42634993.m_KeyValue: "The world never ceased its endless cacophony."

42634995.m_KeyValue: ""Noah Nevernight, I demand you tell me everything.""

42634996.m_KeyValue: "I don't remember anything from my childhood anymore."

42635000.m_KeyValue: ""Darcias, how can you, as Vice-Commander, doubt the Bell Ringer you serve?""

42635001.m_KeyValue: "I arrived at the location Acappella specified."

44909204.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, do you remember that bedtime story?""

44909205.m_KeyValue: ""But thanks to you, I've experienced happiness. Joy.""

44909206.m_KeyValue: "Would that help me experience that sorrow once again?"

44909207.m_KeyValue: "I don't blame her. But the sorrow remained."

44909208.m_KeyValue: ""This place... it's where you first met Tris, isn't it?""

49963505.m_KeyValue: ""Due to their diverse bloodlines, different Vassals play different roles in battle.""

50741602.m_KeyValue: "That red-haired lady seems to be one of the Isle's overseers. Perhaps she can tell us where to begin."

50741668.m_KeyValue: "These three coffins... are they the _$$old friends_$$ you mentioned?"

51199946.m_KeyValue: ""I have a notice here, signed by Lord Hallon himself.""

51199947.m_KeyValue: "What do you mean? You're with that silver-haired one as well?"

51199949.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm... If we sever their strings at the same time, we might gain a brief window to escape with Ami as they fall.""

51199951.m_KeyValue: "Isaac once said his dream was to become the most righteous tailor on the continent."

51199952.m_KeyValue: "Finally! Did you see it? Did you hear it?"

51199977.m_KeyValue: ""I'm not the one who will decide your fate. When the sun rises, I will take you to meet your judgment.""

51199979.m_KeyValue: "It's such a relief that Lord Isaac made it to the Isle! He assisted Joyce in resolving the final issue."

51199980.m_KeyValue: ""The desire to control life, hmph, no less insane than the Bloodborn.""

51199982.m_KeyValue: "Stop copying Joyce! You're ruining Joyce's cute mannerisms!"

51199983.m_KeyValue: "The next device... is it up ahead?"

51200004.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Are we just leaving like this?"

51200011.m_KeyValue: "Why isn't it working?! Could the power of the Siren's Tear not be strong enough?"

51200012.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Why is no one here to protect poor Joyce?"

51200013.m_KeyValue: "Van Helsing?! What are you doing here? Didn't you say you were too busy for a vacation? Why did you come here alone in secret?"

51200014.m_KeyValue: ""We couldn't keep our promises back then, but now, eleven years later, you've defeated the Master and saved my people.""

51200035.m_KeyValue: ""But in Sapphire Isle, dousing each other with blessed seawater is how we welcome guests. The more soaked you are, the more blessings you receive!""

51200036.m_KeyValue: ""Selena, you need to be more careful about the company you keep. You're always getting tangled up with the questionable sorts.""

51200041.m_KeyValue: ""I heard from the wine merchant... You must be Miss Ami, the new Sage?""

51200042.m_KeyValue: ""If creatures like sirens do exist, shouldn't we report this to the Church right away, Van Helsing?""

51200043.m_KeyValue: ""Dawn is near. When the others wake, they'll likely notice these subtle changes as well.""

51200044.m_KeyValue: "I have no need for such lavish ceremonies. You may leave."

51200045.m_KeyValue: "I... I suppose I could muster the courage to visit the Roland family and get to know her better..."

51200046.m_KeyValue: ""What's the matter, Aiona? You look a bit pale.""

51200047.m_KeyValue: "Is that about the only outfit that's... normal?"

51200070.m_KeyValue: "'And don’t forget to check your mailbox. Our deal...'"

51200073.m_KeyValue: "The Church's Bell Ringer had arrived. The Isle could be saved!"

51200074.m_KeyValue: ""Joyce stood over Bella's mangled body, hands on her hips in dismay.""

51200075.m_KeyValue: ""Albrecht's voice lingered in his mind, but Isaac remained silent, fingers clenched tight around the dagger.""

51200076.m_KeyValue: "It had taken all his courage to make a deal with the Bell Ringer—under the guise of establishing liquid metal currency. He fled with Constantine in tow."

51200077.m_KeyValue: ""Labeled vials lined the shelves. Inside jars, dark gray tissue floated. As Averdin stepped closer, he saw slender fingers webbed with translucent skin.""

51200078.m_KeyValue: "'I want my friend to stop being sick.'"

51200079.m_KeyValue: ""Bella awoke from unconsciousness, pain stabbing through every inch of her body.""

51200080.m_KeyValue: "But how could she tear out the throat of the man who had once saved her? The man who had built a home for her people?"

51289838.m_KeyValue: ""Hello, I'm Ami, the new Famine. I used to be the captain of the El Dorado.""

51289839.m_KeyValue: ""I have someone to meet at the sealed area, so I'll wait for you there, meow.""

51289840.m_KeyValue: "His first four drops of blood birthed the Four Calamities. The rest became the Scourges."

51289841.m_KeyValue: ""And he's the one who killed Noah, right here... Ah, could it be!""

51289842.m_KeyValue: ""The Bathory guard a Divine Body known as the Wings. Unlike the others, this one exists as a pair...""

51289843.m_KeyValue: "Why was their Matriarch sealed inside it?"

51289844.m_KeyValue: "This is where I first met Noah… Does that mean we've come full circle?"

51289847.m_KeyValue: ""So you've made up your mind, Mr. Lifeless Eyes? Once you leave this path, we might not meet again.""

51293046.m_KeyValue: "Killer of the Choir... Why don't you kill us?"

52030122.m_KeyValue: "My old nemeses... Let us meet once more—on a new battlefield."

52033323.m_KeyValue: "I remember now. This area is the Hunting Ground where Baphomet conducted his experiments!"

52491336.m_KeyValue: "Then tell me—What must I give to learn the truth?"

52491337.m_KeyValue: "You're Constantine. The other survivor of the catastrophe from eleven years ago... aren't you?"

52491338.m_KeyValue: ""That disaster brought with it the sirens. They're now imprisoned. They agreed to help the fishermen—catching fish, gathering pearls—in exchange for supplies.""

52491339.m_KeyValue: "But to understand how it all began... we must go back twenty years."

52491340.m_KeyValue: ""Not all of it. Fate is cruel... For what awaited us when we returned to the basement... were torn garments and severed limbs, left behind by the Blood Beast.""

52491341.m_KeyValue: ""The procedure lasted through the night. Before I could examine her, Hallon forced me to flee the basement.""

52491343.m_KeyValue: ""Whatever it was you did back then, you did it only to ease your father's torment. He was consumed by the Black Blood.""

52491368.m_KeyValue: "The guards said you killed Lorelei. Is that true?"

52491370.m_KeyValue: ""Lorelei must be alive, and I must... find our promised meeting place...""

52491371.m_KeyValue: ""It's not even dawn yet, why is everyone being woken up so suddenly?""

52491373.m_KeyValue: "Should I pretend I didn't see you in such a pitiable state?"

52491375.m_KeyValue: "Joyce rushed over after hearing about the commotion at the prison—Joyce thought Lord Isaac might be in danger!"

52491377.m_KeyValue: ""I understand… but I will never forgive you, Uncle.""

52491624.m_KeyValue: ""We didn't do that to him, but... Bella, run!""

52491633.m_KeyValue: ""I've never heard of Catherine, Yakov, or the Adventures of Ginokio. From the way you speak to the way you dress... you're suspicious in every possible way.""

52491634.m_KeyValue: ""There, in the gentle breeze of Sapphire Isle, under the masterful hands of the great artisan Peppetto, our protagonist—Ginokio—was born.""

52491635.m_KeyValue: "To dream up something so revolutionary... I must truly be a genius!"

52491636.m_KeyValue: ""Obeying that proud instinct born to mankind... I suppose I, too, must long to become human.""

52491638.m_KeyValue: ""First, I'll need the right weapon. A blade that draws blood on the slightest cut...""

52491639.m_KeyValue: "The stench of blood... that pale skin... This one reeks of the Bloodborn."

52491664.m_KeyValue: "Did I really make a promise with someone? Do I even belong here... in Sapphire Isle?"

52491665.m_KeyValue: ""All over, really... But I remember the beach up ahead—every summer, it would be blanketed by Tidewisps.""

52491667.m_KeyValue: "B-But where were... w-where were we meant to meet?"

52491670.m_KeyValue: "I don't even know her—so how does she know my name?"

52491671.m_KeyValue: "Wait—wait a second! Isn't that Alexa of the Seven Sages?!"

52491696.m_KeyValue: ""And a rather uncouth one, at that.""

52491697.m_KeyValue: "Now it's going to be hard to slip away..."

52491698.m_KeyValue: "We must end this before tomorrow's Eighth Sage Inauguration Ceremony."

52491699.m_KeyValue: "The Church's people are still waiting at the auction house. I'll leave the investigation entirely in your hands."

52491702.m_KeyValue: "You mean the memories of this body's original _$$owner_$$...?"

52491703.m_KeyValue: ""Next time, don't touch anything that creepy again...""

52491729.m_KeyValue: "Silver-Haired! I've successfully completed the plan—what about you?"

52491732.m_KeyValue: "She's getting better and better at handling that strange power—surely thanks to my impeccable guidance!"

52491760.m_KeyValue: ""Lady Alexis, this is where we found that strange device!""

52491761.m_KeyValue: "Has Constantine's Siren's Tear been replaced? Which of the other six tampered with it?"

52491762.m_KeyValue: "No. That’s not what matters now. We must destroy the Master."

52491763.m_KeyValue: "Ah... so you haven't known each other long..."

52491767.m_KeyValue: ""Second—I have no interest in guaranteeing basic welfare for dolls, nor do I see any reason to be dragged into the spotlight for such things.""

52491793.m_KeyValue: ""He's more skilled than I am—easily strong enough to defeat other Sages—and yet, he lent me the Siren's Tear and listened to everything I had to say. He's not the monster that poster makes him out to be.""

52491795.m_KeyValue: "And somehow... I can see the next Siren's Tear is there too."

52491796.m_KeyValue: "Very good. You've carried out the Master's command."

52491797.m_KeyValue: ""Lord Hallon, you are the head of Sapphire Isle Seven Sages. Who would dare question your word?""

52491798.m_KeyValue: ""To think, after more than a decade—Sapphire Isle faces another wave of chaos...""

52491822.m_KeyValue: "I… I have to protect them. I have to defeat the monster."

52491824.m_KeyValue: ""He spent years studying sirens. He would know their anatomy, their behavior—everything. Could it be...""

52491826.m_KeyValue: ""A truth I thought was lost forever... With his appearance, new threads have begun to surface.""

52491827.m_KeyValue: ""Three weeks ago, he began frequently rotating the number of sirens held across various facilities.""

52491829.m_KeyValue: "Take the yellow door on the right."

52491830.m_KeyValue: "Up ahead... that should be the meeting place in my memories."

52491831.m_KeyValue: ""Tourists...? But isn't Sapphire Isle... just a dull, forgotten place?""

52739942.m_KeyValue: ""Each Vassal has four skills, three of which can be enhanced.""

54440983.m_KeyValue: ""I once thought that as long as the light cast mine, you'd catch up eventually.""

54440984.m_KeyValue: "But one thing still puzzles me. Why would this tale be carved into the walls of this sealed place?"

54440985.m_KeyValue: "But the version I know says there was a war before everyone became one."

54440986.m_KeyValue: "Those three figures at the center—are they children?"

54442003.m_KeyValue: "You said it yourself—those holy water bullets are fatal to Bloodborn."

54442006.m_KeyValue: ""But I don't regret it. Because it led me to Noah, who, like me, refuses to kneel to fate.""

54442007.m_KeyValue: ""I trust Aiona, Van Helsing... and I trust Empousa most of all. They'll stop him.""

54442009.m_KeyValue: ""It seems you still don't understand me, Lady Empousa.""

59179123.m_KeyValue: "That sound again... it sounds so miserable... Is this the 'language' of pain for the deaf and mute?"

59179125.m_KeyValue: "Just get him some. You can take your frustrations out on the other wretches."

59179127.m_KeyValue: ""Then, for my next move—Ugh, my head...""

59179154.m_KeyValue: ""No, no! Now’s not the time to worry about Joyce! Let’s turn our attention to the candidates and see how they’ll prove their worth to claim the symbol of the Eighth Sage—the Siren’s Tear!""

59179156.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Savich, don’t you have important matters to attend to today? How do you still have time for tea with me?""

59179157.m_KeyValue: ""Heh, then we’ll strike while the iron’s hot! We’re getting Master Van Helsing out of there!""

59179158.m_KeyValue: ""If Mr. Savich is elected, every resident of the Isle will receive a bag of gold to fund their shops. The remaining gold will be used to expand roads and maintain shipping routes.""

59179160.m_KeyValue: "Hahaha! The Young Master doesn't even know what a barnacle is!"

59179418.m_KeyValue: "Are you really stopping now? Don’t you want to keep going? How about another barrel?"

59179421.m_KeyValue: "Van Helsing? Which family is that? Are they wealthy?"

59179422.m_KeyValue: "I must apologize that your visit to Sapphire Isle has been... 'unpleasant'. That is my failing."

59179444.m_KeyValue: ""M-M-Me what? I know, your father led the creation of the Maritime Spice Route, and you're his precious son.""

59179445.m_KeyValue: ""You are guests who have 'come from afar,' and we've become such fast friends. Please allow me to extend my hospitality.""

59179450.m_KeyValue: "The Sapphire Isle Seven Sages...? What’s that supposed to be?"

59179452.m_KeyValue: "Hmm... it would be perfect if we trimmed the fabric a bit here and there!"

59179453.m_KeyValue: "Trust in the expertise of the 'Association's Fashion Contest' champion! This fit will definitely suit you."

59179454.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Selena is fascinated by mysterious poisons concocted by Alchemists, Miss Aiona seems interested in the pearl-encrusted lamb figurine but remains silent, and as for Miss Ami...""

59179455.m_KeyValue: "I... How did I end up here fighting a siren?"

59179456.m_KeyValue: ""Ah... I understand now, this part needs some improvement...""

59179482.m_KeyValue: ""Grab something to eat, then go see the Captain.""

59179484.m_KeyValue: ""After such a busy day, aren't you tired?""

59179514.m_KeyValue: ""At night, when the mist rolls into Sapphire Isle... a merciless killer called the 'Mistbound Terror' will appear.""

59179515.m_KeyValue: "I would love to see these Roland family runts 'soften' bit by bit... Wouldn't you agree?"

59179516.m_KeyValue: "Could it be... that this Mistbound Terror uses dreams to mark their next target?"

59179517.m_KeyValue: "Or perhaps it was because of playing with that device..."

59179518.m_KeyValue: "Please enjoy the inn's breakfast while you wait for news."

59179519.m_KeyValue: ""Welcome, esteemed guest. How may I be of assistance?""

59179520.m_KeyValue: "You must be Mr. Savich! You've come at the perfect time!"

59179521.m_KeyValue: ""They're at the Shark Hunter Tavern, but let me handle this—Mr. Savich is so wealthy, he looks down on everyone except the Church.""

59179547.m_KeyValue: "It's true! My mother told me so too!"

59179550.m_KeyValue: ""Where does this suffering come from? And where will it end? If we are to endure, if we are to resist, how can we turn a blind eye to such questions?""

59179552.m_KeyValue: "No. Focus on practicing your archery. I'll check your progress when I return."

59179553.m_KeyValue: "Where am I? Why am I locked in here?"

59179576.m_KeyValue: "The night is still young. There's time for pleasant dreams."

59179577.m_KeyValue: "This should be the time for sweet dreams."

59179578.m_KeyValue: ""You won't suddenly try to kill me, will you?""

59179579.m_KeyValue: "Could it mean that 'blackmail' goes against justice?"

59179580.m_KeyValue: "So the victim was a competitor of the Seven Sage Association—or planning to work with their competitors."

59179581.m_KeyValue: "Could the victim be from the same family as Van Helsing?"

59179582.m_KeyValue: ""The dove, a symbol of peace, was mutilated.""

59179583.m_KeyValue: "'Crime Scene and Autopsy Report'... this is it! There's even a sketch of the scene in here..."

59179585.m_KeyValue: "Still content with this life of groveling before the Church for a few measly coins?"

59179608.m_KeyValue: "I should never have trusted you... and Master Van Helsing shouldn't have trusted you either!"

59179609.m_KeyValue: ""Stop, I don't want to hurt you...""

59179612.m_KeyValue: "While I have already know a lot about Miss Ami and your attendant..."

59179613.m_KeyValue: "What do you think of my methods?"

59179615.m_KeyValue: ""That's right, he must be present for any discussion with me.""

59179616.m_KeyValue: "What brings you here? Is there something I can help you with?"

59179617.m_KeyValue: ""Hold on, when was the last time you took a bath?!""

63519039.m_KeyValue: ""Listen here, whelp. Lay a hand on Noah, and you'll regret it.""

63519040.m_KeyValue: "Death can't fight back now. I'll finish him myself and avenge our Commander!"

63519048.m_KeyValue: "Don't worry. I'll help you remember it all. Bit by bit..."

63519049.m_KeyValue: ""Spare me your smug remarks, you traitor!""

63519050.m_KeyValue: "I'm sorry... I never imagined she would..."

63519051.m_KeyValue: "He's just turned into an egg! He's not dead! You're not the one suffering here!"

63519052.m_KeyValue: "You think I wanted this? Your Commander left of her own will—and now Noah has become... this."

63519054.m_KeyValue: ""Must we quarrel now, of all times?""

63520063.m_KeyValue: "The crystal traces become increasingly prominent as we venture deeper. It should lead us to Miss Piera."

63520064.m_KeyValue: "Noah seems to be there as well."

63520071.m_KeyValue: "Master always warned us: every action carries a price. So why would Piera risk punishment by returning to this place?"

63520072.m_KeyValue: "Maybe it's because of her family... just like me."

63520073.m_KeyValue: "The Paracelsus name had already fallen from grace by the time she was born into the Church's territories. She shouldn't have any deep ties to Sunset Isle."

63520074.m_KeyValue: "If something happens to her... I don't know how I'll explain this to Master Albrecht."

63520075.m_KeyValue: "It seems Miss Piera has lost control of her powers due to unforeseen circumstances. This has resulted in the island and its inhabitants being crystallized..."

63520076.m_KeyValue: ""However, this appears to be the only explanation that fits our current situation.""

63520077.m_KeyValue: "She's not as fragile as you're making her out to be."

63520078.m_KeyValue: "But what other explanation could there be? I certainly can't think of any..."

63521217.m_KeyValue: ""You never imagined I would take Commander Tris's place and become a Bell Ringer, did you?""

63521218.m_KeyValue: "Only fragments of memory from that time. There's no need to be afraid."

63521223.m_KeyValue: ""You believed yourself to be a simple doctor, healing villagers beside Ressa.""

63521225.m_KeyValue: "A dream of Sunset Isle and Ressa."

63521226.m_KeyValue: ""That's because during those sixty-six years inside the black cocoon, you fell into a dream of your own making...""

63521228.m_KeyValue: "This is where you truly were for those sixty-six years."

63521230.m_KeyValue: ""But in reality, once removed from Sunset Isle, we were locked within the Church's alchemy chamber, sealed inside the black cocoon for study.""

63522242.m_KeyValue: ""Don't misunderstand me. If Piera is in there, then I can't guarantee her survival once the Bell Ringer strikes.""

63522247.m_KeyValue: "I won't allow it. The one in there is my prey."

63522249.m_KeyValue: ""Hard as it is to believe, it's the only lead I've found.""

63522250.m_KeyValue: "Then what are we waiting for? Let's get Noah out of there!"

63522251.m_KeyValue: "Aren't you Albrecht's student? I'll let you off. Leave now."

63522252.m_KeyValue: "I'm afraid... I can't comply with that."

63522253.m_KeyValue: "What are you planning to do to Noah!?"

63522254.m_KeyValue: "Isn't it obvious? I'm going to kill him here!"

63523396.m_KeyValue: "Naturally... because you left behind two very important things."

63523399.m_KeyValue: "Only by awakening completely... can we become _$$Death_$$ once more."

63523400.m_KeyValue: "Surely by now you understand why I made you remember?"

63523401.m_KeyValue: "You've prepared quite the speech. It seems you knew I would return here after sixty-six years."

63523402.m_KeyValue: "I'm more conscious than I've ever been."

63523403.m_KeyValue: "And she is the testament to the bonds you've made."

63523404.m_KeyValue: ""Death and life, cold and warmth. Only when you become aware of their existences and duality will you truly take form.""

63523405.m_KeyValue: ""Death and rebirth, bitterness and sweetness. Only when you can walk both paths and embrace their duality will you truly have a soul.""

63523406.m_KeyValue: "Her existence serves as a reminder of what you once cherished."

63524420.m_KeyValue: "It's more like I've gained full control of its power."

63524423.m_KeyValue: "It's those creatures from before! And they're even more aggressive now!"

63524425.m_KeyValue: "I know what you've all done for me."

63524428.m_KeyValue: ""No... this feeling, it's like something's burrowing up from underground.""

63525573.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps Death is lonely. At the end of life, only a lonely soul was left to sink silently into the abyss.""

63525575.m_KeyValue: "Speak for yourself... but I still need to find Piera's remains before the island sinks."

63525576.m_KeyValue: "I've never smacked a Divine Body before. I want to see just how tough it is!"

63525577.m_KeyValue: "And I'm sure everyone here feels the same way—"

63525578.m_KeyValue: ""Who's the Vassal, you or me? If you can do it, so can I! Don't forget—we're partners in crime!""

63525579.m_KeyValue: "But dealing with the Divine Body is not going to be easy."

63525580.m_KeyValue: ""From now on, don't even think about leaving my sights!""

63525581.m_KeyValue: "Are you trying to play the lone hero again? Just like on the ship?"

66866370.m_KeyValue: ""In Accursed Journey, deploying the following Vassals will increase your chance of obtaining Extra Rewards.""

66962423.m_KeyValue: ""And as for him... Will he, at last, find the answer to the question that haunts his every step: _$$Who am I?_$$""

70687618.m_KeyValue: ""Are you truly trying to clear up the misunderstanding, or make it worse?""

71287644.m_KeyValue: "Could it be... a 'shade' of an old friend?"

71287645.m_KeyValue: ""He seems to be talking to someone, but he's the only one there.""

71287651.m_KeyValue: ""But there's one thing I'm absolutely sure of: when it comes to Piera, he's definitely on our side.""

71287652.m_KeyValue: ""I'll admit, those Bloodborn with him have piqued my curiosity, but dealing with them isn't part of my current mission.""

71287653.m_KeyValue: "And he's probably here to investigate Piera too."

71287654.m_KeyValue: "'—You said the village was at the base of the mountain... so why haven't we arrived yet... are we going in circles?'"

71287655.m_KeyValue: ""I recognize his heartbeat from the ship, it's him... but...""

71287657.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, I found him. There's a very constant heartbeat in the forest to the southwest.""

71289822.m_KeyValue: ""So... I think... what matters isn't how I'll die, but how I've 'lived.'""

71289823.m_KeyValue: "I could die from using Covenant... die from Blood Beasts... die from being consumed by nightmares. Once we're born... death is always looming... isn't it?"

71289826.m_KeyValue: ""She may be more timid than most, but your existence and her master's support have given her courage far beyond ordinary people.""

71289827.m_KeyValue: ""She wants your approval; she wants to inherit your title; she wants to complete the duty you left unfinished, even if it means facing everything she fears.""

71289828.m_KeyValue: ""I know that... if I hadn't met Noah, I probably would have died soon after arriving on the island...""

71289829.m_KeyValue: "...I'm... not as amazing as Noah says... but I... I did make this decision on my own..."

71289830.m_KeyValue: ""Though I haven't known Piera long, I can sense her confusion. She fears death, fears Blood Beasts, and even fears animals...""

71289831.m_KeyValue: "I... What would he know about me!"

71289833.m_KeyValue: ""Yet she came back on her own, because she admires you—you who bear the family's honor as the Gravekeeper.""

72853540.m_KeyValue: ""Scions of Astolfo, guardians of this sacred ground—eternal and unyielding.""

72853541.m_KeyValue: "Bring her back...? What do you mean?"

72853542.m_KeyValue: ""Look at that Blood Moon, Alene. Tell me—does this look like a world with order to you?""

72853543.m_KeyValue: ""No, I meant... You're the Gravekeeper of the Scourge, Frost. I thought you would have already—""

73462280.m_KeyValue: "How can I trust someone who'd side with the Church in slaughtering their own hometown?"

73473333.m_KeyValue: "Where do you get off talking like that?"

73473335.m_KeyValue: ""I see, young Nevernight. I can sense your confusion, or should I say, your fear...""

73475381.m_KeyValue: ""Unable to recall important people, or even who they are... The pain of 'nothingness' will torment them forever.""

73477525.m_KeyValue: ""Though not explicitly stated, it seems the location of the forbidden grounds is likely related to this place called the Ashen Garden.""

82687887.m_KeyValue: ""The basic principle is to sacrifice the essence of Bloodborn souls as offerings, in turn allowing one to draw upon the purest Ancestral Power to increase a Vassal's strength.""

83721471.m_KeyValue: "I remember your dream was to reach the 'promised home' with the Moonblessed. It seems you still have a long way to go..."

83722494.m_KeyValue: ""Then I met you all, and we journeyed together.""

83727477.m_KeyValue: "I've always procured the latest and finest armor for that old-timer's body."

83728500.m_KeyValue: ""After losing the Matriarch, Lady Empousa is the first heir in line, the one who the family should pledge allegiance to... Are you implying...?""

83731568.m_KeyValue: "Excellent. Decisive and composed. I expected nothing less of you. This is your reward."

85323810.m_KeyValue: ""When it comes to slaughtering one's own, you humans are hardly innocent.""

85323811.m_KeyValue: "I suggest you hand it over. Now."

85323812.m_KeyValue: ""No need for such alarm, miss. If we're speaking of oddities, I'd say that towering companion of yours is a far stranger sight.""

85873742.m_KeyValue: "Then let me show you what House Astolfo has become."

85873743.m_KeyValue: "Then allow me to show you—what your teachings and her decisions have made of me."

85873744.m_KeyValue: "The thunder you heard earlier... That was her."

85874765.m_KeyValue: "So you've stopped concealing your power... You must think you've already won."

85874766.m_KeyValue: "Now that we're alone... won't you share a few secrets with me?"

85874768.m_KeyValue: ""Even after everything—after meeting Noah, after seeing a different future—""

86615465.m_KeyValue: ""Why stand by these fragile, fleeting mortals!?""

86615468.m_KeyValue: ""If we're to retain our humanity, trust is the only weapon we have left.""

87165390.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, but what's the rush? We've all the time in the world to discuss such things, don't we? After all...""

87165391.m_KeyValue: "You really believe you can keep all of us at bay?"

87165392.m_KeyValue: "And they wouldn't have fallen—not Ressa. I know her strength."

87165393.m_KeyValue: ""Plague is the White Knight—whose power now flows through Hati. Famine, the Black Knight—passed her power to Ami through Ranna...""

87165394.m_KeyValue: "Three actually. The red door is closed."

87165395.m_KeyValue: ""Let's not slow him down. We should press on into the sealed area! This time, I swear I'll—""

87165396.m_KeyValue: "Isn't it obvious? The gate's wide open—he's already inside."

87165397.m_KeyValue: "And now the headscarf woman's weapon lies here... abandoned."

87166414.m_KeyValue: ""Let the Long Night descend, and call forth the Blood Moon—""

87166415.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, Lady Empousa... we’re all unharmed. I just couldn't stop him from taking you...""

87166416.m_KeyValue: "You expect me to let an inferior copy serve Lady Limine?"

87166417.m_KeyValue: "…Lamia was right about you. You're always like this."

87166418.m_KeyValue: ""Don't get coy with me—I can hear it in your voice. You feel pity, don't you?""

87166420.m_KeyValue: ""Bad feeling? Oh, I won't have a word of it!""

87166421.m_KeyValue: ""Still at it, are we? Must I remind you, we exist solely to fight for the right to become Mother's _$$vessel of rebirth_$$!""

87166422.m_KeyValue: "Where is this place? What has Cain done to us?"

87166423.m_KeyValue: ""_$$When the four Moonblessed gather, Mother will open her arms and take us back..._$$""

88968648.m_KeyValue: "Stay alert. Their goal is to trap you in this illusion until you die. This game won't stop until you completely break down."

88968655.m_KeyValue: ""Don't you notice? You're no longer on the battlefield. Look at your feet—there's no shadow, and the candlelight passes right through you.""

88968656.m_KeyValue: "Raise shields! Now! Arrows are coming! In waves! Take cover!"

88968657.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Cartographer, stop engaging with him. He's not harmless—whoever summoned him can force him to attack. Use your weapon now!""

88968658.m_KeyValue: "No! Cowards! We fight on! For the Moontide Canal! Where is my sword? Bring me my sword!"

88968659.m_KeyValue: "That Bloodborn stabbed Tom to death before your eyes! He was so close… Why? Why didn't you kill that Bloodborn? You traitor!!"

88969671.m_KeyValue: "Really? How did you figure that out?"

88969672.m_KeyValue: "Tertius promised me a whole room of new playmates!"

88969679.m_KeyValue: "Will you be my new Vassal? It would ease my mind."

88969680.m_KeyValue: "Why do hands sprout from her mantle? Is she being controlled?"

88969681.m_KeyValue: ""Those aren't physical hands... The mantle and claws are extensions of her will. She uses them to drag the souls of the deceased back to the mortal realm, imprisoning them in her mantle as her playthings.""

88969682.m_KeyValue: ""Little Quinn, you've changed... You used to love playing hide and seek with me.""

88969683.m_KeyValue: "Let's skip the small talk. We need to go to the Ritual Chamber. Please step aside."

88969684.m_KeyValue: "The Ritual Chamber? Why would anyone want to visit such a boring place?"

88969685.m_KeyValue: "What did Tertius offer you? This isn't like you at all."

88969686.m_KeyValue: ""It can't be playing hide and seek with her, can it?""

88970831.m_KeyValue: ""The situation has turned in our favor, Elder Valora. If not for your timely arrival, those vicious wolves would have troubled us indefinitely.""

88970836.m_KeyValue: ""I've seen all you've done for this family. When the young lord ascends, I will ensure the Baphomet name rises with him—""

88970837.m_KeyValue: "The Ganelons will remain quiet after this battle. Perhaps your heart can find its solace now."

88970838.m_KeyValue: "Worthy indeed of the Bathory's most loyal knight. The old master's faith in you speaks for itself."

88970857.m_KeyValue: "That was the story of Long Night."

88970858.m_KeyValue: "You must have realized it—the Divine Body I used to cross the realm is the same one that Grandpa and Noah mentioned."

88970863.m_KeyValue: "You brought back... historical materials far more precious than any notes."

88970865.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Grandpa... I went surveying in secret... and couldn't even bring back a single page of notes... I've failed again... I'll never become a true cartographer...""

88970867.m_KeyValue: ""This, Agnes Ganelon, is your greatest and most credible record as a cartographer.""

88970869.m_KeyValue: "You have passed the ultimate test for a cartographer."

88970870.m_KeyValue: ""You became the one to etch legends onto the timeline, grounding history's course in the chaos of uncertainty.""

97203878.m_KeyValue: ""Once they're all my playthings, there'll be no more quarrels. Wouldn't that be peaceful?""

97203909.m_KeyValue: "I have stood watch over this Twilight Citadel for a hundred years..."

97203975.m_KeyValue: ""No soul that draws breath, nor any that ever will, can defeat me!""

97402253.m_KeyValue: ""You think the 'Black Blood' is some sort of disease, right?""

97402254.m_KeyValue: "It's been corroding my sanity. I could turn into a monster at any moment..."

97402255.m_KeyValue: "But what if I told you... that the Black Blood can grant you power beyond human limits?"

97402256.m_KeyValue: "So... the Bloodborn are carriers capable of harnessing the power of Black Blood?"

97402257.m_KeyValue: "It seems your higher-ups have not told you the real reason why they fear the Black Blood!"

99635668.m_KeyValue: "...Let's keep going. Noah won't break his promise. He'll make sure no one misses our Covenants."

99638868.m_KeyValue: "You mean we can rest here for a while?"

99638869.m_KeyValue: "The forbidden grounds my father protected suffered the same..."

111117374.m_KeyValue: "Was any of it real? Or just dreams dressed up in memory?"

111117377.m_KeyValue: "(The collar's too tight… This mantle feels like it's choking me)"

111117380.m_KeyValue: "I'm starving. This really is the waking world."

111117382.m_KeyValue: "_$$Sleeping here with me for a century_$$—weren't those your own words?"

111117383.m_KeyValue: ""Until then, wait for me... and want for me, my beloved Vassal.""

111117384.m_KeyValue: "I will make you keep that promise."

118910632.m_KeyValue: ""When the people from the Church landed on the island, I... I think I gave them the wrong directions.""

118910634.m_KeyValue: "The source of their mutation is Black Blood—and salt is one of the substances that counteracts Black Blood!"

118910635.m_KeyValue: "66 years ago? What are you talking about...?"

118910637.m_KeyValue: ""But Noah... when did you become so strong? All this time, we thought you were just some frail assistant to the doctor...""

118910664.m_KeyValue: ""In truth, no one knows what happens after we die. Perhaps its possible to become a phantom of longing thoughts.""

118910665.m_KeyValue: ""Even though I lost my memories, it feels like I've been constantly having brushes with death these past few days.""

118910666.m_KeyValue: "How could that be? Jason... Sora... Ressa... Why can't I remember any of them...?"

118910667.m_KeyValue: "What's going on? The tremors seem to be coming from the mountain!"

118910691.m_KeyValue: "But if that's the case... why would Master choose me? I'm not good in battle and I don't have any special abilities... I'm not good at anything..."

118910696.m_KeyValue: ""Because you know something, right? Or maybe you did do it after all.""

118910697.m_KeyValue: ""Piera Paracelsus, Vice-Commander of the Third Bell Ringer.""

118910700.m_KeyValue: "That last sec was for my catchphrase."

118910702.m_KeyValue: "Yet... I can't detect even a hint of hesitation in your heartbeat... Are you actually serious?"

118910722.m_KeyValue: "Acappella's voice? Where are you?! Why did you run off and abandon us here?!"

118910723.m_KeyValue: ""'Air manipulation'? So that's what that move on the ship was... I've got to say, that was seriously impressive.""

118910728.m_KeyValue: "And you were there with us 66 years ago to subjugate Death. Don't tell me you've forgotten...?"

118910730.m_KeyValue: ""Though he was a passenger, while we were stowaways.""

118910731.m_KeyValue: ""Throughout the ages, this isle has stood apart, its shores barred to outsiders by the will of the Divine Body. Thus it has ascended into the realm of legend.""

118910732.m_KeyValue: ""Go, follow your path. I'll help you find him, so he can be your ally in the fight against the Calamity's fate.""

118910733.m_KeyValue: "That concern doesn't seem to extend to me."

118910734.m_KeyValue: "So Noah... might be connected to the Bathory family... Could the companions he's searching for also be...?"

118910735.m_KeyValue: ""So you're worried about him. Well don't. If he really is from Sunset Isle 66 years ago, we might just have a lot in common...""

118910757.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella, as my successor, you're far too naive. For a Bell Ringer, having 'humanity' is a fatal flaw.""

118910760.m_KeyValue: ""And what's truly infuriating... is your tone. Urging us to fight Death, to abandon our current existence...""

118910763.m_KeyValue: "No... this can't be right. You must have been deceived by Death... How... How could this be??"

118910764.m_KeyValue: ""Hahaha! Oh no, we know exactly who you are, little Piera. You're you, and your grandmother is your grandmother!""

118910765.m_KeyValue: ""All 'thoughts' eventually die, becoming 'longings' that rely on other 'thoughts.'""

118910766.m_KeyValue: "Grandmother... once told me that Death left behind its most precious possession on this island..."

118910767.m_KeyValue: ""That's why when you enter these blessed grounds, we can all connect through our shared memories.""

118910788.m_KeyValue: "No... I'm fine... It's just... I haven't mastered the Covenant yet.. my body is a bit..."

118910789.m_KeyValue: ""Covenant is a way of borrowing power from their 'gods' by consuming one's life force. While Bell Ringers might be unaffected, for ordinary people...""

118910793.m_KeyValue: ""My Piera... though you've grown up, you're still my brightest, most dependable granddaughter... and the one most like me...""

118910794.m_KeyValue: "What...? So the reason you can see Grandmother is because... you were here 66 years ago?"

118910795.m_KeyValue: ""I hate to interrupt this touching reunion, but I'm afraid we need to pause for a moment.""

118910796.m_KeyValue: "Behind it... stands the sun that never sets; yet its eyes... are forever fixed upon the 'darkness' sealed within the coffin."

118910797.m_KeyValue: "A Gravekeeper is born to guard the abyss... and they must know... how to find their way in the darkness..."

118910798.m_KeyValue: "...In the name of Paracelsus... I offer my life for the legacy..."

118910799.m_KeyValue: "Foolish child... you don't... understand at all..."

118910826.m_KeyValue: ""Yeah... Sorry to keep you waiting, Ressa...""

118910827.m_KeyValue: "I'll get you out of there! I'll take you away from this place!"

118910828.m_KeyValue: "The Spirit Bone Tower... it's the perfect form made from the blood and bones of my people... It's indestructible..."

118910829.m_KeyValue: ""I won't leave you behind, no matter what happens.""

118910830.m_KeyValue: "No... not that... I mean... hurry... and go..."

121096958.m_KeyValue: ""Skoll... you've always looked up to Father, haven't you?""

121096959.m_KeyValue: ""After I arrived, I snuck away from the squad and came to look for you two.""

121096960.m_KeyValue: ""Then, those wolves we encountered earlier were probably the infected townspeople.""

121096961.m_KeyValue: "It's precisely because it's dangerous that I need to find them!"

121096963.m_KeyValue: "Leave that to my superior. He'll surely step in to help."

121096990.m_KeyValue: ""But what about you? You seem to possess some power to suppress the Black Blood, but even that has its limits...""

121096991.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, my former colleagues, but I must bear witness to this man's oath until the very end.""

121097255.m_KeyValue: "Enemy? Is there something between your two families?"

121097256.m_KeyValue: "What the... This guy looks so weak."

121097257.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Why are you back? Weren't you in a hurry to find someone?"

121097291.m_KeyValue: ""No one can change their predetermined fate, nor escape the cycle of time.""

121097292.m_KeyValue: "Hahaha! Good point. Perhaps no one really knows their 'true self.'"

121097318.m_KeyValue: ""Cain always has something concealed, but he never lies.""

121097319.m_KeyValue: "Are you alright? Are you hurt anywhere?"

121097320.m_KeyValue: ""For as long as I can remember, we have never been accepted by mortals. We cannot walk under the sunlight. We are born as fugitives, constantly hunted.""

121097321.m_KeyValue: "But the moon is far beyond our reach. Even birds can't fly there. How could we possibly...?"

121097322.m_KeyValue: ""Damn it, I don't get it! What's the Church up to? They're the ones who told us the Bathory family was the enemy!""

121097324.m_KeyValue: ""Huh? Listen here, you unruly brat! You better explain yourself. I won't stand for baseless insults!""

121097325.m_KeyValue: ""And here I thought you were going to say something decent... How dare you insult my family, you stinking bat!""

121097354.m_KeyValue: "I'm sorry... If only I had noticed sooner... I hope you'll no longer be tormented by nothingness."

121097355.m_KeyValue: "The Church has abandoned you now. I'd say it's karma for you 'evil wolves'!"

121097356.m_KeyValue: ""Did you see a boy on your way here? About my height, with brown skin and messy hair.""

121097357.m_KeyValue: "I-I'm fine. But her... how can that bat woman actually turn into a bat? And change back on her own!"

121097382.m_KeyValue: ""What a pain... So either we search on our own, or we help them find their father first?""

121097386.m_KeyValue: "I'm not taking you with me. I'm going back to find them on my own..."

121097387.m_KeyValue: "And three others who don't look local. Reinforcements she called in?"

121097389.m_KeyValue: ""You've been calling me a smelly bat all this time, and now you're finally asking for my name?!""

121097417.m_KeyValue: ""Let's hurry to the Ashen Garden, Noah! It's this way!""

121097418.m_KeyValue: ""Wolfsbane is actually its real name. Thibault, the Church's chief doctor, does indeed give it to soldiers infected with Black Blood.""

121097420.m_KeyValue: "Do you know where your father might be now?"

121097421.m_KeyValue: "Have you been to Mouret before? Do you know their father?"

121097449.m_KeyValue: ""That was harsh, Hati. We grew up together...""

121097450.m_KeyValue: "Don't look at me. The Bathory family cut ties with The Church long before I can remember. I know nothing about any Gravekeeper."

121097452.m_KeyValue: "I was there the few times Uncle Gadric came to see Father. They never talked about this stuff."

121097453.m_KeyValue: ""What are you talking about, Clive? Father has always seen you as his heir.""

121199361.m_KeyValue: ""It's too cold here… isn't it, Pavana?""

121199362.m_KeyValue: ""No, no, no! You have to run—warn the others! Get them out of the camp!""

121199365.m_KeyValue: "No... Colossus Max... you must go back..."

121878492.m_KeyValue: "You can continue to increase Transfusion Level after evolution.|The following Vassals' levels will be locked and cannot be reset. Continue?"

123282492.m_KeyValue: ""He's on a completely different level from the enemies I've fought before, and we‘ve just suffered a crushing defeat...""

123282493.m_KeyValue: "Can we just leave out that last part?"

123294534.m_KeyValue: "Stop being dramatic. These soulless pawns of Baphomet will never break through my shield!"

123294535.m_KeyValue: ""It's all because of you, loudmouth! Now the guards are after us!""

125765597.m_KeyValue: ""This must be the brazier. Once we light it, we should be able to activate the elevator.""

125765599.m_KeyValue: ""Every day—every night in that cell, I could hear someone whispering to me.""

125765601.m_KeyValue: ""...because they were modified by Baphomet's Black Blood process, the Black Blood left in the cell would...""

125765602.m_KeyValue: ""It was the memories of my dead family... my father, brothers, and even my mother who protected me regardless of her own peril...""

125765603.m_KeyValue: ""—I'm willing to become such a relentless curse, as long as I can kill him with my own hands!""

125765604.m_KeyValue: ""Baphomet has always been toying with flesh and blood, only to retaliate against his own terrible curse that can never be undone.""

125765605.m_KeyValue: ""Not to mention, now I have one more reason to settle the score with that demon—for Lady Empousa and her sisters!""

125766623.m_KeyValue: ""Next, we have to face the oldest elder of the Bathory family, the arrogant and cruel Bloodborn—Baphomet 'The Soulless.'""

125766624.m_KeyValue: ""He is powerful and cunning, and understands the battleground better than any of us. This is bound to be a fierce battle.""

125766625.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, I'm trembling. I can't help but doubt my feeble self, can we really defeat him?""

125766626.m_KeyValue: ""I don't think you're weak. Don't forget we've crossed swords before, although you lost that time, too.""

125766628.m_KeyValue: ""How reliable... Well then, let's go. We've got a score to settle with him.""

125774301.m_KeyValue: "As far as I can touch... that is the end of the world—the Other Side."

125774309.m_KeyValue: "Where do you think the 'Other Side' at the end of the world lies?"

125774311.m_KeyValue: ""(Cinematic Subtitles) When I grow up, I'm gonna leave 'Paradise' and conquer whatever's out there.""

125774312.m_KeyValue: ""(Cinematic Subtitles) Across the sea, of course.""

125774313.m_KeyValue: "You're such a kid. The stars were created to illuminate our Paradise. We are the center of it all. There's nothing out there."

125774314.m_KeyValue: ""Well I think the Other Side is up there, beyond the pale moon, where the stars were born.""

125774316.m_KeyValue: ""What about you, Abel? Who do you think is right?""

125775325.m_KeyValue: ""And then we recreated you through alchemy. Although it seems incomplete, I should congratulate you on your rebirth, so... 'Happy Birthday.'""

125775334.m_KeyValue: "We've prepared some new clothes for you. I hope they will fit."

125775336.m_KeyValue: ""This is a secluded castle that belongs to the Bathory family, and the home of Lady Empousa and myself.""

125776479.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph. Well, now that you've seen through me, there's no point hiding it. Naturally, my beauty far eclipses that hideous creature.""

125776480.m_KeyValue: ""No, you're not Empousa. I spot plenty of differences.""

125776485.m_KeyValue: "The special type... 'silver-hair'... I'll give you a chance to return to my side."

125776489.m_KeyValue: "Have you looked in a mirror lately?!"

125776490.m_KeyValue: "What?! You're the flower girl from Starfall Valley? Why are you dressed so shamelessly!"

125776491.m_KeyValue: ""You really did lose your memory. Do you not even remember your master, Empousa?""

125777504.m_KeyValue: "What gave you the right to speak during this council?"

125777510.m_KeyValue: "I just got here... I don't know the past of this family."

125777512.m_KeyValue: ""How long has it been since the Hall of the Elders last saw such excitement, with two trials on the same day? A hundred years?""

125777513.m_KeyValue: "Don't be rude. The one in charge here is Elder Baphomet. He values tradition and standing above all else."

125777514.m_KeyValue: ""Elders, please hear me out. Yes, lady Empousa violated the tenets, but it was to rescue a special type. It was an emergency...""

125777516.m_KeyValue: "The Four Elders seem quite different from what I imagined... more like a gathering of weirdos."

125778657.m_KeyValue: ""No, I was just struck by the coincidence. Just as I had doubts, someone appeared to answer them...""

125778662.m_KeyValue: ""Oh... and her, what is this Moonblessed thing anyway? At first, I thought it was what the Bloodborn called themselves...""

125778664.m_KeyValue: "The Bloodborn have long held a legend that we were born on the moon."

125778665.m_KeyValue: ""The Black Blood, the carriage accident, the execution, the resurrection, the Embrace, the Bathory elders...""

125778667.m_KeyValue: ""My thoughts are so muddled, my memories before the crash...very hazy.""

125778668.m_KeyValue: "We've been rushing through so much until now. Only after calming down do I realize just how many things have happened these past few days."

125779681.m_KeyValue: ""If you knew the way, why didn't you say so earlier?""

125779682.m_KeyValue: ""You didn't ask me. Besides, I wanted Aiona to ask, not you.""

125779685.m_KeyValue: ""We must be close to those treasures, that's why we're caught in these disorienting traps...""

125779686.m_KeyValue: ""No, that's not it, we've just been taking the wrong turns.""

125779687.m_KeyValue: "Wait... do you know your way around here?"

125779688.m_KeyValue: ""Sometimes, Baphomet would escort members of our family to the experiment site. I... remember the way.""

125779690.m_KeyValue: "It feels like we've been going in circles..."

125779691.m_KeyValue: ""I heard this tower existed even before the Bathory family took refuge here, it was only converted into a prison in the last decade.""

125779692.m_KeyValue: "Then there may be many ancient treasures hidden inside this tower that no one knows about!"

125780835.m_KeyValue: ""<style=""Highlight"">The moon is but a dream of the sun</style>, and thus we were forgotten by the light—""

125780836.m_KeyValue: "The stars are our birthplace; and thus we were exiled—"

125780838.m_KeyValue: "Do you know what Death means? Do you fear disappearing as well?"

125780839.m_KeyValue: "I feel like... this is the first time I truly understand the meaning of that word."

125780841.m_KeyValue: ""When the sun rises, and its rays shine in, I will... disappear, won't I?""

125780842.m_KeyValue: ""Even the moonlight, which should feel like a mother's embrace, has turned cold...""

125781859.m_KeyValue: ""Or rather, he was struck down by that new elder, Gilrain, and then we were imprisoned in this tower...""

125781860.m_KeyValue: ""I see... But I still feel that if it's him, he wouldn't die just like that.""

125781863.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, and where's Cain? Is he slacking off somewhere again?""

125781865.m_KeyValue: "Why has Lady Empousa been silent since leaving the cell?"

125781866.m_KeyValue: ""You... if you did anything to upset Lady Empousa, I'll kill you where you stand.""

125781868.m_KeyValue: ""When you two were alone earlier, did you discuss anything?""

126326561.m_KeyValue: ""Peace can be destroyed by war, yet war is the only way to build peace—what you seek is a war that will completely end the old era.""

130015517.m_KeyValue: "Turn this setback into drive by strengthening your Vassals."

130015520.m_KeyValue: "Failure is but a chance to start anew. Trust that you will face the next challenge with better composure."

131268388.m_KeyValue: ""Ressa did everything she could for me to prevent the disease from spreading. But I eventually became like this, while still clinging to the promise I made her, until...""

131269411.m_KeyValue: ""If I disappeared, you would remember me?""

131269412.m_KeyValue: ""Well it doesn't matter how many there are, just kill them all!""

131808636.m_KeyValue: ""Those were garments to cover your body. Equipment, however, helps increase the Blood Power and gain an advantage in combat.""

131808667.m_KeyValue: ""When a Vassal reaches a certain Affinity level, they may open up their inner world to you.""

131808966.m_KeyValue: ""As we progress forward, you will have the opportunity to enter more areas and unlock powerful features, greatly assisting us in our journey.""

131809725.m_KeyValue: "I've heard from Setti that Cain has began assigning Missions to those stationed in the castle."

131811868.m_KeyValue: ""To leave this tower, take the left path. For the unknown, take the right, which may prove rewarding.""

132743186.m_KeyValue: ""Units that pass through the werewolf's Blood Trail will be inflicted with Pestilence, taking DMG equal to a percentage of their Max HP per sec, while boosting DMG dealt by {0}. This effect lasts until the end of the battle.""

133669634.m_KeyValue: ""It's alright, Hasan... If not for her, those creatures would have devoured us long ago.""

133669635.m_KeyValue: ""Disaster...? Wait—Ottavia, earlier you said this lance would bring death. Why?""

138570518.m_KeyValue: "Help Aiona use the power of the _$$Eye_$$ to reverse time and return to the past"

143480661.m_KeyValue: "The sun sets and darkness creeps across the land."

143480662.m_KeyValue: "Not long ago… I was even thinking of ending it all. To erase the curse for good."

145267704.m_KeyValue: "If the Alita family had not fallen..."

148257079.m_KeyValue: ""To keep your account secure, please do not remove your last bound account.""

153238191.m_KeyValue: "Eva! You too... Has the entire search team been infected?"

153496557.m_KeyValue: ""The more fragments you unlock, the better rewards you'll receive.""

158775739.m_KeyValue: "Purchase items to earn Shop Points and claim generous rewards including <color=#FF9435>Ancestral SSR Vassals</color>!"

158831147.m_KeyValue: ""Stop talking. The speed of 'sandification' is far faster than the effects of Black Blood. Our power can't suppress or stop this process, so stay away from the monsters in this desert.""

158831148.m_KeyValue: "I'm afraid their power might be even greater than those we encountered earlier."

158831150.m_KeyValue: "We're... running out of time... my lady..."

158831181.m_KeyValue: ""<alpha=#FF>My companions are waiting for me, I must go back... Let me go!""

158831183.m_KeyValue: ""Whoever you are, swear by Aeon, if I offer my soul... you will protect everyone in my stead!""

158831443.m_KeyValue: ""The lord is not here, my lady. You shouldn't speak too much; your eyes need time to recover. Please rest for now.""

158831445.m_KeyValue: ""Relax and just sleep for now. When you open your eyes again, the honor and duty of our family will be yours...""

158831446.m_KeyValue: "I don't need to rest. I need to see my father."

158831448.m_KeyValue: "There's no end to them. I need to find a way out of here—"

158831475.m_KeyValue: "I will definitely save Father and our family..."

158831476.m_KeyValue: "Was that the day of the ritual? What about the lord? What happened to him?"

158831477.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, kid! Where are you going? You did pay—""

158831478.m_KeyValue: "So much sand... Did it blow in from outside?"

158831510.m_KeyValue: "But the lord said the most important thing is to complete 'that matter.' None of the guards stationed there are allowed to leave their posts..."

158831544.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be afraid, I have no ill intent.""

158831575.m_KeyValue: "The servants will die; the guards will die; the seven elders will die; the lord and his heir will die; and this entire castle will crumble in a great fire. This is what is 'predestined' to take place today."

158831577.m_KeyValue: ""I don't care if you're after wealth or honor, but you... shouldn't have touched Aiona.""

158831610.m_KeyValue: ""Assassins clad in black, concealing their ambitions beneath the night sky;""

158831641.m_KeyValue: ""Those who seek power from darkness will fall into eternal night. Gilrain, do not waver from the faith you pursue.""

161174827.m_KeyValue: ""I've had my eye on this situation for a while now. The real issue is... oops, I'm saying too much...""

161177765.m_KeyValue: "There are no fools here. Just tell me what you're really after."

161179940.m_KeyValue: ""It might not be suitable, but I could help you find more inspiration.""

161181854.m_KeyValue: ""Haha, I thought you might have actually learned something after all this time apart...""

161183011.m_KeyValue: "Hmm... Allow me to share a story with you after the meeting concludes."

161184032.m_KeyValue: "Something lurking in the shadows of my past warns me against such actions..."

161187103.m_KeyValue: "I've witnessed far too many tragedies in this world and they all shared a common cause一human nature."

163500050.m_KeyValue: ""The moment you entered the Hall of the Elders, I began preparing...""

163500051.m_KeyValue: "To become this strong in just a night... to be able to stand against even me..."

163507080.m_KeyValue: ""The Hall of the Elders is not far ahead. From here on out, we must proceed with the utmost caution.""

163758122.m_KeyValue: "Make good use of it and it will prove to be a boon."

163761323.m_KeyValue: ""I lose sleep in agony every time I think about the future of the Bathory family resting on your shoulders, you complete failure.""

163792833.m_KeyValue: "That stance... Don't tell me he's about to use Compost?"

163792835.m_KeyValue: "The perfect fusion of the Alita bloodline and the Eye of the Divine Body… The Saint never wished for you to walk freely in the outside world."

163792836.m_KeyValue: "We'll send both you and that ugly rat sky-high!"

163792837.m_KeyValue: "But… aren't you a Bell Ringer? How can you speak like that about the Divine Bodies?"

163792839.m_KeyValue: ""Gone for only a moment… and already you stand with the Bloodborn, Aiona Alita?""

163792840.m_KeyValue: "I’m sorry… Lady Empousa. I never told you… I once served as the Saint's priestess."

165084492.m_KeyValue: ""Freedom... this freedom that you all yearn for, what exactly is it?""

165084493.m_KeyValue: ""Hah! You fancy yourself witty, do you?""

165084494.m_KeyValue: ""He might've ruled this dump once, but now I'm the strongest!""

165084495.m_KeyValue: ""Here, on Carrelle land, it's our only shot at changing fate!""

165964799.m_KeyValue: ""But with everything that's been happening on the island recently, I couldn't bear to watch everyone getting infected and turning into beasts one after another. That's why the village chief and I contacted the Church...""

165964800.m_KeyValue: "D-Don't suddenly get quiet like you're trying to spare my feelings!"

165964801.m_KeyValue: "Then I'd better stay alive to witness the day you unleash the secrets of salt!"

165964802.m_KeyValue: ""An odd fellow from the Church told me, but more importantly...""

165964804.m_KeyValue: ""You've already known for a long time, haven't you?""

165964831.m_KeyValue: ""No, I'm not just doubting you, I'm doubting my own existence as well.""

165964832.m_KeyValue: ""No, I mean about my grandmother. She sacrificed herself as a Gravekeeper before I was even born. I've never met her, nor have I ever mentioned her to you.""

165964834.m_KeyValue: "Who could it be? Only those from the Paracelsus bloodline can become the sacrifice..."

165964857.m_KeyValue: ""Whether we bring her back, what happens afterwards... we'll cross those bridges when she actually returns.""

165964858.m_KeyValue: "It's fine. It seems she holds everyone in equal contempt."

165964863.m_KeyValue: "Did you help Death escape from the cathedral?"

165964864.m_KeyValue: ""This time, his Vice-Commander has committed such a serious crime, even someone like him couldn't just feign indifference.""

165964866.m_KeyValue: "Noah... Was it really just a coincidence that you used this gesture as our secret signal...?"

165964867.m_KeyValue: "Piera... have you ever wondered why the Bell Ringer's Vice-Commanders tend to be such emotionally detached oddballs?"

165964870.m_KeyValue: ""You expect me to believe that? If it wasn't you, how could you possibly know all this?""

165964889.m_KeyValue: ""Cut it out, you brat! If you're here, show yourself already!""

165964890.m_KeyValue: "You little brat! Just wait till I find out where you are—I'll fly over and teach you a lesson."

165964896.m_KeyValue: ""Come to think of it, wasn't there someone from the Bathory family on the ship too? Could that have been his companion?""

165964899.m_KeyValue: ""Forgive me, Acappella. I fear I can't keep my promise.""

165964900.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, come on! We were just following Aiona's advice to meet in the village. How did we end up in this mess?!""

165964901.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, you're right! But... where should I even start looking?""

165964902.m_KeyValue: "But that didn't prevent you from getting lost on the way here."

165964924.m_KeyValue: ""...Fear and hesitation are behind me now... Goodbye, Master, Acappella, Grandmother, and ...Noah.""

165964928.m_KeyValue: "What? But you're my ancestors! You're not Gravekeepers—you've become Death's pawns!"

165964929.m_KeyValue: ""I am Piera's granddaughter, I am the Paracelsus Gravekeeper. I will defeat Death. I have never wavered...""

165964930.m_KeyValue: ""...Master, even though you never allowed me to use the things inside...""

165964931.m_KeyValue: ""Because we're all Gravekeepers, every one of us!""

165964932.m_KeyValue: ""And that is the indomitable courage of 'humanity,' something unique only to them.""

165964933.m_KeyValue: ""...But she was right. Death has truly returned, and... it will indeed come back to the blessed grounds where it was once sealed.""

165964955.m_KeyValue: "I knew he couldn't be trusted! Curse that heartless man!"

165964956.m_KeyValue: "You... why are you still defending him! He's a Bell Ringer! How could he not know what you were doing right under his nose!"

165964959.m_KeyValue: ""It's because of Death's power that this island has these 'phantoms of longing,' allowing us to converse like this...""

165964960.m_KeyValue: "No... that can't be! The grandmother in my memories would never be... be someone who would choose to give up..."

165964964.m_KeyValue: "Will I also remain on Sunset Isle... as someone's 'longing'?"

165964966.m_KeyValue: "Death remains an inescapable nightmare looming over our homeland."

165964994.m_KeyValue: ""You have to live on... Carry my 'longing' with you, and see the world beyond this island.""

165964995.m_KeyValue: "But in the end... I'm not the one who can accompany you on the journey ahead..."

165964996.m_KeyValue: "My master... transmuted them into... the 'perfect form'... There's no way to destroy it..."

168324958.m_KeyValue: "Maximum number of Clan applicants has been reached."

173380725.m_KeyValue: ""You already are—standing by my side, drinking with me.""

173380727.m_KeyValue: ""You are the leader of the Inquisition, entrusted with carrying out the Church's orders to punish heretics and uphold its authority.""

173695176.m_KeyValue: ""You're just in time. Before I purge this heretic, let us ask the great Aeon to forgive us for the bloodshed that's about to come.""

173695178.m_KeyValue: ""You're okay, aren't you? You won't die that easily, because you're like me.""

173695179.m_KeyValue: "Why would I need to hide from the likes of you? And the name is Empousa!"

174991091.m_KeyValue: "I said not to treat me as a weakling... Why are there more enemies coming from the other side! Help me!"

178273849.m_KeyValue: ""You're right. And as a daughter of Ganelon, I won't allow you to lay a finger on Quinn.""

178274179.m_KeyValue: "I... I just wanted to be stronger..."

178274210.m_KeyValue: "Cursed wretch of that damned bloodline. We should've eaten you long ago!"

178274276.m_KeyValue: ""They're after something else. Jamie, stay behind me.""

178274311.m_KeyValue: "So this is how the feud between Ganelon and Bathory began..."

178274342.m_KeyValue: ""...and violated the sacred boundary of the Moontide Canal, I'd have never so much as stirred.""

183190611.m_KeyValue: ""This guy talks big, but he can't fight at all.""

183823773.m_KeyValue: "Not again... These Bloodborn... why do they keep turning up everywhere? Are they truly immortal?"

188548467.m_KeyValue: ""Desert dwellers came to this place twice—once a century ago in pursuit of new lands, and a hundred years later in chains. The rare blue crystal mines turned the desert into a treasure trove for nobles, but they also became the final resting place for countless enslaved desert inhabitants.""

188548468.m_KeyValue: ""The frozen blue lake stands high between the Astolfo and Montebello families. Beneath its untouched surface, an ancient verse echoes: A lake upon the heights, illuminated by the Other Side, sings of a child divine.""

188548469.m_KeyValue: ""Adamm Astolfo, the sage who once led the desert people in their wandering, established the first desert tribe along this river. Though the tribe has long since vanished, the river bears the sage's name as its lasting legacy.""

188548470.m_KeyValue: ""Stone pillars stand solemnly in the desert sands, engraved with records of the Astolfo family's southward migration along the oases. Yet their ancestral dwellings have crumbled to ruin, and the elders who have passed sealed away this history, burying unspeakable secrets of the past.""

188548473.m_KeyValue: ""Children of the desert often sing this rhyme: Water flows where sands run dry, trees shall bloom and touch the sky. A bard roams from town to east, to seek a land of peace at least. Yet long ago, this verdant land, belonged to another's hand.""

188548474.m_KeyValue: ""This narrow mountain path, northeast of Sandspire Keep, is the only route to the outside world. After the Campaign began, it became a burial ground for fallen Vassals. Though frost has replaced the desert sands, the weapon marks carved into the surrounding cliffs remain as eternal scars.""

188548479.m_KeyValue: ""_$$We extolled our ancestors for their protection, we extolled the Divine for our victories. Now, with nowhere else to turn, we must extol once more—for the future of our people._$$""

188548480.m_KeyValue: ""After countless migrations, the desert dwellers finally built high walls atop the central dunes. Yet the peace they longed for crumbled under relentless conflict, leaving only restless spirits to wander the sands.""

188708387.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'prohibiting the consumption of raw flesh and blood'?"

188709408.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'investing significant funds to repair our long-neglected Observatory'?"

188711586.m_KeyValue: ""What are your thoughts on 'Granting vassals the freedom to enter the long sleep, provided there are sufficient grounds'?""

188714657.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'claiming this area with favorable natural conditions but far from our castle'?"

190534828.m_KeyValue: "Don't worry. I'm not tired at all."

190534830.m_KeyValue: "And mine may end sooner than most."

193589265.m_KeyValue: ""Ever since that day, these vermin have been haunting my dreams...""

194932806.m_KeyValue: "Who are you? Where did you come from? Where will you go?"

194932808.m_KeyValue: ""As you said, my soul is nearing its end, which is why I crave the physical and envy it.""

195944384.m_KeyValue: "Did you not learn your lesson the first time?"

197637822.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> The stylish cap worn by Isaac Van Helsing. On the pursuit of justice, it shielded him from the elements.
Though the damp winds may tousle his hair, they are incapable of extinguishing the youthful sparkle in his eyes.""

197637824.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> Van Helsing's wrist guard, stained with blood.
Even as the marsh envelops his figure, the young man draws his sword with swift alacrity, displaying not even a speck of hesitation.""

197637825.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Outfit</style> The pauldrons worn by Van Helsing. Its bold design accentuates the wearer's personality.
At the time, he hadn't realized that pursuing one's vision demands bearing heavy responsibility.""

197637827.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> Van Helsing's vows echoed with resolve.
It wasn't until darkness consumed him that he realized: Only actions taken from a position of power are considered true justice.""

197637855.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> The feathered crown discarded by Noah the Apostate, imbued with the primal power of Death.
Renouncing himself to embrace death, his sole hope is to leave a trace of himself somewhere in the future.""

197637856.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Outfit</style> The torn garment of Noah the Apostate, imbued with the primal power of Death.
The fervor which burned inside chest was not for the present, but for a future unbound from destiny.""

197637857.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring.</style> A ring forged from the blood of Noah the Apostate, imbued with the primal power of Death.
Blood and mind converged to birth a soul which could lead them forth. _$$This is faith; overbearing, yet ethereal._$$""

197637858.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> The amalgamation of deep despair and profound hope within Noah the Apostate, imbued with the primal power of Death.
'Place down your sword, the future you seek is not elsewhere; it is right beneath your feet.'""

197638215.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> Amulet crafted from the carcass of the Starfall Valley Blackblood Beast.
The Bell Ringer melted the beast's seemingly impregnable hide instantaneously with a terrible heat, bringing inspiration to the artisans.""

197638218.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> A leather helmet sewn from the carcass of the Starfall Valley Blood Beast.
Perhaps an illusion? The visage revealed by this Blackblood Beast appears to be in agony, yet somehow gives the impression of a grin.""

197638220.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> A ring crafted from the carcass of the Starfall Valley Blackblood Beast.
The bone smith who crafted this became haunted for seven nights, by horrific cries wailing in the darkness.""

197638221.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Outfit</style> A leather jacket sewn from the carcass of the Starfall Valley Blackblood Beast.
The wing membranes connecting their limbs are durable, yet flexible. As Blood Beasts evolve towards a form capable of flight, one must wonder: Where are they headed?""

199668391.m_KeyValue: "Your blood pressure—it's no longer the same as when you first came to the castle. Has Death fully claimed you?"

200234189.m_KeyValue: ""If I'm not mistaken, mine isn't the only heart racing right now.""

200234192.m_KeyValue: "Because I'm rather enjoying this little game of cat and mouse."

210815490.m_KeyValue: "Those spectral soldiers... they're Vassals bound by Soul Link to Baphomet!"

217840801.m_KeyValue:

Moonlight, gentle yet somewhat duplicitous, bathes her as she leans against the window, shedding tears, just as scripted.""

217840803.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> Ressa's cherished memories, strung together by countless moments of happiness.

217840831.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> A crown that embodies Joan's resolve.
War is the lifeblood of civilization. Flowing through the corridors of history, it is unstoppable, nay inevitable.""

217840832.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Outfit</style> A blood-stained suit of armor worn by Joan.
Leaning against the wall, the homeland lay behind her in ruins; gazing into the distance, the future lay before her in doubt.""

217840833.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> Joan's signet ring, shaped like twin-peaks and engraved with the words _$$May Astolfo remain prosperous._$$
She leads all the lost souls unable to return home to the Motherland of nigh. _$$Through utter despair, hope springs anew._$$""

217840834.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> Joan's immortal past.
_$$Though yesterday has vanished and tomorrow is already known, how ought one navigate today?_$$""

""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> The rusty amulet of Baphomet, the Soulless, Elder of the Bathory family.

217841194.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> The dark iron helmet of Baphomet the Soulless, Elder of the Bathory family.
Blood represents the gravity of memory, while souls are as free as the blue sky. It's not that they are grander, just less attached.""

217841196.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> The dark iron ring of Baphomet the Soulless, Elder of the Bathory family.
