460499786.m_KeyValue: "Have you decided on your next move?"

462463649.m_KeyValue: "A disability is no reason for such treatment."

462463652.m_KeyValue: "For a slave? Eat with your filthy hands."

462463654.m_KeyValue: "I think... I understand the meaning of these sounds."

462463681.m_KeyValue: "Ah—something strange is happening to Joyce's body!"

462463682.m_KeyValue: "Move it! The selection has already begun!"

462463683.m_KeyValue: ""<color=#b39cb7>Such beauty must be worth 'recording,' don't you think?</color>""

462463684.m_KeyValue: ""Once we reveal the truth, that’s your cue to enter.""

462463686.m_KeyValue: "Did I just make such a cool speech?! Father will definitely praise me!"

462463687.m_KeyValue: "Monocle? Why are you calling me a monocle?"

462463945.m_KeyValue: ""At this pace, you're still far from winning the grand prize.""

462463946.m_KeyValue: "Weren't we… here to investigate someone in the area who resembles Goldland…?"

462463948.m_KeyValue: ""But if... if I could find Master Van Helsing, then maybe...""

462463949.m_KeyValue: ""You…! You're nothing but lowborn rabble, yet you dare defy me! I—""

462463950.m_KeyValue: "We're in no hurry... Let's order twenty more skewers of squid while we wait."

462463951.m_KeyValue: "I don't believe you! My master would never work with a heretic. Unless... you can tell me one of his secrets!"

462463972.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, I'll take care of the payment.""

462463977.m_KeyValue: ""Not only that, she's also one of the Seven Sages who reformed the institutions of Sapphire Isle with an iron will.""

462463978.m_KeyValue: ""Of course! At Sapphire Isle, people might splash you with blessed seawater at any moment—such attire is absolutely necessary!""

462463979.m_KeyValue: "Please don't trouble yourself. I've already prepared my vacation attire."

462463980.m_KeyValue: ""Since you're Miss Lorelei's guests, please feel free to choose any outfit you like.""

462463981.m_KeyValue: ""From Francis Justinian's unfinished painting 'No. 198.4' to the legendary wine glass used by the Bell Ringer of Light, the Sapphire Isle Auction House offers an impressive array of extraordinary items.""

462463984.m_KeyValue: "Would you like to try fighting the sirens?"

462464012.m_KeyValue: ""I'm so hungry... While everyone's asleep, I'll sneak some food prepared for tomorrow's guests.""

462464038.m_KeyValue: "I can't help but feel her friendliness toward us is excessive. It's hard not to suspect she has other motives... though I hope I'm just overthinking it."

462464046.m_KeyValue: ""Why isn't he here?! W-What's going on, did he find me too troublesome and leave me behind?""

462464048.m_KeyValue: "Noah might have been beaten to a pulp by then! Where is that Mr. Savich anyway?"

462464077.m_KeyValue: ""To silently endure the poisoned arrows of fate, or to rise against the endless suffering of this world?""

462464078.m_KeyValue: ""The Isle, the beach, and this mysterious 'auction house'—what a perfect summer vacation spot. I'll take care of the expenses like before.""

462464079.m_KeyValue: "I just want to be of use... Master's affairs are my affairs too. Please let me join you!"

462464103.m_KeyValue: "The fog is getting thicker. Let me escort you back."

462464104.m_KeyValue: "If we can't find the victim's body... will we be trapped in this dream forever?"

462464106.m_KeyValue: "The goddess with scales and blindfold—these are symbols of 'justice' and 'fairness.'"

462464107.m_KeyValue: "...offering prices 10% lower than the Seven Sage Association... please consider our proposal..."

462464108.m_KeyValue: "Master's two guns are also named Aphrodite and Eros."

462464110.m_KeyValue: ""'Summer Concerto Sheet Music,' '137th Meeting Summary,' 'Comparative Analysis of Acorellia Highlands Cashmere and Long-haired Cashmere'... None of these are...""

462464112.m_KeyValue: "You were never this dull when you were still active in the 'Assassin's world.'"

462464135.m_KeyValue: "Listen to the voice in the deepest depths of your heart—"

462464138.m_KeyValue: "You won't have to lay your eyes on a single beast."

462464140.m_KeyValue: "Miss Ami has uncovered even this? How very admirable."

462464141.m_KeyValue: "Did you already know Viktor Thoreau? No wonder Lorelei treated you all so well..."

462464142.m_KeyValue: ""One moment, I am Miss Ami's advisor.""

462464143.m_KeyValue: "Completely unconvincing... Didn't the victim have curly hair?"

466803566.m_KeyValue: ""Are you kidding me!? I just finished reporting to the Church, and you all ran off without me! I finally caught up, and now you're leaving again!?""

466803575.m_KeyValue: "But at least this way Noah will survive..."

466803578.m_KeyValue: ""But seriously, why were those dreamfeeders attacking me!? I don’t even look like a longing... huh?""

466803579.m_KeyValue: "Hah... I should've known. Ressa handled it already."

466803580.m_KeyValue: "Don't call me a child! Death and the Valkyrie are one thing—but there’s no way you’re older than me!"

466803581.m_KeyValue: "I know you two! The warrior and the child with the Bell Ringer!"

466805744.m_KeyValue: ""Now it's just the two of us, Noah…""

466805751.m_KeyValue: "I heard you drove Albrecht away again?"

466805753.m_KeyValue: ""Yet before us, she says nothing. She merely stands... unmoving. Watching.""

466805754.m_KeyValue: ""But next time you speak to me, lose that smile.""

466805756.m_KeyValue: ""One bell toll has passed. Let me speak with him alone, would you?""

466805757.m_KeyValue: "The man who executed you. A Bell Ringer of absolute authority."

466807926.m_KeyValue: ""Even without my memories, I never forgot the promise I made.""

466807927.m_KeyValue: "But it seems you haven't forgotten our promise."

466807929.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry to keep you waiting... I'm back, Ressa. Piera.""

466807932.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Noah... I wish I could be there with you.""

466807933.m_KeyValue: "Though something has changed. You seem more mature than when we first met."

466810100.m_KeyValue: ""Because it's that Noah who gave me the courage to face my fate, isn't it?""

466810101.m_KeyValue: "The Noah I know never hesitates or wavers..."

466810102.m_KeyValue: "Hesitation... that's not the Noah I know..."

466810103.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps beyond death lies only darkness, but for those behind you, it becomes a door to the future.""

466810104.m_KeyValue: ""As life fades, the remains left behind nourish the land, ushering in new life.""

466810105.m_KeyValue: ""Remember, Death took many lives, but it also allowed everyone who once lived on Sunset Isle to have the most beautiful farewell.""

466810106.m_KeyValue: ""You'll always be Noah Nevernight, the Noah we all know.""

466810108.m_KeyValue: ""If I use this power, I might transform into Death...""

471034410.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'granting full rights to the recreated vassals'?"

471036588.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'investing a certain amount of money and manpower to diversify the castle's menu'?"

471039659.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'convicting vassals who have close associations with the kingdom'?"

476138067.m_KeyValue: "I'll kill you. I swear I'll kill you!"

476138070.m_KeyValue: "Joan led us to break the chains the nobles had bound us with."

476712776.m_KeyValue: ""As I've said, she's far more perceptive than we give her credit for.""

476712777.m_KeyValue: "I'm fading away soon enough. I don’t want my final memory to be of her looking sad."

476712778.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Thank you, Sheila. Please pass on my gratitude to Father and the others as well._$$""

476712779.m_KeyValue: ""Actually, before today, Sheila came to me and asked me to keep his existence a secret.""

476756704.m_KeyValue: ""Sir Gadric, what brings you to a place like this? You don't seem to be related to the Ganelons.""

476756705.m_KeyValue: "You look like a garlic to me."

476757635.m_KeyValue: ""Sir Gadric said he was heading to the town, but...""

476757638.m_KeyValue: "He clearly went the wrong way. That's the direction we came from."

476757862.m_KeyValue: "Toying with you? I might even say I'm the one being toyed with."

476759743.m_KeyValue: "I was just about to ask... What exactly are you here for?"

476759843.m_KeyValue: ""...Hati, it seems your father truly loves you very much.""

476759844.m_KeyValue: ""Oh... yeah, I guess. But you've never met.""

476759846.m_KeyValue: ""Since I was little, my father has been very protective of me, saying I must never get injured or bleed. So I've always been careful not to get infected with the Black Blood...""

480895385.m_KeyValue: ""Oh no, he seems to have completely lost control!""

482149020.m_KeyValue: "Word from my kin there—the alchemist's water has been defiled!"

485477734.m_KeyValue: "Only Vassals eligible for Dispatch are displayed."

485972414.m_KeyValue: ""Though the Church has explicitly banned alchemical research, for the Bloodborn, it remains an essential means of self-enhancement, regardless of the risks.""

487005998.m_KeyValue: ""Jestel, do you know about Baphomet's abilities? Jestel...?""

487007022.m_KeyValue: "He's the first one I've encountered whose actions completely exceed my expectations."

487012004.m_KeyValue: ""But looking at his battle with Cidhall, that body seems to have potential.""

487013027.m_KeyValue: ""Lady Empousa may have broken the tenets, but it was to save a Moonblessed. If we explain that to the elders...""

487013028.m_KeyValue: ""So I understand even less about how great these tenets you speak of are, or how formidable these so-called elders can be.""

487014182.m_KeyValue: ""As the first heir, you should know better than anyone the consequences of your actions.""

487016095.m_KeyValue: ""Shut up, you're too loud. If you want to keep babbling, let that rusty heap of armor you call a body come out itself.""

487016096.m_KeyValue: "This is the secret that the young lady works so hard to keep."

487017119.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, you just said we two are in some kind of relationship now?""

489405101.m_KeyValue: "I just wanted to send you on a pointless errand."

489405102.m_KeyValue: ""It was in the hands of a sailor from the El Dorado, corrupted by Black Blood. Even after losing his will, he still held onto this drawing with all his strength.""

489899995.m_KeyValue: "Me too! I like Colossus Max and the hat lady!"

490449917.m_KeyValue: "We are blessed with something close to eternity... are we not?"

490449918.m_KeyValue: "That would be... difficult. But I did say I strive to be a dutiful butler. And if it is my lady's wish..."

490449919.m_KeyValue: "Unless... They faced something they never expected."

490449920.m_KeyValue: "The gray door is meant for Noah. And the red one... the one already closed..."

490449921.m_KeyValue: "Then let's pick from the remaining three and stick together!"

490449922.m_KeyValue: ""Noah... you will return to us, won't you? I absolutely forbid you to...""

490449923.m_KeyValue: "Then what are we waiting for?! We have to stop him!"

490449924.m_KeyValue: "The gate to the sealed area's been forced open too. Just like when the forbidden grounds back home was breached..."

490449926.m_KeyValue: "It appears there was a fierce battle. Everything's been burned... utterly destroyed."

490450942.m_KeyValue: ""He's right. On my own, I can only track his presence—stopping him is another matter...""

490450943.m_KeyValue: ""No—you'll been officially eliminated, just like your _$$sisters_$$ before you.""

490450944.m_KeyValue: ""Always pretending to be naive, always playing the fool—when in truth, you see more than anyone else. But you keep it to yourself.""

490450945.m_KeyValue: ""Well, I'll stand for it no longer... Always pretending to be different, always fantasizing about _$$free_$$ will...""

490450946.m_KeyValue: ""I thought we were clear on your role as sacrifices... or rather, _$$vessels._$$""

490450947.m_KeyValue: ""Now that the Divine Body here has been destroyed, the sealed area has merged once more with our castle, and Mother's resting place is exposed...""

490450948.m_KeyValue: "—This is the only way Bloodborn can reproduce!"

490450949.m_KeyValue: "Where's Aiona? And Noah... Where are they?"

490450950.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Back to our homeland, on the far side of the moon._$$""

492253174.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, Quinn... do you remember your younger days? You'd ask if the stories were true—that gargoyles become red petals when they die…""

492253175.m_KeyValue: ""O' my gargoyle, may your petals never fall...""

492253182.m_KeyValue: "Now—! While I can still control myself—! Destroy—me—!!"

492253183.m_KeyValue: "What signal... what use of that when you're gone?"

492253184.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn, you won't be able to hold on like this...""

492253186.m_KeyValue: ""The link flows both ways—not only do you take on others' wounds, they can share your pain too.""

492253187.m_KeyValue: "Your bloodline power... it lets you channel damage through a mental link!"

492253188.m_KeyValue: ""Take my hand, let me help you!""

492253189.m_KeyValue: ""If you truly can't do it to Michelangelo, at least... let me stand with you.""

492254199.m_KeyValue: "Even if there was one... it'd be nothing but scrap metal. Give up..."

492254206.m_KeyValue: "The two Elders… they should've reached the frontlines by now. With power like theirs…"

492254207.m_KeyValue: "It won't take long before people in Mouret become cold bodies."

492254208.m_KeyValue: "Why not stay here and play one last game of hide and seek with me? At least... you can spare yourself from those dreadful scenes..."

492254209.m_KeyValue: "Did she just say this place is called the Timeworn Mausoleum...?"

492254210.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, if I'm not mistaken, this name indicates the nature of time.""

492254211.m_KeyValue: ""Time's nature, circle, time... and what Cain said... there must be a connection between these.""

492254212.m_KeyValue: ""As a cartographer, you have a unique insight into the structures of time and space.""

492254213.m_KeyValue: ""Remember this: Time is a circle, two faces meeting as one. The beginning is also the end. Therefore—""

492255358.m_KeyValue: "If we hit the stone pillars... what will happen?"

492255359.m_KeyValue: "What signal... what use of that when you're gone?"

492255360.m_KeyValue: "The signal... remember the signal I told you before—!"

492255361.m_KeyValue: "There must be a faster way to get there!"

492255365.m_KeyValue: "Why didn't I think of this sooner? It will summon gargoyles of course!"

492255385.m_KeyValue: "Q-Q-Quinn! Why are you in this era?!"

492255390.m_KeyValue: ""That pathetic boy who wept as his father died, powerless to even graze the enemy's hem... he is dead now.""

492255391.m_KeyValue: ""Before you is Jamie Mouret, future Lord of Ganelon, the one to erase the name of Bathory from this world forever.""

492255392.m_KeyValue: "Child... what's happened? You are a new person now."

492255394.m_KeyValue: "Could this Cartographer be talking about... me?"

492255396.m_KeyValue: "'Not all Bloodborn bears pale skin and fangs. I once met a Bloodborn lady—she was the most captivating presence I've ever beheld.'"

493536125.m_KeyValue: ""Their weak forms cannot bear the Black Blood. Mutation will only reduce them to mindless creatures, lost to its corruption.""

493536126.m_KeyValue: "Werewolves... How could the Ganelons harness the mutation powers of the Black Blood?"

493536127.m_KeyValue: "...Are you saying the Ganelon is deliberately turning the mutated villagers into weapons for this war?!"

493536128.m_KeyValue: "They need not become true Bloodborn... All they want is to win this war."

493536129.m_KeyValue: ""Didn't I warn you just hours ago? These vermin... the longer you hesitate, the more they swarm like flies.""

493536130.m_KeyValue: "Why the surprise? The Ganelon's betrayal of its own kind is nothing new."

493536131.m_KeyValue: "Allowing werewolves into Bathory territory—this provocation is unforgivable... and it will not stand."

493536132.m_KeyValue: "I care not for their ways. What truly matters... is that the honor of Bathory must never be tarnished."

493536134.m_KeyValue: ""Blood Servants, heed my call! Assemble at once and defend the front!""

493537149.m_KeyValue: ""Lady Quinn, you deduced that the Long Night is sustained by rituals, yet you never wonder where the ingredients are from?""

493537150.m_KeyValue: "You mean the ritual ingredients are blood... and entrails?"

493537151.m_KeyValue: "Let me be clear: the Long Night is sustained by an abundance of blood. As for the rest… they're not vital."

493537153.m_KeyValue: "My mistake. It's 'dining time' for the Blood Servants."

493537154.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, here's the little traitor who escaped the dungeon this morning. Couldn't stay away, could you?""

493537155.m_KeyValue: "Tsk. Do you see the 'trash' piling up here? It would be decent of us to clear it away."

493537156.m_KeyValue: "The scent of death lures bats to feast..."

493537157.m_KeyValue: "So... these bodies were drained of blood to sustain the Bloodletting."

493537158.m_KeyValue: ""Precisely. The old master hungered for the power of the Long Night, but the Divine Body kept it sealed away. To grant his wish, this ritual was conceived—to undermine the Divine Body and draw forth the power of the Long Night.""

493545853.m_KeyValue: "It's time to prove these stories aren't just legends... they're history."

493545854.m_KeyValue: "And how do you plan to prove that?"

493545861.m_KeyValue: ""Agnes, I'm warning you again—stop wasting time on unverified stories. If your grandfather hears about this, I'm the one who'll get scolded.""

493545862.m_KeyValue: "It's not just some story... it’s a legend!"

493545863.m_KeyValue: "Make no assumptions without evidence.' First Rule of Cartography. I've got it memorized."

493545864.m_KeyValue: ""No wonder you keep failing the exams. Just like your last evaluation said: 'lacks research discipline, prone to flights of fancy.'""

493545865.m_KeyValue: "Are you seriously planning to get certified through your grandfather's influence?"

493545868.m_KeyValue: "You're destined to become the greatest cartographer in all of Minexus."

493547007.m_KeyValue: ""It's Wolfsbane. We originally gathered it to treat the plague in town... Though now, it seems we won't be needing it for that anymore.""

493547014.m_KeyValue: "Like this—massage both sides of your head. Nice and gentle. Ten times. Can you do that?"

493547016.m_KeyValue: "You've been asleep a whole day and night. No wonder your head hurts..."

493547018.m_KeyValue: "Ah! I remember now—this one always works!"

493547019.m_KeyValue: ""That's odd. When I had headaches, Father would always massage them like this—and it always helped!""

493547020.m_KeyValue: "You don’t need to fuss. It's nothing new... it'll pass."

493548031.m_KeyValue: ""Is this the Wolfsbane? All I have to do is give it to the patients, right?""

493548037.m_KeyValue: ""You've got time to nap, but not enough to deliver medicine to dying patients?""

493548038.m_KeyValue: ""The more I think about this, the more this feels... deliberate. There's something off here. James, hide for a moment. I'll try to get some answers.""

493548039.m_KeyValue: "Someone's sleeping in a place like this?"

493548040.m_KeyValue: ""That's Johannes. We take turns tending the infected. Lately, there've been so many... He must've been too exhausted to stay awake.""

493548041.m_KeyValue: ""Johannes! I'm new here. The townsfolk said you and James were overworked, so they sent me to change shifts with you!""

493548042.m_KeyValue: ""Shifts? That's perfect! Finally, I can go home and sleep like a rock!""

493548044.m_KeyValue: ""Mmm... don't disturb... Wait, who are you?!""

493549185.m_KeyValue: "Come on! I'll take you to the cave. Maybe we'll find something that helps us learn more about her!"

493549186.m_KeyValue: "Your mother left you that Wolfsbane mark. She must've been someone truly special..."

493549189.m_KeyValue: "So he's the one who locked you in the dungeon all those years just because you wouldn't drink human blood...?"

493549190.m_KeyValue: "Maybe those bats aren't wrong to call me a traitor."

493549191.m_KeyValue: "Jamie... that is enough. He's still my father. And nothing can change that."

493549192.m_KeyValue: "Ugh! I take it back. Impressive? Forget that! Even the finest plating can't hide the rot underneath!"

493549193.m_KeyValue: ""The other Elders said that after I was born, he lost his physical body in the war. His memory and will were bound to that armor to keep him alive.""

493549194.m_KeyValue: ""I-I didn't study much, so... so armored people can have children?!""

493549195.m_KeyValue: "The way he pushed for war today... and so many things he's said over the years... I no longer know if I can agree with any of it."

493549196.m_KeyValue: ""As a child, I thought he was a hero who gave his all for the family. And as his daughter, I tried to honor that. But ever since the patriarch passed... he's changed. He's grown harsher and more violent.""

493550214.m_KeyValue: ""Deep breaths, Agnes… you're a cartographer. You've faced worse. No panicking...""

493550216.m_KeyValue: "What is this…? It's soft… and warm—"

493550217.m_KeyValue: ""Wait… I think I see something—eyes, glowing red, just ahead in the dark...""

493550218.m_KeyValue: "Red eyes... could it be a B-Bloodborn...?"

493550219.m_KeyValue: ""D-don't worry, sir… I'm a licensed cartographer! I've seen all sorts of monsters before—even Calamity-class! A Bloodborn's nothing… L-leave it to me!""

493550220.m_KeyValue: "Your voice is shaking! Drop the act and get behind me!"

493551364.m_KeyValue: ""And that girl in the hood. She bears some resemblance... James, bring her closer. Let me see.""

493551365.m_KeyValue: "Forgotten? No. It's because I remember that I must wipe out every last one of those fanged wretches... before I die."

493551366.m_KeyValue: "You—! Have you forgotten the bloodshed from twenty years ago?! You heartless... (coughing)"

493551367.m_KeyValue: ""If we clung to every vow made to the departed, we'd all be bound by ghosts.""

493551368.m_KeyValue: "What promise must I keep... with the dead?"

493551369.m_KeyValue: "And I haven't forgotten it. But Leila is gone."

493551370.m_KeyValue: "You gave your word to Lady Leila—that you'd never take up arms again."

493551371.m_KeyValue: ""Ezareth, I heard everything! What is this talk of war?""

493552387.m_KeyValue: ""Run away, fool! Or you'll die here too!""

493552388.m_KeyValue: "No... my brother can't die on the land of Bathory..."

493552391.m_KeyValue: ""You're not actually thinking of ending this war… just to fulfill your mother's dying wish, are you?""

493552395.m_KeyValue: ""'I'm sorry I missed your childhood... but I brought you into this world because I believed that life, whether bitter or sweet, is worth living.'""

493552396.m_KeyValue: ""'And finally, my dearest daughter, remember: What your eyes see is not always the truth, but what your heart believes will lead you to the light.'""

495756195.m_KeyValue: "All unlocked effects and stats will be modified according to the set rate. Duplicate effects cannot be acquired."

496523653.m_KeyValue: "Challenge [Tomb of the Fallen] - The Soulless {0} time(s)."

498293647.m_KeyValue: "How do you know I'm not here to _$$finish_$$ you now?"

500488405.m_KeyValue: "Stay perfectly still and become my living target!"

500488502.m_KeyValue: "The old sorcerer once prophesied that I would bring ruin to the Baphomet bloodline."

502188250.m_KeyValue: "The neatly organized room on the right."

502188251.m_KeyValue: "The room in the middle with barrels scattered about."

502188252.m_KeyValue: "The room on the left with bloody footprints."

503363792.m_KeyValue: "An enhanced detector with improved range and sensitivity."

515156291.m_KeyValue: "We can't keep dragging this out. Skoll... he's running out of time!"

516735163.m_KeyValue: "Too dense. I've said all along we should do this."

516737341.m_KeyValue: ""Hm. Still qualifies as knightly, I'd say.""

516741697.m_KeyValue: "Yes... this will certainly keep with the course of history."

517814944.m_KeyValue: ""Will this create a rift between us, too?""

517819300.m_KeyValue: "Please reconsider. Too many tragedies have been born from momentary impulses..."

517820323.m_KeyValue: "Bella: Let's call this a special perk for our loyal customer."

518438755.m_KeyValue: ""As a Bloodborn, my actions are no different than humans slaughtering their cattle. The strong culling the weak. Is that a sin?""

518438756.m_KeyValue: ""I can hear the sound of the wind breathing, it must be coming from outside. We must be getting close to the exit!""

519494913.m_KeyValue: "I just felt like… you were the only one who'd truly listen."

519495010.m_KeyValue: ""Listening to those stories in a graveyard… Who knows, maybe the spirits are still here, eavesdropping.""

522195161.m_KeyValue: "Why do you look so frightened? Did my outburst startle you?"

522195162.m_KeyValue: ""Not many, but they were all wearing masks like some kind of elite squad.""

522195163.m_KeyValue: ""Just like the nightmare we encountered, one of us...""

522195164.m_KeyValue: "...Quite the fighter! Have you been hiding your strength this whole time?"

522195192.m_KeyValue: "Are you suggesting you might be a phantom I created?"

522195193.m_KeyValue: ""Today? When we first met? There's something seriously wrong with you, Noah.""

522195229.m_KeyValue: "I had to come back here. It must be me... who puts an end to Death. Because I am..."

522195230.m_KeyValue: ""You've been chasing her with me all this time, and you still haven't figured that out?!""

522195259.m_KeyValue: ""When I first arrived on this island, I knew I wasn't prepared... I wanted to run away... But Noah...""

522195260.m_KeyValue: "You're not going to tell her? The possibility that troubles you so?"

522195284.m_KeyValue: ""What's that commotion... Piera, that fool! She broke our agreement! Though I was also...""

522195287.m_KeyValue: ""Hahaha! We are indeed your ancestors, and we were once Gravekeepers. However...""

522195288.m_KeyValue: ""...Yes, great ancestors. Since so many of our family are here... together, we can...""

522195289.m_KeyValue: ""...Noah, even though I haven't had the chance to tell you what's inside...""

522195293.m_KeyValue: "I'm so glad... I made the right decision to come back here... I'm so glad I'm not alone anymore... We can definitely succeed!"

522195294.m_KeyValue: ""That's right, we're all family! Even though we lived in different eras of history.""

522195320.m_KeyValue: "That's precisely why more and more members of the Paracelsus family have come to believe that Death is our true god."

522195322.m_KeyValue: "Grandmother... you knew Master Albrecht? You two sound close."

522195324.m_KeyValue: ""I... was born bearing both duty and curse, yet under the protection of the Church... under Grandmother's care, under Master's guidance...""

522195325.m_KeyValue: "The blood before us is guidance left by our ancestors..."

522195354.m_KeyValue: "If only... I had told you everything from the beginning... maybe things could have turned out differently... (coughing)"

522195355.m_KeyValue: "In the end... I just caused more trouble... for you... for everyone..."

522195356.m_KeyValue: ""The last step? Wait, you mean sacrificing a 'Gravekeeper'?!""

522195357.m_KeyValue: ""Think, damn it! I know how to do this!""

523766944.m_KeyValue: ""_$$But now I understand—even if you're not by my side, I can still protect you all!_$$""

523766946.m_KeyValue: ""As they left me one by one, I felt lost in a forest, alone and helpless.""

524381486.m_KeyValue: ""Trust me, Hati. I'm just a lowly monk. I had no idea the Church was going after Mouret.""

524381487.m_KeyValue: "Almost everyone in town has been infected. This place is... beyond saving."

524381488.m_KeyValue: ""Hati, you don't understand how terrifying a Bell Ringer can be, or how dangerous Mouret is right now!""

524381490.m_KeyValue: "But there must be people in town who aren't infected yet. What about them?"

524381518.m_KeyValue: ""After all, nothingness is far more desperate and painful than death... especially eternal nothingness.""

524381519.m_KeyValue: "A graveyard filled with Wolfsbane... Who prepared this stage for you? Was it fate? Or was it you..."

524381815.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm... You did help me earlier, and I'd like to just let it go, but I can't abandon my duty...""

524381818.m_KeyValue: ""Gadric, Noah... This is your choice? Can't say I'm surprised.""

524381846.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, your brother was just here. Where did that boy suddenly run off to...""

524381849.m_KeyValue: "It's possible that the conflict between our families has been a misunderstanding from the start."

524381851.m_KeyValue: "You Bathory scum! Are you here to take advantage of our misfortune?"

524381881.m_KeyValue: ""So, I won't let outsiders hurt you... It must be me. I, Hati Ganelon, will set you free with my own hands!""

524381882.m_KeyValue: ""It seems every time you opposed us Bathory, you were being used by the Church without even realizing it!""

524381909.m_KeyValue: ""It's alright, Clive. Father is strong. He's just covering our retreat. We'll see him soon.""

524381948.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, how did Father... I've never heard of this before, and he knows Noah?""

The Elders condemn a Vassal not just as a punishment, but also as a calculated warning.""

628344480.m_KeyValue: ""Rather than a hunch, perhaps it's more like being led by fate.""

628344481.m_KeyValue: ""Wh-what the...! These mushrooms seem to be... singing? Ugh, gross...""

628344509.m_KeyValue: "She doesn't look good. Something must have happened."

628344538.m_KeyValue: "Impossible. How could he still be human after so long? Wait... Could that rumor be true?"

628344539.m_KeyValue: "The power of the Black Blood... I never imagined someone could actually control this power akin to 'Immortality.'"

628344540.m_KeyValue: ""Hati should be fine, but what happened to me just now...""

628344544.m_KeyValue: "So you were hiding something from us after all? I thought this mission would be a good opportunity to clear up our misunderstandings."

628344545.m_KeyValue: "I suddenly felt a sharp pain in my chest."

628344567.m_KeyValue: ""For this cave itself is a 'Divine Body,' created to seal the source of the Black Blood.""

628344570.m_KeyValue: ""He's finally awake! It's all thanks to you, Aiona.""

628344571.m_KeyValue: ""I heard it from the kid. Hurry, make him eat it.""

628344574.m_KeyValue: "Am I... am I sick? Because I drank the water?"

628344576.m_KeyValue: ""His wound should be healed, but something's not right...""

628344577.m_KeyValue: ""...N-Noah, don't hurt them. I know them... from Mouret.""

628344599.m_KeyValue: "But wait... didn't you just have Clive eat those spores?"

628344602.m_KeyValue: ""Don't forget, if we don't bring the spores back, then you, the one who proposed this mission, will be the one held responsible.""

628344605.m_KeyValue: ""Actually, I didn't get a chance to introduce myself earlier. My family... the Alita family, are the keepers of the Eye of the Divine Body...""

628344606.m_KeyValue: ""Our mission was just to escort Aiona to pick mushrooms, but we unexpectedly picked up a special type as well...""

628344607.m_KeyValue: "And these twelve Divine Bodies are guarded by twelve powerful families loyal to the Church."

628344608.m_KeyValue: "The Ganelon family is indeed responsible for guarding this Ashen Garden—the cave believed to be the womb of the Divine Body."

628344609.m_KeyValue: ""That's right, Noah. We didn't lie to you... Gilrain here is the heir to the Cidhall family, the keepers of the Horn of the Divine Body.""

628344639.m_KeyValue: "You're just now catching on? You really are a dumb wolf."

628344640.m_KeyValue: ""Those damn explosive mushrooms did a number on us, but we've finally caught up to them!""

628344641.m_KeyValue: "How come you're so familiar with this place? This is our family's secret!"

628344670.m_KeyValue: "They may be being raised as food."

628344671.m_KeyValue: ""Whether they're food for humans or werewolves, what difference does it make to them? It's just as sad.""

628344672.m_KeyValue: ""Its parents, or perhaps its ancestors from long ago, may have survived here. There are plenty of plants and a water source.""

628344673.m_KeyValue: "But... hasn't the Black Blood disease already broken out?"

631784996.m_KeyValue: "William—why would you do something so foolish!"

631784997.m_KeyValue: "...Why is there someone hanging up there? And that person is..."

631784998.m_KeyValue: ""Wait—if they're too scared to follow us in here, shouldn't we be safe as long as we stay put?""

631784999.m_KeyValue: "The spread is too fast... They've fully transformed... Could it be something as potent as the Plague sealed in the Forbidden Grounds?"

631785000.m_KeyValue: "Am I even heading the right way...?"

631785001.m_KeyValue: ""All you need to know is this—it's the weapon's final form, forged to erase flesh entirely.""

631785020.m_KeyValue: ""Right? That lustrous Captain dresses like a peacock in spring, yet makes the whole crew wear the same uniform—just in different colors. Even his own brother only gets an extra hat...""

631785021.m_KeyValue: "Come... come to me... let us feast... until there's nothing left to crave..."

631785028.m_KeyValue: "Mr. Van Helsing! These stairs will take you to the helm at the aftcastle!"

631785029.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Van Helsing is Noah's friend. He won't abandon him. And of course, we'll help too.""

631785031.m_KeyValue: "First—I'm certain he was the one who orchestrated Aaron's murder aboard this ship."

631785032.m_KeyValue: "That walking armor? What did he say?"

631785033.m_KeyValue: "Ah! It's the same again—how could he be so sure William committed suicide… Unless he saw it happen. Or worse..."

631785034.m_KeyValue: "If that's the case… could Mr. Jones have spoken so instinctively because he already knew where the poisoning took place?"

631785035.m_KeyValue: "Then William may have been killed by Jones as well?"

631785060.m_KeyValue: ""So, you're not someone imprisoned... then what are you? You look bizarre...""

631785061.m_KeyValue: ""Strange… that pesky bat isn't even here, and I can still hear her mocking me…""

631785062.m_KeyValue: "Save you…? I thought you were inviting me to dinner or something."

631785063.m_KeyValue: "Strange… I break through one wall only to find another?"

631785092.m_KeyValue: "What I mean is—perhaps you were already infected with Black Blood long before we ever met."

631785093.m_KeyValue: ""Those infected with Black Blood lose their will swiftly, but in return, their bodies grow unnaturally resilient, capable of limited regeneration.""

631785094.m_KeyValue: "This should hold them off—unless they manage to break the door down."

631785095.m_KeyValue: "It's fine if you don't believe me. Everyone laughs whenever I say such things."

631785096.m_KeyValue: ""If that wall is truly as thick as the blueprint claims, it shouldn't sound like this when struck.""

631785098.m_KeyValue: ""Back then, we searched far and wide for the Moonblessed… only to discover that Hati—who had been with us the entire time—was...""

631785099.m_KeyValue: "Then… could that sound have come from beneath the sea?"

631785120.m_KeyValue: "Still haven't figured out the difference in strength? Such pitiful tricks…"

631785121.m_KeyValue: ""I won't listen, I won't believe it! We've all already… passed the point of no return!""

631785124.m_KeyValue: "You… cowardly fool! You slaughtered an entire ship of people who cared about you!"

631785125.m_KeyValue: ""People are always most afraid of being exposed for what they've long pretended to possess, but never truly had.""

631785126.m_KeyValue: ""He must have learned through his connections that mortals can only contend with Blood Beasts, especially when their strength is unknown—by harnessing the power of a Divine Body.""

631785127.m_KeyValue: "What?! That's insane—who in their right mind would sell or even buy something like that?!"

631785128.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps you should answer my question first. Where is Jones?"

631785130.m_KeyValue: "What did you say…? And you call yourself the Silver Cross's most merciless hunter! Why didn't you burn his body on the spot?!"

631785131.m_KeyValue: ""Lies! All lies! I have wisdom, ideals! I am neither fool nor coward!""

631785156.m_KeyValue: ""Of course we heard it. William, shouting in madness—though what exactly happened, I cannot say...""

631785157.m_KeyValue: ""William, the traitor who murdered your Captain, is just ahead! And this is the moment you choose to get seasick and fall to pieces?! You're no better than he is! Ah—!""

631785158.m_KeyValue: "She? What are you talking about? Weren't you just strutting about all fearless? And now you're cowering at a voice?"

631785160.m_KeyValue: "So much happened in the time it takes to miss a single meal…"

631785161.m_KeyValue: ""No need to be so grumpy. If your mood's sour because you're hungry, I can share half of Finley with you.""

631785162.m_KeyValue: ""To begin anew, under the name of the one he envied most. Captain Goldland: wealthy, respected, untouchable.""

631785163.m_KeyValue: ""Anyone who dares stand in our way shall die aboard this ship. As long as I'm with you, we are invincible.""

631785190.m_KeyValue: "R-Recognition? Tch. You actually think I'd be moved by that?"

631785191.m_KeyValue: "We shall become her sustenance... become one with her!"

631785192.m_KeyValue: ""You're nothing but a nameless scrap of flesh, fresh-spawned and unworthy of being devoured by the beautiful Ranna!""

631785193.m_KeyValue: ""The Atoll Devourer, Ranna... Though you might know her better by a different name. For she is also known as…""

631785194.m_KeyValue: """"To feed her?"" You turned your former companions into Blood Beasts—to feed this being?""

631785195.m_KeyValue: ""This tragedy, born of your cowardice, foolishness, and selfishness ends here.""

639666715.m_KeyValue: ""Well, it seems I haven't been left behind after all.""

639674899.m_KeyValue: ""Yes! At last, I understand what Noah was thinking!""

639677970.m_KeyValue: ""For a commoner, you have some lofty ideals.""

644526293.m_KeyValue: "Enhanced actuators with enhanced burst power for short-distance high-speed movement."

646046236.m_KeyValue: ""While travelling and battling about the land, we Lords can <style=""Highlight"">Tax</style> properties to obtain resources.""

646742186.m_KeyValue: "How can there be so many Blood Beasts on such a small island?"

646742281.m_KeyValue: ""Hey! Don't run away, your opponent is over here!""

646742284.m_KeyValue: ""What you seek... is nothing but more blood, right? Then come!""

649884931.m_KeyValue: "I didn't know Bloodborn could eat human food like this."

652229050.m_KeyValue: "They will eventually become you—if you two fail to become the 'perfect vessel' in the end."

652229051.m_KeyValue: "It's a memory from even before then? So we've been here before."

652229052.m_KeyValue: ""...66, don't act rashly. I have a very bad feeling about this...""

652229053.m_KeyValue: "We're going to defeat you and take the sixth card!"

652229055.m_KeyValue: ""I won’t allow it! I will never, ever let someone like you ridicule our dreams...""

652229083.m_KeyValue: "Why did we just happen to find the first card at the Astrolabe?"

652229084.m_KeyValue: "It's time to put an end to all of this... No. 79!"

652229085.m_KeyValue: "Don't tell me... you deliberately provoked me to attack you?"

652229109.m_KeyValue: ""Well then, let us waste no time and start this blissful slaughter. After all, only one will make it to the far side of the moon.""

652229114.m_KeyValue: ""Even knowing the scene before you is but an illusion, you still refuse to give up.""

652229117.m_KeyValue: ""To reach our home on the far side of the moon, we need a vessel capable of carrying the 'Blood.'""

652229118.m_KeyValue: "Who... are you? What are you talking about? Is this the far side of the moon?"

652229120.m_KeyValue: ""She entrusted everything to me, through countless cycles, through countless deaths...""

652229121.m_KeyValue: "I... should have known. Why did it take me so long to realize..."

652828727.m_KeyValue: "Or could it be that Aunt Mary's world no longer needs us?"

652828728.m_KeyValue: ""More specifically, to the will of people.""

652828729.m_KeyValue: "I don't know. I can't tell which events are the process and which are the result."

652828730.m_KeyValue: ""That _$$thing_$$ you asked me to do last time... or rather, asked me not to do—I complied.""

653107057.m_KeyValue: "Again...? How many rebels have given in to the Black Blood?"

653107058.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of which, is everyone accounted for? If I recall, this operation was meant to be carried out by four Vice-Commanders.""

653108079.m_KeyValue: "What's wrong? Why are you looking at me like that?"

653108082.m_KeyValue: ""No... If I survive, only to turn into one of them...""

656315591.m_KeyValue: "The wind reeks of garlic... Just thinking about it makes my hair stand on end!"

699611294.m_KeyValue: "Whoa—this thing's amazing! Can I touch it?"

699761593.m_KeyValue: ""Look, <style=""Highlight"">that wooden sign</style> seems rather suspicious. Let's check it out.""

699761594.m_KeyValue: "That sounds like such a mature choice. Maybe I should give it a try next time."

699761595.m_KeyValue: "Me too! I like hiding my whole body under the bed—it's the perfect escape from boring daily life."

699761596.m_KeyValue: "You must have been bedridden for quite some time."

699761597.m_KeyValue: ""Although they don't have Tidewisps, this baby’s breath might remind you of them in some way.""

701452877.m_KeyValue: ""If that's the case, we can't afford to be stalled here—especially not if they're after the sealed area as well.""

701452878.m_KeyValue: "But how could those Divine Body families manufacture war machines without access to the Church's tech!?"

701452879.m_KeyValue: "What do you mean? The Church sold off its abandoned war machines... to the noble families?"

701452880.m_KeyValue: "Just a lost and helpless woman wandering through Starfall Valley."

701453901.m_KeyValue: "What took you so long?! We just fought some spoiled little princess!"

701453902.m_KeyValue: ""Be careful, though the Soulless is their leader, the most dangerous one is actually that white-haired....""

701453903.m_KeyValue: "They're likely Vassals born of Lady Lamia's power."

701453904.m_KeyValue: ""Don't you remember? Cain once told us, if ever we sensed he was no longer himself—""

701844703.m_KeyValue: ""Look at you, little Ami, all fired up!""

701844704.m_KeyValue: "What's lost cannot be recovered. Someone must establish a new homeland."

701844711.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, the Calamity hidden in the conch shell wanted to merge with me, tempting me with promises of restoring the Landis family.""

701844712.m_KeyValue: "You saw the history of the Landis family's downfall?"

701844713.m_KeyValue: ""They were corrupted by the very Calamity they were supposed to guard, which led to all of Landis sinking beneath the waves.""

701844714.m_KeyValue: "So I took a peek at the Landis family's history."

701844715.m_KeyValue: ""The Calamity exploited their weakness, manipulating them into committing irreversible acts.""

701844716.m_KeyValue: ""Truth is, given how fast the sea levels were rising, Landis was destined to sink one day.""

701844717.m_KeyValue: ""Therefore, I will not be deceived by the Calamity again.""

701844718.m_KeyValue: ""If the entire island hadn't been dragged beneath the waves, they might have had a chance to find a new homeland.""

708726318.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, sis! I can fight too!""

709414677.m_KeyValue: ""When I first arrived here twenty years ago, the Ashen Garden was still inhabited by many werewolves who retained some form of collective consciousness.""

709414678.m_KeyValue: "Look at this... something's written on the stone..."

709414679.m_KeyValue: ""It's a curse, but also a noble deed... He wanted to seal the Black Blood and secrets in the forbidden grounds, as did the previous Gravekeepers...""

709414680.m_KeyValue: ""That's because Father is only thirty-five. Twenty years ago, he would have just been a fifteen-year-old boy like Clive. How could he have been the Gravekeeper?""

709414682.m_KeyValue: ""Even in that state, they still fought for their home and people... That's just like Father, the hero my brother has always looked up to.""

709414709.m_KeyValue: "Why... Why can't I use Covenant when I have inherited the Eye of the Divine Body?"

709414710.m_KeyValue: "He... Noah was taken away by the werewolves while trying to protect me and the boy."

709414711.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, I believe directly confronting the Calamity is too dangerous for us at present. We should return and make a report.""

709414744.m_KeyValue: "Why is he here?! Is this another one of Cain's arrangements?"

709414775.m_KeyValue: ""I'm not sure how, but my guess is the special type must have done something to him.""

709414776.m_KeyValue: "They... They want to use Noah's blood to suppress the creature's awakening!"

709414806.m_KeyValue: ""He said something about meeting with the Moonblessed, and Noah returning...""

709414810.m_KeyValue: ""Sheila, this Moonblessed, represents one of the divine punishments bestowed upon nonbelievers... Plague.""

709414811.m_KeyValue: ""'After your encounter with the first Moonblessed, travel south and look for the El Dorado'""

709414812.m_KeyValue: "Don't make it sound like I follow his orders. I came here of my own volition—to find something I lost."

709414833.m_KeyValue: "Please don't tell Hati the truth. Tell her I died. Even though she will be very sad..."

709414837.m_KeyValue: ""After we're done, we'll take that special type back for a thorough examination.""

709414838.m_KeyValue: ""The world isn't black and white, but there's no doubt he was the source of the Black Blood seeping into Lupine Forest.""

709414839.m_KeyValue: ""Don't look down on me, I can get out on my own!""

709414840.m_KeyValue: "A baby crying? But the Calamity... could it be twins?"

709414842.m_KeyValue: ""To get you, Noah. You have many people waiting for you out there, but me...""

709414843.m_KeyValue: ""Clive, what exactly did you see? I'll help you, just tell me—""

716392850.m_KeyValue: ""So, was it you that sent the carriage over the cliff?""

716392852.m_KeyValue: "Let's sort it out after we deal with them together."

716392854.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh... this feeling again, the uncontrollable surge of blood rushing to my chest...""

716392855.m_KeyValue: "That's your Bloodsoul trying to take control of your body."

716696399.m_KeyValue: "Hey! One's Death and the other's a traitorous Bell Ringer. They don't deserve fairness!"

717179984.m_KeyValue: "You just met him today! What do you know about any of this?"

717179986.m_KeyValue: "You dumb wolf! Take care of that equally dumb monk and your brother. Leave this to us!"

717179987.m_KeyValue: ""All these years, I've been waiting for you to say something like that. I'm so glad...""

717179989.m_KeyValue: "Is this why the Church is so afraid of the Black Blood? They fear what they don't understand..."

717180018.m_KeyValue: ""When you were helping Noah and the others just now, big brother Skoll...""

717180019.m_KeyValue: ""He had it with him, so why didn't he take it?! He'd rather become... this...""

717180021.m_KeyValue: ""Hati, the singing is coming from not far to the north. If I'm not mistaken, that should be...""

717180049.m_KeyValue: ""But I'm really worried about my big brother, sister, and father...""

717180051.m_KeyValue: "Relax. He's the Gravekeeper of Ganelon. Ordinary Church Knights are no threat to him. Besides..."

732681187.m_KeyValue: "...There shouldn't be another living soul left on this island."

732681189.m_KeyValue: "The tenth Bell Ringer at the time arrived on the island with her 'Choir.'"

732681190.m_KeyValue: ""The members of the Landis family we encountered covet the power of the Calamity; in contrast, the Paracelsus family are sworn mortal enemies of the Calamity.""

732681192.m_KeyValue: ""But Piera, if Death has been sealed in the Church's territories for the past 66 years, and the island has been abandoned by your family, why did you return now?""

732681193.m_KeyValue: ""Noah... look carefully, that is not me.""

732681220.m_KeyValue: "Piera... you seem more upbeat than usual. Is it because we got away from Death?"

732681221.m_KeyValue: "You nearly lost your life trying to help me. Nothing could be more important than finding you safe and sound."

732681222.m_KeyValue: ""We... we searched everywhere, but couldn't find the doctor... Sora, he... he didn't make it...""

732681224.m_KeyValue: "We must go to the village. We need to find the doctor as soon as possible."

732681483.m_KeyValue: ""May the mortals of both shores be freed from sorrow, no longer divided by the veil of life and death.""

732681484.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, that's right... to save Ami from Famine, I grabbed her and dove into the sea...""

732681485.m_KeyValue: ""But if the Blood Beasts and I all washed up on this island, the ship must have went down near the coast. There's a good chance the others made it too.""

732681515.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, I think that's the first time someone's said that to me. This isn't really my usual style of dress.""

732681516.m_KeyValue: "Okay but... I don't think I can walk... I'm really sorry for being such a burden."

732681518.m_KeyValue: ""I've been walking along this coast for quite some time since I came to, yet the daylight hasn't changed at all.""

732681548.m_KeyValue: "Then you're also from here? And you've only heard about it from others... Could we be in the same boat?"

732681549.m_KeyValue: ""It appears to be just a sprain, but you should still be careful.""

732681550.m_KeyValue: "You lived here? Are there other people living on this island?"

732681553.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... my mother told me about the legend of this island. 'Our home is forever chasing the sun across the sea, so night never falls...'""

732681579.m_KeyValue: "The person I saw was much younger than the grandmother I remember..."

732681582.m_KeyValue: "Is it really just a coincidence? What do you think?"

732681585.m_KeyValue: "Thank you for waking me up. I promise I'll remember... remember who you are!"

732681586.m_KeyValue: ""Damnit! Just when I thought we found a lead on the doctor, it's just an empty shell who can't remember anything!""

732681615.m_KeyValue: "A Vice-Commander's sworn duty is to protect their Bell Ringer."

732681616.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, this is all his fault! Making me suffer that infernal boat ride and having to step foot on this bizarre island again.""

732681618.m_KeyValue: ""Because when we captured him the first time, he left something very important here...""

732681647.m_KeyValue: ""So you were... truly that special to Dr. Ressa...? No, I can't aceept it...""

732681649.m_KeyValue: ""I may not be able to see your grandmother, but I could see how happy you were when you were talking with her. Even though...""

732681650.m_KeyValue: "Well... um... I know it's hard to believe since you couldn't see her..."

732681675.m_KeyValue: "So these are indeed phantoms... What are the rules that determine how they appear and to whom?"

732681676.m_KeyValue: ""But for the Divine Body or the Calamity, I still have no idea where they are or what they look like...""

732681678.m_KeyValue: "Well... it's complicated. Can you tell me what you know about the Calamity first."

732681679.m_KeyValue: ""So, your family's duty must be to...""

732681680.m_KeyValue: ""I hesitated. I thought about becoming a different person, discarding all of my past... but I just couldn't do it.""

732681681.m_KeyValue: "You already knew about this island's strange phenomenon."

732681682.m_KeyValue: ""...Divine Body? I've only read about them in my grandmother's books. I never imagined you would have encountered them firsthand, and twice at that...""

732886657.m_KeyValue: ""Let us retrace the path you've taken... Back to the beginning, where the heart gives rise to form.""

732886659.m_KeyValue: "Limine would awaken stronger than any of us. And who knows who'd she choose as her first meal."

732886660.m_KeyValue: "So our little silver-haired one really does have the grit and cleverness Agares spoke so fondly of..."

732886661.m_KeyValue: ""When I stole you—the spark—from the Grand Cathedral, I didn't expect you'd follow every step of my design so perfectly.""

732886662.m_KeyValue: ""According to our plan, a civil war will erupt in Starfall Valley. It will break the Blood Moon Seal.""

733299021.m_KeyValue: "It seems your encounters with those outsiders Bella and Cidhall have taught you the rules of this 'game.'"

733299022.m_KeyValue: ""Fear not. What stands before you is but one of my avatars, its power still within mortal bounds to challenge.""

733299053.m_KeyValue: ""No matter what lies ahead, I'll be by your side. But...""

733299054.m_KeyValue: "Then we have nothing more to say to you."

733299055.m_KeyValue: "What does that mean?! ...Is it the far side of the moon? Or a bleeding moon? I've seen both in my dreams..."

733299057.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, we'll think about it on the way. Before we find the last two cards and escape...""

733299317.m_KeyValue: "Who am I? Why am I here?"

733299319.m_KeyValue: "The ones locked up here either lose their minds in despair or rush headfirst into death without a second thought. But you..."

733299320.m_KeyValue: ""Instead of complaining, pay attention to what's ahead of us...""

733299349.m_KeyValue: "I think whoever's controlling those puppets might be the one watching us."

733299351.m_KeyValue: "Brilliant! Teaming up with you was a great idea!"

733299352.m_KeyValue: "What if there was more than one prison from the start?"

733299383.m_KeyValue: "Huh? So you don't believe that the far side of the moon is our true home?"

733299413.m_KeyValue: ""Darn, she's pretty sharp when it comes to making deals...""

733299414.m_KeyValue: ""Don't flatter yourself. I made the decision to leave, and I was the one who found the card clue.""

733299416.m_KeyValue: "Bella's quite happy to have made two new friends."

733299417.m_KeyValue: "Jealous?! How did you come to that conclusion?!"

733299449.m_KeyValue: ""We got lucky once, but how can we ensure we'll be fortunate enough to survive a second or third time?""

733299451.m_KeyValue: ""If I'm right, then the person controlling these statues might... possess the third card.""

733299481.m_KeyValue: "The path ahead is yours to choose."

733299483.m_KeyValue: "I'm surprised you still have the strength to speak."

733299513.m_KeyValue: ""No, on the contrary, I think it's wonderful!""

733299516.m_KeyValue: "We'll have to use our tried-and-true method—knock them out! But be careful not to fall off—Aaah!"

737624038.m_KeyValue: "Could those slaves have come from the sea as well?"

737624039.m_KeyValue: ""Be it 'auctions' or 'elections', Sapphire Isle seems to be undergoing many institutional reforms.""

737624041.m_KeyValue: "Me?! Am I really going to be a candidate?"

737624043.m_KeyValue: "Where are those wretched slaves? Release them all!"

737624071.m_KeyValue: ""I couldn't revive the dead, could I?""

737624072.m_KeyValue: ""Just as stubborn as your father. The world has changed, Isaac. Integrity and courage alone can't protect everyone.""

737624073.m_KeyValue: ""This is the treasure of Sapphire Isle, the Siren's Tear.""

737624096.m_KeyValue: "'Sapphire Isle has become a dead land. Only I can bring it back to life.'"

737624097.m_KeyValue: "(That familiar presence about her... am I just imagining it?)"

737624102.m_KeyValue: "Annoying... when you're nothing but food to me."

737624103.m_KeyValue: ""Or rather, I should say, there has never been a ‘Miss Ami’ in either the main line or any branch of our family.""

737624104.m_KeyValue: "Surely none here doubt Miss Ami—she has no cause to deceive us."

737624106.m_KeyValue: "These Sages certainly have quite a lot of secrets to hide."

737624107.m_KeyValue: ""From the very beginning, you fabricated Ami's image as wealthy and influential, lured Thoreau into drawing her in, and steered Selena and me toward the trail of the Mistbound Terror.""

737624108.m_KeyValue: ""I have one last question for you, Mistbound Terror.""

737757711.m_KeyValue: ""I'm just a side character, not meant to be noticed.""

737757777.m_KeyValue: ""It wasn't you who killed me, but my own sins and the evil I once committed.""

737757808.m_KeyValue: ""From the moment I took the path of a slayer, redemption became unworthy and unreachable.""

739641126.m_KeyValue: "Different challenges await along different paths in the Threads of Fate."

742272565.m_KeyValue: ""So... please, Father, can you come to your senses? At least... at least let me say goodbye to you in person—""

746647560.m_KeyValue: "Kenneth's team reporting in for scheduled relief..."

746647561.m_KeyValue: ""...No, we're right on schedule. Strange—Kenneth is never late.""

746647563.m_KeyValue: "All I know is my shift got longer because of it... (yawn)"

746650760.m_KeyValue: "I wish you could witness it—a new order reborn from the embers."

746650761.m_KeyValue: ""The Garden of Asta is fortified beyond compare. An assault with our current numbers would come at a steep cost, my Lord.""

747287638.m_KeyValue: ""What a pity, you almost completely 'devoured' me instead.""

747287639.m_KeyValue: "There it is... Of course someone as broken as you could never wield power from the 'other side.'"

747287640.m_KeyValue: ""I shall be reborn as the Calamity, 'Famine'—feared by all of mankind.""

747287641.m_KeyValue: "Damn it... I have to keep fighting... I can't let anyone else fall..."

747287645.m_KeyValue: "I wouldn't be so sure about that."

747287646.m_KeyValue: "You... We share the same blood—why do you all stand in my way!?"

747287647.m_KeyValue: ""There's nowhere left to run, little Devil.""

747297374.m_KeyValue: "Phew—I feel so much lighter. Did I finally shake off that thing?"

747297376.m_KeyValue: ""How... How long has it been since we last spoke face to face, my kindred?""

747298520.m_KeyValue: "Don't tell me Cain sent you because he doesn't trust us to find the Moonblessed."

747298521.m_KeyValue: "That's not what I meant. Why are you on this ship?"

747298526.m_KeyValue: ""Though to be fair, Jacintha's the only one in the family who actually enjoys showing up in her beast form.""

747298527.m_KeyValue: "What's that surprise for? I can turn into a bat too. Controlling one's beast form is the basic for all Bloodborn."

747298528.m_KeyValue: "Meow—It seems The High Priestess is more familiar with this form of mine."

747298529.m_KeyValue: ""But the others are Bella, Gilrain, and... Oh!""

747298531.m_KeyValue: ""This is the ship's alchemy lab, isn't it? Naturally, I came to see if there was any useful research worth stealing, meow.""

747298532.m_KeyValue: "Enough distractions. Jacintha! What are you really here for?"

747298533.m_KeyValue: "Now I'm curious... What kind of beast forms do the other Elders and Noah have?"

747299551.m_KeyValue: "Wait—there's another one?! Who are you supposed to be?!"

747299552.m_KeyValue: "You seriously thought you could take me? Not in this lifetime!"

747299553.m_KeyValue: "How could this be... Am I still too weak? I need to eat..."

747300707.m_KeyValue: "Because Miss Hati... might be one of the Moonblessed we've been searching for."

747301722.m_KeyValue: "My faithful exist for one purpose only: to feed me."

747301723.m_KeyValue: ""Why's it smashing the floor now? What, is there food down there too?""

747301726.m_KeyValue: ""Yeah. And it ate all my rations, too. Truly heartbreaking.""

747301727.m_KeyValue: "So that's why you hit so hard... Didn't expect you to be such a good fighter."

747301728.m_KeyValue: "Such pitiful creatures... no wonder you cannot endure my power."

747301730.m_KeyValue: "Exactly! Stop right now! Those are my rations—you can't eat them all!"

747301731.m_KeyValue: "Ah... so that's what this is really about..."

747301732.m_KeyValue: "No one will keep me from eating..."

747301733.m_KeyValue: "So you've gorged yourself and grown this massive... and that's all you've got?"

747302883.m_KeyValue: "I see... Oh—right. I don't even know your name yet."

747302885.m_KeyValue: "No! I looked away for one second and that thing made it to the deck!"

747303901.m_KeyValue: "A world where only the strong endure."

747303903.m_KeyValue: "You did defeat me—in that world. But do not forget... You chose to..."

747303905.m_KeyValue: "All that arrogant nonsense—yet one hit was all it took."

747303908.m_KeyValue: "You've fallen too far... trapped in the crude instincts of a lesser creature."

747303909.m_KeyValue: "You leave me with no choice but to devour you all. One by one. Then I'll seek out the rest of our kindred."

753359412.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'sending vassals to explore the island of the 'Other Side' despite the risks involved?'"

753361590.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'canceling the castle's daily evening gatherings'?"

753364661.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'exploring other Bloodborn factions on the continent'?"

758117008.m_KeyValue: "'Have you heard? That guy committed suicide with his wife after the divination...' 'That's awful... what a pity. I wonder what the mystic said to him?'"

758117009.m_KeyValue: "It's all my fault... I shouldn't have secretly done a divination for Bernice... She believed what I said... I messed things up again..."

758117010.m_KeyValue: "Don't rely on... the power of the Tarot..."

758117011.m_KeyValue: "Look at your wounds. What can you control? What have you changed?"

758117012.m_KeyValue: ""So what? Haven't we relied on our own strength every time we've overcome storms, white whales, undercurrents, and thick fog?""

758117043.m_KeyValue: ""The memories of the living endure, and thus the past lives on in reminiscence.""

758117045.m_KeyValue: "We are the last Tarot card—'The Hanged Man'."

759408365.m_KeyValue: "More beasts than ever before! They've breached the camp!"

759408398.m_KeyValue: "We'll go to the back to support!"

759408399.m_KeyValue: ""Come to think of it, she left her black cat near the ship this morning and then disappeared.""

759408400.m_KeyValue: ""You can do it, I believe in you, and so did Captain Patchen.""

759408662.m_KeyValue: "That's hard to imagine... I know! How 'bout doing a divination for me? See my fate and stuff."

759408663.m_KeyValue: ""As the veil of destiny unfurls, each card whispers in secret: _$$Death_$$ slowly reveals itself, not as a finality, but as the shadow of endless torment and anguish.""

759408665.m_KeyValue: "Quiet you—Have you forgotten what happened the last time? She hasn't performed divination since..."

759408695.m_KeyValue: ""I knew it... When I didn't see you in the camp, I knew you must have snuck out.""

759408696.m_KeyValue: ""Can you be infected with Black Blood, kitty? If you can, would you turn into...""

759408761.m_KeyValue: "Blood Beasts were lying in ambush in the sea!"

759408764.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... the infected are unable to eat at all. It's pure suffering, day in and day out.""

759408789.m_KeyValue: "The fearless Captain...buried by the sailor's shanties..."

759408793.m_KeyValue: ""Kitty, can you swim? You'll be fine, right? You're a cat who can do anything, after all.""

759408794.m_KeyValue: "Stop! Our fate will not end here."

759408795.m_KeyValue: ""You are my handpicked sailors, of course you can weather the storm and set sail on the Pontos II!""

759408796.m_KeyValue: "If you could hear the voice of destiny... why didn't you tell everyone what to do earlier..."

759408823.m_KeyValue: "Help me take these insects back and soak them in dew."

759408824.m_KeyValue: "...That's what the Captain used to say."

759408825.m_KeyValue: "On the mysterious ghost ship—sailors break the curse—"

759408826.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, my dear, I'll use divination to avoid them.""

759408827.m_KeyValue: ""If the almighty Esmeralda were here, she'd raise her steel fork and swing her iron fists, beating those Black Blood beasts to a pulp! They wouldn't know what hit them!""

759408857.m_KeyValue: ""Otherwise, what do you think I am? A wandering spirit in this world? A fairy born out of thin air?""

759408860.m_KeyValue: ""Your friend is waiting for you, beloved 'Star'...""

759798863.m_KeyValue: "And the 'Sapphire Secret Fashion Show' sounds so intriguing too... How will I ever decide?"

762475541.m_KeyValue: ""Father... he loves Wolfsbane as much as I do, so he told me long ago—""

763091844.m_KeyValue: "Um... I've just finished a prototype of a new 'siren' device... would anyone like to try it?"

763091845.m_KeyValue: "I've invested everything I have into this place. And I'll keep building it up—no matter what."

763091850.m_KeyValue: "They'll find a new home in time."

763091851.m_KeyValue: "Farewell... But to whom do I offer these words?"

763091852.m_KeyValue: "It's a familiar song... I feel like I've forgotten something important..."

763091854.m_KeyValue: "It's not like we ever relied on them to make a living."

763091856.m_KeyValue: "But what will Sapphire Isle do now without the Seven Sage Association?"

765591713.m_KeyValue: "It appears to be a fungal colony formed by the spores that fell."

766919598.m_KeyValue: "But what is this restoration ritual supposed to be...?"

766919599.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, you all look a little restless.""

766919600.m_KeyValue: "Don't let his sharp tongue fool you—Hasan's not one to fear death."

767009010.m_KeyValue: "I feel the blood surging in my chest... could it be the Black Blood again?"

767009041.m_KeyValue: "Consumed Bloodsoul will regenerate on its own over time."

768484007.m_KeyValue: ""But my wishes aren't what matter most. What do you want, Bella? Do you truly want to reclaim that life?""

768484008.m_KeyValue: ""With you on our side, silver-haired one, buying back a life will be easy. At this rate, we could buy the moon itself!""

775575920.m_KeyValue: ""Using the Altar of Invocation allows you to obtain desired Vassals more quickly, helping us build a stronger and more comprehensive lineup.""

775747125.m_KeyValue: ""For every 5 stages in the Threads of Fate Main Story that you complete, your Territory Prosperity will advance by 1 level.""

776773021.m_KeyValue: "Tip: Tap a Vassal to view Details."

778080314.m_KeyValue: "...What is this...? The entire Starfall Valley—it's trembling."

778080316.m_KeyValue: ""Since that day, I've lived countless lives… witnessed countless choices.""

778080317.m_KeyValue: ""Every successor who bore his title followed in his footsteps, carrying the roots of all medicine forward.""

778080318.m_KeyValue: ""Something wrong? You look uneasy. If you're tired, we can head in and rest.""

778080319.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Ressa... but this time, I have no choice but to break my promise.""

778080321.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed. Though sixty-six years have passed, it felt like mere days while I slept.""

778083519.m_KeyValue: "The next strike shall put an end to your sins."

780681528.m_KeyValue: ""You think I don't know that!? Ever since that red moon rose, the desert...""

786434514.m_KeyValue: "Remarkable. I've never encountered water that resists my analysis."

786434515.m_KeyValue: "Why does he bear such a resemblance to that rumored Bell Ringer? Surely it's just my imagination..."

786434516.m_KeyValue: ""I suppose this is divine retribution. Had they not insisted on secretive alchemy, none of this would have come to pass.""

788841773.m_KeyValue: ""Trying to provoke me, are you? Hah! You'll regret this dearly.""

788842796.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be troubled, for it's human nature to favor those who echo their sentiments.""

788847152.m_KeyValue: ""I'll keep you in my prayers. For everything else, you're on your own.""

788848307.m_KeyValue: "May you find your way back from the path of Loss."

788849330.m_KeyValue: ""Okay, I'll leave it up to you.""

790221889.m_KeyValue: ""Strike your weapon here, and let the creations of sand return to dust.""

790221896.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be scared. Stand behind me, I'll protect you.""

790221897.m_KeyValue: "This must be the Church's scheme. Both the crown and our sudden arrival in this desert."

790221900.m_KeyValue: "Aiona! Ami! Run! These monsters... they turn everything they touch into sand..."

790221902.m_KeyValue: ""<alpha=#FF>But I can still protect you, Ami...""

790221903.m_KeyValue: "Goldland taught me two things. First: protect your companions."

790221928.m_KeyValue: ""As long as human desires and conflicts exist, the Flames of War will never be extinguished...""

790221930.m_KeyValue: ""But through your eyes, I saw my father again, my friends, and Minexus's moon...""

790221931.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, we're all here! Aiona, come join us!""

790221961.m_KeyValue: "I've always worried that I couldn't be as exceptional as my former 'self.'"

790221962.m_KeyValue: ""I am the vessel for these eyes, a puppet of fate.""

790221963.m_KeyValue: ""You... all of you, you've poured all your power into these eyes. That's why you said I'm the last hope.""

790221967.m_KeyValue: ""Get yer high quality cotton and linens! Wash 'em, soak 'em, bask 'em in the sun!""

790221994.m_KeyValue: ""I apologize, Lady Empousa. I'm a bit tired from using my eyes for so long to track the carriage carrying our 'target.'""

792051853.m_KeyValue: ""Here, you may select the area you wish to journey to. Difficulty will vary slightly.""

795216857.m_KeyValue: "Naturally. The crew wouldn't have noticed—because the 'tool' wasn't left behind. Because that's..."

795216858.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, what is that supposed to mean!?""

795216860.m_KeyValue: ""Huh? Because of some information I didn't know, I actually fell behind that oaf?""

795216861.m_KeyValue: ""While the first two mistakes narrowed our suspicions, the third mistake will serve as the most telling evidence.""

795216862.m_KeyValue: ""Little Van Helsing, if you can't explain yourself properly, you won't even need the Captain to deal with you... As First Mate of this ship, I won't forgive such insolence!""

795216864.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, lifeless eyes! You're really just going to stand there and take that? Tell him you have evidence!""

795216866.m_KeyValue: ""This is why William went to such lengths to stage Aaron's death. Even if the Captain covered for him, the Church's guards were still aboard.""

795216889.m_KeyValue: "Third Mate William… and Captain Goldland... They haven't been in here?"

795216890.m_KeyValue: ""No time for questions! Everyone! To the deck, now!""

795216892.m_KeyValue: "The culprit isn't among the people you see here."

795217145.m_KeyValue: "Take them below deck and lock them up. I'll handle this myself."

795217146.m_KeyValue: "Heh. Don't address me by my family name. I'm just a humble fortune teller now—free to live as I please."

795217153.m_KeyValue: "That's if Cain's intel is even accurate to begin with."

795217154.m_KeyValue: ""From your perspective, Starfall Valley wasn't even our first encounter. Why didn't you tell me anything?""

795217155.m_KeyValue: ""A child, yes—but also a man. A Gravekeeper. A father who will never regret the choice he made.""

795217156.m_KeyValue: "My apologies. I did advise Miss Dalcarlo not to interrupt your... private moment."

795217157.m_KeyValue: ""As she said, you may call me Dalcarlo. I was invited aboard by Goldland himself—the true Captain of this ship. You could say I dabble in the art of divination.""

795217158.m_KeyValue: ""It's the lowest-numbered among the twenty-two Major Arcana, yet also the most distinct.""

795217159.m_KeyValue: "That explains your pale face and thin frame. Better be careful not to get blown away once the storm hits."

795217160.m_KeyValue: "Invitation? Do you mean the letter the white-haired Elder mentioned they'd be sending me?"

795217185.m_KeyValue: "Are you seriously casting shade right now?! Come help already!"

795217186.m_KeyValue: "Ugh... So annoying! Talking to yourself nonstop! You haven't even introduced yourself!"

795217187.m_KeyValue: ""Even if you have long been free from the Church's oversight, a lady of Bathory should still strive to speak with grace.""

795217188.m_KeyValue: ""I can't make out the words, but ever since we boarded… they've been whispering, over and over… Ugh—""

795217191.m_KeyValue: "You—! You only became a Bell Ringer's student because of your family connections. Stop letting it go to your head!"

795217192.m_KeyValue: ""What's the matter, our lovely guest, Sir Van Helsing? Do you happen to know this rude young lady?""

795217217.m_KeyValue: "So you've encountered stowaways too? You must've dealt with them easily."

795217218.m_KeyValue: "What did he do to you? Especially Hati—she looks badly..."

795217219.m_KeyValue: "We need to pick up the pace. Let's start collecting today."

795217221.m_KeyValue: "Don't you dare take that commanding tone with me!"

795217222.m_KeyValue: ""Highly likely! This is bad—real bad. We need to find another place to hide, fast.""

795217223.m_KeyValue: ""Isn't that right, 'Sir' Van Helsing, Eighth of the Silver Cross?""

795217224.m_KeyValue: "You're not seriously implying that Bloodborn like you faced a Bell Ringer and lived to tell the tale?"

795217246.m_KeyValue: ""If it's just ordinary wine, I'll pass.""

795217249.m_KeyValue: "What?! I'm not even seasick! Why do I have to go?! I'll end up having to take care of her again!"

795217252.m_KeyValue: "Something's been bothering me... How do you know Cain? And why invite him aboard?"

795217253.m_KeyValue: ""Ha. Look who's talking. Pot, meet kettle.""

795217254.m_KeyValue: "What do you know?! My team's been guarding this ship for years—we have history with Captain Goldland! But Van Helsing..."

795217255.m_KeyValue: ""That only makes them rarer guests! My dear brother, you must never forget our creed—""

795217256.m_KeyValue: "This escort duty was originally his assignment. I joined on short notice because it aligned with my objectives."

795217277.m_KeyValue: ""That's just a ventilation panel. It connects to the deck, but it can't be opened. And it's way too high for anyone to reach anyway.""

795217278.m_KeyValue: "That dutiful sailor—the one who follows the rules to the letter."

795217282.m_KeyValue: "Miss Ami. You were the first to find him. Please tell us exactly what you saw."

795217283.m_KeyValue: ""Not everyone’s like you, Ami. Always thinking about food...""

795217284.m_KeyValue: ""Haha! Did I embarrass you, Little Ami?""

795217285.m_KeyValue: ""That's when the ship suddenly lurched! I rushed over to the crew quarters to check—and by the time I arrived, this is what I saw.""

795217286.m_KeyValue: ""What am I, your personal seismograph? Don't think I missed that little jab, Silver-haired.""

795217287.m_KeyValue: "From what Bob's saying... William doesn't sound like much of a sailor."

795217288.m_KeyValue: ""The rest of you, with me. Something's happening aboard this ship. No one wanders off alone. Everyone stays where I can see them.""

795217314.m_KeyValue: "...Your understanding of feelings seems to come entirely from what the crew taught you."

795217315.m_KeyValue: ""If they hurt me, it's fine. If they hurt you... it would be a disaster.""

795217316.m_KeyValue: "That's Sailor Marlow—he's in charge of inspecting the cabins right now."

795217317.m_KeyValue: "...Then maybe it wasn't a 'person' pulling at all."

795217318.m_KeyValue: ""The second 'door' inside the guest room is this ventilation panel, and the rust on the rope matches the panel's corrosion.""

795217319.m_KeyValue: ""It's a little too big, but the weight feels about right.""

795217320.m_KeyValue: "This bed's too big. I can't get the rope tied around it."

795217345.m_KeyValue: "This is what happens when you move around."

795217347.m_KeyValue: "Contaminated food. Everyone's always so careless about hygiene. They don't have my constitution—I never get stomachaches."

795217350.m_KeyValue: ""Marlow, you shouldn't do this. The Captain will be mad if you break the door.""

795217351.m_KeyValue: "Let's seal the deal with this dark bread. We each take a bite. Instant accomplices."

795217352.m_KeyValue: "'Somewhere else'... He must've been taken to the guest room next door."

798906897.m_KeyValue: ""These resurgent demons hail from the Other Side, temporarily manifesting in the mortal realm during periods of invasion. Like a spectre, they haunt the land of Minexus.""

799733290.m_KeyValue: "Wait... am I supposed to drink blood?"
