810256489.m_KeyValue: ""An auction house, curious vendors... Looks like there are plenty of places worth <style=""Highlight"">exploring</style> here.""

810256652.m_KeyValue: ""Let's go one more round? Pleeease, Silver-haired!""

810714825.m_KeyValue: ""If we can't fulfill this promise this year, there's always the coming year, or the one after that...""

810714834.m_KeyValue: "Hey. That look... Are you judging me for my height?"

810714835.m_KeyValue: "...You want to help the humans by dismantling those devices?"

810714837.m_KeyValue: "That's quite a mouthful. Never heard of you."

810714838.m_KeyValue: ""One day, we'll repair this ship and sail beyond the Isle, to explore the world.""

810714865.m_KeyValue: "Lord Hallon's little Bella... has been with Joyce all along. Joyce took her from that laboratory the day you killed Lord Averdin."

810714866.m_KeyValue: "Lorelei? Don't even mention that wretched woman! How dare she free all those little slaves behind Joyce's back!"

810714867.m_KeyValue: "Joyce has transformed all of Lord Hallon's cheerful touring devices on the Sapphire Isle into Joyce's Elysium devices."

810714868.m_KeyValue: ""Ser-, I mean, Sir Silver-haired! Surely you haven't forgotten that Joyce still has your master, Miss Ami?""

810714870.m_KeyValue: ""Since Ami is already here, it seems your deal has failed.""

810714891.m_KeyValue: "We got this from someone who speaks in a way we couldn't understand. They wanted us to deliver it to you."

810714896.m_KeyValue: ""Stay focused... I'll lend you my strength too, aim here—""

810714897.m_KeyValue: ""But that's fine. Do you know why Bella No. 13 is Joyce's masterpiece? Even with just one arm and a head remaining, she would fight on, for Joyce!""

810714898.m_KeyValue: "Well... Joyce will have to show everyone Joyce's masterpiece—"

810714900.m_KeyValue: ""As long as I live on in your memories, I'll never truly be gone.""

810714901.m_KeyValue: ""No, it's I who's eleven years late. Please forgive me, Lorelei.""

810714902.m_KeyValue: "Resurrecting humans as Bloodborn depends on memories stored in blood. But her memories reside in an entirely different vessel..."

810714922.m_KeyValue: ""What I sell isn't mere clothing—it's a philosophy. Clothing is the shackle of existence. Wealth, the chain of freedom. True liberation is the only design worthy of Sapphire Isle.""

810714923.m_KeyValue: "What?! There's actually one decent soul among ten thousand rich folk?"

810714932.m_KeyValue: "It's real! The deal the puppet mentioned is real!"

810714933.m_KeyValue: ""One of the former stewards left us something called a sunscreen potion. When applied, it shields us from the sun's searing heat temporarily.""

810714934.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, haven't you still chosen to be his friend, even though he's a Bloodborn?""

810714960.m_KeyValue: "Clovis had never seen waves that high..."

810714961.m_KeyValue: ""Grabbing a stick for balance, Bella limped toward the exit, hopping on one leg. She knew where to find allies who would help her uncover the truth.""

810714963.m_KeyValue: ""'Pay the price, and they'll be yours.'""

810714964.m_KeyValue: "Like a fish flailing on a market stall."

810714966.m_KeyValue: ""Before they could clean the blood from her body, Hallon returned to the basement.""

810714967.m_KeyValue: "The moon had risen quietly above the treetops."

812664214.m_KeyValue: ""Just as Empousa once believed you stood with her, before stepping into this place.""

812664215.m_KeyValue: "Is this some kind of jest?! I don't care what twisted bloodline you serve or what rules you follow!"

812664216.m_KeyValue: "Because... she wants to bring Mother back. So this... all of this... was for that."

812664217.m_KeyValue: "She was waiting for us. But this time..."

812664218.m_KeyValue: "Enough with the games! Show yourself if you have something to say!"

812665234.m_KeyValue: ""I’m sorry… Under Cain's assault, I can't hold the realm link much longer...""

812665235.m_KeyValue: "Plague snuffs out the ember of humankind. Famine awakens its primal cravings."

812665236.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, my silver-haired friend. If only you'd agreed to walk with me from the start... if only you'd grasped the truth earlier... no...""

812665237.m_KeyValue: ""You're starting to see. This is a confined space, so you assume you're Noah Nevernight.""

812665239.m_KeyValue: "Then tell me... when do you think a person truly dies?"

812665240.m_KeyValue: ""You're sharp, my silver-haired friend. Sharper than I was at your age... but you've lived too short.""

812665241.m_KeyValue: ""Well, it was more of an experience I had. The only difference is that this version of me remembers more than you do.""

812665242.m_KeyValue: "Not yours alone. Ours. We created it together."

813955870.m_KeyValue: "That makes me sound weak. I can transform too. I'll protect you. You go ahead."

813955871.m_KeyValue: ""Seth… the Saint, right? Now I get it.""

813955872.m_KeyValue: "I thought the tale would be difficult to grasp... Yet Ami has explained it more clearly than I ever could."

813955873.m_KeyValue: ""I was moving too fast to notice earlier, but aren't those the same paintings all over the walls?""

813956890.m_KeyValue: ""Yet here you are, planning something so reckless. That anxious girl... has grown too bold.""

813956893.m_KeyValue: ""That night, I went to Noah alone. Before Lamia or the others could reach him.""

813956894.m_KeyValue: ""You made it this far, ready for a fight to the death—yet you're still fretting over someone else?""

813956895.m_KeyValue: ""Didn't you say it yourself? That the closer one gets to Aeon, the clearer it becomes. The divine powers are just people, hiding truths they don't want uncovered.""

813956896.m_KeyValue: "To think Albrecht still remembers me so fondly... even going so far as to prepare 'holy water' for me. As expected of my nemesis."

813956897.m_KeyValue: "Then let's see if you truly are immortal when I pierce through the source of your memory!"

814810649.m_KeyValue: "So you traveled all the way to this era just to recruit one member?"

816730147.m_KeyValue: ""No... This time it's really me, and I've... truly returned?""

818205566.m_KeyValue: "The Third Tenet of the Bathory family is the 'Prohibition of Unsanctioned Creation of Progeny.' Vassals must obtain an Elder's consent to form blood contracts with outsiders. What are your thoughts on this matter?"

818205663.m_KeyValue: ""Some vassals are very curious about the alchemical research Cain has been conducting in secret, and they hope he could share some of his findings with everyone. What are your thoughts on this matter?""

818205830.m_KeyValue: ""The recent wave of acid rain has severely damaged the castle's Observatory, forcing us to cancel our nightly stargazing ceremony. Do you think this will have a significant impact?""

818205896.m_KeyValue: ""Recently, our castle has seen an increase in vassals recreated through alchemy. We need to discuss whether to grant them the same rights as our regular vassals.""

818205962.m_KeyValue: "A vassal returning from travels has mentioned encountering a mysterious island in the Sea of Medimar. The island's characteristics bear a striking resemblance to the 'Other Side' described in our family's historical records."

818205993.m_KeyValue: ""The Church has recently resumed salvaging 'Future Artifacts' from the sea. A vassal has suggested that we could try this as well, to enrich our collection in the Hall of Opulence. What do you think about this?""

818206028.m_KeyValue: ""A vassal who traveled to the Alita family returned with an album of secret alchemical techniques, but even our family's senior alchemist cannot decipher the formulas depicted within. Should we proceed with further research?""

818206059.m_KeyValue: "Cain has reported that many vassals have been secretly using the castle's alchemical facilities. I'm considering granting permission for the use of these facilities. What are your thoughts on this?"

818206125.m_KeyValue: ""Recently, the Church has been mining meteor craters day and night at the Howling Peninsula, yet these 'meteors' appear no different from ordinary stones. What are your thoughts on whether we should investigate the Church's true motives?""

823033737.m_KeyValue: "Even our passionate hero has quite the temper."

823673460.m_KeyValue: ""Right now, we need to find someone nearby and ask what's going on.""

828366577.m_KeyValue: "A moving island...? Or perhaps the island itself... is alive?"

828366578.m_KeyValue: "Maybe it wasn't meant literally. It could be describing an island capable of movement."

828366585.m_KeyValue: ""If we keep reading at this pace, we may not even get a chance to appear in our own story.""

828366586.m_KeyValue: ""And because it's so thorough, there are dozens of volumes. Are you sure you want to read through all of them here?""

828366588.m_KeyValue: "Let's head to the upper level and rejoin the others."

828366589.m_KeyValue: ""_$$But rather than an island, it more closely resembled an enormous ship..._$$""

828366590.m_KeyValue: "_$$The island home of the Landis family was known as the 'Pillars of Hercules.'_$$"

828366591.m_KeyValue: ""Even with branch families and all the residents of their territory, no ship could possibly carry so many people...""

828366592.m_KeyValue: ""Before their disappearance, the Landis family was one of the twelve families under the Church protection.""

828367601.m_KeyValue: ""I spent the last of my fortune to restore it, and gave it a name worthy of its fate—The El Dorado.""

828367602.m_KeyValue: ""This day forward, it shall carry our dreams, set sail, and never sink...""

828367609.m_KeyValue: ""Then my dream—no, humanity's dream—of voyaging into the deep is no longer a fantasy.""

828367610.m_KeyValue: ""I learned much from the Landis people—of the ocean, of navigation.""

828367611.m_KeyValue: ""Aboard their great vessel, I discovered by embedding two jewels on opposite ends of the helm, they could sail to any destination within the span of a single storm.""

828367612.m_KeyValue: ""One jewel was blue, mournful—like the one in my possession. The other was crimson—deep and unfathomable.""

828367613.m_KeyValue: ""If I can find the second gem, I too shall command this miraculous gift. And I shall become the greatest adventurer the sea has ever known.""

828367614.m_KeyValue: "I must tell William! We who carry this jewel are chosen by the sea. We were meant to embark upon a legendary odyssey."

828367615.m_KeyValue: ""In the years that followed, I slowly gathered a fleet, piecing together every rumor tied to the lost Landis ship.""

828367616.m_KeyValue: ""In Sapphire Isle, my perseverance bore fruit: I acquired the wreckage of a ship built by the Landis people.""

828368755.m_KeyValue: "Wait... your card can be used for fire!?"

828368756.m_KeyValue: ""My apologies, I forgot the Empress fears the dark.""

828368761.m_KeyValue: "So what would make it whole? Devouring that jellyfish girl? What makes her so special?"

828368762.m_KeyValue: "If it becomes whole... the consequences will be devastating."

828368763.m_KeyValue: ""With half its power restored, Famine can already draw every Blood Beast aboard into its will resonance.""

828368764.m_KeyValue: "Followers? They aren't just regular Blood Beasts?"

828368765.m_KeyValue: "Blending into the environment to protect myself is instinct."

828368766.m_KeyValue: "You've shifted back to your beast form!! Don't go creeping around in the dark like that!"

828368767.m_KeyValue: ""Whatever the reason, we absolutely cannot allow her to be devoured... meow.""

828368768.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps it has something to do with Miss Ami's unknown origins?"

828369779.m_KeyValue: "I was prepared that each voyage might be both the dearest and the last of my life."

828369780.m_KeyValue: ""The Eyes of the Divine Body once held by the Alita family vanished with their host, but I endured the vast frozen plains and wind that cut through bone.""

828369785.m_KeyValue: "That tree has long since sunk beneath the sea. And two fruits alone are not enough to seal Famine."

828369786.m_KeyValue: ""As despair took hold, I remembered the dream I had all those years ago...""

828369787.m_KeyValue: "There was hope. The two gems Ami and I possessed are fruits of the Right Hand of the Divine Body once guarded by the Landis family."

828369788.m_KeyValue: "But the true Right Hand was the golden tree that upheld their island—the very pillar that gave name to the Pillars of Hercules."

828369789.m_KeyValue: "I never told the crew the truth behind how we traveled through the storm. They simply believed that El Dorado was the fastest ship in the world."

828369790.m_KeyValue: ""Only Ami, who lent me the jewel before each departure... I could never tell whether she was naive, for not once did she ask a question.""

828369791.m_KeyValue: ""By embedding the two jewels into either side of the helm, one could sail anywhere—so long as they passed through the storm that churned like a vortex of time itself.""

828369792.m_KeyValue: "To prevent William from growing suspicious—and awakening Famine before I was ready—I used exploration as a pretense to visit each family guarding a Divine Body."

828370933.m_KeyValue: ""How tragic. That's the difference between you and us. You bar the path of what you fear, while I pursue what I revere.""

828370934.m_KeyValue: "You won't let me through? Then I take it you fear what I carry—a fruit of the Divine Body."

828370937.m_KeyValue: "That night… was the first time in a year that the nightmares left me alone."

828370938.m_KeyValue: "I never knew she could draw like that. I watched her work from sunset to starlight."

828370939.m_KeyValue: ""Even from here, I can feel the overwhelming pressure... So this is what it means to face a Calamity...""

828370940.m_KeyValue: "Ranna of the Famine... A name I knew only from history. The nightmare whispered of by countless souls."

828370941.m_KeyValue: ""Even now—knowing what he's done, knowing what he's become... I've spent this entire year lacking the courage to face him.""

828370942.m_KeyValue: "It wasn't William who changed... I had been wrong the entire time."

828370943.m_KeyValue: ""She didn't answer. Instead, she asked for a pen. She sat quietly at the bow and began sketching every crew member—face by face, name by name.""

828370944.m_KeyValue: "I wonder… does Ami see me as a selfish Captain? A poor excuse for family?"

828371957.m_KeyValue: ""At last, I no longer need to worry about endangering Ami—the Hermit I was meant to protect.""

828371958.m_KeyValue: "She's... she's so strong! Even stronger than Uncle Gadric!"

828371961.m_KeyValue: ""He has both the power and the reason to protect this ship. And if I'm wrong... at the very least, he will preserve my story.""

828371962.m_KeyValue: ""The third letter I sent to elder Bella Slade of Bathory Castle. The Puppet Association has long been my trusted partner, and the Bathorys—like the Landis—are a reclusive family.""

828371963.m_KeyValue: ""If both I and this ship were to vanish, that would be the safest place for Ami to begin a new life. A life of true freedom.""

828371964.m_KeyValue: ""But Bella recommended another—Jacintha Dalcarlo, undisputedly the strongest of the Bathory Elders.""

828371965.m_KeyValue: "I want William to receive a fair trial. The punishment he deserves. For he sold his soul to demons."

828371966.m_KeyValue: "And yet... I want him to live—because he is still my family."

828371967.m_KeyValue: ""The second letter went to the alchemist Cain Lamboza. He aided my search for the Divine Bodies time and time again, yet asked for nothing in return.""

828371968.m_KeyValue: "I know he has long taken interest in the El Dorado—and in my adventures aboard her."

828373112.m_KeyValue: ""And yet the Church... The Church has lied to us for generations. They sealed away our Ancestors using those cursed Divine Bodies, twisting our true gods into monsters.""

828373113.m_KeyValue: "Lady Ranna was one of the original thirteen Moonblessed. The source of the twelve great families across the continent."

828373115.m_KeyValue: "Hahahahahaha! Never have I met a descendant so bold. You'd dare speak to me this way? How amusing."

828373116.m_KeyValue: "Why should you devour me... when I could devour you?"

828373117.m_KeyValue: "Very good... worthy of being my child... Hm? What did you say? You refuse? But you've learned of your lineage—this is your destiny!"

828373119.m_KeyValue: "Now that you know our blood is the same... Become one with me. Let us return to our original form."

828373120.m_KeyValue: ""That alone may prove you're truly Ranna's descendant. Such calm, such clarity.""

828373143.m_KeyValue: "She's not just any whelp. She might be our last hope."

828373145.m_KeyValue: "Could they have... jumped into the sea together?"

828373146.m_KeyValue: ""I don't care who you are, whelp! I'm not in the mood for your nonsense!""

828373147.m_KeyValue: "No! They've found me... there's no helping it now..."

828373148.m_KeyValue: "What about that silver-haired one and the maid who almost caught me? I can't hear their heartbeats on the ship anymore..."

828373150.m_KeyValue: "Ah! You're that child I saw in the kitchen!"

828373151.m_KeyValue: "So close… I nearly defeated the Calamity… and this is where it ends?"

828373152.m_KeyValue: "Oh? Everyone's already here... Did I arrive at a bad time?"

831780716.m_KeyValue: ""We're getting closer to Empousa, I can feel it.""

831780747.m_KeyValue: "This is my first time fighting with a warrior like Jestel. She's quite reliable."

831780848.m_KeyValue: ""Blood Vassals are minions created by the Bloodborn using Black Blood, so they can indeed be considered our kind.""

831780914.m_KeyValue: "I don't know what you're talking about..."

833973508.m_KeyValue: "Tap Vassal to assign as an Observer"

836637337.m_KeyValue: ""Traveling merchants from distant lands gather at this crossroads before setting forth once more. Their camel bells chime a melodious farewell as they carry precious cargo—goods, gold, and trade secrets—toward unknown horizons.""

837276055.m_KeyValue: "Can a hero find redemption by plunging into this paradox without past or future? This question has no answer."

837276056.m_KeyValue: ""Now... take my body, my consciousness, my soul, my everything...""

837276063.m_KeyValue: ""It feels like a part of our memory has been cut out, and we suddenly ended up in this desert.""

837276064.m_KeyValue: "It takes thirty years for bones to weather into dust."

837276065.m_KeyValue: ""I picked up some navigation skills from Goldland, but here... I can't tell the time or direction...""

837276066.m_KeyValue: "Watch out! There's a monster behind you."

837276067.m_KeyValue: ""Hold on, I'll take care of them—""

837276068.m_KeyValue: ""<alpha=#FF>Snap out of it, Aiona! More monsters are coming. Run!""

837276070.m_KeyValue: ""...Don't worry about me, I'm an immortal Bloodborn...""

837276095.m_KeyValue: ""Every time a Calamity breaks its seal and disaster strikes, everyone gathers here. But why are there so many versions of you—of me... and so many old friends?""

837276096.m_KeyValue: "Only when the predestined destruction is shattered... can all timelines regain their freedom..."

837276097.m_KeyValue: "Prevent the calamity... Can I really do it?"

837276098.m_KeyValue: ""So, don't worry about me. Go to the future that awaits you...""

837276099.m_KeyValue: "Why... how could you do this to me?"

837276127.m_KeyValue: ""Return to my timeline, prevent the calamity, break the cycle, and save all timelines.""

837276129.m_KeyValue: ""All the past timelines, the Aionas in those timelines, the companions and memories, will be devoured by it, forever losing their future.""

837276130.m_KeyValue: ""(The attacks of 'Time' feel familiar, like the power of my eyes.)""

837276133.m_KeyValue:
""The palace of the gods sat high in the clouds, their wrath like mighty thunder;
The condemned one, Sisyphus, cheating Death with his cleverness;""

837276134.m_KeyValue: ""Are you alright, young lady? You must have passed out.""

837276162.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry. Our target—that legendary 'Silver-haired' heretic—will be in the carriage that's about to pass through here, right?""

840421440.m_KeyValue: "Observe more Constellations and Stars in the Observatory to increase the occurrence of higher-rarity Missions."

841965829.m_KeyValue: ""Fortunately, Hilda's letter made her intentions clear—she planned to leave. That's how Reese II knew she hadn't taken her own life.""

844838698.m_KeyValue: "That thing will drag you to an early grave—"

844838700.m_KeyValue: "I see. Did he leave anything behind?"

845388628.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know from which direction they'll strike the seal, but I will stop them!""

845388629.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Never show mercy to an enemy, no matter the bond you share._$$ That was your first lesson.""

845388630.m_KeyValue: "I never expected our meeting would be under these circumstances."

845389650.m_KeyValue: "So this is what had you so distracted mid-battle. This little trick was your plan all along?"

845389652.m_KeyValue: "I once believed Lady Empousa might understand my ideals."

845389655.m_KeyValue: "Cidhall? He's here too? Why would both of them...!?"

849195451.m_KeyValue: "I never said I was conducting alchemical experiments."

849195452.m_KeyValue: "I couldn't care less about how it tastes. Shouldn't you explain why you just drank what was supposed to be alchemical material?"

849195457.m_KeyValue: ""The concentrated flavor of wild blackcurrants, with a remarkably weighty acidity...""

849195458.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, this familiar taste... it's been so long.""

849195461.m_KeyValue: ""Before sealing the cask, they added a small amount of Limine's own blood. Though Bloodborn blood typically tastes bitter, when mixed with the wine, it created an unexpectedly distinct flavor profile.""

849195462.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, this is the Bloodborn Covenant, a private wine blend of the Bathory family from when Limine was still around. It's made from a mixture of Sangiovese and Black Moon grapes.""

849195464.m_KeyValue: "Wait! Why did you just drink it?"

850483044.m_KeyValue: "What connection do they have to the memories I'm trying to recover?"

850483045.m_KeyValue: ""Finding the Moonblessed would serve multiple purposes: advancing the family's revival, fulfilling Lady Empousa's aspirations, and...""

850483079.m_KeyValue: "What are you two doing? Are we going or not!"

854681485.m_KeyValue: ""The cruel blood rose, truly fitting for a Bloodborn.""

856037066.m_KeyValue: "I wonder how many more surprises this place has in store for us."

857858892.m_KeyValue: "No matter. I don't care who you were—You stand now as pawns of the Apocalypse."

857858893.m_KeyValue: ""And you, leader of the Chamber of War, should be ending conflict. Yet here you are—relishing it.""

857858896.m_KeyValue: ""Even then, I wondered where the base of that tower led. Who would've thought… the opposite end of the continent.""

857858897.m_KeyValue: "Then am I right to assume—Dracula is the source of all Black Blood?"

857858898.m_KeyValue: "Didn't those things get burned to ash already?"

857858899.m_KeyValue: "We were chasing after a Moonblessed—now you're telling me Mother is here too?! Why didn't I know any of this?"

857858900.m_KeyValue: "What's strange is why you're tailing us."

857858901.m_KeyValue: ""If you'd prefer a friendly duel instead, I wouldn't mind.""

857862100.m_KeyValue: "Looks like there's no time to find other Vice-Commanders—we need to find Acappella immediately."

857862101.m_KeyValue: ""No, I'm with the Choir. Just passing through.""

858058861.m_KeyValue: ""Nonsense! The 'Black Blood' is Aeon's divine punishment for heretics, members of the Church can't be...""

858058862.m_KeyValue: ""We don't need to kill her, do we? She's just following orders, and her sense of justice.""

858058864.m_KeyValue: ""Oh great Aeon, is this a test? Why did you subject us to such a cruel ordeal?""

858599176.m_KeyValue: "More spirits will manifest the further Threads of Fate progresses."

858602377.m_KeyValue: ""That bastard knew that <style=""Highlight"">my specialty is dealing with large numbers of enemies</style>, so he wanted to torment me with them.""

859060390.m_KeyValue: "She's alive...? That's impossible! Where is she?"

859060391.m_KeyValue: "You've forgotten what happened? No wonder. That tragedy... it was too much for a child to shoulder."

859060394.m_KeyValue: ""So you walk beside the Bell Ringer now... Good. Like your father, you carry grand ideals—and boundless potential.""

859060395.m_KeyValue: "It's over... everything's ruined. And it's all Averdin's fault!"

859060397.m_KeyValue: "Damn it—what did you just bite into?!"

859060424.m_KeyValue: "Is she... Ami from the wanted poster?"

859060426.m_KeyValue: ""From what they're saying, it seems they've found Van Helsing. Let's follow them and see.""

859060427.m_KeyValue: "Ami has fallen into slumber due to the Master's schemes. I must gather all the Siren's Tears to awaken her."

859060428.m_KeyValue: "If you wish to serve under me… I might consider it."

859060678.m_KeyValue: ""Let this be your very first lesson about this cruel, cruel world!""

859060686.m_KeyValue: ""A new Sage has risen, the Mistbound Terror has been caught, and Lord Thoreau's ordered extra patrols. Tonight's festivities are cleared to last 'til dawn!""

859060688.m_KeyValue: "That settles it! I'll craft a new line that truly embodies the spirit of Sapphire Isle!"

859060689.m_KeyValue: ""And what, pray tell, is Robin von Quinn's most treasured possession?""

859060690.m_KeyValue: "Only commoners waste time on such nonsense! We’re leaving. Now!"

859060691.m_KeyValue: ""Surely, one can grasp that most mysterious thing called love... by slaying wicked dragons, conquering uncivilized barbarians, and unmasking the schemes of evil wizards!""

859060692.m_KeyValue: "To think... I would face my nemesis here and now."

859060713.m_KeyValue: ""With this seal, we can forge a letter requesting an audience with Thoreau—along with orders to transfer the remaining captives.""

859060720.m_KeyValue: ""They're fairly common flowers by the coast. When in bloom, they float across the water in clusters. Truly a beautiful sight.""

859060721.m_KeyValue: ""Curious about these flowers? For just thirty Soli, you can hire Yakov—Sapphire Isle's most knowledgeable guide—to dig up the truth!""

859060722.m_KeyValue: "She hasn't returned yet? Or... did she leave again?"

859060724.m_KeyValue: ""Wait—isn't this the Siren's Tear? The mark of a Sage's status and rank? If I could sell it on the black market, I could clear all my debts!""

859060752.m_KeyValue: "If anyone's an outsider... I suppose that would be me."

859060756.m_KeyValue: "Could Little Bella be a reaper?! She keeps cutting people's _$$threads of life_$$!"

859060757.m_KeyValue: "He was one of the Sages—he must've had one on him..."

859060783.m_KeyValue: "What important business could he possibly have without me? Wait... am I not his companion?!"

859060786.m_KeyValue: "They say you can get anything from him—if you're willing to pay his price."

859060787.m_KeyValue: "Hey! Listen here! A proper actor never refuses a lady's request—that's day-one etiquette for any respectable performer!"

859060789.m_KeyValue: "Lady Selena! We searched the auction house but found no one by the name Van Helsing."

859060811.m_KeyValue: ""With this motion, it makes an _$$ahh_$$ sound.""

859060814.m_KeyValue: "This is clearly our device—one that uses Siren's Tears to produce crimson mist. Anyone caught in the hallucinations shouldn't even be able to see it..."

859060816.m_KeyValue: "And this stone... it's already helped me recall fragments of the promise. It's time to return it. He needs it far more than I do."

859060817.m_KeyValue: ""By the way, that peculiar someone happened to be Sage Alexa—The same Sage who fined my stall thirteen times.""

859060818.m_KeyValue: "Me? I'm Joyce—the famous and beloved mascot of Sapphire Isle!"

859060819.m_KeyValue: "Wow! There are actually things in this world that money can't buy? What are they? What are they?"

859060821.m_KeyValue: "Outside Lord Hallon's office! That person said he was one of only two survivors of the tsunami eleven years ago. That he would keep Lord Hallon constantly on guard!"

859060845.m_KeyValue: ""Debts must be paid, and promises must be kept—no matter what.""

859060846.m_KeyValue: ""That's fine. If you do decide to snitch, I'll be sure to tell them all about your heroic exploits. How you helped us thoroughly defeat the Sages.""

859060847.m_KeyValue: ""Then this is part of your promise too, isn't it?""

859060848.m_KeyValue: "Then why is Miss Ami on the wanted poster?"

859060849.m_KeyValue: ""If I'm not mistaken, there must be a connection between those invisible _$$threads_$$... and the Siren's Tear.""

859060850.m_KeyValue: "Disgraceful. If anyone deserves a fate worse than a demon's in hell—it's you."

859060852.m_KeyValue: "Then we won't write it that way."

859060853.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Viktor Thoreau, Miss Alexa, and Miss Alexis. All fell by her hand... or rather, by the blade of Mr. Nevernight.""

859060878.m_KeyValue: ""If it weren't for you lot, that damn prisoner would never have escaped!""

859060882.m_KeyValue: "Hey! Isn't that Noah from the wanted poster? He's walked right into our hands—seize him!"

859060883.m_KeyValue: ""I know what you want to ask, Miss Bella. But not everything is as it seems.""

859060884.m_KeyValue: "Polished railings... tasteless flooring... and—torture devices? Either her taste has taken a strange turn... or my memories of her are still incomplete."

859060885.m_KeyValue: "As for the tsunami... There's a memorial garden dedicated to the victims of the 1342 disaster. It's in the southwest corner of the isle."

859150553.m_KeyValue: "Life is more fragile than you think—yet far braver than you'd ever believe."

859150556.m_KeyValue: ""Well said. Life is a precious miracle—cherish all life, and stay away from all calamities.""

859153754.m_KeyValue: "Or are you worried about what the fire guy might do if he defeats the thunder woman?"

859153755.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, is your battle with Joan over? And that thunder just now... what was it?""

869490349.m_KeyValue: ""When the battle begins, grants all allies placed on this tile 1000 Special Energy.""

870632260.m_KeyValue: ""Or should I make you part of my mantle, becoming my eternal Vassal?""

870632261.m_KeyValue: "Hehehe... Should I put a collar on you and make you sit obediently at my feet?"

870632264.m_KeyValue: "Hahaha... Looks like we'll be trapped here together forever!"

870632265.m_KeyValue: ""Oh my, what's happening here? Why did the tomb door close?""

870632268.m_KeyValue: "Oh? Cat got your tongue in front of your master?"

870632270.m_KeyValue: "Don't worry. You'll see how tall I am when you're crawling and whimpering at my feet."

870632271.m_KeyValue: ""Sirene, you're... much shorter than I expected.""

874005817.m_KeyValue: "Deals True DMG equal to {1} of Max HP every {0} sec to enemies on burning tiles."

874005819.m_KeyValue: ""When the battle begins, Vassals placed on this central tile gain All DMG Reduction (Minor), lasting for {0} sec, and immediately gain <color=#c33131>{1}</color> point(s) of Energy.""

875432663.m_KeyValue: "Seeking the gifts of the Threads of Fate through the cycles."

879422593.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, everyone... I can't bring you food anymore...""

879422596.m_KeyValue: "No! That's not it! Joan... she's protecting the world—making sure it follows the right order—"

879422597.m_KeyValue: "Me? Here? Heh... It's been ages since someone asked something so delightfully foolish."

879997303.m_KeyValue: ""So this was Hati's plan? To call me out, so you could speak with me before the Awakening power fades away.""

879997304.m_KeyValue: ""She's a serious child—stubborn, too. If she learns the truth, it might shake her to her core.""

879997305.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... as long as your heart beats and memories flow, we will always be with you.""

879997307.m_KeyValue: "I guess I won't be able to join Sheila and the others in their rest just yet—"

880044370.m_KeyValue: "I guess no one told you. How else do you think the legends of vampire bats and werewolves came about?"

880044373.m_KeyValue: "That's impossible! I've never heard of such a thing!"

880044435.m_KeyValue: "We only know the town's in big trouble. Having a local with us could be beneficial."

880045362.m_KeyValue: "Another monster like that eyebrow-less arsonist? You've got to be kidding me. Why do we keep running into these freaks..."

880045397.m_KeyValue: ""That stupid wolf, that wild girl, she's running so fast! She's doing it on purpose, isn't she?""

880664472.m_KeyValue: "Are you still thinking about what she said?"

880664474.m_KeyValue: ""Like that cat from earlier, it seems to have disappeared.""

880664503.m_KeyValue: "Appearing together is too much of a coincidence—it's like they're just there to fill space."

880664504.m_KeyValue: "Yeah... These monsters and that Tarot woman..."

880664536.m_KeyValue: ""It's fine to be confident, but you need to consider your own strength as well.""

880664538.m_KeyValue: "I didn't expect you to be so capable."

880665527.m_KeyValue: "I hope you can complete the next trial just as well."

880665530.m_KeyValue: ""Well done, you did not disappoint me.""

880665559.m_KeyValue: ""I take that back, this hunk of metal is impossible to talk to!""

880665561.m_KeyValue: "...How are you more optimistic than me at a time like this?"

880665562.m_KeyValue: "Maybe this is his way of showing goodwill?"

880665625.m_KeyValue: ""And now, let me see what you're made of.""

880673186.m_KeyValue: ""But one thing's for sure, we have to get rid of them if we want to get out of this place.""

880673247.m_KeyValue: ""I thought this would be quick, but they're tougher than expected.""

880673248.m_KeyValue: "Let's focus on the ones in front of us for now."

880675263.m_KeyValue: "Why are those things from before inside these creatures?"

880675265.m_KeyValue: "We need to figure out how to deal with this."

880675296.m_KeyValue: "A big one appeared. Is it the leader?"

880675300.m_KeyValue: "She seems to enjoy talking to the puppet."

880676289.m_KeyValue: "It dripped slime all over the floor too."

880676385.m_KeyValue: ""Clean yourself up first, then I'll tell you.""

880676386.m_KeyValue: "Whoa! I-I almost slipped... Why are you so far away?"

880676448.m_KeyValue: "It's a different color than the others..."

880677540.m_KeyValue: "These guys look really heavy. How can they fly?"

880677541.m_KeyValue: "Why do you always notice the weird things..."

880677571.m_KeyValue: ""If you're done observing, could you come here and help me?""

880677572.m_KeyValue: "Their wings are made of stone. There must be something else keeping them in the air."

880677606.m_KeyValue: ""The shadow... That's it, there's something wrong with the shadow.""

880678596.m_KeyValue: ""I'm fine, but it seems we're no match for her.""

880678627.m_KeyValue: "Would anyone really pay money for that kind of thing?"

880678692.m_KeyValue: "Not unless you give us the card."

880679619.m_KeyValue: ""These suits of armor are on fire, but they're cold to the touch...""

880679652.m_KeyValue: "Just a little more... Can you manage?"

880679654.m_KeyValue: ""I'm not scared anymore... Ugh, it's still so high...""

880679716.m_KeyValue: "Hold on... let me... let me catch my breath..."

880680644.m_KeyValue: ""79, do you still have strength left?""

880680645.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry about me. They're tough, but I can still manage.""

880680646.m_KeyValue: "Then I'm counting on you to watch my back."

880680741.m_KeyValue: "I just want to get this pointless farce over with."

880680742.m_KeyValue: "Finally decided to get your hands dirty?"

880680803.m_KeyValue: "They're... a lot tougher than what we encountered earlier!"

880714249.m_KeyValue: "Don’t let him waste his energy here."

881727423.m_KeyValue: "Infiltrate failed. Enemy alert level now at 100%."

884697597.m_KeyValue: "Don't treat me like I'm some immobile scarecrow."

885608599.m_KeyValue: ""Guide the stars of the past, bathe in the moonlight of yesteryear.""

890086992.m_KeyValue: "You'll be receiving Missions and Tasks in the castle. Try to complete as many as you can."

890097090.m_KeyValue: ""Phantoms will always drop Past Relics, regardless of their strength.""

890097092.m_KeyValue: ""Next, select Nefertari's Unique Relic—the sealed _$$Bow of Pyre_$$—and drag it to your Inventory.""

890097093.m_KeyValue: ""Now, take this bag while you're at it. It's nothing rare—you'll find more in the future.""

890098115.m_KeyValue: ""Excuse me, but I've just remembered something that would make the perfect gift to celebrate your rebirth—""

890098116.m_KeyValue: "These are notes I obtained from a cartographer friend. They will guide you to discover lost items during your journey."

890098117.m_KeyValue: ""Through its guidance, you may uncover treasures left by those who came before, or perhaps a story or two worth remembering.""

890098118.m_KeyValue: ""So, we just need to follow the clues to find the hidden location in this 'puzzle,' right?""

890098119.m_KeyValue: "Exactly. Try tapping on places you find suspicious. You may come across something unexpected..."

890296531.m_KeyValue: "Let's finish this before old man Baphomet has to get his hands dirty."

890297555.m_KeyValue: "Let's go. We have to rescue Empousa."

890298709.m_KeyValue: "I never thought you would defy the family's tenets."

890299732.m_KeyValue: "(Cinematic Subtitles) Looks like you are ready."

890300622.m_KeyValue: ""...Well, if you don't think that way, it's like you're denying that you're a real 'life' yourself, isn't it?""

890300625.m_KeyValue: ""Jestel, you know where the other brazier is, lead the way!""

890301646.m_KeyValue: ""You seem to have quite an injury, are you alright?""

890548627.m_KeyValue: ""Quick, fight off the tentacle, or more will come!""

891320353.m_KeyValue: ""To help you adjust to your new role, I've compiled the _$$Ten Essential Duties of a Bloodborn Elder._$$""

891321477.m_KeyValue: ""Behold, a treasure chest awaits just beyond. Are you ready to embrace the challenge?""

891321508.m_KeyValue: "It's time to invoke the power of the 'Chariot' and deal with this sleeping guard."

891321675.m_KeyValue: ""Hope I didn’t keep you waiting, Patchen. The key’s ours now.""

891321706.m_KeyValue: "The chest is locked. It seems the 'Wheel of Fortune' has one more trial."

891323488.m_KeyValue: "Be diligent about upgrading your Vassal skills. It will greatly help in battle!"

891323523.m_KeyValue: ""Before we proceed, there's something I need to give you.""

891323554.m_KeyValue: ""We've been on this journey for a while now, Noah. Know that having like-minded Vassals by your side makes everything much easier.""

891323589.m_KeyValue: ""Thanks to you, we have finally gained a foothold.""

891323620.m_KeyValue: "Truth's Odyssey is the main Raid for obtaining Skill enhancement materials."

891323853.m_KeyValue: ""Though the family remains in a state of disarray, the many facilities built during its golden era are still accessible in the castle.""

891324612.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh, we've been trudging forever! My legs are about ready to fall off. I'm getting jealous of those bums back at the castle, sleeping in and sipping their hot wine.""

891326755.m_KeyValue: "This tower is overcomplicated! Why all the divergence? Which path should we take?"

891326790.m_KeyValue: ""We successfully broke free from the prison and completed the first phase of the fated covenant. Let's go back and check how we've been compensated, Noah.""

891690482.m_KeyValue: ""Wait! Why is my Bloodsoul resonating with you, an ordinary person?""

891892864.m_KeyValue: ""Not much. Just a golden lance, and it's absurdly heavy.""

891892866.m_KeyValue: ""You may have helped us just now, but I still don't know why you chose to intervene.""

892258073.m_KeyValue: ""Units that pass through the werewolf's Blood Trail will be inflicted with Pestilence, taking DMG equal to a percentage of their Max HP per sec, while boosting DMG dealt by {0}. This effect lasts until the end of the battle.""

892689628.m_KeyValue: ""As promised, I've come to return your sketchbook—complete this time.""

892689629.m_KeyValue: ""In fact, your Captain already gave you the answer.""

892689630.m_KeyValue: ""No matter where the ship sails, as long as you're not alone on the journey—that is what freedom truly means.""

893184522.m_KeyValue: ""Ever since the Blood Moon engulfed the sun, this desert's become a wasteland.""

893734445.m_KeyValue: "So the Bathorys were the fourth. And yet not a single Vice-Commander detected your movements..."

893734446.m_KeyValue: "Just as I was told—fierce and fiery. A most spirited small guest indeed."

893734447.m_KeyValue: ""So this is what lies within the sealed area... It feels like a twisted union—part Bathory, part Church.""

893734449.m_KeyValue: ""I can't say why, but something about this place feels... very off-putting.""

893734450.m_KeyValue: "Go on ahead. I'll hold them off."

893734451.m_KeyValue: ""What's even stranger is—where is she? If she lost, did she just vanish?""

893734452.m_KeyValue: "Wait—him? That man with the sinister eyebrows?"

893735468.m_KeyValue: "Save your strength—what good is reaching me if you're already on death's doorstep?"

893735471.m_KeyValue: "I won't abandon you! We'll leave together! I swear we will find a new life!"

893735473.m_KeyValue: ""Cain! Please spare my sister—spare Empousa! Let me become the sacrifice, let me serve as _$$Mother's vessel_$$!""

893735474.m_KeyValue: ""It is the memory etched into the veins of all _$$sisters,_$$ Empousa—""

893735475.m_KeyValue: "Who have only one reason to exist..."

893735476.m_KeyValue: "I should be the one asking that! Why are you here... Did you arrive with Jacintha and Cain?"

893735477.m_KeyValue: ""Then you went on to help him _$$find himself,_$$ but you were really following Cain's orders to gather the Moonblessed!""

896820652.m_KeyValue: ""I've heard they use a unique alchemy to sustain the Long Night. If we can stop the ritual, the night might finally end.""

896820653.m_KeyValue: ""Once the night ends, both sides will lose their power to fight. Maybe then, their hatred will yield. This is the only way to stop them.""

896820655.m_KeyValue: "But the castle is too vast to search for the ritual site. If only Cain were here…"

896820656.m_KeyValue: ""A steward must answer when called. Unfortunately, with Lady Quinn in the dungeon then, I regret that I was unable to assist.""

896820657.m_KeyValue: "How terrifying! No one was here just now—how did you appear out of nowhere?"

896820658.m_KeyValue: ""Regarding the ritual site you seek, we can discuss it as we walk. This will ensure none of your precious time is lost.""

896820659.m_KeyValue: ""After such a wearying journey, my lady, I have readied fresh attire for your comfort.""

896820660.m_KeyValue: "I never would have imagined that you were truly a lady."

896820661.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you for your thoughtfulness, Cain the steward.""

896830380.m_KeyValue: "You've been drinking it?! Doesn't Mouret have the Moontide Canal?"

896830381.m_KeyValue: ""Daylight's been getting shorter, and Ganelon's stretch of the river has almost dried up. This underground spring is all we've got left...""

896830388.m_KeyValue: "I-It's all Mr. James's fault for not stopping me! I was only trying to protect him!"

896830389.m_KeyValue: "Protect me? You ran faster than a rabbit! These old bones nearly fell apart chasing you!"

896830390.m_KeyValue: "But seriously—why come to the forbidden grounds of all places? That's just asking to get infected by the Plague!"

896830391.m_KeyValue: "Forbidden grounds... Plague... You mean this place? The Ashen Garden?"

896830393.m_KeyValue: ""In my time, this cave is one of the Twelve Forbidden Grounds of the continent—known as The Blackroot Hollow. You have no idea how dangerous it is!""

896830394.m_KeyValue: "I only found out about it by sneaking a peek at my grandfather's diary."

896830395.m_KeyValue: "Wait... we've been drinking water from here all this time... Isn't that basically slow suicide?"

896831534.m_KeyValue: "This is... an old score I need to settle."

896832558.m_KeyValue: ""It's a long trek through the caves. Are you sure you want to delay your search for the young hero, Agnes?""

896832559.m_KeyValue: "When I stumble on a historical mystery this big... I have to see it through!"

896832564.m_KeyValue: ""Instead, he went to the trouble of recruiting Johannes... and keeping the infected alive.""

896832565.m_KeyValue: ""Ezareth also said that once the patients mutated, they can be left alone. That sounds more like he wants them to stay that way.""

896832566.m_KeyValue: "We all know contracting the plague is a death sentence. Accelerating it helps no one... Unless... he's trying to sacrifice a few to save the rest?"

896832567.m_KeyValue: ""That doesn't hold up. These patients were already isolated in the caves. If he wanted to protect the healthy, he would've fortified the town.""

896832568.m_KeyValue: "Do you know where we might find this Lord Ezareth?"

896832569.m_KeyValue: ""During the war, he stationed himself near the edge of town to monitor the frontlines.""

896832571.m_KeyValue: ""I have a theory, but I need more evidence.""

896833720.m_KeyValue: "A curse? No way! It was incredible!"

896833721.m_KeyValue: "They called it a curse. Said this strange Blood magic would bring ruin upon the Baphomet line."

896833722.m_KeyValue: ""You're the one who brought me here, to seek out my mother. I should be the one thanking you.""

896833723.m_KeyValue: ""Inside that barrier, everything went silent... like the whole world held its breath. I've never felt so at peace.""

896834736.m_KeyValue: ""See, Quinn? I told you my dad would know what to do!""

896834740.m_KeyValue: "They said I looked like I was from the north… which means Mother wasn't a native of Mouret. She came here from her homeland."

896834741.m_KeyValue: ""The Crowleys are affiliated with Ganelon and typically reside beyond the northern reaches of the Lupine Forest. That said, your mother was among those who came to Mouret on official duty. After all, Mouret was once a key stronghold under Ganelon.""

896834742.m_KeyValue: "Agnes and I are actually headed to find Ezareth Crowley. He's from the same clan and used to be quite close with Elonora."

896834743.m_KeyValue: "He may know something. Why don't you come with us?"

896834744.m_KeyValue: ""Right! If the Cartographer hadn't reminded me, I would've completely forgotten!""

896834745.m_KeyValue: ""Father... Quinn's mother—she's the envoy you mentioned before, Elonora? Do you know where she is now?""

896834746.m_KeyValue: "Elonora... Elonora Crowley? That famed envoy from Mouret? I believe she disappeared after the great battle twenty years ago."

896834747.m_KeyValue: "So that's why they kept calling me a Crowley witch… My mother came from the Crowley family."

896835890.m_KeyValue: "So it's true. Your beloved sister was nothing but a pawn from the start."

896835891.m_KeyValue: "Only then... could her death serve... its greatest purpose..."

896835892.m_KeyValue: "I merely... ensured it appeared... at the right moment..."

896835893.m_KeyValue: ""O-Of course it was real... it had to be, to make it convincing...""

896835894.m_KeyValue: "This letter... it bears the Wolfsbane mark... This truly was my mother's!"

896835895.m_KeyValue: "Your father's bloodstained debt in Ganelon remains unpaid—and now you dare add to it?"

896835896.m_KeyValue: ""A child raised by monsters, ungrateful to the last... I generously let you see my sister's keepsake, and this is the thanks I get?""

896835898.m_KeyValue: ""Naturally, you don't care about facts. All you needed was a tragic tale to stir hearts. But this clay... it's the fatal flaw that unravels your lie.""

896835899.m_KeyValue: "Reasoning with a villain like you is a waste of breath. The only justice now... is to shut you up for good."

896836914.m_KeyValue: "Ah! My leg! That cursed arrow… And my fields—the harvest is still waiting. Who will care for my family now?"

896836915.m_KeyValue: "Father... Mother... where are you? It's so dark... it hurts so much... I'm scared..."

896836916.m_KeyValue: "My child! My little Tom! He was only five... Why? Why did you destroy our house? He was so young..."

896836917.m_KeyValue: "I don't want to die...but I don't want to kill either... I'm just a miller's apprentice! Why must I wield a sword? I can barely hold it steady!"

896836918.m_KeyValue: ""The faces are a blur now. But the screams... those screams... they haunt me still, as if they've carved themselves into my soul. Even after all these years, I hear them as clearly as the day they shattered my world.""

896836919.m_KeyValue: ""Conrad... Conrad! Open your eyes! Don't leave me and the children... Please, I'm begging you, wake up!""

896836920.m_KeyValue: "Leave everything here to Father and me!"

896836921.m_KeyValue: ""On our way to the castle, we passed through a war zone. It was the first time I witnessed the horrors of war with my own eyes.""

896836922.m_KeyValue: ""If you want to harm these villagers, you'll have to get through me first!""

896836923.m_KeyValue: ""Hurry along, Quinn. Time waits for no one. And you, Cartographer, keep her safe.""

903772932.m_KeyValue: "Hehe... I tremble to imagine how lively it'll be under my cloak tonight."

903772963.m_KeyValue: ""Gargoyles are carved from stone. We have no souls, and we do not die.""

903773029.m_KeyValue: ""I never believed it. Yet here we are, father and daughter, facing off against each other.""

906112464.m_KeyValue: "I've always said she wouldn't be a companion who'd stay with us till the end."

906113550.m_KeyValue: ""You can do it, Aiona! Aim for their heads!""

906113552.m_KeyValue: "These two aren't even fighting having a heated debate..."

906113553.m_KeyValue: ""When Ganelons fight, we aim for the heart!""

918346035.m_KeyValue: "This desert can't go on forever... can it?"

918346037.m_KeyValue: "Wait! Did you forget what he said? Do you want to turn into sand too?!"

918346066.m_KeyValue: "What's with the monsters here!? It keeps getting worse..."

918346069.m_KeyValue: "You're bleeding... Stop talking... Let me patch you up..."

918346332.m_KeyValue: ""The eyes have been moistened... All preparations are done... Wait, is she regaining consciousness. What should we do?""

918346334.m_KeyValue: ""I am not just a vessel for the eyes, nor am I a puppet for the family!""

918346363.m_KeyValue:
""Their lands, blessed with eternal spring, where streams through verdant meadows flow;
Its people, prosperous and content, to the Church their loyalty show;""

918346365.m_KeyValue: "The bandages are still here... Have I returned?"

918346369.m_KeyValue: ""Strange, Lady Aiona isn't here either... Let's search over there!""

918346397.m_KeyValue: "They're armed assassins sent here to kill us!"

918346427.m_KeyValue: "<alpha=#FF>That voice... Are you the masked person from the desert?"

918346430.m_KeyValue: "I still have to save my Father. I must return to the castle immediately. Please!"

918346431.m_KeyValue: "Father... I need to go back and find Father!"

918346462.m_KeyValue: ""Tsk... So you think you know everything, little lady?""

918346465.m_KeyValue: "'Aiona... Fulfill... the duty of the Alita family...'"

918346496.m_KeyValue: ""The lord is not here, my lady. You shouldn't speak too much; your eyes need time to recover. Please rest for now.""

918346529.m_KeyValue: "Don't act rashly! Our power is being suppressed."

920331012.m_KeyValue: "How can you spurn the mercy that's been offered..."

920332035.m_KeyValue: "It is time for the people of this world to wake up and witness the truth."

921723282.m_KeyValue: ""Hahaha! You, the greatest of sinners in the eyes of those mortals, dare speak so arrogantly of my sins?""

921734405.m_KeyValue: ""After all, like your sister, there are plenty to replace you...""

922779537.m_KeyValue: "Because I'd rather spend time alone with you."

923307718.m_KeyValue: "Looks like I succeeded. My mission was to keep you occupied."

923307720.m_KeyValue: "So… you'll let us leave? Even Aiona?"

923307721.m_KeyValue: "...It's coming from the sealed area. The Divine Body's seal… it's been broken."

923307724.m_KeyValue: ""All you need to know is this: Like you, I am simply one of many forms life may take.""

923307725.m_KeyValue: "Now that I’ve been honest with them... Will you grant me one request?"

923307726.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, so Aiona's over forty? That makes her ancient! No wonder she always wears a veil.""

923307727.m_KeyValue: "You aren't lying. But you haven't told them everything. There's something more you're looking for in the Bathory."

925479686.m_KeyValue: "You contacted the Church and brought them here? Why didn't you tell me about this before?"

925479687.m_KeyValue: "No way... How do I keep getting lost on my own doorstep?"

925479688.m_KeyValue: "That's right! I've also heard that each of the Church's twelve Bell Ringers possesses a unique ability that specifically counters Black Blood!"

925479689.m_KeyValue: "Could it be Death that I encountered on the cliff? And their presence at both ends..."

925479691.m_KeyValue: ""What do you mean? I'm never been mistaken about a person! You're Noah, plain and simple! Even if you started acting like a completely different person...""

925479718.m_KeyValue: "Of course! Everyone on the island knows that phantoms can only manifest from those we've shared wonderful memories with..."

925479719.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, when you were talking about your grandmother, you asked if I was a phantom or a real, living person, right?""

925479720.m_KeyValue: ""No... While I have no memories of the past, my experiences with Empousa and the others since my rebirth must be real...""

925479721.m_KeyValue: ""—The chant of my family's forbidden ritual! It turns the invoker into a 'sacrifice,' reducing them to nothing but ashes!""

925479722.m_KeyValue: "Noah? I'm glad you're okay... And the person you brought with you..."

925479744.m_KeyValue: "I am indeed angry at you for leaving the Church on your own without consulting me; but I'm also angry at myself..."

925479745.m_KeyValue: ""You're different from Darcias. You're not a cold weapon; you have your own thoughts, your own emotions...""

925479750.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, tell me, how much do you really know?""

925479751.m_KeyValue: ""Save your excuses for your master, Albrecht, that old fossil.""

925479754.m_KeyValue: "Wow... so Darcias is that skilled too..."

925479755.m_KeyValue: "Acappella... I know you still have many questions... but these... could they be Death's... minions? They..."

925479756.m_KeyValue: "Let's be wildly generous and say you actually learned Death's weakness from that old woman. What difference would it even make?!"

925479757.m_KeyValue: ""If you didn't do it, then why did you just happen to secretly leave the Church on the exact same day Death escaped? And why...""

925479777.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh, this brat! She can clearly hear us, but only listens when it's about her!""

925479782.m_KeyValue: ""From that moment, the 'shades of longing' created by the Head of the Divine Body became the sole inhabitants of the island. Not a single living being remained.""

925479783.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, Darcias... You've been treating me like my grandmother... I guess that means I'm very similar to her... That makes me happy.""

925479784.m_KeyValue: "That's right. Your use of Covenant not only defeated Famine but also destroyed the ship."

925479785.m_KeyValue: ""If the Divine Body rejects all outsiders to this island... could it be that Noah is, in fact, not an outsider?""

925479786.m_KeyValue: ""I will. But in return, you must promise not to open that coffin before I come back.""

925479788.m_KeyValue: "There's also a worst-case scenario... Could he be..."

925479789.m_KeyValue: ""I trust you, Acappella, but you've only met him once. How do you plan to find him?""

925479811.m_KeyValue: "...I should be used to it by now... having no one by my side..."

925479815.m_KeyValue: "B-But... everyone was just saying... I'm not a child anymore! I'm the last Gravekeeper of the Paracelsuses!"

925479818.m_KeyValue: ""I hate to admit it, but you're right. We've left this world long ago, hahaha!""

925479819.m_KeyValue: ""Our methods are no different than those of the Bloodborn. We preserve the self, 'thoughts,' through the ceaseless transference of memories into new vessels.""

925479820.m_KeyValue: ""Well... Grandmother didn't say... but she did say that if Death ever escaped, it would definitely...""

925479821.m_KeyValue: ""Haha! That's right, I'm your grandmother's grandfather!""

925479843.m_KeyValue: "That bastard Albrecht... how could he be so heartless towards you!"

925479846.m_KeyValue: ""How ironic... Something our family only realized after generations of struggle, so casually stated by an 'outsider.'""

925479847.m_KeyValue: "Grandmother... so that's why we went to live with the Church..."

925479849.m_KeyValue: ""But he must have just returned to this island. While he's weakened, it's our chance to send him back to the 'abyss.' But protecting Piera takes priority!""

925479850.m_KeyValue: ""But why... why is my mind filled with... fear, despair, and uncertainty... of death... of being alone... of my duty...""

925479851.m_KeyValue: "But... I'm also... a bit angry at you. I was ready to say farewell..."

925479853.m_KeyValue: "How could anyone in this world wish for their grandchild to sacrifice their life for a duty they themselves had fled from?"

925479881.m_KeyValue: "I... I feel myself slipping... The ritual is... almost done..."

925479882.m_KeyValue: "I finally understand... Someone as weak and pathetic as me... being born into this family... this must be my destiny."

927666012.m_KeyValue: ""Hati, now's not the time to argue about right and wrong!""

927666013.m_KeyValue: ""That's not important right now. If we don't leave, it'll be too late!""

927666014.m_KeyValue: "Are you all alright? Have you seen my father?"

927666016.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry to keep you waiting, my old friend.""

927666017.m_KeyValue: "From what I've heard... Mr. Clive betrayed the Church and released the Black Blood demon sealed in the forbidden grounds. That's why this place..."

927666045.m_KeyValue: ""Since then, your life has been sustained by your oath. You've persevered all this time to protect Hati.""

927666046.m_KeyValue: ""I remember you loved these flowers, even though they're poisonous to you...""

927666311.m_KeyValue: "Bad predicament? You called for help because you were about to be eaten."

927666312.m_KeyValue: ""This is where your journey ends, kind travelers. No... perhaps I should call you vampires.""

927666341.m_KeyValue: ""Come, my worthy adversary! Our fated duel begins!""

927666342.m_KeyValue: ""...I guess that won't work, huh? And here I thought we could resolve this without fighting...""

927666343.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Is this how you treat those who saved your life? What kind of knight are you?"

927666345.m_KeyValue: ""...Ah yes, I must find Hati right away!""

927666372.m_KeyValue: "Cain said there were four Moonblessed left. Have all the clues really converged here?"

927666374.m_KeyValue: "You're the most relaxed one here... And I'm surprised you eat normal food."

927666375.m_KeyValue: ""Our home lies beyond the sea of stars, on the other side of that distant moon.""

927666376.m_KeyValue: ""We are indeed members of the Bathory family, but we only came to Lupine Forest to find someone.""

927666377.m_KeyValue: ""Wait a second, I know that look... Quick, get away!""

927666378.m_KeyValue: "You look like you've seen a ghost."

927666379.m_KeyValue: ""Get out of here, now! I'll hold them off!""

927666405.m_KeyValue: ""He... he's an old friend of my father's. But for some reason, today he kept trying to stop us from going back to help Father. He even tried to stop me by force...""

927666408.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, stupid wolf! If you can't bring yourself to fight people you know, step aside. Leave the Black Blood enemies to us!""

927666409.m_KeyValue: "How could this happen? We just escaped from the Church's soldiers together! What's happening?"

927666410.m_KeyValue: ""Your skin tone is different from theirs, and so is your build. I remember the Ganelon people being naturally tall and robust.""

927666411.m_KeyValue: ""In conflict, there are no true winners. Only varying degrees of harm suffered.""

927666436.m_KeyValue: "You helped me and Clive. I'm truly grateful. We're going to go find Father now. This is where we part ways."

927666440.m_KeyValue: "Why should we tell you? It's none of your business."

927666442.m_KeyValue: "Don't you dare talk about my father like that!"

927666471.m_KeyValue: ""So it can't save their lives, but will allow them to die with more dignity—is that what you mean?""

927666472.m_KeyValue: "These soldiers have also been infected with the Black Blood disease."

927666473.m_KeyValue: ""No, I'm just trying to understand his words—'Bringing him to the Ashen Garden is our family's destiny.'""

927666474.m_KeyValue: ""He might be able to... No, he definitely can help us solve the current crisis in town!""

927666475.m_KeyValue: ""I've always wanted to be a strong Gravekeeper like Father, so I've pestered him with questions about many things, including the possibility of forbidden grounds existing.""

927666500.m_KeyValue: ""Lord Ganelon is here too? With him by your side, perhaps it'll be fine...""

927666502.m_KeyValue: "That outfit... So you are from the Church!"

927666504.m_KeyValue: ""But it's okay. Even if Father only cares for sister, that's fine, because for me...""

927666505.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, and the Ganelon Gravekeeper gets their own Moonlight Sword too! It's really cool!""

927666506.m_KeyValue: "You've been flying the whole time. Have you really got the nerve to complain about being tired?"

927666507.m_KeyValue: "Find someone... Ah! He's Father's best friend. He must be coming to help Father!"

932637849.m_KeyValue: "(Cinematic Subtitles) My apologies. Did I wake you?"

932637856.m_KeyValue: "History is but the culmination of countless coincidences interwoven."

932637858.m_KeyValue: "But echoes of what has already transpired."

932637859.m_KeyValue: ""Prophecies are not tales of what's to come,""

932638872.m_KeyValue: ""Now, now, <style=""Highlight"">Noah Nevernight</style>, the silver-haired one, I'm just doing my job. The Church expects me to interrogate an extreme heretic like you very thoroughly.""

932638873.m_KeyValue: "So let's cut the formalities. What I really want to know is—"

932638881.m_KeyValue: ""If a beast takes on the memories of a human, is it still just a beast, or is it now human?""

932638883.m_KeyValue: ""Don't feel like answering? Or perhaps, you believe it's neither?""

932638884.m_KeyValue: ""Then tell me, when do you think a person truly dies?""

932638887.m_KeyValue: "Did you really drag me here just to ask these questions?"

932640027.m_KeyValue: ""The shining knights of the Church, now just food for the rats in this forsaken valley... how ironic.""

932640032.m_KeyValue: "But where did that man with the sinister eyebrows go? Did he fall to his death?"

932640033.m_KeyValue: ""Thank goodness this carriage held together, even after falling from such a height.""

932640036.m_KeyValue: ""I made a promise to <style=""Highlight"">Ressa</style>... I will return, no matter what...""

932640037.m_KeyValue: "I... can't die in a place like this. I made... a promise..."

932640038.m_KeyValue: ""Argh! Damn, why is it acting up now...""

932640039.m_KeyValue: "Luckily the rain stopped. Now is my chance to escape while the path is visible."

932642204.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of which, has Starfall Valley always been covered by this bloodlike mist?""

932642208.m_KeyValue: "I'm indebted to the Bathory family for accepting me when I had nowhere to go. I'm still learning the full extent of my powers."

932642209.m_KeyValue: "I'm really tempted to sink my 'mundane' fangs into your neck right now!"

932642212.m_KeyValue: ""She temporarily reversed the flow of time back there, didn't she? Do all members of your family possess such incredible power?""

932642214.m_KeyValue: "I see. I guess some only have mundane powers like turning into a bat."

932642215.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona arrived only a few years ago, and she also holds a special place within our family.""

932643229.m_KeyValue: ""I see. No one can hurt me, and I won't be forgotten there...""

932643232.m_KeyValue: ""If the Blood Beast devours you, it could lead to a cataclysmic evolution. You two must be careful!""

932643234.m_KeyValue: "Is it trying to talk to us?"

932643237.m_KeyValue: "Just now... I heard cries of sorrow... but also something calling to me..."

932643238.m_KeyValue: "You heard it too? Like a myriad of echoing thoughts... that's the Black Blood yearning for all life to be one..."

932643239.m_KeyValue: "Both of you are exceptional Moonblessed with unique Black Blood."

932644382.m_KeyValue: ""...I'll go with you, but let them live.""

932644383.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, she's always been following in my shadow. What would she see if she was to stand beside me?""

932644384.m_KeyValue: "What about Setti? What was her crime? She was your subordinate! She looked up to you!"

932644385.m_KeyValue: ""All your suffering will be cleansed in fire. As for breaking that promise, I will go atone on your behalf.""

932644386.m_KeyValue: ""I admire your willpower, but you cannot resist the Black Blood much longer. Let me help you.""

932644387.m_KeyValue: ""It's such a shame, my silver-haired friend. Even if you are a special type with a unique heart...""

932644388.m_KeyValue: ""This is the power of a Bell Ringer, the Church's strongest...""

932644389.m_KeyValue: "Can a human really wield this kind of power? It's like trying to fight fire itself."

932645408.m_KeyValue: ""The great heretic, Noah Nevernight, ""The Silver Demon,"" defied destiny and desecrated the world's natural order. He was burned at the stake in the autumn of 1353.""

932645411.m_KeyValue: ""May you find peace adrift in the river of time, and find solace in God's embrace.""

932645415.m_KeyValue: "No matter what... you will live on."

932895612.m_KeyValue: ""I deliberately exposed my whereabouts to the lady of the Bathory family, and allowed her to take your blood, granting you new life.""

932895614.m_KeyValue: "I imagine the letter's contents are related to your promise."

932895615.m_KeyValue: ""And now, just like before, you're quietly waiting for the opportunity to start the war.""

988015395.m_KeyValue: ""You know… for someone with such a sharp memory, recalling every detail, you sure keep getting that poor sailor's name wrong. That's on purpose, isn't it?""

988015455.m_KeyValue: ""Noah… are you truly a Bloodborn? Do you mean to devour me, so you can keep all this food to yourself?""

988015485.m_KeyValue: "Why did everyone begin respecting you so quickly? Why did he trust you so much?!"

1035069688.m_KeyValue: ""I hate raw fish! And whether you're naming your food or devouring your own pets—either way, it's unnatural!""

1102877923.m_KeyValue: "The older one must be in charge of this route. Good. I'll take his form next."

1102881121.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, my lord… though, would that not be… rather severe?""

1103046123.m_KeyValue: "That's why my father barely let me go anywhere."

1103046124.m_KeyValue: ""Tidewisp may wither once plucked, but the promises it holds will endure forever.""

1103046125.m_KeyValue: "My friend always says I'm a great swimmer."

1103447276.m_KeyValue: ""Your name is Noah Nevernight, a heretic branded by the Church, who was burned at the stake two days ago.""

1103447277.m_KeyValue: "Please take the memory of this deceased and use the Embrace to create a Blood Vassal that will fight for our cause."

1103447278.m_KeyValue: ""I understand. No matter what, I must live on. If this will help restore my strength and memories, then I'll drink it.""

1103447279.m_KeyValue: "I only remember Starfall Valley... What did you do to me? Was it that vampire freak? Where is she?"

1104187473.m_KeyValue: "Don't give me that—you're just trying to avoid the trouble."

1104187475.m_KeyValue: "He dropped it off right before he vanished."

1104187476.m_KeyValue: "Silver hair. Crimson eyes... What did he say to you?"

1112699204.m_KeyValue: ""Though the handwriting is very sloppy, like by a madman as you said, it's undoubtedly an ancient chant.""

1112699206.m_KeyValue: "How could that be! Why would they do this? They're the family's heroes! Why treat them like this?!"

1112699207.m_KeyValue: "Although father rarely speaks of his own matters... I know very well that the duty of a Gravekeeper is to prevent the bad things within from escaping!"

1112699209.m_KeyValue: "This m-many is just too much. And I can't stand bugs. Doesn't this creep you out?"

1112699236.m_KeyValue: "What should I do? Should I try to escape? Like all those other times..."

1112699238.m_KeyValue: "It's hard to imagine how dangerous the Seed of Calamity will become if it encountered a special Black Blood..."

1112699270.m_KeyValue: ""Not in particular. As long as there's no sunlight here, it's all the same to me.""

1112699271.m_KeyValue: "Just how strong and resilient were the previous Gravekeepers to be able to suppress this?"

1112699300.m_KeyValue: "I won't hesitate anymore. I'll go save him by myself!"

1112699301.m_KeyValue: "Are you saying that Noah's consciousness and memories are being invaded by Sheila?! Then wouldn't that mean..."

1112699302.m_KeyValue: ""They're probably parasites that feed off the Blood of Calamity... Fortunately, they haven't hatched yet.""

1112699303.m_KeyValue: "Why... Why are they so obsessed with Noah's blood? What exactly are they trying to do?"

1112699333.m_KeyValue: "Hey! You're really not going to explain anything to us?!"

1112699336.m_KeyValue: ""Even though I didn't cry when father died, or when Clive disappeared, I'm crying here of all places...""

1112699337.m_KeyValue: ""Who knew in the depths of this forsaken place, the heart of the plague, there would be such a beautiful sight...""

1112699339.m_KeyValue: "They're using the Calamity's corpse as their nest!? That's how the Black Blood..."

1112699360.m_KeyValue: ""There's no point hiding it any longer. Yes, Hati was born on this day. The one you know is twenty today...""

1112699361.m_KeyValue: ""Clive, I promise you—if our timelines converge once more, if our paths are destined to meet again...""

1112699364.m_KeyValue: "The Black Blood connection is becoming unstable?"

1112699365.m_KeyValue: ""It's the Divine Body... Sensing the sealed one is missing, it has gone berserk.""

1112699366.m_KeyValue: "My Covenant can activate a state approaching the speed of light. I can get everyone out."

1112699367.m_KeyValue: ""No, Noah. What you must escape from is not this place, but this time.""

1112699369.m_KeyValue: ""So this is the world from the memories of those werewolves... No, from the Gravekeepers.""

1112699370.m_KeyValue: "I learned that this place is called the Other Side."

1113123736.m_KeyValue: ""Humanity yearns for change, yet fears its cost.""

1113125914.m_KeyValue: ""You're you, I'm me. It's only natural we see things differently.""

1113127069.m_KeyValue: "I'm not angry! I still trust your judgment."

1113128092.m_KeyValue: ""Hey! You're doing this deliberately, aren't you?""

1113129247.m_KeyValue: "Making decisions is never easy. Don't be so hard on yourself."

1113130270.m_KeyValue: "The 'Wheel of Fortune' has begun turning. Follow your intuition."

1114347335.m_KeyValue: "Kitty... why are you here? Didn't I put you on the ship?"

1114347367.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh, I'm so sorry, her future is tragic and full of pain—'""

1114347371.m_KeyValue: "There are no cards left in the box."

1114347372.m_KeyValue: "You can't defeat us... We are everywhere... We are endless... We are you—"

1114347398.m_KeyValue: ""You can't defy fate, you can't escape destiny. Esmeralda's divination—the curse, has never been broken. You, Jacintha Dalcarlo, are not the one who drew the Tarot that brings hope!""

1114347404.m_KeyValue: ""We pray here for Dracula's blessing, to bring rebirth and eternity to the world.""

1114347405.m_KeyValue: "I've done what I needed to do. Death is nothing to fear. You don't need to accompany me anymore for the final journey..."

1115070129.m_KeyValue: "I saw them licking the blood from Dalcarlo's wounds... Could they be attracted to blood?"

1120464511.m_KeyValue: ""Hati, I believe... Uncle Gadric isn't that kind of person.""

1120464512.m_KeyValue: ""What's wrong? Hati, do you know Sir Gadric too?""

1120464514.m_KeyValue: "...I'm not so dumb that I need a smelly bat to remind me. We don't have time to fret over this. Let's go find Father!"

1120464515.m_KeyValue: "There must be a way to save him! I can't... I don't want to see anyone else die in front of me..."

1120464516.m_KeyValue: ""You said you met Gadric, right? Do you know where he is now?""

1120464544.m_KeyValue: ""Please, stop. Don't say things like that.""

1120464545.m_KeyValue: ""No, she'll take us to the Ashen Garden. She just needs some time to say goodbye...""

1120464546.m_KeyValue: ""Why is there Wolfsbane here... Ah, could it be that Skoll brought it...""

1120464547.m_KeyValue: "I know... I know all of that."

1120464548.m_KeyValue: "This is... the ancient ballad of our Ganelon family!"

1120464576.m_KeyValue: "But I'm certain that the answers I seek are just beyond this door!"

1120464582.m_KeyValue: "Two children? Ah... You mean the Gravekeeper's two children?"

1123149959.m_KeyValue: "'Where thunder dwells'... Joan wields the power of lightning."

1123149960.m_KeyValue: "Move fast if you want to live!"

1123149963.m_KeyValue: "And can you guarantee a bonfire will rouse him?"

1123149964.m_KeyValue: ""The sun... of all things, the one thing that no longer rises.""

1123465383.m_KeyValue: "These are the monsters I saw during the last 'crossing'... Why are they here?"

1123465386.m_KeyValue: ""No, this isn't the time for that. Where are the guards?!""

1123649988.m_KeyValue: ""But either way, I won't lose. I am the proof of my father and mother's existence! Let me fight!""

1123650120.m_KeyValue: ""Excellent, with Jestel on our side, we're certain to make a smooth escape from this prison tower.""

1128688721.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Clan Hunt
<style=""InfoText"">Challenge bosses together with Clan Members.
Each round of Clan Hunt allows players to take on 5 different bosses simultaneously. Defeating them all advances you to the next round.
Boss levels will increase on select rounds, raising the difficulty.
Monsters DMG modifiers may vary across different stages.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Daily Hunt Attempts
<style=""InfoText"">Each Clan Member has 3 hunt attempts per day.
If other Clan Members defeat the boss while you are in battle, your attempt will not be consumed.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Boss Battle
<style=""InfoText"">Each Vassal of a Clan Member can only participate in one boss battle per day.
DMG dealt to the same boss by Clan Members is shared across the Clan.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ DMG Settlement
<style=""InfoText"">Non-summons cannot be defeated in battle, and DMG dealt to them accumulates towards the Total DMG for the current boss.
After battle, DMG dealt to bosses accumulates towards the Total DMG for the current Clan Hunt.
If DMG dealt exceeds the boss's remaining HP, only the HP is counted.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Ranking and Rewards
<style=""InfoText"">When Clan Members defeat a boss, rewards will be sent to all members via mail.
At the end of the Hunt Season, Clan rankings will be determined based on the Total DMG dealt by all members during this Clan Hunt.
Final Clan Hunt rewards will be sent via mail based on rankings.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Mock Hunt
<style=""InfoText"">You may enter a Mock Hunt with your boss of choice, which will not affect the actual boss.
Mock Hunt will not consume daily battle attempts.
Vassals in Mock Hunt are permitted multiple uses.""

1128688722.m_KeyValue:

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Equip Artifact
<style=""InfoText"">Each Vassal can equip only 1 Artifact, which provides the following effects:
• Enhances the 4 basic attributes.
• Provides up to 3 additional passive skills.
Each Artifact has a specific limit on the number of Vassals who can equip it, but Artifacts can be unequipped.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Artifact Development
<style=""InfoText"">Artifacts can be leveled up, which gives the following effects:
• Enhances basic attributes.
• Unlocks or upgrades an Artifact's passive skills.
• Increases the number of Vassals who can equip the Artifact.""
