1220014673.m_KeyValue: "I have no interest in the weak. Do with them as you please."

1220014674.m_KeyValue: ""I can only say, I'm sorry, truly...""

1221012635.m_KeyValue: "What... What does that vile creature plan to do?!"

1221012636.m_KeyValue: "This Blood Beast seems to be the culmination of a flesh fusion in this valley. How many lives has this giant consumed?"

1221012637.m_KeyValue: "It's been drawn to the strong scent of your Black Blood; its insatiable 'appetite' has been whetted."

1221012638.m_KeyValue: ""Be mindful not to expose your wounds, and never let it touch your blood!""

1221012639.m_KeyValue: "This thing's too tough. We can't keep this up..."

1221978537.m_KeyValue: "I can't just sit here and wait for death... I need to find a way out. If only I had something sharp..."

1221978539.m_KeyValue: ""What sets humans apart from animals is our use of 'tools,' but even animals know how to work together...""

1221978541.m_KeyValue: ""If the sirens take us away, we won't have to endure any more pain.""

1221978568.m_KeyValue: "Would you like us to safeguard your 'token of proof' for the selection?"

1221978569.m_KeyValue: ""It can only be father, it will only ever be father.""

1221978570.m_KeyValue: "You should have let him take over your business sooner."

1221978571.m_KeyValue: "Master’s judgment was right about you. You really are a good person."

1221978573.m_KeyValue: "What if I treat the audience to a special Joyce dance performance?"

1221978833.m_KeyValue: "Was it the lamb doll prize that kept Miss Aiona from leaving? I can still drink..."

1221978835.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, well, when it comes to money, he might be just as broke as I am… but if my master were here, he'd surely find a way.""

1221978836.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Savich, while your shirt is indeed one of a kind, the auction house recently acquired a batch of gold-threaded brocade. Perhaps you'd consider having a new one tailored from it?""

1221978838.m_KeyValue: "...He never told me about this! I must verify this with Master Van Helsing myself..."

1221978858.m_KeyValue: "You won't get away this time! Stop them!"

1221978864.m_KeyValue: ""Seven nobles decided to rebuild it, investing their wealth and effort to restore the isle to its former glory, making it what it is today. The isle's residents came to call them the Sapphire Isle Seven Sages.""

1221978865.m_KeyValue: ""The sun is quite intense here at the isle. Before heading into the water, be sure to apply the isle's exclusive sunscreen.""

1221978866.m_KeyValue: "Lady Ami's prepared 'attire' is truly a masterpiece."

1221978867.m_KeyValue: "Hmm... why the hesitation? I'm quite skilled at seeing beyond appearances—"

1221978868.m_KeyValue: ""This statue was salvaged by fishermen from the bay not long ago. Though it appears expensive, it's merely gold-plated. The appraiser named it 'Those Whom the Gods Would Destroy.'""

1221978869.m_KeyValue: ""Finally sobered up? Congratulations, we've reached the Return to the Moon final challenge—facing the siren.""

1221978871.m_KeyValue: "Well... um... this is a device developed for the Seven Sages Association's city promotion efforts... would you like to give it a try?"

1221978899.m_KeyValue: ""What could be so important at this hour... Let me just stabilize my vital signs first, then I'll go.""

1221978925.m_KeyValue: "<color=#c6ae80>Soli... Soli and even more Soli... being rich is such a bore.</color>"

1221978928.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed... this Mistbound Terror appears at night as well, hunting travelers on the island. It drains their blood and dismembers them. Several lone visitors have already disappeared mysteriously.""

1221978929.m_KeyValue: "This is getting more and more interesting."

1221978930.m_KeyValue: "But it's not entirely out of the question."

1221978932.m_KeyValue: ""The crispy Stargazer's Delight mingles with the ocean's freshness, while aged cheese stretches into beautiful, viscous arcs. The fish head soup with flatbread and canned shark are equally delightful, making it impossible to choose. I'll have another serving of both—""

1221978933.m_KeyValue: ""Silver-haired man? Ah, you must mean... the one with Miss Ami—Uhh... Oh, Mr. Nevernight!""

1221978934.m_KeyValue: "See? Now give us back our boss!"

1221978935.m_KeyValue: "All because he was trying to help me..."

1221978961.m_KeyValue: ""The victims remember the happiest moments of their lives before they drown, and with a blissful smile, they become stuck forever in the past...""

1221978965.m_KeyValue: ""Yeah, hard to believe how prosperous it's become, isn't it?""

1221978966.m_KeyValue: "That place... who's in charge of it now?"

1221978967.m_KeyValue: "But everyone who knew I was the lord's son should be dead by now..."

1221978991.m_KeyValue: "Sapphire Isle is quite dangerous at night. What brings you wandering to the auction house?"

1221978992.m_KeyValue: ""This is bad, really bad! I just defeated many monsters—they might be people infected with Black Blood! We need to report this—""

1221978993.m_KeyValue: "The 'Mistbound Terror' only targets people who threaten the Seven Sages... Could they be working for them?"

1221978994.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps all 'swords' just look similar by nature."

1221978995.m_KeyValue: "All the important stuff has been burned... only some useless scraps of paper left."

1221978997.m_KeyValue: "Many of the Sapphire Isle Auction House’s goods are shipped by sea—and those pirates are notorious for raiding their vessels."

1221978999.m_KeyValue: "So that fanatic has really got you completely brainwashed..."

1221979024.m_KeyValue: ""We have money, land, and slaves. We could achieve great things together.""

1221979025.m_KeyValue: ""Greed knows no bounds, especially for the wealthy.""

1221979026.m_KeyValue: ""I've only heard about them, oh, a dozen times or so a day since I got here.""

1221979028.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Ami, do we share such an instant connection?""

1221979030.m_KeyValue: "I can call them for you. Who are you looking for?"

1225030500.m_KeyValue: "Does the Church just recruit anything with two legs?"

1226318453.m_KeyValue: "Are you asking me? I don't know."

1226318454.m_KeyValue: "But why? Why would she take Death back instead of destroying him?"

1226318461.m_KeyValue: "That was not a request. It was an order."

1226318462.m_KeyValue: "I'm sorry... My Lady. But I haven't finished what I'm here for..."

1226318463.m_KeyValue: "I knew where you were long before you thought to flee."

1226318464.m_KeyValue: "If you hoped to delay me by hiding on Sunset Isle... You've misjudged."

1226318465.m_KeyValue: "So... you did hold me in such high regard after all?"

1226318467.m_KeyValue: "She can hear you when you call her that."

1226318468.m_KeyValue: ""That old woman... how dare she! Our Commander sacrificed herself, and she doesn't even care!""

1226319486.m_KeyValue: "I can't catch my breath all of a sudden... It's so... uncomfortable..."

1226319487.m_KeyValue: ""It's not just affecting Hati... I'm feeling it too, albeit to a lesser degree.""

1226319488.m_KeyValue: "Could it be... because of that black mist? Why does it feel so familiar..."

1226320631.m_KeyValue: ""Thibault. The most inscrutable of all Bell Ringers. Though a healer, she can make kings kneel with but a glance.""

1226320632.m_KeyValue: ""(sighing)... Withdraw your power. If the test subject is damaged, you will bear the consequences.""

1226320637.m_KeyValue: "I overheard a guard once say: He succeeded in refining a potion from a rare fungus... One that could suppress the Black Blood's effects."

1226320638.m_KeyValue: ""Each day, Albrecht drew material from us. To fuel his Black Blood research.""

1226320640.m_KeyValue: ""As my third student, you've mastered theory. Let us see how you perform in practice.""

1226320643.m_KeyValue: "I believe I made myself clear that no one is to enter without my permission."

1226321663.m_KeyValue: ""Come, show me just how strong your resolve is!""

1226322809.m_KeyValue: ""And this time, don't throw the blade away again.""

1226322813.m_KeyValue: ""We can't match her head-on, we need to find another way...""

1226322814.m_KeyValue: ""This is bad… If this keeps up, the Bell Ringer's going to wipe us out sooner or later!""

1226322816.m_KeyValue: "Wait… this black mist... Is it about to explode?!"

1226322817.m_KeyValue: ""You're wrong. It wasn't you who chose me, but I who chose you.""

1226322818.m_KeyValue: ""So, you're ready... to accept this power.""

1226322819.m_KeyValue: ""But, I hadn’t thought you so well-loved.""

1226323841.m_KeyValue: ""Now that your memories are back, is there any reason for you to stay on Sunset Isle?""

1226323842.m_KeyValue: "There's still one thing I must resolve."

1226323843.m_KeyValue: "The anomaly within the Divine Body... I believe you can all sense it to some extent."

1226323844.m_KeyValue: "Unless I destroy it... None of us will ever leave this place."

1226324987.m_KeyValue: ""If I can't even save my friends with this power, then I have no right to wield it.""

1226324989.m_KeyValue: ""Even though I've prepared for this, I don't know if I can really wield this power.""

1226324990.m_KeyValue: "Escape to where? The Divine Body will probably destroy the whole island before we can get away."

1226324991.m_KeyValue: ""Maybe this is a little late, but we must leave this place immediately.""

1226324993.m_KeyValue: "Even the Bell Ringers probably couldn't damage it..."

1226324994.m_KeyValue: "The Divine Body is essentially the remains of a god. It's not something that normal weapons can even scratch."

1226324995.m_KeyValue: "Is there no way to stop it?"

1226324996.m_KeyValue: "The Divine Body... I think it's trying to blow up early!"

1233487032.m_KeyValue: ""As expected of a Ganelon, you've inherited the family's inability to think quite well.""

1234089236.m_KeyValue: ""I spent the first half of my life on this island, and I've seen my share of 'longing'...""

1234089237.m_KeyValue: "Are you... no longer attached to this place?"

1234089240.m_KeyValue: "It seems the 'longing' between us has also fulfilled its purpose."

1234089242.m_KeyValue: "My Piera... you've already grown so much."

1234089243.m_KeyValue: "But grandmother... you haven't seen me grow up yet!"

1234089244.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps your mentor wanted to show you through their own actions what your predecessors may have proven: that life cannot truly overcome Death..."

1234089245.m_KeyValue: "Nor been able to defeat Death together."

1234089246.m_KeyValue: ""My my... It seems my granddaughter is even luckier than I am, meeting a better Noah in a better era during better times.""

1234089247.m_KeyValue: ""But you can also prove to them: as long as your heart beats and your blood flows, you have the power to choose how to 'live.'""

1235477403.m_KeyValue: "Oh? So should our relationship move to the next level?"

1236271369.m_KeyValue: "Don't let your guard down. These are no ordinary beasts... and they just set their sights on us."

1236272749.m_KeyValue: "Are you done rambling? Didn't you say you'd leave if we won? Or are you planning to go back on your word?"

1236275946.m_KeyValue: "Sister Aiona. And Noah... can I call you big brother?"

1236275947.m_KeyValue: "You can call me Aiona. This is Noah Nevernight."

1236275948.m_KeyValue: ""I-I know your name is Empousa! I heard them call you that, but I still don't know their names...""

1239921864.m_KeyValue: ""A mysterious forbidden ground lies deep within Starfall Valley, safeguarded by the Tempus Church and impenetrable to all. Some believe it to be the origin of the Black Blood disease, while others whisper of an unspeakable horror lurking within the sealed area—one capable of ending the world.""

1240560583.m_KeyValue: ""This is the end of time, the void of oblivion.""

1240560590.m_KeyValue: ""If we're asking them anything, our weapons will do the talking.""

1240560591.m_KeyValue: "Could your family also be researching clones?"

1240560593.m_KeyValue: "If a Bloodborn dries up... does it feel like hunger?"

1240560595.m_KeyValue: ""That's great! I wouldn't expect anything less from you, Aiona!""

1240560596.m_KeyValue: ""No, who you are doesn't matter... You're right, I've already lost so much...""

1240560597.m_KeyValue: "It's not working... Why isn't it working..."

1240560622.m_KeyValue: "That phoenix is the will of time. It devoured the Flames of War... and became it..."

1240560654.m_KeyValue: ""In the future, you'll surely break through this darkness...""

1240560656.m_KeyValue: "I don't want to give up on you all either."

1240560661.m_KeyValue: "It's so lively... I... I like it here."

1240560688.m_KeyValue: "(I couldn't hear the rest. Was it just my imagination...?)"

1243428656.m_KeyValue: "Three centuries after the full outbreak of the Black Blood disease."

1243433012.m_KeyValue: "Now that I think on it… perhaps she meant to show me where to go."

1245250356.m_KeyValue: "Now that we've wrapped up here… I've received a new case. Interested in joining me?"

1245250357.m_KeyValue: ""When he saw me, he yelled _$$Hilda_$$ and fainted.""

1248123224.m_KeyValue: "They say this desert has long been torn by war."

1248123225.m_KeyValue: ""I've no idea how to use the thing, yet here I am, hauling it up a mountain. What is the point of all this?""

1248673157.m_KeyValue: "Is this the future you and Joan were fighting for?"

1248673158.m_KeyValue: ""But he's also the last survivor of his batch—and Joan's Vice-Commander, no less. He can handle it.""

1248674177.m_KeyValue: "Wait... where's the stupid bat? I don't see her anywhere!"

1248674179.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Ami, is it? Tell me—where is it you wish you were most right now?""

1248674180.m_KeyValue: "This inherited strength... surpasses all I imagined."

1248674181.m_KeyValue: "Think they ran into trouble on the way?"

1248674182.m_KeyValue: "No matter how many times they're reborn..."

1251768061.m_KeyValue: "The signal... remember the signal I told you before—!"

1251768069.m_KeyValue: "And this is what death feels like? Well... it's not as frightening as I imagined."

1251768070.m_KeyValue: "I only remember a piercing pain... then... peace... So... I am a spirit now?"

1251768071.m_KeyValue: "While we still have the chance... there are things... I must tell you..."

1251768073.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn, you've always been such a tough child. I never doubted you could overcome any hardship...""

1251768075.m_KeyValue: ""Child... when something feels wrong, when danger creeps in... Say 'no,' and stand your ground.""

1251768076.m_KeyValue: ""Your problem is... you endure too much, always trying to carry it all alone.""

1251769085.m_KeyValue: "Hehe... looks like your guide has deceived you..."

1251769086.m_KeyValue: "The Ritual Chamber is tucked high in secrecy and guarded like a fortress… Do you believe you can reach it? Even if you do… it will already be too late."

1251769093.m_KeyValue: ""He will only bring deeper darkness and more death. Not peace, but complete destruction.""

1251769095.m_KeyValue: "What you say... seems to make sense... I'll let you pass... but... but..."

1251769097.m_KeyValue: ""This is the deepest of the Timeworn Mausoleum's east wing—but the Ritual Chamber lies atop the west wing, far across the castle.""

1251769099.m_KeyValue: "Impossible. I remember clearly—the Bathory Divine Body is deep underground. How could it be atop?"

1251769100.m_KeyValue: ""I remember too. Every ritual night, the elders would come to the mausoleum and descend to the lower levels...""

1251770239.m_KeyValue: ""We can't reach the battlefield before the next bell. By then, the fires may have already reduced Mouret to ashes.""

1251770240.m_KeyValue: "It's Father... he had a backup plan. We must get to the battlefield now!"

1251770248.m_KeyValue: ""As the night retreats, the Bloodborn bound by flesh may cower. But my armor-forged form is eternal—I am invincible! Hahahaha!""

1251770251.m_KeyValue: ""Follow me to the future. Though I'm not yet a cartographer, Grandpa and I will keep you safe there.""

1251770252.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn, come with me. When your father returns... he'll imprison you again.""

1251770271.m_KeyValue: "Take your rest... A shattered home can't be restored in just one day..."

1251770272.m_KeyValue: ""No, I can't rest... Every day counts.""

1251770277.m_KeyValue: ""Cain is supposed to comfort me, yet why does his smile feel so... unsettling?""

1251770278.m_KeyValue: ""Our little master... Growing more charming by the day, wouldn't you agree?""

1251770279.m_KeyValue: ""If I had known it would end like this, I never would have agreed... I've failed to stop Quinn, and now Elder Tertius will come for me. Cain, help me!""

1251770280.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry. After this battle, his Soul Pyre has been greatly weakened... He is no longer what he used to be.""

1251770281.m_KeyValue: "Let us bide our time…until that fateful day—"

1251770282.m_KeyValue: "—The day when the true Lord of the Bloodborn awakens us."

1251770283.m_KeyValue: "Do you feel pain? Resentment? Or perhaps..."

1252488575.m_KeyValue: ""Should we go somewhere further next time? No, let's go to the mountains!""

1252488581.m_KeyValue: ""(Noah, it's time to act. Come on!)""

1252488582.m_KeyValue: "But I can't help feeling that you two have been in contact behind the scenes."

1253767571.m_KeyValue: ""...Could it be because after my death by fire, only the small amount of blood Empousa returned remains?""

1253767572.m_KeyValue: "You've overlooked something crucial—why should I trust someone who has been deceiving me by feigning death?"

1254762785.m_KeyValue: ""(Beneath the pure moonlight, Darcias begins to recite name after name.)""

1254762786.m_KeyValue: "Even if I forget again… looking at the painting might help me remember how I felt."

1254762788.m_KeyValue: "So this book is a memento from your parents...?"

1254762789.m_KeyValue: ""But I've often been called strange myself, so I don’t mind.""

1254917909.m_KeyValue: ""Esteemed Lord, Castle Bathory congratulates your awakening.""

1255674067.m_KeyValue: ""When the battle begins, the first time the HP of the allied unit on this tile falls below {1}, they immediately restore HP equal to <style=""Highlight"">{3}</style> of Yggdrasill's Max HP.""

1260411482.m_KeyValue: "The room in the middle with wine bottles scattered on the floor."

1260411483.m_KeyValue: "The room on the right with junk piled up at the entrance."

1260411484.m_KeyValue: "The room on the left with bloodstains on the door."

1262435080.m_KeyValue: "Would you stay and speak with me… until this war is over..."

1262435082.m_KeyValue: ""Ami is right. Back on Sunset Isle, even all of us combined couldn't defeat Acappella without Noah.""

1262435083.m_KeyValue: ""Not offspring in the usual sense, but yes… they share its blood.""

1262438282.m_KeyValue: "She must have gone to stop Agares—we need to hurry there too."

1262438283.m_KeyValue: "Didn't that old man promise to spare us? Why are there more and more of these things?"

1270515545.m_KeyValue: "Lamia Event Client Configuration Data Exceeds Limit"

1273916788.m_KeyValue: ""Little Noah, haven't you noticed? It's been so long since you last slept.""

1273916791.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, just as I told you—I'm watching your every move.""

1273916793.m_KeyValue: ""Hehehe... Feel that? Your strength slipping away? Even breathing feels like a chore now, doesn't it?""

1273916796.m_KeyValue: ""Did you really think I'd fall for that, little Noah?""

1273916798.m_KeyValue: ""You didn't actually think you could fool me with some random cookbook from the library, did you?""

1275939052.m_KeyValue: "美丽的奎因 (程序控制显示配置的文本)"

1277290344.m_KeyValue: "Deals True DMG equal to {1} of Max HP every {0} sec to enemy units on burning tiles."

1283281830.m_KeyValue: "You must sense it—Hati's own bloodline is constantly being assimilated by the Plague. It won't be long before my consciousness fades completely."

1283281831.m_KeyValue: "These are... words Hati wrote for me?"

1283281832.m_KeyValue: ""Wherever we are together is home... isn't it? Hati, you really have… grown.""

1283281833.m_KeyValue: ""You're bound by chains called _$$the past._$$ Though you've always held the key, you've never wanted to unlock them.""

1283998778.m_KeyValue: "You served as Joan's vice-commander. I'm the one who brought you home."

1284791186.m_KeyValue: ""_$$How someone treats their promises determines the color of their soul._$$ Despite how you may seem, I believe you're someone who honors their word.""

1284791187.m_KeyValue: ""Quoting my own words back to me—how like you. But knowing the kind of man you are, you didn't come all this way just for a reward, did you?""

1284791189.m_KeyValue: ""I didn't expect you to actually come to me, my silver-haired friend. Aren't you afraid I might go back on my word... and have you executed again?""

1284791190.m_KeyValue: ""_$$One cradle built from bone and breath, a corpse gave life, then slept in death._$$""

1284791191.m_KeyValue: ""You remember the first _$$tale,_$$ don't you? I was born among corpses on the battlefield, then taken in by a slave owner and raised in that manor.""

1284791192.m_KeyValue: "Brennholt. Everyone at that manor you sent me to bears that family name."

1284791193.m_KeyValue: "It's hard to imagine someone of your standing caring about a place so remote... Unless it's your hometown."

1284791196.m_KeyValue: ""All of us there were given the name Brennholt. We were slaves... but even so, we shared something close to peace.""

1284791197.m_KeyValue: "You mean all of you were slaves… and all called Brennholt?"

1285386954.m_KeyValue: "Interesting choice. Is there a matter you need me to handle?"

1285392200.m_KeyValue: ""Puppet: Make sure to invite Miss Bella to our next meeting as well, okay?""

1285398209.m_KeyValue: "A fine choice. I presume you're also one of the Moonblessed."

1285399230.m_KeyValue: "You can rest assured that this matter is in good hands."

1285401408.m_KeyValue: "I didn't know you were such a visionary."

1285402301.m_KeyValue: "Thanks for the recognition! Is there anything you need me to do?"

1285404479.m_KeyValue: "It would be an honor to assist you."

1285405500.m_KeyValue: ""Heh, are you trying to win my favor...?""

1288871433.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know about elegant, but the rest does seem to fit...""

1288871434.m_KeyValue: ""The stories say the Bloodborn are beautiful and elegant creatures, with silver hair, crimson eyes, and the ability to transform into animals. But they can't bear the sunlight...""

1292744058.m_KeyValue: ""When you're ready, follow me to the Hall of the Elders.""

1293833154.m_KeyValue: "Getting ambushed by all these werewolves and having to take care of Clive is a real handful."

1293836324.m_KeyValue: ""Though we've arrived in Mouret, we may still return to the Twilight Citadel at any time for a brief rest.""

1294067802.m_KeyValue: ""There was an outbreak of Black Blood in my town. Most of the people became infected, including me. They all suffered the same fate as those soldiers.""

1294068825.m_KeyValue: "But I don't think to disappear means to be forgotten."

1294068826.m_KeyValue: "The report said the carriage was attacked before it veered off the cliff. Was it this bat demon?!"

1294606004.m_KeyValue: ""Oh dear... as expected, the iron law of 'Justice' has locked the door.""

1294606233.m_KeyValue: "The key’s with that sleepyhead over there. Take him out quickly."

1294608015.m_KeyValue: ""Materials for Skill Enhancements can be obtained from [Timeworn Mausoleum]. Take a look, if that sounds enticing.""

1294608050.m_KeyValue: "Lady Empousa prepared a set of Equipment for you and your Vassals while you were asleep."

1294608081.m_KeyValue: "It looks like they have something to say."

1294608116.m_KeyValue: ""To help you adapt to the Black Blood coursing through your body, I took the liberty of making some preparations.""

1294608147.m_KeyValue: ""You shall venture into secret zones fraught with peril across the continent, enduring the trials in search of enlightenment and truth.""

1294608380.m_KeyValue: ""As you progress, you will be able to access more areas and unlock powerful features that will greatly assist both you and your Vassals.""

1294609139.m_KeyValue: "Jess and Setti aren't just lounging at the castle. They're there to oversee crucial family affairs."

1294611282.m_KeyValue: "Aren't you the heir here? How come you don't even know your way around your own castle?"

1295974155.m_KeyValue: ""Moonlight spilled through the window, casting soft patterns across the floor. Ami stood in the light, quiet and still—as if waiting for someone.""

1295974156.m_KeyValue: "And I couldn't leave like they did... Was it because my treasure had always been on the ship?"

1295974157.m_KeyValue: ""Or rather—from the moment you stepped aboard, you had already become their treasure.""

1300105179.m_KeyValue: ""I failed to stop Ganelon's advance. But their lord is dead, and the remnants of his force are already beginning to fall apart.""

1300105180.m_KeyValue: ""Useful, but only just... That sly old fox ensured his trap was sprung before death. Their forces, alongside the mutated werewolves, have already crossed the border to start the war.""

1300105181.m_KeyValue: ""Hahaha! Peace? Nothing but a pitiful veil the defeated pull over their cowardice. You claim to understand my hatred, but what do you know? The weak exist to be crushed, and those who retreat invite their own ruin!""

1300105182.m_KeyValue: ""But Father… even with her final breath, Mother prayed for peace between our clans. You loved her once. Surely… you remember what she stood for.""

1300105184.m_KeyValue: "I'll go on ahead—the situation won't wait. Join me after you two had your family talk."

1300105185.m_KeyValue: ""I spared your life only because of that trace of Crowley blood in you. For supply and shield, 'it'll make do.'""

1300105186.m_KeyValue: ""Just think about it—if I had truly loved your mother, would you be in your current situation?""

1300105187.m_KeyValue: "Precisely. Now... fulfill your role. This is your final chance—go and die on the battlefield."

1300105188.m_KeyValue: ""So that time in the arena, when I won and you called me over, patted my head and said, 'it'll make do'... that's what you meant...""

1300106203.m_KeyValue: "You're urging us to destroy your family's most important ritual and expose your kin to daylight? Why would a steward turn against his own people?"

1300106204.m_KeyValue: ""The Bloodborn isn't that weak. When the Long Night fades, daylight is nothing more than a trivial hindrance to us.""

1300106205.m_KeyValue: "The old master sought to invoke the Long Night to give the Bloodborn more freedom to move. It was understandable."

1300106206.m_KeyValue: ""After his passing, the Long Night became a weapon wielded by some elders to fulfill their selfish ambitions. Victory holds meaning, but stripped of dignity and honor, it descends into nothing more than savagery.""

1300106207.m_KeyValue: "Besides... it's not yet the time for the Bathory to claim its place in history through such means."

1300106208.m_KeyValue: ""I can't fully explain it, but there's a hint of mockery toward your father.""

1300106209.m_KeyValue: ""I have no right to interfere in family matters, but if this is your wish, my lady, I will do my utmost to help.""

1300106210.m_KeyValue: ""Ultimately, you need to find the ritual site yourself. As a steward, I can only offer answers and point you toward possible paths.""

1300106211.m_KeyValue: ""As every second passes, more innocent lives are lost. Please, don't let my presence stop you—go now and save whoever can still be saved.""

1300106212.m_KeyValue: ""Damn it… Quinn, don't you see? Cain is using your kindness and your desperation to serve his own twisted ends!""

1300114907.m_KeyValue: "At last... I've been waiting for you...!"

1300114915.m_KeyValue: "I read Grandfather's journal. There's a Divine Body hidden in the cave at Lupine Forest—it can cross realms."

1300114919.m_KeyValue: ""Damp, dark, stone walls dripping with moisture... This has to be the cave in Lupine Forest. Location confirmed.""

1300114920.m_KeyValue: "The fungi are still in their primitive state... unchanged in size. All signs match the conditions from 600 years ago."

1300114921.m_KeyValue: "Ha! Not bad at all. First temporal landing—spot on! Just what you'd expect from the future greatest cartographer in all of Minexus."

1300114922.m_KeyValue: "Now then... time to track down the 'young hero' and earn that license!"

1300116061.m_KeyValue: ""And where there's a glimmer... it can light the way home! You said her name was Elonora, right? I think... I think my father once mentioned someone by that name!""

1300116062.m_KeyValue: ""That alone means everything to me. Like a glimmer of light cutting through the dark—brief, but unbearably precious.""

1300116067.m_KeyValue: "That word feels... so distant from my life. Almost foreign."

1300116069.m_KeyValue: ""In our culture, Wolfsbane stands for protection. This is her way of keeping you safe!""

1300116070.m_KeyValue: ""According to Mr. Cain, it was done by my mother. He said she was from the Lupine Forest.""

1300116071.m_KeyValue: ""It's alright. You've done nothing wrong. Because of you, I now know its name... its meaning... that it hails from the Lupine Forest... and that it bears healing properties.""

1300116072.m_KeyValue: ""Y-you never met your mother...? I'm sorry! I didn't know, I didn't mean to—""

1300116073.m_KeyValue: "Because I've never met her. 'Elonora'—that name... and this little flower... That's all I have. That's all I have ever known of her."

1300116074.m_KeyValue: "But it a gift from your mother... Why do you sound... so sad?"

1300117085.m_KeyValue: ""So because we lacked clean water, you poisoned the very people you lived among?""

1300117086.m_KeyValue: "Careful... He's dangerous and he craves the power that comes with Black Blood..."

1300117092.m_KeyValue: ""Leila treated you like her own son. These villagers trusted you, never wronged you... Why, Johannes? Why would you do this?""

1300117093.m_KeyValue: ""You cared for Leila when she was sick. She died so suddenly... in such pain... Tell me, was it because you withheld her Wolfsbane?!""

1300117095.m_KeyValue: "You all say you're kind. But what has your kindness given us? Not even a sip of clean water!"

1300117096.m_KeyValue: "Look at the Bathorys! What's wrong with joining the Bloodborn? At least they were—"

1300117098.m_KeyValue: "I never accepted that old fraud Leila as my godmother! A Ganelon Gravekeeper? Guarding the border under Church orders? What a load of crap!"

1300118239.m_KeyValue: ""A witch! She's a witch! The last time I saw magic that twisted, it came from the Crowleys up north!""

1300118240.m_KeyValue: ""Before scheming to snatch him, did you truly fail to notice someone else standing behind him?""

1300118245.m_KeyValue: ""My, my. Not only do you lack judgment, it seems you also lack sight.""

1300118246.m_KeyValue: "That girl... something's wrong with her. Her eyes... they're glowing..."

1300118247.m_KeyValue: ""S-So... If he comes back, everything we've planned... will fall apart!""

1300118248.m_KeyValue: "Didn't Lord Ezareth say... that boy went missing in Bathory territory? That's our perfect pretext to act!"

1300118250.m_KeyValue: "Then what are you gawking at?! Grab him and bring him to Lord Ezareth!"

1300119263.m_KeyValue: ""I—I'm not… not gracious or thoughtful… I'm Agnes, by the way.""

1300119264.m_KeyValue: "But you… you're a Bloodborn. Why are you in Ganelon territory? And your clothes—they're unmistakably Bathory."

1300119268.m_KeyValue: ""(coughing) No, there's no need to apologize. Given the circumstances, your response was more than reasonable.""

1300119269.m_KeyValue: "If a stranger had approached me in the dark—especially after what you've been through—I might've reacted even more harshly."

1300119270.m_KeyValue: "Thank you for your understanding. You're so gracious and thoughtful."

1300119271.m_KeyValue: ""Jamie and I were chased all the way here. When this young lady appeared, I thought she was one of them… so I lashed out without thinking.""

1300119272.m_KeyValue: "(The books say Bloodborn have pale skin and fangs. I imagined monsters… but she's… beautiful.)"

1300119273.m_KeyValue: ""(She may seem kind, but most Bloodborn are masters at deceiving. Agnes, don't be fooled. She must be dangerous. You can't let her go…)""

1300120417.m_KeyValue: "I said you could see it. I never said I'd give it to you. It's all I have left of Elonora. I won't part with it."

1300120418.m_KeyValue: "What are you doing? Let me go!"

1300120419.m_KeyValue: "James can vouch for this—it was her favorite case. There's no doubt."

1300120420.m_KeyValue: "Fetch her case—the one she always carried."

1300120421.m_KeyValue: "Just because someone died in another territory—does that mean the people there were the ones who did it? Where's your proof?"

1300120422.m_KeyValue: ""If only she had stayed in Mouret... But no, she wanted to be an envoy. Had she not... she'd still be alive today...""

1300120423.m_KeyValue: ""I sent for her many times. The Bathorys agreed, then stalled. And before long, we received word. She was assassinated.""

1300120424.m_KeyValue: ""I was the fool who arranged her marriage into that cursed house. I thought... if she wed a Bathory, it might bring peace between us. Instead, I sent her to her death.""

1300120426.m_KeyValue: "But yes. Nora is dead. Slain by the Bathory."

1300121441.m_KeyValue: ""Now, at last, I have found the answer to my question—she showed me the meaning of her life through her pursuit.""

1300121442.m_KeyValue: "Before I find my own path... I want to complete the journey she began."

1300121443.m_KeyValue: "What kept me going through that darkness... was my longing for a mother I had never met..."

1300121444.m_KeyValue: ""If only Mother were here, could she tell me the true meaning of life?""

1300121445.m_KeyValue: "Wishing for my safety… that was her heart as a mother. But striving for peace—that was her conviction as a person."

1300121446.m_KeyValue: ""During my days in the dungeon, I would often sleep for days on end, sometimes wishing... I'd never wake up again...""

1300121447.m_KeyValue: ""Seeing all this, I think of Mother and the sacrifice she made. Peace between our families was her lifelong wish, and she gave everything for it. I think... I have to try.""

1300121448.m_KeyValue: "Look at the letter again. Your mother sealed her power into that little flower—doesn't that say everything about her true wish? That you live in peace and without fear."

1300121450.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn, have you truly thought this through? If we return now… that rusty armor will show you no mercy!""

1316295971.m_KeyValue: ""Now, select your Vassals and give it a try.""

1317587405.m_KeyValue: ""During rituals, Vassals offer precious resources as a tribute of their loyalty and reverence.""

1317587436.m_KeyValue: "Eliminate the souls first to truly suppress Baphomet's power."

1317587529.m_KeyValue: ""We are warriors, and we must fulfill our duty! We shall protect her!""

1317587595.m_KeyValue: "The Cluster Brain? It seems that defeating her is the key to winning this battle."

1318009416.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'reducing the severity of punishments for violating the Third Tenet: Unsanctioned Creation of Progeny'?"

1318011594.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'allocating funds to procure wool tapestries with superior light-blocking properties for curtains'?"

1318014665.m_KeyValue: "What are your views on 'imposing price controls to a certain degree on the shop'?"

1321630561.m_KeyValue: ""The power of these monsters is 'sandification', we're not sure if it's contagious, but...""

1321630562.m_KeyValue: "These vile creatures are actually born from the sand?!"

1321630564.m_KeyValue: "What's going on? How can there be assassins on our lands?!"

1321630593.m_KeyValue: "We don't have time to look for it!"

1321630595.m_KeyValue: ""No... you're a tempting demon, I won't succumb to you...""

1321630596.m_KeyValue: ""Wake up... Wake up, Gilrain... Wake up...""

1321630857.m_KeyValue: ""Please call me Sandra, my lady. After you completed the ritual, the lord—your Father—sent me to look after you.""

1321630860.m_KeyValue: ""I must ask Father about my eyes. Call for him—he'll come, I'm sure of it.""

1321630862.m_KeyValue: "Is this... some kind of Blood Beast?"

1321630889.m_KeyValue: "Have the assassins already infiltrated the castle? Father! Is Father alright?!"

1321630890.m_KeyValue: "My family was attacked?! When did this happen?"

1321630891.m_KeyValue: "Then you absolutely must try some! It's our local specialty."

1321630892.m_KeyValue: "...I'll take off the bandages and see for myself."

1321630922.m_KeyValue: "But how? Even Black Blood can't spread this fast..."

1321630924.m_KeyValue: "Since they're suspicious individuals... let's throw them in the dungeon and interrogate them thoroughly."

1321630959.m_KeyValue: ""Here again... Too late, it's already too late...""

1321630960.m_KeyValue: ""I will become a worthy vessel. Ancestors of the Alita family, let me return to the past once more!""

1321630989.m_KeyValue: ""I have lots and lots and lots of time to find all of you, one by one.""

1321630991.m_KeyValue: ""There isn't much time... however, the Alita family owes you nothing.""

1321631022.m_KeyValue: "This place... Is this where all the answers lie?"

1321631024.m_KeyValue: ""Even if I don't do it myself, you won't last much longer.""

1321631055.m_KeyValue: ""It feels like a part of my memory has been cut out, and we suddenly ended up here.""

1321631056.m_KeyValue: "Rushing in now would be futile. We need to find a way to restore our power first!"

1325007808.m_KeyValue: "Your composure makes it hard for me to believe you were just a lowly lifeform yesterday..."

1325007809.m_KeyValue: "Oh? So desperate that you're recruiting the church's lapdogs as Vassals..."

1325007810.m_KeyValue: ""This is my first time here too, I didn't expect this tower to be so tall...""

1325015994.m_KeyValue: ""It was Lady Empousa who revived you with her blood, so you now share a special connection.""

1325018931.m_KeyValue: "So this was all his scheme? Why go to such lengths? Who was he trying to fool? I was scared to death!"

1326063967.m_KeyValue: "You don't have to think so hard about it..."

1326592245.m_KeyValue: "One of the last two Brennholts in this world."

1326592247.m_KeyValue: ""War will stain the moon red. Scourges will devour the sacrifice. And then, everlasting night shall descend.""

1326592248.m_KeyValue: "Come. Return to this place. Welcome the night of blood. Ascend to the moon's embrace."

1326592249.m_KeyValue: "But know this: I always keep my promises. Without exception."

1326592250.m_KeyValue: ""Lady Empousa, you're injured. Please, let me heal you...""

1326592252.m_KeyValue: ""Stop wasting your energy, jellyfish girl! We're not here to fight the Bell Ringer—we need to find the Moonblessed in the sealed area!""

1326592254.m_KeyValue: ""And I want to learn from you... From Elder Jacintha, and from Cain... How to destroy the Divine Body. The true enemy of the Alita family.""

1330950539.m_KeyValue: "So we're heretics because of the Black Blood outbreak? They're going to slaughter us as an example?"

1330950544.m_KeyValue: "They... those beasts we fought were people we knew? How did this happen?"

1330950571.m_KeyValue: ""Silently guarding a vow made twenty years ago, all alone... You're quite the stubborn yet gentle man, aren't you, Clive?""

1330950572.m_KeyValue: ""After all, your life stopped that day—twenty years ago when the Black Blood contaminated the entire forbidden grounds.""

1330950573.m_KeyValue: ""I didn't notice at first, but there are so many... Did you plant these?""

1330950838.m_KeyValue: "Haha! I was stuck in a bad predicament and had no other choice. My sincerest apologies!"

1330950839.m_KeyValue: "I'm afraid I can't let you leave."

1330950868.m_KeyValue: "A knight never goes back on their word!"

1330950870.m_KeyValue: "Hati will have to wait. I cannot allow heretics like you to roam free."

1330950873.m_KeyValue: ""'If you can block my attack, I'll leave you be' is what he said.""

1330950874.m_KeyValue: "Ugh... This guy's not as simple as he looks..."

1330950899.m_KeyValue: "Home? Of the Moonblessed? And you're saying I'm also a Moonblessed...?"

1330950900.m_KeyValue: ""Geez, why does everyone talk in riddles...""

1330950901.m_KeyValue: "Aww... should we really be taking it this easy?"

1330950902.m_KeyValue: "Until we discovered the reason we were rejected by this world was because we never belonged here."

1330950903.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Hati, there's no need to be on edge.""

1330950905.m_KeyValue: ""I know, the Church has always supported our poor town. Why would they suddenly...""

1330950906.m_KeyValue: "D-Damn it... All the fighting today must have drained my strength..."

1330950932.m_KeyValue: "So you do know him. He was looking for you."

1330950935.m_KeyValue: ""Alright, alright! Stop ganging up on me! I get it, we have to help her to move forward!""

1330950937.m_KeyValue: ""Come to think of it, I just realized you're quite different from the Ganelon clan members I've known before...""

1330950938.m_KeyValue: ""Ironic, isn't it? The Bathory clan is down to just a few of us, while the Ganelons... Well, you've seen it. They're barely surviving in the shadows of the forest.""

1330950963.m_KeyValue: "At least he's safe now. That's what matters."

1330950964.m_KeyValue: "Well... I think I might know where the forbidden grounds are..."

1330950967.m_KeyValue: "What are you looking for in Mouret?"

1330950969.m_KeyValue: ""Dying by our hands might be less painful than facing the Bell Ringer, you know.""

1330950998.m_KeyValue: ""Moreover, because it forcibly suppresses the mutation symptoms, it's likely to accelerate the patient's death.""

1330950999.m_KeyValue: ""No, they look different. I'm afraid they might be even tougher than our previous enemies...""

1330951000.m_KeyValue: ""How did you know that, Noah? Have you been to Mouret before?""

1330951001.m_KeyValue: ""I... I believe in Father's words. Besides, Noah did save me. He's incredible!""

1330951027.m_KeyValue: "Why? We were just about to go look for Father..."

1330951030.m_KeyValue: "(panting) That was close... We're... we're saved... I can't believe we actually won."

1330951031.m_KeyValue: ""That's not true! Clive, you look exactly like Father. I'm the one people say was adopted...""

1330951032.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know what The Church wants him to protect, but I do know he's our family's guardian deity, our pride and joy.""

1330951033.m_KeyValue: "How much longer until we reach this Ashen Garden? Have some consideration for those of us who've been traveling all day."

1330951034.m_KeyValue: ""We ran into him in the Lupine Forest. But he was in a hurry to find someone, so he left quickly.""

1331124248.m_KeyValue: "Error with bonus items when claiming the purchased item."

1331124439.m_KeyValue: "Too many purchases. Please try again tomorrow."

1331270267.m_KeyValue: "A summon that performs Basic ATK. Only 3 can exist at the same time."

1335927760.m_KeyValue: ""Within my 'execution grounds,' I command the 'ignition point' of all things... Ah, I almost forgot...""

1335927761.m_KeyValue: ""You people of this era wouldn't know what an 'ignition point' is, would you? Well, just know this...""

1335927763.m_KeyValue: ""How frustrating. No one seems to take my words seriously. I will allow you to leave out of respect, but I am bound by duty and promise, to carry out Noah Nevernight's execution.""

1335927764.m_KeyValue: ""If you're prepared to challenge my resolve, I won't hesitate to forsake courtesy...""

1336180139.m_KeyValue: "Phew... I don't know whether it's good luck or bad that you saw right through me."

1336180142.m_KeyValue: "Looks like you've figured out why she didn't."

1338467006.m_KeyValue: "Season has ended. The score will not count for this round."

1339669517.m_KeyValue: "The following Vassals will receive the following attribute bonuses when clearing stages."

1340234285.m_KeyValue: ""As for you, I'll be waiting for you. When you finally emerge from this fog and see the truth, I'll be there, Noah.""

1341121968.m_KeyValue: "Go with them. My intuition tells me there's more to you than just being a heretic."

1341121969.m_KeyValue: "That sinister-looking man suddenly appeared with an army. He burned down our home and took me prisoner."

1342413624.m_KeyValue: ""We entered the valley from this road, but there was definitely a stone bridge here at that time...""

1342413626.m_KeyValue: ""(Cinematic Subtitles) Turn against the flow of time, and return what once was!""

1342414647.m_KeyValue: ""Well, it's a fitting place for him... Damnit! That disgusting thing bit me!""

1342420917.m_KeyValue: "Forgive me. I failed to return you to the time before you were infected with the Black Blood."

1346623187.m_KeyValue: ""Ever since the sun vanished, more people have been turning into those things...""

1346825755.m_KeyValue: ""Unlike the ocean, you couldn't see where it ended.""

1346825790.m_KeyValue: "The magnificent landscape there was completely different from Sapphire Isle."

1348196151.m_KeyValue:
"Every path is different; only you can choose the right one.
The spider comforted itself with these thoughts."

1348196153.m_KeyValue: "There's a carriage moving ahead. Should I take the leap and catch a ride?"

1348196154.m_KeyValue:
"'My abilities aren't as basic as they seem!'
The mechanical spider snickered as it hitched a ride."

1348196183.m_KeyValue:
""'The way of the spider is to always pursue a stronger self.'
In this moment, the mechanical spider became a hero.""

1348196184.m_KeyValue: ""A group of mechanical spiders surrounds a tree that has fallen in the middle of the road, waiting for a hero to come. Rev your engines and push the tree aside?""

1348196186.m_KeyValue:
""Waiting and waiting, waiting and waiting...
Our hero is going to appear, right?""

1353334239.m_KeyValue: ""She will not yield to resignation. Not in this brief, yet radiant life.""

1353334243.m_KeyValue: "No. They've gone quiet. After I helped that child find his comrades… those restless voices faded away."

1353334244.m_KeyValue: ""That thought… It terrified me. But the more I fear, the clearer their voices get.""

1356388679.m_KeyValue: ""Get ready to be steamed, stirred, braised, and fried, you crabs.""

1356701857.m_KeyValue: ""High-quality equipment can also be Enhanced. As we progress, try acquiring more equipment.""

1357732220.m_KeyValue: ""(Cinematic Subtitles) And is that person you, Cain?""

1357732221.m_KeyValue: ""I won't let you die at someone else's hand, Empousa... my dear sister.""

1357732222.m_KeyValue: ""Moonblessed, since I cannot obtain your flesh, it is you who must devour my memories instead.""

1357732223.m_KeyValue: ""I've long lost my body, and you've lost that frightening aura you once had. Time has robbed us of so much...""

1357740407.m_KeyValue: "Shhh—I just heard something... the wind is telling me there's someone waiting to ambush us."

1362467802.m_KeyValue: ""Listen, Noah! We've uncovered something terrifying about Empousa!""

1362467804.m_KeyValue: "Follow the wind and grant them salvation!"

1362467805.m_KeyValue: "Then allow me to leave an impression!"

1364641572.m_KeyValue: ""The more Vassals deployed, the faster the Bloodsoul Recovery, which means you can use Ultimates more frequently in battles.""

1366470622.m_KeyValue: "As expected from someone who caught my eye!"

1369052359.m_KeyValue: "This guy... isn't he a bit too strong?"

1369652241.m_KeyValue: "Tap on the Regeneration Clock to alter the growth of the tree."

1373353632.m_KeyValue: "What are you saying? You met me centuries ago? I was still human just yesterday..."

1378127418.m_KeyValue:
"'Protecting yourself also takes courage—don't bear too much weight for others.'
This statement is true indeed."

1378127447.m_KeyValue:
""'No spider is perfect; what matters is moving forward.'
Even after a hard fall, this spider remains optimistic. Right?""

1380640217.m_KeyValue:

1380640246.m_KeyValue:

1380640247.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> A ring forged from the blood of Agares the Beguiler, imbued with the primal power of War.

1380640248.m_KeyValue:

As he opens his eyes once more, wings grew from his spine, and his hunger drove him to gorge on entrails. Alas, he was never a hero, but a vulture who drank the blood of heroic memories.""

1380640605.m_KeyValue: ""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> The Wolfsbane plant means something special to the Clive family.The ballad goes: _$$Wolfsbane blooms beneath the moon's soft grace; The promised home waits beyond the sky's embrace._$$""

1381207083.m_KeyValue: ""Only glittering shards in the snow, scattered through the tents. Were they frozen breath? Or was that all that remained of them?""

1381207084.m_KeyValue: ""The day everything froze, I wasn't even here. I was off at a merchant guild in another oasis, negotiating supplies.""

1382498738.m_KeyValue: "I don't know... I only just came to myself."

1382498739.m_KeyValue: ""When we arrived, you three were lying there in a neat little row. No trace of any dark figure.""

1383270158.m_KeyValue: ""I'm not that good with a sword, but it's better than nothing.""

1383548759.m_KeyValue: "Vile silver-haired demon! The great Aeon will curse your fate..."

1383548760.m_KeyValue: ""I'm not sure what you're talking about, my disease made my hair...""

1384657429.m_KeyValue: "Timed Vassals. Unavailable after the event ends."

1385756362.m_KeyValue: "Quite an effective one—it definitely caught the eye of the lady next to me."

1394969010.m_KeyValue: "These Bloodborn... were they drawn here by that sound!?"

1400605649.m_KeyValue: ""You didn't just look. You commented on everything, too.""

1400605678.m_KeyValue: ""When we talked about the drawings… I don't know why, but I suddenly wanted it back.""

1403678673.m_KeyValue: ""The final price on your order may vary due to your region's exchange rate, payment method, or limited-time promotions.""

1404786387.m_KeyValue: "(Cinematic Subtitles) The thread of fate has been set in motion once more."

1404786389.m_KeyValue: ""We have bigger problems! If we keep falling, we'll be joining him!""

1404786390.m_KeyValue: ""Who am I? Where did I come from? Where will I go? After all this time, I've yet to find any answers.""

1405974959.m_KeyValue: "Attack with everything you have! His soul is about to expire!"

1406086229.m_KeyValue: ""And you, a mere proxy elder, have no right to lecture me!""

1408897421.m_KeyValue: "Let me deal with the enemies that are lined up perpendicular to me."

1411743939.m_KeyValue: ""The one lying on the ground must be No. 79, who hasn't thought of a name yet, correct?""

1411743940.m_KeyValue: ""It's on you, isn't it? You, the fifth elder of this rotten family!""

1411743942.m_KeyValue: "Why... It can't be... This can't be happening..."

1411743969.m_KeyValue: "It's those monsters we encountered earlier. They weren't destroyed after all..."

1411743970.m_KeyValue: "Why... did so many of our sisters die along the way?"

1411743973.m_KeyValue: "Take that card and come to the Astrolabe. Perhaps you'll find the answers you seek."

1411743996.m_KeyValue: "Welcome to the second round of the 'Moonfall Games'—"

1411744002.m_KeyValue: "It's time for you to remember who you truly are."

1411744003.m_KeyValue: ""I told you, the Astrolabe can give you the answers you seek.""

1411744004.m_KeyValue: "The moon is not so gentle. The blood that it sheds is not something that anyone can bear."

1411744005.m_KeyValue: "The moon? Guess we have another lost fool."

1411744007.m_KeyValue: ""But it's all in vain. As long as you exist, this farce will never end.""

1412343616.m_KeyValue: "But her son was killed taking an arrow meant for me."

1412343617.m_KeyValue: ""If two Noah Nevernights were to appear in the same place, it would likely lead to some irreversible consequences.""

1415570723.m_KeyValue: ""Each time your Insight LV. increases, you'll gain rewards.""

1415570758.m_KeyValue: ""Do be careful, though—you may only select a limited number at a time. And if you get greedy,.. Well, foreign memories may corrupt your mind.""

1415570824.m_KeyValue: ""However, within these rifts you shall not find phantoms, but beasts.""

1415570855.m_KeyValue: ""To prevent phantoms sneaking through while we're distracted, we must remain near the rift at all times. Do not move away from it.""

1425092212.m_KeyValue: "You... we're all members of the Church! We shouldn't be crossing swords!"

1425092213.m_KeyValue: "What if we've had it backwards all this time? What if Black Blood is our true ancestral origin...?"

1425092215.m_KeyValue: ""You clearly harbor deep resentment toward the Church and Bell Ringers. Though I'd prefer to understand the reason behind it, there's something I must know first:""

1425095414.m_KeyValue: "To be chosen by the Saint is a precious honor. You truly are someone special."

1425095415.m_KeyValue: ""Agares Brennholt, usurping chancellor of the Carrelle family, your sins weigh too heavily upon you.""

1427693422.m_KeyValue: "Is this the future you and Joan were fighting for?"

1431017627.m_KeyValue: "Miss Alita… this will hurt—both body and soul..."

1431880983.m_KeyValue: "The pool's sequence reward cannot be claimed."

1436705354.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Investigate the Church's Motives Behind Mining Meteorites Despite Risks'..."

1436705356.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Allowing Vassals to Use Alchemical Facilities Independently'..."

1436705357.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Sending Vassals to Explore the Other Side Island Despite Risks'..."

1436705358.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Collecting Highly Contested Future Artifacts Despite Significant Risks'..."

1436705368.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Continuing to Support Cain's Unknown Alchemical Research'..."

1436705369.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Reducing the Punishment for Violating the Third Tenet Unsanctioned Creation of Progeny'..."

1437518986.m_KeyValue: ""Yeah, she's already remembered who she is... But what about me? Who am I? Am I still the same person?""

1437518987.m_KeyValue: ""But we will most likely have to get her out by force, which is why we need to expand our Power by using the <style=""Highlight"">Embrace</style>. Then Mr. Moonblessed can help us save our lady.""

1438033861.m_KeyValue: "Clear any [Tomb of the Fallen] stage 3 times."

1438547054.m_KeyValue: "Surrounded on both sides? Maintain formation and keep protecting Empousa! That's our main priority."

1438655790.m_KeyValue: ""When the battle begins, Vassals on this tile gain Unnatural Chill: Gain 20% ATK and DEF, and become immune to status effects.""

1454736992.m_KeyValue: ""From now on, you'll be in control of your own path. Though certain to encounter many obstacles, Blood Moon may help alleviate your plight.""

1454736993.m_KeyValue: "The moon phases have completed. It is time to let the Blood Moon rise."

1454736994.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, as a Bloodborn, you must learn to wield the power of the Blood Moon.""

1454736995.m_KeyValue: ""Let me fight alongside you. This way, we'll have three different Moon Phases.""

1454736996.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, now that you've become one of the Bloodborn, you must learn to harness the power of the blood moon.""

1455486111.m_KeyValue: ""Okay, okay! I'll change my stance, just stop staring at me.""

1455488025.m_KeyValue: "Go on... a touch of suffering is all it takes to invite grace."

1455489049.m_KeyValue: "Don't get the wrong idea. I'm simply discussing things objectively."

1455491224.m_KeyValue: ""While I can't fully grasp your decision, it has inspired me. Thank you for that!""

1455493138.m_KeyValue: ""I'll leave it up to you. After all, the 'future' rests in your hands...""

1455494295.m_KeyValue: "Is this sense of illuminating each other also an aspect of life's significance?"

1455495316.m_KeyValue: ""I apologize, my mind wandered for a moment...""

1455498387.m_KeyValue: ""Well then, perhaps you really can carve out a different path...""

1459276481.m_KeyValue: "It's like leaving a little surprise for the future."

1459276482.m_KeyValue: "You never hid anything in a tree before?"

1459276483.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, what was that that fell from the tree?""

1459276484.m_KeyValue: ""Fresh daisies, sunflowers, and balloon flowers! Would you like a bouquet? They make wonderful gifts for friends or lovers!""

1459276486.m_KeyValue: "Have you forgotten many things from your past too?"

1459676111.m_KeyValue: "Four Bell Ringers... What kind of enemy calls for this level of force?"

1459676112.m_KeyValue: "What? You as Vice-Commander? Did... something happen to Piera?"

1459677135.m_KeyValue: "Skoll! You have to hang in there!"

1459677136.m_KeyValue: "Were they drawn here by our arguing?"

1460967764.m_KeyValue: "This isn't something you get to decide."

1460967765.m_KeyValue: "We were wondering what kind of threat warranted four Vice-Commanders."

1460967766.m_KeyValue: "Heh. A _$$person_$$ as numb as you could never grasp true pleasure."

1460967767.m_KeyValue: ""Compared to the so-called Desert Queen who became a Bell Ringer, you're the real traitors.""

1460968788.m_KeyValue: ""Each time, I die not long after becoming someone new…""

1460968790.m_KeyValue: ""Wait... If I handle this, I might get a better grasp of Cain's power.""

1460968791.m_KeyValue: "To the Hall of the Elders… to play my part in the spectacle."

1462277317.m_KeyValue: ""Easy, Colossus. We need them alive. Information comes first.""

1462277319.m_KeyValue: "You're right. We're working with far too few pieces of the puzzle."

1466391054.m_KeyValue: "Adorn the end of your lives with this crimson bouquet!"

1466391055.m_KeyValue: ""...It is indeed unfair. They can resurrect at will, but we cannot.""

1466391063.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry, but I can't bring myself to hurt my former comrades, even in this state...""

1466391064.m_KeyValue: ""But if you need someone to cover you, leave it to me!""

1466391065.m_KeyValue: ""In that case, I will hold them off at the front.""

1466391066.m_KeyValue: ""Well, that's reassuring. Now I can unleash my power without any worries...""

1466391067.m_KeyValue: ""What?! Is there an even higher level of ""Blood""?""

1466391068.m_KeyValue: "Did you hold back during our previous battle? I don't know whether to be relieved or annoyed."

1466391069.m_KeyValue: "Just stay by my side and root for me."

1473438033.m_KeyValue: ""You found the root of the lie. Of course she knew. And yet, she still chose me. The real question is—why?""

1473438034.m_KeyValue: "Please. Your true form is fine too."

1473438035.m_KeyValue: "...Earlier than expected. I thought we'd have to wait until the full moon tomorrow night."

1473438036.m_KeyValue: ""Soon, we shall be reunited—my kindred, bound by the Blood of Dracula.""

1473438037.m_KeyValue: ""Cruel, but necessary for a new age to begin.""

1473441236.m_KeyValue: "I almost forgot you were still here."

1473441237.m_KeyValue: "No wonder Agares was able to plan these operations while evading the Church's watchful eyes all these years."

1475009437.m_KeyValue: "But... I made a promise to return _$$home_$$ alive!"

1492196076.m_KeyValue: ""The village's best doctor claimed she had found a way to fight against Death, and needed everyone's help, but—""

1492196077.m_KeyValue: ""Grandmother said that since ancient times, our family has resided on this isolated island alongside the Calamity known as Death.""

1492196078.m_KeyValue: "That's all I know... The story from 66 years ago that my grandmother told me..."

1492196079.m_KeyValue: ""But that was from 66 years ago... It's not surprising that you haven't heard about it, Noah...""

1492196080.m_KeyValue: ""The terrifying appearance, the inescapable whispers... just like the previous 'Calamities' I've encountered...""

1492196082.m_KeyValue: "I told you these tricks won't work against... Wha?!"

1492196083.m_KeyValue: "Think of happy thoughts! Remember your grandmother!"

1492196107.m_KeyValue: ""What's going on... Piera, why'd you hit me?""

1492196108.m_KeyValue: "I have. One of them said she was heading to the village and would wait for you there."

1492196110.m_KeyValue: "Piera... you contacted the Church? When did you...?"

1492196111.m_KeyValue: ""...Hah, look at you now... What a sorry sight...""

1492196372.m_KeyValue: "Seems I was right. They all bear markings on their bodies—some kind of symbol."

1492196402.m_KeyValue: "But they were trying to kill us moments ago."

1492196404.m_KeyValue: "...'The location of the next Moonblessed and the home of the silver-haired heretic lie toward the sunset.' That's what Cain said."

1492196409.m_KeyValue: "Those crabs have the advantage on this coastal terrain. Let's head inland first. There's also something I want to check on the way."

1492196437.m_KeyValue: "I'm just... used to being alone. I don't know what to say..."

1492196441.m_KeyValue: "Then that figure I saw... was it my imagination?"

1492196466.m_KeyValue: "She appeared... not long after you left..."

1492196467.m_KeyValue: ""Hah... Hahaha... Oh, you'll remember eventually. You'll remember everything.""

1492196469.m_KeyValue: ""If we get separated again, this gesture will be our way of telling it's the real us.""

1492196472.m_KeyValue: ""You doomed us all! You should be the one rotting in the ground, Noah Nevernight!""

1492196498.m_KeyValue: "I thought they were just wild beasts."

1492196499.m_KeyValue: ""Look, if you come across creatures like the ones we just dispatched, don't waste your time on them.""

1492196504.m_KeyValue: ""For the past 66 years, Death has been sealed beneath the cathedral. It's impossible for him to escape on his own.""

1492196505.m_KeyValue: ""That is the will of Aeon, perhaps?""

1492196532.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, I need to know—what exactly is inside that coffin you're carrying?""

1492196533.m_KeyValue: ""But that's not necessarily a bad thing, right, Noah? It means you've come to the right place... This is your 'homeland'—""

1492196534.m_KeyValue: ""How utterly despicable, Nevernight. You think you can wash away all your sins just by pretending to not remember?""

1492196535.m_KeyValue: "'Behind every frightful specter lies a soul that someone else misses dearly.'"

1492196536.m_KeyValue: ""O-Oh, I see... Noah, you're... really perceptive, aren't you...""

1492196560.m_KeyValue: ""Well, it's just one of many theories. I have no means to prove it though.""

1492196562.m_KeyValue: "We're being attacked by Blood Beasts. You can't see them?"

1492196563.m_KeyValue: ""Memories? But I don't have any memories of them. Wait, does that mean...""

1492196564.m_KeyValue: ""I want so badly to tell Grandmother, to tell everyone on the island... 'I'm Piera... I've come home today...'""

1492196565.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, are you... the type to get hung up on these philosophical questions?""

1492196566.m_KeyValue: ""It seems you've met the Gravekeepers from other families... haven't you, Noah...?""

1492196567.m_KeyValue: ""No, that's also one of the reasons. I nearly lost my life, and more importantly, I lost all my memories...""

1492196569.m_KeyValue: "That's because I've experienced this type of phenomenon twice before."

1492813908.m_KeyValue: "Only I remain absolutely loyal to the Bathory family!"

1492813910.m_KeyValue: ""The promised home on the far side of the moon, or the descent of the Blood Moon? Which dream is the real one?""

1492813940.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, I actually have a name. When I first awoke, I gave myself a beautiful name...""

1492813941.m_KeyValue: ""I merely said these cards aren't what you're looking for. I never said it wasn't in my possession, did I?""

1492813942.m_KeyValue: ""The reversed 'Moon'... unease and deception. As if you're flying towards the dream you seek—the far side of the moon. Beautiful, but is it truly real?""

1492813943.m_KeyValue: "I've thought it through. Now is not the time."

1492814204.m_KeyValue: ""No past, no future, not even a name. We are the forgotten ones, known only by a number.""

1492814205.m_KeyValue: "I'm No. 66! You got both digits wrong! And who are you calling a fool?!"

1492814206.m_KeyValue: ""Heh, you can't fool me. You remembered that No. 18 escaped three days ago, and you deliberately misnumbered No. 34, who was the first to die...""

1492814207.m_KeyValue: "Why are you getting all fired up? Remember our goal is to get out of here."

1492814237.m_KeyValue: "And with that prophetic image on the card... It feels like someone's watching our every move."

1492814239.m_KeyValue: "Is it it bad to say that it's fortunate we didn't team up with her?"

1492814268.m_KeyValue: "I wonder how they will surprise us next. I can't wait."

1492814270.m_KeyValue: ""But aren't you curious? There are so many things you don't know about yourself, waiting to be discovered.""

1492814300.m_KeyValue: ""You have a point. Okay, two friends... I will count that as 10 million Soli. Take this card and be on your way.""

1492814301.m_KeyValue: "Kill me instead! Don't you dare harm her!"

1492814303.m_KeyValue: ""Shame... In the end, only one can remain. Or perhaps, none at all.""

1492814305.m_KeyValue: ""How do you distinguish between humans and puppets, if I may ask?""

1492814306.m_KeyValue: ""I may look cute, but I'm also an Elder of the Bathory family.""

1492814336.m_KeyValue: ""You're right. So I've been thinking, even if we manage to escape, will it really change anything?""

1492814337.m_KeyValue: "I... I don't want to face the unknown alone. Even if it's a lie... even if it's for just a moment... could you... could you continue to walk with me?"

1492814338.m_KeyValue: ""If... if I die, you must live on, for both of us...""

1492814369.m_KeyValue: "My name. Didn't you ask for my name?"

1492814370.m_KeyValue: "Are you willing to die in her place?"

1492814371.m_KeyValue: "Are you one of that puppet's companions?"

1492814400.m_KeyValue: "I was just thinking how wonderful it is to be on this journey with you!"

1492814402.m_KeyValue: ""And there are some unsettling figures here—first puppets, then statues, and now armored suits?""

1492814403.m_KeyValue: "The gate stands open. I await you here."

1496569023.m_KeyValue: ""'You're always caught up with matters on the Isle, yet you never make time for yourself.'""

1496569028.m_KeyValue: "'I want to... tend to your wounds.'"

1496640927.m_KeyValue: "Upgrading skill levels also increases a Vassal's Blood Power."

1496640993.m_KeyValue: "Collect all memory fragments to receive rewards."

1500709018.m_KeyValue: ""Thanks to you, Acappella can now start a new life with the other children in the choir.""

1500709019.m_KeyValue: "Acappella's adoption papers... the Church approved it?"

1500709020.m_KeyValue: ""The choir takes these children in, and as the Commander, I naturally bear the responsibility of raising them.""

1500709021.m_KeyValue: "You truly meant it when you called them 'children.'"

1500709022.m_KeyValue: ""At Tris's invitation, I attended the hymn recital at the church. Acappella, that young girl, proved to be truly gifted—her performance was met with thunderous applause.""

1500709025.m_KeyValue: ""After the performance, Tris approached me with a smile, her eyes sparkling with joy.""

1500709030.m_KeyValue: ""As I executed more heretics, I came to realize that most of their children were innocent... A child shouldn't suffer for their parents' sins.""

1500709031.m_KeyValue: "It all began with a moment of mercy during a heretic's execution—that's when I brought Anna back with me."

1504088720.m_KeyValue: "Monthly Card lasts 30 days from purchase. Can be purchased repeatedly."

1504873989.m_KeyValue: ""For the second time, I died in fire as a Brennholt.""

1504873990.m_KeyValue: "The Divine Body's hunger grows... these sacrifices won't last long."

1504873991.m_KeyValue: "So you're the demon of the Heretics?"

1504873992.m_KeyValue: ""What hurts more, I wonder—this, or being beaten to death in the arena?""

1504873994.m_KeyValue: ""Haven't you heard? Pass the trials, and we'll be more than slaves—we'll become Carrelle's warriors!""

1505092195.m_KeyValue: ""The higher the rarity and Spirit Siphon phase of the selected Vassal, the greater the attribute bonus.""

1506731803.m_KeyValue: "Bringing people back from the dead... Is that really possible?"

1506731804.m_KeyValue: ""It appears that Miss Setti, like Noah, has only recovered a small portion of her memory and strength due to the lack of blood.""

1506731805.m_KeyValue: ""You also call me 'Moonblessed'... But what you just said, do you mean Empousa is in some kind of trouble?""

1506802527.m_KeyValue: "You've just come out of a brutal fight. Let me take care of Ami!"

1506802528.m_KeyValue: "Is that the nameless sailor? When did you get here?"

1506802529.m_KeyValue: "Ugh... Not again!? What kind of sailor skill is this supposed to be!?"

1506802532.m_KeyValue: "I let my guard down. He's taken Ami..."

1506813413.m_KeyValue: ""Deliver his necklace to the Hermit—that girl called Ami, meow.""

1506813414.m_KeyValue: ""I made a deal with the real Captain, meow. I've already received payment. Now I must keep my end of the bargain.""

1506813415.m_KeyValue: "Can you please stop calling people by those Tarot card names?! I can't even tell who you're talking about!"

1506813416.m_KeyValue: ""As if the free-spirited Magician would ever take orders from anyone, meow. Besides... that detestable man...""

1506813420.m_KeyValue: "Ami? She was just next to us... Eh?"

1506816609.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Such big talk and you flee?"

1506816610.m_KeyValue: "Wait—it said something about more food... Is there something upstairs?"

1506816613.m_KeyValue: "Oh—so he was the one who stocked this ship with delicacies just for me."

1506816614.m_KeyValue: "What's this? You want to fight me again using that body?"

1506816615.m_KeyValue: ""You've got spirit, Sheila. In my weakened state, I cannot best you...""

1506816616.m_KeyValue: ""But in time, every one of you will become my sustenance.""

1506816617.m_KeyValue: ""As you wish... Become my sustenance, alchemist...""

1506816618.m_KeyValue: ""Wait... is that the Captain? No, it looks like William, disguised as the Captain...""

1506816619.m_KeyValue: "Ah... This type of 'food' is the finest—so easy to control."

1506818789.m_KeyValue: "Hold still. I'll finish off the last of the Landis bloodline first—then take my time with you."

1506818791.m_KeyValue: "I won't... let you... get away with this..."

1506818794.m_KeyValue: ""I must thank you, Sheila. You kept such lovely company while I dined.""

1507472000.m_KeyValue: "So... there are still those who wait faithfully for the sun."

1511770940.m_KeyValue: "Allow me to join you in your future battles."

1511770941.m_KeyValue: ""Black Blood is still stirring within you, be careful!""

1513556074.m_KeyValue: "Dismantled equipment can't be restored. Confirm dismantling of selected equipment?"

1515635448.m_KeyValue: "Don't come crying to me when you get into trouble!"

1515636603.m_KeyValue: "How many more tragedies born of ignorance must we witness..."

1515638781.m_KeyValue: ""You never fail to surprise me, like that unexpected move in chess. I must say, I quite enjoy it...""

1515884951.m_KeyValue: "Season has ended. The score will not count for this round."

1515983731.m_KeyValue: "Huh? You two can read this kind of writing?"

1515983733.m_KeyValue: "...that those werewolves... are the past Gravekeepers?"

1515983734.m_KeyValue: "Don't you dare insult the honor of our family!"

1515983735.m_KeyValue: "Sheila was slain by us twenty years ago. By the five of us."

1515983736.m_KeyValue: "Th-they're back again? Is there no end to them?!"

1515983763.m_KeyValue: "My attacks... can't hurt them at all..."

1515983764.m_KeyValue: ""Lastly, I forbid you from saying such a discouraging thing again, because you have never been alone.""

1515983765.m_KeyValue: ""Don't forget, there are three of us, so we'll decide with majority rule. At least two must agree.""

1515983797.m_KeyValue: "Gilrain... Does this place seem familiar to you?"

1515983798.m_KeyValue: "With so many of these things... I'm too creeped out to fight!"

1515983827.m_KeyValue: ""But he... believed in me. I, whose life had always been predetermined, can still become the person I want to be...""

1515983828.m_KeyValue: "He must have been taken to 'that place' as well!"

1515983829.m_KeyValue: "...The insect eggs scattered along the path gave off a strong stench of rotten Black Blood."

1515983830.m_KeyValue: "Now's not the time to let emotions get the better of us. We should focus on dealing with the enemy at hand."

1515983859.m_KeyValue: ""What?! You're the one who said we would find Clive here. That's the only reason we went through all this trouble, but now there's absolutely nothing...""

1515983860.m_KeyValue: ""When that Noah guy gets back, give him this invitation—""

1515983863.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know why, but standing here, I can't help but... Even though...""

1515983864.m_KeyValue: "Why is this place filled with Wolfsbane?"

1515983866.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh... No matter how many times I see it, it still disgusts me...""

1515983888.m_KeyValue: ""Is that so? You've become strong and reliable, Clive... No, Lord Ganelon.""

1515983891.m_KeyValue: "What in the world are you talking about?"

1515983892.m_KeyValue: "What's going on!? Didn't we take him down?!"

1515983894.m_KeyValue: ""Clive, grab on to me. We're leaving.""

1515983896.m_KeyValue: "I see... this must be the Hive Mind created by the Black Blood."

1515983897.m_KeyValue: "I now know that you and I ended up in the forbidden grounds twenty years in the past."

1515983898.m_KeyValue: "But somehow... I recognize this is Mouret twenty years in the past."

1517631862.m_KeyValue: "Finally... I can rest for a while..."

1517631893.m_KeyValue: "There's still time... there must still be time..."

1517631894.m_KeyValue: ""'Great Mystic, will my beloved's illness get better?'""

1517631895.m_KeyValue: ""My dear lost 'Star,' why are you crying?""

1517631897.m_KeyValue: "Who are you? Where is this? It's not your place to judge my choices."

1517631898.m_KeyValue: "What should we do? What do the Tarot cards say?"

1517631925.m_KeyValue: ""The human who adopted you couldn't do it, what chance do you have? Look at your legs, trembling with fear in the seawater!""

1517631926.m_KeyValue: "If that's how it is... then let us walk this final path together."

1517631930.m_KeyValue: "This child's rebirth is... the most brilliant divination you've ever performed."

1517631932.m_KeyValue: "Now I understand everything. I know how to love this world and feel it. My will and my life are the Tarot spread that can change fate. This is the true power of the Tarot."

1519313750.m_KeyValue: "It seems that careless little one dropped something under the carpet."

1523749039.m_KeyValue: "You're saying Gadric is... is the Vice-Commander?"

1523749040.m_KeyValue: "(coughing) I... I took care of some knights who looked sick... gave them water..."

1523749042.m_KeyValue: ""Once his body begins to break down, there's no turning back, unless...""

1523749071.m_KeyValue: ""I was born here, I've returned here, and I'll stay here forever. This is... what I want...""

1523749072.m_KeyValue: ""Heh... I don't mind... her saying that. This way... I've caught up to you a bit, haven't I?""

1523749075.m_KeyValue: "Huh? That garlic head can actually say something so profound?"

1523749103.m_KeyValue: ""You're wondering why he's been waiting for you, aren't you? It's perplexing—you didn't know him before today, yet he's known about you for twenty years.""

1523749105.m_KeyValue: ""Well, well, you've finally arrived. Hati, Clive, and... the rest of you.""

1523749109.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Are we just going back like this?"

1523902509.m_KeyValue: ""Much of this ship is falling apart. But if we follow the markers Lorelei and I agreed upon, we can avoid the traps.""

1526934647.m_KeyValue: ""Could this be the grace of fate, allowing me to meet Miss Aiona, the 'Moonblessed', here and even earn her praise!""

1526934845.m_KeyValue: "These are Lady Empousa's Blood Servants. They must have sensed we were in danger and came to assist."

1527998892.m_KeyValue: ""As instructed, I visited Bella the moment I returned from Sapphire Isle.""

1527998894.m_KeyValue: "We could also pretend none of this ever happened."

Purchase Pass for Extra Rewards.
