1531973247.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Dusk Castle
<style=""InfoText"">The night deepens as the moon cries resoundingly. As the castle stands alone, it lies forever within the moon's embrace.
• From here you may enter rooms with varying functions.
• Some rooms have been sealed for ages and need to be unlocked with a key, which can be obtained by advancing Threads of Fate.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Observatory
<style=""InfoText"">The arrangement and movements of the stars are no mere coincidence; they signify cycles of cause and effect on the continent.
• Utilize Prophecy Inscriptions to unlock constellations and observe their Stars for bonuses.
• Advance Threads of Fate to uncover clues about Prophecy Inscriptions and explore the map to locate them.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Hall of Honor
<style=""InfoText"">Your honor transforms into blessings for the future.
• Complete Achievements to earn Medals of Prestige. Accumulate these medals to upgrade your Hall of Honor Level.
• Upgrading the Hall unlocks honorary statues and rewards, some of which provide permanent bonuses.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Ritual Chamber
<style=""InfoText"">This ancient soul-alchemy ritual sacrifices souls of similar quality to extract potent Ancestral Power from them.
• The Ritual Chamber can enhance Vassals' attributes universally.
• All Ritual level caps are limited by Bloodline Transfusion Levels.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Bloodline Transfusion
<style=""InfoText"">The secret technique of the Bloodborn grants all living souls, no matter how young, powerful abilities by transfusing their blood with that of the ancients.
• The 5 highest-level Vassals will automatically join the transfusion.
• The Transfusion level will be determined by the lowest-level Vassal among the chosen five.
• Vassals that are newly-added to the Transfusion Bar will be automatically upgraded to the Transfusion level. Vassals in the Transfusion Bar cannot be upgraded independently.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Moonlight Tribute
<style=""InfoText"">Moonlight Tribute is an essential ritual that the Bathory family must observe.
• For every 5 stages cleared in Normal Mode or Hard Mode in Threads of Fate, Moonlight Faith increases by 1 level. As Moonlight Faith increases, so do Tribute yields.
• You can perform a limited number of Extra Sermons each day. Through Extra Sermon, you will immediately gain basic resources and random item rewards equal to 2 hours of ritual time.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Wilderness Expedition
<style=""InfoText"">Most Bloodborn follow the tenet of Secrecy, but should they truly wish to restore their past glory, Lords must dispatch Vassals to explore the continent for lost treasures.
• Different expeditions require Vassals of different factions and rarities.
• Higher-star expeditions require longer completion times and higher-rarity Vassals.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Starlit Memoir
<style=""InfoText"">On moonlit nights, Vassals venture outside the castle walls and play in the surrounding areas. It is here where little stories often unfold.
• Each story requires Candles to access. Candles represent the number of stories available this week.
• Earn a reward for completing each Memoir.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Council Chamber
<style=""InfoText"">The ancient castle is a place of intrigue, where Lords gather with their confidants to discuss topics such as internal affairs, diplomatic plans, or personal matters.
• Every day, Lords will randomly receive topics of discussion. Lords can choose which topics to discuss based on their own preferences.
• Each Vassal that participates in the meeting gains Affinity.""

1531973248.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Building Unlocked
<style=""InfoText"">The Rare Specimen Gallery clearly embodies one single ambition: Establishing itself as a universal symbol through total control.
• Advance Threads of Fate to uncover clues about Keys and explore the map to find the doors they unlock.
• Use Keys to access new rooms and unveil the past.""

1531973249.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Building Unlocked
<style=""InfoText"">During the era of the Crimson Inquisition, the Bathory family hid Ancestors with special Blood Powers inside their cellar, preserving them for a future rebirth.
• Advance Threads of Fate to uncover clues about Keys and explore the map to find the doors they unlock.
• Use Keys to access new rooms and unveil the past.""

1531973250.m_KeyValue:
""Duke it out with other Lords in Best-of-3 matches.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Season
<style=""InfoText"">• A season consists of both an Engagement and Armistice period. The Engagement period lasts for 13 days, while the Armistice lasts for 1 day.
• If you initiate an attack and win, you will switch rankings with your opponent. If you are attacked and fail to defend, you will also switch rankings with your opponent.
• At the end of each season, the Etched Keystone (Crucible Points) will be reset.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Challenge</style>
<style=""InfoText"">• Select an opponent you want to challenge from the Opponent List.
• You will only be matched against higher-ranking players.
• You have 2 free challenge attempts per day.
• Once your free attempts are used up, you may use Crucible Passes to engage in more battles.
• A challenge consists of a Preparation Phase and a Battle Phase.
• If you quit or time out during the Preparation Phase, the challenge will end and no attempts will be consumed.
• If you time out during the Battle Phase, it will be considered a failure (each of the 3 battles is independently timed).

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Defense Team
<style=""InfoText"">Tap _$$Edit Team_$$ to deploy your lineup. When challenged by other Lords, your Defense Team will defend your glory. You must build 3 teams, ensuring that each team contains 5 Vassals.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Offense Team
<style=""InfoText"">You may build your Offense Team after selecting an opponent and entering battle.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Winning Conditions
<style=""InfoText"">The team that eliminates the other team first wins. Should the two teams be eliminated at the same time, the attacker wins. If you time out during the Battle Phase, it will be considered a failure (each of the 3 battles is independently timed).

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Rewards
<style=""InfoText"">• Winning the battle earns you rewards.
• After a season ends, season ranking rewards will be issued via Mail.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Hourly Rewards
<style=""InfoText"">• Hourly idle rewards vary based on your rank; the higher the rank, the greater the rewards, with a maximum of 24 hours of idle earnings.
• Idle rewards also include Points, so achieving a higher rank can help you earn more Points, allowing you to secure a top spot on the Point Rank!

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Quick Battle
<style=""InfoText"">• When Quick Battle is enabled, battle results will be displayed directly.
• Use the Replay function to watch the battle again (may not be 100% accurate).""

1531973251.m_KeyValue:
""Your honor transforms into blessings for the future.
<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Hall of Honor
<style=""InfoText"">• Activating Honor Statues bestows Supreme Blessings, which increases Vassal deployment limits, Challenge Attempt caps, and maximum Earnings across various game modes.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Upgrade the Hall
<style=""InfoText"">• Complete Achievements to earn Medals of Prestige. Accumulate these medals to upgrade your Hall of Honor level.
• Upgrading the Hall unlocks Honor Statues and grants Supreme Blessing.""

1531973252.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Affinity Level
<style=""InfoText""> • Increase Affinity through Council Chamber and Banquet.
• Improving Affinity Level provides attribute bonuses.
• Use Spirit Siphon to raise the Affinity cap.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Banquet
<style=""InfoText""> • Use Banquet to treat your Vassal and increase their Affinity.
• Providing Vassals with their favorite food significantly boosts Affinity gains.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Journal
<style=""InfoText""> • Vassals's back stories and their daily with you can be found here.
• Increase Affinity to unlock more about them in the Journal.""

1531973253.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Truth's Odyssey
<style=""InfoText"">• Set off on a journey to solve various contingencies and discover the wonders of enlightenment.
• All progress in this mode will reset daily at a specified time.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Embark
<style=""InfoText"">• Choose your preferred difficulty and Chamber.
• Chambers will be gradually unlocked by clearing [Threads of Fate].
• Each Chamber contains 3 difficulties. A new difficulty unlocks upon a successful challenge of the previous one.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※Chambers
<style=""InfoText"">• Each difficulty consists of multiple stages.
• For each stage, you can choose random or fixed Elements.
• These include Wind Elements, Earth Elements, Aether Elements, Water Elements, etc.
• After clearing all stages in one difficulty, you may claim rewards and proceed to the next.
• Clearance Rewards may only be obtained once per day.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Wind Elements
<style=""InfoText"">• Divided into three tiers: Wind Element I, Wind Element II, and Fire Element.
• Upon completing, you will gain Catalyst rewards.
• The higher the difficulty, the higher the chance of obtaining High-Grade Catalysts.
• Vassals will not recover HP after each challenge.
• Enemy units also cannot recover HP should the stage remain incomplete.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Catalysts
<style=""InfoText"">• Provide special effects for Vassals participating in battle.
• However, Catalysts only apply to eligible targets.
• Catalysts are divided into four Grades: N, R, SR, and SSR. The strength of the effect increases with the Grade.
• The strength of Catalysts also increases with their Aspect Level.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Catalyst Aspects
<style=""InfoText"">• The Aspect Level will increase based on the number of Catalysts of the same Aspect type held.
• Catalysts are divided into 4 Aspects: Triangle, Diamond, Circle, and Square. Each Catalyst belongs to one of these Aspects.
• Catalyst Aspect Levels:
• LV1: Base state
• LV2: Hold 3 of the same Aspect type
• LV3: Hold 4 of the same Aspect type
• LV4: Hold 6 of the same Aspect type
• LV5: Hold 8 of the same Aspect type

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Aether Elements
<style=""InfoText"">• Triggers various Wonders, each providing different effects based on your selection.
• Effects will impact the status of Vassals and their Catalysts.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Water Elements
<style=""InfoText"">• You can choose to restore Vassal HP or revive Vassals.
• You must choose between restoration or revival.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※Stop
<style=""InfoText"">• You may end the Odyssey manually, or end through completion after clearing the final area.
• After the Odyssey ends, all progress will be reset.
• You can end the Odyssey at any time and come back to challenge it.""

1536551097.m_KeyValue: "Can you guess which words of yours made me change my mind?"

1536556346.m_KeyValue: ""Bella: Alright, I shall trust your judgment this time.""

1536558260.m_KeyValue: ""Alright, since they're saying you're one of the Moonblessed, I suppose I'll trust you this time!""

1536561459.m_KeyValue: ""Fine, I guess you have a point there.""

1536562352.m_KeyValue: "Is it still possible to change my mind?"

1536563373.m_KeyValue: ""I must admit, your argument has finally convinced me.""

1536565551.m_KeyValue: "It's nothing. I just wanted to see your smile."

1536568622.m_KeyValue: ""Upon consideration, your choice is indeed the more prudent course of action.""

1539868075.m_KeyValue: ""While I bear you no ill will, I am not here to answer your questions.""

1539868078.m_KeyValue: "Watch out! Those suits of armor are coming for us."

1539868107.m_KeyValue: ""What's wrong, 79? Don't tell me you're thinking about going back again.""

1539868109.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, what a clever choice. As a reward, I'll do a Tarot reading for you—""

1539868110.m_KeyValue: "I just saw in you the image of a past friend. I remember she also gave herself a name..."

1539868111.m_KeyValue: ""Of course! Think about it. If we really made it to the far side of the moon, what would you say when the people there ask for your name?""

1539868371.m_KeyValue: ""'The more I chase, the further it gets from me.'""

1539868372.m_KeyValue: "There's nothing to be happy about... What's the point of living like this?"

1539868373.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, she's too reckless. Going with her... it's basically asking for death.""

1539868374.m_KeyValue: "I guess you'll do. Not like we have many options..."

1539868404.m_KeyValue: "This shape... it seems to match those grooves we saw."

1539868405.m_KeyValue: ""Look here, there are seven grooves. What could they represent?""

1539868435.m_KeyValue: ""I shouldn't have dismissed your ideas. I failed to realize that it could be your dream, too.""

1539868437.m_KeyValue: ""Well, we haven't found those two little puppets... might as well talk about something.""

1539868467.m_KeyValue: ""...that card, and a way out... as friends.""

1539868471.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, don't think we'll forget you're a puppet just because you hid them away!""

1539868472.m_KeyValue: ""Welcome to the stage I've prepared for you, foolish child, and naughty child.""

1539868503.m_KeyValue: "What are you talking about? We just found the second card!"

1539868505.m_KeyValue: "I can't shake the feeling that these statues are being manipulated by someone using the shadows."

1539868506.m_KeyValue: ""C'mon, let's go! I'm curious to see what we'll face next.""

1539868535.m_KeyValue: "But I lack her overzealous curiosity for these trials. I'm just doing my job here."

1539868536.m_KeyValue: "Forget it! We're escaping together. I'm not leaving you behind!"

1539868538.m_KeyValue: ""But we still have to push forward, right?""

1539868567.m_KeyValue: ""You used to always hide away, quiet and emotionless. But now...""

1539868569.m_KeyValue: "So this must be the abyss he mentioned?"

1539868570.m_KeyValue: ""This time, perhaps some souls will persevere to the depths below, and grant this old warrior an unexpected delight.""

1540746342.m_KeyValue: ""This time, there'll be no superiors to get in the way.""

1540746343.m_KeyValue: "So the report was true. A Bell Ringer's Vice-Commander is locked in a brutal fight."

1540746346.m_KeyValue: ""No, Lord Agares. Following you is our freedom!""

1540746347.m_KeyValue: ""I heard it—the heartbeats of my kin, the resonance of blood born of Dracula.""

1540747368.m_KeyValue: "Van Helsing?! Don't tell me Bob couldn't even slow him down..."

1540747370.m_KeyValue: "What have I become… Who am I?"

1540747371.m_KeyValue: "He's more than his title. You won't be able to handle him."

1544193094.m_KeyValue: ""No, there are more important matters that need your attention, Aiona.""

1544193095.m_KeyValue: "I believe they'll definitely move the slaves near the auction house by then."

1544193097.m_KeyValue: ""Right... after all, he's the one who failed to look after his own disciple.""

1544193124.m_KeyValue: "Why can't I remember... anything from my past? My head hurts..."

1544193126.m_KeyValue: ""I suppose you haven't had a proper look around, right? Come—let me show you. Think of it as a little vacation.""

1544193150.m_KeyValue: ""'Don't be afraid, Averdin said he would protect us.'""

1544193157.m_KeyValue: ""Relying on me is convenient, isn’t it? But Miss Ami also needs someone in her corner.""

1544193158.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Lorelei knows where the Mistbound Terror is? Please, you have to tell us!""

1544193159.m_KeyValue: "It’s Lord Thoreau! He's overseeing the selection himself!"

1544193160.m_KeyValue: ""I can help you with your plan, but I need to know the answer.""

1544193161.m_KeyValue: ""And besides, if you were the one who did the killing, why investigate the so-called culprit? And why leave those sketches behind in your office?""

1544193162.m_KeyValue: "Miss Ami should become the Eighth Sage!"

1544193163.m_KeyValue: "Guards! Escort Mr. Roland and me out of here."

1545410430.m_KeyValue: "θ-Blood Variant. Counters α-Blood Variant enemies (DMG +30% ); countered by β-Blood Variant enemies (DMG -20%)."

1545410431.m_KeyValue: "β-Blood Variant. Counters θ-Blood Variant enemies (DMG +30% ); countered by α-Blood Variant enemies (DMG -20%)."

1545410432.m_KeyValue: "α-Blood Variant. Counters β-Blood Variant enemies (DMG +30% ); countered by θ-Blood Variant enemies (DMG -20%)."

1545949401.m_KeyValue: ""Under closer examination, I can see countless particles suspended inside...""

1545949402.m_KeyValue: ""Well, the notice on the bulletin board is clear enough—""

1545949403.m_KeyValue: ""Still, it's a blessing in disguise for the rest of us—the water runs pure again. Those wretches showed no reverence for water, the very wellspring of existence!""

1546817157.m_KeyValue: "I wonder how Cain is doing with the ship preparations..."

1546817160.m_KeyValue: "The Church's ship has reached the target waters. Time to act."

1548524043.m_KeyValue: ""This is the Land of No Return... A moment of absolute stillness, conjured by my Covenant, beyond the reach of time. No breath, no sound, no interference.""

1548524045.m_KeyValue: "There’s no need to worry. Even the Saint cannot hear us within the Land of No Return."

1548524047.m_KeyValue: ""Time is frozen, but only for a breath. Listen closely.""

1548524049.m_KeyValue: "And I know this as well. The eternity given to the Bell Ringers is nothing but a curse. Every choice we make is already inscribed in the will of Aeon."

1548524050.m_KeyValue: ""I know the claim. That the Divine Body is the seal that protects the world, and the Black Blood is the Calamity that destroys it. But that's not the truth.""

1548534930.m_KeyValue: "Oh—Doctor Ressa! That flower you were carrying earlier… was it from a secret admirer?"

1548534931.m_KeyValue: ""Don't frighten them, Piera. The guards already have enough to bear.""

1548534932.m_KeyValue: "Good. Because ordinary folk who meddle in the passage rites might find themselves stalked by spirits... Ones that never let go..."

1548534933.m_KeyValue: "Return... Return home... Return to where it all began..."

1548538129.m_KeyValue: "The Church. I'm going to the Church!"

1548538131.m_KeyValue: "So it exists... even beyond this island?"

1548538133.m_KeyValue: ""Leave the island? Since our ancestors settled here, no one's ever left Sunset Isle.""

1548538134.m_KeyValue: "There is a way! Just as Dr. Ressa once reached this place."

1548538135.m_KeyValue: "But only the Paracelsus main family knows the method. I'm sorry for keeping it from you."

1548538136.m_KeyValue: "Forget that! Who are you even going to find? Who else can save us!?"

1548540303.m_KeyValue: ""By this, you have cast doubt upon Aeon's eternity and betrayed the sacred truth of the Church.""

1548540304.m_KeyValue: "Is it heresy to seek one's own path rather than blindly follow doctrines?"

1548540305.m_KeyValue: ""Even through these years of silence, you remain the indomitable clergy, Ressa Ambolia.""

1548540306.m_KeyValue: ""Yet your words just now reveal a grave sin. The Church upholds the order of time, and still, you leave the Church in search of eternity...""

1548540307.m_KeyValue: "I was wondering why the dreamfeeders grew so restless. A Bell Ringer has arrived on this island… Tris Tepes. That explains it."

1548540308.m_KeyValue: "I wondered as well—how anyone on this remote island could have bested my choristers."

1548540309.m_KeyValue: "If there was never an enemy... then did the eternity I crossed to the Other Side for ever truly exist?"

1548540310.m_KeyValue: "For eternity... So this is why you left the Church of your own accord?"

1548540311.m_KeyValue: "You always do this—shattering everything I've come to believe in over these three years on the island."

1548540312.m_KeyValue: "If _$$Death_$$ is not the enemy of life... then who is?"

1550712287.m_KeyValue: ""In just these two days, I've faced two tragic souls.""

1554151217.m_KeyValue: ""Go, Captain. Teach William a lesson he won't forget. As for the others... leave them to me.""

1554151218.m_KeyValue: ""First Mate Bob, you're siding with sin and sentiment—shall I take this as your betrayal to our doctrine of truth?""

1554151219.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps one day, little Van Helsing, you will come to understand just how merciless the truth we once upheld truly is.""

1554151220.m_KeyValue: "But it is emotion that makes us human—without it..."

1554151221.m_KeyValue: "...what difference would there be between us and the Black Blood beasts we once hunted?"

1554151222.m_KeyValue: "Hey! What's....? This guy's aura is completely different from when he was picking fights earlier!"

1554151223.m_KeyValue: "And that weapon he just drew... it's a Future Artifact!"

1554151224.m_KeyValue: "Huh? The same kind lifeless eyes carries around? That oaf has something that dangerous too?"

1554151225.m_KeyValue: ""After all, First Mate Bob was once a Hunter of the Church. Or perhaps I should say...""

1554151226.m_KeyValue: "Former Eighth of the Silver Cross—Robert Lawrence."

1554165336.m_KeyValue: "Could it be... someone else has been murdered?"

1554165337.m_KeyValue: "Why's Captain Peacock so agitated? Did he drop one of his treasure chests?"

1554165338.m_KeyValue: "It's coming from the guest rooms again?"

1554165339.m_KeyValue: "Did you hear that? It sounded like something just hit the floor."

1554165341.m_KeyValue: "What are you talking about? Murderer? Who killed who?"

1554165342.m_KeyValue: "Now that you mention it... Lady Empousa was resting the whole time and hasn't heard yet. Actually... there's been an incident on the ship."

1554165343.m_KeyValue: "I was wrong to accuse you without cause. And I still refuse to believe Aaron was killed by someone from our crew!"

1554165344.m_KeyValue: ""Under Captain Goldland's leadership, everyone on this ship is family. There's no way a murderer who would harm their own family exists here!""

1554165366.m_KeyValue: ""The last person to see Aaron alive, and the first person to discover his body... Miss Ami. Both times, it was you.""

1554165370.m_KeyValue: ""If he stayed in the guest room, then only Ami, who was already on this floor, and Jones, who was guarding the entrance, would have had the opportunity to reach him there.""

1554165371.m_KeyValue: ""Exactly. When we eliminate all contradictory possibilities, the ones left standing—however improbable—are closest to the truth. And right now, the most suspicious connection is clear:""

1554165373.m_KeyValue: ""From then until the discovery of his body, no one saw him return to the deck.""

1554165374.m_KeyValue: ""The last time anyone saw Second Mate Aaron was in the kitchen, about one bell ago.""

1554165375.m_KeyValue: ""...either the guest room, or the kitchen.""

1554165376.m_KeyValue: ""This means that during that entire time, he could only have been in two places...""

1559248177.m_KeyValue: ""If you're unsure how to progress, be sure to take a moment to check your Tasks!""

1559248178.m_KeyValue: "You should be ready to continue on your journey."

1559695871.m_KeyValue:
"Actions can't keep up with thoughts—that's just how it is.
We'll leave it at that."

1559695900.m_KeyValue: ""Having moved too slowly, it's as if nothing happened when you arrive. World's unsolved mysteries +1.""

1562372694.m_KeyValue: ""I never expected to find such beautiful flowers in this haunted, gloomy place...""

1562372695.m_KeyValue: "'Blooming toward the moon'—these mysterious flowers seem to be guiding us to the Moonblessed... Cain's riddles always come up at the right time."

1562372696.m_KeyValue: ""Cain... Come to think of it, before meeting up with you all, he did mention—""

1562372697.m_KeyValue: ""Not long ago, within the castle walls.""

1563608105.m_KeyValue: "Thank you for staying by my side. Thank you for keeping your promise."

1565977422.m_KeyValue: ""She's right, I saw with my own eyes how the Tarot guided us to find the cochineal.""

1565977452.m_KeyValue: "They seem to have caught the scent of food and are in hot pursuit!"

1565977453.m_KeyValue: "I see! We need to wait for the bell!"

1565977716.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, was it something exciting? Were you being chased? Or ran into the wrong crowd?""

1565977718.m_KeyValue: "That's amazing! Do these mysterious phrases just come to you? What do they sound like when they appear? Is it a male cat or a female cat?"

1565977719.m_KeyValue: "There are more and more Blood Beasts. This isn't working... We need to get out of here."

1565977749.m_KeyValue: ""Is this... cypress? Hmm, it's a fine material for building ships. Wait, you mean...""

1565977782.m_KeyValue: "Strong and sturdy... an excellent base for a dugout canoe!"

1565977815.m_KeyValue: "The great Pontos II will set sail another day!"

1565977817.m_KeyValue: ""Shoot, Mother is looking for me. She won't let me come out to play with you. She says I'll get infected... I have to go now!""

1565977818.m_KeyValue: "Tomorrow? You still think there's going to be a tomorrow?"

1565977843.m_KeyValue: ""...Yes, I am the one Esmeralda spoke of. I will perform the final divination.""

1565977878.m_KeyValue: "Are you here looking for treasure as well?"

1565977880.m_KeyValue: "That cowardly 'Fool' has forgotten everything she taught her!"

1565977881.m_KeyValue: ""Esmeralda said that only a mystic who truly masters the power of the Tarot can draw the final card, bringing new hope to the incomplete spread...""

1565977911.m_KeyValue: ""Are you not? If not, why is this scene appearing before your eyes?""

1565977912.m_KeyValue: ""Silly cat, don't be sad. It's time to save everyone.""

1565977914.m_KeyValue: "The journey... is always lonely—Fate... always leaves you behind—"

1566442337.m_KeyValue: ""Excuse me, could you lend me a hand?""

1566442338.m_KeyValue: ""I've found no new clues along the way, and there are no traces of any construct. Did I take a wrong turn somewhere... Wait.""

1566442340.m_KeyValue: "You'd sacrifice your own core just to survive... What are you trying to tell me?"

1572179102.m_KeyValue: "I've known since the beginning. Secretly saving Noah... seeking the Moonblessed who still believed in freedom..."

1572179103.m_KeyValue: ""I won't deny we share certain goals. But to say I serve them? No, no... that's not quite right.""

1572180120.m_KeyValue: ""I won't let you stop me again, Co—""

1572180121.m_KeyValue: "This is going to call for a lot of food after..."

1572180124.m_KeyValue: ""Leaving? But in every previous case, I only left when I died.""

1572180125.m_KeyValue: ""After a journey through memory, do you still define the present as _$$reality_$$?""

1572180126.m_KeyValue: ""Because of memory. Without others' memories, we cannot view the world from an omniscient mind.""

1572180127.m_KeyValue: ""When the memory vanishes? Be it our own, or the memories others hold of us.""

1572180129.m_KeyValue: "I possess no such power. I merely uncovered the truth."

1573488655.m_KeyValue: ""Surely you don't expect me to track down the camp, clear out the monsters, and let you enjoy the fruits of my labor?""

1573488656.m_KeyValue: "Then it's simple. I'll head there and get rid of them."

1573488657.m_KeyValue: ""Without warmth, that large one will never wake.""

1573488658.m_KeyValue: "Is there any way we can save him?"

1574780312.m_KeyValue: "He... he came out of Colossus Max... and took Alene away..."

1575905453.m_KeyValue: ""Of course! Who do you think I am... Wait, why am I even taking orders from you!?""

1577639258.m_KeyValue: "...It's too late. The plan must proceed."

1577639259.m_KeyValue: ""Good night, honored guests of Sapphire Isle.""

1577639260.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Lorelei, is there anything else you need?""

1577639261.m_KeyValue: ""However, Miss Ami wishes to keep her identity concealed. Do not mention this in their presence.""

1577639264.m_KeyValue: "Miss Ami who just checked in is from a branch of the wealthy Roland family. Please take extra care when attending to them."

1585038605.m_KeyValue: "None of us ever saw him again. Everything we heard came only through Noah and Gilrain."

1585941025.m_KeyValue: "Then show me how much you've grown."

1585941026.m_KeyValue: ""Foolish child, now you understand the danger. This path was never safe.""

1585941027.m_KeyValue: "I chose to bear that weight alone. So you wouldn't have to. You're now Bell Ringer No. X."

1585941028.m_KeyValue: "Or perhaps… we were beasts to begin with."

1585941030.m_KeyValue: "You're still a child. The road I've chosen is far too dangerous."

1587882497.m_KeyValue: ""Just endure it. Once you're well-done, the heat won't bother you anymore.""

1587882498.m_KeyValue: "You think this is a grill!? I need water!"

1587882499.m_KeyValue: ""Fish... always in such a rush. Unlike us, right?""

1587883648.m_KeyValue: "It seems even my reading speed has become a liability."

1587883649.m_KeyValue: ""A pity. He was a fine Captain. But in the end, his need to play the 'good brother' doomed him.""

1587883650.m_KeyValue: "Now I understand why Jones so readily accepted when I volunteered to take over security for this voyage."

1587883654.m_KeyValue: "I suppose I'll have to experience what it's like to be a murderer."

1587883655.m_KeyValue: "Blood Beasts have gathered in both the upper and lower corridors. Which way should I go...?"

1587884666.m_KeyValue: ""We kept our vow. We guarded the Divine Body and offered our sacrifices. Yet year after year, our home kept sinking.""

1587884667.m_KeyValue: "It was Ranna—our great mistress—whose whispers led us to salvation! She showed us the truth: we could cut down the Divine Body and use its sacred wood to build a great vessel that would carry us to a new homeland!"

1587884672.m_KeyValue: "You're not merely a Landis survivor... are you..."

1587884673.m_KeyValue: "Indeed. He is the descendant of countless Landis people."

1587884675.m_KeyValue: ""And you... that masked witch. Even cloaked as you are, you can't hide the stench of the Divine Body on you...""

1587884676.m_KeyValue: ""Through the resonance of Black Blood, their memories merged—and those memories now live on in survivors like him.""

1587884677.m_KeyValue: "It's Aeon's fault. That shameless false god who poisoned the world with her lies about order!"

1587884678.m_KeyValue: "What's that supposed to mean? That's creepy... Are you saying he's not just one person?"

1587884679.m_KeyValue: ""It's collective memory. When the Landis family sank beneath the sea, most perished. But they had already turned to Famine's Black Blood.""

1587885820.m_KeyValue: "I've grown too old… too old to love any crew or ship but this one."

1587885821.m_KeyValue: "These old hands can't use the metamorphosis anymore... But they still remember what it means to fire one last shot."

1587885824.m_KeyValue: ""Bob, the courage you've loaded into this ship… I'll carry it.""

1587885825.m_KeyValue: "Stop wasting time reflecting and move! I'm almost out of ammunition!"

1587885826.m_KeyValue: "But you're not the only one keeping secrets. I never told you about my final measure either."

1587885827.m_KeyValue: "How cruel of you. You've gone and reminded me what it felt like to be young. To be like you."

1587885828.m_KeyValue: "What are you waiting for? Your job isn't to fight them off! It's to break through and face the big one!"

1587885829.m_KeyValue: ""Bob's weapons are too old. Even with the metamorphosis, they'll only stagger Famine's minions, not stop them...""

1587885830.m_KeyValue: ""Compared to Bob, I still have a long way to go.""

1587885831.m_KeyValue: "That's it! I don't need to destroy these tentacles. I just need to strike while they flinch!"

1587886845.m_KeyValue: "At this rate... I won't have the strength left to face Famine."

1587886848.m_KeyValue: "Indeed. I can't even imagine what Noah would look like in a panic."

1587886849.m_KeyValue: ""Whether it's our dependable little Fool, or Justice, who seems to have foreseen all of this...""

1587886850.m_KeyValue: "They've already taken the main stage. So? Are we just going to stand around here?"

1587886852.m_KeyValue: "Sounds of battle... coming from the upper deck."

1587886853.m_KeyValue: "Of course! That lifeless eyes said he'd meet Noah on deck! They must be fighting Famine right now!"

1587886854.m_KeyValue: "Noah! We haven't seen him in so long... Is he really up there? I hope he's okay..."

1587886855.m_KeyValue: "What are you worried about?! It's Noah! No danger's going to bring him down."

1587887999.m_KeyValue: ""As punishment for reading my diary, you'll be restricted to only two afternoon tea sessions per day for the next three days!""

1587888002.m_KeyValue: "Oh! I think we've found something! Although it looks like..."

1587888003.m_KeyValue: "But that was all before you met us."

1587888004.m_KeyValue: "So I've always been alone. I am nothing. I have nothing..."

1587888005.m_KeyValue: "It wasn't a dream. It wasn't someone else's memory. It was my own."

1587888007.m_KeyValue: ""Just like Landis sinking beneath the waves, you'll descend into the lightless deep. Alone. Sinking... endlessly... deeper...""

1588510822.m_KeyValue: ""You really are a little princess, aren't you...""

1590717428.m_KeyValue: "Yes. From here we go northeast through <color=#D63536>Starfall Valley</color>. There's a secluded wharf where we can find a boat to <color=#D63536>cross the sea</color>."

1591295735.m_KeyValue: "Don't lose focus! I'm just not used to this new body yet."

1598240380.m_KeyValue: ""It's a survival rule etched into my very bones. Even with the game over, my eyes remain fixed on my _$$opponent,_$$ terrified that a moment's lapse could spell eternal doom.""

1598240381.m_KeyValue: ""As she frantically chased after the fluttering ornament, we unknowingly strayed far from the castle, arriving at the tree No. 66 had mentioned.""

1598240382.m_KeyValue: "What she truly wanted to give me... was freedom."

1598620907.m_KeyValue: ""Tonight, the moon is in a crescent shape, signaling the appearance of the Starfall Valley Odyssey Gate. Allow me to accompany you there.""

1600123425.m_KeyValue: ""No matter how many times the cycle repeats, you were always by my side...""

1601480716.m_KeyValue: "So it was Reese II behind the ghost story all along."

1601480717.m_KeyValue: "Didn't expect you to make it here."

1601785912.m_KeyValue: "What Mr. Van Helsing means is that any suspicious activity would have easily drawn the attention of the crew patrolling the deck at the time."

1601785913.m_KeyValue: ""Huh. Listening to all this, the 'murderer' must have been quite smart.""

1601785914.m_KeyValue: ""The other end was wound around the helm inside the crew quarters, directly opposite the cabin.""

1601785915.m_KeyValue: "His second mistake? The knot tied to the helm wasn't even a proper sailor's knot."

1601785916.m_KeyValue: "Hmph. The one Van Helsing wants to accuse is William—my good-for-nothing little brother."

1601785918.m_KeyValue: "I suspect Captain Goldland's confidence comes from having disposed of the rope at sea the moment he discovered it."

1601785919.m_KeyValue: ""The one guarding the deck entrance to the guest cabins, who briefly left his post...""

1601785920.m_KeyValue: "That's why none of us ever suspected William at the time..."

1601785945.m_KeyValue: "No... they weren't even here when we first arrived. They weren't like this before..."

1601785946.m_KeyValue: ""But… if you do this, everyone aboard will die... Must it truly come to this?""

1601785947.m_KeyValue: "How long was I out? At least I'm feeling better... Right!"

1601786199.m_KeyValue: "Third Mate William! These two may be stowaways—boarded without invitations. How should we handle them?"

1601786200.m_KeyValue: ""May the 'Chariot's' voyage reach its destination without fail, Captain Kristoph Goldland.""

1601786207.m_KeyValue: "Because Noah's 'homeland' seems to lie on a legendary island..."

1601786208.m_KeyValue: ""Are you still thinking about that day... when we first met in the forbidden grounds, twenty years ago?""

1601786210.m_KeyValue: ""Well now… I didn't expect anyone else to be admiring this storm-kissed seascape—dangerous, but quite captivating.""

1601786211.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, little Ami and her 'ambitions,' already laid bare before strangers. But perhaps it’s that candor that makes her so... endearing.""

1601786213.m_KeyValue: ""There are some sweets in the kitchen. Would you two like some? That way, no one will notice I've been sneaking a few for myself.""

1601786239.m_KeyValue: "Wait! I do have an invitation—just not on me right now! And I'm not a stowaway!"

1601786240.m_KeyValue: "As for your earlier accusation—I did not spy you. I deduced it."

1601786241.m_KeyValue: ""Still, sitting still will only ease the symptoms for a time. You should find the ship's doctor quickly. A remedy of honey and spirits would serve her well.""

1601786242.m_KeyValue: "Are you delirious? It's just the two of us here. Who else could you be talking to?"

1601786245.m_KeyValue: ""'Captain' Van Helsing, what are you doing here? Being assigned as temporary squad leader doesn't give you the right to act on your own!""

1601786271.m_KeyValue: "Bob! These two were just caught on deck—without invitations!"

1601786272.m_KeyValue: "You know about Future Artifacts? That's top-level intel—even within the Church..."

1601786273.m_KeyValue: ""Exactly. If more Elders keep getting taken out by someone like that silver-haired one, we'll have fewer and fewer fat lambs to feast on. At this rate...""

1601786274.m_KeyValue: "That scoundrel?! What's his invitation doing here?"

1601786275.m_KeyValue: "The Captain is expecting him. And those stowaways are coming with me."

1601786276.m_KeyValue: "Wait! They're talking about the stowaways now... That's not good."

1601786278.m_KeyValue: "Hmph! We've fought enemies far stronger than you!"

1601786300.m_KeyValue: ""I appreciate the gesture, but let the crew dine first. They've endured enough in this weather.""

1601786303.m_KeyValue: "Can't you see how unwell she is? Or did you not understand what I just said?"

1601786304.m_KeyValue: "As expected of the magnanimous Captain Goldland! Now that's a true sailor's spirit!"

1601786305.m_KeyValue: ""If you truly had wings strong enough to cross the sea, you wouldn't have risked boarding a ship in the first place.""

1601786306.m_KeyValue: ""'There are no eternal friends, only eternal profits.' Such is the way among merchants.""

1601786307.m_KeyValue: "B-But Mr. Van Helsing said we can't harm them before a proper interrogation..."

1601786308.m_KeyValue: "How dare you speak of Captain Goldland with such contempt?! He's a generous man with grand ambitions—he treats every crew member like family!"

1601786309.m_KeyValue: "...my guests. Welcome aboard the El Dorado."

1601786310.m_KeyValue: ""If you're referring to Jones, they're just ordinary knights. Their conflict is none of your concern.""

1601786331.m_KeyValue: ""No, it doesn't. This cabin only has one door, facing the kitchen. The other three sides are solid walls—no windows at all.""

1601786332.m_KeyValue: ""The other one's with me. I always volunteer for kitchen duty, so Jack—the one in charge today—was nice enough to lend it to me.""

1601786335.m_KeyValue: "What? Aaron? Why would anyone—who would kill him..."

1601786337.m_KeyValue: ""He had his back to me when I walked in. As soon as he noticed me, he left.""

1601786338.m_KeyValue: ""Impressive, isn't it?! Little Ami drew that! She's so talented! Remarkable, right?!""

1601786339.m_KeyValue: ""Have you found the problem, Bob? What exactly happened here?""

1601786341.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be too hard on yourself, William. This wasn't your fault. Someone sabotaged the rudder with that rope.""

1601786342.m_KeyValue: ""Bob... He's always reliable when the crew needs him, but when it comes to Ami, he gets far too anxious and impulsive.""

1601786367.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of that, I remember something. After I bumped into him...""

1601786368.m_KeyValue: ""If it were Van Helsing here instead of you, I'd protect him the same way.""

1601786369.m_KeyValue: "You can't beat them? Marlow and the others aren't even fighters—they're weak."

1601786370.m_KeyValue: "Not much strength... but pretty fast on his feet."

1601786371.m_KeyValue: ""Then maybe it wasn't one person? With your strength, you'd need at least a hundred!""

1601786372.m_KeyValue: ""Because if not, you're still the only one who could have done it.""

1601786374.m_KeyValue: "I believe Aaron's death is tied to that second tremor and sound."

1601786399.m_KeyValue: "I'm counting on you to lead the way."

1601786400.m_KeyValue: "This is terrible! What are we going to do?"

1601786401.m_KeyValue: "You forgot? Octo is the octopus I just ate."

1601786402.m_KeyValue: ""Damn it... How many sailors ate this?! At this rate, this ship will end up like Mouret...""

1601786405.m_KeyValue: ""Calm down, Aaron. As a fellow snack thief, I won't tell anyone you were here.""

1606302344.m_KeyValue: "Tap here to open the Task panel."

1606302345.m_KeyValue: ""If you're unsure how to progress, take a moment to check the Task Bar!""

1606302476.m_KeyValue: ""While Blood Moon is active, all Vassals gain <style=""Highlight"">Ultimate Bloodsoul Cost -1</style> and deal <style=""Highlight"">25% more DMG</style>.""

1608718934.m_KeyValue: "The girl's endless chatter echoed through their secret hideout."

1608718937.m_KeyValue: "Did you never build a secret hideout as a kid?"

1608718939.m_KeyValue: ""Hey... would you at least listen to what I, the Bell Ringer, have to say?""

1610993145.m_KeyValue: "But I haven't decided what to paint yet."

1610993147.m_KeyValue: ""I just thought that if I read this book over and over, maybe I could remember them?""

1610993148.m_KeyValue: ""My father, infected by Black Blood, killed my mother. Then Tris ended his life.""

1610993149.m_KeyValue: ""Don't let her hear you say that, or I'll be paying off another strange debt.""

1616047446.m_KeyValue: ""Within each faction, you can select five Vassals for the ritual.""

1616825609.m_KeyValue: ""Permit me a proper introduction. Before you lie the former Elders of the Bathory family, long consigned to eternal slumber.""

1617283887.m_KeyValue: ""I have a confidential letter here, signed by Lord Hallon himself.""

1617283889.m_KeyValue: ""I don't believe you. Speak the truth, or this will be the end of you.""

1617283890.m_KeyValue: "But to strike at two targets at once..."

1617283891.m_KeyValue: ""Today, we shall make Sapphire Isle into an elysium.""

1617283919.m_KeyValue: ""I should never let my guard down. I suspected they might be the Master behind it all, but how could an ordinary 'human' move so fast?""

1617283921.m_KeyValue: "Don't look at me when you say that."

1617283922.m_KeyValue: ""Sir Isaac, I've finally found you! I'm coming to save you!""

1617283923.m_KeyValue: ""I remember now... The promise I wanted to keep was to set sail on a great ship with Lorelei, to help her people find their homeland.""

1617283924.m_KeyValue: ""The devices which the sirens asked me to dismantle—were they tools of their suffering, or the fetters that held them captive within the Isle?""

1617283925.m_KeyValue: "They're no longer heading to another location. I suppose all the devices have been dismantled."

1617283950.m_KeyValue: "As expected... Joyce should have used Bella No. 14 instead..."

1617283951.m_KeyValue: ""Bella, what's happening? Why are you glowing?""

1617283952.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, we're still missing one Siren's Tear.""

1617283953.m_KeyValue: "Could someone have sabotaged Joyce's Elysium devices?! And the only one who knew about all the devices was that wretched Lorelei..."

1617283954.m_KeyValue: "So you just didn't want to do it with us?"

1617283955.m_KeyValue: ""You've done your part, so now it's my turn. To save you.""

1617283957.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, you've arrived. The devices Joyce tried to activate just failed—was that your doing?""

1617283976.m_KeyValue: ""That tradition… you just made it up, didn't you.""

1617283977.m_KeyValue: "No clothes…? To think there's another soul out there who shares my ideals!"

1617283982.m_KeyValue: ""I just went to see Lord Hallon, but the guards said... all the Sages were killed last night... Is that even possible?""

1617283983.m_KeyValue: ""Please, Sir, don't do this! We may not know everything, but it wasn't the sirens who caused the disaster—it was the humans who experimented on them.""

1617283985.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, the person who made the reservation insisted that this gift be given to you, even if everything else was skipped.""

1617283986.m_KeyValue: "Where's Ami? Why isn't she with you?"

1617283987.m_KeyValue: ""It's nothing, Lady Empousa. You must be mistaken.""

1617283988.m_KeyValue: "It's just that... I accidentally got myself into a lot of debt here."

1617283989.m_KeyValue: ""It seems I'll have to contact the Bell Ringer, Albrecht.""

1617284014.m_KeyValue: ""But with a snap of their fingers, the Bell Ringer summoned a flood from the heavens, drowning homes and fleeing villagers alike.""

1617284015.m_KeyValue: ""'Oh dear, oh dear. Half the body’s been eaten. Tragic… And the other half? Tainted with Black Blood... Such a pity…'""

1617284016.m_KeyValue: ""Even as the Blood Beast tore into him, even when his hands could no longer feel, he kept his grip on the dagger.""

1617284017.m_KeyValue: "Run! Get Bella from the basement and leave now!"

1617284019.m_KeyValue: "'So that one day… she might become the greatest musician who ever lived.'"

1617284020.m_KeyValue: ""She remembered her illness flaring again, being carried to bed by servants, and then...""

1617284021.m_KeyValue: ""Tonight, the moon looms vast, round, and brilliant.""

1617373779.m_KeyValue: "Just how badly do you want to be captain..."

1617373780.m_KeyValue: "Wait—what?! We'd stand a better chance together! Why are you running off now?!"

1617373781.m_KeyValue: "So the four Moonblessed Cain spoke of... They correspond to the Four Calamities?"

1617373782.m_KeyValue: ""When he took me from the Church, his aim was to use the blood of the Calamity to awaken the final Scourge.""

1617373783.m_KeyValue: ""One in the castle on Howling Peninsula, the other here in Starfall Valley. These two places have always been connected.""

1617373784.m_KeyValue: "She was the Bathory's new dawn—born in sunlight to serve as their Gravekeeper. But her black wings eclipsed the light..."

1617373785.m_KeyValue: "There was a theory that the world was round."

1617373786.m_KeyValue: ""If I had to guess, the carriage that took Noah headed that way.""

1617373787.m_KeyValue: "Thank you for escorting us this far."

1617376987.m_KeyValue: "I didn't receive any order to kill the Church's soldiers."

1617376988.m_KeyValue: "Sir Gadric... forgive us. It's all because of our weakness."

1617573748.m_KeyValue: "Liar! You're distorting the truth to absolve yourself of guilt!"

1617573749.m_KeyValue: "How can this guy still retain himself at this stage of the disease... Maybe the prophecy was..."

1618114063.m_KeyValue: "The residual blood on this sword can serve as a catalyst for awakening memories..."

1618117264.m_KeyValue: "Who... who would do such a thing! How could they treat them like this!"

1618575277.m_KeyValue: ""In this new order, sentiment means nothing. What matters now is leverage. Transaction.""

1618575279.m_KeyValue: "As luck would have it... Those two years are precisely what I've lost from memory."

1618575280.m_KeyValue: "Has it only been eleven years...? It feels like a lifetime ago..."

1618575281.m_KeyValue: "So this... is the truth of what happened back then."

1618575282.m_KeyValue: ""Hallon brought her to the lab, demanded I try the incomplete treatment. I had no choice. It was our only hope.""

1618575284.m_KeyValue: "Your hatred is deserved. That's why I'm telling you everything. To lighten the weight on my conscience… and to let you know..."

1618575310.m_KeyValue: "Strange fragments of memory... began to surface in my mind…"

1618575311.m_KeyValue: "My eyes... they're getting wet... something is falling…"

1618575313.m_KeyValue: ""Stop lazing around, we need to go catch him right now!""

1618575314.m_KeyValue: "(sighing) I think I'll just go back to sleep..."

1618575315.m_KeyValue: "Thanks. So you really did kill Constantine."

1618575316.m_KeyValue: ""Lord Isaac, Joyce wasn't stalking you at all!""

1618575317.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps. Once we defeat him, we'll know.""

1618575318.m_KeyValue: ""At first, I never meant to do evil. Everything I did was for her... I just wanted to keep her by my side...""

1618575566.m_KeyValue: "Something just flew out of the pocket..."

1618575574.m_KeyValue: "Of course! Catherine's makeup is flawless—you're the perfect Ginokio!"

1618575575.m_KeyValue: ""In interactive theater, improvisation is everything, Bella. Just follow my narration and act along!""

1618575576.m_KeyValue: "It means the course of the tale is shaped by every member of the audience!"

1618575577.m_KeyValue: ""If we're talking about a puppet, surely what she wants most... is to become a real person!""

1618575578.m_KeyValue: "W-what utter nonsense are you spouting?! How dare you suggest I’d entertain such thoughts! Teach him a lesson!"

1618575579.m_KeyValue: "How did that get approved?! I didn't write that!"

1618575580.m_KeyValue: "Take this book... You've earned it—by strength alone..."

1618575600.m_KeyValue: "Miss Ami collapsed after touching the Siren's Tear... then Mr. Thoreau forced his way in and took her."

1618575605.m_KeyValue: "I can't recall anything after I fell ill... not even signing a contract with you."

1618575606.m_KeyValue: "Before they were removed—where did the flowers used to bloom?"

1618575607.m_KeyValue: ""Little Bella, money is the least important thing in life. A promise between friends? Far more valuable.""

1618575609.m_KeyValue: "We forced the other Sages to acknowledge her status through public pressure at the election. They’re unlikely to fully trust her now."

1618575611.m_KeyValue: "Yeah! Why did Alexa suddenly come after us? What earth-shattering thing did Little Bella do in the past?"

1618575612.m_KeyValue: ""See, Little Bella? Someone on the Isle does remember you!""

1618575637.m_KeyValue: "Oh my. I thought Miss Ami had urgent business with me. But it's just her servant."

1618575638.m_KeyValue: ""These two are terrifying. I told you, Little Bella—we should've left sooner.""

1618575640.m_KeyValue: "Mr. Van Helsing's offer is... most compelling."

1618575643.m_KeyValue: "If you still had Goldland's memories... You'd never have let Ami fall into danger like this."

1618575644.m_KeyValue: "When I cut the thread... It felt like all my strength drained out of me."

1618575670.m_KeyValue: "I... I need to meet with a friend."

1618575675.m_KeyValue: "You bear the Bell Ringer's token. To see the token is to stand before the Bell Ringer."

1618575676.m_KeyValue: ""I don't need anything expensive. Actually, I already know what I want.""

1618575697.m_KeyValue: ""Come to think of it, I did faint by the roadside when I woke up... And what you described sounds exactly like what I experienced.""

1618575701.m_KeyValue: "But... Lord Constantine has been awfully busy with something lately. Joyce hasn't seen him in quite some time..."

1618575702.m_KeyValue: "I have to tell Alexa about this!"

1618575703.m_KeyValue: "It's stronger... more aggressive than anything from Constantine's experiments. Is someone trying to turn every human on the Isle into their puppet?"

1618575704.m_KeyValue: "Little Bella... you really shouldn't be so brutally honest with people you've only just met..."

1618575706.m_KeyValue: ""Well... you see, Sapphire Isle hides a tremendous secret...""

1618575707.m_KeyValue: ""...And yet, if such a thing did exist—I might buy it too.""

1618575708.m_KeyValue: "First—I have no interest in becoming the heir to any territory."

1618575732.m_KeyValue: ""Fine, Little Bella—I promise. No snitching. But I really can't take another step right now.""

1618575733.m_KeyValue: ""The road ahead... you'll have to walk it alone, Little Bella. This is as far as I go.""

1618575735.m_KeyValue: "That man over there... isn't that the one from the poster?!"

1618575736.m_KeyValue: "The promised place... it's just over there."

1618575737.m_KeyValue: ""The Bell Ringer...? Truly, Mr. Van Helsing—your connections are enviable. I understand.""

1618575739.m_KeyValue: "T-This can't be... I'm the only one left?"

1618575763.m_KeyValue: "He devoured Mother… he devoured everyone… He's a monster..."

1618575765.m_KeyValue: "No one saw Constantine leave the prison. If he's still there... then why hasn't he been found?"

1618575767.m_KeyValue: "Why would you go to such lengths to find him?"

1618575768.m_KeyValue: ""Constantine spent nearly half of every month inside the prison, devoting himself to siren experimentation.""

1618575769.m_KeyValue: "1353...? Eleven years later? Then I haven't been asleep for just a month... It's been eleven years...?"

1618575770.m_KeyValue: "Take the middle door marked with the Tidewisp marker."

1618575772.m_KeyValue: ""Even by continental standards, these are remarkably novel ideas. No wonder the place is flooded with tourists.""

1625263063.m_KeyValue: ""Heh, is that all the strength you can muster with that whip?""

1625263065.m_KeyValue: "Stop making that disgusting noise! Behave or else!"

1625263097.m_KeyValue: "I've left that matter to my son."

1625263099.m_KeyValue: ""Ooh—if Joyce had a bag of gold, then… then I could replace my head with pure gold!""

1625263100.m_KeyValue: ""Th-th-the last candidate’s token of proof hasn’t arrived yet, so what if… what if…""

1625263101.m_KeyValue: ""What a ridiculous title… but honestly, it suits him quite well.""

1625263360.m_KeyValue: "Was it the scorching summer sun that left the Bloodborn lightheaded? Or the heady warmth of the breeze that left them utterly intoxicated?"

1625263366.m_KeyValue: ""This will reduce the debt by a lot, right? Maybe it's not so...""

1625263386.m_KeyValue: "One million! Do I hear any higher bids?"

1625263391.m_KeyValue: ""Eleven years ago, Sapphire Isle was just a poor fishing village—until a tsunami turned it into a dead land, haunted only by crows and wild wolves.""

1625263392.m_KeyValue: ""So cold... Noah, let's go play in the water!""

1625263394.m_KeyValue: "Maybe... possibly... it's a bit... different from her usual style."

1625263395.m_KeyValue: "Isn't that... the statue from the Captain's room?"

1625263397.m_KeyValue: ""I almost forgot... Please accept this reward, the 'Siren Slayer's Sword of Honor.' You've earned it.""

1625263425.m_KeyValue: ""Close your eyes, and I'll tell you a bedtime story.""

1625263426.m_KeyValue: "The Captain wants to see you. You should head to his study right away."

1625263452.m_KeyValue: "The wealthy... are there really no good ones among them...?"

1625263455.m_KeyValue: "That sounds similar to the siren Miss Lorelei mentioned..."

1625263458.m_KeyValue: "I also had a... strange dream last night."

1625263459.m_KeyValue: ""Rest assured, Mr. Thoreau's security team will see to the safety of every guest.""

1625263460.m_KeyValue: "Where's the silver-haired man who stayed here yesterday?"

1625263461.m_KeyValue: "This is the sacred token of Master Albrecht!"

1625263462.m_KeyValue: "That Noah... He got involved with such dangerous people..."

1625263488.m_KeyValue: ""They use their singing to mesmerize people, making them walk into the sea...""

1625263491.m_KeyValue: "When did fate begin weaving its entanglements? What tragedy do these weaving hands desire?"

1625263492.m_KeyValue: "You mean the one that got hit by a tsunami?"

1625263493.m_KeyValue: ""After Father's death... I should have 'inherited' ownership of Sapphire Isle. But I've been running away for all these years, and now...""

1625263494.m_KeyValue: "Who did this... Was it the one who runs the Isle?"

1625263520.m_KeyValue: ""The first victim was a pirate who robbed the Trading Company's ships, the second was their business competitor, and the third was blackmailing the Sapphire Isle Seven Sages—assuming that's true.""

1625263521.m_KeyValue: ""This sword... it looks like yours, silver-haired? And also kind of like that 'Siren Slayer's Sword of Honor.'""

1625263522.m_KeyValue: ""If that's the case, Master Van Helsing must be in grave danger...""

1625263523.m_KeyValue: "There appears to be a bird in the victim's tattoo as well."

1625263524.m_KeyValue: "This tattoo... it belongs to a pirate crew that operates near Sapphire Isle."

1625263526.m_KeyValue: "Master Van Helsing has taught me many things that money cannot buy."

1625263549.m_KeyValue: ""Eavesdropping is quite unbecoming behavior, young lady.""

1625263551.m_KeyValue: ""You're from the Roland family—wealthy, bold, and well-connected with the Church.""

1625263552.m_KeyValue: ""As you said, my master is wealthy and well-connected with the Church, so why should we cooperate with you?""

1625263553.m_KeyValue: "I am unsure whether Miss Ami knows enough about the Sapphire Isle Seven Sages."

1625263555.m_KeyValue: ""Though I have never seen his face before, no one would dare impersonate one of Sapphire Isle's renowned Seven Sages.""

1625263558.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, so you've already met Mr. Thoreau?""

1629602980.m_KeyValue: "I believe you've inherited Tris's nobility. And I believe Noah carries a strength that rivals any of us."

1629602981.m_KeyValue: "Aren't you afraid we'll kill him? Or toss him into the sea on the way?"

1629602988.m_KeyValue: ""You sure ask a lot of questions. Bell Ringers aren't miracle workers, you know! If you want to stay behind and rot with the Black Blood, that's your choice!""

1629602989.m_KeyValue: ""The true enemy... You mean Death? Even the Bell Ringer can't stop him? Ressa... Does that mean Jason, Sora... they can't be saved?""

1629602990.m_KeyValue: ""Homeland isn't always a place. Sometimes it's the memories we share with family, with those we love... with those we long for.""

1629602991.m_KeyValue: "Even so... to leave the homeland we've known all our lives..."

1629602992.m_KeyValue: "I'm sure you have your ways of leaving this place."

1629602993.m_KeyValue: "That's what someone dear to me just reminded me of."

1629602994.m_KeyValue: "Then I'll entrust Noah to your care."

1629602995.m_KeyValue: "Naturally. We'll be transporting the black cocoon as well."

1629605164.m_KeyValue: "Isn't it strange? Why did you awaken in that carriage? And why did I allow the Bathorys to take your blood... for resurrection?"

1629605166.m_KeyValue: "Lest you forget—I'm the one who helped you escape the Church."

1629605170.m_KeyValue: ""Remember, the sealed area in Starfall Valley. That's where I'll be waiting.""

1629605171.m_KeyValue: ""If you want answers, then find me in the sealed area...""

1629609516.m_KeyValue: ""Hate to say this, but we're not out of the woods yet.""

1629609517.m_KeyValue: "You did it. Noah! You really stopped the Divine Body!"

1629609520.m_KeyValue: "I won't let it... end like this!"

1629609523.m_KeyValue: ""Even if I become Death, I am still Noah... Nevernight!""

1637369529.m_KeyValue: "The remains of these nightmares didn't disappear... they've crystallized into fragments. Is this... salt?"

1637370497.m_KeyValue: "That guy with silver hair?! He's on this island as well?"

1637370503.m_KeyValue: ""This is about your family's duty and finding yourself. In the end, you must face it alone.""

1637370504.m_KeyValue: ""After losing your temper, you're back to acting like a Bell Ringer.""

1637370505.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella, are you saying... you'll help me fight against Death? That's wonderful! With you by my side...""

1637370506.m_KeyValue: "Don't get your hopes up. Albrecht must have told you that the Bell Ringers are not allowed to interfere too much with the 'predetermined future'..."

1637370507.m_KeyValue: "Noah! I almost forgot he was knocked off the cliff by Death's minions! I have to save him!"

1637370508.m_KeyValue: "...Did you just say Noah? It couldn't be..."

1637370509.m_KeyValue: ""...I understand now. I've made my decision. I used to believe I was all alone, that no one needed me...""

1637370510.m_KeyValue: ""But in truth, Grandmother and you, Acappella, have always been protecting me. As well as Master, and even Noah, whom I just met today...""

1637371585.m_KeyValue: ""Are we sure about this? We're helping Isaac again, even though he's running with the Bloodborn now.""

1637371586.m_KeyValue: ""Albrecht's dim-witted disciple should be able to put two and two together by now. I've dropped enough hints, after all.""

1637371592.m_KeyValue: ""—Hmm, you've got a point, Darcias. If we help out this Van-whatever kid, Albrecht will owe me another one.""

1637371593.m_KeyValue: "Lady Acappella... did you just imply Noah's presence on this island as well?"

1637371594.m_KeyValue: "Did she say silver hair?! So she's looking for Noah too?"

1637371595.m_KeyValue: "Why didn't you tell us in the first place."

1637371596.m_KeyValue: "—Their weak point is located just above the center of their chest. Target that spot and strike!"

1637371597.m_KeyValue: ""—Listen up, I'll only say this once: those minions are all smoke and mirrors. They're actually very weak...""

1637371598.m_KeyValue: "And this has nothing to do with Master Albrecht. Stop trying to use me to get to him all the time!"

1637373763.m_KeyValue: "...He said grandmother regretted betraying the family's heritage; regretted running away from her duty."

1637373764.m_KeyValue: "R-Regret? That Albrecht was always spouting nonsense!"

1637373767.m_KeyValue: ""In his eyes, Grandmother was... smart, brave, and bold... He always spoke well of her, but there was one thing that would always make him sad...""

1637373768.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, what kind of person was your grandmother, according to your master?""

1637373769.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... He said grandmother was always putting on a courageous smile, but deep down she was full of regret.""

1637373770.m_KeyValue: "That bastard is capable of feeling sadness? Hmph!"

1637373772.m_KeyValue: ""It may not be my place to say this, but I believe Piera's master wanted her to choose her own path in life.""

1637373773.m_KeyValue: "Piera told me that her master would always tell her stories about her grandmother... about you..."

1637373774.m_KeyValue: "You're wrong! You don't know anything about that madman! His eyes see nothing but his work and evolution!"

1638937483.m_KeyValue: ""Where is the Tempus Church now, when the world cries out for salvation? Where are these so-called protectors of the living?""

1638937484.m_KeyValue: ""—been consumed? Fed to the Church's divine order, like good little fuel?""

1639557276.m_KeyValue: "I don't even know who my 'true self' is right now."

1639558235.m_KeyValue: ""Do you really think I, the noble Lady Bathory, would be interested in some poor, backwater region up north?""

1639559289.m_KeyValue: "But why is the Black Blood Disease in town? Is this why the Church attacked?"

1639559323.m_KeyValue: ""Surprised, aren't you? She's not as weak as we thought.""

1639560314.m_KeyValue: ""Are you kidding me? If it's forbidden grounds, how could I possibly take outsiders there?""

1639560315.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, the 'forbidden grounds' are just a legend. In the whole town, perhaps only my father knows if such a place really exists.""

1639560316.m_KeyValue: "That's perfect then. We can go to town together to help your father and ask him about it."

1648771828.m_KeyValue: ""Other rituals can enhance the abilities of Vassals, depending on their Faction and Equipment type.""

1649805412.m_KeyValue: ""No way, Loudmouth, you look fearless but you're actually afraid of heights!""

1649806435.m_KeyValue: ""Because I was deemed one of the Moonblessed from the prophecy, I was resurrected as a Bloodborn.""

1649806436.m_KeyValue: ""Heh, you're the first to joke with me like that.""

1649811418.m_KeyValue: ""An almost eternal lifespan of memories, yet confined to a rusting metal vessel. I can understand his obsession with flesh.""

1649812441.m_KeyValue: "What are you saying? How could any of the elders have such a notion?"

1649812442.m_KeyValue: "You are right about one thing: you made a big mistake when you past on the oppotunity to help Empousa save Noah Nevernight."

1649815509.m_KeyValue: "I don't recall being from the same clan as scum like you."

1649815510.m_KeyValue: ""The gift I sent you, do you like it?""

1649816533.m_KeyValue: "I remember now! They said we are linked by blood."

1651407752.m_KeyValue: ""Planning to sell it off, are you?""

1651407754.m_KeyValue: "So he is here. If I may... could I see him?"

1651957683.m_KeyValue: "Van Helsing! Go to the sealed area—stop the fourth family!"

1651957684.m_KeyValue: "Why do you hesitate? I am now your enemy. Isn't it your duty... to strike me down?"

1651957685.m_KeyValue: "Then she must have arrived long before us... And yet—no sign of her since."

1651958706.m_KeyValue: ""And what of you? Where would you go, if given the choice?""

1651958709.m_KeyValue: ""...It always ends like this, doesn't it?""

1651977243.m_KeyValue: "The treasure chest lies just ahead. Let’s head out."

1651977246.m_KeyValue: "Decoy is a highly deceptive skill that lures enemies to a designated location."

1651977248.m_KeyValue: "Select a suitable tile to lead our friend astray."

1651977250.m_KeyValue: ""Good, let’s take a moment to rest and wait for our prey to walk into the web.""

1652699408.m_KeyValue: ""Forget the walking scrap heap—what about her? She's a Bloodborn, isn't she? You won't fool me.""

1653249331.m_KeyValue: "Then it was you... You were the one who revived this Noah."

1653249332.m_KeyValue: "Hmph... You're quite sure of yourself. But I'm not the only Bell Ringer in this place."

1653249333.m_KeyValue: "They wouldn't simply let Agares pass without resistance."

1653249334.m_KeyValue: "They are the Four Knights of the Apocalypse!"

1653249335.m_KeyValue: "There are four paths ahead. Which one do we take?"

1653249336.m_KeyValue: "Have faith in Noah. He's nearly a Bell Ringer's equal now."

1653249337.m_KeyValue: "Instead of her… I want to know where Agares went."

1653249338.m_KeyValue: "So they fought here...? A battle between Bell Ringers—I wish I'd seen that!"

1653249339.m_KeyValue: "She's the one who stopped us—surrounded by lightning."

1653250355.m_KeyValue: "You're struggling just to speak… Allow me to put you out of your misery. No need to keep wasting Lady Empousa's time—nor Mother's."

1653250356.m_KeyValue: "That silly wolf and jellyfish? What did you do to them?!"

1653250357.m_KeyValue: "What... should I do? What would Aiona do?"

1653250358.m_KeyValue: ""Then what about Mother? You're so desperate to resurrect her—yet you don't even see her as an ally, do you? I knew you had another motive!""

1653250359.m_KeyValue: ""We're sisters! Compared with the _$$Mother_$$ we've never even seen, we're... we're family.""

1653250361.m_KeyValue: ""I'd had a bad feeling, but I never imagined it would come to this...""

1653250364.m_KeyValue: "—This is where all of us _$$sisters_$$ are destined for."

1655052589.m_KeyValue: ""Cartographer, shouldn't finding what you've sought be a cause for joy? Why then does your gaze grow so grave?""

1655052596.m_KeyValue: "Michelangelo protected you in his way. Now it's our turn to fight on. We can't let his sacrifice be in vain."

1655052597.m_KeyValue: ""That's right, Quinn. This is exactly what Tertius wanted—he's trying to break you.""

1655052598.m_KeyValue: "Every strike lands where it hurts most. A merciless hunter who threads weakness into the very soul."

1655052599.m_KeyValue: ""...You're right, Agnes. We can't let more petals... fall.""

1655052600.m_KeyValue: "Elder Sirene...? But she... has always been neutral..."

1655052601.m_KeyValue: ""In the castle, only one holds such power.""

1655052602.m_KeyValue: ""Then likely, you'll have to confront her head-on soon.""

1655052603.m_KeyValue: ""Evidently, Elder Tertius's offer this time... was enough to sway her.""

1655053612.m_KeyValue: "I'm not even a real cartographer—that was just a lie I told James and myself!"

1655053613.m_KeyValue: "I failed the cartographer's exam four times. I can't even conduct a survey..."

1655053620.m_KeyValue: ""My mother wrote in her letter, 'What your eyes see is not always the truth, but what your heart believes will lead you to the light.'""

1655053621.m_KeyValue: ""She urged me to follow my instincts… to place faith in my path, even when all signs said otherwise.""

1655053622.m_KeyValue: "This horrible switch... it won't activate at all!"

1655053623.m_KeyValue: ""Of course it won't... because you're here too early, a whole year ahead.""

1655053624.m_KeyValue: "You're... that old janitor from the dungeon?"

1655053625.m_KeyValue: ""No trace of Cain, yet we have this strange old man... You seem to know a lot, would you help us?""

1655053626.m_KeyValue: ""You were never meant to activate this elevator. As the cartographer, your designated survey will happen one year from now. In a few months, your grandfather will teach you how to operate this elevator, but not now...""

1655053627.m_KeyValue: "Enough! We have no time for your nonsense..."

1655054766.m_KeyValue: "You may have ended the Long Night. It was but a Scourge—a fleeting shadow. But I… I am the true master of this land. I am eternal!"

1655054767.m_KeyValue: ""Father-daughter bond? Hah… No daughter of mine would carry such filthy, traitorous blood—let alone spend her days meddling and standing in the way of my great work!""

1655054772.m_KeyValue: "I couldn't find any in town... so... so I had to venture across the river..."

1655054773.m_KeyValue: "So it was you... who stole Wolfsbane from town..."

1655054775.m_KeyValue: ""Your seemingly 'perfect fuel' is missing the key, doesn't it?""

1655054776.m_KeyValue: "Put out this fire. Now. Or I swear... not even blood will stay my blade."

1655054777.m_KeyValue: "Wolfsbane was Mother's favorite flower... and your token of love. How could you twist it for your evil schemes?"

1655054778.m_KeyValue: ""I refuse to watch my homeland and my people devoured by fire. If I must fall, I’ll make sure that demon burns in hell with me.""

1655054779.m_KeyValue: ""You fool, shouldn't you stay in town? What are you doing here?""

1663897775.m_KeyValue: ""His wounds should have healed, but it seems he's in pain from something else...""

1665719609.m_KeyValue: "And Joan—leader of the Chamber of War—is far more skilled than she is."

1665719610.m_KeyValue: ""Tch, just as annoying as the last one. Tell me they don't get back up too?""

1665722809.m_KeyValue: "Your safety comes first. Why don't we wait until they've worn each other out before we make our move?"

1665722810.m_KeyValue: ""The breaking of the Divine Body's seal has unleashed the Black Blood, causing them to evolve by themselves.""

1666163206.m_KeyValue: "A basic detector that identifies potential threats."

1666906422.m_KeyValue: "Now that I know what became of my mother… I can understand your hatred for the Ganelon."

1666916160.m_KeyValue: "Three centuries before the full outbreak of the Black Blood disease"

1669495972.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps she's feeling the same way I did when I saved you."
