1673800040.m_KeyValue: "This feature is temporarily unavailable due to date restrictions."

1677201322.m_KeyValue: ""A breeze passes. The mantle on my shoulders softly caresses my cheek, like a ghost's touch.""

1677201323.m_KeyValue: ""I feel a gentle tap on my shoulder, but there is no one behind me.""

1677201325.m_KeyValue: "Looks like this mantle won't be coming off so easily."

1677952504.m_KeyValue: "I'm starting to think we shouldn't have saved him."

1677955705.m_KeyValue: ""Get out of my way, you damn bastards!""

1681331678.m_KeyValue: ""Moreover, the Bathory steward often appears and disappears mysteriously, and his words are always cryptic. We should investigate what he's really up to.""

1681331911.m_KeyValue: ""I see these new friends all strictly following our precepts, even better than regular vassals in fact. So why should their rights be treated differently?""

1681331977.m_KeyValue: "Unraveling the 'mystery of eternal life' has always been our family's desire. Why don't we have this vassal lead a fleet to investigate?"

1681332008.m_KeyValue: ""Moreover, the Church and major families are desperately trying to collect them, apparently because these treasures can greatly enhance Blood power. We Bathory cannot miss this opportunity—we must quickly arrange a fleet to salvage them.""

1681332043.m_KeyValue: ""It's a completely new system of alchemy. If we invest a bit more time in studying it, we might stumble upon some unexpected breakthroughs.""

1681332074.m_KeyValue: ""If vassals use and research with the alchemical facilities more, it can enhance the power of our entire family in the long run. Let's encourage everyone to give it a try!""

1681332140.m_KeyValue: ""For stones with absolutely no practical value, the Church is willing to sacrifice numerous soldiers to mine them... This is too suspicious. We should send people to investigate.""

1684994573.m_KeyValue: "It's not that... I just realized... I might have done something bad."

1684994574.m_KeyValue: ""...I recall you saying the village was at the base of the mountain, but we've been subtly veering off the right path this whole time...""

1684994575.m_KeyValue: ""Yes. You see, the phantoms had already existed on the island, but they never harmed anyone. It was only after being corrupted by Death that they turned into these nightmares.""

1684994576.m_KeyValue: "A Bell Ringer?! Are you saying a Bell Ringer has come to this island again? Just like what happened 66 years ago?"

1684994605.m_KeyValue: "That's ridiculous! Wouldn't we know if we were a phantom?"

1684994606.m_KeyValue: ""I don't remember dying... Do you, Noah?""

1684994607.m_KeyValue: ""Jason, Sora, and I, along with you and Dr. Ressa, have been living together on this island for many years now.""

1684994631.m_KeyValue: ""The resolve to challenge predetermined fate with a fragile form; the courage to pursue one's own will in the face of cruel reality, that is—""

1684994632.m_KeyValue: "Is it truly appropriate to speak of someone in such a manner when they're present?"

1684994637.m_KeyValue: "I haven't even said what your crime was. Aren't you getting ahead of yourself?"

1684994638.m_KeyValue: "You should understand this better than anyone else in this world. Yet you still did it... Why did it have to be you..."

1684994639.m_KeyValue: "You're not ready to use Covenant just yet."

1684994641.m_KeyValue: "Twenty-one. Never underestimate a Bell Ringer's sense of time."

1684994642.m_KeyValue: "Why do you have the same look in your eyes as that old woman? Why is everyone abandoning me?"

1684994643.m_KeyValue: ""What nonsense are you spouting! You're about to lose your life, and you're talking about duty?!""

1684994644.m_KeyValue: ""Isn't a Vice-Commander always with their Bell Ringer when on duty? ...Just like you, idiot.""

1684994663.m_KeyValue: "—A loud sound is coming from the easternmost part of the island."

1684994664.m_KeyValue: ""After inheriting the 'Air Manipulation' ability from the 10th Bell Ringer, she became even more adept at controlling the air to enhance her sound abilities.""

1684994669.m_KeyValue: "I don't get it. What are you two talking about?"

1684994670.m_KeyValue: "She's not the Piera from 66 years ago! She's the granddaughter of that old hag—of that person!"

1684994671.m_KeyValue: ""...You could say we were shipmates for a while, searching for Sunset Isle.""

1684994673.m_KeyValue: "Your heartbeat has calmed down. I can sense the courage you two give each other."

1684994674.m_KeyValue: ""And should that one-in-a-million scenario come to pass, I'll be compelled to act—with such extremity that no one around me will be safe.""

1684994675.m_KeyValue: ""Of course, they weren't completely destroyed... Rumor was that they managed to achieve some form of 'eternal life' and now live in seclusion, adhering to the First Tenet of Secrecy.""

1684994676.m_KeyValue: "No... what I mean is... Noah might be a Bloodborn... an enemy of the Church. I don't want you to harm him..."

1684994698.m_KeyValue: "Commander! She's... my friend! How can you speak of this so lightly..."

1684994701.m_KeyValue: ""We were going to spare you, as one of the family, but you know too much...""

1684994702.m_KeyValue: ""You must leave now, little Piera. You can't go any deeper.""

1684994705.m_KeyValue: ""Um... I think you might have me confused with someone else. My name is Piera, but... the Piera you know... is probably my grandmother?""

1684994706.m_KeyValue: "Thoughts come from oneself while longings involve others."

1684994707.m_KeyValue: ""Great ancestors... please hear me out. Death, who was sealed away 66 years ago by my grandmother and the Church, has broken free and returned.""

1684994708.m_KeyValue: ""It's also our shared memory of fighting against Death, coursing through our blood.""

1684994729.m_KeyValue: "Piera! Are you alright?! Are you hurt anywhere?"

1684994730.m_KeyValue: ""At the time, I still held onto my determination to destroy Death with my own hands, so I agreed. But little did I know...""

1684994733.m_KeyValue: "So that's why those former inhabitants of Sunset Isle became Death's followers... and turned into those monsters."

1684994734.m_KeyValue: ""No... no! Grandmother, you once told me... this isn't... isn't how we should 'live'!""

1684994735.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you for understanding... Noah, I remember 66 years ago, you were the only one who understood my decision...""

1684994736.m_KeyValue: ""He gave you the salt stake that I had sealed away... if you really became a sacrifice, he'd be Death's accomplice!""

1684994737.m_KeyValue: ""This statue... it's beautiful, but also so... full of sorrow...""

1684994738.m_KeyValue: ""If Death hadn't escaped from the Church, I would have almost... fallen into a life that was never meant to be mine...""

1684994739.m_KeyValue: "It's time to end this... end this curse that has shackled us for generations..."

1684994740.m_KeyValue: ""I know... but I'm the family's last Gravekeeper. This is the duty you entrusted to me, Grandmother. I have to...""

1684994767.m_KeyValue: ""Geez, I've been waiting all this time...""

1684994768.m_KeyValue: ""This isn't who I am! And you, Piera... this can't be your destiny!""

1684994770.m_KeyValue: "While I can... still hold on... run Noah... the further... the better..."

1684994771.m_KeyValue: "Just hold on! I'm trying to remember! I have to stop the bleeding somehow!"

1685991648.m_KeyValue: "Seems like the light half is on his way here. You've outlived your purpose."

1685991651.m_KeyValue: ""I believed this place—this ruin—would give birth to a new order, one shaped by the free.""

1686366182.m_KeyValue: "A basic CPU with slightly different performance focus compared to Type I."

1687180899.m_KeyValue: ""He's what I've been chasing my whole life, and the one who led me out of my despair.""

1687180900.m_KeyValue: "Why is the Church targeting Mouret? Just because the Black Blood has spread here?"

1687180901.m_KeyValue: "That's a horrific thought you just blurted out!"

1687180902.m_KeyValue: "I... I can't bear to lose anyone else!"

1687180931.m_KeyValue: ""Now you're at your wit's end, having turned into this state yourself. My old friend... do you have any regrets?""

1687181196.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph! The north of Lupine Forest is overrun by a bunch of savage, smelly werewolves! How could we possibly have good relations with them?""

1687181197.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, Brave travelers! I shall remember this charitable deed in my heart...""

1687181198.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm... fangs, long ears, and pale skin...""

1687181229.m_KeyValue: ""If you can block my attack, I'll leave you be. What do you say?""

1687181232.m_KeyValue: ""Very well, I'll wait here and see if you can forge a different path.""

1687181233.m_KeyValue: "This young lady speaks quite rudely! I am not one to break my promises!"

1687181259.m_KeyValue: ""The 'moon' is likely just a symbol. Before we set out, he mentioned that Mouret harbors a set of 'forbidden grounds.'""

1687181261.m_KeyValue: "I want to change that. I want to fight back. I want to know 'why.'"

1687181265.m_KeyValue: "We can't let these stinking bats push us around! Let's teach them a lesson!"

1687181266.m_KeyValue: "Didn't you call me a butcher? You're just a mangy wolf who believes everything you hear!"

1687181295.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, so the Ganelon family does have someone worth a second look after all.""

1687181296.m_KeyValue: ""Calm down, Lady Empousa. We can't just leave her behind now.""

1687181297.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry, we haven't seen anyone else besides you and a knight with a garlic-shaped head.""

1687181298.m_KeyValue: ""So it's all true? Your betrayal of The Church, and the rumors about embracing the power of Black Blood?!""

1687181323.m_KeyValue: "Um... What I meant to say was..."

1687181327.m_KeyValue: ""But if you insist on following me, that's your choice...""

1687181328.m_KeyValue: "Leave them out of this. I'm the one you're after!"

1687181330.m_KeyValue: "What's with this kid? Why's he so attached to you?"

1687181358.m_KeyValue: ""That person over there just now, could it be...""

1687181359.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, I didn't know you were versed in medicine.""

1687181360.m_KeyValue: ""As I thought, it's not so easy to shake off these persistent bastards...""

1687181361.m_KeyValue: ""When we separated, he went north alone to draw away the Church. That direction is... Ah!""

1687181362.m_KeyValue: ""No, at least not the current me. But my past self... I'm not sure.""

1687181389.m_KeyValue: ""But don't be afraid, Hati. I'll protect you, just like when we were kids!""

1687181390.m_KeyValue: "But now's not the time for reminiscing."

1687181391.m_KeyValue: "The Church already has monsters like the Bell Ringers. Why do they need each family's Gravekeeper to guard anything?"

1687181392.m_KeyValue: "No way! I don't smell any hostility at all!"

1687181394.m_KeyValue: ""He doesn't want you to be the Gravekeeper, so I have to inherit the role...""

1687283302.m_KeyValue: "This isn't suppose to happen! The ritual hasn't even—"

1687283305.m_KeyValue: ""And now, I've found a way to bring Joan back. So we can stand guard over this land—together—forever.""

1691861444.m_KeyValue: ""Be very careful, though the Soulless is their leader, the most dangerous one is actually that white-haired....""

1691861445.m_KeyValue: ""Are you referring to me? Coming from you, it's an honor.""

1691861450.m_KeyValue: "How dare you speak of Jacintha like that!"

1691861451.m_KeyValue: ""You can't even tell Empousa and Lamia apart, yet you're judging a cat's beauty?""

1691861452.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, the lovely Jacintha caught a whiff of danger and ran off first—""

1691861454.m_KeyValue: "(sighing) As the newest elder... I suppose I should deal with it."

1691861455.m_KeyValue: "I don't know how strong they are... but we're all seasoned warriors too!"

1691861456.m_KeyValue: "Enough! Are you two waiting for me to do everything myself?!"

1691861457.m_KeyValue: "Eh? But this new 'silver-haired' lad looks like he could become a lucrative customer. I'd hate to kill a potential client."

1691862599.m_KeyValue: ""Shh! Keep your voice down, or we'll attract the guards!""

1691862602.m_KeyValue: ""You're... the fabled shepherd of the Moonblessed, Aiona Alita!""

1691862604.m_KeyValue: "I am a faithful follower of the Moonblessed! Please take me with you! I will surely be of help!"

1691862605.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, uh... this warrior with the booming voice is...""

1691862606.m_KeyValue: ""I swear, if I ever make it out alive, I will have my revenge!""

1691862607.m_KeyValue: "That demon has hated flesh ever since. Unfortunately my clansmen were natural-born warriors with strong builds..."

1692410499.m_KeyValue: ""Then here's to you, the warmonger who claims to be a peace advocate.""

1692410501.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps that's why she took the earring... In her eyes, I'm gradually becoming another Carrelle.""

1692410502.m_KeyValue: "Why would I want to get involved in something this complicated?"

1697352331.m_KeyValue: ""Either way, you've saved my life, and I'll repay that debt for sure.""

1697353353.m_KeyValue: ""Black uniform, silver hair... it's him! The heretic that escaped, Noah Nevernight!""

1697616905.m_KeyValue: "You have to rub it... just... the right... way."

1697890531.m_KeyValue: ""Eh? The chest is locked too? Well, well, seems the Church's enforcers have actually gotten smarter.""

1698827127.m_KeyValue: ""Units that pass through the werewolf's Blood Trail will be inflicted with Pestilence, taking DMG equal to a percentage of their Max HP per sec, while boosting DMG dealt by {0}. This effect lasts until the end of the battle.""

1699753573.m_KeyValue: "Exactly. That lance is the key they've been searching for."

1699753575.m_KeyValue: ""I don't care if she fought beside you. This is our last refuge, and I won't have her join us.""

1709470347.m_KeyValue: "Fine by me! Let's finish them all off in one go!"

1709564601.m_KeyValue: "Shall we go make some new memories?"

1709564602.m_KeyValue: ""Two figures walk side by side, slowly surrendering themselves to the embrace of shadow.""

1709564603.m_KeyValue: "But when I saw that child's remains... I felt afraid again."

1709564604.m_KeyValue: "There are things that must be done while I still can."

1709564605.m_KeyValue: ""And yet, you're the one who said you wanted to see me.""

1710139375.m_KeyValue: "Anna should teach you how to speak..."

1717406506.m_KeyValue: "Grateful? So you repay your kindness by sending your two underlings to keep Empousa from me?"

1717406508.m_KeyValue: "Noah Nevernight was the first to slip through the cracks of my design. But you... you've surpassed even him."

1717406509.m_KeyValue: ""I enjoy keeping secrets—but I do not lie. If I tell you this, it is only because I do not fear your knowing it.""

1717406510.m_KeyValue: ""He lived with me. In this world, he is unlikely to meet an opponent stronger than I. He'll survive.""

1717406511.m_KeyValue: "You must be dying to know—why did she come here? What is she fighting for? So many questions... waiting for her to answer."

1717407526.m_KeyValue: "I just woke up. Prepare my food."

1717407527.m_KeyValue: ""The Blood Moon rises, and the long night approaches... At last, the era of us new Bloodborn begins.""

1717407528.m_KeyValue: ""Fortunately, I had already removed three unwanted observers.""

1717407529.m_KeyValue: ""Forgive my little tricks, but... I wasn't confident I could defeat both of you.""

1717407530.m_KeyValue: ""I will defeat you, defeat Cain and the Long Night, defeat all the divine wills and laws that dare toy with our lives!""

1717407531.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you, Noah, for letting me witness the end of a new fate...""

1717407534.m_KeyValue: ""Huh? I just asked why this island is surrounded by ocean, what's he going on about?""

1717407535.m_KeyValue: ""So, can your mentor really kill anyone? ...Even someone cursed with immortality?""

1719322132.m_KeyValue: ""Her ranged magic is just as deadly. I'm sorry, but I must live on!""

1720871932.m_KeyValue: "Rituals have been banned for several hundred years following the decline of the families."

1720871963.m_KeyValue: "Beware of those spirits... the Soulless' power comes from them."

1720872056.m_KeyValue: ""Empousa is weakened now, so try to prevent her from getting hurt.""

1720872122.m_KeyValue: ""You're right, that large suit of armor housing the memories of Jestel's mother is their leader!""

1723991064.m_KeyValue: "Give Noah back! He can't endure this pain any longer!"

1729583991.m_KeyValue: ""Hahaha! After all these years, I can finally reclaim all that you took from me! My flesh, my pride!""

1729845264.m_KeyValue: ""Never speak Mother's name! You show no mercy for your own kin... Today, you will face the consequences of your atrocities.""

1729876772.m_KeyValue: "What!? The seal on the Divine Body… it's been broken!?"

1729876775.m_KeyValue: "Probably a sign you're not eating right."

1729876776.m_KeyValue: "Expect us to ditch her and just walk away? Absolutely not!"

1729876778.m_KeyValue: "Being a Bell Ringer is my duty. It does not define my beliefs. The task of guarding a Divine Body… is a curse upon every family burdened with it."

1729876779.m_KeyValue: "You've found companions who truly understand you. This journey wasn't in vain after all."

1729876780.m_KeyValue: ""Not a moment... It's been forty years since you were my mentor, Sir Yggdrasill.""

1729876781.m_KeyValue: "I always suspected you were extraordinary. That ability to reverse time… and the fact that you never needed to drink blood..."

1731168434.m_KeyValue: "But I thought getting a surname meant I was no longer a slave?"

1731168435.m_KeyValue: "And here I thought the silver-haired Agares was something special. Guess even he can eat dirt."

1731168436.m_KeyValue: ""Don't you get it? Without a surname, you stay a slave forever.""

1732458333.m_KeyValue: "The relationships within the Bathory family are... rather complicated."

1739464666.m_KeyValue: "You seem quite certain I'll stand by your side."

1739464668.m_KeyValue: ""But in her eyes, ever since I became the Bell Ringer, war seems to have turned into a weapon that destroys freedom.""

1739464669.m_KeyValue: ""Or perhaps you're gathering strength. If I remember correctly, your crimson flames symbolize destruction, while the azure flames that almost no one has seen...""

1739779119.m_KeyValue: ""One of the <style=""Highlight"">Moonblessed</style>! That silver hair is proof enough.""

1739779120.m_KeyValue: ""<style=""Highlight"">Bloodborn</style>? You mean like vampires from those tall tales?""

1743124828.m_KeyValue: "Shouldn't you have left the castle by now?"

1743124829.m_KeyValue: "Did No. 66's weapons fail to finish us all off?"

1744194040.m_KeyValue: "I... I don't want to see Noah die either!"

1744357821.m_KeyValue: ""You may look slow, but at least you know you're in trouble.""

1746962512.m_KeyValue: ""But in a place unknown to them, the Star has already entwined with the Devil.""

1746962513.m_KeyValue: ""Before we face the Sun… This Judgment, born in the heart of a storm, has only reached its intermission.""

1746962516.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know whether it was right to stay silent… There was never a sailor named ""Jack"" on this ship.""

1746962517.m_KeyValue: ""Driven by the Wheel of Fortune, this Chariot has begun to stray.""

1746962518.m_KeyValue: "The Emperor is dead—yet my pact with him must continue."

1746962519.m_KeyValue: ""The Fool and Justice shall soon cross paths once more, and together they shall write the epitaph of the Hanged Man.""

1746962520.m_KeyValue: "Though now that I think of it… Hasn't the ship's course been odd for some time? Who's at the helm?"

1746962521.m_KeyValue: ""It should be that sailor, Jack—the one who helped us fight the Blood Beast… I think I got his name right this time.""

1746962522.m_KeyValue: ""Jack...? I understand. Go, Van Helsing. Go after William. Leave the helm to me.""

1746962523.m_KeyValue: "I'll make sure William pays dearly for what he did to you… and to Goldland."

1749907714.m_KeyValue: "Hours on foot... and still nothing. I can't return empty-handed..."

1756618770.m_KeyValue: "But I might still die. No—I will die."

1756618772.m_KeyValue: ""And I wouldn't stop talking about old stories. That wasn't very appropriate, was it?""

1756618773.m_KeyValue: "So I thought—some things are better said while there's still time."

1778222603.m_KeyValue: "Just another day survived. Will tomorrow even be different?"

1782205630.m_KeyValue: ""No problem! Then this is the perfect time for another cup! One sip, and you'll be an Alita local!""

1782205634.m_KeyValue: ""Then maybe… in that yellow desert of yours, an almond milk oasis is starting to form.""

1791143594.m_KeyValue: "You said these disgusting things were the seeds of Plague?"

1791143626.m_KeyValue: "I see. You really are the type of person who takes promises very seriously..."

1791143627.m_KeyValue: "That's why Clive could see their memories just now. And these carriers... can also glimpse into Clive's memories!"

1791143628.m_KeyValue: ""No, he hasn't given up fighting the Black Blood yet.""

1794584543.m_KeyValue: ""I was rather hoping the object of your devotion was the sea, not... something stranger.""

1794584545.m_KeyValue: ""I, Isaac Van Helsing, Eighth of the Silver Cross, hereby commence inquisitorial judgment upon you—Captain Goldland.""

1872214254.m_KeyValue: ""My choice to stay here does not mean my life has ended. On the contrary, it has begun anew.""

1872214255.m_KeyValue: "Is it actually real? If not a dream... Could it be the afterlife?"

1872214256.m_KeyValue: ""This world on the 'Other Side' is strange, Noah. What felt like a brief moment outside seemed to last for days here.""

1872214257.m_KeyValue: ""I don't really get it, but we've really gone back twenty years.""

1872214258.m_KeyValue: ""I also couldn't fathom why Father was so cruel to abandon us to keep a solitary vigil at the forbidden grounds, waiting for someone he refused to speak of...""

1873620834.m_KeyValue: "C-Cain!? You... Why are you with them?"

1873626050.m_KeyValue: "Someone in Priest Mira's team was injured. They said they'll catch up with us later."

1876196607.m_KeyValue: "If I am Noah Nevernight... I should return to the home where Ressa is waiting... but..."

1879495813.m_KeyValue: ""Ow, ow… give me a break. I just crawled out of a brutal fight—can't a man rest for one moment?""

1879979399.m_KeyValue: ""Why didn't he stop it? He's no friend of Father's, and he's no Uncle Gadric to us!""

1879979403.m_KeyValue: "The Church's claim that 'Black Blood disease is God's punishment upon Heretics' is nothing but a lie they've been feeding you."

1879979433.m_KeyValue: ""Skoll used to always go with you to pick Wolfsbane, Hati.""

1879979434.m_KeyValue: "Gadric once said that worse than death... is emptiness."

1879979462.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed. I wanted to have one last stroll with a friend, so I took a slight detour.""

1879979463.m_KeyValue: "Is... is that guy also one of the infected townsfolk? He looks way more intimidating than the others."

1879979464.m_KeyValue: ""I'm ashamed to admit, I didn't realize you were the man Clive had been waiting for.""

1879979465.m_KeyValue: "Easy for you to say! I'm going to help him!"

1880817196.m_KeyValue: "Successfully bound. You can now log in to Silver and Blood mobile via phone number and sync your game progress and services. Please keep your account safe."

1884177818.m_KeyValue: ""Cooking destroys the essence of blood. Would you have us adopt the digestive sensibilities of humans? In my view, we should steadfastly maintain the Bloodborn tradition of consuming raw sustenance.""

1884177915.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, what good could possibly come from anything made by the Church? If you ask me, we'd be better off saving our money!""

1884348162.m_KeyValue:
"What kind of rain will that cloud bring?
The spider cannot say."

1884348163.m_KeyValue:
""'Bathe in the moonlight of yesteryear.'
Under the whispers of a masked woman, returned to the crossroads from earlier.""

1884348164.m_KeyValue:
"Skating on the ice.
The mechanical spider knew no childhood."

1884348165.m_KeyValue:
""The need for speed gradually diminishes.
The mechanical spider, ravaged by sandstorms, has slowly lost its will to fight.""

1895480601.m_KeyValue: "Paracelsus... the Calamity that our family has sealed for generations..."

1895480602.m_KeyValue: "Noah... are you not going to ask anymore? Do you believe me?"

1895480603.m_KeyValue: "Yes... that Bell Ringer ended up sacrificing herself during the battle against Death..."

1895480604.m_KeyValue: "Hold on a second! You just said there are no living people on this island now. That means your family's struggles..."

1895480605.m_KeyValue: "N-No... it's not that... it's... it's Death. It..."

1895480607.m_KeyValue: "We both have to live on. We'll meet again someday... I know we will."

1895480610.m_KeyValue: ""For some reason, this thing's contamination doesn't seem to affect me. But in terms of raw fighting ability...""

1895480634.m_KeyValue: "Of course... That explains why another one appeared out of nowhere."

1895480635.m_KeyValue: "You can thank me later. Right now we need to get to the village!"

1895480636.m_KeyValue: "Damn it! Damn the Black Blood! Why does it keep tormenting us?!"

1895480637.m_KeyValue: ""Sora isn't a...! He's a living, breathing person!""

1895480638.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, are you listening? The Black Blood disease on the island has spiraled beyond you and the doctor's control.""

1895480898.m_KeyValue: "I wonder what happened to Empousa and the others on the ship... Hm?"

1895480932.m_KeyValue: ""And apart from those Black Blood crabs, I haven't seen any other living creatures.""

1895480962.m_KeyValue: "But since this was also your family's origins... Is there any chance you've heard someone mention me?"

1895480963.m_KeyValue: "Just call me Noah. By the way..."

1895480964.m_KeyValue: "I've never actually lived here. Most of what I know I heard from my family."

1895480967.m_KeyValue: ""Nevernight... Wow, your name is just like the legend! So you really are from here!""

1895480993.m_KeyValue: ""She said... Welcome back to the home of the sunset, to the... 'resting place of memories.'""

1895480994.m_KeyValue: "...Sorry. I just had a really strange encounter. It's still messing with my head."

1895480997.m_KeyValue: "It is you! The young man who's always with Dr. Ressa!"

1895480998.m_KeyValue: ""I've been meaning to ask, why have you been carrying that coffin this whole time?""

1895480999.m_KeyValue: ""Give back everything you took from us, Noah Nevernight!""

1895481000.m_KeyValue: "(coughing) I don't want to die... I don't... want to die alone... You're coming with me!"

1895481029.m_KeyValue: ""I do not know the answer to that, but the Saint said...""

1895481030.m_KeyValue: "Orders are orders. He escaped some days ago and they tasked us with recapturing him."

1895481031.m_KeyValue: "But if there's really a traitor in league with the Calamity among the twelve Bell Ringers... I can't even fathom the catastrophe it would bring."

1895481061.m_KeyValue: "Noah... are you alright? You look terribly pale..."

1895481062.m_KeyValue: ""You brought death upon us, you turned us into these... abominations.""

1895481064.m_KeyValue: "Noah... you don't think I'm just making this up... do you?"

1895481089.m_KeyValue: "And what each person sees is based on who they long for and those that long for them."

1895481090.m_KeyValue: ""The Divine Bodies I've encountered before didn't have any set forms. One turned out to be an entire cave, while another was a golden tree shaped like a ship's keel.""

1895481092.m_KeyValue: ""Where to begin... Ah, yes. My grandmother told me that up until 66 years ago... all members of our family were still living on this island...""

1895481093.m_KeyValue: "You've been so open with me. I shouldn't keep this from you either. The truth is..."

1895481094.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, what's wrong? Why are you crying...?""

1895481095.m_KeyValue: "I believe you. But that doesn't mean you haven't heard about this place... Perhaps from relatives who once lived here?"

1895481096.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... As you deduced, the Paracelsus family has been the 'Gravekeepers' of Sunset Isle for generations.""

1895686073.m_KeyValue: "And you expect me to nod along while lives are thrown away for your hollow fantasy of returning to the moon?"

1895686074.m_KeyValue: "As expected of you. Naive. Stubborn. And strong enough to see it through."

1895686075.m_KeyValue: ""We—the children of Dracula—are awakening. And together, we shall return... to the Other Side.""

1896976703.m_KeyValue: "I want to know if that's true."

1896976704.m_KeyValue: ""At this rate, I'll be buried beside this garlic...""

1896976706.m_KeyValue: "For Lord Agares! For the freedom of will!"

1896976707.m_KeyValue: ""Well... since our allies from the Kingdom are here, your mission is complete.""

1896977730.m_KeyValue: "But Van Helsing is the Eighth of the Silver Cross... Can we really take him down?"

1896994605.m_KeyValue: ""The Gate of Ritual, not yet opened.""

1898286257.m_KeyValue: "Wait. Could that have been his plan from the very beginning?"

1898286258.m_KeyValue: "Tsk. You don't look like someone with only thirty percent left."

1905071979.m_KeyValue: ""Father, you said before that if the Wolfsbane was crushed, I'd have to fight you with all my might... So this is what you meant?""

1908158517.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, I heard if you survive the trial, you become a Carrelle Warrior? Maybe even marry into the noble house?""

1908158518.m_KeyValue: ""Impressive?! I am power! It was Aeon who tricked my bloodline—Carrelle betrayed me, sealing me with the Divine Body’s Heart.""

1908158521.m_KeyValue: "Should I call you confident... or just hopelessly optimistic?"

1908158522.m_KeyValue: ""The great Lord Carrelle gave you new life. In his mercy, he even gave you the name Brennholt.""

1909446976.m_KeyValue: ""How would we know what happened after that? Someone like him probably returned to the Church, right?""

1909450175.m_KeyValue: ""Lord Agares, the remaining nobles are willing to submit to your authority. Should we...""

1909450177.m_KeyValue: ""Lord Agares, the Carrelle family has rejected our terms for negotiation.""

1910016330.m_KeyValue: ""This is a secluded castle that belongs to the Bathory family, and the home of Lady Empousa and myself.""

1910016331.m_KeyValue: ""The essence of life lies in memory, and blood is the vessel that carries memories. The Embrace is the ritual of reliving life by extracting the memories contained within the blood.""

1910016332.m_KeyValue: ""There is... a surge of warmth... rushing through my chest... My mind feels clearer now, and my body is more agile.""

1910016333.m_KeyValue: ""That last one wouldn't happen to be me, would it? Well, that's just mean.""

1910087052.m_KeyValue: "_$$Sheila_$$ is not my name alone. It is ours."

1910087053.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you, Clive... Father... For always accepting me, even when I could not face who I truly am.""

1910087054.m_KeyValue: ""I've returned. To our homeland, and to the memories we shared.""

1910087055.m_KeyValue: "Sorry to keep you waiting—my other self."

1910087057.m_KeyValue: "I'm proof that you once lived... so lend me your strength!"

1910087058.m_KeyValue: "Could Aiona be right... Is she going to transform into one of those furry giant wolves?"

1910087059.m_KeyValue: ""The flea brain is fighting some monster... Wait, is she about to 'mutate'!?""

1910088076.m_KeyValue: "Who's at the helm?! The ship's gone completely off course—at this rate we'll be swallowed by the whirlpool!"

1910088077.m_KeyValue: "I won't let the El Dorado become just another legend lost beneath the waves like Landis!"

1910088080.m_KeyValue: "What in—?! A Blood Beast?! That sailor at the helm—is he the one steering the ship?!"

1910088081.m_KeyValue: "...Is that the sailor young Van Helsing mentioned?"

1910088082.m_KeyValue: ""No time to think—rescue first, helm second!""

1910088084.m_KeyValue: ""That won't be necessary, First Mate Bob.""

1910088085.m_KeyValue: "The greatest help you could offer me... is to die."

1910096788.m_KeyValue: "I just ate... and yet I'm still..."

1910096790.m_KeyValue: "Food... It's all mine... I have to survive..."

1910096792.m_KeyValue: "I am Famine! I am the strongest of the Black Blood...! ...No..."

1910096793.m_KeyValue: ""No, I'm not! I'm not Famine at all...!""

1910096794.m_KeyValue: "I'm Hati! A warrior of Ganelon! I won't... let you control me!"

1910096795.m_KeyValue: "This thing that suddenly latched onto my neck—it's your fault I'm in such a bad mood!"

1910097934.m_KeyValue: "They're not even strong—just annoying! Did they come here just to cut us off?!"

1910097935.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh, I knew it! There's always someone who shows up to interrupt at exactly the wrong moment! Can't I hear the full story just once?!""

1910097940.m_KeyValue: "We have to... seal her away... Before she regains her strength—Before she's had her fill... Or else..."

1910097941.m_KeyValue: "See? She's just babbling because she's dizzy. She doesn't even look old enough to know what happened forty years ago."

1910097942.m_KeyValue: "No... we can't let this go on. She'll devour us all... just like she devoured that entire island—forty-four years ago..."

1910097943.m_KeyValue: "Huh? But neither that dumb wolf nor this jellyfish girl looks infected. And why can't I hear anything?"

1910097944.m_KeyValue: "Only Noah and I were present that day... We're the only ones who know the truth. She's actually—"

1910097945.m_KeyValue: "That dumb wolf's just a survivor from our archenemy's family. What other identity could she possibly have?"

1910097946.m_KeyValue: "I believe they're both hearing the whispers. It might be connected to Miss Hati's true identity..."

1910097947.m_KeyValue: "I think you're the one who's hungry. Why don't we take you to the kitchen first?"

1910098959.m_KeyValue: "Aw... A dream forever out of reach—this illusion of human kinship is merely a snare devised by that sanctimonious Aeon."

1910098964.m_KeyValue: ""I did not! I promised I'd take you next time, didn't I?""

1910098966.m_KeyValue: "Wait a second. This is... Mouret? I was on a ship... How did I end up back here? And..."

1910098967.m_KeyValue: ""A ship? Ugh, you went to the ocean without me again, didn't you?""

1910098968.m_KeyValue: "Shut up! This has nothing to do with you—and my name's not Sheila!"

1910098969.m_KeyValue: ""Who are you talking to, sis? Why are you just standing there?""

1910100112.m_KeyValue: ""A fine Captain entrusted his dream of adventure to this vessel. In the end, because of one spoiled little brother, he lost all his Strength.""

1910100113.m_KeyValue: ""What a mess this place has become… Even a cat can't help but sigh, meow…""

1910100116.m_KeyValue: ""So you're looking for more than one person, meow. Naturally, I foresaw this in the future.""

1910100117.m_KeyValue: "Miss Hati is also in the lounge ahead. We can pick her up along the way."

1910100118.m_KeyValue: ""The infection's spreading fast. When we descended, this floor was still secure...""

1910100119.m_KeyValue: "Oh? And these strays were in your so-called future too?"

1910100121.m_KeyValue: "What's with the sudden shift in tone? You're not even saying _$$meow_$$..."

1910100122.m_KeyValue: ""To the future, the path does not matter—only the outcome, meow.""

1910100123.m_KeyValue: "Are you sure she went this way? There's no sign of her at all."

1910101137.m_KeyValue: "Octo is the octopus I ate today."

1910101141.m_KeyValue: "Enough. This is the mindscape born of Black Blood resonance..."

1910101142.m_KeyValue: "It seems I must guide you from the beginning—help you remember who you truly are."

1910101145.m_KeyValue: "Wait—there's another one?! Who are you supposed to be?!"

1910101146.m_KeyValue: "Why are there strangers showing up in my head?!"

1910101147.m_KeyValue: "That's my question! Why are you—who clearly aren't food—inside my head?"

1910102290.m_KeyValue: "They're heading up... Huh? Now there's two of them?"

1910102293.m_KeyValue: "This Captain's already dead. The Black Blood's controlling him?"

1910102295.m_KeyValue: "This body... has no memory of you. What exactly are you?"

1910103314.m_KeyValue: ""Come back, Sheila. Return to your true homeland.""

1910103317.m_KeyValue: ""Just know that where your loved ones dwell, where your thoughts return... that is where you truly belong.""

1910103318.m_KeyValue: ""Aeon deceived his faithful, branding Black Blood as a disease that devours the will.""

1910103319.m_KeyValue: "But is he not the same—splitting our once-unified consciousness into a thousand curses of flesh and blood?"

1910103320.m_KeyValue: "Why do you believe that world of life and death—defined by a false god—is real?"

1910103321.m_KeyValue: ""And why do you call this world of your own making, where all your desires are fulfilled, false?""

1910103323.m_KeyValue: "No! This is not real! You're not the real Clive!"

1910395725.m_KeyValue: "Don't you dare disturb my friend's rest!"

1910395726.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know what you're up to, you headscarf bear, but if it's a fight you want, take it outside.""

1910395729.m_KeyValue: "Caught you red-handed! You were trying to phase through the wall!"

1910395731.m_KeyValue: ""I challenge you, Bloodborn of Bathory! In my authority as First Mate of the El Dorado, I hereby issue my challenge!""

1910395732.m_KeyValue: "What are you even talking about? What's with the agression..."

1910395734.m_KeyValue: ""You're severely underestimating Van Helsing's intelligence! He's genuinely skilled at this sort of thing, and soon...""

1910395735.m_KeyValue: "Should I transform and sneak into the next room..."

1910395736.m_KeyValue: "Who is he talking to...? Why isn't the other person saying anything?"

1910756527.m_KeyValue: "Tch... I'll be straight with you—you're not paying me nearly enough to die for you again."

1910756529.m_KeyValue: "He left? The whole desert's frozen solid—where in the world could he have gone...?"

1920916389.m_KeyValue: ""They must have left by now, right? The herbs in the bag should temporarily suppress the Blood Beast... Now, it's my turn to deal with you.""

1920916420.m_KeyValue: "Quickly bring the herbs... to save everyone..."

1920916421.m_KeyValue: ""'I don't want to die vomiting all my blood, hideous and in pain... Goodbye, everyone.'""

1920916423.m_KeyValue: "But I always mess things up... I can't pass fate's test..."

1920916425.m_KeyValue: ""Like all my captured prey, you'll become a puppet of the Black Blood—the true threat your companions will have to face.""

1920916426.m_KeyValue: ""Y-yes... We've defeated Blood Beasts before, this time we'll also...""

1920916427.m_KeyValue: ""You forced your way into my mind through the Black Blood—but within the Hive Mind, I glimpsed your secrets as well.""

1920916453.m_KeyValue: ""Was it you who woke me? I told you to run, didn't I, silly cat...""

1920916455.m_KeyValue: "What's the diving limit for humans? 100 meters? 200 meters?"

1920916458.m_KeyValue: ""Before I leave, I can grant you one last wish!""

1922207779.m_KeyValue: "Could this be the power of 'The Sun'?"

1922207780.m_KeyValue: "The glory of the whole world and thereby all obscurity shall fly from you."

1922208075.m_KeyValue: ""Aunt Julia says you can do divination, is that true?""

1922208076.m_KeyValue: "But you said you were able to find your luggage through divination. Is it because I didn't give you treats?"

1922208077.m_KeyValue: ""The final 'Judgment' descends, where past sins are settled, undisputable, and no one is spared.""

1922208078.m_KeyValue: ""Hurry and defeat them! After all—these are your memories, not some blissful dreamland.""

1922208109.m_KeyValue: "Let's save that poor little thing first."

1922208141.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm... that's indeed an option. Men, let's chop down this tree!""

1922208175.m_KeyValue: ""It's alright, I've thought of a sturdier way to secure the mast.""

1922208178.m_KeyValue: ""She'll be fine, she will definitely be fine...""

1922208207.m_KeyValue: ""If only I were a cat too—If we were all cats, we could swim away from here, couldn't we?""

1922208208.m_KeyValue: ""She adopted you to inherit her role as the next mystic of the Pontos, to break that prophecy, but you can't even pick up the Tarot cards!""

1922208209.m_KeyValue: "I see the spirit of the deceased has descended once again... He must have given you final guidance."

1922208210.m_KeyValue: "The gifts of fate come at a price. It was my cowardice and hesitation that delayed its revelation..."

1922208237.m_KeyValue: "I'm going to listen to fate's final advice."

1922208238.m_KeyValue: ""There's nothing to apologize for. We all abandoned our stable lives to follow the Captain we admired, drifting around at sea.""

1922208239.m_KeyValue: "In the distant new land—milk and honey flow everywhere—"

1922208240.m_KeyValue: "Shh—Spoken words have the power to become reality."

1922208241.m_KeyValue: ""Her righteous light would blind the windmill, her inspiring words would make it ashamed to see the light of day!""

1922208242.m_KeyValue: "The future shown in the reading is sealed... unless I can draw the final card."

1922598277.m_KeyValue: "Miss Lorelei! We have new prizes at our stall. Would you like to try your luck?"

1922656492.m_KeyValue: "You need to download {size} of necessary resources before entering your territory. Start downloading now?"

1922672697.m_KeyValue: "We'll need more clues. Judging by where it vanished and where this part turned up... I'd say it headed east toward the other side of town."

1925891258.m_KeyValue: "Just a little more... and it would've been a flawless work of art."

1925891259.m_KeyValue: ""Now that Sapphire Isle has grown so vibrant... would you like it better, Bella?""

1925891264.m_KeyValue: "Such sad memory fragments... I can't bear to look... I don't like this..."

1925891265.m_KeyValue: ""To Dalcarlo, helping me search for treasures was probably just a passing whim.""

1925891266.m_KeyValue: "I told her about the most extraordinary creatures. The ones you can only find in Sapphire Isle."

1925891267.m_KeyValue: "Such a precious item... What did Little Bella No. 1 trade Dalcarlo to get this?"

1925891268.m_KeyValue: ""You said Sapphire Isle was nothing but a dreary fishing village, lacking music, invention, or the fashion you longed for.""

1925891269.m_KeyValue: ""...It's been eleven years since you left. In your diary, you wrote that I was a dull father who did not care about your interests, your life, your growth.""

1925891270.m_KeyValue: "Did Bella catch a cold too? Why is there liquid running down her face?"

1928409462.m_KeyValue: ""Don't underestimate me! When I made up my mind to protect that stinky bat, I felt it—my whole body surged with strength. Maybe, from the very beginning...""

1928409463.m_KeyValue: "She needs me... as a vessel for her resurrection."

1928409464.m_KeyValue: "...I'd like to know that myself. Jacintha—whose side are you really on!?"

1928409465.m_KeyValue: "Spare me the flattery and drop that form!"

1928410480.m_KeyValue: "W-Why is there another one?! She looks exactly the same!"

1928410482.m_KeyValue: ""Is he some kind of bard, here to cheer us on?""

1928410484.m_KeyValue: "—the coachman... the one Empousa is about to attack!?"

1928410485.m_KeyValue: ""I only pray Albrecht can stall him, even briefly...""

1928410486.m_KeyValue: ""And if there are others like me, then they too become us—and together, we live on, as one and the same.""

1928410488.m_KeyValue: "Was that your doing? How did you obtain such power...? Or does it belong to that strangely dressed woman at your side?"

1928410489.m_KeyValue: ""Because Aeon is me, is you, is everyone—and all that exists?""

1930219042.m_KeyValue: ""Coupled with my mother's determination to protect us, I doubt its defenses can be easily breached!""

1930219209.m_KeyValue: "This... this is Baphomet's hunting ground where he toys with his prey!"

1930219372.m_KeyValue: ""First of all, she's not my sister! And secondly, don't you dare order me around!""

1931283420.m_KeyValue: "Fragments of a girl named Bella. Pieces of personality—stripped away."

1931283421.m_KeyValue: "Can we truly return to being just merchant and customer?"

1931283422.m_KeyValue: "Mr. Derek mentioned you're well-read in philosophy."

1931617998.m_KeyValue: ""Damn it... Clive, you'd better be alright!""

1932150933.m_KeyValue: "My face... your hands... it feels so..."

1933049131.m_KeyValue:
"The spider has lost curiosity due to exhaustion.
Continues walking down the road."

1933049133.m_KeyValue: "The bells of a nearby church ring in an irregular rhythm. Should you check it out?"

1933049134.m_KeyValue:
""Lucky! It's the Bell-Ringer Spider!
Received guidance from the mightiest of spiders, and speed has been further increased!""

1933049163.m_KeyValue:
"'Acting is believing!'
Can machines possess belief? The answer doesn't matter."

1933049164.m_KeyValue: "Your computer flashes a message: 'Do you have the courage to tread the path ahead?'"

1940328355.m_KeyValue: ""Like the ancient arenas, this is a place for blood, sweat, and honor. Build your lineup, train your Vassals well, and test your might against rival Lords.""

1940331556.m_KeyValue: ""While you were away, our territory has accumulated a fair bit of resources.""

1940879728.m_KeyValue: "How?! With Joan standing guard—how did Agares reach the sealed area?!"

1940879730.m_KeyValue: ""The more I cursed death, the more I came to understand it. I wanted to run from you—and find you again.""

1940879731.m_KeyValue: ""When I accepted the Silver Blood ritual, I let go. The pain of crossing to the Other Side… The comfort of living by your side… All of it was replaced by a single purpose.""

1940879732.m_KeyValue: ""There you go again, saying strange things.""

1940879733.m_KeyValue: ""We can build a new reality—return to an ordinary life, just like before...""

1940879735.m_KeyValue: "Thibault. Would you allow me a moment alone with this child? There are things I must say to her."

1940882932.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh, it burns! Want to know why you lost? Though you probably can't hear me anymore, I'll be kind enough to tell you.""

1940882934.m_KeyValue: ""This is truly awe-inspiring! To witness the legendary Covenant of the Goddess of War for the first time—and in a battle against me, no less?""

1940882935.m_KeyValue: ""Limine Bathory, the _$$Everlasting Night._$$ Once we have you, we'll be halfway to achieving our long-cherished wish.""

1942171385.m_KeyValue: ""Even if the Saint begins to doubt you because of me... As long as you remain useful, she will protect you.""

1942171387.m_KeyValue: ""Why do you think animals are unaffected by Black Blood? Yet humans lose themselves to it, becoming beasts?""

1942171388.m_KeyValue: ""I don't care if you truly believe this, or if you've simply lost your mind. All I know is this: You, Tris Tepes, are now an enemy of the Church. A heretic I must vanquish!""

1942171389.m_KeyValue: "No... that's not what I wanted to ask."

1942171390.m_KeyValue: "...you would've received the memories of every Bell Ringer before you. And the memory of history itself."

1942189287.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, this armor... these patterns... I've seen them before.""

1943480940.m_KeyValue: "So close! You were so close to sounding like a person!"

1943480941.m_KeyValue: ""If you'd gotten yourself hurt, I'd be the one left picking up the pieces.""

1944030869.m_KeyValue: "I wasn't working for that silver-haired. We fought side by side only because circumstances left us no choice."

1944030870.m_KeyValue: ""So, are you an agent of the Silver Cross, or companion to the silver-haired one?""

1944030871.m_KeyValue: "That weapon... You're Isaac Van Helsing of the Silver Cross!"

1944030872.m_KeyValue: "Stay back! Run while you still can—before the monsters reach us! Go!"

1944030873.m_KeyValue: ""Come now, could you at least let me finish my heroic line?""

1944030874.m_KeyValue: ""I heard it at time's end, the toll of the bell returning to zero.""

1944031897.m_KeyValue: ""What's that supposed to mean? Aren't you my brother Kris? Or should I call you Captain Goldland, seeing as we're still on the ship.""

1944031898.m_KeyValue: ""That's why we need your help, Kris... no, Captain Goldland.""

1947477619.m_KeyValue: ""However, during our investigation, Selena and I discovered that Mr. Thoreau is likely putting up a front—he has done many questionable things in secret.""

1947477621.m_KeyValue: ""If it was an eating contest, I'd be more confident.""

1947477622.m_KeyValue: "—They might even be connected to the people of Landis..."

1947477624.m_KeyValue: ""Once everything is done, I'll find a way to regroup with you all.""

1947477653.m_KeyValue: ""All I could do was return to the ruined Sapphire Isle, take up your father's legacy, and rebuild it into the thriving place you see today.""

1947477654.m_KeyValue: "What your father went through... could very well be your fate."

1947477678.m_KeyValue: "Then let us lay it all bare beneath the summer sun."

1947477683.m_KeyValue: "Oh? This is quite unexpected. Could it be that... Miss Ami is a fraud?"

1947477685.m_KeyValue: "I knew it—the guests staying at our inn must have gone missing..."

1947477688.m_KeyValue: "The olive branch at the crime scene suggests Viktor Thoreau cloaking violence beneath the guise of peace; the scepter and Pisces imply that one of the Seven Sages usurped Van Helsing's rightful lands; and the scales with the blindfold... a symbol of you enforcing order through bloodshed."

1949233928.m_KeyValue: "The food matches my data perfectly—no significant anomalies detected here."

"Actions can't keep up with thoughts—that's just how it is.

1974805968.m_KeyValue: "Thirty Soli is exactly what you owe me."

1974805969.m_KeyValue: ""Something's wrong. There are half-eaten grilled oysters here. If it were Ami, she wouldn't have left a single bite. Something must've happened.""

1974805970.m_KeyValue: "They're showing signs of bestial mutation—fish-like tails and other traits. Miss Ami was right—their bloodline is indeed linked to the Landis family."

1974805972.m_KeyValue: ""If I just mimic her movements, I should be able to pull it off...""

1974805999.m_KeyValue: "You know I've always believed you should be the one to take that seat."

1974806003.m_KeyValue: "Could that thread I can't see... be what's sustaining him?"

1974806030.m_KeyValue: ""...Did they leave me behind again? No, no—Silver-Haired would never do that...""

1974806033.m_KeyValue: "The merchants in town sound way more interesting than the ones at Sapphire Isle... What would you buy?"

1974806034.m_KeyValue: "I'm not an actor. Nor have I ever aspired to be one."

1974806035.m_KeyValue: "Regarding the Mistbound Terror—report it to the Church and ensure a full investigation."

1974806036.m_KeyValue: ""However, we did uncover substantial evidence in Lorelei's office—documents tied to the Mistbound Terror.""

1974806058.m_KeyValue: ""One day, when you sing, I'll play beside you.""

1974806061.m_KeyValue: "Someone tampered with them? But only the Seven Sages knew these existed..."

1974806062.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... Loyalty to the great and omnipotent Master—that is the only, and final, thought in your mind.""

1974806063.m_KeyValue: "But Little Bella... I need to sell it on the black market for money!"

1974806064.m_KeyValue: ""If I understand correctly... each Siren's Tear helps you recall part of the promise, right?""

1974806065.m_KeyValue: ""How tragic... Poor Joyce works twenty-three hours a day, bringing joy and impeccable service to our dear visitors, and yet Lord Isaac doesn't even know my name...""

1974806066.m_KeyValue: "Things like time. Love. Or perhaps... eternal life."

1974806067.m_KeyValue: "...only need to work eight hours a day!"

1974806092.m_KeyValue: "Thank goodness I managed to shake them off. A troupe owner has no business running around with wanted criminals..."

1974806093.m_KeyValue: "H-Hey! That was your doing! I didn't lift a finger—!"

1974806094.m_KeyValue: "We don't have time to worry about the warrant. Let's head to the promised place. For your promise... and for the Siren's Tears."

1974806095.m_KeyValue: "Oh right—what does the poster say again...?"

1974806096.m_KeyValue: ""Attention, Isle residents! By order of the Seven Sage Association, a warrant has been issued. If you see the suspects shown, report immediately.""

1974806097.m_KeyValue: "You're one to talk. Didn't you rise again in that freshly dredged corpse?"

1974806099.m_KeyValue: ""According to the results of an urgent overnight investigation by the Association, Miss Ami, the newly elected Sage, was found to be secretly colluding with the Mistbound Terror. Their alliance fractured during the election.""

1974806100.m_KeyValue: ""Constantine and Robin von Quinn, still missing, were likely his victims as well. And then... Lorelei, killed in broad daylight. Among the Seven Sages...""

1974806123.m_KeyValue: "Lord Isaac is keeping secrets from Joyce!"

1974806125.m_KeyValue: "Since you're so concerned about my departure... I've returned."

1974806126.m_KeyValue: "That's just a monster wearing his face! Don't look back… just run!"

1974806128.m_KeyValue: ""Constantine must have realized he was in danger. He found a way to vanish—evading the Sages, slipping out of sight within the isle.""

1974806131.m_KeyValue: "So much has changed in the isle in just a single month..."

1974806132.m_KeyValue: ""1342...? But that's... wait, what year is it now?""

1975463629.m_KeyValue: ""Such spirit. But listen well, young one. When faced with a foe you cannot possibly defeat... You'd do well to value your life more.""

1975463630.m_KeyValue: "No... That's not it. Mother doesn't hate me. She... needs me."

1975463631.m_KeyValue: ""Wait—she's a Bathory, isn't she? Why is she attacking us?!""

1975463632.m_KeyValue: "It seems the young lady has grown quite a bit during this little journey... meow."

1975464648.m_KeyValue: "—If I hadn't gone to Sunset Isle... if I hadn't found Piera… maybe I would've given up."

1975464649.m_KeyValue: ""Now begins the final judgment. The blood of the Four shall form the key, and the Nine Scourges shall rise upon the earth...""

1975464650.m_KeyValue: "Only to drown again and again in the waves of _$$truth_$$..."

1975464651.m_KeyValue: "The one speaking to me isn't the black-clad prisoner I'm escorting. You are—"

1975464652.m_KeyValue: ""Then she's with Cain—but if you, her Vassal, are still alive, so must she...""

1975464653.m_KeyValue: ""Goldland, Skoll, even Cain—though his existence remains uncertain—I carry their memories before death, fragments of lives long lost...""

1975464654.m_KeyValue: ""Just as I believed last time, that you are more suited to become Dracula.""

1975464655.m_KeyValue: ""So, you've walked not only your own memories... but others' as well?""

1975464656.m_KeyValue: "Then consider—why is Aeon omniscient and omnipotent?"

1976755286.m_KeyValue: "...So I'm a poor storyteller? That's a bit disheartening."

1976756304.m_KeyValue: ""Push me further, and I might actually get angry.""

1976756308.m_KeyValue: ""I'm not the only one with a plan. Even if we destroy each other, Cain will seize the moment—and you'll still lose.""

1989225556.m_KeyValue: "Of course I hear it. That's exactly why I don't understand…"

1989225557.m_KeyValue: "Silly child. All parents want just one thing—to see their children grow up in freedom."

2001524909.m_KeyValue: ""You mean she saw through my weariness, knowing I would eventually try to burn it all down...""

2005070440.m_KeyValue: "...and easily hoist whatever was tied on the cabin side."

2005070474.m_KeyValue: "What exactly did Captain Goldland mean by 'something's happened'?"

2005070727.m_KeyValue: "Tch... These two aren't your everyday stowaways. We can't handle them alone... Where's Bob? Get him here now!"

2005070766.m_KeyValue: "Great... and now someone even stranger shows up."

2005070767.m_KeyValue: ""You boarded at the Harbor of Soughs, a port on the Howling Peninsula. There are only two major families from that region: the Ganelon and the Bathory.""

2005070773.m_KeyValue: "Bob... Sailing with you these past few years... it made our lives whole!"

2005070798.m_KeyValue: ""Whether to believe you or not—that's for Kris… I mean, Captain Goldland to decide.""

2005070799.m_KeyValue: ""Even from outside, I could smell the blood and killing intent on you, Silver-haired.""

2005070801.m_KeyValue: ""'We cordially invite our esteemed guest aboard the magnificent and elegant El Dorado. Together, we shall explore yet another legendary mysterious isle…'""

2005070802.m_KeyValue: "Huh. So lifeless eyes does have some self-awareness."

2005070804.m_KeyValue: "It's my principle not to harm suspects before a proper trial—. Even if you are Bloodborn who deserve no mercy."

2005070805.m_KeyValue: "…Little Van Helsing is the new Eighth of the Silver Cross?"

2005070826.m_KeyValue: ""Looks like I’ll be drinking alone, then—To a safe voyage!""

2005070837.m_KeyValue: "An ambush...? Leave it to me... Ugh..."

2005070859.m_KeyValue: ""I know what you're thinking, Silver-haired. But we need to rule out another possibility first. Could the storage room downstairs connect to anywhere else?""

2005070862.m_KeyValue: "Little Ami's fine. Just a bit startled..."

2005070864.m_KeyValue: "I went to the kitchen after greeting those two passengers on deck."

2005070865.m_KeyValue: "Right. William did complain about it during our dispute."

2005070866.m_KeyValue: ""Some rope appeared out of nowhere and tangled itself around the rudder post, completely jamming the helm.""

2005070867.m_KeyValue: "Or maybe... your fingers are just too thick?"

2005070894.m_KeyValue: "Oh. So everything they taught me about 'liking' is wrong?"

2005070895.m_KeyValue: "William said risking your safety to protect someone means you like them."

2005070897.m_KeyValue: ""You remember that strange incident on the ship earlier, don't you?""

2005070899.m_KeyValue: "Bob taught me. He said every proper sailor should know how."

2005070901.m_KeyValue: "No need to panic. That was me."

2005070927.m_KeyValue: "This is what happens when you move around."

2005070928.m_KeyValue: "Did you kill Marlow and the others?"

2005070929.m_KeyValue: "But how did it get tainted? Was it brought in from the sea... or did someone poison it deliberately?"

2005070930.m_KeyValue: "Wasn't Jones supposed to be guarding the kitchen? No one except Ami was supposed to be here."

2005070931.m_KeyValue: "Should be near those two barrels by the door. Go check for yourself."

2005070932.m_KeyValue: "Hm? Looks like someone's here before me."

2006316066.m_KeyValue: ""It's all my fault... If it weren't for me, Noah wouldn't be suffering like this...""

2009479691.m_KeyValue: "Whether I can truly hold you all within this domain..."

2009479692.m_KeyValue: "Did you use the reversed linkage of the Divine Body’s Wings to invade from below once the seal was undone?"

2009479693.m_KeyValue: ""Don't call me small! ...Who are you, to deflect my strike so easily?""

2009479694.m_KeyValue: "Three sealed doors... and one door left open. It seems my course is set."

2009479695.m_KeyValue: "What do you understand? Don't tell me you're taking the gray door."

2009479696.m_KeyValue: "And no one's here to greet us."

2009479697.m_KeyValue: "Alone again!? We just found you! Let me fight beside you this time!"

2009479698.m_KeyValue: ""Maybe she burned away? That happened to Noah once, didn't it?""

2009479699.m_KeyValue: ""The situation... got complicated. From what I saw, he and Joan ended up fighting each other.""

2009480716.m_KeyValue: ""Like them? Mr. Cain Lamboza, these were made just for you.""

2009480717.m_KeyValue: ""Lastly, should you feel the need to refer to me as _$$demon,_$$ _$$scum,_$$ or _$$beast_$$—then so be it. For, since the day I was abandoned...""

2009480718.m_KeyValue: "If only you'd both been this honest sooner. Then we could've skipped this whole pathetic show of sisterly love."

2009480719.m_KeyValue: ""Just... go! Go with Aiona, go with Noah, or even that jerk, Agares!""

2009480721.m_KeyValue: ""To survive until the end, to be chosen as the _$$vessel,_$$ to resurrect as Mother, and then...""

2009480723.m_KeyValue: "You're always like this... pretending as if you didn't know."

2009480724.m_KeyValue: ""N-no, that's not true... I traveled with Noah because...""

2012003462.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, I knew that empty head of yours couldn't come up with any good ideas.""

2012003463.m_KeyValue: "Isn't that what you asked for in your letter?"

2012003467.m_KeyValue: ""No, no, this wasn't how it was supposed to go!""

2012003469.m_KeyValue: "I thought we were going to miss him again."

2012177428.m_KeyValue: ""One day, I hope to prove to be an indispensable ally to you.""

2012185612.m_KeyValue: ""My, my... I didn't peg you for the obedient type. How intriguing.""

2012188683.m_KeyValue: ""Let us, with steadfast resolve, mend the very fabric of fate.""

2012190861.m_KeyValue: "It's a relief that you thought the same. I feared it might spark discord among us."

2012191882.m_KeyValue: "Have the whispers of the 'Lovers' been heard?"

2012195974.m_KeyValue: "To be recognized... it's a rare gift. You have my deepest gratitude."

2013282458.m_KeyValue: "There are still four more Moonblessed mentioned in the Prophecy of the Apocalypse. Go and seek them out... piece together your complete self."

2013282459.m_KeyValue: "Such a pleasure to converse with someone intelligent."

2013282493.m_KeyValue: "I look forward to witnessing you in your complete form."

2014277673.m_KeyValue: ""While looking up definitions in the library, I found that people express emotion through painting.""

2014277674.m_KeyValue: "If I forget it... then I've forgotten them."

2014277676.m_KeyValue: ""Never mind. If you chose to meet me in such a meaningful place, this must be about more than just supplies.""

2014277677.m_KeyValue: "This covers the cost of the paint and your procurement fee."

2020658306.m_KeyValue: ""She is Joan Astolfo, Bell Ringer No. V and leader of the Chamber of War in the Church.""

2020658307.m_KeyValue: "This… is the true power of Death?"

2020658309.m_KeyValue: ""Once he arrives, all four Moonblessed will be gathered here, in Starfall Valley. And their destination will be...""

2020658310.m_KeyValue: "You've been there before. That bottomless tower."

2020658311.m_KeyValue: "Dracula is not a human. He is a will. A spirit that defies the world order Aeon created."

2020658313.m_KeyValue: "That's where Lady Limine's Divine Body lies sealed—"

2020658314.m_KeyValue: "And you? Couldn't you have flapped those giant moth wings and flown us here yourself?"

2020658315.m_KeyValue: "Not before I repay Miss Aiona for mending my wounds."

2020661514.m_KeyValue: "Huh!? You mean... he could come back to life?"

2020661515.m_KeyValue: "Which one of you is Gadric without his helmet?"

2020858275.m_KeyValue: "Devotion can't save you from it. Your ignorance of the truth will only allow it to spread into an uncontrollable epidemic."

2020858276.m_KeyValue: ""Did I strike a nerve? Hey, what's wrong with you?""

2020859299.m_KeyValue: "Not again... Damn it! Am I going to share the same fate as them?"

2021859804.m_KeyValue: "Don't think this means you've won. The Master already knows you're here."

2021859805.m_KeyValue: "Is that what you've been chasing all this time? The truth behind your father's death?"

2021859806.m_KeyValue: "It seems you've forgotten all about them."

2021859809.m_KeyValue: "What?! That vial contained Black Blood extracted from the sirens!"

2021859836.m_KeyValue: "But I never anticipated she had already planned her own death to give us a chance to reach and eliminate the Master behind the Seven Sages."

2021859837.m_KeyValue: ""After all, she is the genius of Sapphire Isle.""

2021859838.m_KeyValue: ""What has become of the Isle, that you were left with no choice but to become the 'Mistbound Terror'?""

2021859842.m_KeyValue: "He stole this Isle from my father."

2021859843.m_KeyValue: "I'm impressed you're capable of such complex reasoning."

2021859844.m_KeyValue: ""And now, fate has brought you here—and him to his destined end.""

2021859845.m_KeyValue: ""The one you've been dealing with is the 'Master,' isn't it?""

2021860101.m_KeyValue: ""No time to explain, little Bella—the whole troupe's waiting, come on!""

2021860103.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, Sir Rowan—the pale-skinned gentleman of the Seven Sages who shuns the sun? He passed through just moments ago, heading that way. But surely, that's not what our dear puppet longs for most!""

2021860104.m_KeyValue: ""Young Master, your father is waiting for us. If you wish, we can return to watch the play another time.""

2021860105.m_KeyValue: "Return for now. I have matters to attend to."

2021860106.m_KeyValue: "The blazing sun scorches flesh and bone."

2021860107.m_KeyValue: "Forget about the stone! Hurry up and clean this place!"

2021860134.m_KeyValue: ""These look like Tidewisp petals, don't they?""

2021860135.m_KeyValue: ""Since you remember the promise involves flower petals, why not start the investigation there?""

2021860136.m_KeyValue: "Then I'll search the direction her people pointed out—see if I can find anything."

2021860137.m_KeyValue: ""If possible, I'd rather not call them that. From their anxious gestures, it seems more of their people are still imprisoned elsewhere—but they could only point out rough directions.""

2021860164.m_KeyValue: ""Your questions, your conduct—entirely inappropriate. Still, for Miss Ami’s sake, I shall overlook your insolence.""

2021860165.m_KeyValue: "He has that thread on his head too."

2021860166.m_KeyValue: ""Lorelei may have betrayed us, but only we hold the right to judge and execute her. An outsider has no place in such matters.""

2021860170.m_KeyValue: "Take this Siren's Tear. Only all the Siren's Tears together... can awaken..."

2021860171.m_KeyValue: ""You can't see it—and even if I told you, you wouldn't believe me.""

2021860200.m_KeyValue: ""Then sneak out afterward, and I'll celebrate with you properly.""

2021860201.m_KeyValue: "This means a great deal to me. Please... just let me borrow it."

2021860224.m_KeyValue: ""Isn't that Sage Alexis, heading this way? The same one who rejected my open-air performance permit fifty-three times!""

2021860225.m_KeyValue: ""We rarely get to see instruments like that, don't we?""

2021860230.m_KeyValue: ""Little Bella, what are you doing?! That's our precious treasure—we earned it together after defeating all those opponents!""

2021860231.m_KeyValue: "Thank you... May I ask—where did this Siren's Tear come from?"

2021860232.m_KeyValue: "Quick! Someone get Lord Isaac another coconut juice!"

2021860233.m_KeyValue: "How does the Master control everyone? Who is the Master? Would you care to take a guess?"

2021860234.m_KeyValue: "Joyce heard it—Lord Isaac is the true heir of Sapphire Isle! The most righteous member of the Silver Cross!"

2021860235.m_KeyValue: ""Ask away, Lord Isaac! Uncover every thread of Joyce, down to the last bit of cotton stuffing!""

2021860259.m_KeyValue: "You still owe me twenty Soli for that investigation fee..."

2021860260.m_KeyValue: "Surely you wouldn't stoop to snitching like some shameless adult?"

2021860262.m_KeyValue: ""During the Sage Selection Assembly, a candidate named Ami exposed the true identity of a bloodthirsty fiend. A killer who roamed the Isle under the cover of night and mist, draining victims dry!""

2021860263.m_KeyValue: "When we defeated Alexis just now—did you see those threads you mentioned earlier? On her head?"

2021860264.m_KeyValue: "The faithful who keep their vows shall receive their answer."

2021860266.m_KeyValue: "Why not issue a warrant across the Isle? Let every resident aid us in rooting out this danger."

2021860292.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm... no matter! Joyce will go search for more clues right away. Please wait here a moment, Lord Isaac!""

2021860293.m_KeyValue: "This scent of blood... That same scent again..."

2021860294.m_KeyValue: "How does Hallon tolerate this thing working beside him twenty-three hours a day..."

2021860295.m_KeyValue: ""An unsent letter: 'Lord Albrecht, my research has reached a critical juncture, but my situation is now extremely perilous. Perhaps you could help me escape from the bay—I plan to...'""

2021860296.m_KeyValue: "She can't still be waiting for me... Wait—Is there... is there a renowned singer named Lorelei anywhere on the continent?"

2021860297.m_KeyValue: "As expected from the one who killed Lorelei... We can't stop him—report to Lord Hallon!"

2021860298.m_KeyValue: ""A shipwreck... here, a year ago? Strange. I haven't heard anyone else mention it.""

2021860299.m_KeyValue: "The isle is currently governed by an association—formed by the Sapphire Isle Seven Sages."

2026224972.m_KeyValue:

2026583727.m_KeyValue: "You lingered long in thought this time."

2026801575.m_KeyValue: "Dispatch ships from the dock to meet Dalcarlo at sea."

2028547590.m_KeyValue: ""Get out of the way, or do you want a beating?!""

2028547593.m_KeyValue: ""Then surely that person must have told you not to let me starve, right?""

2028547595.m_KeyValue: ""In death, all comes to an end. In sleep, there may still be dreams.""

2028547597.m_KeyValue: "We confiscated everything when you were locked up. What 'personal belongings' could you possibly have?!"

2028547623.m_KeyValue: "But why would Albrecht entrust us this task to us in secret?"

2028547625.m_KeyValue: "No problem. The Roland family will certainly honor Mr. Savich’s request."

2028547626.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Noah, you requested a meeting with me. What is it about?""

2028547627.m_KeyValue: "My token of proof hasn’t arrived yet. Please wait a little longer."

2028547628.m_KeyValue: "(Let's make this selection a little more... interesting.)"

2028547629.m_KeyValue: "The selection ceremony is in complete chaos… Joyce can't handle this anymore! Lady Lorelei! Lord Thoreau! Please send more people to help!"

2028547878.m_KeyValue: "But not for food or shelter... I'm here to keep an eye on you for my master!"

2028547887.m_KeyValue: ""Selena, grill faster! We have more orders to fill!""

2028547888.m_KeyValue: "Set your worries aside! Coming to Sapphire Isle means—"

2028547889.m_KeyValue: ""Do you understand? My father led the creation of the Maritime Spice Route—and I am his son, Michel Savich!""

2028547890.m_KeyValue: ""Another meddlesome pest… Guards, deal with her too!""

2028547891.m_KeyValue: "Miss Lorelei asks for your patience. She will return shortly."

2028547893.m_KeyValue: "But I... still owe the owner here a lot of money..."

2028547912.m_KeyValue: "One million?! Who would spend one million on something so tasteless?!"

2028547919.m_KeyValue: "Let's put the research aside for now. There's still a customer waiting."

2028547922.m_KeyValue: "I'm sorry... Did my drunkenness waste everyone's time..."

2028547923.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... using all these principles, the sword produces an inspiring sound when 'slaying sirens.'""

2028547924.m_KeyValue: "How do we play this—what's it called?"

2028547925.m_KeyValue: ""Every night, a mysterious fog envelops this place. They say... man-eating sirens lurk in the mist—""

2028547950.m_KeyValue: "So you're looking for something to eat?"

2028547953.m_KeyValue: ""From now on, whenever you want to hear a bedtime story, you can come to me.""

2028547978.m_KeyValue: "<color=#8f9abf>Fate weaves its threads! Let us exalt this grand death!</color>"

2028547979.m_KeyValue: ""What? Of course not! No, no... I need to ask Miss Lorelei about this!""

2028547982.m_KeyValue: "That man can't be trusted. You'd better be careful around him."

2028547983.m_KeyValue: ""If the lovely lady wishes to take them away, by all means.""

2028547985.m_KeyValue: ""Yeah, I felt oddly drowsy last night, so I went to sleep.""

2028547989.m_KeyValue: ""As for why Noah left without notice, he was 'invited' by Michel's father—Mr. Savich Sr.""

2028548019.m_KeyValue: "Sapphire Isle... Should we invite Friedrich to join us?"

2028548020.m_KeyValue: ""Investigation? Master Van Helsing, please allow me join you.""

2028548021.m_KeyValue: "What is the destination? Where does it lie?"

2028548045.m_KeyValue: "If this is a dream... why are we in the same one? And how do we wake up?"

2028548047.m_KeyValue: ""Even for the Sapphire Isle Seven Sages, keeping slaves wouldn't be grounds for blackmail, given their status as Lords and Ladies.""

2028548049.m_KeyValue: "Two fish and a staff... I feel like I've seen these somewhere before..."

2028548050.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm... olive branches are usually seen as a symbol of peace, right?""

2028548077.m_KeyValue: ""What are you plotting with him? To enslave those monsters? Noah, don't forget—you were once a Black Blood 'monster' yourself.""

2028548078.m_KeyValue: ""...Indeed, all the 'rubble' should be cleared away.""

2028548079.m_KeyValue: "I'm curious about your slaves as well. Why do you call them ugly monsters?"

2028548080.m_KeyValue: ""I also heard from my business partners that you had a minor conflict with Mr. Michel Savich. In the end, it was a 'person of importance' from the Church who took you away.""

2028548081.m_KeyValue: "For the rest... perhaps it's not my place to say..."

2028548082.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps there's another way to interpret the murder scene that the Mistbound Terror set up..."

2032887507.m_KeyValue: "We've found no cure for the Black Blood. And we can't stop the true enemy of this island from awakening at any moment."

2032887508.m_KeyValue: ""Wha—?! Ressa, you can't be serious! All survivors... All survivors?""

2032887515.m_KeyValue: "How are Jason and Sora? What about Noah?"

2032887516.m_KeyValue: ""Is the Black Blood under control? Death hasn't revived, right? The Bell Ringer's here, so I assume things are resolved?""

2032887517.m_KeyValue: "...I'll explain everything later. Is your method of leaving Sunset Isle still viable?"

2032887518.m_KeyValue: ""He's always sticking close to you, Ressa—but when danger strikes, where is he? I knew he couldn't be trusted.""

2032887519.m_KeyValue: "Then you'll have to make several trips."

2032887520.m_KeyValue: ""Huh? You want to leave the island? Well... it's possible, but I can only take one person at a time… And I just got back...""

2032887521.m_KeyValue: "Everyone. Every last survivor on this island."

2032887522.m_KeyValue: "Wait—are you planning to evacuate multiple people? That goes against my family's code! Just how many are you thinking of?"

2032889685.m_KeyValue: ""Once you break free of this place, find me. Seek me in the sealed area of Starfall Valley.""

2032889686.m_KeyValue: ""No, no, no. I am the only one who can reach you here.""

2032889691.m_KeyValue: ""This isn't the place for conversation. Come, let's speak elsewhere.""

2032889692.m_KeyValue: "An illusion? This is merely a memory replaying. It should not be able to think..."

2032889694.m_KeyValue: "I regret that we must meet like this."

2032889695.m_KeyValue: "How are you speaking to me... inside a memory?"

2032889696.m_KeyValue: "This really does come as a surprise."

2032889697.m_KeyValue: "Come. Draw your blade. Let me see how far you've come."

2032894043.m_KeyValue: ""But everyone is right, there's no need for hesitation.""

2032894044.m_KeyValue: "I never thought I'd hear Ressa's lecturing again..."

2032894045.m_KeyValue: ""Noah... is Noah, and that... will never change!""

2032894046.m_KeyValue: ""Keep moving forward, Noah! Don't look back!""

2032894048.m_KeyValue: ""As long as you remember our promise, you will always be Noah.""

2032894049.m_KeyValue: ""You better cheer up! If you keep being gloomy, I'm really going to get mad.""

2040658298.m_KeyValue: "What was Grandmother trying to tell me?"

2041536226.m_KeyValue: ""If you're having trouble deciding, tap this button for some clues.""

2042222008.m_KeyValue: "So you were the one pulling the strings. You sent that dark imposter and the Bloodborn to steal that golden lance."

2042222010.m_KeyValue: ""Just when victory was within reach, she abandoned us. She joined the Church as one of their Bell Ringers.""

2042796717.m_KeyValue: "Such a troublesome child... I was already prepared to leave quietly."

2042796718.m_KeyValue: ""..._$$Knowing you're still by my side makes me happy, but I also feel a bit lost._$$""

2042796719.m_KeyValue: ""_$$I won't be sad, because no matter where I go, I'll carry our memories with me._$$""

2042796720.m_KeyValue: "Then why did you still help me meet him?"
