Upgrade Genevieve's Basic ATK and Special Skill to increase War Golem's Basic ATK and Special DMG.""

2050379211.m_KeyValue: ""Basic ATK turns into boomerang attacks, targeting enemies within the Projected Plane.""

2053089939.m_KeyValue: ""I don't see any lift devices, what's generating that much upward force?""

2053090963.m_KeyValue: "Was this all part of your grand scheme?"

2053095945.m_KeyValue: ""I don't believe in this Moonblessed legend, let alone any of this nonsense about a promised home.""

2053096968.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph! Dote over Empousa all you want, she's still going to die today. There's no way you can save her!""

2053096969.m_KeyValue: ""You're right, I don't know how any of this works.""

2053099146.m_KeyValue: ""It is the foundation of her resurrection, and the covenant that binds her to our cause.""

2053100036.m_KeyValue: ""I am the oldest elder of the Bathory family. I'm well aware of your origins, the first puppet...""

2053100037.m_KeyValue: ""If I really die, there will still be... these 'sisters' to replace me... Now you understand why I said that...""

2053101060.m_KeyValue: ""Of course! For you are the noble vanguard of the Moonblessed, the moonlight will naturally protect you!""

2055489042.m_KeyValue: "That's it? Not even a word of thanks?"

2055489043.m_KeyValue: "So I was... free? Was I actually the same as everyone else?"

2055983934.m_KeyValue: "It remains with a band of human refugees. Our forward scouts will have it in hand shortly."

2056533858.m_KeyValue: "I would not call it a conclusion. More... a question I have learned to carry."

2056533859.m_KeyValue: ""I'm honored by your praise, Doctor Thibault.""

2056533860.m_KeyValue: ""...So this is someone's trick, after all. How presumptuous. Don't tell me you truly believed...""

2056533862.m_KeyValue: "...My instincts say I'm meant to follow the white path."

2056533863.m_KeyValue: "Is this what lies within the sealed area? The layout... it reminds me of our castle."

2056533864.m_KeyValue: "Are they going after that sinister eyebrows too?"

2056533865.m_KeyValue: "It's like William and I both wanting to be captain—but I know I'd do a better job."

2056533866.m_KeyValue: "Wow! You're that strong now?! Took down a Bell Ringer alone? You have to teach me when we get back!"

2056533867.m_KeyValue: "No... I think the battle's already been decided."

2056534882.m_KeyValue: "Cain… Where do you think you're going? Our battle… isn't… over yet."

2056534883.m_KeyValue: ""That's enough... Finding him was all I needed. I may not be able to stop him, but someone else can...""

2056534884.m_KeyValue: "I've known her for a few decades—hardly what I'd call a long time."

2056534885.m_KeyValue: "Lamia! Hold on! I won't let you die!"

2056534887.m_KeyValue: ""Is the real traitor not you, who refuses to serve as the _$$vessel_$$ for this noble mission?""

2056534888.m_KeyValue: ""What are you talking about!? None of them are pawns, and I've no desire to become Mother!""

2056534889.m_KeyValue: ""Here we go again... always indifferent, always pretending like you don't even try...""

2058337115.m_KeyValue: ""The path ahead will not be easy. If you wallow in grief, you'll falter long before the end.""

2058337116.m_KeyValue: "This only proves that we're on the right path."

2058337123.m_KeyValue: "Now I suppose... I will finally find out... the answer..."

2058337124.m_KeyValue: "I never experienced it... couldn't tell you... And because of that... whenever you saw red petals... you came running to me in panic... thinking I was gone..."

2058337125.m_KeyValue: ""'O' my gargoyle, may your petals never fall...'""

2058337126.m_KeyValue: ""Though my spirit will linger… but even spirits fade, don't they? Promise... to check for me... if I truly... become petals...""

2058337127.m_KeyValue: ""So you are the 'young hero' after all, Quinn...""

2058337128.m_KeyValue: "That line in the ballad... it was your wish for Michelangelo..."

2058337129.m_KeyValue: "He anticipated your route and positioned his accomplice along the path to the Ritual Chamber. These spirits are all his accomplice's doing."

2058337130.m_KeyValue: "Tertius... he's heartless. Why must he take even these fleeting moments of warmth from my life?"

2058338139.m_KeyValue: ""You try to say that if we start here—at the beginning of the ring—and keep going down, we'll reach the other side of the ring—the end at the top of the west wing?""

2058338140.m_KeyValue: ""Exactly. It's a clever illusion. Everyone assumes they must climb up to reach the top, or that going down leads to the bottom. No one realizes that the Ritual Chamber lies at the end of the path that leads 'downward.'""

2058338147.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn, ignore her. Take me to the elevator, now.""

2058338149.m_KeyValue: ""No time to explain, Quinn! Help me get over there! At least... at least let me try one last time!""

2058338150.m_KeyValue: ""Damn it, this thing's broken. And Cain—where's that steward?""

2058338151.m_KeyValue: ""He was always there before when we needed him, so don't vanish at this critical moment...""

2058338152.m_KeyValue: ""This elevator has been abandoned for ages... Agnes, what exactly are you planning?""

2058338153.m_KeyValue: ""Before Cain disappeared, he told me that time is a circle, two faces meeting as one. And this place is called the Timeworn Mausoleum... I don't think that's a coincidence.""

2058338154.m_KeyValue: ""I believe this mausoleum itself is a manifestation of space-time laws—like a Möbius strip, a unique structure where beginning meets end, where front connects to back.""

2058339294.m_KeyValue: "I allowed her the honor of a last tribute before she joined her esteemed old master."

2058339299.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn, this fire is bizarre! It's created with alchemy... We can't stop it.""

2058339300.m_KeyValue: "Tertius... that lunatic is going to scorch the entire Peninsula to cinders."

2058339303.m_KeyValue: ""If she's truly wise, she'll know that peace isn't born from the ashes of those werewolves.""

2058339304.m_KeyValue: "You've been stripped of your humanity... Do you not fear Elder Valora's discipline?"

2058339305.m_KeyValue: "I infused it with the entrails of the Ganelons this time—aren't the hue stunning?"

2058339306.m_KeyValue: ""This is my masterpiece, the purest flame, Soul Pyre... Naturally, it can't be extinguished.""

2058339331.m_KeyValue: "These six hundred years of waiting... are my answer to your invitation."

2058339333.m_KeyValue: ""Six hundred years ago, you invited me to the future... I hesitated, for my path then was not yet complete.""

2058339334.m_KeyValue: "You crossed through time to find me... because of a ballad I wrote."

2058339335.m_KeyValue: "Show me... this era you promised I would see."

2059620066.m_KeyValue: "That's just children's writing. There are more pressing matters to deal with."

2059620067.m_KeyValue: "So this is why you came to this era—to find the author of this rhyme?"

2059620068.m_KeyValue: ""You did well uncovering the ambush of the Ganelons. But with Julius at the front, the Ganelons don't stand a chance. Flesh and steel are nothing to him.""

2059620069.m_KeyValue: "(Am I imagining things? Why does it feel like you're the one I've been searching for... Quinn.)"

2059620070.m_KeyValue: "I can only hope he's enough to quell the chaos."

2059620071.m_KeyValue: ""Julius is better than you—stronger, faster, deadlier. He's the right choice. We'll wait for his success here.""

2059620072.m_KeyValue: "Report! Werewolves have breached the frontline and crossed the boundary. Current forces likely won't hold beyond the next bell."

2059620074.m_KeyValue: ""Heh, Elder Valora. You claim to follow the old master's will, yet your grasp of the Black Blood is... lacking.""

2059621090.m_KeyValue: ""They look like Ganelon soldiers straight off the battlefield. Agnes, do you notice anything unusual about them?""

2059621092.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry, I thought a Cartographer would be able to glean more from the corpses. But if you're too scared… Cain—""

2059621094.m_KeyValue: ""There are puncture wounds here—likely from the battlefield. But strangely, these don't seem to be fatal...""

2059621095.m_KeyValue: "The skin shows signs of severe blood loss. They died from being drained of blood in a very short time."

2059621096.m_KeyValue: "Um... could you pull back their upper garments a bit more?"

2059621097.m_KeyValue: ""The wounds on the neck... these aren't Bloodborn bites, more like clean cuts from a sharp weapon. And... the abdominal cavity has been emptied.""

2059621099.m_KeyValue: ""Blood is the key to ancient rituals, and entrails... they serve certain purposes in darker arts of alchemy.""

2059629795.m_KeyValue: "Lyra?! When did you sneak up on me?!"

2059629802.m_KeyValue: "A young hero stepped alone onto the battlefield."

2059629803.m_KeyValue: ""By strength of will, they wrested from death a fleeting chance for the land to rise again.""

2059629804.m_KeyValue: ""'A <style=""Highlight"">young hero</style> gave this dying land a chance at rebirth...'""

2059629805.m_KeyValue: "What happened next? There must be more!"

2059629806.m_KeyValue: "That's it? You can't end it there!"

2059629807.m_KeyValue: "What kind of cartographer stops a story at the climax? Ugh—!"

2059629808.m_KeyValue: ""...But still, from this moment on, that young hero is my new idol!""

2059629809.m_KeyValue: ""The <style=""Highlight"">song</style> she penned is absolutely breathtaking... I must treasure it in secret, where no soul will ever discover it.""

2059630948.m_KeyValue: "Don't say such things! I won't allow it—not ever!"

2059630954.m_KeyValue: "Why... why this dream... over and over..."

2059630957.m_KeyValue: ""So go ahead, 'Lady' Quinn. Stay here. Rot. That's all that's left for you—decay.""

2059630958.m_KeyValue: ""Sometimes... death sounds like a mercy, doesn't it, Jamie?""

2059630960.m_KeyValue: "Quinn... this is the third time you've woken up like this."

2059630961.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps rotting away... is what I deserve. This useless shell... will return to dust anyway..."

2059630986.m_KeyValue: "Then with Elder Valora's word... I can rest easy."

2059630988.m_KeyValue: ""I have only one question: If Ganelon's whelp can cross our borders today to pick flowers, what's to stop them from storming our gates tomorrow? When that day comes, Elder Valora, will you still speak of negotiation and restraint?""

2059630989.m_KeyValue: ""One was a child's innocent act. The other, a calculated provocation. They are not the same. And should the latter occur... I will see to it they pay a hundredfold.""

2059631972.m_KeyValue: ""Haha! 'Kill two birds with one stone,' you mean. You're such an optimistic girl.""

2059631978.m_KeyValue: ""Isn't it beautiful? 'One day, I shall escape this prison of eternal night, to reach the Other Side, where I dance with all living souls...'""

2059631979.m_KeyValue: "I actually found it in a former cartographer's notes. Whether the person really exists or even lived in this era... I have no idea."

2059631980.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, I'm searching for someone... but all we have to go on is that they're young, and there's this old, half-forgotten song.""

2059631981.m_KeyValue: "Hmm... sounds like it's describing a castle..."

2059631982.m_KeyValue: ""A cartographer's duty is to uncover the truth. Public suffering, the plague... that's part of history, too.""

2059631983.m_KeyValue: "Maybe the person I'm searching for... Maybe I'll solve two mysteries in one go!"

2059631984.m_KeyValue: ""Anyway, don't worry about it! What we do need to find is that missing flower basket.""

2059631985.m_KeyValue: "Are you sure I won't get in the way of your... important investigation?"

2059633126.m_KeyValue: "What?! That armored man who argued with the white-haired Elder in the Hall... he's your father?"

2059633130.m_KeyValue: "But is strength alone truly enough? Perhaps what makes us human... is that we carry something beyond brute force..."

2059633131.m_KeyValue: ""If I had a set like that, I'd definitely become the strongest warrior in town!""

2059633132.m_KeyValue: "...It’s not your fault. You just reminded me of something unpleasant."

2059633133.m_KeyValue: "Hmm... I'm not sure I understood all of that. And... you're frowning... Did I say something wrong?"

2059633134.m_KeyValue: ""You may have broken the rules by crossing, but your heart was in the right place. You only wanted to help your people.""

2059633135.m_KeyValue: "Borders are drawn by people. Flowers don't understand such things—they bloom freely on both banks."

2059633136.m_KeyValue: ""But you know what? I bet those guards belong to the same clan as Elder Tertius from the Hall of the Elders, right? That armor of his... it's so impressive!""

2059633137.m_KeyValue: ""Mm-hmm! And I don't regret it one bit! Besides, getting caught last time taught me how to sneak past those armored guards! That's how I managed to bring you here!""

2059634150.m_KeyValue: ""We did take a wrong turn—my fault. Come, this way! I won't get it wrong again!""

2059634155.m_KeyValue: "Why else would he allow a girl your age to attempt something as dangerous as crossing between realms? He's testing you. That's why he let you come here."

2059634156.m_KeyValue: "(But… I only figured out how to cross through the Divine Body because I peeked at Grandfather's journal… Could he have left it out on purpose?)"

2059634157.m_KeyValue: "Oh! I know where we are now!"

2059634158.m_KeyValue: "This time was no different—perhaps it was the Gravekeeper's intuition that warned her of the storm to come..."

2059634159.m_KeyValue: ""Before she passed, she left behind three wishes: to receive you, the envoy from the future; to teach our son Jamie to shoulder his duty; and… to protect Mouret to the very end, no matter what.""

2059634160.m_KeyValue: "So Lady Leila was a Gravekeeper? My grandfather was one too..."

2059634161.m_KeyValue: ""Then maybe he's guiding you in his own way. They may act distant, even cryptic—but their intentions are never truly hidden. We simply tend to notice them too late.""

2059635304.m_KeyValue: "As for me... I'll use this lull to speak with an old friend."

2059635305.m_KeyValue: "No need. Stick to the plan. Armor up and return to your posts."

2059635307.m_KeyValue: ""A Bloodborn, infiltrating a human stronghold? What better justification?""

2059635308.m_KeyValue: "Now then... seems another fine excuse for war has walked straight into camp."

2059635309.m_KeyValue: "Watch your tongue! She was my sister!"

2059635310.m_KeyValue: "B-but sir... Lady Elonora's death... surely you didn't—"

2059635311.m_KeyValue: ""Exactly. In chaotic times, the cause for war will always find you. Why rush?""

2059635312.m_KeyValue: ""L-Later on... wasn't it because Lady Elonora—the one who married into Bathory—tried to return to Mouret to visit her kin? But Bathory refused to let her go, and in the end… they had her assassinated. That's when you reported it to the Lord and convinced him to declare war, isn't it?""

2059635313.m_KeyValue: ""Twenty years ago, when I first took command, I longed to prove myself on the battlefield... but I knew better than to lose my composure like you lot.""

2059635338.m_KeyValue: "The Bathory is ruled by warmongers and tyrants..."

2059635339.m_KeyValue: "But this time... I have a weapon... Moontide Canal... will definitely be ours..."

2059635340.m_KeyValue: "Heh... my clever niece... finally you see."

2059635341.m_KeyValue: "Just like your mother... so sharp... so very Crowley."

2059635342.m_KeyValue: "Then with Elder Valora's word... I can rest easy."

2059635344.m_KeyValue: ""I have only one question: If Ganelon's whelp can cross our borders today to pick flowers, what's to stop them from storming our gates tomorrow? When that day comes, Elder Valora, will you still speak of negotiation and restraint?""

2059635345.m_KeyValue: ""One was a child's innocent act. The other, a calculated provocation. They are not the same. And should the latter occur... I will see to it they pay a hundredfold.""

2059636328.m_KeyValue: ""'Why I chose the Wolfsbane pattern—well, there's a little secret of mine behind it.'""

2059636329.m_KeyValue: ""'Wolfsbane is more than a symbol of protection—it's also the token of love between your father and me. Like you, this delicate flower represents the union of two bloodlines.'""

2059636330.m_KeyValue: ""'I sealed my power of Blood within it. When you're in danger, it will manifest to protect you.'""

2059636331.m_KeyValue: ""'You are a daughter of the Crowley, born with the power to protect others. But more than anything, I hope you will protect yourself.'""

2059636332.m_KeyValue: ""'Even so, I refuse to give up. I want to try one last time... Forgive my selfishness...'""

2059636333.m_KeyValue: "'Perhaps you've always wondered about that small pattern on your body?'"

2059636334.m_KeyValue: ""'Back then, I did believe that these talks would forge a lasting peace across the Peninsula.'""

2059636335.m_KeyValue: ""'Unfortunately, some people will never be content...'""

2059636336.m_KeyValue: ""'But please, do not mourn for me. This was the path I chose.'""

2059636337.m_KeyValue: ""'It was during that negotiation, heavy with the hopes of so many, that I met your father.'""

2088279201.m_KeyValue: ""Legend has it that the Divine Body on Sunset Isle creates phantoms of the deceased, blurring the boundary between life and death. These seem to be those phantoms.""

2088279229.m_KeyValue: ""Hahaha! Then if we kill you, there won't be any pesky Gravekeepers left to threaten Lord Death's revival?""

2088279264.m_KeyValue: "Only to finally choose to follow Death? If even they could never succeed..."

2088279265.m_KeyValue: "Grandmother... what was the Other Side like... the world you used to tell me about?"

2088279267.m_KeyValue: ""When I was just a girl even younger than you, I had already witnessed too many loved ones become sacrifices to seal Death away. And what did it achieve?""

2088279296.m_KeyValue: "Noah... I'm really happy to have met you..."

2090465459.m_KeyValue: ""Old friend, the moment you can forgive yourself is almost here. Until then, rest well.""

2265316174.m_KeyValue: "Wine Seller; Intelligence Broker for the Assassins"

2265695234.m_KeyValue: "And you're not going to explain what this thing is?"

2265695235.m_KeyValue: ""Mama says if you're still hungry, it's better to sleep. Then it doesn't hurt as much.""

2265845537.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... my father insisted my condition is serious, but I don't feel it is. I just pass out from time to time, that's all.""

2265845538.m_KeyValue: "Thank you. This is the first time anyone has given me flowers."

2267536818.m_KeyValue: "As expected of the Bell Ringers' Vice-Commanders. So quick to put the pieces together."

2267537840.m_KeyValue: ""Am I going to… become someone else again? And watch them die, too?""

2267537843.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know who you are, but you're no longer the Cain I knew. This is our chance…""

2267537844.m_KeyValue: "Are these bats also considered Blood Beasts?"

2272561604.m_KeyValue: "Should we also provide similar education for our vassals? What are your thoughts on this?"

2274810259.m_KeyValue: ""If I'm scared of this, Father will be disappointed in me.""

2275498618.m_KeyValue: "These were written by people living here?"

2275498619.m_KeyValue: ""At this point in time, there should only be three of us alive in the Ashen Garden.""

2275498620.m_KeyValue: "So... all of the Gravekeepers eventually become infected?"

2275498621.m_KeyValue: ""If others are not allowed to enter, what if it's one of their own...?""

2275498623.m_KeyValue: ""The further we go, the more bugs we run into...""

2275498650.m_KeyValue: "But the present me can't even protect myself... I even felt a hint of relief that I wasn't the one taken away."

2275498651.m_KeyValue: ""I'll leave the support and healing to you, as always.""

2275498684.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, what did you just ask him? How do you know him?""

2275498685.m_KeyValue: "It seems Cain's predictions have been flawless thus far..."

2275498715.m_KeyValue: "What are Aiona and that boy doing?"

2275498717.m_KeyValue: ""Sheila, the Seed of Calamity that symbolizes the Plague. I never expected to encounter such a legendary being so soon.""

2275498750.m_KeyValue: ""Alright, alright... But going back on topic, is he really the Moonblessed we're looking for? He seems to have been dead for a long time.""

2275498751.m_KeyValue: "So where is this Moonblessed we're looking for? Or should I say this Calamity?"

2275498752.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, so you're a dumb bat too!""

2275498753.m_KeyValue: ""You unsightly creature, your existence no longer has meaning.""

2275498774.m_KeyValue: ""I will stay to fulfill my dream of becoming a Gravekeeper of the Ganelon family, to fulfill...""

2275498775.m_KeyValue: "Is this the promise between men you mentioned to Uncle Gadric?"

2275498780.m_KeyValue: ""Well, that was the only thing you ever beat me at in our competitions since we were kids.""

2275498781.m_KeyValue: ""This should be the last time that we will speak like this, as I am now, Noah.""

2275498783.m_KeyValue: ""It's peaceful and serene here. But without Father, Sister, or you, I started to feel scared...""

2275498784.m_KeyValue: "Could it be that he's not here because he never entered the forbidden grounds?"

2275498785.m_KeyValue: ""And here, fertile farmland will soon be cultivated... And over there...""

2275765452.m_KeyValue: "I don't think that's going to work."

2275770701.m_KeyValue: "I've known this feeling of failure before..."

2275772615.m_KeyValue: ""That's rather lacking in decorum, wouldn't you say?""

2275773636.m_KeyValue: ""Hey Noah, something doesn't feel right here. What do you think, bro?""

2275779906.m_KeyValue: ""Such an idea... Well, well, your boldness has certainly grown since we last met.""

2276905330.m_KeyValue: ""Mere ants, and yet I must deal with them personally!""

2276905361.m_KeyValue: ""Even if it's the emotions talking, I'm going to get angry if you continue acting like this.""

2276910577.m_KeyValue: "Where's the rest of the search team? Why haven't they caught up?"

2283263925.m_KeyValue: ""As much as I dislike that garlic head, he really doesn't seem like the type to abandon someone in need.""

2283263928.m_KeyValue: ""Hati... I joined the Church to catch up to you. But now, it seems like you've left me even further behind...""

2283263929.m_KeyValue: "It's your call! Go find your father or stay here with that idiot who's just as dumb as you!"

2283263930.m_KeyValue: ""That's impossible. Even Dr. Thibault, the Bell Ringer herself, is still searching for a cure for the Black Blood disease...""

2283263958.m_KeyValue: ""Stupid wolf! Face it, that idiot doctor is beyond saving!""

2283263960.m_KeyValue: "Is that the flower you take after being infected to die with some dignity?"

2283263961.m_KeyValue: ""When you broke your arm as a child, I was the one who set it for you. You always said I was too rough—""

2283263962.m_KeyValue: "That voice... It's Uncle Gadric! Uncle Gadric is singing!"

2283263989.m_KeyValue: ""But I won't stop here. I'll bloom as you wished, like the Wolfsbane growing towards the moonlight.""

2283263990.m_KeyValue: ""Clive, why don't you stay here and keep Uncle Gadric company?""

2283263991.m_KeyValue: "Let's go in too! Hati and Clive might need us."

2285522091.m_KeyValue: "Allow me to show you how it's done."

2287462345.m_KeyValue: ""Preposterous! Consuming raw flesh and blood is not only a Bloodborn tradition, but it also infuses our bodies with an endless stream of vitality.""

2287462442.m_KeyValue: ""Preposterous! As Bloodborn, every drop of blood left from our hunts is a badge of honor.""

2287632657.m_KeyValue:
"'Check out my racing technique!'
Handled the hairpin turns with ease."

2287632658.m_KeyValue:
"'Excellent! It's the Aqua No. 4 I've been longing for since leaving home!'

2287632660.m_KeyValue:
""Ignore the red, surge forth!

2287632663.m_KeyValue:
"Rushed out the gates right before they closed.

2287632689.m_KeyValue:
""'Beep~~'

2287632691.m_KeyValue:
"Working for free will eventually lead to your downfall.

2287632692.m_KeyValue:
"They stared at each other for a long time.
The spider and the machine turned their ways and departed."

2288539729.m_KeyValue:
""Red always triggers the impulse to stop.
Even in a fantasy world, traffic rules must be observed.""

2288539731.m_KeyValue:
"'The Aqua No. 4 I've been dreaming about was swapped with Aqua No. 7!'
Mechanical spider is somewhat disappointed."

2288539732.m_KeyValue:
"'I'm great at going straight!'
Takes hairpin turns like a snail."

2288539734.m_KeyValue:
"Powerless against the closing city gates.
The spider has weakened."

2298970598.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Wear another's face_$$? So that's your shallow little theory, like all the rest.""

2298970599.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph. Even if he is that capable, he couldn't possibly anticipate my contingency plan...""

2298970600.m_KeyValue: "Just as the Moonblessed began accepting the name 'Calamity' from mortal tongues... a name is just a name."

2298970601.m_KeyValue: "If Death and War unite... perhaps we could stop him."

2298970603.m_KeyValue: ""A falling-out? I don't know either of you well, but somehow that doesn't surprise me.""

2299382962.m_KeyValue: "Outsiders? Aren't they elders of the family like you?"

2299382964.m_KeyValue: "Are you alright? You're muttering to yourself."

2299382965.m_KeyValue: "You can still talk in that state?"

2299382994.m_KeyValue: ""It's because we'll continue this journey together, leave this place together, and go to our home on the far side of the moon that I feel...""

2299382995.m_KeyValue: ""My, my... It seems you two have had quite a rough time with the other elders. You've grown much more cautious.""

2299382996.m_KeyValue: "It seems... you're a bit lost. Are you about to break free from your cage?"

2299382998.m_KeyValue: ""My, I almost said too much, and spoiled the second half of the cruel prophecy...""

2299383258.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know, and it doesn't matter. The memory called 'my past' is very hazy.""

2299383259.m_KeyValue: ""To the far side of the moon, of course—our promised home!""

2299383260.m_KeyValue: ""You're like me, aren't you? Always watching the others, waiting for the right moment.""

2299383291.m_KeyValue: "What's wrong? You've been staring at me."

2299383292.m_KeyValue: ""It's just a guess, no need to get so excited. We don't even have a single key...""

2299383324.m_KeyValue: "It's not that... I don't even know what a home is supposed to be like."

2299383325.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, sorry, we didn't mean to hurt you...""

2299383354.m_KeyValue: ""But you see, what we're offering you is two friends.""

2299383355.m_KeyValue: ""If we're talking about who's responsible, I bear the larger share. Take my life but spare her, shopkeeper.""

2299383358.m_KeyValue: ""It seems she doesn't really understand human emotions at all, yet she longs to become a real person.""

2299383359.m_KeyValue: "I can't believe they called you foolish and naughty."

2299383361.m_KeyValue: ""I'll sell it to you, for just 100 million Soli.""

2299383390.m_KeyValue: "That puppet was right. So many have died along the way. How much hope do we really have of becoming survivors?"

2299383392.m_KeyValue: "You're trembling. What are you afraid of? Worried we'll be defeated like before?"

2299383423.m_KeyValue: ""It's Cidhall, the Elder here... sort of. I'm new.""

2299383424.m_KeyValue: ""But it's still within expectations. In the end, you're just another batch of failed experiments.""

2299383425.m_KeyValue: ""The louder the voice, the more it fails to mask the fear underneath. That's lesson two.""

2299383454.m_KeyValue: ""You've always been different from the others, always immersed in your own world, enjoying your own secrets.""

2299383456.m_KeyValue: ""No, this feeling... The ground beneath us is sinking!?""

2299711300.m_KeyValue: "Moran!? What are you doing out here all by yourself?"

2299711302.m_KeyValue: ""In that case, surely you can form a proper sentence?""

2303707979.m_KeyValue: "The statue of Goldland and many items at the auction were salvaged from the deep sea by fishermen… I'm worried…"

2303707980.m_KeyValue: "The Eighth Sage… would they really use an 'election' to determine such a position?"

2303707981.m_KeyValue: "I told Selena a little lie—her route will avoid your operation."

2303707982.m_KeyValue: "A token proving your candidacy for the election."

2303708012.m_KeyValue: "So you became a thief? What an interesting way to grieve."

2303708013.m_KeyValue: ""You're still... too young after all, Isaac.""

2303708015.m_KeyValue: "The chart room? I'm on... a ship?"

2303708044.m_KeyValue: "Mr. Savich... I've never seen this Miss Ami before. She isn't from our family."

2303708045.m_KeyValue: "How could she have done such a thing?"

2303708046.m_KeyValue: "The 'proof' is the Mistbound Terror! The very nightmare that haunted Sapphire Isle and left both tourists and residents in fear—captured by Miss Ami herself!"

2303708047.m_KeyValue: ""As long as there are those who seek to exploit the Siren's Tears, running will be in vain. The Master hiding among the six remaining Sages has yet to be revealed.""

2303708049.m_KeyValue: ""So what do you plan to do with this Mistbound Terror, Mr. Noah?""

2308038928.m_KeyValue: "Y-y-you're... Ressa Ambolia? The Valkyrie who once stood at the Saint's side!?"

2308038929.m_KeyValue: "I object! She's just an ordinary nun! ...Wait..."

2308038930.m_KeyValue: "This is ridiculous! How could you be involved with a Calamity!?"

2308038931.m_KeyValue: "It's been a while since anyone called me that."

2308038932.m_KeyValue: "So even one as detached from the world as a Bell Ringer has someone she holds dear."

2308038933.m_KeyValue: ""Do as I say, Acappella. This is no place for a child—descend the mountain at once.""

2308038934.m_KeyValue: "Weren't you the one who trusted only your Choristers? Seems you're the one who's changed the most."

2308038935.m_KeyValue: "One voice alone does not make a Choir."

2308039952.m_KeyValue: "But for an explosion like this—she must be in danger too…"

2308039953.m_KeyValue: "Only one possibility. She encountered something she couldn't defeat. A Calamity… one as powerful as Famine."

2308039958.m_KeyValue: "C-could it be the sunlight from earlier? Why such a delayed reaction?!"

2308039959.m_KeyValue: "No... it's Noah. I can feel his pain..."

2308039960.m_KeyValue: ""A resonance between those connected by blood... just like when Noah sensed you, back at the castle.""

2308039961.m_KeyValue: "He's not far from us... he's here... on this island!"

2308048656.m_KeyValue: ""What a clever girl. Even when longing continues its passage, it doesn't vanish—it remains with us.""

2308048657.m_KeyValue: ""They return to us through their longing, and we hold them close through ours.""

2308048664.m_KeyValue: "Because this is where longing lingers... before it continues the passage to its final rest."

2308048665.m_KeyValue: ""Each longing sheds a tear before it goes—and over time, those tears formed this pool.""

2308048666.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, I know what longing is! The grown-ups say when someone dies on the island, they become longing and stay with us.""

2308048667.m_KeyValue: "What do you mean by 'continuing the passage'?"

2308048668.m_KeyValue: "It means being guided to the place where they're meant to go."

2308048669.m_KeyValue: "Guide them? Where to? Wouldn't it be better if they stayed with us?"

2308048670.m_KeyValue: ""This world lives by the law of balance. What do you think would happen to our island if there was only life, and no death?""

2308049810.m_KeyValue: ""We're grateful for the gesture, truly. But we cannot accept this gift.""

2308049811.m_KeyValue: ""These flowers... I once loved them dearly. But Eleanor... she fell from here, trying to pick one for me.""

2308049816.m_KeyValue: ""Because I knew if we wished to find you, this would be the place.""

2308049817.m_KeyValue: ""Dr. Ressa, Piera? What brings you here?""

2308049818.m_KeyValue: "But I really wanted to give Mother the flowers…"

2308049819.m_KeyValue: "It's alright. Let's wait a little while. They'll come… I promise."

2308049820.m_KeyValue: "Someone who couldn't bear to see your sorrow entrusted me with a task: To bring you these flowers."

2308051988.m_KeyValue: ""No—no, that can't be... Why would Death—a Calamity no less—help us reunite with the dead?""

2308051989.m_KeyValue: "No. It may be a privilege—bestowed by the death sealed beneath this island. A parting gift... to those who die here."

2308051993.m_KeyValue: "This thing doesn't devour longing... It devours everything touched by Black Blood."

2308051994.m_KeyValue: "Then that means... The longing on this island didn't come from the imagination of the Divine Body's Skull..."

2308051995.m_KeyValue: "Because maybe longing was never about clinging to life... Maybe it was always a bond... with death."

2308051996.m_KeyValue: "A dreamfeeder... but I've never seen one this massive before."

2308051998.m_KeyValue: "Names... are given by humans. But what if everything we've ever named—we've misunderstood?"

2308051999.m_KeyValue: "Wait—how can a dreamfeeder devour living people?! Wouldn't that be a people-feeder?"

2308053012.m_KeyValue: ""I don't remember who I was, or what I want to do. All I have is the name _$$Noah._$$ Nothing else.""

2308053013.m_KeyValue: ""You were Noah before, and you're still Noah now—working beside me to heal this island. You'll take pride in that one day. Isn't that enough?""

2308053016.m_KeyValue: ""I understand. But in just three months, more than ten villagers have already shown symptoms.""

2308053017.m_KeyValue: "Are you using time to pressure me?"

2308053019.m_KeyValue: ""You know your past, you know your purpose. You even take pride in your principles.""

2308053020.m_KeyValue: "To defy death. To find a way to eradicate the Black Blood entirely."

2308053021.m_KeyValue: "Whether you mean death as a natural end—or the Calamity sealed on this island—neither can be undone by sheer will alone."

2308053022.m_KeyValue: "I know. Of course I know. I've lived on Sunset Isle for over three years... and I've made no progress."

2308053023.m_KeyValue: "But the balance of life and death is a law nurtured over countless ages. Three years is nothing against that."

2308054166.m_KeyValue: ""Darcias, take her back to the Church.""

2308054168.m_KeyValue: ""Just like the legends say—darkness outside, yet dusk lingers within.""

2308054169.m_KeyValue: "Wow... so this is what it's like inside Sunset Isle?"

2308054170.m_KeyValue: "The black fog rising there is far thicker than it was three months ago. Could it be... That Death is awakening?"

2308054171.m_KeyValue: ""No, that direction... it's the blessed grounds.""

2308054173.m_KeyValue: "Why are they suddenly moving in one direction?"

2308054174.m_KeyValue: "I'll stay with him. You... go help... Ressa..."

2308055190.m_KeyValue: ""At least for us who were fed upon by dreamfeeders, we felt the cruel truth—how these minions of the Divine Body tried to make us their prey.""

2308055191.m_KeyValue: ""Yet this young man known as Death defied the god to protect us, slowly losing his strength until he became what he is now.""

2308055192.m_KeyValue: ""If what you're saying is true, then we've had it all wrong from the start?""

2308055193.m_KeyValue: ""Just as my wife said, we who guarded the Divine Body were but vessels, beings trapped in deception.""

2308055194.m_KeyValue: ""It is the Divine Body, the protector, who leads longings across to the Other Side.""

2308055195.m_KeyValue: ""We always believed that _$$Death,_$$ as a Calamity, devoured longings, dragging them into oblivion.""

2308055196.m_KeyValue: "We doubted it at first too. But you saw it—Eleanor reached her final destination with his guidance."

2308055197.m_KeyValue: ""As I said before, death is not what I once believed—not an end, but the dawn of a new beginning.""

2308055198.m_KeyValue: ""So youthful and gentle in form, yet known by a fearful name.""

2308055199.m_KeyValue: ""Even so, Death shouldn't be the one that sends longings to the Other Side...""

2312731501.m_KeyValue: "...Is it time to ring the bell?"

2312731502.m_KeyValue: "Why hasn't Kenneth's squad come to meet us? The patrol unit's missing too... Am I late again?"

2312731504.m_KeyValue: ""You still don't get it?! The Bell Ringer himself is here, scouring our post for the legendary Divine Body!""

2312734701.m_KeyValue: ""To light the dawn of a new era, these old nobles make perfect _$$firewood._$$""

2312734702.m_KeyValue: ""Remember how it flies now, for this once-proud symbol will soon be no more than ash and memory.""

2312734703.m_KeyValue: ""Mass Carrelle betrayed her family, and attempted to destroy the Divine Body before leaping into the flames—on the very day of your resurrection.""

2313371579.m_KeyValue: ""I can feel it... Their longing, their protection.""

2313371582.m_KeyValue: "And the one they love... Is the truest version of me."

2313371583.m_KeyValue: "I never understood a word you said. But there's one thing I've always known:"

2313371584.m_KeyValue: "Impossible! How could someone as incomplete as you achieve transcendence on your own!?"

2313371585.m_KeyValue: "How can this be...? How is your power greater than mine!?"

2313372604.m_KeyValue: "Have you forgotten me? You've all forgotten I existed."

2313372605.m_KeyValue: ""But that's just as it should be. We, the faithful of Famine Ranna, have no need for names.""

2313372606.m_KeyValue: "Then you... You were never part of this crew to begin with! When did you..."

2313372607.m_KeyValue: ""When your body is devoured by the great Ranna, you will be reborn. You'll finally see the truth of this world.""

2313372608.m_KeyValue: ""Now, raise your voice with mine and invoke the sacred name of the Moonblessed!""

2313372609.m_KeyValue: "Famine Ranna shall once more reign over the sea that rightfully belongs to her!"

2313381308.m_KeyValue: "Such stubbornness... Then it's time you remembered who you truly are."

2313381315.m_KeyValue: "You want to eat me? You're a thousand years too early for that!"

2313381317.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, not again! I don't even know you!""

2313381318.m_KeyValue: "You're the perfect vessel... Become one with me..."

2313381319.m_KeyValue: "Shut up! Stop clinging to me and get off!"

2313381320.m_KeyValue: "Let's escape... And reclaim what was stolen from us..."

2313381321.m_KeyValue: "I don't know what you are... But I'm not going along with this."

2313381322.m_KeyValue: ""Let's find the others... Together, we shall be invincible...""

2313382461.m_KeyValue: "No. She's been with our family for a long time now."

2313382462.m_KeyValue: "An Elder...? You mean the one replacing Baphomet?"

2313382467.m_KeyValue: "I haven't seen you for a while. I was concerned something had happened to you."

2313382468.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you for the timely assistance. You must be... Miss Dalcarlo, from earlier on the deck.""

2313382469.m_KeyValue: ""You have a bad habit, my Empress. Always fixated on what's right in front of you... while ignoring the dangers that surround you.""

2313382470.m_KeyValue: ""Alright, go on, Aiona. What secret is that silly wolf hiding?""

2313382471.m_KeyValue: "Of course. She's part of the family and one of the Elders."

2313382472.m_KeyValue: ""You two know each other, Lady Empousa?""

2313382474.m_KeyValue: ""Do not forget, I'm a fortune teller. Foreseeing and avoiding danger is what I do best.""

2313383485.m_KeyValue: "I told you—you messed with the wrong person!"

2313383491.m_KeyValue: ""Return to me, Sheila. Rejoin me, and find the rest of our kin and reclaim the world that was always ours.""

2313383493.m_KeyValue: ""Remember your name, Sheila—and speak mine: Ranna.""

2313383494.m_KeyValue: ""We are kindred, Moonblessed—branded with the stigmata of Famine and Pestilence, cast out from our true homeland.""

2313383495.m_KeyValue: ""The Ganelon family sealed you away, did they? I see... they've tamed you like a lapdog.""

2313383496.m_KeyValue: "You leave me no choice. I'll have to devour you to complete our union—"

2313384639.m_KeyValue: "Speaking of resonance... What were you about to say about that silly wolf's identity? Why would she have the Black Blood disease?"

2313384640.m_KeyValue: ""Yes. And knowing Hati's temperament, she must have gone straight for the source.""

2313384643.m_KeyValue: ""Seriously, where did everyone run off to!""

2313384645.m_KeyValue: "That Black Blood resonance you mentioned? Same as the jellyfish girl?"

2313384646.m_KeyValue: "Ah... could it be those whispers again?"

2313384647.m_KeyValue: "Stay out of it! Every family's like this when it comes to siblings!"

2313384648.m_KeyValue: ""The Empress really should try getting along with her sisters, meow.""

2313384649.m_KeyValue: "Who knows? Maybe she ran off to find her precious little brother again."

2313384650.m_KeyValue: ""Not always. Lady Hati and her brother are quite close... Oh, why didn't she come with you?""

2313385663.m_KeyValue: ""Compared to your growth, this one's 'growth' seems far more troubling...""

2313385664.m_KeyValue: "It's getting bigger the more it eats! We have to stop it!"

2313385667.m_KeyValue: "Wait... I get it now! It transforms into what it eats! That's why it took on my form earlier!"

2313385668.m_KeyValue: "If I'm its child... Does that mean I'll learn to do that too?"

2313385669.m_KeyValue: "Why do you sound so excited to become... whatever that is?"

2313385670.m_KeyValue: "Now it all makes sense. My love of food... it's part of my growth!"

2313385672.m_KeyValue: ""Octo was food. After I ate it, I just happened to inherit its memories too.""

2313385673.m_KeyValue: "You truly are my child... Able to turn food into strength..."

2313386817.m_KeyValue: "The cabins are on this floor... but they went down."

2313386818.m_KeyValue: ""You think they're suspicious too, don't you?""

2313386819.m_KeyValue: "Um... I see you two are busy! I'll just take Mother back now!"

2313386820.m_KeyValue: "Now's really not the time for this..."

2313386821.m_KeyValue: "Then allow me to escort you both back to your cabin."

2313386824.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, yes! That's right! We're just... lost passengers who wandered in by mistake!""

2313386825.m_KeyValue: "They look like normal passengers. Pretty sure I saw them near the bow earlier..."

2313387841.m_KeyValue: "You're right. They're not in Mouret. They're not even in this world. But I can still sense them."

2313387843.m_KeyValue: "That side of Mouret is long gone. You have no home left to return to."

2313387844.m_KeyValue: "If they're not here with me—then where could they be?"

2313387845.m_KeyValue: "But now... maybe being dumb isn't a bad thing."

2313387846.m_KeyValue: "Honestly? I didn't understand a single word you said. But I know one thing for sure. My family's not with you."

2313387847.m_KeyValue: ""Don't hesitate. Everything you've ever loved and longed for... is right here, with me.""

2313387848.m_KeyValue: ""...You know, lately everyone's been calling me a dumb wolf. At first, I didn't want to admit it...""

2313387849.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, Clive... I should make your dinner now...""

2313666104.m_KeyValue: ""...Yes. If these old bones would allow it, he would not hesitate.""

2313666105.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Captain Goldland... I leave the rest... to you.""

2313666106.m_KeyValue: "...All those touching words and you still killed him! You heartless demon!"

2313666107.m_KeyValue: "He's only unconscious. And not from our attacks. It was from the strain of wielding the Future Artifact. That drained all his strength."

2313666108.m_KeyValue: ""Those weird weapons of yours are Future Artifacts too, right? Why aren't you out cold?""

2313666109.m_KeyValue: ""I just said—the Church's research has advanced... Why am I explaining anything to you, a Bloodborn who will inevitably become my enemy?""

2313666110.m_KeyValue: ""More importantly, Mr. Van Helsing... Captain Goldland slipped away during the commotion. Shouldn't we pursue him?""

2313666111.m_KeyValue: "I believe he went to inform William—the true culprit. As for William's current whereabouts..."

2313666112.m_KeyValue: ""According to Miss Bathory, wasn't he just in the break room at the end of the hallway with Jones?""

2313666113.m_KeyValue: "If the person speaking with that armored man next door is the culprit you mentioned... Then he should still be there."

2313680253.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, wait! Are you defying the Captain's orders!? This man...""

2313680256.m_KeyValue: "And you call yourself a Silver Cross heretic hunter! You'd rather slander little Ami than go after the Bloodborn!"

2313680258.m_KeyValue: ""Bob, calm down! Let's hear Mr. Van Helsing's deduction first...""

2313680260.m_KeyValue: ""It must have been Miss Bathory! She admitted she was a Bloodborn, didn't she!?""

2313680261.m_KeyValue: "I once heard a bard say that Bloodborn could pass through walls to enter human homes and drink their blood! That's it—"

2313680262.m_KeyValue: "Walking through walls is just an unproven legend. Can you truly do that?"

2313680263.m_KeyValue: "The rope on the rudder! She must have done that too! It was all to lure me away so she could kill Aaron! It has to be her!"

2317135974.m_KeyValue: ""I wrenched myself free from Quinn's grasp, but dawn broke sooner than expected.""

2317136005.m_KeyValue: ""I chose to trust Quinn. Soon, the morning sun crested the horizon like a cautious flame, its first rays reaching toward us with unexpected gentleness.""

2321336745.m_KeyValue: "Casting the right skills at the appropriate time may turn the tide of battle."

2321494961.m_KeyValue: "Give Extra Sermon in Moonlight Tribute {0} time(s)."

2321494967.m_KeyValue: "Make a purchase in General Store {0} time(s)."

2324200915.m_KeyValue: "After I die... will I go to heaven..."

2324200948.m_KeyValue: ""'The divination was true, everyone is dead, and I'm next.'""

2324200949.m_KeyValue: ""You don't like hearing this? But that's how it is. Fate is cruel, cold, and unpleasant, just like—""

2324200950.m_KeyValue: "This isn't your fault. Fate allows you to see the prophecies behind the Tarot... It's both a blessing and a test for you..."

2324200951.m_KeyValue: "Not relying on the power of the Tarot? Were you able to do it?"

2324200952.m_KeyValue: ""You've been tainted by the Black Blood, made a part of me—even your feeble mind is now mine to command.""

2324200953.m_KeyValue: "Are we going to give up resisting just because we don't have the Tarot?"

2324200954.m_KeyValue: "What else are you trying to do? You can't do anything!"

2324200982.m_KeyValue: ""Even if you know my weakness, so what? You can't dive that deep.""

2324200984.m_KeyValue: ""The living and the departed converge here, welcoming new kin in a baptism of blood.""

2324200985.m_KeyValue: ""I should leave, I should disappear! Into the deathly abyss! How terrifying—""

2324200986.m_KeyValue: "Sacrifice brings a turn of fate. That's why we will bring hope."

2325492307.m_KeyValue: ""Separate thou the earth from the fire, the subtle from the gross sweetly with great industry.""

2325492339.m_KeyValue: "Open it! The tarot's curse on the monsters must be inside!"

2325492340.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, where's Jacintha and her cat? Why aren't they here?""

2325492341.m_KeyValue: "Me? I can't... I can't compare to the Captain..."

2325492602.m_KeyValue: ""When the rainy season ends and the sun comes out, my twinkling star, we'll wander to the next place.""

2325492603.m_KeyValue: "Divination is like... looking at reflections in the rainwater. Vague fragments will appear in your mind."

2325492606.m_KeyValue: ""Jacintha, aren't you Esmeralda's chosen successor? Can you use the Tarot cards to see what we should do?""

2325492637.m_KeyValue: ""Esmeralda always says I'm a wild cat... If I were really a cat, would I still have all these worries?""

2325492669.m_KeyValue: ""A landlubber's life may be peaceful, but WE DON'T CARE!""

2325492734.m_KeyValue: ""Let's hope Captain Patchen's skill at steering a canoe is as good as commanding a big ship... Surely... we won't capsize, right? I can't swim...""

2325492735.m_KeyValue: "Esmeralda's divination was right—these beasts will destroy the Pontos. Better to be eaten by the Captain than die in the jaws of those beasts."

2325492764.m_KeyValue: ""They can be ground into the most vibrant red, used to create the Tarot beloved by the Goddess of Fate, allowing us to glimpse into a new future.""

2325492765.m_KeyValue: ""You're not at the camp, so you must have snuck out.""

2325492766.m_KeyValue: "The golden chest opens—pearls and coral shining brightly—"

2325492767.m_KeyValue: "Bernice said there are wolves in the mountains. It's not safe."

2325492768.m_KeyValue: ""Kitty, what should I do... If Esmeralda were here... What would she do...""

2325492801.m_KeyValue: ""It's okay, I'll be fine after some rest. Quickly go to town...""

2325882804.m_KeyValue: "Joyce seems to be preparing for tonight's auction. Better not to interrupt."

2325957224.m_KeyValue: "Surely you can sort this out yourself?"

2325957225.m_KeyValue: ""Toys... Could this be connected to constructs? Either way, I need to investigate.""

2327827077.m_KeyValue: "Consuming raw meat indeed increases the risk of disease transmission. I certainly don't wish to see everyone suffering from frequent stomach ailments. Let us partake in cooked fare instead!"

2327827174.m_KeyValue: ""I've tried it myself, and it truly works wonders. It's particularly effective for cleaning bloodstains on formal attire after hunts. We must have Elder Bella arrange an acquisition immediately!""

2328313516.m_KeyValue: "Tomb of the Fallen - Restless Spirit II"

2329175792.m_KeyValue: "No one gets left behind this time! Headcount now before we report to Lord Albrecht!"

2329175793.m_KeyValue: "I'm repaying the favor for everything you've done for Sapphire Isle."

2329175794.m_KeyValue: "I doubt any of you want to see the Isle fall into ruin."

2331142638.m_KeyValue: "Oppose 'Freedom to Go Into the Long Sleep'"

2331675654.m_KeyValue: ""Don't struggle. The more you move, the stickier it gets.""

2332704212.m_KeyValue: "Basic ATK targets all enemies in a circle around the target. This form ends when all stacks of Swift Hunt are consumed."

2332704214.m_KeyValue: "Basic ATK transforms into an electrified circular saw. ATK SPD is increased during this time."

2333003541.m_KeyValue: ""No, no—I very much like being alive, thank you.""

2333003543.m_KeyValue: ""(sighing) I'd take that chance too, but...""

2333003544.m_KeyValue: "Absolutely not! I won't even consider it!"

2334567947.m_KeyValue: "Is Dalcarlo helping you gather the others?"

2334567948.m_KeyValue: "Then I'll help you with everything I have."

2336194180.m_KeyValue: "Don't be rash. Be careful not to get tangled up with them."

2344164255.m_KeyValue: "This presence... Has the gate to the sealed area been opened?"

2344164257.m_KeyValue: ""And in the end, all it did was confirm my deepest fear: Time and space… are nothing but a circle.""

2344164258.m_KeyValue: ""Then dust, and healing… Yes. Both suit you perfectly.""

2344164259.m_KeyValue: ""...Yes, I should have known when I remembered who I was.""

2344164260.m_KeyValue: "If you no longer wish to remain caught in this fleeting dream called Sunset Isle... Then let's go somewhere else."

2344164261.m_KeyValue: ""You… you were there, in my memory. You sealed me with your own blood...""

2344164262.m_KeyValue: ""Stop treating me like a child! And stop avoiding my questions, Commander—!""

2344167460.m_KeyValue: ""I didn't want to resort to this, but to defeat you, it seems I have no choice.""

2344167462.m_KeyValue: ""I heard it—the call of my brethren, the bloodline of Dracula, and this stirring deep within my veins.""

2346765467.m_KeyValue: "Hang on. Let me deal with these pests first."

2352518455.m_KeyValue: "But this water—there's something about its molecular structure—"

2352518456.m_KeyValue: "Hmm. Off already? What an odd fellow..."

2352518457.m_KeyValue: "By Aeon above! That explosion could've razed the nobles' estate to rubble!"

2352653623.m_KeyValue: "Why must we be dragged into this pointless infighting between heretics and monsters?"

2356305830.m_KeyValue: "Only eyes that pierce through time can defy time itself."

2356305837.m_KeyValue: "How can this be?! It must be the Church's doing! My power is gone..."

2356305838.m_KeyValue: ""This crown is a unique heirloom passed down through generations of the Alita family. Even if they could clone 'people,' they couldn't replicate this crown.""

2356305840.m_KeyValue: "Ask another stupid question like that and I'll quench my thirst with you!"

2356305842.m_KeyValue: ""These things look like they're all bark and no bite, they're not that tou—""

2356305844.m_KeyValue: ""Get back, Ami! You'll become sand too!""

2356305870.m_KeyValue: ""The power of my eyes... It seems I can travel through time with this power, yet I appear unable to change anything...""

2356305871.m_KeyValue: "I've been fighting here for so long that I had forgotten everything..."

2356305872.m_KeyValue: "I finally get to see you all here again..."

2356305901.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, we're always here with you...""

2356305903.m_KeyValue: ""Please take my body, my soul, my consciousness.""

2356305908.m_KeyValue: ""Well of course! While it can't compare to those big, bustling cities, it's got that small town charm. If you explore the market, you'll find there's still plenty of interesting things to see.""

2356305935.m_KeyValue: "(My eye... it hurts so much... but why is it the other eye this time?)"

2357755266.m_KeyValue: "But Cain said I was only half right—only the part about Empousa was correct."

2357755267.m_KeyValue: "Beyond the gate? There's nothing there at all."

2357755269.m_KeyValue: ""The wind hadn't changed, but I had learned to run, and at last the world howled back in response.""

2358135794.m_KeyValue: ""Here, you may select the difficulty level for your journey.""

""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> A headpiece worn by Piera that emanates a lambent glow.
Silk ribbons embroider the restless mind of the Bone Collector. Pray tell me, are white lies truly kind, or are they deception?""

2361871175.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> Piera's cherished ring, seemingly symbolizing a pact made with someone.
Could internalizing one's pain be a form of deceit?""

2361871176.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Outfit</style> The shawl worn by Piera, stitched ornately.
Carefully, she collects the sorrows of the dead, folding each piece meticulously then stacking them on her shoulder, waiting for the pain to absorb into her.""

2361871178.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> Piera's collection of skulls, her constant companions.
Pristine white bones, each a testament to the girl's acts of redemption. She convinces herself this is a form of kindness.""

2361871206.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> The blazing crown of Agares the Beguiler, imbued with the primal power of War.
Bearing the sparks of hope, he brought them to the mortal realm, only to be judged by the gods as a thief.""

2361871207.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Outfit</style> The black robe of Agares the Beguiler, which suppresses his high-temperature scales. It is imbued with the primal power of War.
As the Flaming Chariot raced across the sky, he removed one of his own ribs, using it as kindling to cast the first ray of light.""

2361871208.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> A ring forged from the blood of Agares the Beguiler, imbued with the primal power of War.
Iron nails pierced the chest, and hot blood stained the mountainside. Gazing down at the smoke billowing in mortal realms, he finally found solace as he closed his eyes.""

2361871209.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> Agares the Beguiler, after being consumed by flames, left only a few feathers as proof of his existence in this world.
As he opens his eyes once more, wings grew from his spine, and his hunger drove him to gorge on entrails. Alas, he was never a hero, but a vulture who drank the blood of heroic memories.""

2361871566.m_KeyValue: ""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> The Wolfsbane plant means something special to the Clive family.The ballad goes: _$$Wolfsbane blooms beneath the moon's soft grace; The promised home waits beyond the sky's embrace._$$""

2361871569.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> A hood that Clive would always wear before he turned into a beast.
_$$Children say I look scary, but admire me in battle. So I keep this thing on for them, I suppose. Until the grave calls me._$$""

2361871571.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> The iron ring worn by Clive.

2361871572.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Outfit</style> The robe that Clive often wore.
