2596039268.m_KeyValue: "Still thirty-six? Well... don't forget to pay the fine to the Association for not meeting safety qualification standards."

2596039271.m_KeyValue: ""No, no! I was just asking for myself.""

2597064195.m_KeyValue: "All this fuss over nothing. Don't you all have better things to do?"

2597712646.m_KeyValue: "But they couldn't have just vanished! There must be another explanation!"

2597712647.m_KeyValue: ""What's going on? We finally made our way through those explosive mushrooms, but it's like we've been going around in circles.""

2597712648.m_KeyValue: ""Actually, the Alita family has the power to manipulate time as both our faith and weapon.""

2597712649.m_KeyValue: ""I wouldn't have believed it before I set foot in this place. After all, it's been twenty years.""

2597712650.m_KeyValue: ""I can only guarantee that you will witness the fate of each and every one of them with your own eyes: Noah, Clive, and our true enemy...""

2597712651.m_KeyValue: "Yeah! Tell me how to bring them back!"

2597712679.m_KeyValue: "So there's a possibility that the Moonblessed I'm searching for is this Calamity sealed by The Church."

2597712680.m_KeyValue: ""But that child... what is he to you, Noah?""

2597712681.m_KeyValue: ""Something seems off. They were moving silently before, but now they're deliberately howling to reveal their location...""

2597712682.m_KeyValue: "This is bad... He's showing signs of turning!"

2597712683.m_KeyValue: "Is that my blood can resist the transformation!"

2597712911.m_KeyValue: "I've looked through many lives and observed countless choices. Yet the results are surprisingly consistent—nothingness."

2597712942.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, do you think father truly found peace in the end?""

2597712943.m_KeyValue: "Your father wouldn't want to see you giving up on yourself."

2597712945.m_KeyValue: "I don't understand... Father and Noah... Why... Why did it turn out like this?"

2597712946.m_KeyValue: "We can't stop here. We have to keep moving."

2597712947.m_KeyValue: ""To be precise, I'm looking for the 'Moonblessed.'""

2597712948.m_KeyValue: "We were led all the way here by your father."

2597712949.m_KeyValue: "What is this place? How can there be such a huge space here? Where does it go?"

2597712975.m_KeyValue: "The stage and actors of the Ashen Garden are set. Will you drift with the tide or turn against the current..."

2597712976.m_KeyValue: "I had to knock some sense into you! Now tell me what happened to Noah!"

2597712977.m_KeyValue: "What the hell's taking them so long?"

2597713006.m_KeyValue: "The condemned need not know such things."

2597713007.m_KeyValue: "I see... So you're one of those Special Types capable of suppressing the Black Blood in your body?"

2597713009.m_KeyValue: "So much tragedy in this world are the result of small acts of ignorance and carelessness."

2597713012.m_KeyValue: ""Letting emotions cloud your judgment has always been your weakness, Aiona. It's the reason the Alita family has yet to appoint you as its head.""

2597713035.m_KeyValue: ""You, on the other hand, are different. A special type who can control the Black Blood within.""

2597713038.m_KeyValue: ""And that is precisely why we were chosen to lead our families, while she has yet to be selected to this day.""

2597713040.m_KeyValue: "And Noah... I'm sorry. It's not that I don't trust you. I just..."

2597713041.m_KeyValue: ""Hey... you two haven't forgotten about us, have you?""

2597713042.m_KeyValue: ""I'm mending the wound, but Gilrain's blade went very deep. For a child like him, the process will likely be excruciating.""

2597713043.m_KeyValue: "It hurts... it hurts so much... Noah..."

2597713045.m_KeyValue: ""Only a lingering thought remains, their bodies have completely turned into filthy beasts...""

2597713066.m_KeyValue: "It's using Hive Mind! The Black Blood gradually links the minds of infected hosts with similar thoughts and bloodlines."

2597713067.m_KeyValue: "We only need the spores from them. The Church wants to research their natural suppressive properties against the Black Blood."

2597713070.m_KeyValue: "He's in danger? The reason why the Black Blood needs to be sealed with Divine Bodies is because..."

2597713073.m_KeyValue: "Covenant? He shouted something like that when we fought. What exactly is..."

2597713074.m_KeyValue: "Divine Body...? I've never heard of such a thing."

2597713076.m_KeyValue: ""I'm fine. If your mission was to retrieve those spores, don't waste them on me.""

2597713107.m_KeyValue: ""We're Bloodborn. Our bodies don't age like you, idiot.""

2597713108.m_KeyValue: ""I can simply fly over them. Oh, right, some of us aren't so capable.""

2597713136.m_KeyValue: ""But someone made me realize that I shouldn't be fixated on the past, or fear that inevitable end called the future.""

2597713138.m_KeyValue: ""...you're from the future? You might think I'm a strange person to even come to that conclusion, but actually...""

2597713139.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps this lamb is just like the lambs out there."

2597713140.m_KeyValue: ""This little thing was so scared a moment ago, but now it has completely let its guard down. You really are something.""

2597713141.m_KeyValue: ""For humans, the final stage of the Black Blood disease is transforming into a beast-like state. But for animals, they are already beasts, aren't they?""

2599504768.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Allowing vassals to keep pets other than Blood Servants'..."

2599504769.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Allowing vassals to attend meetings in transformed states'..."

2599504772.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Arranging for Vassals to Infiltrate Other Kingdoms'..."

2599504773.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Investing Money and Manpower to Diversify the Castle's Menu'..."

2599504774.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Adhering to the Family-First Policy in All Matters'..."

2599504775.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Granting Vassals the Freedom to Enter the Long Sleep While Sufficient Grounds Provided'..."

2599504782.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Spending Funds to Promote Upper Class Education in the Castle'..."

2599504783.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Allocating funds to procure wool tapestries with superior light-blocking properties for curtains'..."

2600318399.m_KeyValue: ""Let's go. She's in danger because of me, so I have to do something. Besides, she and Setti are both my saviors.""

2600318400.m_KeyValue: ""What's the hold-up? Let's go save Empousa already. I'll have you know I'm the fastest Vice-Commander in the Church, the Galewind Hunter!""

2600318401.m_KeyValue: ""For her actions, she will be condemned by the four highest-ranking elders of the family and suffer a most cruel punishment...""

2606775939.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be so reckless, you stupid wolf!""

2620257820.m_KeyValue: ""As we progress through our journey in Threads of Fate, more facilities will gradually become available.""

2621597520.m_KeyValue: ""The bad news is, while I'm not skilled in combat, you seem even less so.""

2621597521.m_KeyValue: ""Why make such a fuss? In this world, aren't we all being manipulated one way or another?""

2621597523.m_KeyValue: ""Noticed something amiss? You have no memory of naming yourself, yet you remember having a name.""

2621597552.m_KeyValue: "The reason the first card was inside the monster is that those girls... could only get this far before being devoured by that creature."

2621597554.m_KeyValue: ""No... you can't die. Please, I'm begging you, don't die!""

2621597577.m_KeyValue: ""Oh! As expected of a senior, I really want a name too!""

2621597582.m_KeyValue: "It's time to complete the final step."

2621597585.m_KeyValue: ""You can call me Cain. Before we activate the Astrolabe, I suspect you have many questions.""

2621597586.m_KeyValue: "Looks like the last one finally showed up. You've kept us waiting far too long."

2621597588.m_KeyValue: ""If I can go back, I'll be able to meet No. 66 again.""

2621597589.m_KeyValue: ""From beginning to end, we have always been... the same person.""

2622475524.m_KeyValue: "Seems we've underestimated what we're up against."

2622475526.m_KeyValue: "My condolences... I knew how close you two were. I shouldn't have asked."

2622476547.m_KeyValue: "And then alive again… Who will I become this time?"

2622476550.m_KeyValue: "Is it the will to live—or the urge to protect her...?"

2622531132.m_KeyValue: "What a nightmare! What brat left their toy here? Look at my shop!"

2623767181.m_KeyValue: ""Is that so? And here I thought my disguise was flawless. No point keeping up appearances now, is there?""

2623768203.m_KeyValue: "Only to relive their destined end. But..."

2623768205.m_KeyValue: "Ugh… I really don't want to fight a potentially high-spending customer."

2625076732.m_KeyValue: "The key is illusion. Make them believe victory lies just within reach. That's when the prey lowers its guard."

2625076733.m_KeyValue: ""A true hunter doesn't just slay her quarry—you know how to capture them, too. Don't you?""

2625076734.m_KeyValue: "I was about to ask you—wasn't this left behind by that silver-haired traveler you've been pursuing?"

2626978915.m_KeyValue: "But at the very least... I'll make sure he has time to say goodbye properly."

2631162339.m_KeyValue: ""Grow up quickly, my little Hati. And take good care of yourself over there, sis—""

2631162340.m_KeyValue: ""The flowers, sister, Mouret, and Noah—I love them all so much.""

2631162341.m_KeyValue: ""As long as you're with Noah, I'm sure you'll find it—a 'future' that truly belongs to you.""

2631162342.m_KeyValue: ""I will protect your past here, and be here to bless you on your next journey—""

2631162343.m_KeyValue: "Why do you keep crying? What should I do..."

2631162344.m_KeyValue: ""He has always been by your side, ever since the day you were born...""

2631162345.m_KeyValue: ""It's my favorite flower. You too, huh...""

2631162346.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, that's right, I brought a Wolfsbane.""

2632349512.m_KeyValue: ""Just like when you were still in Sapphire Isle, going on adventures with me.""

2632349513.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Nevernight, please show me all the unique places, people, and things around the world—through your letters.""

2632349520.m_KeyValue: ""Doctor! We need a doctor here, quickly!""

2632349521.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, Bella, why did you faint? Guards! No, wait, there aren't any association guards left in the bay…""

2632349522.m_KeyValue: "Your letters could never be a bother."

2632349523.m_KeyValue: ""Look, Bella! You've got a letter from outside the bay!""

2632349524.m_KeyValue: ""The doctor said you shouldn't move around too much. If you need to write back, I can—""

2632349525.m_KeyValue: "If I ever get the chance... do you think I could leave Sapphire Isle one day and see the world outside?"

2632349527.m_KeyValue: "Oh! I almost forgot I can't write!"

2636237446.m_KeyValue: "Agares? Why are you here? Did the Saint give you a mission as well..."

2636237447.m_KeyValue: "Are we—the Black Blood—the Church's greatest enemy... Or hers? Does she truly seek to stop the Calamities foretold in the Apocalypse? Or has the end already begun?"

2636237448.m_KeyValue: "What a pity. And here I thought you weren't the sort to judge someone by their looks..."

2636237449.m_KeyValue: "No—this is exactly as Setti foresaw. We don't yet know how many have come. But one thing is certain:"

2636237450.m_KeyValue: ""Even from here, I can feel it—your ambition burns hotter than ever.""

2636237451.m_KeyValue: ""Wherever humanity lingers, conflict follows. Yet each time, I still hope for a war without bloodshed.""

2636240651.m_KeyValue: ""It's a pity that when I transform into someone stronger than me, I can only access half their true power.""

2644196568.m_KeyValue: ""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> The Wolfsbane plant means something special to the Clive family.The ballad goes: _$$Wolfsbane blooms beneath the moon's soft grace; The promised home waits beyond the sky's embrace._$$""

2646179906.m_KeyValue: ""No, you're trying to shake my faith...""

2646179907.m_KeyValue: ""Even when things started to spiral out of control, they simply forced another family to clean up the mess.""

2646179910.m_KeyValue: "But the Church is not the shepherd that protects you."

2646179911.m_KeyValue: "For my birthday wish this year... may the Saint's power protect this little lamb as they grow."

2646179912.m_KeyValue: "So they made the innocent Ganelon family—and other families kept in the shadows—bear the misfortune of sealing the Calamities."

2646179913.m_KeyValue: ""The church may seem overly harsh toward those with Black Blood like you, but their goal is to eradicate this disease from the land.""

2646179914.m_KeyValue: "I'm not really sure what day they were born..."

2646179915.m_KeyValue: ""Yes. Noah, do you know anyone else who shares the day with me?""

2646179916.m_KeyValue: ""Meeting you here today, I had this wild thought—could you be that mysterious person who wrote to me?""

2646179917.m_KeyValue: ""Actually, on my past birthdays, I would always receive a letter from a stranger. They would encourage me to keep going whenever I felt lost.""

2647887442.m_KeyValue: "Give Extra Sermon in Moonlit Tribute 1 time."

2651332760.m_KeyValue: ""Remember, the Puppet Association's shop is the only place in the castle where we can buy goods from the outside world. Lady Empousa's dolls, Elder Cidhall's wooden comb—they all come from there... We should cherish this one and only source of supplies.""

2651333024.m_KeyValue: ""The area is also rich in timber and stone, essential materials for building. Why hesitate over such a prime location? Let's claim it right away!""

2651333090.m_KeyValue: ""I can attest that their interactions are strictly on a personal level... Don't ask how I know! In any case, there's no need for concern, and conviction is absolutely unnecessary.""

2651333121.m_KeyValue: "The First Tenet of Secrecy is a relic of the past. We should have abolished such outdated nonsense long ago."

2651333156.m_KeyValue: ""Most importantly, they have abandoned the survival-of-the-fittest ideology and display remarkable friendliness toward fellow Bloodborn. Given how few of Black Blood lineage remain today, we should investigate their background thoroughly and seize this chance to forge an alliance.""

2651333187.m_KeyValue: ""It's about time we give them a break. For all these trivial matters, why not let the vassals vote and decide?""

2651333253.m_KeyValue: "We could first dispatch Vassals to initiate diplomatic talks and convey our willingness to offer protection. They may submit to us unconditionally."

2651333319.m_KeyValue: ""For instance, they've offered to provide sanctuary to Bathory's vassals whenever they need assistance abroad. I believe we should form a strategic alliance with them!""

2652810275.m_KeyValue: "Looks like they've had their eyes on us from the start."

2652811298.m_KeyValue: "Just a new Elder in the Bathory family."

2653273326.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Goldland has arranged such a magnificent party—one would surely face ""judgment"" for missing it.""

2653273392.m_KeyValue: ""To get the key successfully, we must first infiltrate silently, then assassinate when the guards are unaware.""

2654995488.m_KeyValue: ""Let's get to that village before nightfall—Oh, I forgot the sun doesn't set here.""

2654995489.m_KeyValue: ""But I can't ignore the fact that you've been keeping secrets, especially with all these strange things going on.""

2654995491.m_KeyValue: "Even so... our ancestors never feared Death. Instead..."

2654995493.m_KeyValue: "Death might have won the fight... but it was also severely weakened... The remaining members of the Choir and the doctor were able to seal it again."

2654995495.m_KeyValue: "This is Death?! Just going about in the open like this?!"

2654995520.m_KeyValue: ""In my homeland, we call this a 'medical book'... Want to look at it with me?""

2654995521.m_KeyValue: ""Well as long as you're okay, then don't mind me.""

2654995522.m_KeyValue: ""...Hmm? Piera, I just noticed... that thing you had on your back... where did it go?""

2654995523.m_KeyValue: "Why does that name sound so familiar...?"

2654995524.m_KeyValue: ""After I end your pain, I'll join you!""

2654995784.m_KeyValue: ""...That in your infinite mercy, you can still hear my voice and answer my humble prayers...""

2654995785.m_KeyValue: ""The sun... I can feel it's setting light, yet I feel no pain... Am I still in the dream?""

2654995786.m_KeyValue: ""As I recall, Goldland's notes also mentioned that they would mark their Blood Beast experiment subjects.""

2654995816.m_KeyValue: "But those who did this to them must have had their reasons too... I suppose this is what master often referred to as 'survival of the fittest.'"

2654995817.m_KeyValue: ""Oh I'm sorry, I mean I'm so relieved to finally see another soul out here.""

2654995818.m_KeyValue: "If the ship was sailing toward Sunset Isle the entire time... Perhaps we were already close to our destination when Famine awakened?"

2654995819.m_KeyValue: ""I haven't seen any traces of other people along the way, nor any wreckage from the El Dorado. Could Empousa and the others be somewhere on this island?""

2654995848.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, sorry for getting carried away. I didn't mean to startle you.""

2654995849.m_KeyValue: "I'm... hah... just a bit... tired... I'll be... I'll be fine... after I catch my breath..."

2654995854.m_KeyValue: ""You said this was your first time here, but surely you arrived before me. Do you know when you got here?""

2654995880.m_KeyValue: "No... the person who appeared was... my grandmother..."

2654995883.m_KeyValue: "Let's go. All the crazy things that we've encountered so far..."

2654995884.m_KeyValue: "Where did she go... Have you found Dr. Ressa?"

2654995886.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, no matter what happens, you must have faith in yourself.""

2654995887.m_KeyValue: "Stop talking nonsense. Just tell us where the doctor is."

2654995912.m_KeyValue: ""66 years ago, when the Black Blood disease ravaged this island, we fought many of their transformed kin...""

2654995913.m_KeyValue: "All things on this island should have perished on that fateful day 66 years ago—"

2654995917.m_KeyValue: "I can't believe I actually thought about trying to explain this to Darcias."

2654995918.m_KeyValue: "Someone deliberately let him go. A traitor within our ranks."

2654995947.m_KeyValue: ""When you meet those you truly yearn for and those who truly yearn for you, you'll surely remember everything.""

2654995948.m_KeyValue: ""You have no idea who I am, the person I am now.""

2654995949.m_KeyValue: "Ugh... What... What am I saying!? Ressa... Who's Ressa?"

2654995951.m_KeyValue: ""'Grandmother' just told me that this island is actually quite small. If we head inland towards the mountain, we'll find the island's only village at its base.""

2654995976.m_KeyValue: "Then can we assume they can't harm you either?"

2654995977.m_KeyValue: "My grandmother probably never encountered someone with memory loss... so I'm afraid I wouldn't know..."

2654995978.m_KeyValue: "And when I finally summoned the courage to speak these truths... I found myself utterly alone."

2654995979.m_KeyValue: ""I should be grateful for the person who's here in the present, who's willing to listen... A kind person who values their companions.""

2654995980.m_KeyValue: ""I see... I'm a bit envious of them, because I've always... been alone...""

2654995981.m_KeyValue: "Who am I? What kind of person was I in the past? Does it really matter?"

2654995982.m_KeyValue: ""You've been acting strange. You can't see what I see, yet you assumed they said something to me...""

2654995983.m_KeyValue: ""A few days ago, I walked into a cave and was sent 20 years into the past; then, just before arriving on this island, I boarded a ship that could 'devour people.'""

2655200958.m_KeyValue: "This is... the El Dorado? How did I return here?"

2655200960.m_KeyValue: "Which is why I won't let her surpass me. And you won't let Empousa die."

2655200961.m_KeyValue: "Then let me see if your strength matches the praise he gave you."

2655200962.m_KeyValue: "Then perhaps you should thank your accomplice—Cain."

2655200963.m_KeyValue: "Cain will then link the Bathory castle's Mausoleum to this place—delivering the sacrifice needed to raise Limine."

2656509490.m_KeyValue: "I don't recall giving you permission to lay a hand on her."

2658690342.m_KeyValue: "Progress to Floor {0} in Tower of the Church - Original Sin."

2658690343.m_KeyValue: "Progress to Floor {0} in Tower of the Church - Original Sin."

2658690344.m_KeyValue: "Progress to Floor {0} in Tower of the Church - Original Sin."

2658690348.m_KeyValue: "Progress to Floor {0} in Tower of the Church - Original Sin."

2658690349.m_KeyValue: "Progress to Floor {0} in Tower of the Church - Original Sin."

2659368190.m_KeyValue: ""If even Lorelei has a secret identity as the Midnight Blood Shadow, can the Sages truly be trusted?""

2660663772.m_KeyValue: ""<style=""Highlight"">Touch</style> them in different places and see what they have to say.""

2663508433.m_KeyValue: "Of course. But what do you mean by gone..."

2663508434.m_KeyValue: "But if we meet again at the next recital... I might tell you the answer."

2663508435.m_KeyValue: ""A girl should keep some secrets of her own, Noah.""

2663508436.m_KeyValue: ""The child is gifted, but rather playful.""

2663508437.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella's love and talent for music must not go to waste. After years of dedication to the Church, my service has come to an end. I hope she will succeed me—becoming the Commander of the choir, and perhaps even the next Bell Ringer.""

2663508438.m_KeyValue: ""This way, when I’m gone, there will be someone trustworthy to look after her.""

2663508439.m_KeyValue: "Sir Gadric mentioned you have considerable experience in training Vassals. Would you be willing to guide her together with me?"

2667673405.m_KeyValue: "Are you really content to vanish like this? I feel it in you—your will to live. Promises still unfulfilled."

2667673406.m_KeyValue: ""Loud and clear. I'm overheated, not dead.""

2667673407.m_KeyValue: ""So that's why everyone's named Brennholt, kindling for the fire.""

2667673408.m_KeyValue: "Who else! She's the only daughter. I hear she's beautiful and kind—nothing like the other nobles."

2667673409.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, you must be new! I'm Michel Brennholt. Looks like we'll be working together—let's give it our best!""

2667891609.m_KeyValue: "Experienced Vassals can share memories with novice Vassals through Blood Covenant."

2667891644.m_KeyValue: ""Now, let's weave these clever tricks into our grand performance, just like a Magician would.""

2667894845.m_KeyValue: ""And each of your decisions will influence the Affinity between you and your Vassals. Ah, such is the dilemma of power.""

2668961861.m_KeyValue: "You… you look just like me. Who… what are you?!"

2668961863.m_KeyValue: "No. He stayed. He's searching for the Divine Body—said to be buried deep beneath this valley."

2668965062.m_KeyValue: "Very well—cast them into the hollow of the Divine Body. I shall see to their execution myself."

2668965063.m_KeyValue: "Do you see the Aquila banner atop the clock tower?"

2668979759.m_KeyValue: "A silver-haired traveler? Is he still here? Did he come to join us?"

2668979762.m_KeyValue: "What else does that woman do besides sleep?"

2669130061.m_KeyValue: ""When we write it down and tuck it away, it means we can rediscover it one day and relive the moment.""

2669130062.m_KeyValue: "There's... actually something hidden in the tree."

2669130063.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, all that you've lost will eventually find its way back to you.""

2669130064.m_KeyValue: "I've only seen this many interesting stalls in the city during festivals."

2669130065.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Bella, I'm certain you'll be reunited with your friend someday.""

2669531217.m_KeyValue: "But your survival is of the utmost importance to us... so Lady Empousa had no choice but to extract a bit of your blood."

2669531218.m_KeyValue: ""...If what you say is possible, then let me resurrect her.""

2669531219.m_KeyValue: ""I was wondering, though. Where is Empousa... Where did she go? Was she not the one who resurrected me?""

2669531220.m_KeyValue: "Try giving Pure Blood Essence to other Vassals as well."

2670271414.m_KeyValue: ""If I had that kind of energy, I'd be running for my life too!""

2670271416.m_KeyValue: "This is... a lance? I've never used one of these before. Why give it to me?"

2670271417.m_KeyValue: "I saw him clearly. That silver hair... and eyes the color of blood."

2670462522.m_KeyValue: "Let's go! Break through the enemy's Shield!"

2670462523.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, give me a Blood Enhancement. My Ultimate can break the enemy's Shield. Use it at the right time to obliterate the enemy.""

2678783145.m_KeyValue: "These bloodstains have dried and blackened. It seems they were written a long time ago. Could it be..."

2678783146.m_KeyValue: "Only echoes answer my calls. I bet even the soldiers chasing us have all fled by now."

2678783147.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps it's because the Calamity sealed by the Ganelon family is the Plague. The Black Blood here is extremely infectious..."

2678783148.m_KeyValue: "And to absolutely forbid outsiders from entering! No matter the reason... father would never... any Gravekeeper would never break that oath!"

2678783150.m_KeyValue: "I am the daughter of Clive Ganelon. It'll take more than this to scare me!"

2678783177.m_KeyValue: "Is what Noah said true? Would my future self really say such words to him?"

2678783178.m_KeyValue: "What are you standing there for? Don't tell me you're crying over a few werewolves? Get behind us."

2678783179.m_KeyValue: ""Friedrich, you value chivalry the most. You'll help me save him, won't you?!""

2678783180.m_KeyValue: "I agree with her. We should go rescue that special type."

2678783211.m_KeyValue: ""Come, let's not waste any more time. Our target is just ahead, right?""

2678783212.m_KeyValue: "What's going on... the Calamity should be just beyond this part..."

2678783242.m_KeyValue: "I got a plan. I'll go there and bring Noah back!"

2678783243.m_KeyValue: ""Don't speak so soon, it looks like the largest one is about to hatch...""

2678783244.m_KeyValue: ""They must be trying to awaken their master—the sealed source of the Black Blood, a being that rivals the power of a Bell Ringer.""

2678783277.m_KeyValue: "It... It must be because the smell here is too pungent! You just can't smell it!"

2678783278.m_KeyValue: "Father's favorite flower... Why is it blooming here? Who planted them?"

2678783279.m_KeyValue: ""Don't look at me, I don't understand him either.""

2678783280.m_KeyValue: ""The Moonblessed's remains... Even though it has long withered, the primal urge to survive still exists.""

2678783301.m_KeyValue: "Are you saying you were always destined to end up in this time?"

2678783302.m_KeyValue: ""I will come to this place in twenty years, and take Hati away.""

2678783305.m_KeyValue: "It seems the one hiding in the shell is about to awaken!"

2678783306.m_KeyValue: "H-How? Shouldn't the Divine Body be on our side?!"

2678783307.m_KeyValue: "So you're going to best me in speed too?"

2678783308.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry for pulling you into this place again, but it's the only way I can have time to talk to you.""

2678783310.m_KeyValue: ""As expected of you, Noah. You figured it out already. I was lost here for so long that I even mistook it for the real world.""

2678783311.m_KeyValue: "But when I tried to find the last Gravekeeper—my father... I couldn't find him anywhere."

2678783312.m_KeyValue: "A river will flow through this barren spot and become a rich water source."

2680431307.m_KeyValue: "Are you alright?... Where... where are you?"

2680431309.m_KeyValue: "They... they're all dead... Everyone in town is dead..."

2680431311.m_KeyValue: ""I am you, and you are me.""

2680431345.m_KeyValue: ""The souls of the departed return to nothingness, while their shells continue to walk in the world of the living.""

2680431346.m_KeyValue: ""But still, thank you for staying with me all this time...""

2681156116.m_KeyValue: "Just don't... give up on hope at a time like this."

2684789842.m_KeyValue: "I will. I'll give it my all to defeat you like this... I won't let down Father's final resolve—"

2686548452.m_KeyValue: "This is where I grew up! I won't let the Church have their way! I won't abandon my people who might not even be infected!"

2686548453.m_KeyValue: "No wonder he tried to stop me from returning to town. Did he know the Church was going to purge Mouret?"

2686548454.m_KeyValue: ""...Dr. Thibault once told us that a knight's duty is to fight, while our duty...""

2686548455.m_KeyValue: ""Since I didn't interrupt your little childhood reunion, in return, shouldn't you take us to the Ashen Garden now?""

2686548457.m_KeyValue: "Save your strength. There must be a way... I got it!"

2686548484.m_KeyValue: "No way! I can't just abandon you!"

2686548485.m_KeyValue: ""Yes... I need to stop here... and rest... But you have a long journey ahead,""

2686548486.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, if she can't accept reality, we'll be stuck here too.""

2686548488.m_KeyValue: ""More than losing his form and dignity, he feared losing the memories you shared.""

2686548489.m_KeyValue: "And he can even sing... Huh? Is someone really singing?"

2686548516.m_KeyValue: ""Despite that, you still hoped for me to leave Mouret and see the world for myself.""

2686548517.m_KeyValue: ""Since entering this misty forest, I've been enveloped in mysteries about myself. I'm uncertain if my past self had any connection to Mouret.""

2686548518.m_KeyValue: "You'll understand when you're older. That is... if you're willing to trust me now."

2686548519.m_KeyValue: ""Ha ha ha, indeed. Sometimes the long way around can be the shortcut, you know.""

2686548523.m_KeyValue: "Everything... So you mean you're willing to spare those two children?! Thank you so much!"

2689733929.m_KeyValue: "This is the first time I've heard you speak so softly. Are you really..."

2689734061.m_KeyValue: ""They're armor inhabited by lost souls, remnants of Baphomet's experiments. Leave them to me!""

2689734096.m_KeyValue: "Baphomet... 'the Soulless'? As in the Elder? He did all this?!"

2689734259.m_KeyValue: "This bat... it's... here to help us?! Aren't they supposed to be on the same side?"

2692038461.m_KeyValue: ""In my opinion, we should keep the menu as it is. Let the younger generation taste the hardships we endured in our day!""

2692038527.m_KeyValue: ""This policy is essential to preserving our family's power. If everyone is granted the freedom to take the long sleep, what will happen when war breaks out and they all choose death out of fear? Such a dangerous precedent must not be set under any circumstances.""

2692038558.m_KeyValue: ""Now is absolutely not the time to be training spies. In my opinion, we'd best hold off on this for now.""

2692038624.m_KeyValue: ""Though the Bathory family is regaining its glory, we remain frail compared to the Kingdom and the Church. Only by prioritizing the family's benefit can we ensure our people thrive.""

2692038659.m_KeyValue: ""In my view, the evening gatherings must not be abolished. These young ones, they merely wish to laze about in their coffins.""

2692038690.m_KeyValue: "An untamed animal running wild in the castle could not only damage our antique furniture but also frighten our vassals. We absolutely cannot allow this! It's out of the question!"

2692038756.m_KeyValue: ""However, after all this time, most of the pages must have yellowed and wrinkled... Procuring new books isn't cheap. In my opinion, we should save our resources for now.""

2692038791.m_KeyValue: ""During the Holy War, we didn't even have houses. Who cared about curtains when we were sleeping in cellars? In my opinion, this expense is unnecessary.""

2692038888.m_KeyValue: ""What we need right now are practical skills and survival strategies. Instead of practicing singing, they should focus on perfecting techniques to precisely sever the major arteries of the Church's soldiers. Let's just forget about this.""

2694772657.m_KeyValue:
""Leveling up is the most effective way to increase Vassals' base attributes, but it is subject to their level cap.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Level Up
<style=""InfoText"">Vassals start at LV. 1 and can be leveled up using certain materials. Besides this, Vassals can also be leveled up through the Bloodline Transfusion.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Level Limit
<style=""InfoText"">Vassal level-ups are subject to their own level cap and the following rules:
• Own 5 LV. 40 Vassals to increase level cap to 60.
• Own 5 LV. 60 Vassals to increase level cap to 80.
• Own 5 LV. 80 Vassals to increase level cap to 100.
• Own 5 LV. 100 Vassals to increase level cap to 120.
• Own 5 LV. 120 Vassals to increase level cap to 140.
• Own 5 LV. 140 Vassals to increase level cap to 160.
• Own 5 LV. 160 Vassals to increase level cap to 180.
• Own 5 LV. 180 Vassals to increase level cap to 200.
• Own 5 LV. 200 Vassals to remove level cap.""

2694772658.m_KeyValue:
""Equipment serves as an advanced way to enhance the abilities of Vassals. The higher the quality and level of the equipment, the more noticeable the enhancement effects.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Equipment Part
<style=""InfoText"">There are 4 parts that can be equipped: Head, Body, Amulet, and Ring. You may equip the parts only with its corresponding equipment.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Equipment Type
<style=""InfoText"">There are 3 types of equipment: Light, Medium, and Heavy. Vassals can only wear equipment that matches their equipment type.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Faction Bonus
<style=""InfoText"">Some special equipment enjoys faction bonuses. Such equipment can have its bonus stats (usually 25%) activated if worn by a Vassal of the right faction.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Enhancement 
<style=""InfoText"">High-quality equipment can be enhanced. The higher the enhancement level, the stronger the attributes provided. 

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Soul Echo 
<style=""InfoText"">Soul Echo can be performed with Soulstrike for equipment that meets the following requirements: 
• Belongs to Tier 9 and has faction bonuses.
• Equipped by Vassals of the right faction. 
• Enhanced to the max level. 
After Echo, the equipment is bound to the Vassal and gains the following effects: 
• Cannot be unequipped. 
• Provides more powerful attributes. 
• Gains up to 3 Blessings for a certain chance. Blessings can bring a very significant boost to Vassals. 
• Can be recast or refined later to change Blessing effects.""

2694772661.m_KeyValue:
""In the darkest recesses of the world, countless threads of fate have interwoven tightly. Hence, what is about to unfold is not the future, but an event that has already transpired.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Modes
<style=""InfoText"">Chose from Normal mode and Hard mode. Note that Hard mode unlocks after progressing in Normal mode. Also, enemies in Hard mode are more formidable, so proceed with caution!

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ EX Stage
<style=""InfoText"">EX Stages will appear once certain progress in a chapter has been made. Enemies in EX Stages are all extremely powerful, and units on both sides will be set to a certain LV.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Fated Ties
<style=""InfoText"">Could the items encountered along your journey have once been treasures cherished by a lost soul? Occasionally, the threads of fate intertwine briefly, only to quickly unravel once more.
• Clues may be revealed while progressing through certain chapters. Use these Clues to seek out hidden locations on the world map and discover lost items.
• Some locations contain Lost Memories belonging to various individuals. By completing sets of Lost Memories, certain rewards will become available. View more details in [Fated Ties] — [Lost Memories].""

2694772662.m_KeyValue:
""Duke it out with other Lords for power and glory. If victorious, you will receive Marks of Bravery, which may be exchanged for rewards in the [Shop - Blood Shop].

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Fair Play
<style=""InfoText"">• All teams will be set to LV. 200.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Season
<style=""InfoText"">• A season consists of both an Engagement and Armistice period. The Engagement period lasts for 13 days, while the Armistice lasts for 1 day.
• Winning a battle grants you Points while losing one costs you Points. Your ranking is decided by your total Points.
• At the end of a season, your Points will be reset to around 1,000.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Challenge</style>
<style=""InfoText"">• Select an opponent you want to challenge from the Opponent List.
• You have 3 free challenges per day.
• When free attempts are used up, you may use Arena Pass to engage in more challenges. There is a daily purchase limit for Arena Pass.
• A challenge consists of a Preparation Phase and a Battle Phase.
• If you quit or time out during the Preparation Phase, the challenge will be canceled and no challenge attempts will be consumed.
• If you quit or time out during the Battle Phase, your challenge will be considered a failure, which will result in the consumption of your challenge attempt, thus Points will be settled accordingly.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Defense Team
<style=""InfoText"">Tap Edit Team to arrange your lineup. When challenged by other Lords, your Defense Team will take on the challenge and defend your glory.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Offense Team
<style=""InfoText"">You can edit your Offense Team after you select an opponent and enter the battle.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Winning Conditions
<style=""InfoText"">The team that defeats the other team first wins. If the two teams tie for victory, they both win. If the attacker quits or times out in the Battle Phase, their challenge will be considered a failure.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Rewards
<style=""InfoText"">• Achieving victory in the battle earns you Victory Rewards.
• Daily rank rewards will be issued via Mail every day.
• After a season ends, season rank rewards will be issued via Mail.""

2694772663.m_KeyValue:
""Send your loyal Vassals on hired missions! Mercenary Hunting Ground offers attractive Skill Upgrade materials.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Mercenary Hunting Ground
<style=""InfoText"">Earn rewards based on kills, up to 3 hunts per day. Please manage your hunts wisely!

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Quick Clear
<style=""InfoText"">Achieve a score in any hunt to unlock Quick Clear for that day (consumes hunt attempts). Rewards will be based on your best score of the day.""

2694772664.m_KeyValue:
""Transfuse with family blood, and inherit will of the strong. Bloodline Transfusion can help level up your Vassals and even raise their level cap.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Transfusion Vassals
<style=""InfoText"">The 5 highest-level Vassals will automatically join the Transfusion.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Transfusion Level
<style=""InfoText"">Transfusion Level will be limited to the lowest level of the 5 participating Vassals.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Transfusion Slot
<style=""InfoText"">Newly-added Vassals upgrade to the set Transfusion Level automatically. However, Vassals in Transfusion cannot be upgraded independently.
• In some cases, Transfusion Level can be higher than a Vassal's max level.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Bloodline Evolution
<style=""InfoText"">When Transfusion Level reaches LV. 200, you can evolve the Bloodline Transfusion. Once the Bloodline Transfusion is evolved, Transfusion Vassal levels cannot be reset.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Transfusion Upgrade
<style=""InfoText"">When Transfusion Level is below LV. 200, you can use Transfusion Upgrade to conveniently synchronize and boost all Transfusion Vassals' levels.""

2694772665.m_KeyValue:
""Moonlight Tribute is essential to the Bathory family, and is a key source of basic enhancement materials.
<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Moonlight Faith
<style=""InfoText"">Every 5 clears in Threads of Fate (both Normal or Hard Mode) increases Moonlight Faith by 1, and Moonlight Faith increases Tribute gains.
<style=""InfoText"">Moonlight Tribute Earnings are capped at 24 hour intervals.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Extra Sermon
<style=""InfoText"">Lords may perform Extra Sermons a limited number of times per day to gain basic resources and random item rewards equal to 2 hours of ritual time per Sermon.""

2694772666.m_KeyValue:
""This is where your loyal Vassals gather. To view specific rules about Vassal development, go to the development tab in Vassal details and tap the [!] icon in the top left corner.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Blood Power
<style=""InfoText"">Blood Power represents the overall combat ability of a Vassal. Developing Vassals can enhance their Blood Power rating, and you can develop Vassals through various means, including but not limited to: leveling up, skill enhancement, equipment development, Future Artifacts, Ritual Chamber, Affinity, etc.""

2694772667.m_KeyValue:
""Legend holds that each blade in the tomb has befallen a Blood Beast. As time passes, however, the blood shed transforms into dark spirits that linger below.
Take on these powerful spirits in the Tomb of the Fallen to obtain Equipment! 

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Tomb of the Fallen
<style=""InfoText"">There are 4 major stages that unlock as you progress through Threads of Fate. 

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Exorcise Spirit
<style=""InfoText"">Use Exorcise attempts to take on spirits and earn rewards.
Exorcise attempts are shared between all stages and reset daily. 

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Spirit Fragments
<style=""InfoText""> Spirit Fragments represent the total DMG dealt to a spirit.
The higher the accumulated DMG dealt to a spirit, the more Fragments you'll receive, and thus the better the rewards.
As your Spirit Fragment count increases, spirits will grow stronger.
Spirit Fragments reset daily for each stage. Daily Spirit Fragment records are only recorded when fighting manually. 

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Quick Battle
<style=""InfoText"">After manually fighting a spirit, you may use Quick Battle, which is based on the best attempt that day. 

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Trial Exorcism
<style=""InfoText"">You may practice on all unlocked stages.
Trial Exorcism does not consume daily attempts, but it does not count towards Spirit Fragments, nor does it provide rewards.""

2694772668.m_KeyValue:
""Towers and Abysses appear as opposing forces. Yet, as you climb upwards here, you eventually… plummet further into the depths. Advance in Infinite Abyss to earn Moon Tear and Faction Vassal Shards!

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Infinite Abyss
<style=""InfoText"">Venture into the abyss to take down enemies. The farther you progress, the stronger the enemies you encounter. Infinite Abyss consists of the Tower of Purification and 4 Faction Abysses.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Tower of Purification
<style=""InfoText"">Accessible throughout the day, you may enter with all your Vassals and there are no faction restrictions.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Faction Abysses
<style=""InfoText"">These consist of Tower of Ancestry - Decay, Tower of the Church - Original Sin, Tower of the Bloodborn - Desire, Tower of the Kingdom - Deception. Each corresponds to a faction, and is open for a limited time. Only faction Vassals can enter!""

Confirm quitting?""

2694772821.m_KeyValue:
""When the Blood Moon looms high, intruders prowl into the castle halls. Thus the hunt begins. Exterminate them before dawn's light.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Hunting Hours
<style=""InfoText"">• During the event, 5 stages will open on different days, with 2 stages available each day. All stages will be open on Saturday and Sunday. Only open stages can be challenged. Please plan your Hunt accordingly.
• Available stages open at 05:00 daily and close at 04:00 the following day. Scores will be settled after the stage is closed.
• Entry closes 10 minutes before daily settlement. Ongoing challenges continue, but stages cleared after closing time won't be recorded.
• After all challenges end, the Review phase begins, during which challenges won't be availalble. Lords can collect unclaimed Rewards and view Rankings.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Stage Challenge
<style=""InfoText"">• Complete the objectives for each Stage to achieve a score.
• Stages can be challenged multiple times, but only your best score is recorded and ranked.
• Rewards can be claimed once you reach the required stage score.
• All Vassals are set to LV. 200 during the challenges, with individual progression bonuses remaining unaffected.
• Each stage provides multiple relevant Seals. You can select 2 Seals to assist your battle.
• In different stages, DMG increase or reduction attributes that monsters receive may be adjusted.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Leaderboard
<style=""InfoText"">• You'll be grouped with random players and ranked by your scores.
• Stage Rankings determine your points, which increase with your ranking.
• All Rankings display total scores across all stages. All Ranking Rewards are distributed once all challenges conclude.
• Stage Rankings update in real-time, while the All Rankings update daily at 04:00.""

2694772822.m_KeyValue:
""Would you like to use <style=""Highlight"">{1} x{2}</style> for a discounted Herald?<line-height=1.35em>
<size=32><alpha=#70><line-height=1.6em>Prioritize using Moon Tears (Free)
Moon Tears (Paid) will be deducted when Moon Tears (Free) are insufficient.""

2694772824.m_KeyValue:
""They are treasures that transcend dimensions—the crystallization of memories, but more importantly, items essential for exploring the Timeworn Mausoleum.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Relic Gallery
<style=""InfoText"">When attempting stages, you'll have the chance to collect Past Relics. For each new Relic collected, its entry in the Gallery will activate automatically. In the Gallery, you can look up information about Relics at any time.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Relic Types
<style=""InfoText"">The Gallery is divided into three sections:
• Unique Relics: View the effects of both Sealed and Activated Unique Relics. Here you can also learn which Basic Materia are needed to activate Sealed Relics.
• General Relics: View the effects of both Sealed and Activated Basic Relics. Here you can also learn which Basic Materia are needed to activate Sealed Relics.
• Basic Materia: View the detailed effects of various Basic Materia. These are crucial for activating more advanced Relics.""

2694772825.m_KeyValue:
""Shattered stained glass is our window to other worlds.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Achievement Tasks
<style=""InfoText"">Complete tasks repeatedly to earn rewards.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Achievement Rewards
<style=""InfoText"">Achievement rewards come in two types:
• Completing Achievement Tasks grants a reward.
• Accepting Achievement Tasks grants 1 Memory Fragment. Collect enough Memory Fragments to earn additional rewards.""

2694772826.m_KeyValue:
""The needle guides the way, bringing salvation to those who are lost.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Talent Tree
<style=""InfoText"">Use Timeworn Compasses to activate talent nodes and gain extra effects in battle.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Talent Effects
<style=""InfoText"">Effects come in three types:
• Increase the level of deployed Vassals in battle.
• Increase your Inventory capacity.
• Get more Relics in battle.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Timeworn Compasses
<style=""InfoText"">Two ways to obtain:
• Attempt stages and increase Reward LV. to earn Timeworn Compasses.
• Complete Achievement Tasks to earn Timeworn Compasses.""

2694772827.m_KeyValue:
""As you gaze into the abyss below, countless souls from other realms gaze back. This mausoleum is both a graveyard for memories, and a cradle of nightmares.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Stages 
<style=""InfoText"">• The Timeworn Mausoleum has five floors, with three stages on each floor.
• Complete battle objectives to clear the current stage. 
• There are no attempt limits for any stage.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Mechanics 
<style=""InfoText"">The Timeworn Mausoleum features a tower defense mechanism. Inside the Mausoleum dwell a host of phantoms who constantly surge toward Rifts in a desperate bid for salvation. Certain rules apply:
• In battle, your Vassals will hold their position in front of the Rift and will not actively pursue enemies.
• Each Vassal can block a number of phantoms, and certain roles (such as Warrior, Defender, and Assassin) can block more phantoms.
• Some Vassal skills may function differently in the Timeworn Mausoleum.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Limits 
<style=""InfoText"">When attempting stages in the Timeworn Mausoleum, the following restrictions apply:
• Your Vassal LV. will be a set value, which can be raised through the Talent Tree.
• Equipment will remain effective in the Timeworn Mausoleum.
• Future Artifacts will remain effective in the Timeworn Mausoleum.
• Vassal Skill LV. does not take effect in the Timeworn Mausoleum.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Inventory Management 
<style=""InfoText"">Past Relics will drop in the Timeworn Mausoleum. Players can place Relics in their Inventory to gain extra effects in battle:
• Inventory space is limited, be sure to organize your bags carefully as you may not be able to hold all items. 
• Past Relics come in 5 types: 
1. Unique Relics grant attribute bonuses and skill buffs for featured Vassals.
2. General Relics grant attribute bonuses for all deployed Vassals, with some offering skill buffs.
3. Sealed Relics are either Unique or General Relics with certain powers locked off. When placed in your Inventory, not all effects will be granted.
4. Basic Materia can activate Sealed Relics when placed together in your Inventory, granting the item's full potential.
5. Expansion Bags increase Inventory capacity.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Rewards
<style=""InfoText"">• After completing a stage, rewards are calculated based on the number of Phantoms you eliminate. Your reward level increases with the number of Phantoms eliminated.
• Claim your rewards from the main menu after your reward level increases.
• Rewards can only be claimed once per day.""

2694772828.m_KeyValue: ""Initial Hand allows you to set up to 3 Ultimates that enter your hand at the start of the battle. Upon Victory, your hand will be saved until the lineup is changed.""

2700394617.m_KeyValue: ""And he healed with its grace—nurturing herbs, mending flesh, tilling life from soil.""

2700394618.m_KeyValue: "And prove I will never be bound by darkness again."

2700394619.m_KeyValue: ""Your power is far too dangerous. That's why the Saint chose to seal you alongside the equally dangerous Divine Body, Brain. Only eternal, beautiful dreams… can contain the Death that cannot die.""

2700394620.m_KeyValue: "And what about you? Have you found it yet? The future you've searched for all your life—Where no life will ever face death again?"

2700394621.m_KeyValue: ""It's been a while… or perhaps only a moment for you, Noah Nevernight. The one who died.""

2700394622.m_KeyValue: "This is... Sunset Isle? I'm back here again."

2700397820.m_KeyValue: ""Although the impostor can only move at less than half your speed, it was enough for me to make it here.""

2700397821.m_KeyValue: ""If anyone should be worried, it's me—I came here with the resolve to kill you.""

2700397822.m_KeyValue: ""Now, with no one standing between us, let's have an all-out battle—just me and your true self.""

2701704175.m_KeyValue: "What!? They're back on their feet already!?"

2702049656.m_KeyValue: ""If you say your secret is not related to the Calamity, that's enough for me.""

2702049657.m_KeyValue: ""Grandmother said that at the time, the faithful across the entire continent were in a state of panic... People saw that the Church's Bell Ringers, who had always seemed invincible, could still be...""

2702049658.m_KeyValue: ""Grandmother said she remembers that day vividly. 66 years ago, during a fierce thunderstorm, when the sun was completely shrouded by dark clouds...""

2702049660.m_KeyValue: ""Shortly after I arrived here, I met those crab friends... and you, Noah...""

2702049661.m_KeyValue: "No... I don't... I... I can't hear the other voices!"

2702049662.m_KeyValue: "I can. I'm actually getting used to this by now."

2702049689.m_KeyValue: "I got the directions wrong again? I'm so embarrassed!"

2702049690.m_KeyValue: "It's all our fault... If only we had believed the doctor's diagnosis sooner... if only I had sought help from the Church in time..."

2702049692.m_KeyValue: "But I want to see if they will..."

2702049951.m_KeyValue: ""I will wait for you, always... Noah.""

2702049984.m_KeyValue: ""Seeing them like this, I can't help but feel sorry for them.""

2702049985.m_KeyValue: "I... I'm okay... It's just... I fell and hurt my leg when I got startled. Ow..."

2702049986.m_KeyValue: "Maybe I actually drowned at sea? That would explain a few things. Is there a place where the sun never sets... Wait..."

2702050015.m_KeyValue: ""Alright, stay close to me. Let's take care of these guys first... I still have a lot of questions for you.""

2702050016.m_KeyValue: ""No, it was just wishful thinking on my part. I should've known it wouldn't be that—Huh?""

2702050017.m_KeyValue: "Piera... There's no need to be so nervous. Are you not used to talking to strangers?"

2702050021.m_KeyValue: ""N-No... Besides those crabs, you're the first soul I've seen.""

2702050047.m_KeyValue: ""There are people who recognize us here, but also secrets that are beyond our understanding.""

2702050048.m_KeyValue: "You saw them too?! Do you know who they are?! Did they hurt you?"

2702050051.m_KeyValue: "This is no time for jokes. Where's the doctor? You two were inseparable!"

2702050053.m_KeyValue: "What is my connection to Ressa? What did I do to this island?"

2702050084.m_KeyValue: "Are you saying he did not escape?"

2702050085.m_KeyValue: ""Tch, this is why I can't stand that old hag. She acts like she knows everything, but never lifts a finger...""

2702050086.m_KeyValue: "How peculiar. Blood Beasts don't just vanish upon death."

2702050114.m_KeyValue: ""A homeland where the sun never sets, a lonely isle of the dead's longing—'Sunset Isle' is where I'll find the next 'Moonblessed' connected to my memories...""

2702050115.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry for scaring you. It's probably because I've encountered all these people who seem to know me, yet I can't recognize them. My memories are all jumbled up.""

2702050116.m_KeyValue: ""No, you just don't want to remember—you're terrified to face what you've done to all of us.""

2702050117.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, do you remember what I always used to say?""

2702050118.m_KeyValue: ""But you, on the other hand, seem genuinely unaware of their existence.""

2702050143.m_KeyValue: ""Um... actually... instead of longing, perhaps memories might be more accurate?""

2702050144.m_KeyValue: ""The sun as the Divine Body? Noah, that's... very romantic...""

2702050145.m_KeyValue: ""I sure hope so. At least, I feel like I'm alive. But come to think of it, how should we define being 'alive'...""

2702050146.m_KeyValue: "Wh-what's going on!? Is... is something there?"

2702050147.m_KeyValue: ""...Oh. So you didn't come because this is your hometown, Noah?""

2702050148.m_KeyValue: ""I know who I am, I know where I'm from, I know my duty—I haven't forgotten anything...""

2702050149.m_KeyValue: ""It's your first time here too, but you've already figured out this island...""

2702050150.m_KeyValue: "Please forgive me if my pronunciation is off."

2702255125.m_KeyValue: ""Do you even know who I am now? Who I was, before?""

2702255126.m_KeyValue: ""That's right, Captain Goldland. Everything rests on your decision.""

2702255127.m_KeyValue: ""With the present of the four Apocalyptic Moonblessed, Limine will become the fifth blood.""

2702255128.m_KeyValue: "You and Cain both treat lives as pawns for your schemes."

2702255129.m_KeyValue: "The other at midnight—a final summons to unite all blood."

2702255130.m_KeyValue: "Your hatred for those who burned you surely outweighs your hatred for those who brought you back."

2702667489.m_KeyValue: ""Ever since we woke up, there's been this voice in our heads telling us to go to the far side of the moon...""

2702667490.m_KeyValue: ""Good, you didn't keep this old soul waiting for too long. But my weapon... is thirsting for blood...""

2702667491.m_KeyValue: "It is your destiny; your one and only future."

2702667522.m_KeyValue: ""'The Lovers' - connection, trust, believing in each other, moving forward together. This card depicts your present.""

2702667523.m_KeyValue: ""Now hold on. Don't you want to know more from me? Like which one is the fifth card you need, how to leave this place, or that place you're trying to reach—""

2702667525.m_KeyValue: ""To symbolize breaking free from our past lives, bound by numbers, and embracing a new future.""

2702667785.m_KeyValue: "'They say our true home lies on the far side of the moon.'"

2702667786.m_KeyValue: "Only two of us are left now. Me and that dreary No. 79."

2702667787.m_KeyValue: ""So, what do you say? Even if it's just pretending to play along... Want to escape with me?""

2702667788.m_KeyValue: "Heh... I knew I wasn't wrong about you."

2702667818.m_KeyValue: "There's an image on it. I think it's depicting our battle with that monster..."

2702667819.m_KeyValue: "They were pointing at this in their final moments... could it be the key to our escape?"

2702667851.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, what do you think is on the far side of the moon?""

2702667881.m_KeyValue: "I don't quite understand... but it seems fun. I would also like to have... friends."

2702667882.m_KeyValue: "They may not make much sense... but their strength is undeniable. There's nothing we can do."

2702667884.m_KeyValue: "Huh? So... I miscalculated? Does that mean the two of us are only worth one-tenth of that card?"

2702667886.m_KeyValue: ""I think that big, adorable puppet just ran this way?""

2702667888.m_KeyValue: "We can't leave just yet. Look at what she's holding..."

2702667948.m_KeyValue: ""If you're not afraid of the path leading to a darker abyss, then press on—candidate vessels.""

2702667952.m_KeyValue: "Is anyone really here in this darkness?"

2702667981.m_KeyValue: ""...If it starts up again, we'd have to ride it all the way back up, right? That might be worse than dying...""

2702667982.m_KeyValue: "66... Let's go meet whoever is waiting for us."

2702667983.m_KeyValue: ""Whoa, it's so dark here... Is this what Cidhall was talking about?""

2703545757.m_KeyValue: "They say all Bell Ringer Vice-Commanders are immortal Ascendants. Is it true?"

2703545758.m_KeyValue: "Even Gadric...? So this is Agares’s work. How many aces is he still hiding?"

2703545761.m_KeyValue: "Earlier than expected... just like tonight's Blood Moon."

2703546784.m_KeyValue: "...Is this a glimpse into Goldland's past?"

2704855311.m_KeyValue: "Alene said Colossus Max is the legendary hero—the guardian of the desert."

2704855312.m_KeyValue: "Aren't you afraid I'll take this chance to strike you down?"

2704855314.m_KeyValue: ""That dark one clearly failed to drag you to Twin Peaks, so now he's resorting to bait and deception.""

2706992506.m_KeyValue: ""Thoreau showed us the 'Siren's Tear'—a substance that can create illusions, and possibly even control them.""

2706992507.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, you seem to be... hiding something from Selena.""

2706992509.m_KeyValue: "Would the Church's soldiers really go to the auction house without a proper reason?"

2706992510.m_KeyValue: "I'm afraid there are more slaves imprisoned in the sewers…"

2706992538.m_KeyValue: "They are monsters mutated by the Black Blood. It is my duty to kill them..."

2706992539.m_KeyValue: "...who stole my father's land and doing all these 'good deeds'. Can you even sleep peacefully?"

2706992540.m_KeyValue: "Your father would be so proud to see you becoming a Bell Ringer."

2706992565.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Ami, step forward and claim the honor that is rightfully yours.""

2706992570.m_KeyValue: "Told you! Miss Lorelei will never be a ruthless killer!"

2706992571.m_KeyValue: ""You sought my backing, Michel. And now that I brought a Roland elder to stand with Miss Ami, will you still act so bold?""

2706992575.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, that's more than just one question.""

2706992576.m_KeyValue: "You! Why? This isn't what we agreed on—"

2706992577.m_KeyValue: "Miss Ami was right! She caught the Mistbound Terror!"

2708020103.m_KeyValue: "Buy Premium Pass to reach max LV."

2708624968.m_KeyValue: "Double Speed has been activated. We can now adjust the flow of time in battles."

2708624969.m_KeyValue: ""For example, right now the flow of time is twice its normal speed.""

2708624970.m_KeyValue: ""In the future, you can adjust it here as needed.""

2708625128.m_KeyValue: ""Remember, each Vassal has their own Moon Phase.""

2708625129.m_KeyValue: ""From left to right, they are Full Moon, Crescent Moon and New Moon.""

2708625130.m_KeyValue: "I have marked the three Moon Phases for you."

2708625131.m_KeyValue: ""When I'm deployed, the skill indicator will show the target I'm about to aim at.""

2708625132.m_KeyValue: "I will target an enemy and fire at it the moment the battle starts!"

2708625141.m_KeyValue: ""Once the moon meter is full, Blood Moon can be summoned and bring enormous aid to the fight.""

2708625142.m_KeyValue: ""Whenever there are Vassals of 3 different Moon Phases present, the battle may become more favorable.""

2708625161.m_KeyValue: "It will allow you to flexibly utilize our formation and skills to adapt to any situation!"

2708625163.m_KeyValue: "Leave it to me. Handling solitary enemies is my specialty!"

2708625164.m_KeyValue: "Observe the battlefield and enemy formations during combat."

2708625166.m_KeyValue: ""That enemy may be isolated, but seems like it could be tricky to deal with.""
