2711323455.m_KeyValue: ""Ressa, you must understand the meaning when a Bell Ringer is given the order of elimination—""

2711323457.m_KeyValue: "Then you must also know under what circumstances the Saint would assign a Bell Ringer to carry out such a merciless order."

2711323458.m_KeyValue: ""—To eliminate, at any cost, all beings potentially controlled by the Black Blood in the target area.""

2711323459.m_KeyValue: ""If you know all this, why are you still taking his side?""

2711323460.m_KeyValue: ""—When the Ancestral Black Blood breaks the Divine Body's seal, it may stir a _$$Calamity_$$ capable of plaguing the entire continent.""

2711323461.m_KeyValue: ""But in these past three months, I've seen the truth with my own eyes. He's a kind young man who works without rest to gather herbs, prepare medicine, and tend to the sick.""

2711323462.m_KeyValue: ""I know. Noah is likely Death itself—the one the Church calls the seed of Calamity, the demon sealed within the Divine Body, the very source of Black Blood.""

2711323463.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps from the very beginning, we were misled by those names the Church branded him with... _$$Calamity _$$... _$$Death_$$... Noah...""

2711323464.m_KeyValue: ""And today, I learned he is the guide—long misunderstood by legend—who guides the longing to the Other Side.""

2711324480.m_KeyValue: "Looks like we've shaken off those minions for now."

2711324481.m_KeyValue: ""What is with this island? It's crawling with strange enemies, we've been running forever, and the sun still hasn't set!""

2711324482.m_KeyValue: ""More importantly… Lady Empousa, are you all right?""

2711324483.m_KeyValue: "Why wouldn't I be? Oh! Now that you mention it..."

2711324484.m_KeyValue: ""We've been running under sunlight this whole time, and I'm not burning?""

2711324485.m_KeyValue: ""Could it be... you've overcome your weakness to sunlight, you silly bat!""

2711324486.m_KeyValue: "Seems like I'm the type who grows stronger without even realizing it!"

2711324487.m_KeyValue: "No... something's not right about this sun."

2711324488.m_KeyValue: ""Hey... it hasn't moved. Since we arrived, it's just there—motionless over the mountains.""

2711333183.m_KeyValue: ""What's wrong, Eleanor? Have you been crying?""

2711333184.m_KeyValue: ""… I wanted to pick flowers for Mother to make her happy, but… I kept walking and walking… and ended up all alone...""

2711333193.m_KeyValue: ""O revered Aeon, though I have long departed from the lands under your protection, I still believe...""

2711333194.m_KeyValue: ""...That in your infinite mercy, you can still hear my voice and answer my humble prayers...""

2711333195.m_KeyValue: ""May our path forward be bathed in the light, unhindered by shadow. May both sides...""

2711333197.m_KeyValue: "Sorry... Did I interrupt your—what's it called—prayer?"

2711333198.m_KeyValue: "You didn't interrupt anything. I'd just finished."

2711334337.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you... but that doesn't answer my question. You left without a word. As your escort, I should have noticed.""

2711334338.m_KeyValue: ""You've finally inherited the role? My congratulations, Piera.""

2711334343.m_KeyValue: "Even you? That makes me feel better."

2711334344.m_KeyValue: ""When I first came here three years ago, I got lost quite a few times too.""

2711334345.m_KeyValue: ""I feel I've walked this path so many times before, but I can't remember... How strange.""

2711334347.m_KeyValue: "Ahem! It's Piera! a name worthy of the Gravekeepers."

2711334349.m_KeyValue: "Dr. Ressa? What are you doing here?"

2711334350.m_KeyValue: "Mother and Father always say I'm silly... Sometimes I get scared they won't want me anymore."

2711335361.m_KeyValue: "Jason? You're hurt. Let me tend to you first."

2711335362.m_KeyValue: "It's nothing. I tripped while running. Piera and Sora are in danger! Please go to the blessed grounds now!"

2711335367.m_KeyValue: "Did that couple truly let go of Eleanor?"

2711335368.m_KeyValue: "They claimed they would move on... but their eyes were hollow."

2711335371.m_KeyValue: "I must visit them as soon as possible..."

2711335373.m_KeyValue: ""Not drawn toward life, but consumed by death's eternity...""

2711335374.m_KeyValue: "It's exactly how my people looked... Just before my home fell."

2711336515.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, stay with Sora. Do not let those things get close.""

2711336519.m_KeyValue: "They... they were human just moments ago. How did they turn into this..."

2711336520.m_KeyValue: "Just a little longer. Jason's gone to fetch Ressa. She'll come. She will!"

2711336523.m_KeyValue: "Damn it... I didn't think they'd be so relentless!"

2711336525.m_KeyValue: "Don't be foolish. I'm not leaving you behind!"

2711337539.m_KeyValue: ""Well, well, look who's learned how to tease people now.""

2711337543.m_KeyValue: ""When I first found you, you couldn't even speak. Now you know how to gather herbs and how much to use in each dose.""

2711337545.m_KeyValue: "I don't believe it. It took me ages to learn how to identify herbs and memorize recipes."

2711337546.m_KeyValue: "And you still get them wrong all the time."

2711337549.m_KeyValue: ""Sage, chamomile, and thyme... hmm, if it's something to calm the mind, we'll need mint as well.""

2711337550.m_KeyValue: "Sora's share is ready. Now I need rosemary and hops for Eustace."

2711338697.m_KeyValue: ""As long as I'm here, I won't let you leave this world in regret.""

2711338699.m_KeyValue: "Re... ssa... you came... to see me..."

2711338700.m_KeyValue: "What kind of doctor would I be if I couldn't even face my patient?"

2711338701.m_KeyValue: "Dr. Ressa... about Sora... You should prepare yourselves."

2711339719.m_KeyValue: "Eleanor? Haven't I led you through the passage already?"

2711339720.m_KeyValue: ""Yes! After I bid you farewell, I reached a place of warmth and light. But someone bade me not go further and to return to this side…""

2711339721.m_KeyValue: "Are they trapped here because the awakening of _$$Death_$$ has blocked the passage?"

2711339723.m_KeyValue: "These are the longings I've sent to the blessed grounds over the past three months. Why are they still lingering..."

2711339724.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, I recall you saying that means helping longings with their final departure from this world, sending them to the Other Side, where they belong.""

2715639731.m_KeyValue: "You have not reached the Achievement level to claim the next reward."

2715639863.m_KeyValue: "You are not friends with the player."

2715879334.m_KeyValue: "You need to download {size1} of necessary resources before entering your territory. The remaining resources ({size2}) can be downloaded in advance for a better gaming experience. Start download now?"

2716585384.m_KeyValue: ""It might be unthinkable to mortals, but we are called the Bloodborn precisely because we possess the coveted secret to immortality...""

2716585385.m_KeyValue: ""(sighing) Even though these Pure Blood Essences are from my personal stash... Here, take them.""

2716585386.m_KeyValue: ""Lady Empousa is in grave danger. We must move quickly—prepare yourself, then let's go.""

2716950631.m_KeyValue: ""...After all, only the dead stay silent.""

2716963447.m_KeyValue: "I thought as much. I've already brought some from the kitchen."

2716963448.m_KeyValue: "Then off with you. Four glasses of red wine will suffice for now."

2716963451.m_KeyValue: ""William has arranged for the crew to take their meals on deck in turns. We're just waiting on you, Captain.""

2716963453.m_KeyValue: ""Ah… once again, you've seen through me, sir.""

2716963454.m_KeyValue: ""Heh, don't pin it all on me. You're always in motion—surely, you haven't eaten either.""

2716964779.m_KeyValue: "I see. What a waste. All that pointless talk for nothing. I'm leaving."

2716964780.m_KeyValue: "Sorry to disappoint you. We don't actually possess that kind of ability."

2716964783.m_KeyValue: "Though the ceiling is a little high for me."

2716964784.m_KeyValue: ""After all that complicated talk, are you finally going to pass through walls?""

2716964785.m_KeyValue: "You two looked like you were about to demonstrate going through walls. I stayed to secretly learn it."

2716964787.m_KeyValue: "Then perhaps we need to overturn our assumption. That the killer strangled Aaron inside this cabin."

2716964788.m_KeyValue: "The rope must have been much longer."

2716964789.m_KeyValue: "And in this windowless cabin... this rope could lead us to a new 'door'..."

2716964790.m_KeyValue: ""Because theoretically, with a rope long enough, the killer could have murdered Aaron from somewhere else entirely.""

2728776834.m_KeyValue: "...She's been in that position for so long... I hope nothing went wrong..."

2728776836.m_KeyValue: ""Tonight's 'Moon' has lost its radiance. When tomorrow's 'Sun' is at its peak, accompanied by three bell tolls, we shall set sail from the east, moving towards the rising sun.""

2728776865.m_KeyValue: ""But we are brave sailors! Sailors who never give up in the face of nature's trickery! If Death is our destined end, we shall die at sea, not on this mediocre island!""

2728776866.m_KeyValue: "'Death's curse falls into the black bag.'"

2728776868.m_KeyValue: ""Inside is the divination for the Pontos II. When you encounter difficulties, open it and take a look.""

2728777130.m_KeyValue: ""No wonder you're so afraid of water! Well, not what I was expecting... Do you have any other interesting stories with divination?""

2728777131.m_KeyValue: "It's okay if you don't want to talk about it. Can't we try it just for fun? I want to see what it's all about."

2728777133.m_KeyValue: ""Problems with the cargo, running into a storm, being stranded on a deserted island, and now Blood Beasts appearing out of nowhere... This journey has been nothing but bad luck.""

2728777162.m_KeyValue: ""You mischievous little guy, are you hurt?""

2728777163.m_KeyValue: "But... how are the two of us going to cut down this big old thing and bring it back to camp?"

2728777164.m_KeyValue: ""...Is what I want to say, but...""

2728777195.m_KeyValue: "It seems the Blood Beasts have set their eyes on the talented mystic of the Pontos."

2728777196.m_KeyValue: ""Alright, now let's haul this back to the camp!""

2728777229.m_KeyValue: ""Everyone, muster your strength and paddle hard!""

2728777230.m_KeyValue: "Now let's get the Pontos II into the water!"

2728777231.m_KeyValue: "How could this be?! Didn't they say... didn't they say she could hold on until tomorrow?!"

2728777232.m_KeyValue: ""Everyone's already seen the end of the story, right?""

2728777257.m_KeyValue: "The sea's waves may toss us... but we don't care..."

2728777261.m_KeyValue: "Today is the day we board the great Pontos II!"

2728777263.m_KeyValue: "I will perform the final divination and lead everyone off this island."

2728777264.m_KeyValue: ""He... he is still the Captain, do we really... really have to...""

2728777291.m_KeyValue: "The voice also told me that the paint needed to create the sacred Tarot cards are just ahead."

2728777293.m_KeyValue: "I will draw the last card. I promised Ernest... I can do it."

2728777294.m_KeyValue: ""Stay here and wait for me to come back. Don't wander off, don't interact with other cats. Remember that, my mischievous little 'Star.'""

2728777325.m_KeyValue: ""My trick? I'm just a poor ghost without even a form, how could I have such power?""

2729241751.m_KeyValue: "Here's the culprit—this metal part is blocking the outlet."

2729241752.m_KeyValue: "I'd barely opened my doors this morning when some little creature came barreling through and turned everything into absolute chaos—"

2733029133.m_KeyValue: ""No, we can't just leave like this.""

2733029134.m_KeyValue: "Seems the disguise failed... in that case—"

2733029135.m_KeyValue: ""Since you're with the silver-haired one, he must have already spoken of me. I am his most capable assistant and the foremost disciple of the Church's Silver Cross Van Helsing—Selena, the Deadly Arrow.""

2733029136.m_KeyValue: ""I am indeed here to rescue Ami. And from your question, I'd say you are too, aren't you?""

2733029138.m_KeyValue: "Strange... they've been resurrected... and their strings have been restored as well..."

2733029166.m_KeyValue: ""So, this is the Master Lorelei has been seeking all this time?""

2733029167.m_KeyValue: "Did Joyce ever mention that the Siren's Tears needed to be handed over to Joyce?"

2733029168.m_KeyValue: "Fighting is bad! Why don't we make a deal with Joyce instead?"

2733029169.m_KeyValue: ""Wait! Bella No. 7, you're back! Joyce thought you were gone forever!""

2733029170.m_KeyValue: ""Bella No. 7, don't look at Joyce as your enemy... it makes Joyce so sad...""

2733029171.m_KeyValue: ""Now that all the Siren's Tears are gathered here, Joyce can transform even more puppets!""

2733029172.m_KeyValue: "Fries aren't important—Prioritize Master Joyce... Protect Master Joyce!"

2733029197.m_KeyValue: "Her life is draining... Such is the sorrowful fate of artificial life."

2733029198.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, why are you getting even colder?""

2733029199.m_KeyValue: "Ugh... that silver-haired servant is utterly useless! Why can't he work as tirelessly as Joyce does?"

2733029200.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, where you think you can run now?""

2733029201.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, right! I almost forgot to give this to you.""

2733029202.m_KeyValue: ""I feel the same way... So please, stay. I'll find the way—""

2733029204.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, there's one more thing. If the puppet holds Bella's memory fragments from her life, could we bring her back?""

2733029223.m_KeyValue: ""No need for that, Selena. Someone's already paid off all your debts.""

2733029230.m_KeyValue: "I know that if it were your friend—the silver-haired one—he would definitely grant freedom to the sirens."

2733029231.m_KeyValue: "Someone has already booked the ultra-grand celebration package for the new Sage's appointment."

2733029232.m_KeyValue: ""A grotesquely carved wooden monster, its back marked with the words 'Captain is Family'—but family is not a title to be taken; it is a bond that must be acknowledged by all.""

2733029233.m_KeyValue: "Oh—right! Since when did none of you fear the sunlight anymore?"

2733029234.m_KeyValue: "The costumes from that interactive performance were utterly profound! They've sparked my latest vision: a fabric-free summer collection."

2733029235.m_KeyValue: ""I'll go talk to the owner, maybe... there's another way!""

2733029236.m_KeyValue: "And I have no patience for people who lack a sense of timing."

2733029262.m_KeyValue: "'Before leaving… there's still time to wrap up one last transaction through Hallon!'"

2733029263.m_KeyValue: ""Lorelei counted the stars as they faded, one by one, until golden light broke in the east.""

2733029264.m_KeyValue: ""If they had never come, the Isle would never have descended into this nightmare.""

2733029265.m_KeyValue: "A shard sliced across Averdin's hand. It burned."

2733029266.m_KeyValue: ""The obsidian knife parted the scales, cutting through the hide-like fishtail. The sinewy gray-blue muscles twitched, causing the grotesque fins to strike the blade with a high-pitched, mournful ring.""

2733029267.m_KeyValue: "'Was I kidnapped? Them too? Who would do this…?'"

2733029268.m_KeyValue: ""He stared at Bella on the operating table, one leg already lost. This was the best he could do.""

2733749456.m_KeyValue: ""Wow, it fell and transformed into a flower petal.""

2733754146.m_KeyValue: "That curly-headed boy had dreams like that...?"

2733754149.m_KeyValue: ""When we grow up, you'll be the most famous singer on the continent—and I'll be a renowned clavichord player.""

2733754150.m_KeyValue: ""Very well. From now on, we'll meet there.""

2733754151.m_KeyValue: "My brother once said his dream was to become the most righteous tailor on the continent."

2733754153.m_KeyValue: ""When we practice, let's do it in that old ship by the shore.""

2733754155.m_KeyValue: ""I found a safe path. Just follow the <style=""Highlight"">Tidewisp markers</style> and avoid the damaged areas.""

2733754156.m_KeyValue: "That ship's too old. It might be dangerous."

2733756313.m_KeyValue: "Even after eleven years... the promised markers still guide the way."

2734960181.m_KeyValue: ""By the looks of it, those soldiers will be affected too, not just us.""

2734978515.m_KeyValue: "_$$Who in this world is truly in the right?_$$ ...such a heavy thing to consider."

2734978516.m_KeyValue: "From the beginning... I was no one. Only a vessel. For Mother. For Limine Bathory."

2734978518.m_KeyValue: "You say you have plans—but whose side are you truly on?"

2734978519.m_KeyValue: ""Isn't this the best? You're the one who chose this path. Hopefully, we'll regroup with the others soon enough.""

2734979534.m_KeyValue: "Go after him! I won't allow that stupid bat to die by his hands!"

2734979535.m_KeyValue: "No way! I'll defeat every last one of you!"

2734979538.m_KeyValue: ""But I remember this carriage—when it fell, no one died...""

2734979539.m_KeyValue: "Is she... your companion? Another version of you?"

2734979540.m_KeyValue: ""If a beast takes on the memories of a human, is it still just a beast, or is it now human? Was that your test for your companions?""

2734979541.m_KeyValue: ""And yet you, a Bell Ringer sworn to the Saint, see Aeon—the Church's one true god—as your enemy?""

2734979542.m_KeyValue: "Of all people to see after returning to my body... it had to be you?"

2734979543.m_KeyValue: ""Or that you never became them at all. From the very beginning, you were them. Perhaps... you were everyone.""

2736270172.m_KeyValue: "My blade takes no pleasure in bloodshed. My ears abhor the sound of screaming..."

2736270173.m_KeyValue: ""No, this is the fate of all conscious life...""

2736270174.m_KeyValue: ""On the Other Side, 'he' will weave the 'preordained history' into new time, and from it, forge worlds that repeat.""

2736271193.m_KeyValue: ""I'd be forgotten. Just like the moon is the sun's dream; and when the dawn comes, the dream will be forgotten.""

2736271194.m_KeyValue: ""To remain this calm, even now... As expected of Silver-haired's master.""

2736271195.m_KeyValue: "...Perhaps you're right. Maybe I've had them all along... this companion by my side."

2736271196.m_KeyValue: "I truly despise fighting in this hideous form... but against you..."

2736271197.m_KeyValue: "Because you can resurrect with that... memory transference ritual?"

2736271198.m_KeyValue: "I haven't saved Lamia yet. We haven't found our true homeland. And I still haven't... with Noah..."

2736288066.m_KeyValue: "He's been hiding inside the Colossus Max this entire time!"

2736288067.m_KeyValue: "What is that dark figure even talking about...? None of it makes sense..."

2736288068.m_KeyValue: ""No point delaying. The sooner we test this, the sooner we know if it'll work.""

2736288070.m_KeyValue: "That can't be right! We stockpiled enough wood to supply hundreds."

2736288071.m_KeyValue: "Now you're suddenly saying we should roast that big lump of metal over a bonfire?"

2736288072.m_KeyValue: "I fear that final blow drained all of his stored energy."

2737579727.m_KeyValue: "This is... more complicated than I expected."

2737852473.m_KeyValue: ""Oh no... what do I do now?! Her silence is terrifying! Silver-haired friend, say something!""

2737852474.m_KeyValue: ""That's right! If we collect them all, we can awaken the complete Bella! And redeem her life from Joyce!""

2737852475.m_KeyValue: "And if I choose to continue living as I am?"

2738444157.m_KeyValue: "The road ahead won't be easy. More Vassals will be needed to aid you in battles to come."

2738506033.m_KeyValue: ""Well, now. We haven't seen a visitor here in ages, living ones at that.""

2738506034.m_KeyValue: ""Since the dark-skinned lady here seems intrigued, please follow me.""

2738506035.m_KeyValue: "Was this place not abandoned? Why is there a strange man inside?"

2738506036.m_KeyValue: ""Your presence warms me, but alas, you tread on forbidden grounds—Perhaps you'd do well to reconsider.""

2738506037.m_KeyValue: ""—Augustine. Those who know the name are among the family's most trusted... I can sense that your curiosity has led you here. Well, come then—You may enter freely, at your own will.""

2738506038.m_KeyValue: "I seem to recall him as well. He became keeper after the building was renovated long ago. His name was Augi-something..."

2739478707.m_KeyValue: "I can't stand by and watch them suffer like this..."

2744937277.m_KeyValue: ""Here, you can undertake daily training. These challenges will not only enhance your Blood Power but also grant rich rewards.""

2747448784.m_KeyValue: "And received the baptism that made me a Bell Ringer."

2747448785.m_KeyValue: ""And I'm glad for you. Though we've both lost the home we once shared, you've found people who await your return. You are no longer alone.""

2747448786.m_KeyValue: "For sixty-six years we were at the Cathedral and you'd visit me..."

2747448787.m_KeyValue: ""I have promises to keep. People waiting for me beyond this dream. They pulled me back from the void, back from the dark.""

2747448788.m_KeyValue: ""No, no, no! We just bid farewell at Sunset Isle, so what is that longing!?""

2747448789.m_KeyValue: "Very well. I also have business with Silver-Haired."

2747451987.m_KeyValue: "You think something like this would shake my resolve?"

2747451988.m_KeyValue: ""There's no need to feel guilty about that, for I had already planned to face you in a different form, because...""

2747451989.m_KeyValue: "So this Bell Ringer is the avatar of thunder... Your speed far exceeds my expectations."

2747838018.m_KeyValue: "And drop that fake meow already! ...And stop changing the subject—what are you really here for?"

2747838019.m_KeyValue: "Wasn't he already dead? Cut down by the long-haired Gilrain right there in the Hall of the Elders."

2748740439.m_KeyValue: ""Because you see me now not as Tris—but as a Heretic, through the eyes of a Bell Ringer. That is your choice, Acappella.""

2748740441.m_KeyValue: ""You will always be my child. That wild, untamed soul who loves to sing.""

2748740442.m_KeyValue: ""I don't… I don't understand you anymore. If that's true, then everything we believed in—it was all a lie?""

2748740443.m_KeyValue: ""With Thibault's power, I brought you back to the place where I once watched you grow.""

2748740444.m_KeyValue: "So long as a mother lives… her child remains a child."

2754020956.m_KeyValue: ""In times of uncertainty, the _$$Threads of Fate_$$ always brings unexpected clarity.""

2754094916.m_KeyValue: ""Jestel, I leave the flank to you!""

2754095048.m_KeyValue: ""I can't believe I was praised by the great Aiona, the one close to the renowned Moonblessed...""

2754095083.m_KeyValue: "What... What am I supposed to do?"

2754095114.m_KeyValue: ""Now is not the time to play the hero, Miss Bloodborn.""

2755802982.m_KeyValue: ""Take the soil, for instance—it appears tainted by some unknown contaminant.""

2755802983.m_KeyValue: "Have you had any trouble with the water supply?"

2755802984.m_KeyValue: ""The fountain draws from the underground waterways—naturally, they're contaminated as well.""

2755802985.m_KeyValue: "Time to pay that noble's residence a visit—"

2758698911.m_KeyValue: ""Well done, Noah. I've prepared everything you'll need from now on. Follow me.""

2758709009.m_KeyValue: ""It's so dark in here, not a speck of light... Would it be too late to change our minds?""

2758709011.m_KeyValue: "These phantoms are memories which have slipped here from other realms. It seems today we're dealing with a realm ruled by Blood Servants."

2758709012.m_KeyValue: ""That's what everyone says. Well, let me first provide you with some guidance.""

2758709014.m_KeyValue: ""Now, time for you to deal with them. And don't fear the unknown—you're stronger than you might imagine.""

2758710034.m_KeyValue: "The 'Pure Blood Essence' within is exactly what newly turned vassals desperately need."

2758710035.m_KeyValue: "Pure Blood Essence? Does that mean... they have to drink blood?"

2758710036.m_KeyValue: ""Pure Blood Essence is precious sustenance for the Bloodborn. I understand this transition is difficult to accept right away, but it's necessary to gain power.""

2758710037.m_KeyValue: ""Eating when hungry, wanting to live when sick—setting aside our conflicts, can humans and Bloodborn be similar creatures? I understand now. To 'live,' we drink.""

2761039794.m_KeyValue: ""Sometimes, we don't need to find a way out—we just need to keep moving forward.""

2761039795.m_KeyValue: "Of course... I should have known. We're all caged beasts—how could we possibly hide weapons outside the castle?"

2761039796.m_KeyValue: "No. 66 always said the wind outside the castle sounded different from within."

2761420321.m_KeyValue: ""For each Element, I foresee that you may encounter 1 to 3 Trials.""

2762711976.m_KeyValue: "Please use this function when you need it."

2764585325.m_KeyValue: "I've got it! It must have been the fangs! It was this Bloodborn after all! Those razor-sharp fangs would be perfect!"

2764585326.m_KeyValue: "I'm not suspecting Bob. I simply wanted to demonstrate how difficult it would be for anyone to accomplish this from the deck."

2764585327.m_KeyValue: "But—like what little Van Helsing pointed out—how could the patrol crew not notice the rope?"

2764585328.m_KeyValue: ""The culprit prepared a long rope in advance, looping it over the yardarm on the mast so that both ends dropped to opposite sides of the deck.""

2764585329.m_KeyValue: ""His incompetence as a sailor carried over into his work as a 'murderer'—just as you pointed out, First Mate Bob.""

2764585330.m_KeyValue: ""...Huh? I-I knew it! Even though I'm not totally sure who died, I definitely already figured out the killer!""

2764585331.m_KeyValue: "When did I ever say I had no evidence?"

2764585332.m_KeyValue: ""...All of this is conjecture. Without producing this supposed rope, you cannot prove it existed—much less that it was used to kill Aaron.""

2764585333.m_KeyValue: ""It pains me to say it, but this person was meant to safeguard the ship alongside me... Yet somehow, he became an accomplice to crime.""

2764585334.m_KeyValue: ""Exactly. And according to the testimony we gathered earlier, William was never seen near the kitchen or the guest cabins.""

2764585357.m_KeyValue: "...V-Van Helsing!? How dare you barge in without notice!"

2764585358.m_KeyValue: "Where did you go? I hope you're not hiding anything... Aeon sees all."

2764585359.m_KeyValue: "You said William was on deck. Where is he?"

2764585360.m_KeyValue: "Only a few of us boarded there! And you know we can control Black Blood. We didn't bite anyone—there's no way it was us!"

2764585613.m_KeyValue: "That's not the point! I don't care if this is a shopping list or a ledger—it's not a boarding invitation!"

2764585614.m_KeyValue: ""Sir, what are your orders? A storm's closing in, and Captain Goldland needs you on the sails immediately!""

2764585621.m_KeyValue: "A statue of himself for the figurehead? A golden helm that practically screams for attention?"

2764585623.m_KeyValue: "Yet you did return—just as I remembered. And Clive Jr. remained there... just as history had written it."

2764585624.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, I remember. There was something else you wanted to tell me that day. What...""

2764585625.m_KeyValue: ""That's right. I'm Ami, Captain of the El Dorado. It's an honor to meet you all.""

2764585626.m_KeyValue: ""Look at that—someone who can match her, word for word.""

2764585627.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Dalcarlo may seem unreliable, but her divinations are often uncannily accurate. Don't worry about them.""

2764585628.m_KeyValue: ""If I recall correctly, those are unique to a particular noble bloodline. Why would a child like that be working aboard as crew?""

2764585653.m_KeyValue: "Do you have any idea how beloved I am among the crew? How much the previous passengers adored me? You don't know a thing about me—a-and you call me strange?"

2764585654.m_KeyValue: ""It is therefore highly likely they still linger in the shadows, working to fulfill some mission. Thus, the most probable conclusion:""

2764585655.m_KeyValue: ""This young lady possesses keen senses. Her body isn't adjusting well to the ship's motion—her senses and balance are at odds, causing her seasickness.""

2764585656.m_KeyValue: ""Excuse me?! I'm going out of my way to help you, and this is the thanks I get?""

2764585659.m_KeyValue: ""...If you're unable to authorize it, I'll speak with Goldland myself.""

2764585660.m_KeyValue: "How... how dare you harm my beloved crew!"

2764585685.m_KeyValue: "I'm going to notify the Captain—wait here!"

2764585686.m_KeyValue: "And I've never seen weapons like yours."

2764585687.m_KeyValue: ""I finally managed to buy myself an Elder's seat in a prominent family, and yet I've barely earned a coin from it.""

2764585688.m_KeyValue: "An invitation? Are we being invited to some auction?"

2764585689.m_KeyValue: ""Ah! I got so caught up listening to their banter, I almost forgot my task! I'm here to escort little Van Helsing to see the Captain.""

2764585690.m_KeyValue: ""Huh... You know, I've never actually thought about that. Now I'm curious—who's stronger, you or the Silver Cross?""

2764585691.m_KeyValue: "Eek! I heard they kill without blinking and reek of blood... I need to grab some incense from my cabin—right now!"

2764585692.m_KeyValue: ""In other words—they're powerful, secret operatives who work behind the scenes.""

2764585714.m_KeyValue: ""What?! You sent Ami to the kitchen?! We still have three days left at sea—at this rate, our supplies won't last through the night!""

2764585717.m_KeyValue: ""Aye, Captain! This way, my lovely guests. Ami just changed the mattresses—it should make for a good night's rest.""

2764585718.m_KeyValue: "But Kristoph! Even putting aside their identities—they caused trouble on deck just moments ago!"

2764585719.m_KeyValue: ""You'll remain aboard this ship, Silver-haired. And I'll have plenty of time to watch your every move.""

2764585720.m_KeyValue: ""This manifest bears the seal of the Puppet Association. They're the only ones capable of selling wine to Mr. Cain at 500,000 Soli. That alone tells me enough.""

2764585721.m_KeyValue: ""Eh? No, I was just running my mouth…""

2764585722.m_KeyValue: ""Decorating the Captain's quarters with retired Knight armor—that's his way of showing gratitude. Reverence, even.""

2764585723.m_KeyValue: ""All I feel is disgust. One's a repulsive Heretic who snuck aboard, and the other's an arrogant noble who muscled his way into power...""

2764585724.m_KeyValue: "Let's see if that sharp tongue of yours still works once you're on the gallows!"

2764585745.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph. I must admit, your deduction is sound.""

2764585750.m_KeyValue: "His body's still warm. No sign of rigor mortis yet. He died only moments ago."

2764585751.m_KeyValue: ""Now that you mention it... When I first arrived at the kitchen, I ran into Second Mate Aaron. He was there too.""

2764585752.m_KeyValue: ""Roughly one bell ago, Miss Ami entered the kitchen. She encountered Aaron, who should have returned to his post—but never did.""

2764585753.m_KeyValue: "Didn't you rush here with us the moment you heard the commotion? Why are you only arriving now?"

2764585754.m_KeyValue: ""Careful, Bob. Try not to damage my ship.""

2764585755.m_KeyValue: ""That's right. William reported the helm was jammed. Right after that, the ship shook—and he rushed down here with us.""

2764585781.m_KeyValue: "So everyone got used to seeing him sneak around in the kitchen?"

2764585782.m_KeyValue: "I'm not making excuses. I've just dealt with this kind of enemy before."

2764585783.m_KeyValue: "Why did you bring me to the kitchen? Are you hungry?"

2764585784.m_KeyValue: "Seems the answer has come full circle... Back to where it all began."

2764585786.m_KeyValue: "We're testing if it's possible to strangle Aaron from outside the guest room."

2764585787.m_KeyValue: "Didn't you just say on deck that I'm too thin?"

2764585788.m_KeyValue: "Attempt? What ungraceful attempts have you been making aboard my ship?"

2764585813.m_KeyValue: ""First we need to find somewhere safe! You still have the storage room keys, right?""

2764585814.m_KeyValue: "I dozed off in the barrel. It's surprisingly cozy... I only caught something about stealing..."

2764585815.m_KeyValue: "What's wrong? Did they eat contaminated octopus? Why are they twisted and wobbly like Octo?"

2764585816.m_KeyValue: "I found it while you were talking to yourself."

2764585817.m_KeyValue: "Found what? Is it what Aaron dropped?"

2764585820.m_KeyValue: "What are you doing down here?! Don't you trust me?!"

2767702930.m_KeyValue: "I'll leave here to you and hunt down the fourth family!"

2767703953.m_KeyValue: "How long has it been since I've seen you like this? Ten years? Twenty?"

2767703955.m_KeyValue: "...Elder Dalcarlo? Then it makes sense. We were also attacked—by Gilrain."

2769101758.m_KeyValue: ""Daily, Weekly, as well as Story Tasks each have their own objectives. Completing milestone achievements also grants rewards.""

2769101759.m_KeyValue: ""After completing Missions and Tasks, don't forget to collect your well-deserved compensation!""

2771518348.m_KeyValue: ""But when two hearts beat as one, even chaos can become a sweet melody.""

2771518349.m_KeyValue: ""So, you should start thinking about what game we'll play next.""

2771518350.m_KeyValue: ""Tell me, why is your heart racing so wildly right now?""

2771518352.m_KeyValue: "Stop pretending! You should be awake by now!"

2771518355.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, I was overthinking things. I apologize.""

2771518356.m_KeyValue: "But I have no idea what kind of _$$commotion_$$ to cause yet."

2773792560.m_KeyValue: ""And now, to protect that happiness… I have even more reason to recover my sorrow.""

2773792562.m_KeyValue: ""After that, Tris brought me to the Church. I underwent the Silver Blood baptism.""

2777854883.m_KeyValue: "Buy Premium Pass to reach max LV."

2779625023.m_KeyValue: ""But now, as our family stirs once more, it is time to awaken them, to let them bear witness to our rebirth and rising glory.""

2779625120.m_KeyValue: "Heh... _$$The Deadly Arrow_$$ never misses its mark!"

2780083301.m_KeyValue: ""I have a wanted notice here, signed by Lord Hallon himself.""

2780083303.m_KeyValue: "Who ordered you to bring Ami here?"

2780083304.m_KeyValue: ""If they truly cannot die, what hope do we have of winning?""

2780083307.m_KeyValue: ""Run as you will, and my arrows follow like fate.""

2780083332.m_KeyValue: ""Eleven years... I thought she was dead all this time. Let me see her once, then I'll submit to whatever fate you choose for me.""

2780083333.m_KeyValue: "So Lord Hallon can rest easy and become a 'boring' father."

2780083334.m_KeyValue: ""Correct! Joyce has already replaced all the Sages with puppets, except for Lord Constantine, who's still in hiding, and the ever-troublesome Lord Hallon...""

2780083335.m_KeyValue: "This smoke... has turned the crew and guards into string puppets."

2780083336.m_KeyValue: ""Puppets, bring Miss Ami here at once!""

2780083359.m_KeyValue: ""Constantine's office houses all his research records. Hidden within them, there must be a way to purge the influence of Siren's Tear from Ami.""

2780083364.m_KeyValue: ""Oh! Oh! Bella No. 13! You're burning up! You must be getting stronger! Quick, use your fire punch on them—""

2780083365.m_KeyValue: "Looks formidable... Could it have any weaknesses?"

2780083367.m_KeyValue: ""In truth, none of these sounds ever echo… Sapphire Isle remains lost in its sweet delusion, awaiting the break of dawn.""

2780083368.m_KeyValue: "Oh no! Did we make it in time?"

2780083369.m_KeyValue: ""I made a deal with the Master, hoping to save you, but I never imagined that would mean turning you into a puppet. I was told you were being treated...""

2780083391.m_KeyValue: "Completely bald. Not wearing a single stitch of clothing. She didn't seem... particularly respectable."

2780083397.m_KeyValue: ""Earlier, you called that glimmering object a Siren's Tear. But what are sirens? Are they truly here?""

2780083398.m_KeyValue: ""No wonder this place has risen to fame as a popular resort, despite lacking the support of any major families.""

2780083400.m_KeyValue: "I need to talk to Father right away and have him prepare a token of gratitude!"

2780083402.m_KeyValue: ""Sir, why aren't you saying anything? Ah, this is bad, Sir! I forgot something very important!""

2780083403.m_KeyValue: ""The appointed time has come and gone, yet the Master hasn't brought Michel, nor provided any updates on the Puppet Elysium...""

2780083425.m_KeyValue: ""'Keep this pact with you. When the time comes to fulfill it, you'll receive a letter.'""

2780083428.m_KeyValue: ""Far across the ink-black sea, a silhouette rose with the sun.""

2780083431.m_KeyValue: "Albrecht neither nodded nor shook his head. Hallon couldn't read his expression."

2780083432.m_KeyValue: "Averdin had never known this basement existed beneath his brother's residence."

2780083433.m_KeyValue: ""Lorelei nodded without a flicker of doubt. She was eight years old then, clutching three luminous pearls and seventy-five Soli saved from her stepfather. She was ready to give everything she had—no, more than that—for something others called impossible:""

2780083434.m_KeyValue: "Constantine crumpled to the floor. It was over. His homeland would soon become a breeding ground for the Black Blood."

2780083435.m_KeyValue: "She should have fought. She should have struck him down."

2780913477.m_KeyValue: ""Here, the spirits of powerful enemies you've faced before will manifest again. Defeat them to earn rewards.""

2780916678.m_KeyValue: "Baphomet the Soulless? He did all this?"

2781278276.m_KeyValue: "Tap the Open button to open the chest."

2781623297.m_KeyValue: "Your Vassals are now available for Skill Upgrade."

2781954531.m_KeyValue: "Clan name can be changed after establishment."

2782759955.m_KeyValue: "But what if I told you... that the Black Blood can grant you power beyond human limits?"

2783324338.m_KeyValue: ""But the truth is... you didn't stop. You lost your way. You've become something monstrous, Gilrain.""

2783324339.m_KeyValue: "—Perhaps because one from the Bathory line once took part in that story."

2783324340.m_KeyValue: ""Yes. A final clash between three wills who could not become one. And so, they destroyed each other before the unification.""

2783324341.m_KeyValue: "They look more like rocks than kids. How can you tell?"

2783325358.m_KeyValue: "So? Aiona can't reach this place anymore. And that brat's bullets can't even pierce the air."

2783325360.m_KeyValue: "I know. I've always known. This is our fate—mine and Lamia's. A burden we were born to bear."

2783325361.m_KeyValue: "What's the point of saying all this now?"

2783325362.m_KeyValue: ""How enviable… this trust, these bonds. Is that the privilege of humans who still dare to dream of the future?""

2783325365.m_KeyValue: ""It's... no use... If this goes on, everyone... will die...""

2786153320.m_KeyValue: "This is the privilege you gave me."

2787449600.m_KeyValue: "The following Vassals grant a higher chance of Extra Rewards upon clearing stages."

2788062479.m_KeyValue: "They seem to be trying to communicate with me too. This sound... probably means the guards are not here?"

2788062480.m_KeyValue: ""If I could get the prisoners by the door to warn me about guard movements, it would make things much easier.""

2788062481.m_KeyValue: "You take us for fools?! What is it?"

2788062482.m_KeyValue: ""Are you afraid... Isaac, do you yearn for it?""

2788062509.m_KeyValue: "No need. My subordinates will bring the token over later."

2788062511.m_KeyValue: ""Let’s hope this time, I won’t have to clean up after him.""

2788062513.m_KeyValue: ""Alright, alright… let’s see what our final candidate has in store for us!""

2788062515.m_KeyValue: "'You' what? Turing to your father again?"

2788062773.m_KeyValue: ""Five more barrels of wine, a basket of bread, thirty grilled mussels, twenty grilled oysters, twenty grilled scallops—""

2788062774.m_KeyValue: "Was it the all-you-can-eat snacks that kept Miss Ami lingering about? Five more grilled squid—"

2788062778.m_KeyValue: ""You're not from around here, are you?""

2788062779.m_KeyValue: "Why are you looking for Isaac? Did you get separated?"

2788062800.m_KeyValue: "Sold for one million! Now fill Joyce's body with lots and lots of shiny coins!"

2788062805.m_KeyValue: "That grandiose title is too much praise. We simply wanted to build our ideal city-state."

2788062807.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, I can't even see any seams. How was this made?""

2788062810.m_KeyValue: "Return to the... I remember we were supposed to help Miss Ami find something at the auction—"

2788062811.m_KeyValue: ""Don't underestimate this 'Sword of Honor for Slaying Sirens', it was made using a rare future Artifact that the Association rewarded me with.""

2788062812.m_KeyValue: "Did the Seven Sage Association have the stall owners make these?"

2788062840.m_KeyValue: "Vital signs... what is she talking about?"

2788062866.m_KeyValue: ""<color=#c6ae80>Besides Soli, there's nothing left in my life anymore.</color>""

2788062869.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps the legend of the Siren was created to cover up this Mistbound Terror's existence."

2788062872.m_KeyValue: "Just some old memories. They have nothing to do with this Mistbound Terror."

2788062874.m_KeyValue: "I haven't seen them today... I heard someone went missing this morning. I hope they weren't caught up in it."

2788062876.m_KeyValue: ""I only 'borrowed' this token from Master Albrecht to help Master Van Helsing, but to think I might have to use it now...""

2788062906.m_KeyValue: ""I remember Albrecht had a task there. Come to think of it, wasn't that when he saved you?""

2788062932.m_KeyValue: ""I apologize, my sleeping schedule differs from most people's. I thought I'd pass the time with a walk, and found myself here before I knew it.""

2788062933.m_KeyValue: ""Strange, where are their bodies? They're gone?!""

2788062934.m_KeyValue: "It's possible that... he's one of the Seven Sages!"

2788062937.m_KeyValue: "But... why would a pirate have a tattoo of a dove?!"

2788062938.m_KeyValue: "You seem to know a lot about the Isle."

2788062940.m_KeyValue: ""Well, what information do you want this time?""

2788062963.m_KeyValue: "I knew it! You're in league with those rich people!"

2788062964.m_KeyValue: "What did you see in the Siren's Tear?"

2788062966.m_KeyValue: "I believe we can build a new utopia together."

2788062967.m_KeyValue: "Excellent. Then you must also know what we have accomplished."

2788062968.m_KeyValue: "No need to hold back. Please speak your mind."

2788062969.m_KeyValue: ""If that's the case, our 'negotiation' will surely be a pleasant one.""

2788062970.m_KeyValue: "I heard that you spent a fortune at yesterday's auction on a gilded statue."

2788062972.m_KeyValue: ""Thoreau... You mean Viktor Thoreau, one of the Seven Sages? The keeper of order who was called the 'Peace Bearer from the Olive Leaf' after suppressing the uprising in the Olive Leaf slums?""

2791114441.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry, I'm just a healer. I've never experienced anything like this...""

2792402394.m_KeyValue: "And I still don't remember what happened in all that time."

2792402395.m_KeyValue: "But... sixty-six years have passed since the battle with the Bell Ringer—since I parted ways with Ressa..."

2792402404.m_KeyValue: ""Lies a world that belongs to us, and us alone.""

2792402405.m_KeyValue: "Your heart. Your mind. In your blood. In the deepest corridors of memory..."

2792402406.m_KeyValue: "Then what I just saw... those past events... They weren't dreams. They were memories returning to me."

2792402407.m_KeyValue: ""And I've been waiting here for you, Noah Nevernight... For far longer than you know.""

2792402408.m_KeyValue: "My presence here is proof that you've always known who you are. Death."

2792402409.m_KeyValue: "How can you reclaim what was never truly lost? You never forgot. You simply had no need to remember."

2792403418.m_KeyValue: ""As a Bell Ringer's Vice-Commander and an Ascendant, she wouldn't be permitted to leave without authorization from the Church.""

2792403419.m_KeyValue: "Finding Piera on Sunset Isle isn't just a matter of Church protocol. It's about answering some questions I've had."

2792403427.m_KeyValue: "There are even more traces of crystals around us..."

2792403428.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps we're getting closer to where Piera is channeling her power."

2792403429.m_KeyValue: "I still can't believe that she could transform the entire island like this."

2792403430.m_KeyValue: "I've been wondering why those creatures were also covered in crystals."

2792403431.m_KeyValue: ""Piera and I were both disciples of Master Albrecht, and the very first lesson we learned was how to control our own power. But the current situation seems like...""

2792403433.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of which, don't tell me you boarded the El Dorado just to find Piera on Sunset Isle?""

2792404572.m_KeyValue: "But in my memory… it was Agares who took me away."

2792404573.m_KeyValue: "You were sealed by Bell Ringer Tris and taken away from Sunset Isle... What you see now is the memory you lost."

2792404578.m_KeyValue: ""Of course not. If it weren't for you, Dr. Ressa, who would have treated our wounds and illnesses?""

2792404579.m_KeyValue: "Piera... do you hate me? For lacking the resolve to kill Noah... even knowing he is Death?"

2792404580.m_KeyValue: ""Dr. Ressa, the one named Darcias has already evacuated the residents. Shouldn't we return to the Church as well?""

2792404582.m_KeyValue: ""Dr. Ressa, let's take Noah and leave this place together!""

2792404584.m_KeyValue: ""If you're not leaving now, find your own way off Sunset Isle!""

2792404585.m_KeyValue: ""And besides, even without his memories, Noah helped us many times. Even if he is Death...""

2792405596.m_KeyValue: "He's not alone. The concentration of crystals in the area is high—they're Piera's salt crystals. There was an explosion here."

2792405597.m_KeyValue: "Are you saying... are you saying the one you're looking for is trapped inside that thing—with Noah?"

2792405602.m_KeyValue: ""_$$He is Death, veiled in shadow, who leads all life to its appointed end. He is Rebirth, crowned in light, who calls what withers to rise anew._$$""

2792405603.m_KeyValue: "The Moonblessed Death we seek... Could that be the source of the black mist?"

2792405606.m_KeyValue: "But this thing... Just a fraction of its pressure... It’s stronger than that giant we faced on the ship!"

2792405607.m_KeyValue: "Is Noah... really inside that... all by himself?"

2792405608.m_KeyValue: "You damn bat... Don't tell me you think Noah is in there?!"

2792405609.m_KeyValue: ""I'm certain of it... I can feel Noah's pain, he's trapped in there!""

2792406750.m_KeyValue: "Her existence serves to remind you of the warmth you once experienced as a human."

2792406751.m_KeyValue: "This person is a testament to your friendship."

2792406754.m_KeyValue: "But I don't get it. What purpose does this serve you?"

2792406755.m_KeyValue: ""Using those phantoms of Jason, Sora, and Piera's grandmother, you led me step by step into the depths of my memories in order to awaken my past self.""

2792406757.m_KeyValue: ""Don't forget, Noah... From the beginning, you and I were one and the same.""

2792406758.m_KeyValue: ""It appears that you, in your current state, have lost your power.""

2792406760.m_KeyValue: ""Since my arrival on this island, you were the one who used nightmares to force me to recall my past.""

2792406761.m_KeyValue: "It's still more than enough to deal with you."

2792407774.m_KeyValue: "Because I am not the one you need to fight."

2792407775.m_KeyValue: ""Damn it… Then who? If not you, who am I supposed to hate...?""

2792407778.m_KeyValue: "How unfortunate. I don't have time for you right now."

2792407780.m_KeyValue: "Didn't you hear me!? I told you to stop!"

2792407781.m_KeyValue: ""Why… Even after becoming a Bell Ringer, why am I still powerless against Death?!""

2792407783.m_KeyValue: "And right now... I'm not your enemy."

2792407784.m_KeyValue: "Silence! I must complete Commander Tris's unfinished mission and seal you here!"

2792407785.m_KeyValue: "Otherwise... I'll never break free from that day's shadow!"

2792408928.m_KeyValue: ""You guys get out of here when you get the chance, don't worry—""

2792408929.m_KeyValue: ""When I received Death's memories, I also learned about the Divine Body's weakness.""

2792408932.m_KeyValue: ""But Noah, how are you planning to destroy the Divine Body?""

2792408933.m_KeyValue: ""Having lost all means of resistance, its only option is to detonate its core, trapping me on Sunset Isle forever.""

2792408934.m_KeyValue: "It’s sensed that I've awakened Death's power. That's why those creatures went berserk before."

2792408936.m_KeyValue: "So it finally shows itself... Is this the true form of the Divine Body on Sunset Isle?"

2793122173.m_KeyValue: "Special offer <color=#DEA11F>Choose 1 of 3</color>. Available for 2 hours only."

2800171005.m_KeyValue: ""Yet, the truth is far more somber. They are but 'restless spirits,' forever caught in the turbulent struggle between Death and the Divine Body, unable to find peace.""

2800171006.m_KeyValue: ""Rumors from beyond the island, as well as the islanders themselves, claim that these shades formed from memories of longing are a blessing from the Divine Body upon Sunset Isle.""

2800171008.m_KeyValue: ""It's a phenomenon that transcends the boundary between life and death, allowing the living to commune with memories of the departed who take the form of shades.""

2800171010.m_KeyValue: "T-Tris? But... you died in battle 66 years ago!"

2800171011.m_KeyValue: ""Just as I am now—a lingering memory. It's been so long, Darcias, Acappella.""

2800173177.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you, Noah... It makes me happy. If I hadn't found the courage to come back, I would never have met you, nor seen Grandmother again...""

2800173178.m_KeyValue: "I told you this when we first met. This is proof that we're companions who will support each other and face things together."

2800173181.m_KeyValue: ""But afraid that... when I'm gone, no one will grieve for me... no one will remember me...""

2800173182.m_KeyValue: "But after I arrived here... and I saw the sun that never sets... I felt afraid... Not because of having to face it alone..."

2800173184.m_KeyValue: "Am I being too presumptuous... I haven't done anything for everyone... yet I hope they'll feel 'longing' for me."

2800173185.m_KeyValue: ""Grandmother, you are... our family's proud 'past,' so when duty calls...""

2800173187.m_KeyValue: "What are you saying... you've been my pride and joy since the day you were born."

2800173188.m_KeyValue: "I didn't hesitate at all... I just want to become... the 'future' that would make you proud."

2802356555.m_KeyValue: "Miss Setti seemed quite normal. Maybe he's an exception."

2802356558.m_KeyValue: "Are all people from the Church such self-absorbed idiots?"

2802358703.m_KeyValue: ""According to Cain's clues, the Moonblessed are likely connected to the forbidden grounds in Mouret up ahead.""

2802359596.m_KeyValue: ""Are we here to find someone, or to help someone else find someone?""

2806644523.m_KeyValue: ""But because of the persistence of a fool, these hopeless words remain preserved here.""

2806644524.m_KeyValue: ""To become the vessel for the 'Eyes' of the Alita family, to become the puppet that opposes time.""

2806644531.m_KeyValue: ""You're not... thinking of asking these guys for directions, are you?!""

2806644532.m_KeyValue: ""Strange, it's identical to the Temporal Veil I'm wearing...""

2806644534.m_KeyValue: "How much longer do we have to walk in this desert... I feel like my blood's about to evaporate..."

2806644536.m_KeyValue: "I think... I've regained my power to fight."

2806644563.m_KeyValue: "Are those sand monsters and that phoenix the 'Time' that is consuming you?"

2806644565.m_KeyValue: ""But I can fight with you. Your father, Empousa, Friedrich, and Gilrain... you have none of them by your side. Fighting alone is a lonely thing.""

2806644566.m_KeyValue: "Abandoning your friends is a shameful and cowardly act. Do you want to bring disgrace upon your family with your actions?"

2854664198.m_KeyValue: "More gentle than the last time I heard it."

2854665222.m_KeyValue: ""I have the same feeling... By the way, we encountered your 'sister' while coming to rescue you...""

2894848283.m_KeyValue: ""Naive child, there's so much you've yet to understand.""

2894848285.m_KeyValue: ""...Acappella, even though you warned me not to open it before you returned...""

As he opens his eyes once more, wings grew from his spine, and his hunger drove him to gorge on entrails. Alas, he was never a hero, but a vulture who drank the blood of heroic memories.""

2926521570.m_KeyValue: ""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> The Wolfsbane plant means something special to the Clive family.The ballad goes: _$$Wolfsbane blooms beneath the moon's soft grace; The promised home waits beyond the sky's embrace._$$""

2926521573.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> A hood that Clive would always wear before he turned into a beast.
_$$Children say I look scary, but admire me in battle. So I keep this thing on for them, I suppose. Until the grave calls me._$$""

2926521575.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> The iron ring worn by Clive.
Alas, the abyss looms nigh. Proceed, and let darkness consume thee; Retreat, and let fear erode thy soul.""

2926521576.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Outfit</style> The robe that Clive often wore.
The moonlight shone coolly, and the air filled with frost; The long night approached, yet the will to light was never lost.""

""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> Piera's cherished ring, seemingly symbolizing a pact made with someone.

2926521672.m_KeyValue:
