Silk ribbons embroider the restless mind of the Bone Collector. Pray tell me, are white lies truly kind, or are they deception?""

2928551743.m_KeyValue: "So you have been learning things while I was gone."

2928551744.m_KeyValue: "Tch... what difference do two mice make? Cidhall and Dalcarlo surely have won by now."

2928551745.m_KeyValue: ""I don't care about your fate or your delusions. If you yield, then step aside.""

2928551746.m_KeyValue: "So you want to test yourself against me... now that I'm whole."

2928551747.m_KeyValue: "So this old soul wakes once more from rust and ruin... to cross blades with you again."

2930478648.m_KeyValue: "My arms… they're gone… I can't even hold my crossbow… What's an archer… without arms to draw the string…? Might as well… let death take me…"

2930932355.m_KeyValue: "This stance... What's it trying to do?!"

2930932357.m_KeyValue: "Spread out! Avoid the warning range of its Talent."

2938757919.m_KeyValue: "I never thought I'd be fighting shoulder to shoulder with a Bloodborn."

2938757920.m_KeyValue: "Shoulder to shoulder? We're standing miles apart."

2938757922.m_KeyValue: "Is this the true power of blood?"

2947291023.m_KeyValue: "This thing's power is beyond anything I've faced..."

2947291024.m_KeyValue: "Ah—wait! We were supposed to be analyzing the ritual. When did I start talking to myself?"

2947291025.m_KeyValue: ""With the Blood Moon rising and the eternal night settling in, we needed firewood, candles.""

2947291026.m_KeyValue: "You said someone doesn't want him to speak—what do you mean by that?"

2948582679.m_KeyValue: "You held them off alone? How long was I unconscious?"

2949352947.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps when they are forgotten by the world."

2949632700.m_KeyValue: "Curse us? Sounds like your so-called god is the real demon."

2949632701.m_KeyValue: "Those were lies to lure you in!"

2951840303.m_KeyValue: "'Down thirty drinks to win an exquisite Acorellia Highlands goat toy.' What an odd promotion."

2953943006.m_KeyValue: ""And I thought you were about to say something profound, but what came out was more nonsense.""

2953943008.m_KeyValue: "The sheer number of insects tells me we're not far from the core of the Ashen Garden."

2953943009.m_KeyValue: "This is ridiculous! This is no time to tell lies!"

2953943011.m_KeyValue: ""Fine. I trust you, Aiona. Lead the way.""

2953943038.m_KeyValue: "The Seed of Calamity? I heard they were a group of alchemists who used the power of Black Blood to rebel against the Church."

2953943039.m_KeyValue: ""As long as the person before my eyes is still that kind 'Aiona,' you are you, the one I trust most.""

2953943042.m_KeyValue: "If this continues... you'll all die here!"

2953943043.m_KeyValue: ""Clive, this is the only way... you must drink my blood.""

2953943305.m_KeyValue: "I never imagined we would end up in a place like this..."

2953943307.m_KeyValue: ""Even though Father never spoke about the forbidden grounds, I grew up in Mouret and have never heard anything about any Moonblessed.""

2953943308.m_KeyValue: "Geez... Just what was Father trying to tell me?!"

2953943336.m_KeyValue: ""How do you seem to know so much... Whatever, follow me!""

2953943337.m_KeyValue: "Snap out of it and make some sense!"

2953943366.m_KeyValue: ""I... I'm not going to die, right?""

2953943367.m_KeyValue: ""You would go against me... against the Light, for the sake of a stranger you just met?""

2953943368.m_KeyValue: "You drank the water from this cave?!"

2953943369.m_KeyValue: ""How unfortunate, to say your last goodbye right after meeting.""

2953943398.m_KeyValue: ""Even if you're not that Aiona, deep down I know you're a trustworthy companion.""

2953943399.m_KeyValue: ""Moreover, you gave the precious spores we just collected to a runt beyond saving. Did you forget our mission?""

2953943400.m_KeyValue: "He's already infected with Black Blood and shares the same bloodline as those filthy werewolves. We merely allowed him to return to where he belongs."

2953943404.m_KeyValue: "You're wrong! You can't mock our efforts. Mouret won't be destroyed just like this..."

2953943426.m_KeyValue: "These werewolves have lived in the cave for a long time. They're more familiar with these mushrooms than we are."

2953943427.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, what kind of person do you want to become?""

2953943430.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know what this Calamity is capable of, but Clive is only a child—a child who just lost his father.""

2953943431.m_KeyValue: ""Over some random kid, she's siding with a special type that she just met?""

2953943432.m_KeyValue: "Not yet... But the Church elders and the lords of the kingdom firmly believe that one of them will become the youngest Bell Ringer in history."

2953943434.m_KeyValue: "We have no reason to tell an outsider like you..."

2953943435.m_KeyValue: "The spores I gave you were collected from within the Divine Body. They can suppress the onset of Black Blood to a degree."

2953943436.m_KeyValue: "Their honor and duty were fabricated by the Church from the very beginning. They were destined to be your sacrifices all along!"

2953943437.m_KeyValue: "He'll be sealed by the Divine Body and trapped in this cave. If this cave contains one of the sources of Black Blood..."

2953943467.m_KeyValue: "Family crest... hearing that here... I can't help but be reminded of that time..."

2953943468.m_KeyValue: "You came to the lands of the werewolves? And even entered their forbidden grounds? Then you..."

2953943469.m_KeyValue: "We mustn't let our guard down. Those special mushrooms also grow here."

2953943500.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, Noah, didn't you know? The Black Blood only infects humans. Animals can be carriers of the disease, but it won't have any adverse effects on them.""

2954686044.m_KeyValue: "The most important thing to focus on is evading the dangers of the day."

2954686046.m_KeyValue: ""A winding path lies ahead. Will you take it, or bypass it and go straight?""

2954686047.m_KeyValue:
"'I'm the No. 1 Steering Spider!'
Reach the next destination even faster!"

2954686076.m_KeyValue:
""Misleading opponents is also a competitive strategy.
Faced with a dead end, the two spiders reassess their relationship.""

2954686077.m_KeyValue:
"You encounter spiders moving in the opposite direction.
You question yourself—should you be following them?"

2954686079.m_KeyValue: "The spider that stuck to its path spotted the other spider at the supply point—the one that turned back earlier had caught up."

2955939158.m_KeyValue: ""Now, alter the flow of time and face our destiny.""

2957383824.m_KeyValue: ""No! This is your doing, Van Helsing! Had you not pressed him so hard, he'd never have chosen death!""

2957383825.m_KeyValue: ""It's a dead knot, no way to untie it... We'll have to cut it with a sword!""

2957383826.m_KeyValue: ""No, no—who even are you? When did you even show up!?""

2957383827.m_KeyValue: "Fall back and fight! Head for the Captain's quarters!"

2957383829.m_KeyValue: "Mr. Van Helsing! I'll take the helm! Please cover me while I head up!"

2957383848.m_KeyValue: "Matching uniforms… brothers… the hat… and a veiled plea for me to destroy his flesh… Could it be... Oh no!!"

2957383849.m_KeyValue: "Come... come quickly... I'm waiting for you... my fellow Moonblessed..."

2957383856.m_KeyValue: "Didn't you say you had some final form? What are you waiting for—use it!"

2957383857.m_KeyValue: ""Because perhaps one day, not far from now, I'll use it to kill you.""

2957383858.m_KeyValue: ""No. I will not allow it. You will not desecrate my brother's body, even if it is the only way to stop him...""

2957383859.m_KeyValue: ""When Bob stopped us, Goldland was clearly heading toward Jones's quarters, but when we arrived, only Jones was there.""

2957383860.m_KeyValue: ""Maybe Mr. Jones just thought… On a sealed vessel like this, even one case of infection could doom everyone?""

2957383861.m_KeyValue: "I must understand why William was infected with Black Blood."

2957383862.m_KeyValue: ""Then Jones struck him unconscious in the guest cabin and slipped the rope he had prepared around his neck, waiting for the right moment.""

2957383863.m_KeyValue: ""What about Aiona and me? And you, and that big oaf, and the dutiful sailor from earlier? None of us are infected either!""

2957383890.m_KeyValue: "Help me… my kin… I'm right below…"

2957383920.m_KeyValue: ""It seems you were right, Noah. Once they reach this state, all that remains is hunger.""

2957383921.m_KeyValue: ""You've carried the Black Blood for some time now. And without knowing it, you've learned to live with it. Just as the Bloodborn do.""

2957383922.m_KeyValue: "I see... there's a stockpile of ingredients here. And they all look fresh."

2957383924.m_KeyValue: ""I only sensed that you hold this place dear, that you truly wish to protect this 'sanctuary.'""

2957383926.m_KeyValue: ""Strange, isn't it? I've lived on this ship for over ten years, yet somehow you seem to know more about it than I do.""

2957383927.m_KeyValue: "I examined the floor when I first grew suspicious. There's no hidden hatch that I could find."

2957383948.m_KeyValue: ""First Mate Bob, allow me to tend to your wounds—""

2957383949.m_KeyValue: "I haven't lost. I haven't lost. I haven't! It's only because I stood alone—while you all turned against me..."

2957383952.m_KeyValue: ""Kris... even my brother, always preaching about how the crew is family, yet treated me—his own blood—as dead weight...""

2957383953.m_KeyValue: "I had assumed killing his brother and taking his place was a sudden act—but it may have been planned from the beginning. He may have simply been waiting for the moment to strike."

2957383954.m_KeyValue: ""That is exactly why you're a fool! You know he scolded you, hit you, threatened to throw you overboard! And yet he never once... never once would have...""

2957383955.m_KeyValue: ""That part remained unclear—until now. But from what I overheard just before entering, and from William's own mention of the Divine Body… I've found my answer.""

2957383956.m_KeyValue: "Is that what your brother used to tell you?"

2957383957.m_KeyValue: ""Now, all that remains is to stop this vessel from reaching Sunset Isle—where the Divine Body lies hidden...""

2957383959.m_KeyValue: "Back then I was bickering with the walking tin can over his sense of taste—and now this place is his grave. Wait! You're—!"

2957383984.m_KeyValue: "Something is clearly amiss with Ami. Look after her. As for Blood Beasts of this level—"

2957383985.m_KeyValue: "Isn't it too late to realize this? There can't be many left alive aboard this ship. And if she's not strong…"

2957383986.m_KeyValue: "We'll look after Ami. And we will find Hati. Leave this to us."

2957383990.m_KeyValue: "That remains to be seen. Let's find out whether the answers we carry in our minds are the same. Starting with..."

2957383991.m_KeyValue: ""Don't test me like this… Come out, my goddess...""

2957384018.m_KeyValue: "Enough of your sanctimonious talk… You coward. You couldn't even bring yourself to face the sea."

2957384019.m_KeyValue: ""Don't look at me with those eyes, Van Helsing. I don't need your pity.""

2957384020.m_KeyValue: ""Shut your trap, Van Helsing! You keep ruining everything... Wait...""

2957384021.m_KeyValue: ""You of the Silver Cross ought to know better than anyone. No matter how skilled you are, you're still mere mortals. And a Calamity? They are legends for a reason! They have slain even Bell Ringers.""

2957384023.m_KeyValue: ""To free her, I killed all who might've discovered her. Including my brother.""

2958720717.m_KeyValue: "Note: Refer to web for full list. UID in parameters will be auto-replaced with current account UID."

2967556873.m_KeyValue: "Tip: Try increasing the level of your Vassals."

2972058900.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, what you just said... I think I've found a way to beat him...""

2972170170.m_KeyValue: "Shut up! That idiot is not my sister!"

2974889020.m_KeyValue:
""'I won't do it—but there are plenty of spiders who will.'
The spider is so skilled, it hardly seems mechanical.""

2974889023.m_KeyValue:
""'As long as there's still the prospect of Dew, I can keep going!'
The spider retains its youthful energy.""

2974889052.m_KeyValue: ""Not sure what was updated, but the spider definitely runs faster now.""

2974889053.m_KeyValue: "System updates available at the Supply Station. Update now?"

2974889055.m_KeyValue: ""Useless patch updates can be skipped, right?!""

2975557683.m_KeyValue: "This valley is extremely dangerous at night. No one should be wandering around alone."

2976976386.m_KeyValue: "Thank you all for being there for me!"

2976976390.m_KeyValue: "Clive would want you to start a new life. And you know... both the Wolfsbane and the solarium were actually Empousa's idea too."

2976976391.m_KeyValue: ""Who would have thought? Despite all the bickering, you two actually get along quite well.""

2976976392.m_KeyValue: "I can tell you want to say thank you—but you should save it for Empousa."

2976976393.m_KeyValue: ""A new room, new memories, and... new friendships!""

2978427555.m_KeyValue: ""But whether we understand it, how we interpret it, and what choices we make—that still lies with us.""

2978427556.m_KeyValue: ""Different worlds, different people—what serves as the anchor point for this seemingly unchangeable predetermined fate we call _$$history_$$?""

2978427557.m_KeyValue: ""In this timeline, I intervened in that conflict, and Mary was indeed saved.""

2978427558.m_KeyValue: ""Would you call this _$$seeing_$$ each other? If connecting through our thoughts counts as meeting, then yes, I suppose it does.""

2984617311.m_KeyValue:
""After turning around, the others vanished without a trace, leaving the spider bewildered.
Those who walk the same path are but fellow travelers.""

2984617340.m_KeyValue:
"'I still prefer straight paths...''
Find the right road for you. Hey!"

2990132045.m_KeyValue: "Agree with you? Preposterous. I have my own agenda to consider."

2990137294.m_KeyValue: "Thank you for changing my mind. I'm still learning."

2990139208.m_KeyValue: "I'll let you make the final decision."

2990140229.m_KeyValue: ""Can't say I follow, but... it makes sense when you say it.""

2990142407.m_KeyValue: ""The pursuit of the right answer is, in itself, a tedious endeavor.""

2990145478.m_KeyValue: "I understand now. You've embraced 'a different brand of justice.'"

2990146499.m_KeyValue: ""If changing one's mind could grant us even a brief respite, it would be worthwhile.""

2991176153.m_KeyValue: ""We know you're no villain, sir. We also know we're no match for you. But we still cannot let you pass.""

2991176155.m_KeyValue: "Pestilence. Famine. War. The world drowns in suffering. Has She ever come to save you? Even once?"

2991176156.m_KeyValue: "How did you take Kenneth's appearance? And to what end?"

2991179355.m_KeyValue: ""Agares Brennholt, from this moment forth you shall serve as the Second Bell Ringer, standing as our fellow guardian of the supreme order established by Aeon.""

2991179356.m_KeyValue: ""To move forward from here, you must face the anguish of these ghosts.""

2993777363.m_KeyValue: ""How pitiful—you've lost your mind, your will. Now you're nothing more than a puppet, dancing on the Church's strings.""

2997056505.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""Highlight"">Earn 1 Hunting Point for each enemy unit defeated. Aim to achieve the highest Hunting Points possible.</style>
Use the Seal <style=""Highlight"">Risk and Reward</style> and deal <style=""Highlight"">Piercing DMG</style> to earn more Huntting Points.
Top Picks: Fanny, Stella, Acappella""

2997056506.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""Highlight"">Help Piera swiftly purify the desecrated longing.</style>
What lies at the end of death?
Is it eternal nothingness, or a gateway to rebirth?
Faced with the nightmare born from longing, Piera opened the coffin behind her.
""

2997056507.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""Highlight"">Catch as many escaped crabs as possible—Ami has her own ways of dealing with them.</style>
The escaped crabs are destroying the food chain.
Many of Ami's food friends have fallen victim to their claws.
As the future Captain of the El Dorado, she cannot stand idly by.
""

2997056508.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""Highlight"">Assist Clive Jr. in swiftly eliminating the resurgent Plague.</style>
Blossoming Wolfsbane buried the past.
But the Plague is back once more.
Clive Jr. will never let the Ganelon down.""

2997056509.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""Highlight"">Capture as many escaped puppets as possible to earn Bella's reward.</style>
Joints creak, strings quiver, and under moonlight, the puppets perform their final dance.
Then, a snap. Strings recoil into the dark, and the puppets scatter into the night.
Bella remains still upon the balcony, unfazed. Perhaps... she foresaw this?
'Return my naughty little dolls back to me, would you?'""

2997056510.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""Highlight"">Quickly strike down the Heretic Inquisitor for Gilrain and let your name bask in glory.</style>
The elder, long cloaked in shadow, has emerged in the castle for the first time in years. But before any reunion could unfold, armed soldiers of the Church stormed in.
Snuff out the light, the very thing Gilrain loathes most.""

2997056511.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""Highlight"">Defeat as many Blood Servants as possible. Cain is offering a generous reward.</style>
The wine still half full when shadows tore through the corridor. Such a waste.
Cain taps his glass with measured calm, his expression unreadable. 'A bit too much chaos for such fine wine, isn't it?'
His gaze flickers. It's time to clean house.""

2997056512.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""Highlight"">Fight alongside Hati once more. Deal as much DMG as possible to the guards within the time limit.</style>
The illuminated path appears calm—a rare moment of peace for Hati, a guest of the Bathory Castle.
Yet the guards have mistaken her for an intruder. Best not to let their blunder ruin such a lovely night.""

2997101568.m_KeyValue: ""I also understand now—the weakness of life lies in memory. And only here, in this realm, can we bring an end to his design.""

2997747506.m_KeyValue: "Notice: View and manage Artifacts obtained from Dutchman's Revenge in the Artifact Gallery!"

2997840698.m_KeyValue: ""When I first realized I could manipulate my own destiny, I was exhilarated. I ceaselessly sought to prove myself, and thus I set about changing many things. And I succeeded.""

2997840699.m_KeyValue: ""I'm truly curious—after centuries of life, what is it you still pursue?""

2997840704.m_KeyValue: "Are all your words to me merely the tarot's revelation?"

2997840705.m_KeyValue: ""Our meeting on the ship, my discovery of your secret, my arrival at this gathering—all lead to that tarot deck.""

2997840706.m_KeyValue: ""Was our meeting a decision you made, under the hand of fate.""

2997840708.m_KeyValue: ""Instead, I'm merely a seeker of pleasure.""

2997840709.m_KeyValue: "I thought you would be a staunch defender of the tarot."

2997840710.m_KeyValue: ""That is not the true nature of tarot or divination, nor will it be the path I choose to walk.""

2997840711.m_KeyValue: "Do not be so quick to judge the tarot and divination. Your future will not be controlled by a deck of cards—or by me."

2997964832.m_KeyValue: "Prophecy Unbound: Complete challenge within the same day."

2999074515.m_KeyValue: ""When time meets its end, history circles back to its origin.""

3002564110.m_KeyValue: "Even I can't bear to watch this."

3002789295.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'An Alliance with the Conservative Bloodborn Faction'..."

3002789296.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Raising Taxes to Address Financial Strain in Latter Half of the Year'..."

3002789297.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Signing a Peace and Merger Treaty with the Declining Ganelon Family'..."

3002789298.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Exploring Other Bloodborn Factions on the Continent'..."

3002789300.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Convicting Vassals Who Are Closely Associated with the Kingdom'..."

3002789301.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Continuing to Uphold the First Tenet of Secrecy'..."

3002789302.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Claiming the Distant Area with Favorable Conditions'..."

3002789309.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Allowing Self-proclaimed Neutral Cartographer to Survey Our Territory'..."

3002789310.m_KeyValue: "Regarding 'Imposing Price Controls to a Certain Degree on the Puppet Association'..."

3003602927.m_KeyValue: "Am I an empty shell of the man once known as Noah Nevernight? A curse left on this world by the Black Blood?"

3003602928.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry to interrupt, but all this talk of 'Moonblessed,' 'Embrace,' and whatnot... I don't understand a word of it!""

3004820287.m_KeyValue:
""Between charging and restarting, the update process was completed with great difficulty.
Energy capacity is a must-have for mechanical spiders!""

3004820316.m_KeyValue:
""'I want to quit!'
If the spider doesn't work, to the junkyard it will go.""

3014743663.m_KeyValue: "Rewards are based on Blood Hunt completions and sent via mail!"

3025360421.m_KeyValue: "Sapphire Isle is my birthplace! Let me show you around."

3025360422.m_KeyValue: ""By the way, when you eat a strawberry cake, do you prefer to 'eat the strawberry on top first' or 'save it for last'?""

3025360424.m_KeyValue: ""It's a pearl with an inscription, but the text has faded...""

3025360425.m_KeyValue: "Do you have any bouquets of Tidewisps?"

3025360427.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, I can't remember anything except my name.""

3025760052.m_KeyValue: ""Not just us, but four Bell Ringers as well.""

3025761074.m_KeyValue: "Gadric once told me… emptiness is worse than death."

3026501776.m_KeyValue: "I managed to rest a while. I feel much better now."

3026501777.m_KeyValue: "These vile beasts... they're hunting us like prey."

3027051705.m_KeyValue: "Save your fervor for another time. You're playing right into her hands."

3027051706.m_KeyValue: "Just as I thought. There isn't just one family in revolt."

3027051708.m_KeyValue: "I'd advise you not to speak that traitor's name in front of me."

3028361258.m_KeyValue: "What do you plan to do with the golden lance?"

3028361261.m_KeyValue: ""If it's named a 'key,' then something must lie in wait to be opened.""

3029138877.m_KeyValue: "Quick Assault unlocks after first daily clear of specified difficulty"

3032475003.m_KeyValue: "Don't rope me in when you're despairing over human frailty."

3032475004.m_KeyValue: ""We're running out of supplies. If this continues, sooner or later we'll...""

3036420085.m_KeyValue: "Save them... Free them from their agony..."

3036420248.m_KeyValue: ""They are all of utmost importance to our family. As long as I'm here, I won't allow anyone to harm them.""

3036425464.m_KeyValue: "You sure have a lot of pursuers."

3037372548.m_KeyValue: "How could tarot cards weaken those beasts? Unless..."

3037372549.m_KeyValue: "Could it be that Dalcarlo is no mere fortune-teller… but a wielder of curses?"

3037372550.m_KeyValue: "Dalcarlo must possess extraordinary power as Eliana does!"

3037388720.m_KeyValue: ""Congratulations, you finally learned of my existence... So, what of it? You want to order me around? Or get rid of me?""

3038030570.m_KeyValue: ""Don't talk nonsense, 79. Only one can leave this place.""

3038030571.m_KeyValue: ""Then take it! Since the start, I never intended to leave this place.""

3038030573.m_KeyValue: ""You don't know that! You haven't activated it before, so how can you be so sure?""

3038030574.m_KeyValue: "It wasn't supposed to be like this..."

3038030576.m_KeyValue: "In your hand... is the 'card' that I want."

3038030609.m_KeyValue: ""I've come so far, I must... realize my wish...""

3038030669.m_KeyValue: "I'll be right there. Find a place to hide first."

3038030670.m_KeyValue: "Why is she starting to think about that at a time like this?"

3038030671.m_KeyValue: ""I need to get over there quick... 66, can you hear me?""

3038030673.m_KeyValue: "Who... am I? Why am I here...?"

3038031690.m_KeyValue: ""Sacrificing friends to gain more, and becoming blinded in the process.""

3038031692.m_KeyValue: ""Recklessly getting in the way, only as an excuse to escape reality.""

3038031694.m_KeyValue: "Our true home lies on the far side of the moon."

3038031696.m_KeyValue: ""But because of our excessive desire, we're stuck wandering endlessly in place.""

3039521973.m_KeyValue: "Oh? There have been other paired missions?"

3039521974.m_KeyValue: "The Saint would've known! She'd never make the Church's greatest enemy into a Bell Ringer! H-how is any of this possible?"

3039521975.m_KeyValue: ""Shall I take another form, then? Perhaps that Vice-Commander who used to follow you like a shadow... What was her name again? Setti?""

3039521976.m_KeyValue: "It's not just you. The Divine Body—it's reacting. The sealed chamber ahead is starting to quake. The gate's seal is faltering."

3039525177.m_KeyValue: ""But if you have questions, come to me next time.""

3041022760.m_KeyValue: ""For your first Embrace ritual, you show remarkable talent.""

3041025829.m_KeyValue: ""Come with me, Noah. I'll show you how to recover your Blood Power.""

3041025830.m_KeyValue: ""To help us on the journey ahead, we need to use Blood Enhancement.""

3041034011.m_KeyValue: "How could there be a hidden stairway descending below?"

3041034013.m_KeyValue: "It extends deep underground. Could there be passages hidden below?"

3041034014.m_KeyValue: ""As far as I know, the Bathory Castle is woven with a hidden network of underground passages. In keeping with the First Tenet of Secrecy, the ancient lords carved out a vast subterranean city—once the secret base of the family's operations.""

3041034016.m_KeyValue: ""Careful where you step! That place is dangerous, I seem to recall...""

3041035037.m_KeyValue: ""The battlefield is always changing, but this may help ease your decision-making, to some extent.""

3042295227.m_KeyValue: "Where's that arrogance coming from? You're up against three Bell Ringers!"

3043745323.m_KeyValue: "They will continue to be effective in subsequent Battles."

3043899105.m_KeyValue: "Data will be deleted upon successful cancellation. Please be advised."

3046450540.m_KeyValue: ""As long as it doesn't create more expenses, I'm fine with whatever.""

3046452718.m_KeyValue: "There are more pressing matters to contemplate..."

3046453873.m_KeyValue: ""Kid, is this the kind of stuff you usually concern yourself with?""

3046456051.m_KeyValue: ""With countless innocents perishing in the world, the relevance of this discussion is...""

3046457074.m_KeyValue: "Let's not jump to conclusions when there's still doubt."

3047147544.m_KeyValue:
""'Love begins when two things crash together, scattering parts everywhere!'
With fantastic steering, it is a missed opportunity.""

3047147545.m_KeyValue:
"With great power comes great responsibility!
The Mechanical Spider has great responsibility!"

3047147547.m_KeyValue:
""It said, 'Charge forth.'
The processor issued a command, and the mechanical legs executed an action.""

3047147550.m_KeyValue:
""New all-time high!
Though you've failed before, your success was inevitable.""

3047147576.m_KeyValue:
""Splash, splash...
Rain won't halt this spider, but rust seems to be forming on these weathered parts.""

3047147578.m_KeyValue:
"Survived an attack from some giant white thing.
A polar bear? A yeti? Or some strange creature?"

3047147579.m_KeyValue:
""'Beep beep beep! beep~ beep~'
Not exactly singing, but it does build up courage.""

3048054616.m_KeyValue:
""It said, 'Charge forth.'
It said, 'Charge forth.'
The processor issued a command, but the mechanical legs did not respond.""

3048054618.m_KeyValue:
"Less power equals less responsibility!
Mechanical spider is ready to pass the buck!"

3048054619.m_KeyValue:
""'Love begins when two things crash together, scattering parts everywhere!'
Afterwards, each sets off on their own journey, reeling from their wounds.""

3048054621.m_KeyValue:
"The chassis failed to withstand the acceleration once more.
A few more failures and that'll be it."

3051003025.m_KeyValue:
""The castle becomes so alive. It seems an important discussion is about to begin.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Selecting Attendees
<style=""InfoText"">• You can summon up to 5 Vassals to the Council Chamber each day.
• The Meeting can only be held once per day.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Council Agenda
<style=""InfoText"">• Each day, random topics for discussion will arise. Choose the one that interest you most.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Council Proceedings
<style=""InfoText"">• During the meeting, Vassals will express their opinions, either in support, neutrality, or opposition.
• Afterward, you can interact with them again to review their stance.
• Once all views are heard, decide the final action. All invited Vassals gain Affinity, with those aligned with you gaining more.
• As Hall of Honor levels up, Vassals will gain more Affinity from meetings.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Prevailing Wisdom
<style=""InfoText"">• Occasionally, Vassals who disagree may be swayed by your wise decisions. These Vassals will gain extra Affinity.""

3051003026.m_KeyValue:
""The castle appears quiet to the onlooker, with each minding their own affairs, yet in its shadows, curious tales are unfolding... 

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Memoirs
<style=""InfoText"">• Discover charming anecdotes throughout the castle and its surrounding outposts. 

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Candles
<style=""InfoText"">• Each story will require Candles to access, which are available in limited quantity.
• Candles refresh every Monday at 4:00.
• Upgrade your Hall of Honor to claim more Candles.""

3051003027.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Selecting Catalysts
<style=""InfoText"">• You can obtain multiple Catalysts through Truth's Odyssey Quick Clear.
• The more Chambers you clear at once, the more Catalysts you'll receive, and the higher their Grade will be.
• Quick select your desired Catalysts and continue with your journey.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Catalysts
<style=""InfoText"">• Provide special effects for Vassals participating in battle.
• However, Catalysts only apply to eligible targets.
• Catalysts are divided into four Grades: N, R, SR, and SSR. The strength of the effect increases with the Grade.
• The strength of Catalysts also increases with their Aspect Level.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Catalyst Aspects
<style=""InfoText"">• The Aspect Level will increase based on the number of Catalysts of the same Aspect type held.
• Catalysts are divided into 4 Aspects: Triangle, Diamond, Circle, and Square. Each Catalyst belongs to one of these Aspects.
• Catalyst Aspect Levels:
LV1: Base state
LV2: Hold 3 of the same Aspect type
LV3: Hold 4 of the same Aspect type
LV4: Hold 6 of the same Aspect type
LV5: Hold 8 of the same Aspect type""

3051003028.m_KeyValue: "Progress will be reset. Rewards already claimed cannot be obtained again."

3051171969.m_KeyValue: "Make a purchase in General Store 2 times."

3054617287.m_KeyValue: ""We all know how bad-tempered Elder Bella's little puppets can be... If we impose price controls, they might just pack up and leave. What'll we do then?""

3054617384.m_KeyValue: "Sounds like an impartial and highly professional organization. I say we let them survey our territory! They might help us learn more about our family history. I'm all for it!"

3054617551.m_KeyValue: ""Not only is this place surrounded by mountains on three sides, but there's also a river on the east side flowing towards The Howling Peninsula. Anyone traveling by water must pass through here. It's a perfect haven.""

3054617617.m_KeyValue: ""Let me speak up for the person in question! The one sending letters is an old acquaintance from before they joined the Bloodborn. Although an outsider, they bear no ill will towards the Bloodborn.""

3054617648.m_KeyValue: ""To restore our family’s glory and conquer the continent, our Vassals must venture forth and gain worldly knowledge. We need only ensure they exercise discretion in their affairs.""

3054617683.m_KeyValue: ""Word on the street is that this Bloodborn faction differs greatly from the Bathory—they live among humans, with similar eating habits and lifestyles.""

3054617714.m_KeyValue: ""Absolutely support it! From major decisions like the power to execute vassals and the right to use high-level Alchemy, to minor ones like daily menu planning and choosing the castle's furniture style... the elders want to control everything!""

3054617749.m_KeyValue: ""Raising taxes can only solve our immediate needs. In the long run, it's not a good solution and will inevitably cause discontent among vassals and believers. It's time we explore new ways to earn Soli and acquire resources!""

3054617780.m_KeyValue: "These Ganelon people have lost their families and leaders. They're in a precarious situation where they could be purged by the Church at any moment. Now is precisely when they need protection."

3054617846.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, this is a good opportunity. Although they've made it clear they have no intention of getting involved in the conflict between the Bloodborn and the Church, they're quite generous in other aspects.""

3056761553.m_KeyValue: "Pass unlocked. Upgrade to Premium Pass for extra rewards."

3057934534.m_KeyValue: "So you're the one who's been slumbering here..."

3057934535.m_KeyValue: "I have to head back—they'll be worried sick if I don't return soon..."

3058280015.m_KeyValue: "Secrets are like scars we all carry. A friend understands that."

3058280016.m_KeyValue: ""When I first brought this up, you skillfully avoided the question...""

3058280017.m_KeyValue: ""The method backfired, causing Death to break free from its seal instead?""

3058280018.m_KeyValue: ""As a result of this Calamity's influence, the members of our family... are cursed with very short lifespans, and the succession of Gravekeeper is frequent.""

3058280020.m_KeyValue: ""So after that, since Death never broke free, that means...""

3058280021.m_KeyValue: ""So this really is... Death? The despair that our ancestors fought against for centuries, only to succumb to in the end?""

3058280022.m_KeyValue: "No... I... I don't know. It looks... it looks kind of like... like how grandmother described Death..."

3058280024.m_KeyValue: "Grand... Grandmother... I'm sorry... I... still can't do it..."

3058280048.m_KeyValue: ""You were just lying there, completely still. I was afraid something happened to you.""

3058280049.m_KeyValue: "Was it Aiona? That sounds like her."

3058280051.m_KeyValue: ""Sora, I won't let you suffer alone...""

3058280052.m_KeyValue: ""...But I couldn't win either, this last battle...""

3058280311.m_KeyValue: ""O revered Aeon, though I have long departed from the lands under your protection, I still believe...""

3058280313.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm, this symbol of a sea monster looks almost exactly like the emblem of the El Dorado.""

3058280343.m_KeyValue: "I mean it's sad that they were used as test subjects. Maybe their former selves never meant to hurt anyone."

3058280345.m_KeyValue: "We boarded Goldland's ship precisely because only the El Dorado could reach the legendary Sunset Isle."

3058280346.m_KeyValue: "Is this the other end of the beach? It looks like I've walked the entire coastline on this side of the island."

3058280376.m_KeyValue: "Are you alright? You've been breathing heavily this whole time."

3058280378.m_KeyValue: "Is that why I didn't see you on the ship? Were you by yourself the whole time?"

3058280381.m_KeyValue: "I thought I just saw a person walk by over there..."

3058280407.m_KeyValue: "Was it someone from the island? Did they attack you?"

3058280408.m_KeyValue: ""And when you do, we will be waiting for you—at the place of your true birth!""

3058280411.m_KeyValue: ""Now I'm certain there are people here. Stay here, I'm going to get to the bottom of this!""

3058280412.m_KeyValue: "Was it really just my imagination? That figure I saw... I think they were going this way..."

3058280413.m_KeyValue: "What are they saying... I... I can't remember anything."

3058280414.m_KeyValue: "I can't even remember anything about her..."

3058280439.m_KeyValue: ""Have you forgotten? The Gravekeepers of the Paracelsus family, who have lived on this island for generations—their Blood awakening takes the form of wild boars.""

3058280440.m_KeyValue: ""They're neither beast nor Blood Beast. In fact, they don't even exist.""

3058280443.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, what a perfect chance to unwind—""

3058280444.m_KeyValue: "What I mean is... Argh! Just forget it."

3058280445.m_KeyValue: "I do not understand what you're getting at."

3058280446.m_KeyValue: "We're not here to worry about the Saint. Our priority is to capture Death after he 'escaped.'"

3058280473.m_KeyValue: ""W-What's wrong, Noah? You got really serious all of a sudden.""

3058280474.m_KeyValue: "If there are people here who remember you... that's proof that you existed here... This is where you've always belonged..."

3058280475.m_KeyValue: ""I truly don't know who you are, or what you want me to return. But let me make one thing clear...""

3058280477.m_KeyValue: ""From my observations, you have occasionally interacted with 'people' that I can't see. But these interactions seemed to be genuine.""

3058280478.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, are you sure we're going the right way?""

3058280501.m_KeyValue: ""However, I have a strong feeling that the sealed Calamity is very close to us.""

3058280504.m_KeyValue: "The Divine Body on this island can awaken memories that I can't remember?"

3058280505.m_KeyValue: ""I remember my family's duty... I've learned so much from the Church's teachers... I've grown up, I'm no longer that timid child who cried at everything, and yet...""

3058280506.m_KeyValue: ""...That's not what I meant to discuss with you... I just thought, rather than being sad about the lonely past...""

3058280507.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, we've been through a lot together. They're all precious companions to me now.""

3058280508.m_KeyValue: "I don't remember who I am or where I'm from. At first... I wasn't even sure if I wanted to find the answers."

3058280509.m_KeyValue: "Why are you... suddenly asking me about that? What did the people you saw say to you?"

3058897849.m_KeyValue: ""You don't look like someone without ambition. In fact, from where I'm standing, they look like they're about to burst into flames.""

3058897850.m_KeyValue: ""In order to revive the Bathory family, you shall directly influence the success of the Moonfall.""

3058897851.m_KeyValue: ""You're definitely overthinking it, but that's what sets you apart from the rest of us.""

3058897852.m_KeyValue: "It's yours by right. This key was always meant for worthy vessels. Consider it a reward for pleasantly surprising this old man."

3058897881.m_KeyValue: "Can you tell me? I want to call you by your name."

3058897882.m_KeyValue: ""In fact, quite the opposite. The Astrolabe apparatus and the 'Prophecy Cards' are all of my creation.""

3058897883.m_KeyValue: "The reversed 'Lovers' implies you'll soon face new choices. The moment to choose between your emotions and your dreams may not be far off."

3058898145.m_KeyValue: "How long will these days continue? Perhaps until we're all dead...?"

3058898146.m_KeyValue: ""The moon is in the sky, and nobody has ever seen its far side. I can't understand people who believe there's a 'homeland' there...""

3058898147.m_KeyValue: ""You actually remember everyone, don't you? Their numbers, their fates, everything.""

3058898148.m_KeyValue: ""The path is clear now. Let's go, we need to save our strength for whatever lies ahead.""

3058898180.m_KeyValue: "Let's put that aside for now. What's intriguing is the direction she and the others are pointing at—"

3058898211.m_KeyValue: "There's also the possibility that the past we can't remember simply doesn't exist."

3058898212.m_KeyValue: ""Maybe it wants us to follow it. After all, it doesn't seem to be the owner of the second card.""

3058898241.m_KeyValue: ""Great! Friendship really is the most precious treasure, huh?""

3058898242.m_KeyValue: "Are you two arguing or bonding? Is this what they call 'friendship'? Or... or 'love'?"

3058898246.m_KeyValue: ""Bella has always thought of herself as human, you know.""

3058898248.m_KeyValue: "Bargain my foot! That's way too many zeros! Where would we even get that kind of money?"

3058898277.m_KeyValue: ""The far side of the moon could just be a lie they told us. Even if we somehow escaped, we might just end up in an even bigger cage.""

3058898278.m_KeyValue: "Are these... stone statues from the castle?"

3058898311.m_KeyValue: ""79, get out of the way! Didn't we agree not to do this?""

3058898312.m_KeyValue: "Companion? What a nostalgic yet unpleasant word."

3058898341.m_KeyValue: "Why are you so happy about it?"

3058898343.m_KeyValue: ""Vessels without masters, welcome to your trial.""

3059794018.m_KeyValue: "Ugh... I don't have enough strength left..."

3062652958.m_KeyValue: "'I was wrong. Neither creatures mutated by Black Blood nor sirens will truly love humans.'"

3062652963.m_KeyValue: "'Seems these monsters can speak... Any translators?'"

3062652964.m_KeyValue: "'No volunteers? Then we continue the fight!'"

3062652965.m_KeyValue: ""'Averdin, I will finish what you failed to do.'""

3062652967.m_KeyValue: ""'Mother, did I make the wrong choice?'""

3062652968.m_KeyValue: ""'I can't protect them all. All I can do is watch as they fall, one by one...'""

3062724934.m_KeyValue: "These items might be treasures left by previous visitors. Please explore thoroughly."

3066792959.m_KeyValue: "You showed me that some things can transcend divides."

3066792960.m_KeyValue: ""You're the special one, Noah. You not only helped me find the organ, but when everyone else opposed me, you alone understood my wish to adopt Acappella and nurture her talent.""

3066792961.m_KeyValue: "You are the one who should be thanked for discovering a talent like Acappella."

3066792962.m_KeyValue: ""So today, you are not just a guest invited by a Bell Ringer. It's also a gesture of gratitude, from the choir and the Church, to you.""

3066792963.m_KeyValue: ""The Silver Blood keeps me from aging, while some of them have already entered their later years. Yet in my eyes, they are still children—in need of my care.""

3066792964.m_KeyValue: ""Then came Darcias, Acappella, and others. Decades have passed. Now, over forty children call this place home.""

3066792965.m_KeyValue: "I've indeed never met a Bell Ringer like you—one who adopts orphans and even welcomes a Bloodborn into the Church."

3066792966.m_KeyValue: ""Being a Bell Ringer is my divine duty, but the choir... it's my haven in this cruel world.""

3066792971.m_KeyValue: "Actually... this was another reason I invited you here."

3066792972.m_KeyValue: "You seem to take particular notice of Acappella."

3067871393.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, can you promise me something? When this is all over, will you come with me to lay lots of Wolfsbane on Father's grave?""

3070957930.m_KeyValue: ""And this time, rose again with Dracula's blood. Wings born from flame.""

3070957931.m_KeyValue: "Better go find more slaves before I end up next..."

3070957932.m_KeyValue: ""Hahaha! Not wrong. That's what your god named me—Dracula, Son of the Demon.""

3070957934.m_KeyValue: "Oh! The trials are starting! I'm so excited!"

3070957935.m_KeyValue: ""Another arena, huh? Different walls, same bloodshed. Is that what they call freedom?""

3071176136.m_KeyValue: "Using Ritual wisely can improve Vassals's strength."

3072246388.m_KeyValue: "What are you?! Some kind of heretic?!"

3072246389.m_KeyValue: "Have the traitors who seek to ignite war already begun to move?"

3072246390.m_KeyValue: ""Changed? How? Still the same damp fog, same red mist choking the air…""

3072246391.m_KeyValue: ""It's always been the two of us covering this path... Kenneth, what's with the strange question?""

3072249588.m_KeyValue: "But you are our hero—you forged a new era on this land."

3072249589.m_KeyValue: ""They burn the _$$firewood_$$ for the god, never knowing we shall burn too for vengeance.""

3072815744.m_KeyValue: "We prepared some new clothes for you. I hope they fit."

3072815745.m_KeyValue: "I agree. It's better for him to experience it himself. I'll leave the next Embrace ritual to you."

3072815746.m_KeyValue: "The hungry want to eat and the sick want to get better. Are humans so different from the so-called 'vampires'?"

3073555943.m_KeyValue: "Who knows? I was on watch—wasn't exactly paying attention to much else."

3073555944.m_KeyValue: ""In weather like this, he should just go alone. Expecting me to haul this thing up a mountain? Is he trying to kill me!?""

3083631410.m_KeyValue: "I fear we may be acting with undue haste."

3083634345.m_KeyValue: ""Not happening! If you've got a problem, then fight me!""

3083636523.m_KeyValue: "Might I suggest we give this matter further consideration?"

3083638437.m_KeyValue: ""Once, I would have agreed without hesitation...""

3083638440.m_KeyValue: "But now... the decisions before us are far more nuanced."

3083640615.m_KeyValue: "Let the river of fate carve its own path."

3083715802.m_KeyValue: "Oh no... Seems I'm not dead yet..."

3083715834.m_KeyValue: "I hope there's still some meat on the belly when we get there..."

3083715837.m_KeyValue: ""Don't rely on the Tarot. Love this world, feel this world, that's a power greater than it...""

3083715838.m_KeyValue: ""Afraid that you're the so-called harbinger of disaster, afraid that your fate is controlled by some mysterious force, afraid that you can't actually change anything.""

3083715866.m_KeyValue: ""You want to be a hero? You're a cat! You couldn't even save your fellow cats, and now you want to save humans?""

3083715868.m_KeyValue: "Your limbs have gone limp. You think you're talking to me? This is just your last hallucination before death."

3083715869.m_KeyValue: ""If you think I can't do it, then just watch me fail. Why waste words?""

3083715871.m_KeyValue: "Someone's swimming toward us... is that Jacintha? It really is her!"

3083715872.m_KeyValue: ""You only have one chance, seize it, kitty!""

3083715873.m_KeyValue: ""The hero has saved the world! The warrior has slain the dragon! Now, there's just one tiny, itsy-bitsy problem—how will someone so terrified of water make it back to land?""

3085397691.m_KeyValue: "Hmm? There's a note under the carpet."

3089832979.m_KeyValue: ""Calm down, Hati. Sir Gadric must have his reasons... Anyway, let's get out of here first, then we can talk.""

3089832981.m_KeyValue: "His blood is black... Have you been in contact with the infected?!"

3089832982.m_KeyValue: "He's your father's friend and a Knight of the Church. His oath constrains his position. He must be troubled by this too."

3089832983.m_KeyValue: "The 'Black Blood' is a carrier of chaotic merged memories. The invasion and overwriting of memories don't discriminate when choosing a host."

3089832984.m_KeyValue: "I never thought the Black Blood... would take effect so quickly..."

3089833013.m_KeyValue: ""She keeps calling us stupid, and you're taking her side?""

3089833014.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, you stupid wolf! Don't get so close! Aren't you afraid of getting infected?""

3089833015.m_KeyValue: ""He probably wanted to give Hati his last bunch of Wolfsbane... Clive, keep it for her for now.""

3089833016.m_KeyValue: ""But you returned to your homeland, and you were with us until the very end. Your life was anything but empty.""

3089833044.m_KeyValue: ""Clive mentioned it, but I still don't fully understand...""

3089833050.m_KeyValue: ""That's just like you... Well, let's head back to the Church and make our report.""

3093018456.m_KeyValue: "Jestel... you should leave it to us this time."

3093018588.m_KeyValue: ""So, as I said, it's all because of this loudmouth redhead, causing us unnecessary trouble!""

3093018623.m_KeyValue: ""What a blunder, I was so engrossed in talking to Lady Empousa that I didn't notice—!""

3093018689.m_KeyValue: ""Don't let your guard down, the bats are still swarming in!""

3093018786.m_KeyValue: "But I'm curious to see if the rumors about the silver-haired Noah Nevernight are true."

3093810085.m_KeyValue: "Twin Peaks? How can you possibly know she's there?"

3094082834.m_KeyValue: "It's a private matter. Come with me."

3094082835.m_KeyValue: "So Yakov told me all this on purpose… So that I'll help find the other fragments."

3094082836.m_KeyValue: "Oh my! Yakov can practically smell the sweet scent of romance in the air!"

3097276770.m_KeyValue: "See? You can handle it after all."

""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Equipment Enhancement
<style=""InfoText"">You can use Soli and Smelting Ore to Enhance Equipment.
• Enhanced Equipment grants attribute improvements.
• Other equipment besides Smelting Ore can also be used for enhancement.""

3098057352.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Inventory
<style=""InfoText"">This is where your items are stored.
• Consumables: Under this tab, you'll find all consumables you own. You can view information about these consumables at any time and use them to strengthen your Lineup.
• Materials: Under this tab, you'll find all materials you own. You can view information and quantities of these materials at any time, but they can only be used in their respective systems.
• Equipment: Under this tab, you'll find all Equipment you own. You can view information about this Equipment at any time, and you can fortify or dismantle it.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Equipment Fortification
<style=""InfoText"">There are 4 types of Equipment Fortification:
• Enhancement: Use Soli and Smelting Ore to Enhance Equipment.
1-Enhancing Equipment grants attribute improvements.
2-Other items besides Smelting Ore can also be used for enhancement.
• Echo: Faction Equipment that has reached Tier9 Rarity, LV.5 Enhancement, and is currently equipped can use Soulstrike to perform Echo.
1-Echoed Equipment grants significant improvements, while unlocking both Reforge and Refining.
2-Echoed Equipment cannot be unequipped.
• Reforge: Use Soulstrike to Reforge the Echo Blessing on Equipment.
1-Reforging will randomly modify the type of Echo Blessings.
2-Blessings may strengthen or weaken after reforging Equipment. Use with caution.
• Refining: Use Soulstrike to Refine the Echo Blessing on Equipment.
1-Refining will randomly modify the value of Echo Blessings without changing their types.
2-You can lock individual Echo Blessings. Locked Blessings won't change their value, but the cost of Refining increases, consuming more Soulstrike.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Equipment Dismantling
<style=""InfoText"">You can Dismantle Equipment you don't need into Smelting Ore.
• When dismantling, the enhancement level of your selected Equipment will be calculated into Smelting Ore.""
