3098057355.m_KeyValue: "Reset this Vassal's progress? Consumed resources will be fully refunded."

3098896096.m_KeyValue: "I'm afraid you've been directing your efforts in entirely the wrong direction."

3102685828.m_KeyValue: "Every Bloodborn clan elder has their own castle and territory. You can now collect resources from our territory."

3102685925.m_KeyValue: "We obtained new equipment from the special enemies we encountered earlier."

3106830283.m_KeyValue: "So you want to finish our fight from Sunset Isle."

3106830284.m_KeyValue: "Won't even live to see it sprout."

3106830286.m_KeyValue: "Then follow me... and bear witness to the end."

3106830287.m_KeyValue: ""As promised—you are free to return. From this day forward, no chains, no commands. You are your own.""

3106831312.m_KeyValue: "He looked like nothing but a pampered noble who inherited his title. Why would I be afraid of him?"

3110277033.m_KeyValue: "It was precisely because I had complete faith in you that I worked with Lady Empousa to save you back then."

3110277034.m_KeyValue: ""If Noah's plan is right, then this must be the most suspicious spot…""

3110277035.m_KeyValue: ""What preparations are needed to make this 'token'? Please, let me help.""

3110277036.m_KeyValue: "I was thinking the same thing. Thoreau hinted that whoever becomes the Eighth Sage the day after tomorrow will gain access to those slaves."

3110277037.m_KeyValue: "These slaves have already transformed… and these aquatic features… could it be…"

3110277038.m_KeyValue: "We'll leave that for Isaac to deal with."

3110277065.m_KeyValue: "Their words? Whose words? I can't recall..."

3110277069.m_KeyValue: "What's happening? What's with all the commotion?"

3110277092.m_KeyValue: "Only by becoming the Eighth Sage... can I bring this to an end."

3110277097.m_KeyValue: ""Are you saying that Mr. Roland, and all the guards of House Roland behind him, are frauds I conjured up as well?""

3110277098.m_KeyValue: ""That's enough, Michel. Ours is not a house that boasts through borrowed honor.""

3110277101.m_KeyValue: ""Those too foolish wouldn't survive to see the plan's end, while those too clever—like you, would never stop asking questions...""

3110277102.m_KeyValue: "You could call it... a peculiar interest of mine."

3110277103.m_KeyValue: "Attendants of Miss Ami slew the siren! Slew the Mistbound Terror!"

3112069165.m_KeyValue: "To align oneself with the currents of fate is the truest path."

3112075699.m_KeyValue: "This should be the right course of action... um... right? I'm... not sure..."

3112076722.m_KeyValue: "I feel something calling from the depths of my memories..."

3114607982.m_KeyValue: "No fair! The Commander's stronger than any of them! If only we weren't so useless..."

3114607985.m_KeyValue: "You've done well. I'm the one who failed—I underestimated the bond between them. Leave the rest to me. This is my duty... as your Commander."

3114607986.m_KeyValue: ""Forgive me, Acappella. I've always seen you as a child… But I won't be there to watch you grow.""

3114607987.m_KeyValue: ""Forgive me, Darcias. You've stayed by my side longer than anyone. Just this once... let me be selfish.""

3114607988.m_KeyValue: "There are only two things in this world that can counter a Calamity..."

3114607991.m_KeyValue: "The Divine Body... And the Silver Blood of a Bell Ringer."

3114609007.m_KeyValue: ""She fulfilled her duty as a Gravekeeper. She gave her life to deny the enemy escape. Just as I once did, sixty-six years ago.""

3114609009.m_KeyValue: ""I'm nothing more than a longing now. Sunset Isle is no more... and soon, so will I.""

3114609010.m_KeyValue: ""Wait! Darcias and I... We've been through so much together, and I never got the chance to tell you everything...""

3114609011.m_KeyValue: ""I'm glad you never strayed from the path you chose, Acappella. It's been a joy watching over you, helping you grow...""

3114609012.m_KeyValue: "Do you remember the first song you wrote for me? I wove it into the most beautiful sheet music."

3114609014.m_KeyValue: "Sing it for me... It's the last gift I prepared for you."

3114617718.m_KeyValue: ""Wow! You scared them off just like that! Ressa, you're amazing!""

3114617719.m_KeyValue: ""I'm all grown up now, but when I was your age, I wasn't half as brave as you are.""

3114617720.m_KeyValue: ""When I grow up, will I be as strong as you?""

3114618870.m_KeyValue: "I wonder if the ritual went well... It's rare to see Ressa this serious."

3114618871.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you, Ressa... For staying with me—until I finally found them.""

3114618873.m_KeyValue: "I understand! I won't cry. If Mother and Father knew I'd left tears in the Mourning Hollow... it would only bring them more pain."

3114618874.m_KeyValue: "Why all the sneaking? Don't tell me you two were trying to spy on the ritual?"

3114618875.m_KeyValue: "Re- I mean Dr. Ressa! Have you completed the ritual?"

3114618876.m_KeyValue: "This is getting serious. Should we sneak a peek?"

3114618877.m_KeyValue: "You mean Dr. Ressa! Though you're right... even Piera looks troubled."

3114622066.m_KeyValue: ""She asked me not to tell anyone, but... she left the island days ago.""

3114622067.m_KeyValue: "His body's begun to mutate... We can't hold out like this. I must leave the island and find help."

3114622070.m_KeyValue: "Sora... Sora's becoming less and less human!"

3114622072.m_KeyValue: "These recipes still can't hold back the Black Blood..."

3114622073.m_KeyValue: "Does Piera know? We haven't seen her for days."

3114622075.m_KeyValue: "That scared the life out of me... I thought I was done for..."

3114622076.m_KeyValue: ""Jason, why did you come here alone? I told you to stay and watch over Sora.""

3114622077.m_KeyValue: "That's why I came to find you..."

3114623223.m_KeyValue: "And take my place as Bell Ringer No. X."

3114623224.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella's musical gift is beyond question. In time, she'll succeed me...""

3114623226.m_KeyValue: "To shape seven voices into a chorus of battle—only our Commander could do that!"

3114623228.m_KeyValue: "No need to worry. I have a way. Covenant."

3114623229.m_KeyValue: "ARGHHH—! I should have pressed her for clearer directions back then!"

3114624244.m_KeyValue: "But now I'm not quite sure who you really are."

3114624245.m_KeyValue: ""You are _$$Death_$$ itself, sealed upon this island, yet known to the longings as the god who guides them to the Other Side...""

3114624246.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, I can no longer sense their echoes.""

3114624247.m_KeyValue: ""Thanks to you, those intruders in white couldn't interfere. I knew I could trust you, Ressa.""

3114624248.m_KeyValue: ""Things were different back then… Anyway, I've got a few scores of my own to settle with them.""

3114624249.m_KeyValue: ""Eleanor, her parents, and the others have safely crossed to the Other Side, where new lives now await them.""

3114624250.m_KeyValue: "Yet I remain uncertain about who you are..."

3116796228.m_KeyValue: "They are both scars etched in my memory and proof of how far I've come..."

3117479746.m_KeyValue: "When are we finally going to get out of this hellhole..."

3120235158.m_KeyValue: "What?! This oaf was from the Church too? And not just any grunt—he held a major rank!?"

3120235159.m_KeyValue: ""By the time I joined the Silver Cross, that rank was already vacant. But there were many rumors about where Robert, the former Eighth, had disappeared to.""

3120235160.m_KeyValue: ""Who would have thought—the man who once despised the sea would become a sailor, and even rise to First Mate of the El Dorado, the very ship he was once tasked to investigate!""

3120235161.m_KeyValue: ""I won't explain anything—because as I said, you are not yet capable of understanding.""

3120235162.m_KeyValue: ""Among all the Silver Cross throughout history, you were the brightest. You were too skilled at finding the 'truth,' which made you firmly believe that 'truth' is absolute law.""

3120235163.m_KeyValue: ""Only a fool like me, left behind by truth itself, could see the true darkness behind it.""

3120235164.m_KeyValue: ""Those who hold a rank in the Silver Cross are all masters of Future Artifacts. Even long after retirement, they far surpass ordinary men—he is no common opponent.""

3120235165.m_KeyValue: ""Come forth, truth hunter, witch, and Bloodborn... The Silver Cross Hunter you see before you no longer fights for so-called truth.""

3120235166.m_KeyValue: ""I am Bob, First Mate of the El Dorado! I fight for my people!""

3120249306.m_KeyValue: ""According to Joe, Jones did briefly leave his post—but that was before the bell rang.""

3120249307.m_KeyValue: "What do you mean? Why couldn't it have been Jones? Didn't he leave his post earlier?"

3120249310.m_KeyValue: "Exactly! Are you covering for one of your own!?"

3120249311.m_KeyValue: "But you also said former captain Jones had the opportunity to enter the guest cabin. Why couldn't it have been him?"

3120249312.m_KeyValue: "How ironic. The only one thinking along the right lines... is you—my Heretic enemy."

3120249314.m_KeyValue: ""As I said, my deduction is based on the premise that Aaron was strangled here in this guest room. It's what brings us closest to the truth.""

3120249315.m_KeyValue: ""So... you did it?! Little Ami! I'll... Wait, what? You're saying Ami did it?""

3120249316.m_KeyValue: "The motive is what we must investigate next."

3120249317.m_KeyValue: ""No, no, no, no! Little Van Helsing, you must be wrong somewhere! How could Little Ami possibly be a murderer?""

3121950858.m_KeyValue: "A type of DMG that is neither Physical nor Magic. Requires 200% Shield Strength to resist."

3123076920.m_KeyValue: "I swear they wanted to eat me."

3123080121.m_KeyValue: "For now... let's help her say her final goodbyes."

3132526278.m_KeyValue: "Something dropped next to my feet and startled me—so I kicked it into the fountain."

3132526280.m_KeyValue: "Excellent! The cleaning supplies are right over there. I'll take care of the shop—just help me clear away all these leaves outside!"

3138263042.m_KeyValue: "These children are the future of those who have none. Let us not bind them to the cycle of sorrow their elders could not escape..."

3138263043.m_KeyValue: ""Somewhere along the way, I almost forgot. Forgot who I really was...""

3138263044.m_KeyValue: ""I have only ever served one lady. And I already told you who that was, when we were outside.""

3138263045.m_KeyValue: ""Oh no, Lady Empousa... this is no mere flattery. Even your mind has grown sharper.""

3138263046.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, bat—don't you think this is a little too easy? We haven't seen a single enemy so far...""

3138264062.m_KeyValue: "We are all me—the souls reborn from Carrelle's Divine Body. But we are also you. Join us. Let Calamity and the Divine Body become one again."

3138264063.m_KeyValue: "Guess it's my turn to help too."

3138264064.m_KeyValue: ""The First Scourge, Long Night, must be mine. I won't let Cain take her.""

3138264065.m_KeyValue: "Precisely. You understand. You're about to die."

3138264066.m_KeyValue: "Told you. He's not ready to accept the truth."

3138264067.m_KeyValue: "It seems the you that stands here has seen much—just as I once did."

3138264068.m_KeyValue: "Exactly. That is what Aeon did to us. Erased our memories so only they would endure. Only they would remain eternal."

3138264069.m_KeyValue: ""If a beast takes on the memories of a human, is it still just a beast, or is it now human?""

3140864252.m_KeyValue: "So... we did the right thing by accident."

3140864254.m_KeyValue: "You Bloodborn can slaughter your own without so much as flinching."

3141716353.m_KeyValue:
""(soft panting) Is someone there…?
Please, I just need... a hand.""

3141989394.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, you're wounded! Before the Black Blood spreads further, allow me use my Revert ability and mend your injuries.""

3143723192.m_KeyValue: "It would be my greatest honor if Miss Ami considers me family."

3143723193.m_KeyValue: ""So... there's one more thing, could I ask you a favor?""

3143723199.m_KeyValue: "No need to dwell on such trivial matters."

3143723201.m_KeyValue: "Your father might prefer if you got along well with this 'potential business partner'..."

3143723202.m_KeyValue: "Good thing little Michel isn't as shrewd as his father."

3143723203.m_KeyValue: ""Even though we've just met, you remind me of my 'family' who always took care of me.""

3143723204.m_KeyValue: "This voice... Why does it sound so familiar?"

3143723205.m_KeyValue: ""Tch... I'll let it slide this time, but don't let me catch you again!""

3143728636.m_KeyValue: ""Offer up your most precious possession, win the respect of all residents, win the eighth Siren's Tear, and take your place as the Eighth Sage.""

3143728637.m_KeyValue: ""In two days, we will hold a ceremony to select the Eighth Sage at the auction house. This is your invitation, Miss Ami.""

3143728638.m_KeyValue: "I never said anything of the sort."

3143728639.m_KeyValue: ""Are you saying that if I disagree, you'll continue to shape my 'reality'?""

3143728640.m_KeyValue: ""'Dreams' are defined by humans, and is 'reality' any different?""

3143728643.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Ami, would you like to be part of this 'plan' for the future?""

3143728644.m_KeyValue: ""With this in our possession, the future we have planned will inevitably become reality.""

3151122546.m_KeyValue: "What? Why is he dead again? He literally just handed us clues—and ship tickets!"

3152024966.m_KeyValue: ""Return to the Church, Acappella. If you cannot walk this path with me, then live.""

3152024967.m_KeyValue: ""We've both made our choice, Acappella. So now… we walk forward.""

3152024968.m_KeyValue: "What are you saying?! Have you gone mad?!"

3152024970.m_KeyValue: "And you've proven yourself more than worthy as my successor—beyond what I ever imagined."

3152024971.m_KeyValue: ""Had you inherited your position through traditional means. Then, like me...""

3153968608.m_KeyValue: "Landis... doesn't belong here anymore. Go back... return to where everyone is waiting."

3153968613.m_KeyValue: "Let your foolish—but delectable—blood become our offering for Ranna's glorious rebirth!"

3153968614.m_KeyValue: "You've lost! And just your luck—we're not exactly short on heavy hitters today."

3153968615.m_KeyValue: "Sounds more like she preyed on your desperation and tricked you into destroying the Divine Body... just so she could escape."

3153968616.m_KeyValue: "Your understanding is far too shallow. We won't waste time trying to bring you to our side."

3153968617.m_KeyValue: ""It's no use... Even if you kill us, we'll always remain with our mistress. And she will create new vessels to carry us forward.""

3153968619.m_KeyValue: ""Lady Empousa, parading around in borrowed plumes does little to impress.""

3153969770.m_KeyValue: ""So come, Captain... Let's share a drink—just like we used to.""

3153970793.m_KeyValue: ""Still not here... Silver-haired, we need you...""

3153971939.m_KeyValue: "They came from my memories. They're my family."

3153971940.m_KeyValue: "They're not in my memories... They're not of my bloodline!"

3153971941.m_KeyValue: "No... this isn't right! I didn't summon these creatures—where did they come from?!"

3153971943.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Why am I here too? Am I supposed to say something?"

3153971944.m_KeyValue: ""Marlow, Joseph... If only I'd finished the food in the kitchen faster... maybe you wouldn't have—""

3153971945.m_KeyValue: "Or the toughest... But we'll always be the ones standing between you and danger."

3153971946.m_KeyValue: ""That's right, you're surrounded by a crew that may not be the brightest, or the most articulate...""

3153971947.m_KeyValue: "That's true... The Captain does make everyone take turns on watch. No one's allowed to rest."

3153971948.m_KeyValue: ""Even if you fall into the sea again, someone will be there to pull you out. Don't forget—you've got a whole ship full of sailors behind you.""

3157379676.m_KeyValue: ""I promised to help, and I will stay by your side until we rescue her!""

3160839650.m_KeyValue: "You may miss important Story content if you skip the tutorial."

3164324320.m_KeyValue: ""Until that day, when I was about to leave and several bats suddenly appeared before me.""

3164324321.m_KeyValue: ""If you were constantly compared to your _$$sister_$$ from birth, knowing that only by surpassing her could you survive, you'd develop the same instinct.""

3164324322.m_KeyValue: ""A sudden evening breeze swept in, carrying the hair ornament I had given to Lamia into the night sky.""

3164324323.m_KeyValue: "What she wanted to give me wasn't a weapon..."

3166207335.m_KeyValue: "Gilrain... Perhaps it's because of your blessing... that I could keep moving forward..."

3166207432.m_KeyValue: ""No matter how many times I've been through this, I will always save you.""

3167869852.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph. So after all that, you simply circled back to proving that Aaron was still killed inside the guest cabin.""

3167869854.m_KeyValue: "Lady Empousa seems to be developing a competitive streak... even in this peculiar situation."

3167869856.m_KeyValue: ""I will make you see the truth. As I said, William made three fatal mistakes that exposed him as the culprit.""

3167869857.m_KeyValue: ""Van Helsing, a word of caution. I know who you're about to accuse, but without sufficient evidence, I won't accept it.""

3167869858.m_KeyValue: ""No. I don't have any physical evidence—whatever we might have found, I believe the Captain has already destroyed.""

3167869859.m_KeyValue: "What!? There shouldn't be any more evidence! The rope on the deck was already..."

3167869860.m_KeyValue: "It was a clever plan. But what he never expected was..."

3167869885.m_KeyValue: "William came by earlier. We had a lot to talk about. Both constantly stepped on by people who can't stand us."

3167869886.m_KeyValue: "Now that's a first... seeing you this flustered. Where's all that elegance now?"

3167869887.m_KeyValue: "What?! How can there be a Black Blood infection at sea?! I'm saying this now—it has nothing to do with me!"

3167869888.m_KeyValue: ""For now, it's contained. The Black Blood hasn't fully overtaken their bodies yet.""

3167870140.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, I've been holding onto it. Though… we've been traveling nonstop—I haven't had a chance to open it.""

3167870149.m_KeyValue: ""This ship, the El Dorado, was commissioned at great cost by Goldland—a merchant who fancies himself an explorer—in his search for lost isles.""

3167870150.m_KeyValue: "Every 'present' we live through is a miracle wrought from countless past 'choices.'"

3167870151.m_KeyValue: "What mattered to him wasn't whether he could escape the vortex of history—but whether Hati could leave it behind... and keep walking her own path."

3167870152.m_KeyValue: ""Still, if this is the sort of relationship you'd rather keep unseen, the guest cabins offer far better privacy.""

3167870153.m_KeyValue: "Then it seems this voyage promises enough turmoil to warrant a fortune teller aboard."

3167870154.m_KeyValue: ""I see 'The High Priestess' is well-versed in tarot. 'The Fool' often knows nothing, yet holds limitless potential...""

3167870155.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of which, I should deliver dinner to the Captain before it arrives. I won't be showing you two to your cabins.""

3167870180.m_KeyValue: ""You're right. I have been rude. Please allow me to introduce myself, albeit belatedly. I am Van...""

3167870181.m_KeyValue: "How do you know that—have you been spying on us?!"

3167870182.m_KeyValue: "Hey! Stay with me! What do I do…"

3167870185.m_KeyValue: "A Bell Ringer's student? Just who are you?"

3167870187.m_KeyValue: ""Bob, we're so sorry… We were too weak... We couldn't even avenge you…""

3167870206.m_KeyValue: ""There's a small barrel over here. Hide in it, and no one will ever find you.""

3167870216.m_KeyValue: "...That depends on how you define 'still alive.'"

3167870219.m_KeyValue: ""A Silver Cross member—one of the top ten, no less! The Captain clearly didn't bring just anyone aboard.""

3167870240.m_KeyValue: "I'll pass as well. I don't partake in anything that clouds the mind."

3167870241.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of Jones... It seems he's been repeatedly disrespectful regarding the guard arrangements. Given our long-standing dealings, allow me to offer my sincere apologies.""

3167870244.m_KeyValue: ""Weren't you supposed to be watching them, Jones?""

3167870245.m_KeyValue: ""The sea is fair: no matter how noble or mighty you are, its waves will engulf your arrogance.""

3167870246.m_KeyValue: ""He never mentioned me? Back when we were still a small association, he'd regularly purchase cosmetics and special mirrors from me.""

3167870247.m_KeyValue: ""As Captain, I sincerely apologize for the discourtesy shown by William and the others.""

3167870248.m_KeyValue: "He just strolls in on the back of his connections and snatches command of the security detail! Unforgivable!"

3167870250.m_KeyValue: "You're quite open about having a 'purpose' of your own."

3167870251.m_KeyValue: "Why's it so noisy... Is it mealtime already?"

3167870273.m_KeyValue: ""By the way, just so you know, the crew quarters, where I just fixed the rudder entanglement, are right behind the farthest wall.""

3167870276.m_KeyValue: "What's happening on this ship? And what's going on here now?"

3167870277.m_KeyValue: "Mr. Van Helsing is in charge of ship security for this voyage. The Silver Cross specializes in handling matters like this. Leave it to him."

3167870278.m_KeyValue: ""Me? I was in the kitchen next door, preparing some food. Then I heard something heavy crash to the ground over here, so I came to check.""

3167870281.m_KeyValue: "Untie that knot immediately. We need to resume sailing—we can't let the guests grow uneasy."

3167870282.m_KeyValue: "But yes—the vibration was different. More like something heavy crashing to the floor... And it came from just behind that wall."

3167870283.m_KeyValue: "Ha! William? He's never cared for the sea or being a sailor since he was a boy. Always preferred tinkering with strange contraptions. Good thing he's the Captain's brother..."

3167870308.m_KeyValue: "Maybe because I grew up on this ship. I've never been to anywhere else. I only know these people."

3167870309.m_KeyValue: "Are you being protective because you like me?"

3167870310.m_KeyValue: ""If this is about the damaged floor, I can explain...""

3167870311.m_KeyValue: "To think Silver-haired would share her naive... Wait. I get it now."

3167870312.m_KeyValue: ""If Van Helsing can lift this box—about the weight of an adult—from the deck, it'll prove...""

3167870340.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Why did you knock away Blake?"

3167870341.m_KeyValue: "They suddenly started staring at me! So much for your promise that we'd never be found in here."

3167870342.m_KeyValue: ""Whether you call him Marlow or Jack, he's no longer the person you knew.""

3167870343.m_KeyValue: "Could it be...! I was wondering why the sailors got infected... If the food was contaminated with Black Blood..."

3167870344.m_KeyValue: "Are they about to do something... 'dangerously forbidden'?"

3167870345.m_KeyValue: "Of course. How else would I know who to thank for keeping me fed? Want a tentacle? It's from Octo."

3167870347.m_KeyValue: ""Ah... that's not necessary, I'm... already full...""

3169115480.m_KeyValue: "Maybe Father wouldn't have died then... And Sis wouldn't be so heartbroken... It's all because I'm too weak—"

3172386285.m_KeyValue: ""I realize it's hard to adjust to this change, but Pure Blood Essence is vital for restoring your strength, so that you may <style=""Highlight"">live</style>.""

3172386286.m_KeyValue: ""Daily, Weekly, as well as Story Tasks each have their own objectives. Completing milestone achievements also grants rewards.""

3172386417.m_KeyValue: ""Now, release the Ultimates of the other Vassals. We can summon the Blood Moon by activating each Moon Phase.""

3174083386.m_KeyValue: "There's another reason... I didn't want to hear the story from the future—it felt like a harsh prophecy."

3174083387.m_KeyValue: ""Since birth, I was prophesied as the 'cursed one' for my bloodline. Those memories… still ache too deeply.""

3174083394.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps watching you struggle to defy fate… reminded me of who I once was."

3174083395.m_KeyValue: ""Agnes, you asked me about the ballad earlier...""

3174083397.m_KeyValue: "You were right... the matters at hand are far more important than my naive plans."

3174083398.m_KeyValue: "Do you want to know why I kept denying that I wrote that ballad?"

3174083400.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, I wrote it... but it was just a child's fantasy. I don't deserve the title of 'hero' you speak of.""

3174083401.m_KeyValue: ""The hero of your destiny was never meant to be someone else... but you yourself, Agnes.""

3174084540.m_KeyValue: "What is this? Love? It's disgusting! Making me sick...!"

3174084541.m_KeyValue: ""Trust me, his flame will quench... Go now!""

3174084546.m_KeyValue: ""The flames... they ignite from within him. With his state now, I can see it more clearly.""

3174084547.m_KeyValue: "He's the source of this great fire."

3174084549.m_KeyValue: "Leave? What about you... He can survive this fire... but you'll get killed!"

3174084551.m_KeyValue: ""Jamie, get Da Vinci here and take Agnes to the cave. She can return home from there.""

3174084553.m_KeyValue: ""The source of this fire is inside him. If we destroy it, the blaze will cease!""

3174802877.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, our game of cat and mouse is officially over.""

3174802878.m_KeyValue: ""Usually, heads that know this many secrets go _$$BANG!_$$ and get blown off.""

3174802879.m_KeyValue: "You're too slow. I'll have to knock you all out and make a run for it."

3174802881.m_KeyValue: ""Unforgivable heretic of the Bloodborn, prepare to face judgment.""

3176081873.m_KeyValue: ""—The true reason for your ""incompleteness"" is that neither you nor Lady Empousa possess enough power.""

3176081874.m_KeyValue: ""While the Church controls the mortals through faith, we Bloodborn can show them how they can defy 'death'—even attain 'immortality.'""

3177077086.m_KeyValue: "But there are others in the Choir too. Like Anna. Like—"

3177077088.m_KeyValue: "So that's why you came to me. You hoped I could help you feel again."

3177077089.m_KeyValue: "My parents' faces blurred. Their voices grew faint. The bedtime stories they told me scattered into fragments."

3177077090.m_KeyValue: ""According to the dictionary, your behavior would be described as unusual.""

3177199096.m_KeyValue: "You now have full command. Lead us to victory!"

3177932222.m_KeyValue: ""Come on, it'll be fine! Let's go do something fun.""

3177933245.m_KeyValue: "Such matters are of no concern to me."

3177935423.m_KeyValue: "Is it really necessary to obsess over such trivial matters?"

3177936578.m_KeyValue: "Life is fleeting. Shall we turn our minds to more important matters?"

3177938756.m_KeyValue: ""Kid, don't rope me in unless it's vital. I'd rather catch some more shut-eye.""

3179713768.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'purchasing the blood stain cleaner invented by the Church'?"

3179716967.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'adhering to family-first policy in all matters'?"

3179720038.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'continuing to uphold the principle of the First Tenet of Secrecy'?"

3179958523.m_KeyValue: "Tap [Claim All] to complete all Main Tasks for this stage."

3181965154.m_KeyValue: "This Artifact has been equipped by the maximum number of Vassals. Select an equipped Vassal to switch."

3182131387.m_KeyValue: ""After selection, you'll have a higher chance of obtaining these Vassals during the Embrace ritual.""

3183367827.m_KeyValue: "The Master has installed devices throughout the Isle that will turn everyone into puppets."

3183367829.m_KeyValue: "Here I thought the silver-haired one was like me—someone I could trust. How did he end up so popular and sociable?"

3183367830.m_KeyValue: ""I'm Ginokio, and I never tell lies.""

3183367831.m_KeyValue: ""Ahem! Don't forget that I am the silver-haired one's most capable assistant and the foremost disciple of the Church's Silver Cross Van Helsing—Selena, the Deadly Arrow.""

3183367832.m_KeyValue: ""No matter what, we will always be Master's first and most cherished children.""

3183367833.m_KeyValue: ""And as we sail, we'll help you and your kin find your home beneath the waves.""

3183367834.m_KeyValue: ""I've always wanted to say something cool like Master Albrecht—and today, I did!""

3183367859.m_KeyValue: "Joyce knows where Lord Hallon's daughter is."

3183367860.m_KeyValue: "Ta-da! Joyce and Joyce's puppets are no ordinary humans!"

3183367861.m_KeyValue: ""Thanks to the silver-haired one, Joyce's servant! A simple trap was all it took, and you fell for it, helping Joyce collect every last one of the Siren's Tears!""

3183367863.m_KeyValue: "I don't need saving. I'm not in any danger."

3183367864.m_KeyValue: ""So this's an enemy to both Lorelei and myself. Noah, I'll fight alongside you.""

3183367865.m_KeyValue: ""I cannot comprehend their language, nor can I fathom their thoughts. But their eyes speak volumes—these devices must be destroyed.""

3183367866.m_KeyValue: "The situation with the siren appears to be resolved. It is time I joined Noah."

3183367891.m_KeyValue: ""Bella, you win! That's amazing! Please teach me how—""

3183367892.m_KeyValue: ""I'm fine, Selena. Please lend me your hand one more time.""

3183367894.m_KeyValue: "Wasn't that vile woman supposed to be dead?! Curses! Joyce has been deceived! She must have faked her death!"

3183367896.m_KeyValue: ""You already did, Lorelei. That's why, after eleven years, destiny has guided us back to each other.""

3183367897.m_KeyValue: "You said when the promised place filled with blooming Tidewisps—"

3183367898.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, I dismantled many devices alongside the sirens, but... I always believed they did it to reclaim their freedom.""

3183367917.m_KeyValue: "Well… not entirely! The owner is actually a really good person!"

3183367918.m_KeyValue: ""Strange... Yakov, can you catch a cold too?""

3183367923.m_KeyValue: "Wasn't the Mistbound Terror already dead? Is the Isle still safe? What happened last night?"

3183367924.m_KeyValue: "Besides... the sirens probably won't return to land again."

3183367925.m_KeyValue: ""Congratulations to Sage Ami, graced with valor! Congratulations to Sage Ami, endowed with wisdom!""

3183367926.m_KeyValue: ""She said, 'It was salvaged along with some gaudy statue.’""

3183367927.m_KeyValue: "She's become quite popular with the locals—they've all gathered around to hear her stories."

3183367928.m_KeyValue: ""If you're after swimsuits, try that stall over there.""

3183367930.m_KeyValue: ""No need to search for me, I'm already here.""

3183367955.m_KeyValue: "'No… The Church… they've come to purge us…'"

3183367956.m_KeyValue: ""'But now Joyce has the answer! If we turn little Bella into a puppet, she'll never be sick again!'""

3183367957.m_KeyValue: "To destroy all that is evil. To crush its seed before it spreads."

3183367958.m_KeyValue: "He didn't know that what awaited him… was his daughter's lifeless body."

3183367959.m_KeyValue: "'What have you done?! We promised to give the sirens a home—and you did all this behind my back?'"

3183367960.m_KeyValue: "Constantine gripped the ice-chilled blade and approached the sink."

3183367962.m_KeyValue: ""Tonight, it bleeds with a deep, blood-red hue.""

3183457720.m_KeyValue: ""Then I'm Hati, Pestilence—though I haven't fully mastered that power yet.""

3183457722.m_KeyValue: "Sheila of Pestilence. Ranna of Famine. And I… who am Death. That means only War remains."

3183457723.m_KeyValue: "No wonder it felt strange at the time—he just let Aiona and me leave..."

3183457724.m_KeyValue: "Connected? But there's an entire ocean between them!"

3183457725.m_KeyValue: ""...and she turned her back on Aeon's truth. Thus, she became heir to Dracula's bloodline.""

3183457726.m_KeyValue: "You still believe in stuff like that? You're more of a Heretic than the Heretics themselves…"

3183457727.m_KeyValue: "That direction… it leads to the Blood Moon Seal. So the threads converge after all."

3183457728.m_KeyValue: ""We owe it to Ami's friend. Without them, we wouldn't have landed safely.""

3183457729.m_KeyValue: ""I said it before—once we're past that sea, we're enemies again.""

3183460928.m_KeyValue: "Sir Gadric... we're so sorry... we couldn't avenge you..."

3183460929.m_KeyValue: "But it was your sacrifice that made us realize how meaningless this conflict truly is!"

3183657690.m_KeyValue: ""How naive! Not finishing your enemy, and even letting your guard down!""

3184659219.m_KeyValue: ""Then again, it's been eleven years. We're not who we were back then.""

3184659220.m_KeyValue: "And not long after… he married one of them. Do you remember? You have a siren sister. Her name is Lorelei."

3184659221.m_KeyValue: "What ails my wife?! How could she have... faded so quickly?"

3184659222.m_KeyValue: ""My mind was numb. Hallon pulled me away and we left the isle. Not long after, the Church dispatched the Bell Ringer. And a tidal wave came—'cleansing' the isle completely.""

3184659225.m_KeyValue: "I'm not like you. I don't need comfort. Only the truth."

3184659250.m_KeyValue: "Miss Lorelei asked me to aid her with a plan—to free her imprisoned kin."

3184659251.m_KeyValue: ""I believe in Lorelei's plan, in the allies she chose, and in her strength... she won't die so easily.""

3184659253.m_KeyValue: "Seems like there's been a lot of terrible lately..."

3184659254.m_KeyValue: ""And he even killed Constantine, one of the Seven Sages?""

3184659255.m_KeyValue: "I'm deeply honored to be part of your dreams."

3184659256.m_KeyValue: "It seems we'll be working together again… for now."

3184659257.m_KeyValue: ""I'm Joyce! Joyce got a name! And this handsome silver-haired man... he must work for that extravagant lady, Ami!""

3184659259.m_KeyValue: ""I still have one deal to complete. I'm waiting—for the result, for 'him' to grant me one last glimpse of my daughter.""

3184659506.m_KeyValue: "I still haven't secured the permit for outdoor performances on the Isle—"

3184659516.m_KeyValue: "W-what is happening? Why is someone dressed like that suddenly shouting in the middle of the street...?"

3184659517.m_KeyValue: ""Let's see... you there—what do you think Ginokio wished for most, after coming to life?""

3184659546.m_KeyValue: ""Listen closely—debts must be repaid, and promises must be kept. That's the first rule of being a proper actor!""

3184659548.m_KeyValue: ""To uncover the mystery of these petals, first stop—let's ask the flower vendor.""

3184659550.m_KeyValue: ""As long as Ami insists her actions at the election were an attempt to seize Lorelei’s position, she can still pass as a ruthless opportunist.""

3184659551.m_KeyValue: "Everyone held at the auction house has been rescued."

3184659578.m_KeyValue: "I beg your pardon... what did you say?"

3184659579.m_KeyValue: ""Anyone who acts without saying a word is just plain strange, Little Bella. Let's steer clear of people like that.""

3184659581.m_KeyValue: "I've poured years into Sapphire Isle... I won't allow anyone to tear it apart."

3184659584.m_KeyValue: "I saw it... she resonated with the Siren's Tear..."

3184659585.m_KeyValue: "The demeanor and appearance... they're subtly different. Could she be the same..."

3184659611.m_KeyValue: ""Owner, where's the silver-haired guest who was staying here?""

3184659615.m_KeyValue: "Ah! So that's what stirred Little Bella's memory—the fragment of her promise with a friend?"

3184659616.m_KeyValue: ""Ah! But Master Van Helsing is so much stronger than I am. If I ever did become one, then he would surely...""

3184659617.m_KeyValue: ""Then on your birthday, I'll bring you a _$$pearl_$$—bigger than the one you wanted, and one you'll love even more.""

3184659639.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, you mean that large, elegant one?""

3184659642.m_KeyValue: "This isn't... I understand. Return to your posts—I'll handle it from here."

3184659643.m_KeyValue: "What more is there for your mind to ponder?"

3184659645.m_KeyValue: "I have another one. You should take it too."

3184659646.m_KeyValue: "As expected of Lord Isaac—the true heir of Sapphire Isle!"

3184659647.m_KeyValue: "Actually... there's a rumor whispered among the Seven Sages. That a mysterious... Master is pulling the strings behind everything on the Isle!"

3184659648.m_KeyValue: ""Possibly. But if they truly exist... What are they after? What's worth orchestrating all this—here, on the Isle?""

3184659649.m_KeyValue: "Your mind and will shall be paralyzed forever! Isn't that enough for you to get moving?"

3184659672.m_KeyValue: ""Come, Jacintha. Most beautiful... and most graceful of all.""

3184659673.m_KeyValue: ""This is where we part, Little Bella... It's been a real pleasure working with you today.""

3184659674.m_KeyValue: ""I won't hold it against you—Little Bella, Silver-Haired Boy.""

3184659675.m_KeyValue: "Little Bella! You shouldn't trust strangers so easily!"

3184659677.m_KeyValue: "Before we go... I have one more question."

3184659678.m_KeyValue: ""So it's true... The Master really does possess the means to grant eternal life. Then he'll keep his promise as well, won't he?""

3184659679.m_KeyValue: ""This is a moment that decides the Isle's fate, Lord Hallon. Where is the resolve and clarity you once showed?""

3184659680.m_KeyValue: ""If we allow him to continue moving freely through the Isle, everything you've built... could collapse in an instant.""

3184659681.m_KeyValue: "Any shift in the Isle has already fallen within your expectations."

3184659704.m_KeyValue: "You finally remember. But… the truth may not be so simple."

3184659706.m_KeyValue: ""Lord Isaac, did you find anything? Do you know where Lord Constantine is?""

3184659707.m_KeyValue: "They're Black Blood creatures. Twisted beyond recognition. They could barely string a coherent sentence. Why do I care what they think?"

3184659709.m_KeyValue: "Last week's experiment log was completed by his assistant. Only routine data is recorded."

3184659710.m_KeyValue: "What about Father? Uncle? Those who took care of me? And..."

3184659711.m_KeyValue: "Take the green door in the middle."

3184659712.m_KeyValue: ""And it was your chosen meeting spot. If you hadn't brought me here, no one would've ever noticed it.""

3184659713.m_KeyValue: ""But that was eleven years ago. After a tsunami struck, the Seven Sages funded its reconstruction... And turned the Isle into a coastal paradise.""
