3357767853.m_KeyValue: ""You'll encounter many events during your adventure, some of which require making choices. These events take varying amounts of time, and your Mechanical Spider risks taking damage.""

3357970571.m_KeyValue: "Doing the bare minimum while still getting the job done—that's the spider way."

3357970573.m_KeyValue: ""A winding path lies ahead. Will you take it, or bypass it and go straight?""

3357970574.m_KeyValue:
"'I'm the No. 1 Steering Spider!'
Reach the next destination even faster!"

3357970603.m_KeyValue:
""Misleading opponents is also a competitive strategy.
Faced with a dead end, the two spiders reassess their relationship.""

3357970604.m_KeyValue:
"You encounter spiders moving in the opposite direction.
You question yourself—should you be following them?"

3357970606.m_KeyValue: "The spider that stuck to its path spotted the other spider at the supply point—the one that turned back earlier had caught up."

3358396880.m_KeyValue: ""Yeah, who are you? Do you remember your name at least?""

3358396882.m_KeyValue: "Looks like there weren't enough memories in the blood. Other foreign memories also seemed to have gotten mixed in."

3360668351.m_KeyValue: "I've been meaning to ask—why are you so sure it was suicide?"

3360668352.m_KeyValue: "Be careful with him! That's... that's my brother!"

3360668353.m_KeyValue: "Hey! That's not fair! I'm Jack! I've been here the whole time! I just didn't want to interrupt your conversation!"

3360668354.m_KeyValue: "We might be able to use the narrow hallways there to avoid getting swarmed!"

3360668355.m_KeyValue: "There's a staircase going down... maybe it leads to the dining room?"

3360668356.m_KeyValue: "Seems to me that you—a sailor—have more courage than your supposed crew-loving Captain."

3360668375.m_KeyValue: "What? What is it?! What's going on?!"

3360668376.m_KeyValue: "I don't know who you are or what kind of price you'll demand. But my family motto is:"

3360668383.m_KeyValue: ""I've been meaning to ask—if I'm supposed to cover Jacob while he steers, then why did you come along?""

3360668384.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, that lifeless eyes just pulled off a pompous performance and turned those weapons into a bow?""

3360668385.m_KeyValue: "...more like a reminder. A silent urging… that putting an end to William's body was the right thing to do."

3360668386.m_KeyValue: "How did Goldland leave? And was William ever there to begin with?"

3360668387.m_KeyValue: "That's one possibility. But what troubles me are the coincidences. This is the third suspicious answer I've heard today."

3360668388.m_KeyValue: ""Just now, when you saw William's corpse stir, you seemed startled and found it strange. I've been meaning to ask—what was strange about it?""

3360668389.m_KeyValue: "That explains why he left his post on the deck for a brief moment… It didn't take long—but that was all he needed!"

3360668390.m_KeyValue: "I never eat food prepared by others. As for Bob and James—they were likely too busy to eat."

3360668416.m_KeyValue: ""Even if I weren't here to rescue you, looks like these things wouldn't let me walk away. Fine by me—time to teach them a lesson!""

3360668417.m_KeyValue: "What do I do…? Who knows what kind of danger is down under… can I handle it alone?"

3360668447.m_KeyValue: ""The true purpose of the Black Blood remains unclear. But it drives its hosts to absorb all flesh, all thought—until nothing remains but hunger. That is its clearest symptom.""

3360668448.m_KeyValue: "So when you claimed the Bloodborn are not demons… you were trying to soothe me? Afraid I would reject what I am?"

3360668449.m_KeyValue: "They're not just food—each one carries a story worth savoring."

3360668450.m_KeyValue: "Wait… what if I've misunderstood this from the start?"

3360668451.m_KeyValue: "I know nothing of any hidden door. Only that I broke through this wall…"

3360668453.m_KeyValue: "Because I once glimpsed the ship's layout in Aaron's cabin—shortly before he was murdered."

3360668454.m_KeyValue: "If there's no passage downward—then what lies behind that wall? The one that's noticeably thicker than the others?"

3360668475.m_KeyValue: ""No—don't waste your strength on me. If the Captain still lives, then he would want only two things:""

3360668476.m_KeyValue: "You once had an entire ship of companions. It was you who betrayed them."

3360668479.m_KeyValue: "Is that what you truly believe? Why do you think the Captain was only strict with you? Why do you think he insisted on sailing to the dangerous Sunset Isle this time?!"

3360668480.m_KeyValue: ""Van Helsing, you wretched bastard! Stop speaking like you're the only one with a mind in this room—and don't you dare look at me with that scornful gaze!""

3360668482.m_KeyValue: "The Divine Body… He spoke of it?"

3360668483.m_KeyValue: "Van Helsing… I've been meaning to say this for a long time. I despise your habit of always speaking in riddles."

3360668484.m_KeyValue: ""Then at last, we may be together. Never to part again.""

3360668485.m_KeyValue: "Tch… You old fool. Still breathing? I was certain Van Helsing had already dealt with you."

3360668486.m_KeyValue: "My only mistake… was underestimating the cruelty a coward can unleash when he refuses to face who he truly is."

3360668511.m_KeyValue: "Silver-haired and I are more than enough."

3360668512.m_KeyValue: ""Don't curse her! The dumb wolf may be dense, but she can definitely handle a few infected sailors! Though...""

3360668513.m_KeyValue: ""Let's go, silver-haired. It's time to let this whirlpool of insecurity, jealousy, and greed...""

3360668515.m_KeyValue: "And who's this stinking jellyfish girl? So carefree… and always alone with Noah."

3360668516.m_KeyValue: "What?! What in the world is wrong with you?!"

3360668518.m_KeyValue: "You know what I've done—I killed my brother. I killed the crew. All for you."

3360668545.m_KeyValue: "Something's wrong. This rocking... It's not from the storm."

3360668546.m_KeyValue: "I was born this way. But that's beside the point."

3360668547.m_KeyValue: "Ranna hasn't abandoned me. She's testing me."

3360668548.m_KeyValue: "A Calamity can kill a Bell Ringer?"

3360668549.m_KeyValue: ""Harboring? She was here long before this ship was ever built... No, more than that...""

3360668550.m_KeyValue: ""To feed her, I turned every soul on this ship into flesh puppets, bound by Black Blood...""

3370730457.m_KeyValue: "Is there really any point in fixating on such nonsense?"

3370731480.m_KeyValue: ""Whichever path you choose, all destinies converge upon the same inevitable end.""

3370732635.m_KeyValue: "Well... I don't really know much about that."

3370733658.m_KeyValue: "Neither do I! You make the call!"

3370734813.m_KeyValue: ""I have more pressing matters that require my contemplation. Do proceed without my input, if you would.""

3370735836.m_KeyValue: "Do you fuss over this trivial stuff every day? How utterly boring."

3370736991.m_KeyValue: "Are we seriously holding a meeting for something this trivial?"

3373409648.m_KeyValue: "Basic actuators with slightly different performance focus compared to Type I."

3374398228.m_KeyValue: "Account creation time is not in the event duration."

3374398235.m_KeyValue: "Complete the required stage to link to the inviter's account."

3374929591.m_KeyValue: "Tax revenue can be used to significantly increase your Vassal's LV."

3375343427.m_KeyValue: ""The descent was too fast, I could only manage to slow it down a little...""

3375343559.m_KeyValue: "We've taken care of all the enemies on this floor!"

3375343656.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, we'll definitely get you out of here. I always keep my promises!""

3375343788.m_KeyValue: ""Very well... I've decided. First I'll kill everyone except the silver-hair, and then...""

3381112406.m_KeyValue: ""Why... since entering this room, I've been getting déjà vu.""

3381112407.m_KeyValue: ""The good news is, it seems you haven't truly defeated any of the elders, yet you've made it this far.""

3381112408.m_KeyValue: "The only difference is who's pulling the strings—Parents? Lovers? Or have you ever considered..."

3381112409.m_KeyValue: "And the final one... it firmly locks away your intertwined 'futures.'"

3381112410.m_KeyValue: ""No, it's not like that. This can't be... but... how...""

3381112437.m_KeyValue: "Now isn't the time to second guess ourselves."

3381112439.m_KeyValue: "The final card they needed has been in my possession all along."

3381112464.m_KeyValue: ""Why did you ask that, Empousa? Are you hoping she's as much of a fool as you?""

3381112470.m_KeyValue: "These cards... they're moving on their own..."

3381112471.m_KeyValue: ""Just kill me—that should be easy for you, right?""

3381112475.m_KeyValue: ""Even though I'll lose my memories, there might still be a chance to save everything...""

3381712083.m_KeyValue: ""Everyone is the sole result of their own world, while others are the _$$processes_$$ that help write this result with us.""

3381712084.m_KeyValue: ""Your fall from the cliff is the predetermined result, while Aunt Mary's involvement is the process.""

3381712085.m_KeyValue: "And the result is... Aunt Mary was killed."

3381990411.m_KeyValue: ""That's odd. He's usually as swift and decisive as his superior, Joan. He should have arrived by now.""

3381990412.m_KeyValue: "Ah—never mind that. Looks like we've got more trouble heading our way."

3381990413.m_KeyValue: "Come now—we're all allies here. Let's not break the peace we've managed to keep."

3381991434.m_KeyValue: "Does this mean… I'm back in my own body?"

3381991436.m_KeyValue: "So… what happened on the El Dorado wasn't a dream."

3381991437.m_KeyValue: "Skoll... you must be in so much pain. You've always been the one who hated pain the most..."

3382046019.m_KeyValue: "This is a disaster. I have to find some way to fix this mess..."

3383388507.m_KeyValue: ""IDIP requires that when a Lord does not correspond to the Openid, the error code must be 1.""

3384143752.m_KeyValue: ""This Vassal features an exclusive interactive scene, available in the Satin Boudoir.""

3385198946.m_KeyValue: ""I swear on my code of chivalry, I am a pacifist!""

3385202147.m_KeyValue: "Ha... Hati... You... get out of here..."

3387901838.m_KeyValue:
""After turning around, the others vanished without a trace, leaving the spider bewildered.
Those who walk the same path are but fellow travelers.""

3387901867.m_KeyValue:
"'I still prefer straight paths...''
Find the right road for you. Hey!"

3394460680.m_KeyValue: ""Ah yes, Sir Gadric. The continent's famed swordsman. If someone were foolish enough to challenge you... I suppose they'd never leave this valley alive.""

3394460681.m_KeyValue: ""Should I have joined them in death, Sir Gadric?""

3394460682.m_KeyValue: ""Faithless Apostate! Aeon sees all, and Her wrath shall descend upon you!""

3394463881.m_KeyValue: ""Farewell and take care—you are, besides me, the only other _$$firewood_$$ left in this world.""

3394463882.m_KeyValue: "Congratulations. You have passed the final trial."

3394463883.m_KeyValue: ""In the end, Time eroded my very being.""

3395752333.m_KeyValue: ""I am War, first to awaken among the Thirteen Ancestral Black Bloods. The Calamity given form.""

3395752335.m_KeyValue: ""A few days ago, I may have accidentally slain their... king.""

3395752336.m_KeyValue: "And to think—this is the first time in a hundred years the old Saint's had two Bell Ringers work together."

3395752337.m_KeyValue: "Until the Divine Body's seal can no longer contain it."

3395752338.m_KeyValue: "I recall you had quite the lovely chat with that silver-haired one in the carriage."

3397061890.m_KeyValue: "What am I supposed to do now..."

3398437047.m_KeyValue: ""I won't wait for anyone. If you want to keep up, catch up on your own!""

3399761523.m_KeyValue: ""I'll use these pesky fodder as a demonstration. Watch closely, I'm only showing you this once.""

3401125225.m_KeyValue: ""As a mysterious diviner and the elder of the Bathory family, would you grant me an answer true to my question?""

3401125226.m_KeyValue: "She was just applying the most probable 'lovers' quarrel' pre-made prediction because you wanted a divination on your own."

3401125231.m_KeyValue: ""Mhm, quite a sensible reading, I'd say...""

3401125232.m_KeyValue: "She also said that the argument would be over quickly and that it would actually bring us closer together."

3401125234.m_KeyValue: ""Well, I can't say she was wrong... then she said, 'You must have had a quarrel with your lover.'""

3401125235.m_KeyValue: "She must have seen you when I lifted the tent flap and walked in."

3401125236.m_KeyValue: "So that's what your lover looks like."

3401125237.m_KeyValue: ""Light pink curls, mysterious eyes, and lips as red as blood.""

3401125238.m_KeyValue: ""Finally, she said that if I was skeptical about her words, she could describe my lover's appearance from her crystal ball.""

3402511868.m_KeyValue: ""Through the haze, I saw her walking toward the auction house, heading for her fate.""

3402511870.m_KeyValue: "These unclaimed letters could not be the end of her story..."

3402511871.m_KeyValue: ""An observer should not meddle in the game of chess, Noah from the future.""

3402576975.m_KeyValue: "It just feels wrong to let it die in a place like this."

3406887454.m_KeyValue: ""That's why our lady went to Starfall Valley to find you, but ended up risking her life to save you...""

3406887455.m_KeyValue: ""The 'Great Heretic'... No, I mean Noah. I'm sorry I couldn't change your fate. At the time, I did find Bishop Brennholt, but...""

3412788213.m_KeyValue: ""Or perhaps you prefer to be called ""Jacintha Dalcarlo"" these days?""

3412788214.m_KeyValue: ""Please excuse me, I'll take my leave.""

3417360824.m_KeyValue: ""This one, too. Just need... a hand... again.""

3417394713.m_KeyValue: "(soft panting) Just need... your hand... here."

3418883180.m_KeyValue: "Look what was uncovered in Lorelei's office—"

3418883182.m_KeyValue: ""But the logic here makes sense, could it mean...""

3422314986.m_KeyValue: ""From now on, your vows will be yours to uphold.""

3426466036.m_KeyValue: "Tap to logTap to logTap to log"

3427188292.m_KeyValue: ""Take my burning wings. Live. Fly. Together, we'll be free.""

3427188293.m_KeyValue: "Aeon? Quite the contrary. I am his enemy."

3427188294.m_KeyValue: "I imagined a hundred ways to die... But I never thought I'd burn."

3427188295.m_KeyValue: ""Of course. In her eyes, there's no difference between me and you.""

3427188296.m_KeyValue: "Gratitude... For what? We don't even know what we're signing up for."

3427453232.m_KeyValue: "Understanding something doesn't mean I agree with it."

3427453267.m_KeyValue: ""Maybe it's because we share the same blood, we're both too stubborn to bend.""

3428115587.m_KeyValue: "Guardian of Magical Creatures in Sapphire Isle; Devoted Connoisseur of Fries"

3428115588.m_KeyValue: "Joyce's Perfect Puppet Friend; Founder of the Puppet Association"

3428115591.m_KeyValue: "Sage of Sapphire Isle — Creator of Paradise"

3428115592.m_KeyValue: "Sage of Sapphire Isle — Innovator of Technology"

3428115593.m_KeyValue: "Sage of Sapphire Isle — Keeper of Order"

3428115594.m_KeyValue: "Sage of Sapphire Isle — Hermit of the Seas"

3428115595.m_KeyValue: "Sage of Sapphire Isle — Pioneer of Trade"

3428494647.m_KeyValue: "He's likely in trouble by now. Oh—he left something for you."

3428494649.m_KeyValue: ""Calvin, you're unwell. Sit down. Rest a while.""

3428644951.m_KeyValue: "The Isle has so many fancy market stalls now... it's completely different from before I fell ill."

3428644953.m_KeyValue: ""Father doesn't allow me to swim, but my friend secretly taught me to.""

3430336232.m_KeyValue: "Oh? So you've figured that out too? Then I absolutely can't let you leave."

3430336233.m_KeyValue: "The process is clearly incomplete. They won't be hard to bring down."

3430336234.m_KeyValue: "Or perhaps the rebellious families learned how to build them themselves."

3430336235.m_KeyValue: ""Hard to believe that from Lady Pavana, heir to House Astolfo.""

3430337258.m_KeyValue: "Are you alright? You look a bit pale..."

3430337259.m_KeyValue: "—we could kill him without hesitation. His true self… can't die."

3430728059.m_KeyValue: "I saw the perpetual worry etched on my clan members' faces as the sea levels continued to rise."

3430728066.m_KeyValue: "That fish took quite a bit of effort to catch. It's rare to find one bigger than you."

3430728068.m_KeyValue: ""By the way, one of the fish in the kitchen was an incarnation of Calamity. That one didn't taste very good.""

3430728069.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, it's quite a rare scent indeed.""

3430728070.m_KeyValue: ""Actually, I can gain certain memories, or rather, sensations, by consuming food.""

3430728071.m_KeyValue: "That's why it could summon you through the conch shell—they're both creatures of the sea."

3430728073.m_KeyValue: ""But the fish in the kitchen didn't have any meaningful memories for me to see, so I had to ask you to catch some bigger ones.""

3436045291.m_KeyValue: ""When the battle begins and every 10 sec after, grants a Shield equal to <style=""Highlight"">{0}</style> of Starry-Eyed Aiona's Max HP to the ally deployed on the tile, lasting for {1} sec.""

3436352283.m_KeyValue: "I need more details! This is better than any story I've ever read!"

3436354461.m_KeyValue: "Is that even up for debate? It's the obvious course of action. Only a fool would think otherwise!"

3436355484.m_KeyValue: "I'm in! Just follow me and we can't fail!"

3436356639.m_KeyValue: ""With 'The Chariot' at our disposal, we can boldly forge ahead.""

3436357662.m_KeyValue: "I appreciate this flexibility. It gives us strategic options."

3436661427.m_KeyValue: ""Have no worry. All will settle into place, like dust after a storm.""

3437029711.m_KeyValue: "She's the most beautiful cat in the world!"

3438298034.m_KeyValue: "So that's why Father was so determined to go to the forbidden grounds at that time..."

3438298035.m_KeyValue: ""I just remembered something. Twenty years ago, when I entered the Ashen Garden under the Church's orders, the Gravekeeper wasn't Clive...""

3438298037.m_KeyValue: ""Back then, we saw many transformed Gravekeepers in the Ashen Garden. They locked themselves in the caves to exterminate the insect eggs.""

3438298065.m_KeyValue: "So... where's the man you abandoned us for?"

3438298066.m_KeyValue: "We only obtained the Church's permission to enter the forbidden grounds to collect those spores. Our mission is complete."

3438298098.m_KeyValue: ""Gilrain, do you really not remember anything from when you were human? What happened to you...""

3438298129.m_KeyValue: ""It appears that before the true dawn breaks, the 'moon' is reluctant to return the night.""

3438298130.m_KeyValue: ""And Clive! He's turned back into a human, even though he had fully transformed earlier...""

3438298131.m_KeyValue: "They are not trying to unseal the Calamity... They are the Gravekeepers who once fought against the Black Blood with their lives!"

3438298161.m_KeyValue: "He just took off... What do we do now?"

3438298164.m_KeyValue: "How can you be so certain? Have you seen him before?"

3438298167.m_KeyValue: ""Gilrain, tell me the truth. Did Cain send you?""

3438298189.m_KeyValue: ""Turn against the flow of time, and return what once was!""

3438298192.m_KeyValue: "Finally decided to wake up? We released this huge pain in the ass just to save you."

3438298193.m_KeyValue: "Th-Then... does that mean we may have chosen the wrong side? That big bug... maybe it just wanted to leave this place?"

3438298194.m_KeyValue: ""Gilrain, now's not the time to sulk. Come on!""

3438298196.m_KeyValue: "What are you talking about? Where are we?"

3438298197.m_KeyValue: "You've already left this place once? Why did you come back?"

3438298198.m_KeyValue: ""You said my sister looked forward to my future, but all I want is to protect her past.""

3438298199.m_KeyValue: "The people will work together to transform this barren land into a thriving town."

3439704775.m_KeyValue: ""Whether it's the first 'special type' we rescued from the Church, or Lady Empousa...""

3439709991.m_KeyValue: "But it's strange... why haven't they arrived after all this time..."

3445579754.m_KeyValue: "Then… what if I even the odds?"

3446063339.m_KeyValue: "I've crossed swords with Gadric. I could sense his respect for life."

3446063340.m_KeyValue: ""Father being framed as a traitor, everyone in town becoming infected with Black Blood, and the Church's purge... He must've known about all of it.""

3446063341.m_KeyValue: "Skoll! You have to hang in there!"

3446063344.m_KeyValue: ""But Skoll is so devout, so kind... Why would the Black Blood disease infect him?""

3446063372.m_KeyValue: ""Even if it doesn't concern me, what about your brother? Your father? They're still waiting for you!""

3446063373.m_KeyValue: "He chose to end his own life before fully transforming into a beast."

3446063375.m_KeyValue: ""I have to go, Skoll. Father and everyone in town... they're all waiting for me!""

3446063376.m_KeyValue: "The Ashen Garden. Gadric and Father should both be there!"

3446063403.m_KeyValue: ""You're late, Gadric. Did you get lost again?""

3446063404.m_KeyValue: "Don't worry. They're... prepared to face their fate."

3446063405.m_KeyValue: "We've already introduced ourselves during our previous encounter."

3446063406.m_KeyValue: "A man like him... He won't fall until he fulfills his vow."

3446474361.m_KeyValue: ""For those who can't control it, it's a curse; but for us, it's a source of power.""

3450432104.m_KeyValue:
"'Stinking bat!' 'Dumb wolf!'
Walked into an argument only to be kicked away by someone's foot."

3461564542.m_KeyValue: "The truth is... even if we find the village... there likely won't be anyone there..."

3461564544.m_KeyValue: ""Because the Church suddenly arrived, as if they were already prepared for Death's awakening...""

3461564545.m_KeyValue: "Is it because the sealed Calamity is still cursing the family members that they want to completely eradicate... the Calamity itself?"

3461564546.m_KeyValue: "But I also saw those phantoms... So just who are they?"

3461564547.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, so that's why you said you were learning from the Church's teachers, you were actually born and raised in the Church's territories...""

3461564549.m_KeyValue: ""Piera, hide behind me! Run as soon as you get the chance!""

3461564551.m_KeyValue: "I won't let you lay a finger on her!"

3461564574.m_KeyValue: ""When the time comes, we'll return here together.""

3461564575.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, I can't believe you're still in one piece after falling from all the way up there!""

3461564577.m_KeyValue: "Where's Sora? Weren't you two looking for the doctor together? Where is he?!"

3461564838.m_KeyValue: ""May our path forward be bathed in the Light, unhindered by the shadow.""

3461564840.m_KeyValue: "The bad news... the El Dorado has most likely sunk..."

3461564870.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, my clothes are all dirty... Your clothes... they look very expensive...""

3461564871.m_KeyValue: ""I have a lot I'd like to ask you, but let's find somewhere safe first.""

3461564872.m_KeyValue: "But I still haven't seen another soul. If only someone could shed some light on all this... anyone would do—"

3461564873.m_KeyValue: "Am I even sure this is an island?"

3461564902.m_KeyValue: ""This island, where the next Moonblessed is supposed to be, and the location of my hometown, according to Cain...""

3461564903.m_KeyValue: "I was told that my hometown is on Sunset Isle."

3461564905.m_KeyValue: ""N-No, I wasn't. I came here to find my hometown...""

3461564934.m_KeyValue: "My grandmother passed away a long time ago. And..."

3461564937.m_KeyValue: "...Why did Noah choose that particular gesture?"

3461564938.m_KeyValue: "Dr. Ressa is our last hope... She's the only one who can save us from turning into those monsters!"

3461564939.m_KeyValue: ""No, it's my fault. I got caught up in the moment.""

3461564940.m_KeyValue: "This voice... why does it sound so familiar? So comforting..."

3461564967.m_KeyValue: ""Longings? But... if we can see them, does that mean we also have a longing for something on this island?""

3461564970.m_KeyValue: "Didn't I tell you to catch a boat back to the Church without me? Why are you still here?"

3461564972.m_KeyValue: ""And there lies the problem. Within the Church, only the Bell Ringers are allowed access to that place. So the traitor...""

3461564973.m_KeyValue: ""If he's been gone for days, why are we searching here?""

3461565000.m_KeyValue: "—'Gravekeeper' of the Divine Body on this island?"

3461565002.m_KeyValue: ""...You are Noah Nevernight, indeed. You haven't changed at all. So self-absorbed, so cold... and yet... so strong...""

3461565003.m_KeyValue: ""But you, Noah Nevernight, you stole her from us.""

3461565004.m_KeyValue: "S-Sorry... I promise I won't get scared. I won't cause you any trouble."

3461565005.m_KeyValue: "But you said your grandmother told you? I don't recall seeing anyone that could be your grandmother on the way here."

3461565030.m_KeyValue: ""Let me take care of these, then you can explain these rules to me!""

3461565031.m_KeyValue: ""Either way, for now we only know that the Divine Body on this island is causing these phantoms to materialize based on people's longings.""

3461565033.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, you just said... you came to the island to find the Calamity, right? But you called it a Moonblessed?""

3461565034.m_KeyValue: ""The Gravekeeper's duty... naturally fell to me, the only one left...""

3461565035.m_KeyValue: ""It's because of my companions—the blurred figure in my memories who promised to wait for my return; and now, those by my side striving towards our common goal, the Moonblessed.""

3461565037.m_KeyValue: "I appreciate the concern. But it was the presence of a Divine Body that linked those two events."

3461770012.m_KeyValue: "Then let me—the heart of the Divine Body—show you what you truly are."

3461770014.m_KeyValue: "But Cain plans to use Empousa regardless. If he succeeds..."

3461770015.m_KeyValue: "And next time you want to negotiate... Come in person."

3461770016.m_KeyValue: ""Just days ago, in that broken carriage... I never imagined you would become the end of my journey.""

3462039791.m_KeyValue: ""What are your thoughts on 'collecting Future Artifacts highly sought after by various factions, despite significant risks'?""

3462041969.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on arranging for vassals to infiltrate the territories of other Kingdoms?"

3462045040.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'reducing the scope of authority of our elders'?"

3462182376.m_KeyValue: ""So, you don't intend to deal us another card?""

3462182377.m_KeyValue: "My mortal flesh has long since withered. This form is all that remains."

3462182379.m_KeyValue: "And here I thought we'd met a nice old man. Looks like we'll have to fight after all!"

3462182408.m_KeyValue: "We've already obtained four cards. We're more than halfway through this journey. Let's stay positive."

3462182409.m_KeyValue: ""I'm afraid none of these are the fifth card you're looking for, darlings.""

3462182410.m_KeyValue: ""My, my, this card... Is it what you expected? 'The Moon' in reverse—""

3462182411.m_KeyValue: ""Consider this card a gift and a word of advice from me. After all, the path ahead will undoubtedly be difficult.""

3462182412.m_KeyValue: ""You're right, but... I have no idea. What name should I give myself?""

3462182672.m_KeyValue: "'Perhaps a caged bird should never yearn for the starry sky.'"

3462182673.m_KeyValue: ""Of course it's boring, doing the same thing every day. But we can choose to escape, to leave this place behind.""

3462182674.m_KeyValue: "Then why me...? I haven't done anything of note."

3462182675.m_KeyValue: ""Seriously, why can't you just be honest?""

3462182704.m_KeyValue: "What the heck were those two... things?"

3462182705.m_KeyValue: "As I thought... this strange card is one of the keys to activate the Astrolabe."

3462182706.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps... keys to unlock a mechanism? Seven grooves, and the Astrolabe has seven rings...""

3462182707.m_KeyValue: ""Even if we count everyone who was imprisoned with us, there still weren't this many people, were there?""

3462182736.m_KeyValue: ""No, I shouldn't have tried to force my ideals on you, and even said you hated...""

3462182739.m_KeyValue: ""...Wait, why are there so many of them?!""

3462182769.m_KeyValue: ""You warned me, but I underestimated our situation. If we fail here, it's my fault alone...""

3462182771.m_KeyValue: "We've got the second card too. Let's get out of here before she changes her mind."

3462182772.m_KeyValue: "Don't be jealous just because I'm cute."

3462182774.m_KeyValue: ""Violence is prohibited in this store. If you have no money, please leave.""

3462182775.m_KeyValue: "I can part with it if you want."

3462182805.m_KeyValue: ""You can feel me, can't you? My body's warmth, my scent—they're real.""

3462182806.m_KeyValue: ""Like those puppets we encountered before, right?""

3462182836.m_KeyValue: ""'Die here in despair,' or 'Struggle to survive and chase that unreachable goal.'""

3462182837.m_KeyValue: "Are you done playing this game of friendship?"

3462182838.m_KeyValue: "This guy... Could he be some kind of monster?!"

3462182839.m_KeyValue: "Lesson one: respect the darkness and the unknown lurking within."

3462182868.m_KeyValue: "Is it... weird? Do you not like it?"

3462182870.m_KeyValue: "So it's literally an abyss? That's rather... disappointing."

3463060644.m_KeyValue: "I've heard that ranked Silver Cross members are second only to the Bell Ringers in power..."

3463060646.m_KeyValue: "I can't run... I have to kill this thing and get the message out!"

3463060648.m_KeyValue: ""My my, Cain is surprisingly dependable when he's our ally.""

3463061671.m_KeyValue: "He says nothing... That's as good as a yes."

3463061672.m_KeyValue: ""...After all, only the dead stay silent.""

3464370198.m_KeyValue: "And yet all this began the moment he handed you that lance without a single explanation..."

3464370199.m_KeyValue: "You're the one who refused to listen to reason!"

3464370200.m_KeyValue: "Let's be honest. You'll collapse halfway there."

3468524481.m_KeyValue: "Complete challenges with Vassals at specific levels to earn abundant Extra Rewards."

3471155920.m_KeyValue: ""But no matter what you've become, you'll always be the hero to us.""

3475530915.m_KeyValue: "Just someone who hopes you'll pretend none of this ever happened."

3475530916.m_KeyValue: "But the commander said they would wait for the full moon... and that night has yet to come—"

3475530917.m_KeyValue: "You remember when Lord Agares executed that silver-haired heretic here a few days ago? Where did he go after that?"

3475530918.m_KeyValue: "I see. Just the two of you… That makes it easier."

3475534116.m_KeyValue: ""Tonight, the Carrelle family's thousand-year reign of bondage comes to an end.""

3475534117.m_KeyValue: ""Lord Agares, are you alright? Everyone is waiting for your orders.""

3475534118.m_KeyValue: ""Now, six days is all I need to reclaim everything I have lost.""

3476100271.m_KeyValue: "I... How did I get here? Who am I? My memory..."

3476100272.m_KeyValue: "This is a sample of Miss Setti's blood that we managed to bring back from Starfall Valley."

3476100273.m_KeyValue: ""It seems the <style=""Highlight"">Pure Blood Essence</style> worked quite well for Miss Setti. What will it be for you, Noah?""

3476100274.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Setti, please calm down. You've just awakened and your body is quite weak. We shall be explaining the situation to you in detail, alright?""

3476170993.m_KeyValue: "I always knew—Ganelon was never truly my name."

3476170995.m_KeyValue: ""Deep down, I've always known... I'm different. From my brother, from my father... from everyone in Ganelon.""

3476170996.m_KeyValue: "And I knew Mouret was never truly my home."

3476170997.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Your true homeland._$$ Back then, I never knew what he meant.""

3476170998.m_KeyValue: ""Father always told me, _$$One day, you must take that step... face your true self... and find..._$$""

3476170999.m_KeyValue: "A true homeland... is just as you said—where the ones I love and hold dear reside."

3476171000.m_KeyValue: "Thank you... Your name's Ranna? Your words helped me understand my father for the first time."

3476171002.m_KeyValue: "So I don't need to go anywhere. Because I never left my homeland."

3476172018.m_KeyValue: ""March – The sea, ever an unpredictable maiden, grew more temperamental this time of year.""

3476172019.m_KeyValue: "Our mission to recover the lost artifacts of the legendary Landis family had come to a complete halt."

3476172020.m_KeyValue: ""Until that day, when Bob—newly promoted to Second Mate—came to me, cradling a child in his arms.""

3476172021.m_KeyValue: ""He said they had pulled her from the sea. Could that be true? How could a girl, barely a year old, survive the ocean's depths?""

3476172022.m_KeyValue: ""Yet something about her brought the Landis family to mind—the very family we had been searching for, the ones who vanished with their island into the waves.""

3476172023.m_KeyValue: ""If they hadn't perished, but instead founded a kingdom beneath the sea... then this child might be the key to unlocking that mystery, to realizing our dream.""

3476172024.m_KeyValue: ""_$$We should give her a name,_$$ Bob said.""

3476172026.m_KeyValue: ""Ami—Ami Landis. She would be our helm, the one to steer us toward the truth behind the legend.""

3476180721.m_KeyValue: "Am I going to be eaten...? Or will I turn into one of them—devouring others...?"

3476180730.m_KeyValue: "Why is this happening? What's going on aboard the ship?"

3476180731.m_KeyValue: ""Just this morning, Bob praised me for working so hard...""

3476180732.m_KeyValue: "I even had my favorite smoked fish for dinner..."

3476180733.m_KeyValue: ""If I could just get some sleep, tomorrow would be another ordinary, happy day...""

3476180735.m_KeyValue: "All I did was slack off a little today... Is this my punishment...?"

3476180736.m_KeyValue: "Is it so wrong to just want to live a quiet life...?"

3476181875.m_KeyValue: "Then those whispers might be a resonance—a symptom of the Black Blood."

3476181876.m_KeyValue: "Miss Ami has lived on this ship for years—she shouldn't be seasick. If Miss Hati heard the same voice..."

3476181881.m_KeyValue: "The source of the voice... Is it moving?"

3476181882.m_KeyValue: "No... something's wrong. The voice... it's getting closer. She's coming up here too—she's nearby..."

3476181883.m_KeyValue: ""We've left the lowest level—the one that caused you pain. Are you feeling any better now, Miss Ami?""

3476181885.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know if they're hearing the same thing, but that's what that dumb wolf said.""

3476181887.m_KeyValue: ""First that dumb wolf, and now her? Do all seasick people hear creepy whispers? What a pain...""

3476181888.m_KeyValue: "That voice... She's hungry... She wants to restore her power... She's searching for more food..."

3476182899.m_KeyValue: "That kick really hurt! Can you help me up?"

3476182905.m_KeyValue: "Huh...? When did it get so dark? Did someone blow out the candles?"

3476182906.m_KeyValue: "Where did that thing that tried to devour me go? Could it be waiting to ambush me from the shadows..."

3476182909.m_KeyValue: "Sis... We're just sparring. You didn't have to go all out..."

3476184053.m_KeyValue: ""I may not know where she is now, but I know exactly where she'll end up.""

3476184054.m_KeyValue: ""Never forget, the future is always a step ahead of the present.""

3476184057.m_KeyValue: ""Erm... Miss Dalcarlo, that's not what the compass is for either.""

3476184058.m_KeyValue: ""If you want to track someone, go ask the compass, meow.""

3476184059.m_KeyValue: "I will not allow anyone to mock the future! ...But you did remind me of something."

3476184060.m_KeyValue: "Why prattle on about the future? We'll be fish food before it ever comes. Especially you—you'd make a rather lovely bite."

3476184061.m_KeyValue: "She's got the brains of a jellyfish—doesn't even realize how dangerous it is to wander off alone right now!"

3476184063.m_KeyValue: ""Empress, you seem to misunderstand what I do meow. I see the future, not the present.""

3476184064.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, Jacintha, aren't you supposed to be a fortune-teller? Hurry up and tell us where she went!""

3476185077.m_KeyValue: "I have to go... I can't let her revive again..."

3476185078.m_KeyValue: "...Am I still too weak? I need to eat..."

3476185082.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, keep an eye on jellyfish girl. Leave these pests to me!""

3476185083.m_KeyValue: "You bear my blood... You are my kin..."

3476185088.m_KeyValue: "That voice... It's coming from the provisions room?"

3476186232.m_KeyValue: "Eh?! Well that's worse! What do we do now?!"

3476186235.m_KeyValue: "It's fine. I recognize that uniform. He's not with the crew."

3476186237.m_KeyValue: "I need more sustenance to restore my strength!"

3476186239.m_KeyValue: "They dare reject fusion with the ancestral Black Blood? They'll regret it soon enough."

3476187255.m_KeyValue: "I'm not falling for that trick again! This isn't Mouret!"

3476187256.m_KeyValue: ""And why are you so certain this world isn't real? Aren't your thoughts, your memories... all right here?""

3476187257.m_KeyValue: ""You dragged me into that mindscape thing again, didn't you?!""

3476187258.m_KeyValue: "Have you ever considered... that this might be the real world?"

3476187259.m_KeyValue: "What happened to you? You look hideous!"

3476187260.m_KeyValue: "Fool! Black Blood is our true form—this shape is proof that I've reclaimed my power."

3476187262.m_KeyValue: ""Now, Sheila... this is the perfect time to join me.""

3476187264.m_KeyValue: "Why's it so quiet... Is there nothing on the deck? Ami...?"

3487000329.m_KeyValue: "Are there annoying Blood Beasts in heaven too?"

3487000330.m_KeyValue: ""As expected, you really like the taste of blood in this body.""

3487000361.m_KeyValue: "Aunty Julia caught a big fish and is calling everyone to eat!"

3487000363.m_KeyValue: "You're right... it's all my fault... I shouldn't have done the divination. Mother warned me long ago..."

3487000364.m_KeyValue: "There's only one way to pass the test..."

3487000365.m_KeyValue: ""No, it's not that you're not relying on the power of the Tarot. You're too afraid... afraid that your divination will come true.""

3487000367.m_KeyValue: "Half of the sailors row at full speed towards the sails! The other half grab weapons and prepare for battle!"

3487000368.m_KeyValue: "Your weakness lies at the ocean's end..."

3487000394.m_KeyValue: ""I'm useless... Kitty... I couldn't save you, nor anyone else...""

3487000395.m_KeyValue: "Stop you? I don't need to do anything."

3487000396.m_KeyValue: ""How many disoriented wanderers have I caught in the deep sea, their lungs filled with water, unable to utter even their last words?""

3488291720.m_KeyValue: ""There were so many beasts this time, yet they were surprisingly weak.""

3488291721.m_KeyValue: "It ascends from the earth to the heaven and again it descends to the earth and receives the force of things superior and inferior. By this means you shall have—"

3488291752.m_KeyValue: ""Pack them separately, be prepared to discard them to lighten the load at any time.""

3488291753.m_KeyValue: "The tarot was right! We defeated so many beasts! Now we can finally set out!"

3488291754.m_KeyValue: "What about the Tarot card she gave us? Does it say where to find her?"

3488291755.m_KeyValue: ""Remember, life returns to dust, but death can have its own value.""

3488292016.m_KeyValue: ""What a downpour! Even the fish are coming up to the surface, let's go catch some!""

3488292017.m_KeyValue: "I... I can't perform divination for others..."

3488292018.m_KeyValue: ""'The Tower' stands at the center of the storm, its once solid foundation crumbling in tragedy;""

3488292019.m_KeyValue: ""What appeared? Slimy, vicious Blood Beasts that bring endless pain and torment, of course!""

3488292020.m_KeyValue: ""...The Tarot is not a power to be used lightly. We explore the limits of being 'human,' and only after that do we seek the blessing of the Tarot.""

3488292051.m_KeyValue: ""A giant, super fluffy version of yourself? Hehe, I can just imagine how cute you'd—""

3488292082.m_KeyValue: ""You mean this tree? ...Ah, to build a new boat?""

3488292116.m_KeyValue: "Captain... the mast was broken during the battle..."

3488292117.m_KeyValue: "Captain... while we were distracted those beasts ripped a hole in the ship..."

3488292119.m_KeyValue: ""The doctor gave her some medicine and said... if she could hold on until tomorrow, there's still hope for recovery...""

3488292149.m_KeyValue: "I don't believe in the fate you speak of! Are you the one Esmeralda said would bring hope? You're not!"

3488292150.m_KeyValue: "It's the Captain! The Captain is speaking!"

3488292151.m_KeyValue: "Why did you wait... wait until the Captain..."

3488292178.m_KeyValue: "What about you? Aren't you going back?"

3488292180.m_KeyValue: "The sealed door opens—ancient tales come to light—"

3488292182.m_KeyValue: "She'd keep fighting all the way to the Blood Beasts' lair! She'd find the mastermind behind it all—the evil windmill that wants to devour the entire world!"

3488292183.m_KeyValue: ""The cards reveal that the Pontos will ultimately fall to Death, and this calamity will continue to spread until it brings misfortune to the entire continent.""

3488682218.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm, should I start with the 'Sapphire Isle Auction House' and its rare treasures? Or head straight to the legendary 'Sails of Glory'?""

3491358896.m_KeyValue: ""'Once the promised flower withers, your father will no longer exist in this world...'""

3491975207.m_KeyValue: "To think I could be outwitted... What a brilliant little cat burglar."

3491975208.m_KeyValue: ""Unfortunately, its most vital memory has been stolen.""

3491975210.m_KeyValue: "And so... that's how everything came to pass."

3491975211.m_KeyValue: ""At last, the wicked Joyce has fallen.""

3494475068.m_KeyValue: "Fungal colony? I think I've heard alchemists mention that before."

3494493403.m_KeyValue: "The power my father taught me was the power to protect! Awaken—"

3494493404.m_KeyValue: "W-what?! What kind of mother does that?! What kind of family is this!?"

3494493405.m_KeyValue: "Is it that sinister eyebrows? Have you joined him? Or is it... Cain? Are you working with him now!?"

3494493406.m_KeyValue: "Miss Dalcarlo... You left so suddenly back there. I thought you'd abandoned us."

3494494422.m_KeyValue: ""What are you trying to do, Mr. Van Helsing…?""

3494494423.m_KeyValue: "What kind of bard would show up in a place like this?! He's clearly the enemy!"

3494494425.m_KeyValue: "Is this... the sealed area? Have I returned to reality?"

3494494426.m_KeyValue: "Just long enough for me to gather the Four and open the path—"

3494494427.m_KeyValue: "No. There is one case in which we do die—"

3494494428.m_KeyValue: "A long tale... and we've little time left. You'll be leaving soon."

3494494429.m_KeyValue: "How rude—both to her wardrobe and to your labeling of truth as an ability."

3494494430.m_KeyValue: "And if I take Aeon's place... then why should I not be omniscient and omnipotent?"

3495802953.m_KeyValue: "Light's other half... 'the dusk remains'... It must mean the black and white Colossus Max..."

3495802954.m_KeyValue: "Seriously... is there anyone normal in this camp?"

3495802955.m_KeyValue: ""Whoa, whoa—don't get upset. I was jesting.""

3495892365.m_KeyValue: "With this power... perhaps I can defeat them!"

3495892396.m_KeyValue: ""No time to worry about that! Since Bloodsoul is a shared resource, allocate it to me so I can unleash my Ultimate!""

3496302983.m_KeyValue: "This armor was crafted by my father with the resolve to protect all of our family. It's incredibly sturdy."

3496303115.m_KeyValue: ""You're so pathetic, black-haired show-off. Are these soulless soldiers really scaring you?""

3496303150.m_KeyValue: "Who... who would do such a thing! How could they treat them like this!"

3496303216.m_KeyValue: ""We can take shelter inside if we get through the corridor. You three go first, I'll cover you.""

3496303313.m_KeyValue: "I don't care about those pointless names. I just want to help your sister. Let us pass."

3497367360.m_KeyValue: "What?! You figured out one of Yakov's brilliant schemes?"

3497367362.m_KeyValue: ""Only humans have wants, longings. Can a puppet really have a will of its own?""

3499955622.m_KeyValue: ""I had a strange dream last night, and the moment I awoke, Savich's man suddenly invited us here.""

3499958924.m_KeyValue: "Don't tell me Goldland's a set of triplets..."

""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Dutchman's Revenge
<style=""InfoText"">A black cat steers a ghost ship through mystifying, fog-laden waters. Let's see how she achieves her goal— sneaking aboard the Church's vessel under cover of night to seize Future Artifacts coveted by various Factions.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Infiltration
<style=""InfoText"">• In each chapter, Dalcarlo will summon various Tarot characters to use for infiltration.
• Control character movements, use skills wisely, solve puzzles, and eliminate targets to obtain keys and open chests for rewards like Future Artifacts or enhancement materials.
• Complete all stages in a chapter to earn additional exploration rewards.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Reset
<style=""InfoText"">• You may reset stage progress anytime to retry the challenge, but rewards that have already been claimed cannot be obtained again.""

""<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Limited Stage - Heart of Darkness
<style=""InfoText""> • Clear stages in [Heart of Darkness] to obtain Gilded Insignias.
• The [Heart of Darkness] event consists of Normal and Nightmare stages.
• Nightmare stages will unlock several days after the event starts and require clearing the Normal stages.
• Event stages require consuming Prisoner's Blood. Each day upon reset, 5 free Prisoner's Blood are provided. Additional Prisoner's Blood may be purchased from the event shop, Joyce's Sundries.

• Quick Clear can be unlocked for a selection of stages upon first clear, consuming Prisoner's Blood to obtain stage rewards directly.

• Gilded Insignias can be redeemed for generous rewards.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Limited Sign-in - Confessions
<style=""InfoText""> • Log in during the event to claim bountiful rewards from Sign-in.

<style=""InfoTitle"">※ Limited Challenge - Cosmic Singularity
