3506412296.m_KeyValue: ""Besides the thrill of battles, you can also earn Mark of Bravery to redeem generous rewards.""

3506415497.m_KeyValue: "You now have the key to our warehouse."

3506415594.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, this is the residual blood we've been collecting along the way. Perhaps we can use these 'memories' to gain new Vassals.""

3506963671.m_KeyValue: ""The more I feared time, the closer it drew. So I returned to the Saint…""

3506963672.m_KeyValue: ""I'm happy for you. The road to your dream may still be long, but at least now you walk it without doubt.""

3506963673.m_KeyValue: "You told me you'd wait for me… Wait until I came home. And that's exactly what you did. You waited—always."

3506963674.m_KeyValue: "But now I know who I am. I understand the power I carry… and the mission entrusted to me."

3506963676.m_KeyValue: ""Just as you did with me, back then...?""

3506966873.m_KeyValue: ""You thought this was just a duel between Bell Ringers, but what's the truth?""

3506966874.m_KeyValue: "How is this possible? How can Silver Blood and Black Blood coexist within you..."

3506966875.m_KeyValue: ""In all fairness, I should inform you—I've seen your Covenant, Prometheus' Purgatory, and I'm afraid it won't work against us.""

3506966876.m_KeyValue: ""Unfortunately, I won't let you have your way, Agares Brennholt.""

3508273228.m_KeyValue: "Yes! The old stories spoke of you—the ancient Vassal who guarded the desert sands!"

3508273229.m_KeyValue: "You weren't even fighting at full strength? That's insane..."

3509564882.m_KeyValue: "The snow kept getting heavier... I was afraid you wouldn't make it back..."

3510234951.m_KeyValue: "Note: UID in parameters will be auto-replaced with current account UID."

3515317869.m_KeyValue: ""To gather comprehensive data, I'll need to examine everything meticulously... Let us begin there.""

3515317870.m_KeyValue: ""Someone's posted a notice on the board. You could take a look, though I doubt it'll do you much good...""

3515317871.m_KeyValue: "These nobles truly believe they can elevate themselves above all living things."

3515317872.m_KeyValue: "I hope this 'gift' I've prepared will open his eyes—even if only slightly."

3515354715.m_KeyValue: "This isn't a suggestion. It's an order."

3520080755.m_KeyValue: "Humans erect gravestones to commemorate those they lost..."

3520935208.m_KeyValue: ""For each area, you need to complete the entire journey to obtain all rewards.""

3524100212.m_KeyValue: ""I had the crew inspect the deck earlier. Regrettably, they found no trace of any unsightly 'tools.'""

3524100213.m_KeyValue: "It seems there are still a few clever ones among those who associate with the Silver-haired one."

3524100214.m_KeyValue: "No. They made three detrimental mistakes. Mistakes that immediately revealed their identity."

3524100215.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, I get it now! That's why the rope I untied was tied there!""

3524100216.m_KeyValue: ""...Hardly conclusive, Van Helsing. William isn't the only one aboard who can't tie a sailor's knot.""

3524100217.m_KeyValue: "And here I thought you were going to say something serious—but you're just shifting the blame from one person to another!"

3524100218.m_KeyValue: "I said I had no 'physical evidence'—I never said..."

3524100219.m_KeyValue: "I know nothing of any rope. All I know is that everything you've said is slander against my family—and I demand you cease this discourtesy."

3524100220.m_KeyValue: ""Jones. Unlike me, he is no stranger to guarding this ship. He must have been quite familiar with William for some time.""

3524100221.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, so you speak. You've been standing there so quietly I thought you were just another piece of furniture—like those dusty suits of armor upstairs...""

3524100245.m_KeyValue: "Captain Goldland? Did you just come from the deck?"

3524100246.m_KeyValue: "It can't be... These symptoms... they look like..."

3524100247.m_KeyValue: ""Either way, assuming the second scenario—there's one thing we can be sure of:""

3524100248.m_KeyValue: "I should go find something to eat!"

3524100500.m_KeyValue: "Ugh... The deck's Aaron's responsibility! What's he doing as Second Mate if not this?!"

3524100501.m_KeyValue: ""Spare me the pleasantries. Just make sure your services are worth the price I paid, Lady Dalcarlo of Bathory.""

3524100508.m_KeyValue: "They say only a ship swift enough to chase down the sun before it sinks below the horizon can reach that place of hidden truths—Sunset Isle."

3524100509.m_KeyValue: "You knew we would meet Hati and Clive in the Lupine Forest. You knew I would step into those forbidden grounds—because you'd lived it already."

3524100510.m_KeyValue: ""But he was only a child... swept into the vortex of history, with no way out.""

3524100511.m_KeyValue: ""Hm? Oh dear, am I intruding on something?""

3524100512.m_KeyValue: ""Unlike you, Miss Dalcarlo—I've never liked how you speak in circles.""

3524100514.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you, but… I don't really need to eat.""

3524100540.m_KeyValue: "Whether you're a stowaway or not is hardly the point anymore. The true offense… is that you made our kind and beloved First Mate cry."

3524100541.m_KeyValue: "Observation and contemplation are how I relax. Much like how you choose to stroll the deck when there's no sunlight."

3524100542.m_KeyValue: "What is with this guy... Another one of those self-important types who just loves the sound of their own voice!"

3524100543.m_KeyValue: "No… There really are voices... They're trying to tell me something..."

3524100546.m_KeyValue: ""Still so flustered and nervous. No wonder no one trusts you anymore, 'former captain' Jones.""

3524100572.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Is this some sort of stowaway convention? This voyage must be more popular than I thought!"

3524100573.m_KeyValue: "Hey! What are you using to point at Noah and Aiona?!"

3524100575.m_KeyValue: "Someone must've mixed up the manifest with the invite. Cain's not the type to make this kind of mistake..."

3524100576.m_KeyValue: "Miss Bathory and the seasick girl will remain here. I'll explain their situation myself. Jones—watch them."

3524100578.m_KeyValue: "Tch. What a bunch of clueless fools. No need to panic—this ship happens to have a Bloodborn expert aboard."

3524100579.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be ridiculous! Within the Church, only the Bell Ringers outrank the Silver Cross!""

3524100601.m_KeyValue: ""My apologies, everyone. For now, I can only offer you some wine. Though I'm afraid it won't compare to the fine vintages of the Carrelle estate...""

3524100605.m_KeyValue: ""More importantly, I heard one of our guests is feeling unwell. I've arranged a rest area near the crew quarters. Let's take her there to recover.""

3524100606.m_KeyValue: ""I'll go check on Jones's injuries... That Bathory lady is there too, isn't she? Between the two of you, she's the one who looks more like a Bloodborn to me.""

3524100607.m_KeyValue: ""In any case, both buyer and seller are old acquaintances of mine. To me, this manifest is as good as an invitation.""

3524100608.m_KeyValue: "Van Helsing's in league with these Heretics! Just wait till we get back—I'll bury him in charges!"

3524100609.m_KeyValue: ""You're really something, you know that? Always snarking about your own, but here you are praising someone else's Captain like he's a saint.""

3524100610.m_KeyValue: ""But Kris... Captain! Setting Van Helsing aside, that silver-haired one not only has no invitation—he's supposedly a Bloodborn!""

3524100611.m_KeyValue: "It's said most Silver Cross members operate alone—Rarely commanding their own forces."

3524100632.m_KeyValue: "What about that window? The one overhead—"

3524100636.m_KeyValue: ""Of all times for a storm to hit... William, take the helm. The wheel must not be left unattended.""

3524100637.m_KeyValue: "It's possible. But we need more clues and evidence..."

3524100638.m_KeyValue: "I figured he was sneaking some food and bolted when he got caught."

3524100640.m_KeyValue: ""Reporting in, Captain. I settled Mr. Jones—he's still unconscious—in the last rest cabin, then escorted the two seasick ladies to the second cabin...""

3524100641.m_KeyValue: "It felt weaker this time. Even Van Helsing barely reacted."

3524100668.m_KeyValue: ""...and after he left, it sounded like he met someone right outside the door.""

3524100670.m_KeyValue: ""No... these symptoms... If I'm right, they're showing early signs of Black Blood infection.""

3524100671.m_KeyValue: "Let's go. The mystery is about to be solved."

3524100672.m_KeyValue: ""I'm not that weak... And if there were more people, it would've been even easier to spot!""

3524100673.m_KeyValue: "I see... So Aaron was killed from outside."

3524100700.m_KeyValue: "That scared me half to death... We almost got caught!"

3524100702.m_KeyValue: "No... what did you just say they ate?"

3524100704.m_KeyValue: ""...It's Octo, the octopus the sailors caught this morning.""

3524100706.m_KeyValue: ""Snack thief...? Ah, right. Then it's agreed—no one knows we met here, okay?""

3531331928.m_KeyValue: ""I must strongly disagree. These so-called 'vassals' are manufactured from mere drops of blood, their Bloodline diluted. How can they be compared to vassals born through the proper Embrace ritual? Granting them the most basic rights should suffice.""

3531331994.m_KeyValue: ""Have you not seen the state of those old relics? They're corroded beyond recognition! Repairing them would cost a fortune! In my humble opinion, let's not waste our coin on this.""

3531332025.m_KeyValue: ""You may not know, but hundreds of years ago, the family sent vassals to retrieve these 'Future Artifacts.' They not only failed to find any trace of treasure but also wasted vast resources. This expedition will likely lead to a direct confrontation with the Church. In my opinion, we should abandon this endeavor.""

3531332060.m_KeyValue: ""Too young, too imprudent. Experimenting with alchemical formulas they barely comprehend... One misstep and they'll face the dire consequences of their own folly.""

3531332126.m_KeyValue: ""Young one, have you not read the next page? Our family history clearly states: exploring the Other Side carries high risks. In 1235, three vassals were sent aboard the 'Virgin Lady' to explore the southwestern Sea of Medimar in search of the Other Side. They were never heard from again.""

3531332157.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, wait! Those mining sites are guarded by clergy members with formidable Blood Power! Going there rashly will surely lead to direct conflict. Our limited number of vassals will be captured before we can even uncover the truth. I say we should abandon this plan!""

3531332223.m_KeyValue: ""Are you completely oblivious to the risks? Our family has been studying alchemy for ages, and we still haven't grasped its full nature.""

3531332258.m_KeyValue: ""On the contrary! It is precisely because our family's Bloodline is declining that we must ensure the purity of our vassals' lineage! In my opinion, elders should have absolute authority over newly created Bloodborn.""

3531332355.m_KeyValue: "Recreating vassals and preparing for the 'return to the moon' are all thanks to Cain's efforts. You probably have no idea how much he has contributed to reviving the Bathory family's bloodline."

3532312232.m_KeyValue: ""Heh, that's just the surface of it. As the creator of the forbidden resurrection ritual, let me tell you the real reason...""

3532312233.m_KeyValue: ""I am one who values his privacy. But rest assured, I am also one who rewards generously in return.""

3539136709.m_KeyValue: "Be sure to come and enhance your equipment often. You can obtain equipment and enhancement items through Nightfall."

3539139844.m_KeyValue: ""The air's full of that mouthwatering scent... Must be Clammond, Krillon, and Squiddrick, freshly grilled.""

3539139910.m_KeyValue: "If you still have the appetite for it... I believe it's time I introduced a few old friends."

3539139911.m_KeyValue: ""The three former Elders did not enter slumber all at once. Once we awaken Elder Sirene and one other, the 'legend' shall return to this world.""

3539139941.m_KeyValue: ""Memory Fragments unlocked: <style=""Highlight"">[Eleven Years Ago – Ninth Hour]</style>, <style=""Highlight"">[Eleven Years Ago – Sunset Hour]</style>, <style=""Highlight"">[Eleven Years Ago – Tenth Hour]</style>. Tap to view.""

3539140007.m_KeyValue: ""Isle Coins and Moon Tears... If I can win those, I'll be one step closer to paying off my debt!""

3540319987.m_KeyValue: "You don't understand—the Tidewisp is a flower of friendship and love. Legend says it glows like fireflies for those with the most sincere hearts."

3540319988.m_KeyValue: "They say a Tidewisp bloomed when Lord Hallon mourned his late wife."

3540319990.m_KeyValue: "More impressive in sound than sight. It's just an ordinary flower petal!"

3541138184.m_KeyValue: "Enhancements will increase the attributes of the skills."

3541547569.m_KeyValue: "I thought you and Agares... are our allies."

3541547570.m_KeyValue: ""Come with me. If I had my way, I would never raise a hand against the Empress's child.""

3541547571.m_KeyValue: "But doesn't that make this stinking bat your lady as well? Why would you still fight us?"

3541547572.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Dalcarlo—are there others with you? Weren't you waiting for us here, in the sealed area?""

3541548590.m_KeyValue: ""Plague, Famine, Death, and I—War. The Four Moonblessed, vessels of the Calamities, have at last come together.""

3541548591.m_KeyValue: "So this is... the true path that leads deeper?"

3541548592.m_KeyValue: ""If I didn't die, then why am I inside a memory? Could it be...""

3541548593.m_KeyValue: "Did you learn where the Long night lies? Where is he taking Empousa to for the ritual?!"

3541548594.m_KeyValue: ""They are both human and beast. They remain themselves, have always been themselves—and they are you. Because they believed in that truth.""

3541548595.m_KeyValue: ""...No, never mind. You only echo my truth, making assumptions, offering clever responses—but you don't believe. Not yet.""

3541548596.m_KeyValue: "So it was all already in motion from here?"

3541548597.m_KeyValue: ""I didn't expect you, of all people, to suggest that my own will forged my identity, others, and even this world.""

3542274842.m_KeyValue: "What exactly is this _$$Bloodsoul_$$ power you just mentioned...?"

3542839225.m_KeyValue: ""Many bask in the light as if it were eternal, forgetting that only shadow endures through every turn of day and night.""

3542839226.m_KeyValue: ""You said you read this in her scripture, but it was really her diary. I keep one too!""

3542839227.m_KeyValue: ""I think I've heard it before. It doesn't sound as dry and complicated when I say it, huh?""

3542839228.m_KeyValue: "They appear to depict pilgrims gazing at the sea... the sky... and time?"

3542840245.m_KeyValue: ""So even you have something to fear. If I die here, you won't be able to resurrect Mother in her complete form!""

3542840248.m_KeyValue: ""Because I truly believed... if I became the 'sacrifice', if I became the vessel—then Lamia would live.""

3542840249.m_KeyValue: "I won't let you hurt Empousa. I won't let you sacrifice Lamia. And I definitely won't let you awaken the Long Night."

3542840250.m_KeyValue: "You still so fond of arguing. Let's see…"

3542840251.m_KeyValue: ""What a shame. You who command water didn't come in person, and instead sent a greenhorn in your place.""

3545613501.m_KeyValue: ""After the Long Night, when the Scourges awaken—this world will become a hell of pure darkness, though it's already...""

3546925222.m_KeyValue: ""If there's a chance, I'll show you around Bathory Castle.""

3547089317.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps we should dispatch a fleet to investigate. What are your thoughts on this matter?"

3555309493.m_KeyValue: ""I know. But to stand against the Church, even if it means becoming what I once hated, is my choice.""

3555309494.m_KeyValue: "Agares has succeeded. As expected of the one who mastered both Silver Blood and Black Blood to their limits."

3555309495.m_KeyValue: "Because I've found a way. A way for both you and this world to be free. By shattering this false world imprisoned by time."

3555309496.m_KeyValue: "The Calamity is our ancestral truth. Chaos is the natural state of the universe."

3555309497.m_KeyValue: ""You can hear it, can't you? The heartbeat that proves I'm still here.""

3555309498.m_KeyValue: "You'll always be my Commander. And that's exactly why I need to know... Why won't you tell me what you're trying to do?"

3557249932.m_KeyValue: "His research into the Landis family artifacts far surpassed even the Church’s own records."

3557249933.m_KeyValue: "Goldland truly was an exceptional Captain. A devoted brother—and an adventurer worthy of every accolade."

3557249940.m_KeyValue: ""December – The crew could no longer endure the bitter cold, and we were forced to suspend the salvage operation.""

3557249942.m_KeyValue: ""But William never left the ship. He shut himself away in the alchemy lab, day after day.""

3557249943.m_KeyValue: ""We sailed south, toward warmer harbors, to escape the winter chill. It was an opportunity to grant leave to the crew who had followed me tirelessly for the past year.""

3557249944.m_KeyValue: ""Everyone on board tried to lift his spirits, but to no avail.""

3557249945.m_KeyValue: ""The more we uncovered about the Landis family, the more reclusive he became.""

3557249946.m_KeyValue: ""When the time comes, I must find a way to understand what’s weighing on him. After all, no matter what happens—he is my only brother.""

3557249947.m_KeyValue: ""I worried for him, but every time I tried to speak from concern, it came out sounding like reproach.""

3557250956.m_KeyValue: ""The fish whispered to me that this was the Pillars of Hercules—a wondrous island beneath the Sea of Medimar, home of the Landis family for generations.""

3557250957.m_KeyValue: ""If the Landis family had not been devoured by sea monsters, as the rumors claimed, but instead migrated into the depths...""

3557250965.m_KeyValue: ""April – Following an encounter with pirates, we carried out repairs on the El Dorado.""

3557250966.m_KeyValue: ""On the eve of our departure, I found myself reflecting on the life I led before ever setting foot aboard this ship.""

3557250967.m_KeyValue: ""Back then, William and I were dockworkers—living from meal to meal, never daring to speak of our dreams of the sea.""

3557250969.m_KeyValue: ""On a storm-ravaged night, I recovered an ocean-blue sapphire from the body of a nobleman lost to the waves.""

3557250970.m_KeyValue: ""I had meant to sell it, to change our lives. But that night, I dreamed. In the dream, the sapphire came from a hidden underwater kingdom.""

3557250971.m_KeyValue: ""I was no longer myself, but a spirit gliding freely through the sea—untethered and unburdened.""

3557252110.m_KeyValue: ""It must be Famine's followers. After their resurrection, they went rampaging through the ship—even the sconces weren't spared.""

3557252111.m_KeyValue: "Why is it pitch black on the way to the Captain's quarters?!"

3557252116.m_KeyValue: ""For nine long years, our salvage operations made no breakthrough. Meanwhile, our maritime trade flourished, drawing the attention of the Church.""

3557252117.m_KeyValue: ""We discovered Ami in these waters, which is why I remain convinced their ruins must lie somewhere nearby.""

3557252118.m_KeyValue: ""March – It has been twelve years since we found Ami. In all that time, we've uncovered no meaningful leads regarding the Landis family.""

3557252120.m_KeyValue: "It seems the path before us remains shrouded in darkness..."

3557252121.m_KeyValue: ""Yet in the end, beyond confirming that the jewel in my earring may be linked to that Divine Body, we uncovered nothing of substance.""

3557252122.m_KeyValue: ""They required my ship's aid in retrieving what they call 'Future Artifacts,' and in return, they agreed to share historical records on the Landis family and the Divine Body they have guarded for generations.""

3557252123.m_KeyValue: ""On the advice of Bob—once a Church officer, now my First Mate—I did not resist their inspection. In fact, I accepted their terms.""

3557253134.m_KeyValue: "The demon I saw was likely Famine. One of the most terrifying Calamities ever classified by the Church."

3557253135.m_KeyValue: ""And only the Divine Bodies, protected across the continent by the twelve families, can hold their ground against such apocalyptic threats.""

3557253140.m_KeyValue: ""Of course, I never intended to sit back and await my death. While I continued to search for traces of the Landis ruins in the open, in secret, I began searching for a man.""

3557253141.m_KeyValue: ""Cain Lamboza. In the underground world, they whisper that his mastery of alchemy rivals that of Albrecht, the Bell Ringer. But more importantly...""

3557253143.m_KeyValue: ""October – For half a year now, I've lived with the knowledge that the demon could awaken any moment, and it was my own brother who stirred it from its sleep.""

3557253144.m_KeyValue: ""But unexpectedly, he showed greater interest in Ami.""

3557253145.m_KeyValue: ""After I told him what little I knew about her, he gave me vital information without asking for another thing in return:""

3557253146.m_KeyValue: "He's also an expert on Black Blood. Far beyond William in both knowledge and danger. He became my only hope against the nightmare that stalked my thoughts."

3557253147.m_KeyValue: "I was prepared to offer both of the Divine Body jewels in exchange for a way to seal the demon."

3557253239.m_KeyValue: ""At this rate, I'll never catch up... Looks like I'll have to fly there in my beast form!""

3557254288.m_KeyValue: ""But when I finally turned around, I saw how far we'd drifted. I hadn't protected him at all. I'd only been trying to protect my idea of him.""

3557254289.m_KeyValue: ""Just like with William, back then. I thought I was protecting him—shielding him behind me while chasing down my own obsessions.""

3557254292.m_KeyValue: ""As always, she didn't ask a thing. But for once, I asked her something. Would she like to go ashore… to simply walk around?""

3557254293.m_KeyValue: ""When no one was around, I asked Ami to join me at the helm to plot our course—just like we used to.""

3557254294.m_KeyValue: ""At first, I kept her close under protection—a key to unlocking the mystery of the Landis legacy. And now… under surveillance, for she is one of the jewel holders.""

3557254295.m_KeyValue: ""It struck me that ever since we found her, I had never once let her step off this ship.""

3557254296.m_KeyValue: ""March – Time moves faster than I'd like. By this time next year, Ami will be twenty.""

3557254298.m_KeyValue: "A place absent from every known nautical chart: Sunset Isle."

3557254299.m_KeyValue: ""After coming up empty in the Ganelon and Bathory Territories, it took us half a year more to locate the next possible site where a Divine Body might be sealed.""

3557255313.m_KeyValue: ""The first went to the Silver Cross, where Bob once served. I couldn't rely on Jones for this voyage—I needed someone impartial. Someone new.""

3557255316.m_KeyValue: ""And when we pass through that storm—even if something happens to me, even if the ship is lost—we will reach Sunset Isle.""

3557255317.m_KeyValue: "Because I must face it. I must face the final consequences of the choices I made. And I must face William—truly face him."

3557255318.m_KeyValue: "I've played out countless versions of that confrontation in my mind. But there is only one ending. Because I know him too well."

3557255319.m_KeyValue: ""Even so, though the destination cannot be changed, and though the ending is already written. I still feel unease.""

3557255321.m_KeyValue: "December 1353 – I finally found Sunset Isle. But it was no ordinary island. It was a resting place of memories."

3557255322.m_KeyValue: "I had a premonition: this was no place mortals were meant to tread. Another followed—it told me this was a voyage I should abandon entirely."

3557255323.m_KeyValue: ""And yet, I set the course anyway, using the two jewels. When placed on opposite sides of the helm, they pull toward one another—and the storm will come.""

3557256466.m_KeyValue: ""I believe you. You're Landis's Ancestor. After all, we both love to eat.""

3557256467.m_KeyValue: ""It's alright if you can't believe it yet. Here, you'll have all the time in the world to understand...""

3557256468.m_KeyValue: "So I'm... of Landis. And you're... an Ancestor?"

3557256469.m_KeyValue: "I am the first of the Landis line. Ranna Landis."

3557256470.m_KeyValue: ""Yes. As long as you're here, you'll remember everything. All that the Landis people saw, heard, and felt lives on within my memories.""

3557256471.m_KeyValue: "You're... the enemy who fought Hati. The one who devoured everyone. The one who's been hiding on our ship from the very start. But... you're also..."

3557256472.m_KeyValue: "This is our shared homeland. The place that's been waiting for your return."

3557256473.m_KeyValue: "But the Captain said we don't feel hunger in dreams... So where am I...?"

3557256500.m_KeyValue: "There's no time to worry about anyone else!"

3557256501.m_KeyValue: "Empousa… You must survive. We all must survive."

3557256502.m_KeyValue: "Where's Ami? What's going to happen to her?!"

3557256503.m_KeyValue: "Wait—where's Noah?! I don't see him anywhere!"

3557256504.m_KeyValue: "What… How does she still have this much power!?"

3557256505.m_KeyValue: ""Anyone who can fly or shift forms, leave now! Everyone else, get ready to jump. The sea might be our only hope!""

3557256506.m_KeyValue: "Did you defeat Ranna? She looked... different."

3557256507.m_KeyValue: "This pressure… it's not just bloodlust. She's trying to take us all down with her."

3560663970.m_KeyValue: "Didn't you promise to take me to the moon?"

3560664071.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps it's a sign that we're on the right path."

3560664168.m_KeyValue: "I won't let these wandering spirits lay a single finger on her!"

3560664203.m_KeyValue: "Are these bats also considered Blood Beasts?"

3560664269.m_KeyValue: "I always thought you and Cain were a good match."

3560664300.m_KeyValue: "That's a shared dream between Lady Empousa and me."

3566159410.m_KeyValue: ""The only certainty is that if we don't act, everything from the past will be forever forgotten.""

3566159411.m_KeyValue: ""I am the vessel of these eyes, a puppet of fate...""

3566159418.m_KeyValue: ""Though the Church is full of shady individuals, we can't pin everything on them...""

3566159419.m_KeyValue: ""One day, the dust will accumulate into deserts, and the deserts will support oceans.""

3566159420.m_KeyValue: "It's as if time and space no longer exist."

3566159421.m_KeyValue: "I can't imagine how you've managed to travel with these two bickering companions..."

3566159422.m_KeyValue: "Ugh... then I'll lend a hand! Ganelon's claws aren't just for show!"

3566159425.m_KeyValue: "I'm just as strong as any Bloodborn! I'm a wolf—"

3566159450.m_KeyValue: "Because the Church has opened new timelines..."

3566159451.m_KeyValue: ""And we, at last, can find release...""

3566159454.m_KeyValue: ""You failed to save me in Starfall Valley, and now you won't stay with me either?""

3566159484.m_KeyValue: "All for the hope of a single timeline... Is this what you wanted?"

3566159488.m_KeyValue:
""Listen! Hear the boulder rolling, from foot to peak, back and forth;
Look! See his sweat fall, year after year, in ceaseless toil;""

3566159517.m_KeyValue: "Everything will go as planned. I'll be back soon."

3567608848.m_KeyValue: ""Cain may be difficult, but he never lies. So there must be something she accomplished that you haven't yet.""

3569281030.m_KeyValue: "Resetting the level will revert the Vassal to LV. 1."

3571154379.m_KeyValue: ""Oh! I knew there had to be another possibility, right, Mr. Van Helsing?""

3571154380.m_KeyValue: "I knew he was suspicious! He was probably just putting on an act to frame me!"

3571154381.m_KeyValue: "Van Helsing... You even investigated the pulleys installed on my ship?"

3571154382.m_KeyValue: ""Little Van Helsing, could you explain that in simpler terms? I'm not quite following.""

3571154383.m_KeyValue: ""Exactly. The unexpected jam caused a violent shake, immediately drawing our attention to the crew quarters.""

3571154384.m_KeyValue: ""Right, lifeless eyes! The culprit must be that... that... that person who was at the helm!""

3571154385.m_KeyValue: ""In that case, I declare this matter closed. Given your service in protecting the El Dorado, I'll spare you the need to apologize to William and myself...""

3571154387.m_KeyValue: ""Allow me to interrupt your self-admiration, Van Helsing. You said William had an accomplice...""

3571154388.m_KeyValue: ""It's easy to deduce. In William's plan, he merely placed a noose in the guest cabin...""

3571154411.m_KeyValue: "Do you even hear yourself? How can you say that without the slightest shame..."

3571154412.m_KeyValue: "What else would he do? Spend the night here? I assume he went back to the helm."

3571154413.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, what's with this wind out here!?""

3571154414.m_KeyValue: "Then how did they end up like this?!"

3571154415.m_KeyValue: "What's this? A hat? Since when does a storm rain down hats?"

3571154668.m_KeyValue: ""We've informed First Mate Bob, but he's dealing with another pair of stowaways he found elsewhere!""

3571154677.m_KeyValue: ""The past... Aiona, your words echo the Tempus Church's doctrine of fate.""

3571154678.m_KeyValue: ""He believes in Hati, who's stronger than most would ever understand. And he believes in us—the ones who once fought at his side.""

3571154679.m_KeyValue: "Pity. I was hoping to have something new to whisper about on the ship."

3571154680.m_KeyValue: ""Would you mind, dear? May I offer you a reading? I sense a rather curious 'Devil' slumbering within your 'World'...""

3571154681.m_KeyValue: ""As for you, little Ami—no need to show me the way. I'll find Goldland on my own.""

3571154707.m_KeyValue: "W-What did you just say?! I'm the First Mate of the El Dorado! A stowaway calling me strange?!"

3571154708.m_KeyValue: "The Ganelon family was forced to migrate north years ago due to 'climate' issues. The few who remained in their ancestral home—the Lupine Forest—recently perished from the Plague."

3571154710.m_KeyValue: ""You are about to be sick! Unbelievable... That's it—whether you like it or not, I'm taking you back to the guest cabin!""

3571154713.m_KeyValue: "Yes. This sharp-tongued stowaway may very well be—"

3571154714.m_KeyValue: ""No! We can't end it like this! There are still adventures to brave, and dreams waiting for us across the waves!""

3571154739.m_KeyValue: ""William, are you sure about this? Shouldn't we detain them?""

3571154740.m_KeyValue: ""…Whoa. These two handsome guys—what an aura! It's like they're sizing each other up for a duel, totally ignoring the rest of us.""

3571154741.m_KeyValue: ""Old man Baphomet is gone… and with him, any hope of collecting what he owed us.""

3571154742.m_KeyValue: "Sunset Isle? Did we sell that? Who'd we sell it to? How much did we make?"

3571154744.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, just going on and on about how mighty the Silver Cross is. Apparently, they're second only to us Bell Ringers in the Church.""

3571154746.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, what exactly is this 'Silver Cross' they keep going on about?""

3571154767.m_KeyValue: "Wh-What's happening?! Has the storm come early?"

3571154768.m_KeyValue: "After the two recent stowaway disturbances... Ami—since she's not part of the combat detail—was sent to the kitchen."

3571154771.m_KeyValue: ""He flew backward with just a light punch... It's not my fault... Ugh, I'm not feeling so good...""

3571154773.m_KeyValue: "Aren't you going to arrest me? Carry out that trial you mentioned?"

3571154774.m_KeyValue: "It seems someone mixed up the invitation I sent to Mr. Cain with his manifest. You must be the representatives I invited on his behalf."

3571154775.m_KeyValue: ""Don't tell me this is one of those cliché plots where you and your pals have been scheming for ages, and then lifeless eyes swoops in and ruins everything?""

3571154776.m_KeyValue: "Now that you mention it… it does look a lot like what you're wearing. So this is the Church's style?"

3571154777.m_KeyValue: "And I suspect your identity goes far beyond the simple label of 'Bloodborn.' Those crimson eyes of yours hide secrets yet unseen. I will uncover them all."

3571154799.m_KeyValue: "Then what was it supposed to mean?"

3571154800.m_KeyValue: ""No. The storage room is mainly used for fresh supplies—it's built like a cold room. Completely sealed, except for the staircase leading to the kitchen.""

3571154803.m_KeyValue: "Startled? What could possibly frighten someone like Ami?"

3571154805.m_KeyValue: "I remember. We met just before the last bell rang."

3571154806.m_KeyValue: "But that was before the bell rang. If no one's seen him since..."

3571154807.m_KeyValue: "There’s a knot at the end of the rope. Someone tied it deliberately."

3571154808.m_KeyValue: ""You are bad, little Van Helsing! Making me sound like some giant brute!""

3571154809.m_KeyValue: "And why did you take so long to get here? A proper helmsman should respond instantly to emergencies!"

3571154810.m_KeyValue: "That scream... It came from behind the wall."

3571154835.m_KeyValue: "That's right. ...But didn't Aaron ever tell you anything?"

3571154836.m_KeyValue: "I'm not being reckless. I just trust my own strength."

3571154838.m_KeyValue: ""Oh my, was it when I got caught snacking?""

3571154841.m_KeyValue: "Same as the painting... We need something that weighs closer to a normal adult."

3571154842.m_KeyValue: ""What!? Little Van Helsing, are you saying you killed someone this time?""

3571154867.m_KeyValue: ""It might not have taken effect yet... If worse comes to worst, she’ll have to drink my blood, just like Clive did...""

3571154869.m_KeyValue: "Then why are you looking for Aaron's killer if you've killed even more people?"

3571154870.m_KeyValue: "Ami! When you saw Aaron—what exactly was he doing? And what did he drop?!"

3571154871.m_KeyValue: ""That dutiful sailor mentioned Jones left briefly... Either someone snuck down during that time, or Jones himself—""

3571154872.m_KeyValue: "Hm? Was that my imagination... Did that barrel just move? Could what Aaron dropped be... something alive?"

3573722052.m_KeyValue: ""If you're a commoner who rose up in defiance, then I am Ottavia—a Bloodborn Hunter who slays her own kind for Soli.""

3573722053.m_KeyValue: ""I appreciate the help, but let's not pretend we're friends.""

3573722055.m_KeyValue: "He disappeared some time ago. No one knows where he went."

3574311535.m_KeyValue: "Chooses the lineup with the highest bonus from the current Imbued Vassals."

3578078806.m_KeyValue: "Being immortal alone is rather dull. Wouldn't it be interesting to create another immortal being?"

3578078807.m_KeyValue: "Are you seeking immortality too? You don't seem like someone who'd need it."

3578078813.m_KeyValue: "And you can keep my alchemy notes too."

3578078814.m_KeyValue: ""With Bathory blood in your veins, you should be able to recreate that original taste better. This will be the last favor - I promise to share a bottle with you when we open the cellar next year.""

3578078815.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be angry. I'm actually trying to recreate the Bloodborn Covenant, but the taste isn't quite right yet. Surely you wouldn't mind helping me once more with a small blood donation?""

3578078816.m_KeyValue: ""Hah, indeed not. But you should know, I began studying Alchemy because of the legendary elixir of life.""

3578078817.m_KeyValue: "You're not the type to give up after failure."

3578078818.m_KeyValue: ""Because my experiments weren't successful, and I didn't continue them.""

3578078819.m_KeyValue: "But your alchemy notes seem to be missing the final results?"

3578087404.m_KeyValue: ""_$$I'll deliberately leave an opening, and you'll seize that chance to strike me down._$$""

3578087405.m_KeyValue: ""Yet here you are, talking about it so casually?""

3578087409.m_KeyValue: "Stand still if you don't want to get shot."

3578997575.m_KeyValue: ""By the way, Noah, I don't know if you've noticed but everything has a _$$Type._$$""

3578997577.m_KeyValue: "I am an _$$Intellect_$$ Type and will dominate _$$Agility_$$ Type enemies. Watch me take them out in one strike!"

3578997578.m_KeyValue: "There is a counter system based on _$$Types._$$ Attacking enemies with the right Type will deal more DMG while attacking enemies with the wrong Type will deal less DMG."

3579366399.m_KeyValue: ""Why should I search for these ""Moonblessed"" when I don't even know where they are?""

3579366400.m_KeyValue: ""The Moonblessed possess the primordial power of the Black Blood, and moreover, they are the key to 'returning to the moon.'""

3579366434.m_KeyValue: ""What's all this? Cain's always so mysterious, yet here he is getting all chummy with you and talking up a storm!""

3580361613.m_KeyValue: ""Just like how you have Tris, Acappella… and me.""

3580361615.m_KeyValue: "Sorrow is my source of strength. My reason to fight."

3580361616.m_KeyValue: "But it was that sorrow that helped me endure it. I lost many emotions that day—but I gained strength."

3586194077.m_KeyValue: ""To rouse a soul long sealed in slumber, one requires a singular reagent—the _$$Mead of Rebirth._$$""

3586742247.m_KeyValue: "Strange. I feel like I know you..."

3586742248.m_KeyValue: ""Ironic, isn't it? You, named for Death itself… Choosing to protect life.""

3586742249.m_KeyValue: ""No. Lady Limine was the last to inherit Dracula's power. Among the Scourges, she embodies Long Night.""

3586742252.m_KeyValue: "That is why the Church named him so. The truth in the title Son of the Demon… lies in that defiance."

3586742253.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of rhythm, why not let your glowing cards show us where to go next?""

3586742256.m_KeyValue: "The next time we meet... it'll likely be with blades drawn."

3586745456.m_KeyValue: ""By her attire, she must be an accomplice of the one who killed Sir Gadric!""

3586942217.m_KeyValue: ""What are you waiting for? I've hunted your kind, so kill me and get it over with.""

3586942219.m_KeyValue: ""We need to get out of here! Conventional weapons are useless against those <style=""Highlight"">who have been turned by Black Blood</style>. It will only hasten their transformation.""

3586943240.m_KeyValue: ""As the body decays, they seek to fuse with other flesh. This symptom is undeniably...""

3587482531.m_KeyValue: "More lords will be unlocked as you progress in your exploration."

3587943746.m_KeyValue: "So you do know me. You were there—when my father died."

3587943747.m_KeyValue: ""Before I arrived, I looked into the Seven Sages—one of them bears that name. But I don't remember ever having a sister called Lorelei.""

3587943748.m_KeyValue: ""We don't know... none of us do. My grandmother, my aunt… they all succumbed to the same affliction.""

3587943749.m_KeyValue: "No wonder Master Albrecht said I was barely alive when he found me."

3587943750.m_KeyValue: ""We argued, and… I dropped your reagent vial. He was exposed to it.""

3587943752.m_KeyValue: "Then allow me… to change the terms of our deal."

3587943777.m_KeyValue: ""Her kin... I know, they were the sirens.""

3587943778.m_KeyValue: ""She will wait for me at the promised place, and we will meet again.""

3587943779.m_KeyValue: ""Lorelei, our 'ship' has changed, and so has Sapphire Isle...""

3587943780.m_KeyValue: ""Haven't you heard? Isaac, the man Lord Hallon was after, escaped prison yesterday… then he was caught again!""

3587943781.m_KeyValue: ""Miss Bella mentioned there are more torture devices on the ship now, and with all these guards... Could the meeting place have been turned into the prison where the Sages keep their criminals and slaves?""

3587943782.m_KeyValue: "It really is you... What brought you here?"

3587943783.m_KeyValue: "You're after Hallon too? I wonder… does it have anything to do with him being a Van Helsing as well?"

3587943784.m_KeyValue: "Miss Ami is wanted by Lord Hallon... so Miss Ami is Lord Hallon's enemy... And Lord Hallon is Lord Isaac's enemy... which means Miss Ami is the enemy's enemy..."

3587943785.m_KeyValue: "Constantine must have told you about what happened back then."

3587943786.m_KeyValue: ""Let me see her once, then I'll submit to whatever fate you choose for me.""

3587944033.m_KeyValue: ""What a shame. Since the show didn't finish, little Bella's only entitled to one-tenth of the promised payment...""

3587944042.m_KeyValue: ""I told you—we have a contract! You promised, clear as day, to play the role of Ginokio!""

3587944044.m_KeyValue: "Could it be... he wished to find Sir Robin von Quinn?"

3587944045.m_KeyValue: "But tell me—who can teach one such a wondrous thing as love?"

3587944073.m_KeyValue: ""If you remember making that promise, then no excuses. You follow it through to the end.""

3587944076.m_KeyValue: "This sounds like a job for the kind and almighty me!"

3587944077.m_KeyValue: ""But we need to act quickly. The longer we delay, the clearer our trail becomes.""

3587944105.m_KeyValue: "Was that a servant... attempting to lecture me—on etiquette?"

3587944107.m_KeyValue: ""That Ami, still can't be fully trusted.""

3587944111.m_KeyValue: "Why did I take her? Why did I harm her..."

3587944112.m_KeyValue: "I must've been mistaken. But what did Miss Bella do... that stirred memories from his original body?"

3587944141.m_KeyValue: "Father's definitely throwing some boring banquet for my birthday..."

3587944142.m_KeyValue: "No wonder it's a symbol of the Sapphire Isle Seven Sages. Such a mysterious and powerful thing!"

3587944169.m_KeyValue: ""Shall we search the area for suspicious individuals, Lady Alexis?""

3587944172.m_KeyValue: "What?! You're giving that one to him as well?!"

3587944173.m_KeyValue: ""Such resilient will, such unshakable spirit, such a flawless physique—""

3587944174.m_KeyValue: ""I didn't ask, and yet here you are, telling me anyway.""

3587944175.m_KeyValue: "Joyce doesn't know what the Master wants. But Joyce? Joyce wants freedom! Joyce wants fairness!"

3587944176.m_KeyValue: "That would be... troublesome. Answer one question for me and I might consider working with you."

3587944201.m_KeyValue: "I see... Then why did you hide the wanted poster?"

3587944202.m_KeyValue: "If we're talking about who looks suspicious... It's definitely you."

3587944203.m_KeyValue: "You've never heard about the Mistbound Terror? It's today's biggest headline!"

3587944205.m_KeyValue: "Let me reclaim my youth with my son's body."

3587944206.m_KeyValue: "Are you... planning to turn your back?"

3587944208.m_KeyValue: "The newly appointed Sage of Sapphire Isle—the one they all looked up to—has just ordered..."

3587944234.m_KeyValue: "It feels as if... as if we were once 'friends'. No... something deeper—'family'."

3587944235.m_KeyValue: "Then I shall stand guard at the door—to protect Lord Isaac!"

3587944236.m_KeyValue: ""'I received no notice that you've completed the experiment, nor do I know when you left. I submitted this report of my own accord in hopes it would help track your experiment's progress.'""

3587944237.m_KeyValue: "And most of all... Do I still have a chance to fulfill that promise...?"

3587944238.m_KeyValue: "Take the worn door on the right."

3587944239.m_KeyValue: "My friend was shipwrecked here last year. She and many others ended up stranded—and eventually settled here."

3587944240.m_KeyValue: "Paradise? Why would Sapphire Isle become a paradise? And what tsunami? What Seven Sages? Isn't Uncle Averdin still the lord of this place?"

3588033908.m_KeyValue: "Those who share the gift of consciousness… should never raise arms against one another."

3588033910.m_KeyValue: "No… We can't just leave Noah to fight them alone. I have to go back."

3588037110.m_KeyValue: ""Let's deal with these creatures first, then we can discuss everything else.""

3592308913.m_KeyValue:
