3594631536.m_KeyValue: ""But to live, to be awake, is to wear oneself down with endless labor, seeking torment in one's thoughts.""

3594631563.m_KeyValue: "All eyes on us! All hearts await! All voices rise! The flawless Sapphire Isle Eighth Sage Selection—"

3594631564.m_KeyValue: "Could this Isle be hiding an unspeakable past? A tale of love? Conspiracy? Or perhaps… a noble family feud?"

3594631566.m_KeyValue: ""Silver-haired, when do we start the plan?""

3594631567.m_KeyValue: "About the Mistbound Terror in Sapphire Isle—"

3594631568.m_KeyValue: "'Hasn’t arrived'? More like it doesn’t exist!"

3594631569.m_KeyValue: ""Since we’re selecting the Eighth Sage, moral character is naturally more important than wealth.""

3594631828.m_KeyValue: ""And what about you, good sir? Care to try my award-winning blend—Sapphire Isle Iced Tea? It won the Association's Innovation Prize!""

3594631829.m_KeyValue: "Enjoying a dream-like summer on the beach!"

3594631830.m_KeyValue: ""Alright, I get it. Loud and clear.""

3594631831.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Savich… W-We definitely struck that woman, but she looks completely unharmed!""

3594631833.m_KeyValue: "I saw your wounds heal by themselves. Consider yourself lucky I didn't report you to the Church—that's me returning the favor. Don't expect to learn anything more from me."

3594631834.m_KeyValue: ""Little Selena can go with him, you know—I just thought of a new way to pay off the debt—""

3594631859.m_KeyValue: "Did she pay you to say that? You rattled off that string of extravagant titles in the blink of an eye."

3594631860.m_KeyValue: "Ah! This handsome gentleman... this fit would be perfect for you!"

3594631862.m_KeyValue: ""To get into the summer spirit at Sapphire Isle, the first thing we need is—""

3594631863.m_KeyValue: ""If we go now, we should still be able to see the last few auction items.""

3594631864.m_KeyValue: "Congratulations on slaying the siren! Congratulations on slaying the siren!!!"

3594631865.m_KeyValue: ""It needs a name? How about 'Whack-a-Siren,' would that work?""

3594631866.m_KeyValue: "Sirens... surely they can't be Blood Beasts?"

3594631891.m_KeyValue: ""Whatever you do, do not cook! If you're that hungry, just wake Viktor up.""

3594631920.m_KeyValue: "I think... it's best not to trust her right now."

3594631923.m_KeyValue: ""These wealthy types are nothing but terrible. Well, except the ones who treat me to a free breakfast...""

3594631926.m_KeyValue: ""In my haze, I noticed a figure and followed them out of the inn and into the fog, where I saw...""

3594631928.m_KeyValue: ""I can't believe 'that thing' is actually here... I need to tell No—the silver-haired one, we need to figure something out...""

3594631929.m_KeyValue: ""Master Albrecht left them in my care, so don't you dare hurt my... my friends!""

3594631930.m_KeyValue: "Just 'iniviting' people as they please... the rich really think they can do whatever the want."

3594631955.m_KeyValue: ""Why are you not answering... Are you deaf, or mute?""

3594631956.m_KeyValue: "Monsters that sound like this... can be found hiding in the sea mist!"

3594631957.m_KeyValue: "I won't let you harm my companions..."

3594631960.m_KeyValue: "Are you trying to set some record for getting rejected by him?"

3594631962.m_KeyValue: ""Countless sleepless nights, these questions haunt a restless soul. For Isaac Van Helsing—""

3594631985.m_KeyValue: ""Walking at night... can be quite dangerous, especially in Sapphire Isle.""

3594631986.m_KeyValue: ""After seeing the victim's body last night, I left the dream.""

3594631989.m_KeyValue: "There are many skills more important than reading like assassination tracking eavesdropping and Master Van Helsing even said..."

3594631991.m_KeyValue: "Is it saying this pirate disrupted the bay's 'peace'?"

3594631992.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, Van Helsing is an 'old friend.' There's no way I wouldn’t get involved if it means gathering information to save him.""

3594631994.m_KeyValue: ""Come to pay what you owe, little Selena?""

3594632018.m_KeyValue: "Lady Empousa saved you. She never would have wanted to see you become like this."

3594632019.m_KeyValue: ""See, I knew we would be of the same mind.""

3594632020.m_KeyValue: "Things tainted by Black Blood are always ugly."

3594632023.m_KeyValue: ""It's a pleasure to meet you, Miss Ami.""

3594632024.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, these people seem to have ill intentions.""

3594632025.m_KeyValue: ""No, no, that's not right. The drawing we saw yesterday definitely didn't look like this.""

3594632026.m_KeyValue: ""Uh, as far as I know, I don't associate with strange people who wear full armor in summer.""

3606742235.m_KeyValue: ""Of course, don't you remember? The name 'Nevernight' was given to you after we found you on Sunset Isle...""

3606742236.m_KeyValue: "Wait... Ressa took me in? So I wasn't originally from this island?"

3606742237.m_KeyValue: ""Didn't you just say those inspiring words to Piera? What matters is your shared future, not your past... Your past is—!""

3606742238.m_KeyValue: "What... did you say!? I came here 66 years ago? Just who am I?!"

3606742239.m_KeyValue: ""You know, for a moment there I thought you might be a 'longing'... How embarrassing of me...""

3606742240.m_KeyValue: "So this is what it feels like to fade away... There's no pain... but I still can't help feeling attached."

3606742241.m_KeyValue: ""...If Dr. Ressa hadn't taken you in 66 years ago, I wonder what different paths our lives would have taken?""

3606742242.m_KeyValue: ""If possible, I hope you can stay by Piera's side from now on. More than me, her 'future' needs you.""

3607620167.m_KeyValue: ""Enter your <style=""Highlight"">Name</style> here. Please note the character limit.""

3608305949.m_KeyValue: "And those creatures—what are they? Those camel-like monsters?"

3608305950.m_KeyValue: "And the one who killed her was Agares. A fellow Bell Ringer."

3608305951.m_KeyValue: "Bell Ringer. Hah. She didn't break her chains—she simply traded them for prettier ones."

3608880659.m_KeyValue: "Is that why you won't respond to Hati now—to spare her from feeling guilty?"

3608880660.m_KeyValue: ""_$$The memories of the past, the home I once had, and... your very existence—these are all things I can protect!_$$""

3608880661.m_KeyValue: "He's just tired. He's gone ahead to rest in your shared home."

3608880662.m_KeyValue: ""You're not lost—you're standing at the edge of the forest, hesitating to leave this place where memories dwell and face the unknown path ahead.""

3608925579.m_KeyValue: "The Church...! No wonder I didn't like this guy."

3608927625.m_KeyValue: "I doubt it. He was heading in the wrong direction."

3609597604.m_KeyValue: "Kill Alene. Cripple Theophane. Then begin the ritual—immediately!"

3610703954.m_KeyValue: "Switch it on to receive a notice when an important letter arrives."

3613579929.m_KeyValue: "I overdid it earlier. Got a bit of a cramp..."

3613580952.m_KeyValue: ""With me here, no one can sneak up from behind.""

3616792460.m_KeyValue: ""w: Enable prefab debug mode. When enabled, closing UI will immediately destroy prefab, and UI modifications will take effect immediately""

3618140296.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps you've noticed that Cidhall, like you, was transformed into a Bloodborn through a forbidden ritual.""

3619173880.m_KeyValue: ""Baphomet... is he right up there? How dare you treat them like that, you'll pay for this—""

3619174904.m_KeyValue: ""Lend me your strength, I want to thoroughly defeat the 'Soulless' Baphomet of the Bathory clan.""

3619180909.m_KeyValue: ""Losing your decorum after a little setback, that is why you'll never match up to the Lady Empousa.""

3619180910.m_KeyValue: ""Huh? Don't you get it? No matter how special you are, or whose blood you have, a newly turned Bloodborn stands no chance against an elder.""

3619183087.m_KeyValue: ""Hold that 'Blood Soul' with care, it's the crystallization of their memories before death.""

3619183978.m_KeyValue: ""You must have guessed it, Lamia is my sister, and they are all my 'sisters' too.""

3619185001.m_KeyValue: ""The moonlight has been pouring down from the heavens all night. That gentle power was a lot like Aiona's, it healed many of my wounds.""

3619185002.m_KeyValue: ""Come to think of it, I haven't felt the agonizing intrusion of the Black Blood for quite some time now. They might just be deceiving me into rescuing you...""

3619431982.m_KeyValue: "Only by attacking the tentacles can you damage the Calamity!"

3621141428.m_KeyValue: ""Units that pass through the werewolf's Blood Trail will be inflicted with Pestilence, taking DMG equal to a percentage of their Max HP per sec, while boosting DMG dealt by {0}. This effect lasts until the end of the battle.""

3621572983.m_KeyValue: "To be honest... I'd already made peace with never getting it back."

3621572984.m_KeyValue: "Where do you think I found the final drawing?"

3621572985.m_KeyValue: "Looks like there's another story to look forward to. I wonder what kind of _$$life_$$ you'll draw on a new page."

3622067877.m_KeyValue: "People are turning into monsters just to survive..."

3622617799.m_KeyValue: "After everything you saw beside Seth... after all that... Is that still the conclusion you've reached?"

3622617800.m_KeyValue: "Cain Lamboza. Your name precedes you. Once a brilliant alchemist—until you allied with the Bathorys."

3622617801.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, welcome, honored guest. You've wandered so far—why not rest awhile at my humble tea table?""

3622617802.m_KeyValue: "Then we've no choice. We’ll each follow the path that calls to us."

3622617803.m_KeyValue: "Someone's calling me from down that corridor. I'll take the black door."

3622617806.m_KeyValue: ""They're both Bell Ringers, right? I didn't think the gap between them would be that wide.""

3622617807.m_KeyValue: "Of course he did! Would he be standing here otherwise?"

3622617808.m_KeyValue: ""No victors, no bodies. Was it a stalemate and they had to continue elsewhere?""

3622618823.m_KeyValue: "Oh? She managed to find this place?"

3622618824.m_KeyValue: ""Such recklessness, my Lady. I would rather not harm so valuable a vessel, especially one who's made it this far.""

3622618825.m_KeyValue: ""Since you insist, allow me to correct you, young lady. First...""

3622618826.m_KeyValue: ""—what follows is regret. Just like Lamia, who's about to die right before your eyes.""

3622618828.m_KeyValue: ""How terribly mistaken. It is I who am loyal to the Bathorys, who am devoted to resurrecting our Matriarch—as she rests here during the _$$Long Night_$$—in Bloodborn fashion.""

3622618829.m_KeyValue: ""Then you'll usurp the power of the Apocalypse, all for yourself... After all, you've got three of them as your pawns already, isn't that right?""

3622618830.m_KeyValue: "No... this thing about the Blood Moon... I'm afraid it's news to me."

3622618832.m_KeyValue: ""Yet it is only now that I realized this prophecy might be true, and what it all might mean...""

3623977749.m_KeyValue: "Name already taken. Please change to another one."

3625704007.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, I'm searching for a 'hero'... but all we know is that they're 'young,' and there's this old, half-forgotten ballad to guide us.""

3625704009.m_KeyValue: "A castle of blood; a realm beyond ruin..."

3625704011.m_KeyValue: ""Souls yield, their devotion marred by beast...""

3625704012.m_KeyValue: "The scent of death lures bats to feast..."

3625704013.m_KeyValue: ""When the long night fades, I shall break these walls...""

3625704014.m_KeyValue: ""O' my gargoyle, may your petals never fall...""

3625704016.m_KeyValue: "Could this be... the very castle spoken of in the old ballad…?"

3625705035.m_KeyValue: ""N-nothing! I mean… you changed your clothes, and I barely recognized you.""

3625705037.m_KeyValue: "It seems Lady Quinn's new friend is quite reserved as well."

3625705038.m_KeyValue: ""The ritual chamber is this way. Please, follow me.""

3625705039.m_KeyValue: "This way... is it leading to Father's mausoleum?"

3625705040.m_KeyValue: "W-why are there so many corpses here? The stench..."

3625713735.m_KeyValue: ""War now loomed, poised to consume the last of the land.""

3625713736.m_KeyValue: "And just as the embers of civilization threatened to vanish..."

3625713744.m_KeyValue: ""A long time ago, the Long Night shrouded the Howling Peninsula,""

3625713745.m_KeyValue: "reducing its already barren lands to a lifeless waste."

3625713746.m_KeyValue: "From the South came a chilling report—The Bathorys had pledged themselves to Dracula."

3625713747.m_KeyValue: "Blood-fed clans festered and multiplied in the shadows."

3625713748.m_KeyValue: ""In the North, the Ganelon wandered dried-up riverbeds,""

3625713749.m_KeyValue: "sustained only by the tainted nectar seeping from cavern springs."

3625713750.m_KeyValue: "A single careless crossing shattered the uneasy truce between two long-feuding families."

3625714889.m_KeyValue: ""Ugh... Don't you get it? Your refusal isn't just personal defiance, it's a stain on Elder Tertius's legacy. You shame your father every time you breathe.""

3625714890.m_KeyValue: "Spare us the sanctimony. The Bloodborn are a superior race! Feeding on humans is our birthright. But I guess a half-blood mutt like you wouldn't understand."

3625714895.m_KeyValue: "I request an audience with the Four Elders."

3625714897.m_KeyValue: ""Well, well... if it isn't 'Lady' Quinn herself. Watching you fall from grace never gets old.""

3625714899.m_KeyValue: "I just... don't want to drink human blood. Is that so wrong?"

3625714900.m_KeyValue: ""That pathetic little <style=""Highlight"">spark</style> of yours is the only reason you're still breathing. Makes you a convenient sandbag when things get rough.""

3625714901.m_KeyValue: "The family's seers named you a harbinger of ruin. Elder Tertius has never once acknowledged your existence!"

3625714902.m_KeyValue: "Ha! An audience with the Elders? Still acting like you're someone important?"

3625714921.m_KeyValue: ""...Rest assured. When the young lady officially ascends, I will petition to raise the Baphomets' standing.""

3625714922.m_KeyValue: ""No need to trouble yourself. How could we, of such lowly Baphomet blood, ever stand beside the noble Aegis line?""

3625714927.m_KeyValue: ""Elder Valora, Elder Julius—shall I refill your cups?""

3625714929.m_KeyValue: "This wine is insipid. Bring me fresh blood!"

3625714931.m_KeyValue: ""I know Ganelon's atrocities from decades past still haunt you, but—""

3625714933.m_KeyValue: "Hey! Why didn't you ask me? I've been working so hard to keep this family from tearing itself apart..."

3625714934.m_KeyValue: ""Tertius, precisely because we now hold the power of Black Blood, we mustn't act in haste.""

3625715913.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, well... I got curious when you mentioned _$$young hero._$$""

3625715914.m_KeyValue: ""Is that who you're looking for? Tell me more. You're Lady Leila's guest, and you helped me find Wolfsbane... I'd like to return the favor.""

3625715919.m_KeyValue: "No sign of the thief here. Let's check over there!"

3625715924.m_KeyValue: "Hey... why do I feel like you've been watching me this whole time?"

3625715925.m_KeyValue: "I wonder if Lyra's getting scolded by Grandfather right now..."

3625715926.m_KeyValue: ""Don’t worry, Lyra! Once I solve this cold case and find the <style=""Highlight"">young hero</style>, Grandfather has to forgive you! My achievement will be too great to ignore!""

3625717067.m_KeyValue: "I was caught red-handed by armored guards when I crossed the border to gather Wolfsbane for the village..."

3625717068.m_KeyValue: "Ganelon has claim to a tributary too... but it ran dry over a decade ago."

3625717072.m_KeyValue: ""Jamie, look! By the riverbank, and floating downstream... Those flowers... are they Wolfsbane?""

3625717073.m_KeyValue: "We're standing at the Moontide Canal. Both this bank and the other side are under Bathory's control."

3625717074.m_KeyValue: ""Since this is your first time in Mouret, I'll give you the full tour!""

3625717077.m_KeyValue: ""There are many places like this in the Lupine Forest—hidden, quiet, and beautiful. If you like it, I'll show you every one of them!""

3625717078.m_KeyValue: "So this is the village where Mother once lived... The moonlight is so bright... and the air smells of flowers and trees..."

3625718092.m_KeyValue: ""Every time something major was about to happen in town, she always sensed it early and made preparations ahead of time.""

3625718095.m_KeyValue: "I'm pointing at the direction we came from! Are you even paying attention to where we're headed?"

3625718097.m_KeyValue: ""What were you thinking about? If we don't stay focused, we'll be wandering these caves until next year and still never find Ezareth!""

3625718098.m_KeyValue: "...Lady Leila. I think she sensed this coming."

3625718100.m_KeyValue: "Strange… why is it getting darker the farther we go?"

3625718101.m_KeyValue: "Are you sure this is the right way?"

3625719245.m_KeyValue: ""Tsk... The way you came fleeing, I thought something truly grave had happened.""

3625719246.m_KeyValue: ""Sir, failing to seize him was our—no, my mistake! We've jeopardized your plans. P-please punish me as you see fit!""

3625719247.m_KeyValue: "B-but the castle's defenses were too lax and he escaped! And now we've lost our pretext for war!"

3625719248.m_KeyValue: ""Sir! The reason for this operation was to recover the boy, taken hostage by the Bathory.""

3625719249.m_KeyValue: "We can speak of that later. Ezareth's camp lies just ahead. Let's pick up the pace."

3625719250.m_KeyValue: ""Back in the Hall of the Elders, didn't they mention something called the <style=""Highlight"">Bloodletting</style> ? Could that be the cause, Quinn?""

3625719251.m_KeyValue: "Daylight growing shorter... I feel like I've read about phenomena like this before... Maybe in ancient records?"

3625719252.m_KeyValue: ""Daylight's been growing shorter these past few years. Dawn comes later, the trees wither, and even the riverbeds have begun to dry up... None of it is natural.""

3625719253.m_KeyValue: ""Strange... it should be dawn by now. We've walked so far, but the sky still hasn't brightened…""

3625719277.m_KeyValue: "My forces have already crossed into Bathory lands... alongside Ganelon's beasts... Hahaha... the wheels are in motion!"

3625719278.m_KeyValue: ""You think war is won just by bringing monsters to the field? Not everyone is like you, driven by bloodlust and selfish ambition.""

3625719280.m_KeyValue: "Hahaha... You really think killing me will put an end to this?"

3625719283.m_KeyValue: "Johannes... that treacherous rat... was never innocent. While under my employ... he was double-crossing us to the Bathory. Did you know that?"

3625719286.m_KeyValue: "Where's Johannes?! That poor boy—where is he?!"

3625720270.m_KeyValue: ""'My dear daughter, by the time you read this letter, I may no longer be with you.'""

3625720271.m_KeyValue: "No... you will not leave. The battle is already upon us. Do not even think of acting alone!"

3625720272.m_KeyValue: ""It's a letter from my mother. Here, read it.""

3625720273.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Agnes, Jamie, James... I need to... return to the castle.""

3625720274.m_KeyValue: "Return to the castle...? What exactly did you read that made you decide this so suddenly?"

3625720275.m_KeyValue: ""I could catch up to you easily, but have you considered how those two invalids would feel?""

3625720276.m_KeyValue: ""An invalid? Mind your tongue, you wretched cartographer!""

3625720278.m_KeyValue: "What's the matter with you? Disappearing without a word."

3628691524.m_KeyValue: "Challenge any stage in [Dutchman's Revenge] - Hermetic Order I."

3628691526.m_KeyValue: "Upgrade a Skill of any Vassal to LV.{0}."

3628691527.m_KeyValue: "Progress to Floor {0} in Tower of Purification."

3628691535.m_KeyValue: "Progress to Floor {0} in Tower of Purification."

3632656287.m_KeyValue: "You said you wished to end conflict. Is this how you bring about peace?"

3632656318.m_KeyValue: "Dear child... all things in this world must meet their end."

3632656384.m_KeyValue: "Doom my bloodline? You think yourself worthy?"

3633996384.m_KeyValue: "But... these were the other group of soldiers sent to search the valley. How did they end up like this?"

3635531674.m_KeyValue: "An advanced detector with greater range and detailed threat analysis."

3644231045.m_KeyValue: "Clear Login Time cannot be less than 1 month"

3647229389.m_KeyValue: "Looks like you're not scoring so well in this real-world test."

3647229390.m_KeyValue: ""No oasis in sight, nor any signs of people.""

3647229392.m_KeyValue: ""We need to bring Friedrich's body... If we can just... if we can just make it out of this place, maybe we can still save him with my Revert...""

3647229421.m_KeyValue: ""No, Aiona didn't scare them off... this guy did...""

3647229422.m_KeyValue: "I learned how to use the power of my eyes. What now? How do we get out of here?"

3647229424.m_KeyValue: ""But here, you're the hope... that protects others...""

3647229688.m_KeyValue: ""No—Father's words, the pain in my eyes—it's too real. Could it be...""

3647229689.m_KeyValue: ""Father doesn't care about what I think, the elders never asked if I was willing, and even you keep going on about eyes, eyes, and more eyes...""

3647229717.m_KeyValue: "What exactly happened during the ritual... If... If only I could go back to that day..."

3647229718.m_KeyValue:
"...The tale I shall weave today is not one of ancient lore;
But of an ancient family in the far north of Minexus's vast shores;"

3647229724.m_KeyValue: "I didn't find the assassins... I can't go back yet."

3647229749.m_KeyValue: "'That place'... It must be the Alita family's forbidden grounds."

3647229752.m_KeyValue: "We're just... petty thieves looking to steal some silverware! Spare us! We'll never dare do it again!"

3647229785.m_KeyValue: "<alpha=#FF>End of where? Never heard of it... Do you know how to leave this place?"

3647229788.m_KeyValue: ""Let me return to the past once more, 'Eyes' of the Alita family—""

3647229818.m_KeyValue: "The Alita family won't be destroyed. Father won't die. None of what you said will happen. I'll stop it all! I..."

3647229819.m_KeyValue: "Don't follow me. I don't want to kill you..."

3647229852.m_KeyValue: "Today is 'predestined' to be the day of the Alita family's—"

3647229884.m_KeyValue: "Damn it… That idiot! I have to go save him!"

3650617759.m_KeyValue: "Don't talk in riddles! I've known him just as long as you have!"

3654363041.m_KeyValue: ""Well, you and the doctor have always been against involving the Church in the island's affairs. You wanted to handle things yourselves...""

3654363042.m_KeyValue: "Guess you've always been bad with directions..."

3654363043.m_KeyValue: ""Your salt seems to be working, but it doesn't look that effective.""

3654363044.m_KeyValue: ""No, these are not Death... They're phantoms of longing that it has corrupted.""

3654363046.m_KeyValue: ""The truth is, I'm not the Noah you think you know. And you... you're not the Piera I know either, right?""

3654363073.m_KeyValue: ""But before the Black Blood outbreak, very few people actually encountered them... It's not like we could ask them, 'Hey, do you know you're just a memory of someone's longing?'""

3654363075.m_KeyValue: ""No, I refuse to accept that I'm merely someone's memory of longing. But if I'm not a phantom, and neither are you, Piera, then...""

3654363076.m_KeyValue: "Looks like they're not going to let us go up without a fight."

3654363099.m_KeyValue: ""At this point, I'm powerless to alter the Inquisition's verdict against you, let alone influence whatever you intend to do next.""

3654363100.m_KeyValue: "Could it be that she... actually hates me?"

3654363106.m_KeyValue: "Does Master... suspect me as well? Was he.. disappointed?"

3654363107.m_KeyValue: ""Without following their loud racket, you'd still be lost, wandering the island.""

3654363108.m_KeyValue: "I am Piera... Piera Paracelsus... the last Gravekeeper of the Paracelsus family."

3654363109.m_KeyValue: "Dealing with Death's minions? It's nothing special."

3654363110.m_KeyValue: ""Darcias, I don't want to obliterate this entire island just yet, but I really need to vent my anger, so—""

3654363111.m_KeyValue: "Do you really think you'll come out of this unscathed? Can you escape the Church's penalty? How will you... even stay alive?"

3654363112.m_KeyValue: "...did you come straight back to Sunset Isle?! It lines up perfectly with our observation of Death's movements..."

3654363131.m_KeyValue: ""Four noisy people... I wonder, am I included in that count?""

3654363132.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella! I don't expect you to come help us, but could you at least tell us how to beat these minions?""

3654363137.m_KeyValue: ""I recall, but what does it have to do with Noah?""

3654363138.m_KeyValue: "What about the silver-haired guy? Why hasn't he aged? He's clearly not from the Church... so who exactly is he?"

3654363139.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, are you saying this is my fault? I made sure to evacuate all the survivors from the deck to the other side of the island!""

3654363142.m_KeyValue: ""What the hell are these things?! They're not ghosts, they're not Blood Beasts—they won't die, and more keep showing up!""

3654363144.m_KeyValue: "Did you forget that I'm the 10th Bell Ringer and commander of The Choir?"

3654363166.m_KeyValue: "I can face this alone... I already made up my mind long ago... If only I hadn't met him and the others today..."

3654363169.m_KeyValue: "How... How is this possible... The Gravekeepers... my ancestors became pawns of Death?"

3654363173.m_KeyValue: "You're also right about not being able to see the longing of people who don't exist in your memories."

3654363174.m_KeyValue: ""—A prison called 'divinity,' wrought from an insatiable obsession with 'immortality.'""

3654363197.m_KeyValue: "Because the salt stakes in the coffin were originally researched by Albrecht and I."

3654363198.m_KeyValue: ""No, Grandmother... it's not like that... you've misunderstood him...""

3654363201.m_KeyValue: ""Noah is right, from the moment we're born, death is inevitable. No matter how we struggle, we cannot change this.""

3654363202.m_KeyValue: ""Though I don't know why, the Church has always wanted the Divine Body to be watched by different families, so I gave up my duty as Gravekeeper...""

3654363203.m_KeyValue: "Is Death in there? Has he returned...? Is he... awakening?"

3654363204.m_KeyValue: "Please don't worry about me... I want to be... the Piera that can fight by your side!"

3654363205.m_KeyValue: ""My noble ancestors, the Gravekeepers of old... what torments did they endure over all those years...""

3654363206.m_KeyValue: "But then you came along and gave me a new curiosity for this world... and new hope for this life as Piera."

3654363237.m_KeyValue: "Don't ever say that. You're not weak. You're stronger than anyone I know."

3654363238.m_KeyValue: "I... used the salt crystals... stopped the bleeding... I can still... still hold out a bit longer..."

3655734650.m_KeyValue: "An advanced CPU with slightly different performance focus compared to Type I."

3656549367.m_KeyValue: "You know I can't just leave you to die!"

3656549369.m_KeyValue: "I told you... Something terrible is happening in Mouret..."

3656549370.m_KeyValue: "Just some... travelers who happen to be passing through."

3656549372.m_KeyValue: ""Right now, only you can clear his name. If something happened to you, Mr. Clive will be branded a traitor for life.""

3656549399.m_KeyValue: "I've always known that the Black Blood wasn't a new threat to Mouret. It actually broke out twenty years ago..."

3656549401.m_KeyValue: ""'Wolfsbane blooms in the moonlight, our promised home awaits in the sky.'""

3656549632.m_KeyValue: "When did you manage to sneak into my armor? You've got quiet the talent..."

3656549666.m_KeyValue: ""My, what a sharp tongue! But I'm no garlic head, I'm Sir Gadric!""

3656549697.m_KeyValue: ""Well, that's true... Wait, how do you know so much?""

3656549698.m_KeyValue: "Is there nothing under that helmet of yours? Why the hell would we do that?!"

3656549700.m_KeyValue: ""Until we meet again! Wait for me, Hati!""

3656549701.m_KeyValue: "This guy... Is he toying with us?!"

3656549702.m_KeyValue: "This garlic head... He's actually strong. Was he just playing us before?"

3656549728.m_KeyValue: "Don't say that! You're our friends! I won't let those knights from the Church hurt you!"

3656549729.m_KeyValue: ""—The moon guides our beliefs, grants us power, and at the same time...""

3656549731.m_KeyValue: ""While there has been a long-standing feud between the Bathorys and Ganelons, perhaps it's time we reassess our relationship.""

3656549732.m_KeyValue: "I'm afraid they're... no longer the people you once knew."

3656549733.m_KeyValue: "Are they talking about me? This is the second time I've been insulted today!"

3656549734.m_KeyValue: "This child... truly a member of the Ganelon family..."

3656549760.m_KeyValue: ""If you're heading back to Mouret, perhaps you could take us with you?""

3656549763.m_KeyValue: ""They're friends I've known since childhood, and the people who watched me grow up. They will always be that to me.""

3656549764.m_KeyValue: "Black Blood... the Black Blood Disease?! How is that possible? I thought the Church had eradicated it!"

3656549765.m_KeyValue: ""Leaving aside the two points Empousa mentioned, what puzzles me most is... why haven't you been infected by the Black Blood?""

3656549791.m_KeyValue: ""And with Father missing, bringing you here is all I can do.""

3656549797.m_KeyValue: "Just as stubborn as your ungrateful brother—"

3656549798.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be silly! You're only 15, you've got your whole life ahead of you! Here, let me help you up.""

3656549826.m_KeyValue: ""They're beautiful and strong. No matter how windy or rainy, they always bloom toward the moon.""

3656549827.m_KeyValue: "It's a white flower that grows around Mouret. They say it can suppress Black Blood. Church doctors have come to gather it before..."

3656549828.m_KeyValue: ""He said 'bring'... Perhaps it means he will be there waiting for me, for a man named Noah.""

3656549829.m_KeyValue: ""But now that I've actually met you, Noah, I remember Father's prophecy. I feel like this is what I'm meant to do!""

3656549855.m_KeyValue: "It's a mission where the Church will not tolerate any mistakes."

3656549859.m_KeyValue: ""They guard the deceased in their graves, preventing lost souls from disturbing their eternal rest...""

3656549861.m_KeyValue: ""By the way, did your father ever mention how he and I met?""

3656549862.m_KeyValue: "No... I think he just got lost. It's that simple."

3668012454.m_KeyValue: ""(Cinematic Subtitles) This time, you owe me one.""

3668013475.m_KeyValue: "The stars are our birthplace; and thus we were exiled—"

3668019745.m_KeyValue: ""Black Blood spreads from the dead. In this valley of corpses, these scavengers serve as the perfect conduit to spread the disease!""

3668627150.m_KeyValue: "But why...? They were just meaningless doodles from the past..."

3668627151.m_KeyValue: ""Because your sketches captured something real—the freedom and joy you all once shared. And even now, that still meant something… to him.""

3669272452.m_KeyValue: ""If they can revive even after death, is there no means to destroy their flesh entirely?""

3669740114.m_KeyValue: "<color=#b2452b>(Non-Ancestral)</color> Vassals not in Altar have a 0% rate."

3675937626.m_KeyValue: "An enhanced chassis with better energy conversion efficiency and more durable power supply."

3679042841.m_KeyValue: ""'Tell me, in places yet untouched by cartographers, could greater fascinations await?'""

3681987507.m_KeyValue: "These naughty little things are ruining our precious moments together."

3686774973.m_KeyValue: ""So tell me, Mr. Brennholt. Where did I go so wrong that you would claim I broke our pact?""

3686774974.m_KeyValue: "Three? You're still underestimating me. You forget—there's one more I've had to keep preoccupied..."

3686774975.m_KeyValue: ""In that tale, Cain slew Abel and fed his blood to the beasts. Even Seth feared him.""

3686774976.m_KeyValue: "Hey now... Seth never mentioned anyone quite like you."

3686774977.m_KeyValue: ""Time may be intangible, but it governs all motion, all record.""

3686774978.m_KeyValue: "They were both your students once. And now they cross blades unto death. Does that stir nothing within you?"

3686775994.m_KeyValue: ""What have you done to everyone?! Ressa, Aiona, and Empousa—""

3686775995.m_KeyValue: ""If you're going to deceive me by impersonating someone, at least choose someone I remember. How boring.""

3686775996.m_KeyValue: ""Listen... Cain failed to get Empousa this time, so he can't awaken the Long Night immediately, but he won't give up so easily...""

3686775998.m_KeyValue: ""Or would you return to this side, defeat me, stop the Long Night, and save those who remain?""

3686775999.m_KeyValue: "This is quite unlike your usual style."

3686776003.m_KeyValue: ""He's more powerful than Acappella who tormented us, and even stronger than that Inquisitor of Flame you mentioned.""

3688690600.m_KeyValue: ""I don't like this... but at this range, I'm the only one who can take her down quickly!""

3690240400.m_KeyValue: "Tributes stop once the limit has been reached. Be sure to collect them in time!"

3696195912.m_KeyValue: ""You won't let me burn, will you?""

3696195913.m_KeyValue: "You have an eternity stretching before you. Will you spend all of it hiding in the dark?"

3696195914.m_KeyValue: "This also means our stolen hours beneath night's veil are drawing to a close."

3696195915.m_KeyValue: ""If you were in my place... if your father had chosen such a dark path, what would you do?""

3696195916.m_KeyValue: "What happened between you and Elder Baphomet? What could drive a father and daughter to such a breaking point?"

3696681841.m_KeyValue: ""Of course, I came here with another purpose in mind.""

3696681843.m_KeyValue: "So you asked me here just to get your storybooks back?"

3696681844.m_KeyValue: ""I'd advise against laying a hand on me. While I harbor no ill will toward the Bloodborn, I cannot say the same for them.""

3696681845.m_KeyValue: ""Grandfather discovered I'd slipped into this era. He's concerned for my safety, so he sent fellow cartographers to watch over me.""

3696681847.m_KeyValue: "I'm fine! Just having a friendly spar with my new friend!"

3696681848.m_KeyValue: "Are you okay over there? Call for me if you need help!"

3696681855.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, you have what it takes to become a cartographer.""

3696681856.m_KeyValue: "That's your weapon... what are you planning?"

3698768458.m_KeyValue: ""However, this bottomless tower still holds many unsolved mysteries. It might be worth further exploration.""

3699213732.m_KeyValue: ""And what about you, Empousa? Will you hide behind the silver-haired to oppose me and continue living your carefree, spoiled life?""

3700536902.m_KeyValue: ""No, of course not. I'm deeply grateful for your... generous gift.""

3700536904.m_KeyValue: ""Before we start again, tell me. Why are you so desperate to win?""

3706805911.m_KeyValue: "Yes. You've seen the eternal night and frost the Bloodborn spoke of."

3706805912.m_KeyValue: "Yes. Like the heavens themselves had frozen solid—then shattered all at once."

3706805913.m_KeyValue: "You're saying... someone's directing them? From the shadows?"

3710196514.m_KeyValue: ""Ezareth has fallen, and the will of his men falters by the hour. But it's my father's forces that trouble me more—if no one steps in soon, this bloodshed will spiral far beyond...""

3711355190.m_KeyValue: "Dangerous things aren't usually left out in the open like this."

3713726289.m_KeyValue: "These are souls twisted by Father’s forbidden alchemy. Stay sharp."

3713726588.m_KeyValue: "Lady Leila and I... we've shown you nothing but kindness..."

3713726619.m_KeyValue: ""Every time you're bored, you visit me in the dungeons. Don't you have anything better to do?""

3713726654.m_KeyValue: ""Judging by your appearance, you're a Bathory.""

3713726720.m_KeyValue: "If—if you didn't hoard the Moontide Canal’s downstream and refused to share..."

3713726751.m_KeyValue: "That war was started by the Ganelons."

3716922519.m_KeyValue: "So this is the path you've chosen? Very well."

3716927768.m_KeyValue: ""Did I miscalculate, or did you think it through more thoroughly?""

3716929682.m_KeyValue: ""Within you, I glimpse the shape of peace.""

3716930703.m_KeyValue: "...I still choose to believe in you. Perhaps you can alter everything I have witnessed."

3716932881.m_KeyValue: "You're perceptive. Perhaps you'd fare well among the Cartographers."

3716933774.m_KeyValue: ""Bella: This time, I'll trust your judgment.""

3716935952.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps this problem has more than one solution."

3716940044.m_KeyValue: "Hmm... You make a good point. I suppose I can't treat you like a child anymore."

3720567838.m_KeyValue: "Someone's still waiting for me... but I... I've no strength left..."

3726082922.m_KeyValue: "It's the Ashen Garden's self-defense mechanism. The native mushrooms growing here are rejecting our presence."

3726083945.m_KeyValue: "Keep your eyes on the Enemy. Don't look away."

3728391207.m_KeyValue: "Like I need you to tell me that!"

3729252319.m_KeyValue: "Find all Clues in this chapter for more rewards."

3729351649.m_KeyValue: "Let not the urgency of present needs obscure your foresight."

3729354584.m_KeyValue: ""Don't get too cocky, you're nothing but a vassal.""

3729356762.m_KeyValue: "I can see quite a few red flags here. What do you think about it?"

3729357655.m_KeyValue: "I'm concerned that this approach might not be entirely appropriate."

3729358676.m_KeyValue: "Such naivety. Being a savior is no easy feat..."

3729359833.m_KeyValue: ""Man, I'm trying real hard to come up with a counterpoint.""

3729363925.m_KeyValue: "My objection is crystal clear: this is nothing but a pathetic farce."

3730385215.m_KeyValue: ""To be precise, it's Noah Nevernight's complete memories. All the answers you seek are there.""

3730385216.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, I still don't know who I am. Or where I should go.""

3730385217.m_KeyValue: ""The existence of the Bloodborn is, in essence, to be the 'memory.' The strong preying on the weak—that's an inevitable process for the evolution of our species.""

3730385218.m_KeyValue: "Memory—It is the key to finding your true self."

3731685057.m_KeyValue: "Were you the one who sent the bats to attack those people?"

3743250080.m_KeyValue: ""The flowers and sunlight that once stirred our hearts, the peace and companionship we cherished... none of it can reach us anymore.""

3743250081.m_KeyValue: "Maybe we can find another path. One not so dark and soaked in blood."

3743250082.m_KeyValue: ""But what terrifies me most is how far he'll go for power—he actually murdered an Elder who outranked him, trying to seize the position of family head.""

3743250083.m_KeyValue: ""When I fled the castle, I took her name to cover my tracks.""

3744364793.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'allowing vassals to use the alchemical facilities independently'?"

3744366971.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'investing certain manpower or funds to enrich the castle's book collection'?"

3744370042.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'signing a peace and merger treaty with the declining Ganelon family'?"

3751574093.m_KeyValue: "But there are more details now. The faceless figures—those worn smooth by time—they've become vivid. Almost lifelike."

3751574096.m_KeyValue: "Maybe this is my way of remembering—a way to honor those who vanished in the endless struggle."

3751574097.m_KeyValue: "The yellow sand in my memories—it's pain I've lived through. Maybe I'll never truly be free of it."

3751574098.m_KeyValue: "And when I hold the hands of those Noahs… they no longer crumble into sand beneath my touch."

3751574099.m_KeyValue: "I know what it feels like to be forgotten. It hurts."

3751574102.m_KeyValue: "But even so… that same sand paved the road that brought me here."

3753292250.m_KeyValue: "Won't you show yourself? Where have you gone... Joan?"

3754350134.m_KeyValue: ""There's no need to resist, no need to think. Just surrender your body to me...""

3754351221.m_KeyValue: ""Stupid beasts, losing their senses at the mere sight of food.""

3754351224.m_KeyValue: "Hmph... But this food can fight back."

3754353398.m_KeyValue: "I will save everyone... I will bring hope..."

3754353399.m_KeyValue: "My future is bright... I am the child blessed by the Tarot..."

3754353402.m_KeyValue: ""This time, it won't be the same... ending!""

3754353403.m_KeyValue: "So many friends... I couldn't save any of them..."

3754353404.m_KeyValue: ""I can't fall yet... I couldn't save Mother, I couldn't save Bernice...""

3756884882.m_KeyValue: "You have reached the Retax limit today!"

3758742230.m_KeyValue: ""Your story shouldn't end in this Isle. You deserve to sing freely on the sea, to sail with your kin, and one day find your homeland afar.""

3758838681.m_KeyValue: "Something extraordinary is set to take place on the Isle today..."

3758838682.m_KeyValue: ""Oh right, right! I forgot to report something to you—""

3758838683.m_KeyValue: "I'm fine. Thank you for remembering my birthday."

3758838685.m_KeyValue: ""Oh? Where do you think you're going, little one?""

3759199562.m_KeyValue: "I'll keep... rubbing... untill... Almost... done... Ah!"

3760512060.m_KeyValue: ""W-Well, it's also possible they've already escaped this cave!""

3760512061.m_KeyValue: "It's called the forbidden grounds for a reason! It's my first time here too! If Noah hadn't accidentally opened the way..."

3760512062.m_KeyValue: "That's something I couldn't make sense of until now. I believe this Ashen Garden is hiding a secret..."

3760512063.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, now I can say with certainty, I was here. Twenty years ago, in this very Ashen Garden, I met Noah for the first time. And that time, it was...""

3760512064.m_KeyValue: "Calamity? Plague? What does this calamity have to do with us?"

3760512065.m_KeyValue: "You can't talk out of this one! Just tell me how to bring them back!"

3760512092.m_KeyValue: "Know that even the Church's elite must obtain approval and form a team of at least three to enter the sealed area around a Divine Body."

3760512093.m_KeyValue: "It's possible. It seems the pieces of the puzzle are coming together..."

3760512094.m_KeyValue: "You seem to care a great deal for him. I thought you might be related or something."

3760512097.m_KeyValue: "Leave everything to me. Take this chance to escape."

3760512325.m_KeyValue: ""All things live and die, beginning from emptiness and returning to dust. Keep running, fleeing from those observers who toy with you...""

3760512356.m_KeyValue: ""That's easy for an outsider to say. But after all that's happened, I can't just walk away...""

3760512357.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps your father hasn't truly left you."

3760512358.m_KeyValue: "You can't be thinking of... That would disturb Father's rest! I can't do something so disrespectful!"

3760512359.m_KeyValue: "They went inside... Is that a secret passage?!"

3760512360.m_KeyValue: ""Our family motto has always been: 'If something gets in your way, just kick it aside!'""

3760512361.m_KeyValue: "I have no memories of my past. I don't even know who I am."

3760512362.m_KeyValue: "I don't think this is just a coincidence."

3760512363.m_KeyValue: ""Well, I don't think Father had anything to do with them. He hates vegetables.""

3760512390.m_KeyValue: "What!? What nonsense are you spouting? Looks like you need another smack..."

3760512420.m_KeyValue: "What now? Killing those tainted by Black Blood is simply granting them mercy."

3760512421.m_KeyValue: "We'll take him back with us. I'm sure the Church's researchers would be very interested in a special type!"

3760512422.m_KeyValue: "Clive... Why are you here? Where's Hati?"

3760512423.m_KeyValue: "There's no need to be so harsh. He's still just a child..."

3760512426.m_KeyValue: "That's Aiona? She seems so different from before..."

3760512454.m_KeyValue: "...What are you saying? You're Clive Ganelon's son! The hero who just sacrificed himself to protect your home!"

3760512456.m_KeyValue: ""No, I absolutely won't let that happen. I won't let Hati lose you both in one day.""

3760512457.m_KeyValue: "Hmm? Why do you know my abilities?"

3760512458.m_KeyValue: ""I hear them... farmers, woodcutters, hunters, fishermen... different voices, but all sharing the same love for each other and this town...""

3760512459.m_KeyValue: "You want a fight to the death?"

3760512480.m_KeyValue: "He will quickly lose his cognition and memories... and become one of 'them.' In other words..."

3760512481.m_KeyValue: ""So back there... you used your time manipulation to accelerate the growth of the spores in that bag, turning them into explosive mushrooms to hold off those two.""

3760512484.m_KeyValue: "Then I definitely can't let Clive reach this Calamity."

3760512486.m_KeyValue: "However... it is also my duty to teach Aiona that she must answer for her selfish actions—"

3760512487.m_KeyValue: "Then... why did you choose to help me? Aren't you allies?"

3760512488.m_KeyValue: ""Are you really taking him back for the Church's sake, Gilrain?""

3760512489.m_KeyValue: "You mean... there's a source of the Black Blood in this cave?"

3760512490.m_KeyValue: "So the forbidden grounds of the Ganelon family are actually where this so-called source of Black Blood is sealed..."

3760512491.m_KeyValue: ""I, Friedrich Roland, am the heir to the family that guards the Four Limbs of the Divine Body, and the most loyal ally of the High Priest.""

3760512521.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, that's why you dumb wolves are always trying to invade our lands... for the secret to immortality!""

3760512522.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, Lady Empousa reminded me. Perhaps we can use the terrain here to our advantage against the enemy.""

3760512523.m_KeyValue: "Why am I the only one dealing with this?!"

3760512550.m_KeyValue: "And the person who made you realize this is..."

3760512553.m_KeyValue: "Humans raise livestock for food as well."

3760512554.m_KeyValue: ""I suppose we're all the same. Intrigued by the unknown, yet also fear it.""

3760512555.m_KeyValue: ""However, I'm concerned that one day, the Black Blood here will flow out into the world...""

3761052380.m_KeyValue:
"Victory is achieved by completing all events and reaching the final destination. Trophies will be awarded based on the finish time.
An attempt ends when durability reaches 0."

3761115620.m_KeyValue: "It seems she's well aware of what happens after contracting the Black Blood."

3763117813.m_KeyValue: ""It seems the family is fighting over the succession, and the Four Elders are the ones who really hold the power.""

3763117814.m_KeyValue: ""It doesn't matter. If you can't remember, then it wasn't important! At least we're all alive.""

3763952879.m_KeyValue: "It's William... That's what I meant when I said something happened to him. He... He killed himself!"

3763952880.m_KeyValue: "You're still worried about Sunset Isle at a time like this!?"

3763952883.m_KeyValue: ""Do you want this ship to become a beacon that carries the survivors through the storm, or a grave where everyone perishes with your murderous brother?""

3763952902.m_KeyValue: "Huh? I meant everyone on this ship dresses like they barely bothered... What's wrong with you? You've been flinching at shadows since earlier."

3763952910.m_KeyValue: "Th-they're not beasts… They're my companions in adventure!"

3763952911.m_KeyValue: ""Hey hey, am I seeing things? That lifeless eyes just pulled off a pompous performance and turned those weapons into a bow?""

3763952912.m_KeyValue: "Was it… out of regard for Captain Goldland's heart? Because he truly could not bear..."

3763952913.m_KeyValue: "Could it be that guilt finally caught up with him? Captain Peacock did speak with him first—likely gave him a lecture on family and honor..."

3763952914.m_KeyValue: "And? Isn't that just common sense? Of course everyone would die if the Black Blood spreads."

3763952915.m_KeyValue: "W-what?! This ship is completely insane! Are both brothers cold-blooded killers?"

3763952916.m_KeyValue: ""Aaron was likely tasked with poisoning the food in the kitchen. Afterward, Jones escorted him to the adjacent guest cabin.""

3763952917.m_KeyValue: "Or perhaps Goldland was part of it from the very start. Only those involved would know to avoid the ship's food today."

3763952942.m_KeyValue: "How am I supposed to get you out of there?"

3763952944.m_KeyValue: "Father once spoke of wicked merchants who smuggled slaves across the sea to line their pockets."

3763952974.m_KeyValue: "No. Quite the opposite. The Black Blood will not bring your death. But…"

3763952975.m_KeyValue: "So that's why you said the Black Blood wouldn't kill me? Though becoming such a creature hardly seems any better."

3763952976.m_KeyValue: "Because this is my sanctuary—my sacred place aboard the El Dorado."

3763952977.m_KeyValue: "Octo isn't a squid. He's an octopus."

3763952978.m_KeyValue: ""Breaking through this wall may damage the storage chamber, but it remains the swiftest path forward.""

3763952980.m_KeyValue: ""What's so strange about hearing sounds from below? I've heard voices from below before, when I snuck in earlier.""

3763952981.m_KeyValue: "What if there's another layer beneath us—one hidden from the rest of the crew?"

3763953006.m_KeyValue: ""Raising sails, hauling lines, casting nets, loading cargo—you never once came to me. You cast me aside like I was worthless, incapable of doing anything!""

3763953007.m_KeyValue: "No… I only knew they were brothers. I thought William kept his face hidden simply because he was shy by nature…"

3763953008.m_KeyValue: "Spare me your smug little deduction game! That nonsense about my brother trying to save me—how laughable!"

3763953009.m_KeyValue: ""Ironically, this horrifying trade is not only real, but sanctioned by certain hands within the Church itself. That… is another reason I boarded this vessel.""

3763953010.m_KeyValue: "You knew full well he couldn't handle a Blood Beast that far gone. Why didn't you stop him?"

3763953012.m_KeyValue: "And stranger still… Why did the face hidden beneath look exactly like yours?"

3763953013.m_KeyValue: "Hey… don't tell me lifeless eyes was right all along. This…"

3763953038.m_KeyValue: "No… that's not the voice I meant… It's not his voice… it's… something else…"

3763953039.m_KeyValue: "No… I've had this gnawing feeling we've forgotten something—something both important and not. That dumb wolf…"

3763953040.m_KeyValue: ""No! Going alone now just gives him another isolated target. From this point forward, no matter what...""

3763953042.m_KeyValue: ""Ami… I know you're hurting. But at a time like this, we should...""

3763953043.m_KeyValue: ""Please, Lady Empousa, don't start a quarrel with her. She's just lost most of her companions because of William. Right now, we should be focusing on defeating our enemy.""

3763953044.m_KeyValue: "Ah yes. The friend who waited twenty years for your return. It seems they shaped your thinking more than you realize."

3763953071.m_KeyValue: "I want to leave... I want to be free... I want to go... home."

3763953072.m_KeyValue: "I have her. I'll become part of her—and together… we'll be free."

3763953073.m_KeyValue: "My goddess will surely embrace me again!"

3763953074.m_KeyValue: ""Regardless! The priority now is stabilizing the situation. Even if Famine is as powerful as he claims, no being is without weakness.""

3763953075.m_KeyValue: "What did you say?! Famine is on this ship?!"

3763953076.m_KeyValue: "I wonder… is there any link between this being and Ami?"

3763953077.m_KeyValue: "There's something wrong with him. His condition isn't normal."

3766571202.m_KeyValue: "Awakening can boost all Vassals' abilities with just one tap."

3766571203.m_KeyValue: ""In the Ritual Chamber, you can enhance your Vassals' base attributes.""

3773242169.m_KeyValue: "You're asking me? Can't Cain handle such a trivial matter?"

3773244347.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, but I can't pass judgment.""

3773245370.m_KeyValue: "Must we really make a decision now...?"

3773247548.m_KeyValue: "What if I said I didn't care? Would that bother you?"

3776694175.m_KeyValue: ""Advanced actuators capable of long-distance, high-speed movement across various terrains.""

3778214118.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps try again after leveling your Vassals. We've got plenty of opportunity to grow, and I'll always be at your side!""

3784072550.m_KeyValue: "Multiple logins detected. Please log in again."

3784072844.m_KeyValue: ""IDIP requires that when a Lord does not correspond to the Openid, the error code must be 1.""

3784396933.m_KeyValue: "Is it me or does this place feel... familiar?"

3784396934.m_KeyValue: "...That's all I needed to hear! I don't care who you are!"

3784396936.m_KeyValue: ""The first is the cage that imprisons you, the second is the fear that devours you, and the third blocks your path forward...""

3784396937.m_KeyValue: ""Then tell me, why do you think you have a name? What makes you different from the others?""

3784396964.m_KeyValue: "Just a bit further! We're almost at the lobby!"

3784396966.m_KeyValue: ""From the very beginning, I've held a card in my hand.""

3784396991.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, newbie, do you have a name?""

3784396996.m_KeyValue: ""Time has imprisoned your memories, but now, you should be able to recall everything.""

3784396997.m_KeyValue: "...You better not be lying to me."

3784396999.m_KeyValue: "Allow me to congratulate you on making it this far."

3784397000.m_KeyValue: ""Beyond this door lies our long-awaited home, and the freedom we've always sought!""

3784397002.m_KeyValue: "That voice in my head just gave me two choices—"

3784725006.m_KeyValue: "Said something about heading toward Twin Peaks..."

3784996610.m_KeyValue: ""So your appearance is a process in my world, and vice versa:""

3784996611.m_KeyValue: ""—So I will definitely fall from the cliff, but Aunt Mary might never appear.""

3784996612.m_KeyValue: ""At least, that's how it appears on the surface.""

3785274940.m_KeyValue: ""You just want an excuse to fight, don't you?""

3785275964.m_KeyValue: "This body is near its end... If this keeps up... (growling) ...am I turning...?"

3786047576.m_KeyValue: ""Pretty much. After all, you are me, and I am you.""

3786047607.m_KeyValue: "That's up to your consciousness. You can certainly choose to see this all as a dream."

3786078947.m_KeyValue: "It doesn't matter whether you're human or puppet."

3787876147.m_KeyValue: ""You said you were a Bloodborn hunter, right?""

3789778329.m_KeyValue: ""Big brother Noah, Skoll will be alright, won't he?""

3791858470.m_KeyValue: ""Precisely because I'm their target, it's easier. Don't worry about me! Save Clive first!""

3797745207.m_KeyValue: "I won't give you the chance to test it!"

3797745208.m_KeyValue: "When my wife and children were infected with Black Blood... They looked just like the heretics we used to hunt. They begged me to end their suffering. Begged me..."

3797745209.m_KeyValue: "You're the heretics who slaughtered your own at the northern camp! To think you've invaded..."

3797745210.m_KeyValue: ""Whether it's trampling another's faith, or taking another's life... I won't allow it.""

3797748408.m_KeyValue: "Then I shall look forward to that day in the near future when we make our Covenant."

3799036860.m_KeyValue: ""You stole Death's vessel without sanction. You brought it to Pestilence and Famine. And now, wearing the face of War, you dare attempt to awaken the Long Night...""

3799036861.m_KeyValue: ""_$$...is not about to happen, but rather..._$$""

3799036862.m_KeyValue: "Blood Beasts—from the valley. Drawn by the scent of Ancestral Black Blood leaking from the Divine Body's seal."

3799036863.m_KeyValue: "Darcias should've landed by now. Has your garlic-head Vice-Commander shown up yet?"

3799036864.m_KeyValue: "With shapeshifting so precise even a Bell Ringer's Vice-Commander couldn't sense it—It's child's play to sow discord among the Church's soldiers."

3799036865.m_KeyValue: "By the way—how long do you plan to keep wearing that face around me?"

3799040064.m_KeyValue: "The moon appears stained with blood... What could this portend?"

3799040065.m_KeyValue: "I don't need a pretender like you to remind me."

3800346417.m_KeyValue: "Someone's still waiting for me... but I... I've no strength left..."

3801721607.m_KeyValue: ""—is to heal and save lives. To do this, we... we need no reason...""

3802693967.m_KeyValue: ""I see, your insomnia must be contagious.""

3804409759.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps you have already found your answer when we meet again. Or perhaps the moonlight will grant you the insight you seek."

3804409761.m_KeyValue: ""What holds you back, little 'Fool'? Behind those veiled memories, what do you truly fear?""

3804409763.m_KeyValue: "So... we will rest in the forest?"

3804409764.m_KeyValue: ""We'll dance around the fire, converse, and relax under the moonlight, listening to nature's whispers.""

3804409765.m_KeyValue: ""Have you ventured into this gathering, completely unaware of the traditions of spiritual seekers, my little 'Fool'?""

3805796395.m_KeyValue: "Was all of this... just an illusion?"

3805796397.m_KeyValue: ""The moment the blood touched the Siren's Tear, I found myself once again pulled into the past...""

3806995589.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> A veil worn by Ressa resembling that of a typical clergywoman, yet it holds a deeper meaning for her.
She ceaselessly smooths, folds, and tucks the edges into her white cap until the Bell of Tempus tolls.""

3806995591.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> Ressa's cherished promise ring, seemingly worn for ages.
The tiny silver ring worn on the middle finger silently declares love, yet by dawn, it becomes a shackle.""

3806995592.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Outfit</style> The shawl worn by Ressa Ambolia. It accompanied her over the long days and nights of separation, as she awaited someone's return.
Moonlight, gentle yet somewhat duplicitous, bathes her as she leans against the window, shedding tears, just as scripted.""

3806995594.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> Ressa's cherished memories, strung together by countless moments of happiness.
In the end, the happiness they defended so vigorously was merely a ruse of fate, designed to trap them in the present.""

3806995622.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> A crown that embodies Joan's resolve.
War is the lifeblood of civilization. Flowing through the corridors of history, it is unstoppable, nay inevitable.""

3806995623.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Outfit</style> A blood-stained suit of armor worn by Joan.
Leaning against the wall, the homeland lay behind her in ruins; gazing into the distance, the future lay before her in doubt.""

3806995624.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> Joan's signet ring, shaped like twin-peaks and engraved with the words _$$May Astolfo remain prosperous._$$
She leads all the lost souls unable to return home to the Motherland of nigh. _$$Through utter despair, hope springs anew._$$""

3806995625.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> Joan's immortal past.
_$$Though yesterday has vanished and tomorrow is already known, how ought one navigate today?_$$""

3806995982.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> The rusty amulet of Baphomet, the Soulless, Elder of the Bathory family.
_$$Ashes beget ashes, and dust begets dust. Alas, life is but an anomaly, and all living memory perishes._$$""

3806995985.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> The dark iron helmet of Baphomet the Soulless, Elder of the Bathory family.
Blood represents the gravity of memory, while souls are as free as the blue sky. It's not that they are grander, just less attached.""

3806995987.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> The dark iron ring of Baphomet the Soulless, Elder of the Bathory family.

3807153157.m_KeyValue: ""Come on, you dumb wolf. Put some muscle into it!""

3810416635.m_KeyValue: "You've brought shame upon the Bathory name!"

3810423798.m_KeyValue: "So you're just like the rest of them in the wretched castle."

3810426997.m_KeyValue: "On behalf of the Cartographers' Association—I oppose this proposal!"

"Bella: I think not.
Yakov: Little Bella actually expressed disagreement!"

3810434160.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps the little one needs some advice from a grown-up?"

3810686857.m_KeyValue: "Gift Perennial Band to a friend 5 times."

3817845264.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, we can't just walk away! Geez, that ragged puppet almost pulled a fast one on me.""

3826499481.m_KeyValue: "There's no need for my input. Simply follow your convictions."

3826500636.m_KeyValue: "I wish to abstain on this matter."
