3827356133.m_KeyValue: ""What a pain... Fine, I'll help you out, just this once.""

3830472819.m_KeyValue: ""To keep that filthy thing beating, they burn slaves as fuel. You're one of them.""

3830472820.m_KeyValue: "So not only am I getting burned alive... now I'm food too?"

3830472822.m_KeyValue: "What if Princess Carrelle notices me and falls in love? My whole life could change!"

3830472823.m_KeyValue: "Praise the great Carrelle! We who bear the name Brennholt will fight to the death for our lord!"

3830690992.m_KeyValue: "Use the Regeneration Clock flexibly to clear obstacles. But be careful—the Regeneration Clock can only be used in the current timeline."

3830691058.m_KeyValue: ""My dear little Fool, you’ll be the one to stir up a bit of commotion and catch his attention.""

3830691089.m_KeyValue: ""Even in the same place, timelines leave quiet traces of change.""

3830693236.m_KeyValue: ""There are still a few towers nearby that aren't ready, but the main tower should be enough for you to explore, right?""

3830693302.m_KeyValue: "Don't underestimate the things these monsters can drop!"

3830694259.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed, Noah. You have entrusted me with this authority, and I am deeply honored. However, each day brings important matters that require your personal judgment.""

3830696402.m_KeyValue: ""Every time you complete a trial, you will receive rewards. May you march forward and take on all challenges that face you!""

3830737759.m_KeyValue: ""After all these years, whenever I think back to my father's choice... I can't say I don't understand it.""

3830737794.m_KeyValue: "I made the same choice... Perhaps it's because we share the same blood that we should speak honestly with each other."

3831400116.m_KeyValue: "Former Lord of Sapphire Isle; Father of Isaac Van Helsing"

3831779173.m_KeyValue: "He left? In weather like this!? Where could he possibly be heading!?"

3831779175.m_KeyValue: "He's like the old tales speak of—the hero who watched over the desert."

3831779176.m_KeyValue: ""Our stores are already empty? Looks like we'll have to venture out again, storm or no.""

3831929475.m_KeyValue: "My friend and I have this little game—we hide secret scrolls behind wooden signs."

3831929476.m_KeyValue: "Such a nonchalant response... but it really fits the impression you give."

3831929477.m_KeyValue: "That's a good idea. I'll remember that."

3831929478.m_KeyValue: "Fainting in a wrong location can be quite dangerous."

3831929480.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, you'll be safe with me.""

3833070830.m_KeyValue: "Said something about you needing to take it somewhere... but I can't recall the rest."

3833070831.m_KeyValue: ""He said... Take this lance to Twin Peaks, and you'll understand everything.""

3833620761.m_KeyValue: "The Church's war machines!? How can you control them?"

3833621781.m_KeyValue: "It wasn't for nothing. At the very least… I now know what Cain's true power is."

3833621783.m_KeyValue: ""It's a hassle, but I am a new Elder after all... I suppose I should pitch in and do my part.""

3833621784.m_KeyValue: ""Because I've realized something. As long as the vessel doesn't die, the past can be changed!""

3833621786.m_KeyValue: "Different? I'd say the opportunity I've waited for has finally come."

3835411657.m_KeyValue: "The 'God of Death' is watching over us! Victory is ours!"

3835412747.m_KeyValue: "We can't let our guard down. Let's finish them once and for all!"

3835420369.m_KeyValue: "We must eliminate them all before they break into the camp."

3835420371.m_KeyValue: ""Moonlight illuminates the ambitions hidden in the darkness... Accept your 'judgment', Blood Beasts.""

3835422547.m_KeyValue: ""Sailors, take up your weapons with the same fervor as you do unfurling the sails!""

3835423633.m_KeyValue: "Then we must prioritize protecting the lady."

3835423634.m_KeyValue: ""Dalcarlo, these frenzied beasts seem to be coming straight for you!""

3835424726.m_KeyValue: "A true captain would not wish harm on others."

3835425780.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be so down, lad! Good things come to those who wait.""

3835425812.m_KeyValue: ""Since you've come with such enthusiasm, I might as well offer you as sacrifices to the sea god in place of the Pontos II, hahaha!""

3835425815.m_KeyValue: "A true captain would not wish harm on others."

3835426903.m_KeyValue: "Don't just charge in recklessly! Such a rude boar..."

3835427989.m_KeyValue: "Don't underestimate the power of mysticism. I'm just as strong as you when it comes to fighting."

3838859639.m_KeyValue: ""As always, you have my full support in matters like this.""

3838863995.m_KeyValue: "Enough hesitation. Let’s plan our next move."

3839943776.m_KeyValue: "Done? I've got other matters to attend to."

3839944799.m_KeyValue: "I'm certain you have your own considerations in this matter."

3839945954.m_KeyValue: "This is but a mere speck among countless misconceptions."

3841582559.m_KeyValue: "How could it be? Were there really people living in this dangerous place before?"

3841582560.m_KeyValue: ""If that foolish wolf doesn't keep up, soon it'll just be the two of us.""

3841582561.m_KeyValue: ""Their duty could not allow the Black Blood to spread to the town, so they chose to lock themselves in the forbidden grounds.""

3841582564.m_KeyValue: ""Aiona, were there this many bugs here twenty years ago?""

3841582591.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know what type of person I will be twenty years from now, but I know I don't want to be alone anymore!""

3841582626.m_KeyValue: ""Without that Noah guy, you won't be able to handle the enemies in this ruined garden.""

3841582655.m_KeyValue: ""What's going on? We stopped the ritual, so why isn't Noah reacting at all...""

3841582656.m_KeyValue: "Never mind that. Have you noticed the Calamity seems a bit off?"

3841582657.m_KeyValue: ""Over there, it's Noah! Are they performing some kind of ritual on him?""

3841582687.m_KeyValue: ""What's wrong with you? Don't be rash, we can still think of a way...""

3841582688.m_KeyValue: ""It's a ticket. 'Across the Sea of Medimar, chasing the legend of the setting sun. Welcome aboard the El Dorado!'""

3841582691.m_KeyValue: "He is indeed Sheila一the Plague. There's no mistake."

3841582692.m_KeyValue: "Isn't it right in front of you?"

3841582693.m_KeyValue: ""However, Cain did ask me to pass on a message to you.""

3841582694.m_KeyValue: ""I can't help but feel that if you were still alive, you might have made a worthy adversary.""

3841582716.m_KeyValue: ""Hehe, well, don't forget, you still have a promise with someone else too...""

3841582719.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, after all, we still have one last thing we must do.""

3841582720.m_KeyValue: ""All things require balance, like light and shadow. Once that balance is lost, either side can turn into a Calamity.""

3841582721.m_KeyValue: "Is that why you chose 'light'? You really are a damn prodigy. Just how far ahead of me do you want to get before you're satisfied?!"

3841582722.m_KeyValue: "What do you mean? Don't you want to go back to our own time?"

3841582723.m_KeyValue: ""I made it thanks to you, Noah, and now I understand my duty.""

3841582724.m_KeyValue: "I began searching everywhere for you all... Until your blood found me and awakened me on the other side."

3841582725.m_KeyValue: "This can't be a coincidence. I know I'll never be able to see the sister I once knew..."

3841582726.m_KeyValue: "That's where our favorite place in town will be built—a bustling market."

3845784027.m_KeyValue: "Pass unlocked! Upgrade to unlock extra rewards."

3847042447.m_KeyValue: "We need to pick up the pace."

3847643352.m_KeyValue: "Invite your trusted Vassal to participate in the meeting."

3847643354.m_KeyValue: "Hold the meeting and hear everyone's opinions."

3847644377.m_KeyValue: ""Different locations offer Missions of varying Difficulty. The higher the Difficulty, the more generous the rewards.""

3847644378.m_KeyValue: "Upgrade the Observatory and Hall of Honor to unlock higher Difficulties."

3847644379.m_KeyValue: "Different Expedition Missions have different requirements for Vassal Rarity and Faction."

3847644380.m_KeyValue: "This Vassal is eligible for the Crystalline Crater."

3847644381.m_KeyValue: ""Tap here to Embark. After a period of time, she will return with 10 Moon Tears.""

3849347866.m_KeyValue: ""He betrayed Father's trust, and you're still defending him?""

3849347868.m_KeyValue: "Were they drawn here by our arguing?"

3849347869.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Skoll. I still can't entrust Father's and everyone's safety to others. I won't run.""

3849347870.m_KeyValue: ""These guys are such a pain... Hey, you stupid wolf!""

3849347871.m_KeyValue: "He's the Bell Ringer's Vice-Commander. He might know a way to control the Black Blood."

3849347899.m_KeyValue: ""Go, Hati... Your path leads to distant horizons...""

3849347901.m_KeyValue: "They're part of the troops under Dr. Thibault. They should all be carrying Wolfsbane to prevent their own transformation."

3849347902.m_KeyValue: "Skoll... you must be in so much pain. You've always been the one who hated pain the most..."

3849347903.m_KeyValue: "Wolfsbane blooms beneath the moon's soft grace; The promised home waits beyond the sky's embrace—"

3849347930.m_KeyValue: ""Father, I will leave this place. Ahead of me is a new path filled with thorns.""

3849347932.m_KeyValue: "...Why do I feel like I can understand that sound? Is it calling us over?"

3849347933.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, he's inside. In the cemetery, by the unnamed hero's gravestone...""

3849347937.m_KeyValue: "It wasn't me who decided to spare those two... it was fate."

3852033316.m_KeyValue: "That's exactly what I was hoping for."

3852033318.m_KeyValue: ""If another powerful enemy shows up, do you really think we’ll survive with what little strength we have?""

3852033319.m_KeyValue: "The sun... He said we need the sun."

3853716598.m_KeyValue:
""'Love begins when two things crash together, scattering parts everywhere!'
With fantastic steering, it is a missed opportunity.""

3853716599.m_KeyValue:
"With great power comes great responsibility!
The Mechanical Spider has great responsibility!"

3853716601.m_KeyValue:
""It said, 'Charge forth.'
The processor issued a command, and the mechanical legs executed an action.""

3853716604.m_KeyValue:
""New all-time high!
Though you've failed before, your success was inevitable.""

3853716630.m_KeyValue:
"Chasing butterflies.
Even mechanical spiders dream of sheep."

3853716632.m_KeyValue:
"Snowstorms and getting lost make a perfect match!
Right? Right!"

3854623670.m_KeyValue:
""It said, 'Charge forth.'
It said, 'Charge forth.'
The processor issued a command, but the mechanical legs did not respond.""

3854623672.m_KeyValue:
"Less power equals less responsibility!
Mechanical spider is ready to pass the buck!"

3854623673.m_KeyValue:
""'Love begins when two things crash together, scattering parts everywhere!'
Afterwards, each sets off on their own journey, reeling from their wounds.""

3854623675.m_KeyValue:
"The chassis failed to withstand the acceleration once more.
A few more failures and that'll be it."

3861948855.m_KeyValue: "Complete challenges and collect puzzles to unlock Memories."

3865054539.m_KeyValue: ""Do you truly believe I'm just copying people? That anyone could do such a thing, you fool?""

3865054541.m_KeyValue: ""So, who did you choose to be your sacrifice? Not Empousa?""

3865054543.m_KeyValue: ""Children of Dracula's blood—do you hear it? Two tolls, ringing for you.""

3865466903.m_KeyValue: ""The thirst for power, for life, for knowledge... Those who cling to such things are merely driven by their own desires.""

3865466904.m_KeyValue: "Maybe this old guy's different from those two weirdos. Could he actually be... nice?"

3865466905.m_KeyValue: ""Maybe I'm overthinking it, but I can't shake the feeling that the future depicted by these cards is not what we're striving for...""

3865466906.m_KeyValue: ""My true form is not here. As long as my soul exists, I can never truly die.""

3865466935.m_KeyValue: ""I don't want to call you 66 anymore, and I don't want you to call me 79. I hope... we can have our own names.""

3865466936.m_KeyValue: "Are you implying that you're one of the elders too? But you don't have a card."

3865466938.m_KeyValue: ""That reminds me, she just mentioned a name. We didn't finish our conversation. You were about to tell me your name...""

3865466939.m_KeyValue: "Better leave it to 'Death.' That man always handles these things with such finesse."

3865467199.m_KeyValue: ""Since waking up one day, I've been locked up here with my 'sisters.'""

3865467200.m_KeyValue: ""...I envy you, 34. You still cling to hope for those fairy tale endings.""

3865467201.m_KeyValue: ""I don't know what you're talking about. I'm not interested in the others, or this place, or the world outside.""

3865467202.m_KeyValue: "Are they immortal or something? This is getting interesting!"

3865467231.m_KeyValue: "'We follow'... Are you imitating how they talk?"

3865467232.m_KeyValue: ""It's nothing... I just find it too coincidental. Just as we were wondering how to activate the mechanism, that monster appeared with the card...""

3865467233.m_KeyValue: ""Hmm, they must be hidden throughout the castle!""

3865467234.m_KeyValue: ""As expected, she didn't last very long.""

3865467263.m_KeyValue: "How interesting... How beautiful! So this is friendship!"

3865467265.m_KeyValue: ""You really are pessimistic, aren't you? Is it because you can't remember your past?""

3865467296.m_KeyValue: "Huh? Wait a second! Are you saying I'm dead weight?!"

3865467299.m_KeyValue: "What's a real person? Is it a more expensive version of a fake person?"

3865467300.m_KeyValue: "...Are you the puppet master? But you look like a puppet youself."

3865467301.m_KeyValue: "(panting) How... how can a puppet be so strong?"

3865467331.m_KeyValue: "Why do you always jump to the worst-case scenario?"

3865467332.m_KeyValue: ""Maybe we'll end up like those cold bodies on the ground, but at least... we'll be together.""

3865467366.m_KeyValue: ""However, I didn't expect that two would come at the same time.""

3865467395.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps it's this side of you that keeps drawing me closer."

3865467397.m_KeyValue: "Whoa! This place is way too high!"

3865467398.m_KeyValue: ""As expected of vessels capable of passing the three trials—and two at once, no less.""

3865795243.m_KeyValue: "So you fear the dark too... You're more human that you let on!"

3866345171.m_KeyValue: ""...Rest well, Sir Gadric. I regret never crossing blades with you.""

3866345172.m_KeyValue: "Why are you the only ones here? Where's the Vice-Commander who was supposed to lead you?"

3866345173.m_KeyValue: "No... I don't want to be here... AHHH—!!"

3866345175.m_KeyValue: "Why are all of you here? Your orders were to delay the Church's reinforcements in Starfall Valley."

3866346198.m_KeyValue: "That's right! You said Van Helsing uncovered our plan. So what now?"

3866346199.m_KeyValue: "This body... it truly can't fight... So this is the helplessness that ordinary man feel?"

3867654725.m_KeyValue: "So let's send him to protect Alene."

3867654728.m_KeyValue: ""And if we keep letting them lead us by the nose, the consequences may be dire.""

3869791920.m_KeyValue: "The strange dreams we've had since arriving at the bay—they must be the effects of this 'Siren's Tear.'"

3869791921.m_KeyValue: "The strange armored visitor today seemed to have misunderstood Ami's identity. They invited her to run for the position of Eighth Sage of Sapphire Isle."

3869791922.m_KeyValue: ""That's why you need to help them escape before the soldiers get to them, Aiona.""

3869791953.m_KeyValue: ""After that disaster, everyone was gone... and you vanished without a trace. You have no idea how it broke me.""

3869791978.m_KeyValue: "'Kill them! For the peace of Sapphire Isle!'"

3869791979.m_KeyValue: "The title of Sapphire Isle's Eighth Sage shall be bestowed upon one of unparalleled valor and wisdom—"

3869791984.m_KeyValue: "I never imagined such brazen deceit would thrive under the Church’s vigilant eye."

3869791985.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Bertram Roland, do come and meet this prodigious young heir of yours—so gifted, so generous with her wealth.""

3869791987.m_KeyValue: "Could the proof be Miss Lorelei's word?"

3869791988.m_KeyValue: "Letting them out of their cage won't guarantee freedom."

3869791989.m_KeyValue: ""Everything I saw, everything I experienced, was part of your plan.""

3869791991.m_KeyValue: ""You have one last thing to do now, little Bloodborn.""

3874122869.m_KeyValue: "Then it is unfortunate. You shall slumber forever. Alongside your _$$Seed of Hope._$$"

3874122870.m_KeyValue: ""Thanks to you, I now believe that perhaps Death... is not evil.""

3874122871.m_KeyValue: "Two against two. Do you truly think that guarantees your victory?"

3874122875.m_KeyValue: "You're the one who got lost. I arrived just fine."

3874122876.m_KeyValue: ""How could you, Commander! Swapping places with your Chorister to teleport ahead, and leaving us stranded behind!""

3874122877.m_KeyValue: "You heard her. That was Tris who said you're weak—not me."

3874122878.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella, stay out of this. You're not strong enough to face them.""

3874123893.m_KeyValue: "And I thought… I could finally walk freely beneath the sun… But the sunlight here wasn't real..."

3874123895.m_KeyValue: "Those white crystals falling from the sky… They must be the salt Mr. Van Helsing mentioned."

3874123896.m_KeyValue: "...This is Piera's doing. She's here. Somewhere on this island."

3874123897.m_KeyValue: ""Piera? Who's that? When you say it's her doing, do you mean the salt on the ground… or the sky exploding?""

3874123898.m_KeyValue: "I suspect both. Though I never thought she'd unleash something on this scale."

3874123899.m_KeyValue: "Wait—you're saying one person shattered the sky with salt?"

3874123900.m_KeyValue: "Whoa—another powerful name!? Who exactly is this Piera!?"

3874123901.m_KeyValue: "She's my senior. Vice-Commander to Bell Ringer Albrecht and..."

3874123902.m_KeyValue: "The reason I boarded the El Dorado to reach Sunset Isle."

3874132597.m_KeyValue: "Oh? Tell me—do you know why it's called the the Mourning Hollow?"

3874132605.m_KeyValue: "They say that Dr. Ressa can handle anything... except medicine!"

3874132606.m_KeyValue: "…So the one thing I want to be good at is the one thing I'm not. It's not as simple as I thought…"

3874132607.m_KeyValue: ""If I want to be a real doctor here, I've still got a lot to learn.""

3874132609.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, we shouldn't keep your parents waiting. Shall we head to Painter's Bluff?""

3874132611.m_KeyValue: ""Not so fast, Eleanor! You'll get lost again if you run off alone.""

3874132612.m_KeyValue: ""No way! This is the Mourning Hollow, I know this place!""

3874133752.m_KeyValue: ""We've made it to Painter's Bluff. Thankfully, no more dreamfeeders crossed our path.""

3874133757.m_KeyValue: "It's not your imagination. There're too many longings left behind... and not enough to guide it."

3874133758.m_KeyValue: ""Is it my imagination? Lately, the dreamfeeders seem more restless than before.""

3874133761.m_KeyValue: "Stay back. You're safe there. Let us handle this."

3874133763.m_KeyValue: "I've only just become Gravekeeper. Couldn't this have waited for the next in line?"

3874134781.m_KeyValue: "If that's true... Then we may be standing at the brink of another catastrophic crisis..."

3874134784.m_KeyValue: "But between this island—formed from a Divine Body—and the Death sealed within it."

3874135929.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Eleanor... If only I'd seen through it sooner...""

3874135933.m_KeyValue: "It took her so long to call me _$$Father_$$..."

3874135934.m_KeyValue: "She'll be so happy. You were the first person she saw when she was born."

3874135937.m_KeyValue: "A world without Eleanor is not real..."

3874135938.m_KeyValue: "What if we—the so-called guardians of the Divine Body—were never chosen? What if we were merely vessels… And longing was the only thing that was truly ours?"

3874135939.m_KeyValue: "My love... it seems... I'll reunite with our daughter first..."

3874136953.m_KeyValue: ""Noah, remember this well: Resorting to that method would pull you into a darkness deeper than the Black Blood itself.""

3874136954.m_KeyValue: "Ressa... Do you remember why you left your homeland to come here?"

3874136957.m_KeyValue: "That method is absolutely out of the question!"

3874136958.m_KeyValue: "Is it really that hard? All you need to do is drink the crimson blood of others to dilute the Black Blood inside you..."

3874136959.m_KeyValue: "Don't suggest something that vile with a straight face."

3874136960.m_KeyValue: "Do you understand what it means to drink someone else's blood? Sacrificing others to save ourselves. That is never the path we should take."

3874136961.m_KeyValue: ""But it's already been three months. We need to find herbs—and formulas—fast, to suppress both the symptoms and the spread.""

3874136963.m_KeyValue: "One day... I will find the way."

3874136964.m_KeyValue: "Do we really need to wait for _$$one day_$$? I remember reading something in the medical book you kept—there was a method written clearly inside."

3874138108.m_KeyValue: "What kind of... fri...end... am I... if I can't even help you... in the end..."

3874138109.m_KeyValue: "(coughing) You said... You didn't want to... harm anyone..."

3874138113.m_KeyValue: "Sora? What are you trying to tell me?"

3874138114.m_KeyValue: "He's restrained—for now. Should we help Ressa?"

3874138116.m_KeyValue: ""Sora... You're not giving up like this, are you? Losing to that Noah...""

3874139131.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, he is Death—the god who delivers us from separation and sorrow.""

3874139133.m_KeyValue: ""That's why you emerged from the Phantom of Aeon, Noah... because all along, you were the guide—""

3874139134.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, he is the one who leads us to the Other Side.""

3874139135.m_KeyValue: ""Plucking wildflowers by the cliff for her mother, listening to tales spun by her father… And whenever she lost her way, Ressa, you would guide her back to the Painter's Bluff.""

3874139136.m_KeyValue: ""Usually, longings take the Phantom of Aeon's hand to go through the passage. But just now, it was your hand that Eleanor took, as she crossed to the Other Side...""

3874139137.m_KeyValue: ""So Eleanor has been guided? Noah, you really...""

3874139138.m_KeyValue: "What's happening? I think I saw this child's memories."

3874139139.m_KeyValue: ""Ressa, thank you! You found my parents and brought back Noah to guide us.""

3875702978.m_KeyValue: "Wipe that look off your face. It's the werewolves' blood."

3878815442.m_KeyValue: "Who are you?! Why do you look like me?!"

3878815443.m_KeyValue: "...It's Kenneth. The others are dead too."

3878815444.m_KeyValue: "What are we even guarding? The mines in Starfall Valley have been deserted for years. Who'd bother attacking this place?"

3878815445.m_KeyValue: ""Heh, was just thinking you should've shown up by now. Finally, I can get some sleep.""

3878818644.m_KeyValue: ""What? You can't accept it just because you're a slave? Hmph! Well, when I become the head of the family, the first thing I'll do is abolish this whole slave system!""

3879750046.m_KeyValue: ""Because if anyone had left that room at the end of the hallway, we would have seen them. We've been fighting here the entire time!""

3879750047.m_KeyValue: "To think Lady Empousa would notice something like that..."

3879750048.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, so much for all that talk about 'observation and deduction' from lifeless eyes. It's not that difficult!""

3879750049.m_KeyValue: ""...If they're all still in that break room, it spares me the trouble of questioning them one by one. Let's go.""

3879750050.m_KeyValue: "It's time to confront the true culprit."

3879750051.m_KeyValue: "Do you realize how foolish you've been?"

3879750052.m_KeyValue: ""I don't understand, Kris... or should I call you Captain Goldland, since we're still on the ship?""

3879750053.m_KeyValue: "You of all should know that harming a 'family' member is a capital offense aboard this ship! You killed Aaron!"

3879750054.m_KeyValue: ""Family, family... It's sickening. We're the only two aboard who bear the Goldland name. I'm your real brother—not them!""

3879764193.m_KeyValue: "But those are things others have defined for you. When I ask myself this question... That's not the answer I'm searching for."

3879764194.m_KeyValue: ""As for me, Van Helsing is my name. Heretic hunter is my occupation. That is enough to answer who I am.""

3879764197.m_KeyValue: "What's this? Another soul trapped in the same tale... The price of power is losing your memory and self?"

3879764198.m_KeyValue: ""You are Van Helsing, a hunter of the Silver Cross, our enemy. But as for who I am... Even when we reach land, I might not remember.""

3879764199.m_KeyValue: "Sentimental fools always think they are unique. But who among us hasn't lost fragments of memory along the way?"

3879764200.m_KeyValue: ""A few days ago, I set out on a journey with no preparation—to find out 'who I am.' An answer I'm not even sure I want to know.""

3879764201.m_KeyValue: "I want to stay here. Look for any clues we may have overlooked—just like you."

3879764202.m_KeyValue: "Aren't you going after them? I won't stop you this time."

3879764203.m_KeyValue: ""But once we reach land, our weapons will remind us of our identities...""

3879764204.m_KeyValue: ""Just like me, huh... We do get along surprisingly well. But that's only because we're trapped together at sea. For now, we have no reason to draw our blades.""

3881465745.m_KeyValue: "Purifies the most recently applied debuff or Control effect of the same type."

3882075145.m_KeyValue: "I'm sorry... It's my fault everyone ended up like this. I'm so sorry-"

3891576247.m_KeyValue: ""Suffering will end, and tomorrow will be as bright and grand as the sun—""

3891576248.m_KeyValue: "Could she be so heartbroken that she just..."

3891576279.m_KeyValue: "Today... the Pontos II sets sail anew!"

3891576280.m_KeyValue: "Yes! Jacintha said it's something needed for divination."

3891576282.m_KeyValue: "You have Captain Patchen's courage and decisiveness. You will be the new navigator for the Pontos II."

3891576544.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, did you see the windmill during the divination? Or was there a voice telling you which way to go?""

3891576546.m_KeyValue: ""This is just a normal little town, after all—""

3891576578.m_KeyValue: ""What else can we do? The wreckage of the Pontos has already drifted who knows where. Although I said I'll rely on myself, right now we're... completely clueless.""

3891576609.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, Captain. The cat led me here to show us a way out.""

3891576610.m_KeyValue: ""The sea's waves may toss us, but WE DON'T CARE! Everyone get in tempo and... LIFT!""

3891576645.m_KeyValue: ""It's the plague. Even if she did last until tomorrow, what then?""

3891576646.m_KeyValue: "A plague broke out in town... My cousin was infected."

3891576671.m_KeyValue: "The brave Captain... buried by the raging waves..."

3891576675.m_KeyValue: ""The Captain was inspecting until late last night, and said we'll definitely set sail today!""

3891576676.m_KeyValue: ""The Captain is gone, the ship is damaged, we have no hope of leaving this place...""

3891576677.m_KeyValue: ""Cheer up, lad! Now is not the time to be disheartened!""

3891576705.m_KeyValue: "The paint you need is from these insects?"

3891576706.m_KeyValue: "How did you... uh... get guided here by fate?"

3891576707.m_KeyValue: ""On the ancient, lost island—sailors find treasure—""

3891576708.m_KeyValue: "I've heard of an herb that can treat the plague. Perhaps I can find it in the mountains."

3891576709.m_KeyValue: "I'm just a fraud pretending to be something I'm not..."

3891576710.m_KeyValue: ""But she never drew the final card, not even when she left us during that accident...""

3891576739.m_KeyValue: ""Becoming a ghost like me, with no home and no one who cares!""

3891576741.m_KeyValue: ""At a time like this, why are there still troublemakers showing up!""

3891576742.m_KeyValue: "So much blood... Did you encounter wolves? I'll go find a doctor!"

3891966745.m_KeyValue: "Street vendors reported something suspicious near the barrels..."

3892041165.m_KeyValue: ""Gah, no! I've tried everything, but it just won't budge!""

3892041168.m_KeyValue: "I could spare you... for now. But know that I'll be watching your every move... Don't test me!"

3897226581.m_KeyValue: "Allow Vassals to Associate with the Kingdom"

3897759595.m_KeyValue: ""Whatever it is, can someone pull me out? This stuff's got my feet stuck. I can't even walk!""

3899087482.m_KeyValue: "Good. Now that we've settled it—let's move."

3899087483.m_KeyValue: "Someone must stay and guard the child and his mother."

3899087484.m_KeyValue: "Our wood reserves won't last more than three days."

3900651887.m_KeyValue: "But—but everything I did was for Lady Bella's wish! Surely you wouldn't punish me... right?"

3900651888.m_KeyValue: "But Elder Bella is the most special one—the core!"

3900651889.m_KeyValue: "And if what I want is to reclaim my life?"

3901243342.m_KeyValue: "They look formidable. Let's find a way to hold them off."

3901504281.m_KeyValue: "These anchor points look solid. If only Setti were here..."

3902194936.m_KeyValue: ""If the stars fall and the sun fades to oblivion, does time still matter?""

3910248198.m_KeyValue: "Dust. The power of the earth—passed down through every Bell Ringer No. XI."

3910248199.m_KeyValue: ""It is my duty to stop the four Calamities from gathering at the sealed area, Noah of Death.""

3910248200.m_KeyValue: "_$$Our home_$$—you never meant the cottage. You meant wherever we were together."

3910248201.m_KeyValue: "But memories remain in the past. And dreams… Dreams are only dreams because we must wake from them."

3910248202.m_KeyValue: "A Bell Ringer who betrayed the Church. Another risen from death. All gathered to stand by a Calamity... Fascinating."

3910251401.m_KeyValue: "_$$I miscalculated... The power of both Silver Blood and Black Blood combined cannot fell you in one strike..._$$"

3910251403.m_KeyValue: "_$$Pawn_$$ and _$$order_$$ are such harsh words. Mass and I are accomplices bound by a common ideal."

3913483494.m_KeyValue: ""Ami's still alive, right!? We can still save her!?""

3913483495.m_KeyValue: ""Well then, little Justice... After all that setup, do you even know where the other jewel is?""

3913483500.m_KeyValue: "Have you lost it?! Are you really planning to kill Ami just to stop Famine!?"

3913483501.m_KeyValue: "So this is the fabled Justice they say never wavers?"

3913483502.m_KeyValue: ""Great Ranna, receive now the blood of your children—may your resurrection be complete!""

3913483504.m_KeyValue: ""According to Goldland's journals, after the Landis family sank, two Divine Body jewels still remained in the world. This red gem... is one of them.""

3913483505.m_KeyValue: "If we can combine them in a certain way—as the journals described—we may be able to suppress Famine. And maybe... save Ami."

3913483506.m_KeyValue: ""No... It seems Mr. Van Helsing was never aiming at Miss Ami at all, but rather...""

3913483507.m_KeyValue: "Wait—was that the red jewel from that jellyfish girl's necklace?"

3913486827.m_KeyValue: ""And these two gems... the fruits in its grasp. Back off, Silver-haired!""

3913486828.m_KeyValue: "So this helm was the ring from the Divine Body's right hand...?"

3913486829.m_KeyValue: ""Turn the golden wheel, follow where my heart leads...""

3913486831.m_KeyValue: ""Crimson to the north, azure to the south...""

3913486832.m_KeyValue: "She noticed it! the Divine Body that had sealed her away is now emanating power!"

3913486833.m_KeyValue: "That golden helm... it reeks of Divine Body... What are you planning!?"

3913486834.m_KeyValue: "Then I'm ready. Everything hinges on this moment."

3913486835.m_KeyValue: "There! I see Ami! She's trapped... in the abdomen!"

3918602396.m_KeyValue: ""The fragrance of blossoms, the sound all around—it all feels so very real.""

3918602397.m_KeyValue: ""Ah, customers? Terribly sorry, but I'm afraid we're closed today.""

3918602398.m_KeyValue: "Dumping untreated waste... only an incompetent alchemist would make such novice mistakes."

3918602399.m_KeyValue: ""After the water source was purified, the soil also returned to its original state.""

3918737564.m_KeyValue: ""Because no matter how lowly their origin, all beasts ultimately yearn for 'The Light'.""

3918991120.m_KeyValue: "A summon that performs ranged Basic ATK in sync with Transcendent Noah. Only 5 can exist at the same time."

3918991124.m_KeyValue: "Purifies all debuffs and fully restores HP."

3923215314.m_KeyValue: "I haven't seen fish this fresh since we left the El Dorado."

3923839207.m_KeyValue: ""Earlier, I thought what my _$$sister_$$ achieved that I couldn't was winning you over, and that sister I was comparing myself to was Empousa.""

3923839208.m_KeyValue: "How many spirits guard this gate? Am I supposed to face the entire Hall of the Elders alone?"

3923839209.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps... the escape itself was her gift to you?"

3923839210.m_KeyValue: ""It wasn't until that moment, when I ran out of the castle, that I realized how wrong I was.""

3942882748.m_KeyValue: ""Good thing the silver-haired one helped Joyce kill her. Thank you, detective!""

3942882750.m_KeyValue: ""Lord Isaac or Miss Ami... who will it be, Lord Silver-haired?""

3942882751.m_KeyValue: "But how did Bella No. 7 wake up? Ugh! It must be that wicked woman Lorelei's doing! No wonder she was asking Joyce all those strange questions..."

3942882752.m_KeyValue: ""It's okay... Even though there were some mishaps, everything is still under control! Now that all the Siren's Tears are gathered here, Joyce can transform even more puppets—you stand no chance of victory!""

3942882753.m_KeyValue: "Everyone in Sapphire Isle shall become Joyce's puppets!"

3942882773.m_KeyValue: "No wonder Joyce's secret weapon failed to activate."

3942882778.m_KeyValue: ""Little Bella, how could you turn Joyce's own power against Joyce? That's so cruel!""

3942882779.m_KeyValue: "Let's play! Joyce can keep this game going forever!"

3942882781.m_KeyValue: ""Clash! Clash! The fearless din of their weapons, striking with unyielding resolve!""

3942882782.m_KeyValue: ""Sing for me one last time, and I'll play along with you.""

3942882783.m_KeyValue: ""I'm the one who broke our promises... I promised to cure your illness, to let you play your cherished harp again, to sail with you under the sun, far beyond the Isle...""

3942882784.m_KeyValue: ""I knew it. You're no better than the Master. One day, I'll face you with my blade.""

3942882785.m_KeyValue: ""Without her master, she returns to her original state—still, void of life.""

3942882810.m_KeyValue: "He must have read my diary again."

3942882811.m_KeyValue: "The other person affected by the Siren's Tear has probably recovered as well."

3942882812.m_KeyValue: "The Seven Sage Association has placed devices throughout the Isle that release small amounts of the Siren's Tear."

3942882814.m_KeyValue: "She... she really does care about me!"

3942882816.m_KeyValue: ""He taught me many useful things. No wonder he can be your friend, Sir!""

3942882817.m_KeyValue: "Wait! I think we've lost something too..."

3942882839.m_KeyValue: ""The Mysterious Merchant clapped, as if dismissing such a minor favor. 'The air here isn't good for her recovery. I'll take her northward, where it's cold. She'll write to you regularly.'""

3942882842.m_KeyValue: ""'The Church will come. When they do, things will return to normal.'""

3942882845.m_KeyValue: "The rest—infected or not—would be nothing more than drops in the ocean. That was the Bell Ringer's flawless form of purification."

3942882846.m_KeyValue: "That unease deepened the moment the basement door burst open."

3942882847.m_KeyValue: ""Lorelei stepped into the dark room—empty, at first glance. From behind the curtain, a low voice drifted forth, warning her that every piece of merchandise came with a price.""

3942882848.m_KeyValue: ""After five long years, Constantine had finally returned to Sapphire Isle—only to find it reduced to a living hell.""

3942882849.m_KeyValue: ""His teeth were sharper, claws sprouting from his fingers, and blood staining the corners of his lips. What had happened? Myrtle was gripped by terror.""

3944157781.m_KeyValue: ""So diviners have such convenient pre-made predictions going around? If I learn this, could I set up my own stall and make some money?""

3944157782.m_KeyValue: ""If you want to set up a stall, you'll need to learn more than these.""

3944264270.m_KeyValue: "What's wrong with running? Staying alive is what matters."

3944264271.m_KeyValue: "It appears someone is healing them from afar."

3944267470.m_KeyValue: "Are you worried that the thunder woman will come after us if she defeats the fire guy?"

3944267471.m_KeyValue: "It seems I've arrived at just the right moment."

3945559369.m_KeyValue: ""The Black Blood aims to seize full control over you, turning you into its vessel. Its Bloodsoul slowly corrupts your mind while continuously strengthening your body.""

3946123754.m_KeyValue: "They didn't want to. But perhaps this is what humans..."

3946123755.m_KeyValue: ""At the end of time in every world, all wills will converge into one. Then 'he' will sail the ark to the Other Side.""

3946124774.m_KeyValue: "I used to think that was all I was worth. That outside my mission... outside being a vessel..."

3946124775.m_KeyValue: ""No! Lady Empousa, there must be another way!""

3946124777.m_KeyValue: ""Seems that by setting you on this path, I ended up forging a foe far stronger than I intended.""

3946124778.m_KeyValue: ""It's true. My nemesis may wound me, but I cannot die. And do you know why?""

3946124779.m_KeyValue: "Dumb Wolf... Lifeless Eyes... Aiona... Lamia... and... Noah..."

3948158090.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> A veil worn by Ressa resembling that of a typical clergywoman, yet it holds a deeper meaning for her.
She ceaselessly smooths, folds, and tucks the edges into her white cap until the Bell of Tempus tolls.""

3948158092.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> Ressa's cherished promise ring, seemingly worn for ages.
The tiny silver ring worn on the middle finger silently declares love, yet by dawn, it becomes a shackle.""

3948158093.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Outfit</style> The shawl worn by Ressa Ambolia. It accompanied her over the long days and nights of separation, as she awaited someone's return.
Moonlight, gentle yet somewhat duplicitous, bathes her as she leans against the window, shedding tears, just as scripted.""

3948158095.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Amulet</style> Ressa's cherished memories, strung together by countless moments of happiness.
In the end, the happiness they defended so vigorously was merely a ruse of fate, designed to trap them in the present.""

3948158123.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Headgear</style> A crown that embodies Joan's resolve.
War is the lifeblood of civilization. Flowing through the corridors of history, it is unstoppable, nay inevitable.""

3948158124.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Outfit</style> A blood-stained suit of armor worn by Joan.
Leaning against the wall, the homeland lay behind her in ruins; gazing into the distance, the future lay before her in doubt.""

3948158125.m_KeyValue:
""<style=""EquipposHL"">Ring</style> Joan's signet ring, shaped like twin-peaks and engraved with the words _$$May Astolfo remain prosperous._$$
She leads all the lost souls unable to return home to the Motherland of nigh. _$$Through utter despair, hope springs anew._$$""

3948158126.m_KeyValue:
