3948898028.m_KeyValue: "What a pity. Perhaps it would be better if you died by that boring man's hand instead—"

3948898029.m_KeyValue: "So this is how we meet again in this place."

3950861896.m_KeyValue: "Why did you run... why are you the only one who survived? Why!"

3950861923.m_KeyValue: "A mission from Lord Albrecht the Bell Ringer… There was never a choice to refuse."

3950861924.m_KeyValue: "<color=#a7675c>Our great plan was nearly undone by a single person.</color>"

3950861925.m_KeyValue: "I want to introduce you to someone."

3950861926.m_KeyValue: "Now... it's time for my 'walk' as well."

3950861928.m_KeyValue: "(Looks like Noah and the others have nearly completed their plan.)"

3950861929.m_KeyValue: ""Stop fighting, stop fighting! The auction house decorations are far too expensive to ruin!""

3950862189.m_KeyValue: "Do you have any idea how much these clothes cost?! My father had them shipped all the way from the Far East!"

3950862190.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, she hasn't finished grilling the mussels and scallops yet.""

3950862191.m_KeyValue: "D-Does this mean we don't have to pay anymore?"

3950862193.m_KeyValue: ""I just want to look after my old friend's apprentice, make sure she's well-fed and has a place to stay...""

3950862194.m_KeyValue: ""Hey silver hair, I'll be joining you from now on.""

3950862213.m_KeyValue: ""I just helped Miss Ami register for the auction. Her wealth, I dare say, is quite comparable to that of your father...""

3950862214.m_KeyValue: "One million... gone with a single strike of the gavel... that's terrifying..."

3950862220.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you so much—Miss Lorelei, lady of the Sapphire Isle Auction House, representative of the isle, a woman of unimaginable wealth... and the owner of the most enchanting voice in all of Sapphire Isle!""

3950862221.m_KeyValue: ""Give me a month... no, a week! I'll definitely be able to recreate this craftsmanship...""

3950862222.m_KeyValue: "Right? Now for this beautiful little cat... this set will definitely suit you!"

3950862224.m_KeyValue: ""Rather than explain, why don't you see for yourselves? Though today's auction is almost over.""

3950862225.m_KeyValue: ""Thank you for the explanation, it sounds absolutely extraordinary and not ordinary at all.""

3950862226.m_KeyValue: ""If you can beat my invention, you'll get the 'Grand Prize'... that's how we're supposed to attract customers, right?""

3950862254.m_KeyValue: "Thanks for enlightening someone who's worked on this ship for twenty years."

3950862284.m_KeyValue: ""After he took us away, he only said some strange things... I'm not sure what he's planning.""

3950862285.m_KeyValue: ""This mysterious investigator... could it have been your master, Van Helsing?""

3950862286.m_KeyValue: ""What about you, Miss Ami? Did you have any strange dreams?""

3950862289.m_KeyValue: ""Let them go, or Master Albrecht won't let you off so easily!""

3950862290.m_KeyValue: ""With such conviction, even someone so small can make unthinkable choices and show incredible power in the face of despair.""

3950862319.m_KeyValue: ""Speaking of which, we should visit this place during the holiday.""

3950862320.m_KeyValue: ""...Sorry, I have other matters to investigate.""

3950862321.m_KeyValue: ""I will meet you at the destination, Master!""

3950862346.m_KeyValue: "And who might this little one be?"

3950862347.m_KeyValue: ""Perhaps us standing here is no longer 'reality,' but rather a 'dream.'""

3950862348.m_KeyValue: ""Never mind that now, Silver-haired, don't you feel... it's suddenly gotten very cold?""

3950862349.m_KeyValue: "Could she be that rumored investigator? Looks like she was blackmailing seven people—could it be the Seven Sages?!"

3950862351.m_KeyValue: ""Two fish... They must have been deliberately placed by the killer, but what could it mean?""

3950862352.m_KeyValue: ""There was an olive wreath around his neck, and an olive was forced into his mouth.""

3950862353.m_KeyValue: ""Look, I can't just let a child break into an auction house at night.""

3950862354.m_KeyValue: ""I can look into the missing travelers, but as for the Mistbound Terror...""

3950862377.m_KeyValue: ""That's right, you've been lying to us from the very beginning...""

3950862378.m_KeyValue: "Did Miss Ami see what she most desired? Or perhaps... what she feared most?"

3950862379.m_KeyValue: ""Your advisor is quite the curious one, Miss Ami. You seem very tolerant of your servants.""

3950862382.m_KeyValue: ""To rebuild a new city upon ruins, one must first clear away the rubble, don't you think?""

3950862384.m_KeyValue: "Miss Ami is as defiant as they say."

3950862386.m_KeyValue: ""But... olive leaf and the Peace Bearer... Could there be a connection to the sketch we saw last night, Noah?""

3955201809.m_KeyValue: "The Saint's Descent... so Darcias was an Ascendant all along..."

3955201816.m_KeyValue: "Enough. Don’t let Tris's sacrifice be in vain."

3955201817.m_KeyValue: "Hmph! Don't underestimate what Darcias and I can do together!"

3955201820.m_KeyValue: "So... it's not an egg... Wait! Are you truly the Saint?"

3955201821.m_KeyValue: "Take the black cocoon that seals Death and return to the cathedral."

3955201822.m_KeyValue: "I have no obligation to answer that question."

3955201823.m_KeyValue: "But he's a Calamity! Shouldn't we destroy him completely!? Why are we bringing him back to the Church?"

3955202841.m_KeyValue: "They're blocking our path. Eliminate them and push forward!"

3955202842.m_KeyValue: "Look there! The crystal traces are much more visible in that area!"

3955202843.m_KeyValue: ""As expected, you really have a wolf's nose.""

3955202844.m_KeyValue: "Is this the time to be snarky... Huh?!"

3955202846.m_KeyValue: "It feels like something's burrowing up from underground."

3955203986.m_KeyValue: ""We'll continue what was left unfinished. This time, Van Helsing will conduct them.""

3955203992.m_KeyValue: "Her hatred has never waned—not once across the years."

3955203993.m_KeyValue: "Mark my words. The moment I get the chance... I will kill you."

3955203994.m_KeyValue: "Why do I still feel such hatred when I look at you?"

3955203995.m_KeyValue: "Damn it... I accepted Aeon's Silver Blood... my resolve should be unshakable... So why..."

3955203996.m_KeyValue: ""Not the one you knew. This Piera is her granddaughter. A descendant of the Paracelsus bloodline. Ah, but yes... you've met her already.""

3955203998.m_KeyValue: "Albrecht. The weakest of the Bell Ringers. And yet the greatest alchemist in the world."

3955203999.m_KeyValue: "But she is young. A Bell Ringer who cannot yet master her own power."

3955205010.m_KeyValue: "What just happened... it wasn't an illusion?"

3955205011.m_KeyValue: "It seems someone is eager for you to remember. Very well."

3955205016.m_KeyValue: "The sacred texts forbid a Bell Ringer from striking without cause..."

3955205017.m_KeyValue: "But they say nothing about using the weapons of one who came before."

3955205019.m_KeyValue: "We're not letting you lay a hand on Noah!"

3955205020.m_KeyValue: ""You chose _$$Death_$$—and in doing so, severed your path to life.""

3955205021.m_KeyValue: "If that's how it is... Then you'll all be buried here!"

3955205022.m_KeyValue: "So this is the power... of a Bell Ringer..."

3955205023.m_KeyValue: "Noah... how long will you stay silent in there!?"

3955206164.m_KeyValue: ""To defeat the enemy before me, I will become the blade of my companions.""

3955206165.m_KeyValue: "And I... am both the knight and the blade..."

3955206168.m_KeyValue: "You... have mistaken the relationship between the knight and the blade."

3955206169.m_KeyValue: "And now that blade... is transforming into the knight that will dominate you."

3955206170.m_KeyValue: ""And a blade is called a blade because, guided by the knight's strength, it proves its edge.""

3955206171.m_KeyValue: "A knight becomes a knight because they trust the blade in their hand to carve out their own path."

3955206172.m_KeyValue: ""At this moment, we are the knight and the blade.""

3955206173.m_KeyValue: "Only by retrieving these memories will your soul be complete. And only then... will you be able to use this power to reshape your form."

3955206174.m_KeyValue: ""Yet you had to rely on it to survive in the chaos. Little by little, you became enslaved to the blade.""

3955206175.m_KeyValue: ""Originally, you wielded this blade, but finding it too cruel, you wanted to cast it aside.""

3955207193.m_KeyValue: "I am—and will always be—Noah Nevernight. The vassal saved by Empousa Bathory."

3955207197.m_KeyValue: "At least the part about my identity as Nevernight."

3955207199.m_KeyValue: "No matter how far back my past stretches... What matters is the present."

3955208342.m_KeyValue: ""This feeling, I've felt it before... This is bad!""

3955208344.m_KeyValue: ""First, we stop the Divine Body. Then we find a way for all of us to escape together!""

3955208346.m_KeyValue: "I suppose I'll humor your recklessness for a bit."

3955208348.m_KeyValue: ""If you don't run, then I don't run!""

3955208349.m_KeyValue: ""But if anything bad happens, just run. And don't look back!""

3955208350.m_KeyValue: ""...Well, it appears I'm terrible at persuading people.""

3955208351.m_KeyValue: ""But, you are not Death. You are Noah Nevernight.""

3960394769.m_KeyValue: "Do you really think you can fool us?"

3960394770.m_KeyValue: "Mortals who can't even grasp the true power of Blood are no match for me!"

3960394835.m_KeyValue: ""Even in death, they can still move about?""

3960394866.m_KeyValue: "I'm no sorceress. My name is Empousa."

3960394867.m_KeyValue: "To which clan do you swear loyalty?"

3960534467.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps we'll find out once we reach the source of that sound."

3960534468.m_KeyValue: "Where did these Blood Beasts come from? They're nothing like the ones we faced before."

3960534469.m_KeyValue: "It seems we've reached our first disagreement."

3960534471.m_KeyValue: ""Before I leave, I need to hurry and—""

3960534472.m_KeyValue: "If all goes well... I'll see you on the deck."

3960534474.m_KeyValue: ""Goldland might have truly discovered the secret behind the Landis family's disappearance, something even the Church doesn't know...""

3960535483.m_KeyValue: "Then why do I feel so hot?"

3960535491.m_KeyValue: ""Right, that's Goldland's earring. Did it fall here when the tentacle dragged him away?""

3960535493.m_KeyValue: "What is this feeling...? Like being dragged into the sea..."

3960535495.m_KeyValue: "That was close... Are you sure hiding in a barrel is really going to work?"

3960535497.m_KeyValue: "Only because he was sent flying! There's a massive hole in the ship now!"

3960536638.m_KeyValue: "When I followed him to the long-sealed lower deck... I understood at last."

3960536643.m_KeyValue: ""There's no doubt in my mind. No matter how many years pass, I'll never forget it. This is the other jewel I saw in my dream.""

3960536644.m_KeyValue: ""She told me she received a strange birthday gift—a jewel, deep red and luminous...""

3960536647.m_KeyValue: ""I failed to see how much he'd changed. How much I had missed. I regret not asking sooner about his research, and why he kept it so carefully hidden from me, his Captain, his brother.""

3960536648.m_KeyValue: ""I'd heard his research had made a breakthrough, but in my obsession with the Landis jewel...""

3960536649.m_KeyValue: ""He barely acknowledged the news. Day after day, he continued meeting in secret with Inspector Jones.""

3960536650.m_KeyValue: ""Could our long-held dream finally be realized? I wanted to tell William the moment I saw it, to share in the joy. But...""

3960537661.m_KeyValue: ""And you, the loudmouthed Bloodborn! You're from the Bathory family, aren't you? You lot saw through the Church's lies and turned your backs on them long ago!""

3960537662.m_KeyValue: "That was before I was even 'born'! Why pin that on me!?"

3960537667.m_KeyValue: "If I'm not mistaken... He's a descendant of the Landis family. While Ami is the final heir of its true bloodline."

3960537668.m_KeyValue: ""Landis... That great family engulfed by the sea forty-four years ago? Even if they survived, weren't they meant to be Gravekeepers of the Divine Body? Then why...?""

3960537669.m_KeyValue: ""I had thought, since the Bathory and Ganelon families have severed ties with the Church, you'd understand our family's vision—and the true nature of this world.""

3960537670.m_KeyValue: "H-How do you know about us...?! Who even are you!?"

3960537671.m_KeyValue: ""When you struck down our mistress earlier, you used another Calamity's power, didn't you? You're no different—a fugitive who killed the Gravekeeper and ran.""

3960537672.m_KeyValue: "I... I didn't... That was... I'm not..."

3960537673.m_KeyValue: ""The Gravekeepers... Instead of protecting the Divine Body, they're resurrecting the Calamity? What kind of madness is this?""

3960537674.m_KeyValue: "Hahahaha... You of all people should understand."

3960538816.m_KeyValue: ""But when planks come together, they become a ship. When people come together, we become...""

3960538819.m_KeyValue: "Save your strength for that wretch! I'll clear a path for you."

3960538820.m_KeyValue: "It's trying to rip the ship apart and drag us all into the sea…?"

3960538821.m_KeyValue: "Every plank on this ship is fragile. Every soul aboard is ordinary."

3960538822.m_KeyValue: "I know El Dorado won't last long under its claws. Just like I know I'll never conquer the sea."

3960538823.m_KeyValue: "Who are you looking down on? I was hunting Heretics for the Silver Cross before you were even born... (coughing)"

3960538825.m_KeyValue: ""That monster tearing up our home... It's the same one that's haunted the Captain for over a year, isn't it?""

3960538826.m_KeyValue: "This isn't the time to play the veteran. These wounds… should've killed anyone three times over."

3960539839.m_KeyValue: "Ah... so if I master Sheila's power... I'll grow a thousand wings and become super strong too!"

3960539840.m_KeyValue: "...No. That's not the takeaway. I meant—don't believe every legend you hear. Who would even need that many wings?"

3960539843.m_KeyValue: ""We did it! With Jacintha on our side, maybe Famine really can be defeated!""

3960539844.m_KeyValue: "Don't celebrate yet. The complete form of the Moonblessed Famine… is the legendary Thousand-Mouthed Calamity."

3960539845.m_KeyValue: "What!? So that was just one tongue—there are still over nine hundred more!?"

3960539846.m_KeyValue: ""No need to panic. Legends tend to exaggerate. Take Sheila, another Moonblessed you're familiar with—they call her the Thousand-Winged Calamity.""

3960539847.m_KeyValue: "N-No wonder it suddenly got bigger than the whole ship... So it wasn't even using half its power when it fought me earlier!?"

3960539848.m_KeyValue: "What are we supposed to do now?!"

3960539849.m_KeyValue: ""That little Justice seems to have found a way. Until then, I suppose I'll lend a hand.""

3960540993.m_KeyValue: "Why do you hesitate? Everyone you know is gone. The world you lived in is a fabrication of Aeon's false order. You have nothing left on that side."

3960540994.m_KeyValue: ""Only you remain... Come, Ami. Return to your true homeland.""

3960540995.m_KeyValue: ""As life returns to the sea, so shall we return to your blood, master.""

3960540996.m_KeyValue: "Return to me. Become my strength. Let me shatter this prison-ship that has caged me for a hundred years!"

3960540997.m_KeyValue: ""There's no need. I have Ami and now that I've reclaimed the final drop of Landis blood, nothing can stand in my way.""

3960540998.m_KeyValue: ""Let us raise more Vassals, my Lady. We'll drown this ship in your blood and silence every last defiant soul!""

3960540999.m_KeyValue: "One of my tongues... severed!? Are those worthless rats on this ship trying to resist?"

3960541000.m_KeyValue: "Told you. I did say it would upset your stomach."

3960541002.m_KeyValue: "What good are all these memories if they can't even fill your stomach?"

3968805219.m_KeyValue: ""Glaciers from ancient times melt and converge here, roaring down the slopes into the frigid sea. Bone-chilling winds and icy torrents batter this harsh land, shaping its people into silent, resilient souls who forge blades as sharp and unyielding as the ice itself.""

3969443937.m_KeyValue: ""This is the end of time, the void of oblivion.""

3969443938.m_KeyValue: "I am willing... to accept what destiny has arranged for me..."

3969443945.m_KeyValue: ""Right now, our top priority is to find someone and ask where we are.""

3969443946.m_KeyValue: "It would take billions of years for new life to emerge in the oceans."

3969443947.m_KeyValue: ""D-don't say such frightening things! Maybe it's just a mirage? That's why there's a second 'Temporal Veil' here, right?""

3969443949.m_KeyValue: ""You two... Your relationship changes more than the weather. Well then, I guess I'll lend a hand—""

3969443950.m_KeyValue: "<alpha=#FF>My power... the power of my eyes..."

3969443977.m_KeyValue: ""New timelines... No wonder the Church's members always disappear; no wonder there are so many of 'me'... The Church has created countless new timelines, only to witness their destruction time and time again.""

3969443978.m_KeyValue: "How can we shatter the predestined destruction?"

3969443979.m_KeyValue: "Then... will I be able to come back here in the future?"

3969443981.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Empousa... I'm sorry I couldn't save everyone...""

3969444009.m_KeyValue: ""I promise, I will break the cycle before it awakens again.""

3969444010.m_KeyValue: "Forget the killing... forget duty... you should return to your companions..."

3969444012.m_KeyValue: ""Let's make a promise. I'll definitely come back, and you'll wait for me, okay?""

3969444015.m_KeyValue: ""In the eyes of the gods, he had failed, yet his soul never yielded to fate;""

3970547262.m_KeyValue: ""How troubling... With water like this, my fruit trees don't stand a chance of survival.""

3974133711.m_KeyValue: "That's how Reese II got his chance for revenge."

3977006579.m_KeyValue: "Now then—your turn. What did the silver-haired one leave behind?"

3977556510.m_KeyValue: "I've always wondered... Are Ascendants truly immortal?"

3977556511.m_KeyValue: "Tell me. Why did you and Joan abandon our family?"

3977557534.m_KeyValue: "Who is this guy? Why's the stupid bat all scared of him?"

3977557536.m_KeyValue: "No one else is around... Aiona... Noah... where are you?"

3980651416.m_KeyValue: "So he didn't spare you after all..."

3980651417.m_KeyValue: "Why... can't I touch you? You... you've become a spirit?"

3980651424.m_KeyValue: "Michelangelo? What's next? Da Vinci or Raphael?"

3980651425.m_KeyValue: ""I knew you'd come. You've always been there when I was in trouble, ever since I was little. This time is no different...""

3980651426.m_KeyValue: ""Michelangelo, after you helped Jamie and me escape, did Father... did he give you trouble?""

3980651427.m_KeyValue: ""Stranger, how do you know my child's name?""

3980651428.m_KeyValue: "But Quinn... didn't you promise me you'd never return to this cursed place?"

3980651429.m_KeyValue: ""Silly child, don't worry about me. I'll gladly take on the consequences for your sake.""

3980651431.m_KeyValue: "I've found out where Mother is! She's really..."

3980652440.m_KeyValue: "I... I just hate to see people fighting... Why won't any of you listen to me..."

3980652441.m_KeyValue: ""If you truly wanted to cease the conflict, you shouldn't have helped Tertius...""

3980652448.m_KeyValue: ""And he said he won't fight with Valora anymore. When they fight, it terrifies me... We're family—we should get along.""

3980652449.m_KeyValue: "I'll ask one last time—will you step aside?"

3980652450.m_KeyValue: ""My, my... little Quinn, you impressed me... Is this why you can have such an adorable new friend?""

3980652451.m_KeyValue: "But you're just a half-blood mongrel of Ganelon's inferior bloodline. How could you deserve her?"

3980652453.m_KeyValue: "Very well. Since you have to be so mean to me..."

3980652454.m_KeyValue: "You leave me no choice... but to tear you both to pieces! Then I'll ask Cain to stitch you back together..."

3980652455.m_KeyValue: ""That way, you'll be my playmates forever! Teehee!""

3980653594.m_KeyValue: "But you... you've missed one little step."

3980653595.m_KeyValue: "Hahaha—my brilliant daughter...! I should have ended you in the cradle!"

3980653600.m_KeyValue: ""Exposing your back to a warrior like me... Valora, your arrogance blinds you!""

3980653601.m_KeyValue: ""But you never cared to remember—above all else, I am a warrior!""

3980653602.m_KeyValue: "You saw me as your lackey. A reckless savage. An inferior to the Baphomet."

3980653603.m_KeyValue: "Rise... It means nothing but a hound dressed in silk."

3980653605.m_KeyValue: "It-it won't work... The n-night will guard all Bloodborn..."

3980653606.m_KeyValue: ""From this day forth, I, Tertius, shall rule the Bathory!""

3980653607.m_KeyValue: "I've bent to your will long enough... This game ends tonight."

3980653626.m_KeyValue: "Enough. Go to Bathory Castle and have Cain figure out how to get me back."

3980653627.m_KeyValue: "So this was Elder Tertius's solution to the conflict with Elder Valora? To kill her?"

3980653632.m_KeyValue: "It seems all these causes and effects were intertwined from the very beginning..."

3980653633.m_KeyValue: ""As I record this, it still burns in my mind like a vivid dream.""

3980653634.m_KeyValue: ""Grandpa never said it, but I believe he left that diary on his desk for me to find, setting me on the path to my test and destiny.""

3980653635.m_KeyValue: ""The Gravekeeper Leila—James's wife—must have resonated with the Divine Body and foreseen my arrival, so she entrusted him with that guidance.""

3980653636.m_KeyValue: "I had sent you messages about everything happening in town... secretly along with all the Wolfsbane you needed..."

3980653637.m_KeyValue: "Why did everything still end up like this... Can I still become a Bloodborn?"

3980653638.m_KeyValue: "Those people from the past... did they see the dawn rise?"

3980653639.m_KeyValue: "Sir! Sir! What are you doing here?"

3981363340.m_KeyValue: "But seeing you reminds me of him..."

3981363341.m_KeyValue: ""Because elevating a species full of flaws to godhood would be too dangerous, and besides, I only wanted that one person who's already gone. Everyone else's company means nothing to me.""

3981363345.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps you'll know when the wine is ready next year."

3981363346.m_KeyValue: ""This is not something you should know. We've discussed far too many things we shouldn't have, so if you don't mind, I must ask you to leave.""

3981371930.m_KeyValue: "But there are way too many bugs in the mountains. Ah! Maybe we should..."

3981371931.m_KeyValue: ""Acappella stared straight up at the sky, falling into an unusual silence.""

3981934367.m_KeyValue: ""Then… should I accept your terms, will you and Elder Valora cease the fight?""

3981934368.m_KeyValue: ""So, that's how it is… I had hoped for some new Vassals to entertain me. How dull.""

3981934372.m_KeyValue: ""No more fighting between us... Death is silence, after all.""

3981944095.m_KeyValue: "Just hang in there—I'll fetch the Wolfsbane."

3981944096.m_KeyValue: "...Wait. Where's the basket? The Wolfsbane's gone!"

3981944103.m_KeyValue: "(coughing)... We can't... can't let the others in town... get infected too..."

3981944104.m_KeyValue: "So... you're isolating them in the cave?"

3981944105.m_KeyValue: "Yes. A few of the younger folks and I take shifts looking after them."

3981944106.m_KeyValue: ""Judging from what they just said, they're still lucid—so the infection's recent. But that mutation level... it's far too advanced.""

3981944107.m_KeyValue: "I know! Just yesterday it was a fever and some coughing—now look at them. Usually it takes a week from first symptoms to full mutation... This... this is way too fast."

3981944108.m_KeyValue: "Drinking from the tainted stream alone shouldn't cause such rapid progression..."

3981944110.m_KeyValue: ""Don't be ridiculous! Lady Leila has left us... If I abandon you too, then...""

3981945249.m_KeyValue: ""Tertius, there's no need for war. I've already negotiated a trade: The trespasser in exchange for a thousand Ganelon cattle. That should sustain the ritual for half a year.""

3981945250.m_KeyValue: ""The ritual is still under refinement. Its flaws are mine to bear. Please, Elder Tertius, this matter is beneath your fury.""

3981945255.m_KeyValue: ""Tertius, you're an Elder now. You must learn restraint.""

3981945256.m_KeyValue: ""Unauthorized border crossing is no small matter, but it hardly justifies a declaration of war.""

3981945258.m_KeyValue: "That little traitor's a monster—we can't handle her!"

3981945259.m_KeyValue: ""War is the most direct, most efficient means of obtaining it. I propose war. Any objections?""

3981945260.m_KeyValue: "But the ritual is flawed—weak. It must be fed constantly with flesh and blood."

3981945261.m_KeyValue: ""We turned our backs on the Church, embraced the Black Blood, and in return, were exiled from the light. Only through the <style=""Highlight"">Bloodletting</style> can the daylight be shortened and our bloodline endure.""

3981945262.m_KeyValue: ""Don't mistake me. I do not call for war merely to punish that trespassing mongrel. I speak for the survival of our bloodline—for the <style=""Highlight"">Bloodletting</style>!""

3981948459.m_KeyValue: ""Hey, Cartographer! You may be Father's guest, but don't you go bullying Quinn!""

3981948461.m_KeyValue: "Keep it up and I'll write a footnote in the archives about how you got caught by a Bloodborn and cried your way back to your father!"

3981949605.m_KeyValue: "W-What’s happening?! Why are the infected villagers..."

3981949606.m_KeyValue: "My weapon of war... is already prepared. Even if I perish... I will not squander this chance..."

3981949607.m_KeyValue: "But now—now that you've wounded me... when the villagers see what you've done... Will they not rise up in fury?"

3981949608.m_KeyValue: ""Heh... naive... so naive... Originally, I needed her captured to make my case.""

3981949609.m_KeyValue: ""All your careful calculations—and yet you never saw us coming. Not only will you die here, Ezareth... so will your war.""

3981949611.m_KeyValue: "You preyed upon her love. Squeezed every drop of worth from her title and blood... And now you blame her for refusing to betray her own heart?"

3981949612.m_KeyValue: ""If she had just played her part—undermined Bathory from within, handed me the credit. I wouldn't have had to let her die and spark the war.""

3981949613.m_KeyValue: "To think a few... empty words about love and peace... could ruin years of planning..."

3981949614.m_KeyValue: ""Nora was... the one I loved most. That's no lie... If she'd simply known her place, I'd never have wished her dead.""

3981950637.m_KeyValue: ""Quinn is beside me wearing an expression I can't read—perhaps it's sorrow, perhaps anger, or perhaps a deep sense of helplessness.""

3981950638.m_KeyValue: ""I thought I was nothing more than an outsider, a mere recorder of events. But at this moment, I realize I have become deeply entangled in it all.""

3982650926.m_KeyValue: "What do you think is the real reason you lost your memories after resurrection?"

3982650927.m_KeyValue: ""A rather compelling proposition, wouldn't you agree?""

3983646140.m_KeyValue: ""(Perhaps one day, the wooden one will recover all they have lost.)""

3983646142.m_KeyValue: "But I misunderstood. That's why you said it wasn't the emotion you wanted."

3983646143.m_KeyValue: ""No, I bought it from a street vendor.""

3983646144.m_KeyValue: ""The last time I felt sorrow, I was standing right here.""

3983646145.m_KeyValue: "…Ah. You're attempting to replace Elder Bella through acts of charity."

3988205971.m_KeyValue: "Then let's deal with it before the cave is destroyed."

3990226743.m_KeyValue: "That's not funny! Aeon would never tolerate such sacrilege!"

3990227767.m_KeyValue: "As expected... It seems the lingering memories are controlling the bodies."

3991318437.m_KeyValue: ""Even if I haven't awakened my full power like Ami… if she can do it, so can I!""

3991318438.m_KeyValue: "No way… is it those rats again!?"

3991321636.m_KeyValue: ""No, we seem to have forgotten something—there might be an even more dangerous being...""

3991321637.m_KeyValue: "You've truly grown—solving them with such ease!"

3991321638.m_KeyValue: ""Don't tell me you're scared of thunder, dumb wolf.""

3992846697.m_KeyValue: ""Vassal or talent missing, cannot craft item(s):""

3996785866.m_KeyValue: ""How many years has it been? Spider webs devour loneliness, growing lushly. The locked door still waits for the echo of a knock, while keys scattered across the land seem to be the lingering lament of that great battle.""

3999398906.m_KeyValue: "Complete Lamia's previous stage to claim clue rewards."

4002800142.m_KeyValue: "...and all that pathetic begging and whimpering."

4002800143.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, I'm so sorry! I won't tease you anymore, Noah...""

4002800146.m_KeyValue: ""H-hey, what kind of creepy spell are you casting?!""

4002800147.m_KeyValue: ""Hear the lament of those who sink, who drown, who vanish beneath the dark tide...""

4002800148.m_KeyValue: ""No, no, no! I'm not going back into that pitch-black coffin!""

4002800149.m_KeyValue: ""...Master of the shattered veil, open wide the gates of dreams...""

4002800150.m_KeyValue: ""We Bloodbornhave time to spare, don't we?""

4002800151.m_KeyValue: "Then open the door and end this farce. Or I'll happily nap beside you for the next hundred years."

4002800152.m_KeyValue: "No response... Then I suppose you leave me no choice."

4003459750.m_KeyValue: ""Don't forget, I scored higher than you in physical combat. Gilrain, lead the others out first.""

4003459751.m_KeyValue: ""That's great, Aiona! You scared away all these monsters!""

4003459752.m_KeyValue: "Why does everyone around me slip through my fingers like sand..."

4003459783.m_KeyValue: "Tch... As if you could touch me... It was that... big thing..."

4003460045.m_KeyValue: ""That I do not know, my lady. Please don't worry about that for now. The most important thing is for you to rest and let your eyes recover.""

4003460077.m_KeyValue: "I can't let my guard down. I should check again."

4003460078.m_KeyValue: "It couldn't be... Why didn't Sandra say anything?!"

4003460079.m_KeyValue: "Such a lively market... I've never seen anything like this in our lands."

4003460080.m_KeyValue: "What lively sounds! Is there a market outside?"

4003460109.m_KeyValue: "What's going on? Why are there assassins in the forbidden grounds?!"

4003460111.m_KeyValue: "What's going on? Who are these people?"

4003460112.m_KeyValue: "...I see. Let's go to 'that place' then."

4003460145.m_KeyValue: ""My lady, there's no need to rush—""

4003460178.m_KeyValue: ""The assassin! That's right, I must find the assassin and save Father...""

4003460179.m_KeyValue: "You still wish to fight? You can barely hold your weapon! Wait... Are you trying to push your limits even further? Are you insane?! You'll die too!"

4003460211.m_KeyValue: ""Why... Why was I given this power, and still unable to change anything? What's the meaning of it all...""

4003460243.m_KeyValue: "Can you two stop bickering at a time like this...?"

4006173699.m_KeyValue: "Deals True DMG equal to {1} of Max HP every {0} sec to enemy units on burning tiles."

4012165185.m_KeyValue: ""To ensure her survival, I chose to sacrifice myself, breaking down my body and blood into nutrients for Hati. That was the moment I said my goodbye to her.""

4012165186.m_KeyValue: "You silly girl... we're your family. We'd do everything to protect you."

4012165188.m_KeyValue: ""Clive Jr., Gadric, and Sheila... Everyone wanted you to move forward. Yet it was precisely these bonds that kept you trapped in past regrets.""

4013674541.m_KeyValue: "They say she died in the same fire that gave me new life. Their deaths became part of my return. Isn't that its own kind of devouring?"

4013674542.m_KeyValue: ""As for the _$$four names,_$$ they must be the four identities I've lived through—just as I told you.""

4013674543.m_KeyValue: ""_$$Three siblings gone before their prime, devoured—his mourning etched in time. Four names he wore in borrowed skin, his shame engraved beneath his grin._$$""

4013674544.m_KeyValue: ""The _$$three siblings_$$ must refer to the Carrelle children. Those who tried to save us slaves, even defying their own blood. Especially the Second Princess...""

4013674545.m_KeyValue: ""I already know the tales of the slave and the Bell Ringer. The Poet of Flame is well known, too. But the chancellor…""

4013674546.m_KeyValue: ""After my resurrection, I found myself gifted with power beyond mortal men. And I never forgot who had stood with us… and who had not.""

4013674547.m_KeyValue: "Slave. Chancellor. Bell Ringer. The Poet of Flame..."

4013674551.m_KeyValue: ""So, I backed the Third Prince of Carrelle—the one who tried to save the slaves. Together, we overthrew the old and founded the new Carrelle nobility. Would you call that gratitude? Or revenge?""

4013674552.m_KeyValue: "More than either. What you did was a revolution. Now I see why you were chosen as a Bell Ringer."

4018031298.m_KeyValue: "My abilities allow me to heal your injuries to a certain degree."

4018031300.m_KeyValue: "What... What does that vile creature plan to do?!"

4018031304.m_KeyValue: "A tough opponent... But don't forget we still have two Bloodsouls!"

4018031305.m_KeyValue: ""As long as you stand in front of me, the Revert ability will help block a portion of attacks.""

4018037570.m_KeyValue: ""Pay attention. After Blood Augmentation is activated, <style=""Highlight"">my attacks can ricochet, dealing DMG to more enemies</style>.""

4019293360.m_KeyValue: ""As long as the family name remains unsullied, the decision is yours.""

4019294515.m_KeyValue: "These decisions should be left to you young people."

4019295538.m_KeyValue: "You're wasting my time with such trivialities?"

4019297716.m_KeyValue: ""Without a prior case for reference, perhaps relying on intuition is also an option.""

4019299894.m_KeyValue: "It's time you learned to make your own judgments."

4019898823.m_KeyValue: "Tap [Start Verification] below to scan and verify your local game files. Please wait for the verification to complete before closing. Interrupting may cause problems."

4019898824.m_KeyValue: "Verify whether this game is properly installed."

4022716478.m_KeyValue: ""The spread of the plague is inevitable, and the fallen Blood Beasts will recover even faster.""

4022716509.m_KeyValue: "Chop down this giant mushroom. Maybe it can stop the swarm of werewolves."

4022951156.m_KeyValue: "Are you two done? Can we get out of this disgusting valley now?"

4022951157.m_KeyValue: "Uh... I'll take that as a compliment..."

4022952180.m_KeyValue: ""When the sun wakes up, the dream of the moon will disappear, and our existence will be forgotten along with it.""

4022952181.m_KeyValue: "That bat turned into a woman! Another heretic?!"

4023489359.m_KeyValue: ""Look over there. The mechanism's colors match the door, like two sides of the Lovers card.""

4023489588.m_KeyValue: "Take action and claim the fruits of victory!"

4023491436.m_KeyValue: "One way to increase a Vassal's Affinity LV. is through touching and interactions."

4023491502.m_KeyValue: ""By resolving contingencies, gathering supplies, and completing your arduous journey, you stand a chance at uncovering the true nature of things.""

4023491735.m_KeyValue: ""Though the family remains in a state of disarray, the many facilities built during its golden era are still accessible in the castle.""

4023492494.m_KeyValue: ""Our family has long adhered to the First Tenet of Secrecy: Seclusion. Should we truly wish to restore our past glory, Vassals must be dispatched to expand our influence.""

4023494637.m_KeyValue: "This castle was built long ago. It’s understandable that Lady Empousa isn't familiar with it."

4023736525.m_KeyValue: "Tip: Continue to cast Ultimates to activate more Moon Phases."

4024857511.m_KeyValue: ""Treasures? The Captain and the others always said the sea held countless treasures. That's why they felt so free, so happy, every time they set sail.""

4024857512.m_KeyValue: "Those treasures at sea... Were they actually us?"

4026689795.m_KeyValue: ""What are your thoughts on 'investigating the Church's true reasons for mining the meteorites, despite the risks involved'?""

4026691973.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'allowing vassals to keep pets other than Blood Servants'?"

4026695044.m_KeyValue: "What are your thoughts on 'proposing an alliance with the conservative Bloodborn faction'?"

4027038703.m_KeyValue: "Pass unlocked! Upgrade to unlock extra rewards."

4028988534.m_KeyValue: ""Agnes, there's no need to argue. I'm the one who... made the wrong bet.""

4028988535.m_KeyValue: ""It was despicable of Ezareth to exploit his people. But you... you've gone even lower, plotting to drain every last drop of blood from your own daughter.""

4028988537.m_KeyValue: "Take them to the dungeon... execute them at once! I never want to see their faces again."

4028988539.m_KeyValue: ""Souls yield, their devotion marred by beast...""

4028988540.m_KeyValue: ""No… I've long known the bridge is doomed to collapse, and patching frayed ropes is but a futile gesture. If he is set on war, then my interference will only serve as kindling for his wrath.""

4028988541.m_KeyValue: ""You're not... going to chase after your father, are you?""

4028988542.m_KeyValue: ""Indeed. And likewise, we Bloodborn rely on moonlight to revive our powers.""

4028988543.m_KeyValue: "The Ganelons... they're using moonlight to draw out the werewolves' primal nature."

4028989558.m_KeyValue: "I care neither about his motives nor whether I'm being used."

4028989559.m_KeyValue: ""I only know we must stop this war as soon as possible, so we cannot waste any more time here.""

4028989562.m_KeyValue: "The future of the Bathory is woven by my hands alone… not for anyone else to shape."

4028998262.m_KeyValue: ""And lately, you've been locked in a territorial dispute with the Bathory in the south over the Moontide Canal... right?""

4028998270.m_KeyValue: ""I am James Mouret. Lady Leila sent me to receive you, Ganelon's Future Envoy...?""

4028998271.m_KeyValue: ""(Clears throat) Hello, I'm Agnes Ganelon—licensed professional cartographer!""

4028998272.m_KeyValue: "(Grandfather never said there'd be someone waiting for me during a temporal survey... This is incredible!)"

4028998273.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, you're not denying it? You... you really are from the future??""

4028998274.m_KeyValue: ""My beloved Leila instructed me to meet an envoy from the future here in the depths of the cave, on the eve of the full moon—I thought she spoke in jest.""

4028998276.m_KeyValue: ""For instance, I know that in this era, the Lupine Forest has been ravaged by the scourges, and even the last water spring is nearly gone... am I right?""

4028999416.m_KeyValue: "Wha—?! I can do that?! I'm that powerful?!"

4028999417.m_KeyValue: ""Go on then, young man! Be the hero and rescue the damsel!""

4028999422.m_KeyValue: "Why are you helping me? Aren't you afraid... of my fangs?"

4028999424.m_KeyValue: ""My father may be... well, not the most reliable person, but he knows everyone in town! I'm sure he can help us find something!""

4028999425.m_KeyValue: ""Come with me to Mouret! Maybe... just maybe... she's there, waiting for you!""

4028999426.m_KeyValue: "But... how do we leave... If only I had summoning powers like Mom..."

4028999427.m_KeyValue: "Don't worry. I'll figure out a way to get you out of here!"

4028999428.m_KeyValue: "Anyone who says no to that is good in my book—fangs or not. You're a good person!"

4028999429.m_KeyValue: ""Not one bit! While you were asleep, those chatty bats told me everything. I heard you were imprisoned for refusing to drink human blood!""

4029000441.m_KeyValue: "That's absurd. Lord Ezareth withdrew from the front lines decades ago—after the war with the Bathory!"

4029000446.m_KeyValue: ""That's enough, lass. Johannes, whatever your reasons, your crimes are unforgivable.""

4029000447.m_KeyValue: "Mark my words: you will pay for what you've done."

4029000448.m_KeyValue: ""And so what if I do?! Without power, you can't even claim a drop of water! What does a Gravekeeper do, huh? Die guarding meaningless rules? The Bathory control half the Moontide Canal, why shouldn't we take back what's ours?!""

4029000449.m_KeyValue: "Stop changing the subject. This has nothing to do with your betrayal. You poisoned your people."

4029000450.m_KeyValue: "N-No... It wasn't just me... I was following orders..."

4029000452.m_KeyValue: "I spared your life so you could speak."

4029000453.m_KeyValue: "Now talk. Why did you do it?"

4029001594.m_KeyValue: ""From what little they revealed, i-it seems their lord intends to use your disappearance in Bathory territory as a pretext to launch an assault.""

4029001595.m_KeyValue: "Everything happened so fast just now. I couldn't make sense of what they were shouting. Why would they suddenly try to capture me?"

4029001599.m_KeyValue: "M-Maybe we should... report back to Lord Ezareth first. Th-This is far beyond us..."

4029001600.m_KeyValue: ""I thought that leaving the castle would grant us safety... But even here, the shadows run deep.""

4029001601.m_KeyValue: "The cave... it's just up ahead. They house the sick there... Most folks avoid it... afraid of infection. We'll be safe... at least for a while..."

4029001602.m_KeyValue: "She's not just using Crowley magic. Look beneath her cloak... the hem... That's something a Bathory would wear..."

4029001604.m_KeyValue: "W-What...? A hybrid... of Crowley and Bathory blood? That's... impossible..."

4029002618.m_KeyValue: ""Jamie would've been safe, if not for me. I owe him more than I can repay.""

4029002619.m_KeyValue: ""(So it's true… The Cartographer's journal was right. Even in this era, the Bathory have already pledged themselves to the Black Blood…)""

4029002622.m_KeyValue: "Jamie told me you saved his life. Thank you—for protecting my son when I could not."

4029002623.m_KeyValue: ""I am Bathory by blood, yes. But I mean no harm to anyone in Lupine Forest.""

4029002624.m_KeyValue: "Jamie was gathering Wolfsbane when he was captured by my family. We met in the dungeon. He spoke of someone here—someone who might hold the answers I seek. So we escaped."

4029002625.m_KeyValue: ""When we arrived in town, we were ambushed by men wielding pitchforks. They tried to seize us both. We fled here for safety.""

4029002626.m_KeyValue: "Hey! What's with that tone? Don't treat Quinn like she's some criminal!"

4029002627.m_KeyValue: ""She's a Bloodborn, but she doesn't attack people, and she never drinks human blood. That's why her own kind cast her out. Don't judge her without knowing anything!""

4029002628.m_KeyValue: ""It's all right, Jamie. It's only natural. Humans have every reason to fear us.""

4029003772.m_KeyValue: ""Then what of my mother's assassination by the Bathory? Could that not have been the first of your schemes—your chosen _$$reason_$$ to rally support, just as you're trying to make me one of your _$$reasons_$$...""

4029003773.m_KeyValue: "And capturing a so-called invading Bloodborn... That's your crafted reason to rouse the people."

4029003774.m_KeyValue: "So you revealed the truth just to shake my resolve... to make me easier to capture."

4029003775.m_KeyValue: ""Let me teach you something: to ignite war and win hearts, one must stand on the righteous ground. Without the people's favor, even the boldest ambition withers alone.""

4029003776.m_KeyValue: ""You're from Mouret, aren't you? That explains it. The greatest flaw of you forest folk… is your lack of subtlety.""

4029003777.m_KeyValue: ""If you want war so badly, why not just declare it outright? Why stoop to such underhanded schemes?""

4029003778.m_KeyValue: "After all... the people do love a righteous war."

4029003779.m_KeyValue: "Now a Bloodborn questions a lord of Ganelon. Am I not within my right to detain her?"

4029003780.m_KeyValue: "A child picks flowers across the Moontide Canal and the Bathory take him hostage."

4029004796.m_KeyValue: ""Jamie, James, thank you for helping me find out about my mother. This letter is the greatest gift I've ever received.""

4029004797.m_KeyValue: ""Agnes, thank you for standing up for me against Ezareth earlier. If we had met under different circumstances... I believe we could have been great friends.""

4029004798.m_KeyValue: ""If that's how it turns out, I'll find another way.""

4029004799.m_KeyValue: "A way? What way could there be when either side refuses to stop fighting..."

4029004800.m_KeyValue: ""Yes, Quinn can stop that armor, while Father and I work on finding a way to stop everyone from the Ganelon!""

4029004801.m_KeyValue: ""No, it's too risky. The Baphomets have always been unrelenting, even in ancient times. If they've decided to attack the Ganelon, intervening now will only provoke him further.""

4029004802.m_KeyValue: ""If father and mother truly loved each other, and he learned the truth about mother's death, his hatred for the Ganelons is understandable...""

4029004803.m_KeyValue: ""But with this letter, perhaps I can help him see beyond his hatred. Maybe Mother's wish will open his eyes and change his heart. I want to take this chance...""

4029004804.m_KeyValue: ""To honor that conviction... you mean to stop your own father? Quinn, this is a blood feud that's been going on between our families for generations.""

4029004805.m_KeyValue: ""Ezareth has fallen. Among the Bathory, only the Baphomet line under my father still calls for war. If I can reach him, perhaps one side will finally lay down their arms.""

4038816201.m_KeyValue: "An advanced detector with a slightly different performance focus than Type I."

4045179326.m_KeyValue: ""Once your DMG reaches a certain threshold, you'll unlock the next fragment.""

4050513948.m_KeyValue: "Wait... My crown... The Temporal Veil is gone..."

4050513951.m_KeyValue: "Take the others... go... carry our blessings... to..."

4050513953.m_KeyValue: ""I am the vessel of these eyes, a puppet of fate...""

4050514214.m_KeyValue: "Ready the forceps... to extract the terminal arteriole..."

4050514215.m_KeyValue: ""The lord is not here, my lady. You shouldn't speak too much; your eyes need time to recover. Please rest for now.""

4050514216.m_KeyValue: ""My lady, you shouldn't speak too much; your eyes need time to recover. Please rest for—""

4050514245.m_KeyValue:
""Assassins cloaked in the night's embrace, their ambition in darkness concealed;
The Alitas unrivaled glory, in one night to dust and ashes did yield;""

4050514276.m_KeyValue: "I want to discuss how to deal with those assassins with Father first. Have the elders come later."

4050514277.m_KeyValue: "These monsters... Did they used to be the servants and guards?"

4050514279.m_KeyValue: "They might have more accomplices lying in wait elsewhere."

4050514309.m_KeyValue: "<alpha=#FF>Is that what I have to do to save my father?"

4050514313.m_KeyValue: "Nothing... How did I do it before?"

4050514315.m_KeyValue: "If the eyes are the Alita family's duty... and the family's honor... and what everyone values the most..."

4050514344.m_KeyValue: "Whether you want to tell me or not..."

4050514346.m_KeyValue: "Isn't it time for the Alita family to return what they borrowed?"

4050514347.m_KeyValue: "If only... If only I could have done something different!"

4050514379.m_KeyValue: "Isn't it time for the Alita family to return what they borrowed?"

4050514410.m_KeyValue: ""My last memory... is us preventing Agares from drawing power from the Black Blood in Starfall Valley. Then a calamity struck, and after that...""

4050514411.m_KeyValue: "Same with my Covenant. Could it be that divine light cannot shine upon this wasteland..."

4053891163.m_KeyValue: ""So let us decide right now, who is right and who is wrong!""

4053891164.m_KeyValue: "You have trampled upon so many lives! Aeon will never let a heretic like you go!"

4053891165.m_KeyValue: "H-how much longer will it take? I'm too scared to look down... or up!"

4053899349.m_KeyValue: "I can feel... her pain... and despair?"

4053902286.m_KeyValue: "I was merely acting according to my duty."

4054947419.m_KeyValue: ""Though, if I'm being selfish… I'd prefer if the spirits weren't eavesdropping.""

4055182820.m_KeyValue: ""Centuries ago, I indiscriminately hunted humans and Bloodborn alike, believing myself to be the one above all.""

4055189849.m_KeyValue: "Ah! Could it be a treasure map for this strange castle!?"

4055475600.m_KeyValue: "I become whoever you need me to be."

4055475602.m_KeyValue: "Death returns to hallowed soil. The Four Calamities converge as one. And the hour of judgment begins."

4055475603.m_KeyValue: "My kin of Dracula's blood… I can hear your heartbeats. Feel your breath."

4055475604.m_KeyValue: ""I'm far too old for battle. As in all my work with the Church, I seek only to heal, to evolve, to preserve.""

4055475605.m_KeyValue: "I don't need you telling me how to fight!!"

4055475606.m_KeyValue: "Hate you? I'm relieved! I was worried you were planning some horrible betrayal. This is way better."

4055475607.m_KeyValue: "That's it? I was kind of hoping to test my powers against a Bell Ringer."

4055475608.m_KeyValue: "She only assisted at my institute. I never taught her anything. Her true mentor… is Saint Seth."

4055475609.m_KeyValue: "Because I know… The Bathory betrayed the Church. They destroyed the Divine Body they were sworn to protect."

4058106505.m_KeyValue: "The following Vassals grant a higher chance of Extra Rewards in Twilight Path."

4059019177.m_KeyValue: "An advanced CPU that adapts performance in real-time."

4059833894.m_KeyValue: "The Church has always emphasized that the Black Blood disease was God's punishment upon the heretics."

4059833896.m_KeyValue: "But... what if they're no longer... human?"

4059833897.m_KeyValue: ""But from where I stand, you're just running away. If you truly admire their father so much, why not help them?""

4059833898.m_KeyValue: ""Sir Gadric, Vice-Commander to the Bell Ringer Dr. Thibault.""

4059834192.m_KeyValue: ""The Ganelon and Bathory families have been at odds for generations, likely due to the ongoing territorial disputes on the Howling Peninsula.""

4059834193.m_KeyValue: "Don't think some nice words will make up for the trouble you put us through!"

4059834194.m_KeyValue: "Why are you staring at me... And did that thing on your head just stick up?!"

4059834223.m_KeyValue: "How can we be certain you'll keep your word?"

4059834227.m_KeyValue: "I think Sir Gadric has someone more important to find. He shouldn't trouble us any further."

4059834254.m_KeyValue: ""According to an ancient Bloodborn prophecy, when all of the Moonblessed of the apocalypse are gathered, the moon will open a passage to welcome her children home.""

4059834255.m_KeyValue: "Forbidden grounds... Sounds like it's full of secrets. The moon we're looking for might very well be hidden there."

4059834257.m_KeyValue: "Why was I born into this world as something unwanted? I want to uncover the 'truth.'"

4059834258.m_KeyValue: "You're both bickering like children. Don't add fuel to the fire."

4059834259.m_KeyValue: ""Are you feeling unwell again? Hang on a bit longer. These three don't seem to be bad people, even if one of them is super annoying.""

4059834260.m_KeyValue: "Damn it... What the hell is the Church doing?! Attacking our town out of nowhere!"

4059834261.m_KeyValue: "Why am I running into all these weirdos today?"

4059834290.m_KeyValue: ""We know nothing about Mouret's current situation, let alone the location of the forbidden grounds.""

4059834292.m_KeyValue: "What's the big deal? I heard the Ganelon clan also has people who can suppress the Black Blood and control their 'beast form.'"

4059834293.m_KeyValue: "I can sense it. The prejudice and hostility between your two families runs deep."

4059834318.m_KeyValue: ""It seems he... admires you, Noah. Apart from his father, I've never seen him like this before...""

4059834323.m_KeyValue: "It seems we have another girl who's not honest with herself."

4059834324.m_KeyValue: ""Hah, stop playing the hero, brat. This purge of Mouret is led by the legendary Bell Ringer herself. None of you are getting away.""

4059834325.m_KeyValue: ""Let's get one thing straight, you dumb wolf. I'm not helping you. I just hate these Church bastards, as always!""

4059834353.m_KeyValue: ""I've just heard about it. Unfortunately... Wolfsbane's main effect is to suppress the mutation, but it's not a cure.""

4059834354.m_KeyValue: "It's those soldiers who attacked our town earlier!"

4059834356.m_KeyValue: "So you really intend to take him to the Ashen Garden? That's where generations of Ganelon family's Gravekeepers are laid to rest."

4059834382.m_KeyValue: ""Hati, Clive, you must leave Lupine Forest with me while there's still time!""

4059834385.m_KeyValue: ""What the... I don't remember being protected by anyone. But you don't seem like an enemy, so just don't get in my way!""

4059834386.m_KeyValue: "Father never looks at me unless we're talking about the Gravekeeper stuff... Am I really his son?"

4059834387.m_KeyValue: ""Father never told me about this, but whatever he's willing to spend his life protecting must be an incredibly important secret.""

4060007601.m_KeyValue: "It is not the Daily Refresh time yet."

4064805738.m_KeyValue: ""Promise me, Noah. You must live on.""

4064805741.m_KeyValue: ""(Cinematic Subtitles) No matter how long it takes, I will wait for you... to welcome you home.""

4064806762.m_KeyValue: ""You just told me you're sick, and you only wish to live.""

4064806763.m_KeyValue: ""Black Blood is an incurable plague, so you're not after <style=""Highlight"">a cure</style>, are you? You're looking for <style=""Highlight"">another way</style>, such as...""

4064806764.m_KeyValue: ""<style=""Highlight"">Transferring your memories to a new body...</style>""

4064810094.m_KeyValue: "The 'rest' you mentioned before... did you mean..."

4064810096.m_KeyValue: ""Well, it seems like the answer is falling out of the sky.""

4064810097.m_KeyValue: ""Yeah, there are no bones or anything. It's like their remains just vanished.""

4064811110.m_KeyValue: "The Bathorys were once one of the High Priest's staunchest allies. I should escort you home safely myself."

4064811111.m_KeyValue: ""That won't be necessary. Noah, let's go!""

4064811114.m_KeyValue: ""A <style=""Highlight"">Bell Ringer</style> of the Church—The Poet of Flame, Agares Brennholt.""

4064811115.m_KeyValue: "He was being escorted by a Bell Ringer!? Why wasn't this in Cain's intel!"

4064811116.m_KeyValue: ""Now this is unexpected, meeting the ladies of the long-lost Bathory family in such a place. I'm honored.""

4064811117.m_KeyValue: ""Since you know we're from the Bathory family, then stay out of our way! We're leaving!""

4064811118.m_KeyValue: ""How someone treats their promises determines the color of their soul. If you don't honor them, your execution will produce a very unpleasant fire to look at.""

4064811119.m_KeyValue: "That's rich coming from the person trying to kill me."

4064811120.m_KeyValue: ""Well, I also made a promise to <style=""Highlight"">a certain someone</style> that I would burn you alive with my own hands. You should curse fate for pitting us in this tragic play.""

4065063494.m_KeyValue: "Yet you still share this wine with me."

4065063496.m_KeyValue: "Inviting me to drink wine under the moonlight... It seems you haven't found that person."

4065063497.m_KeyValue: "Because you never forgot about that earring and the promise it carries."

4071296979.m_KeyValue: "There are traces of a landslide here. It's likely the heavy rain washed away the bridge."

4071304272.m_KeyValue: ""I could not pinpoint the moment, it might be even earlier than I thought. If only my powers were more developed...""

4075506542.m_KeyValue: "Nowhere to hide... So this is it..."

4077079506.m_KeyValue:
"Every path is different; only you can choose the right one.
The spider comforted itself with these thoughts."

4077079508.m_KeyValue: "There's a carriage moving ahead. Should I take the leap and catch a ride?"

4077079509.m_KeyValue:
"'My abilities aren't as basic as they seem!'
The mechanical spider snickered as it hitched a ride."

4077079538.m_KeyValue:
""'The way of the spider is to always pursue a stronger self.'
In this moment, the mechanical spider became a hero.""

4077079539.m_KeyValue: ""A group of mechanical spiders surrounds a tree that has fallen in the middle of the road, waiting for a hero to come. Rev your engines and push the tree aside?""

4077079541.m_KeyValue:
""Waiting and waiting, waiting and waiting...
Our hero is going to appear, right?""

4082217594.m_KeyValue: "And before the endless night of fate descends. The maiden has already made her silent vow:"

4082217599.m_KeyValue: "If I died and turned to bones too... Who would remember my mother? My grandmother? Anyone from our bloodline?"

4085240191.m_KeyValue: "The chest is locked. It seems the 'Wheel of Fortune' has one more trial."

4085272034.m_KeyValue: "I will do everything in my power to protect everyone!"

4090059501.m_KeyValue: ""You helped revive my silver-haired friend, led him to Famine and Plague. For that, I'm grateful.""

4090059502.m_KeyValue: ""It was Seth who tattled to god. Seized victory without a fight, and took the world as Aeon's agent.""

4090059503.m_KeyValue: "That is the true source of your power."

4090059504.m_KeyValue: "What you're implying is… you command time itself? As the Saint once did?"

4090059505.m_KeyValue: "Noah keeps running into powerful foes... yet you show no concern."

4090059506.m_KeyValue: ""Besides, I'm sure you're eager to see how it all plays out. After all, your beloved Commander has been drawn into this conflict.""

4090060521.m_KeyValue: ""Congratulations on your rebirth, my Master. The Blood Moon shall rise for you, and your wings shall forever eclipse the sun.""

4090060522.m_KeyValue: "Let us settle our score... next time."

4090060523.m_KeyValue: ""I must admit, four individuals have grown far beyond my calculations. But they've all... paid the price already.""

4090060524.m_KeyValue: ""In those brief moments, the outside world... has likely experienced several days already.""

4090060525.m_KeyValue: ""I won't forget her, I won't forget any of my companions, I won't forget the will of those who sacrificed themselves in this fight. So...""

4090060526.m_KeyValue: ""I thought after seeing countless futures, I would no longer hope for anything beyond what was preordained.""

4090060527.m_KeyValue: "Because I am Death... the stillness to which all life must return. Must I face this fate as well?"

4090060528.m_KeyValue: ""...The moon is the sun's dream. When she awakens, this dream will disappear, and our existence will be forgotten along with it.""

4090060529.m_KeyValue: "Don't you find this quite an interesting coincidence?"

4091351157.m_KeyValue: "Cain and the others plan to sacrifice her to awaken the Scourge—the Long Night herself: Limine Bathory!"

4091351158.m_KeyValue: "And you—only here because Lord Agares revived you with his flames."

4091351159.m_KeyValue: "Oh? So the castle rats followed us after all."

4091351161.m_KeyValue: ""What does life or death even mean to a suit of armor without flesh... Or a puppet, with four arms and two companions?""

4093524927.m_KeyValue: "Deploy Vassals from the Embrace until the Lineup is complete."

4095076356.m_KeyValue: "I can't... I need to catch my breath..."

4097521954.m_KeyValue: ""Can we pick another one? I'm done with these worn-out, third-rate stories.""

4097524132.m_KeyValue: "Is this supposed to be some kind of joke?"

4097525287.m_KeyValue: "I'm afraid this isn't my domain of expertise."

4097526310.m_KeyValue: "A tricky hand we've been dealt... Let's not play our cards too hastily."

4097527465.m_KeyValue: "Both sides have their merits and drawbacks. It's a real dilemma."

4097528488.m_KeyValue: "What's the hurry? Let me think for a moment."

4102236987.m_KeyValue: "And what of your human life? Are you really sure of who you are?"

4102529769.m_KeyValue: "Do you truly have the courage to witness each Scourge aroused by the final judgment? Do you truly understand what that means…?"

4102529770.m_KeyValue: "(coughing) As expected from the Chamber of War's leader. You must be one of the strongest Bell Ringers."

4102529771.m_KeyValue: ""You're a good per—I mean, you're a good tree.""

4102529772.m_KeyValue: "That’s right! We’ll send that smug old codger hiding in the back flying!"

4102529773.m_KeyValue: "We both come from the same family background! Why did you have to run off with those smelly bats!? You should've joined us!"

4102529775.m_KeyValue: "Aiona... is what that blue-skinned person said true?"

4102529776.m_KeyValue: ""Back at the Ganelon Forbidden Grounds, you mentioned your family had guarded a Divine Body for generations. But why call it your enemy?""

4105496190.m_KeyValue: "Units can be Bound to the Mucus Mat"

4107010773.m_KeyValue:
"'Protecting yourself also takes courage—don't bear too much weight for others.'
This statement is true indeed."

4107010802.m_KeyValue:
""'No spider is perfect; what matters is moving forward.'
Even after a hard fall, this spider remains optimistic. Right?""

4108488582.m_KeyValue: "Transfer Code unavailable: Account bound to a third-party."

4110090440.m_KeyValue: ""They lack strategy, yet their attacks are oddly well-coordinated.""

4111382093.m_KeyValue: "You saved us. We'd have been wiped out without ever lifting a blade."

4111382094.m_KeyValue: "Could that flash of light have driven him off...?"

4111382095.m_KeyValue: ""There was a massive blast where you were, then a blinding flash of light.""

4112152361.m_KeyValue: "I suppose when the heart stops beating."

4113693993.m_KeyValue: "No... not yet. Too many people are counting on me. I can't give up on the 'present' yet."

4114639717.m_KeyValue: "This tree looks like an ideal spot to hide things."

4117061395.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, Mira... May the wind bring you peace!""

4117061404.m_KeyValue: ""Sorry, but I can't bring myself to hurt my former comrades, even in this state...""

4117061405.m_KeyValue: ""But if you need someone to cover you, leave it to me!""

4117061408.m_KeyValue: ""They were once Inquisition Knights, likely accompanied by priests well-versed in arcane rites. If you cross paths with them, be on guard against their ranged sorcery!""

4117911767.m_KeyValue: "This isn't the place to talk. Follow me to the family hall."

4118307664.m_KeyValue: ""Why do I feel like I've seen her somewhere before, and just now she...""

4120559066.m_KeyValue: "But my work is actually quite interesting."

4120559069.m_KeyValue: ""Though it may be boring at times, it's a responsibility I must face.""

4123852364.m_KeyValue: "We were never allowed near these ruins before... I never imagined they'd end up like this..."

4123852365.m_KeyValue: "I'm drained... but I can't fall here—not now..."

4123935411.m_KeyValue: "Miss Bella specially prepared this limited-time Mystery Gift for you!"

4126778551.m_KeyValue: ""They heard me... So, we really do have a choice.""

4126784557.m_KeyValue: "Very well. Let’s face what comes next together."

4126786735.m_KeyValue: "Save your gratitude. I'm merely adhering to my principles."

4126787756.m_KeyValue: "Not bad. It seems we’re cut from the same cloth."

4126791848.m_KeyValue: "Your insight is a rarity in these times."

4128151582.m_KeyValue: ""Get up, and come at me again!""

4128151583.m_KeyValue: "It wasn't supposed to end like this..."

4133669742.m_KeyValue: "(Cinematic Subtitles) Go and piece together the moon."

4133669744.m_KeyValue: "Damn you! How dare a bastard like that find peace!"

4133669745.m_KeyValue: ""By human standards, we died long ago. Now we're just memories trapped in this world.""

4134612340.m_KeyValue: ""Hati is like a black lotus, quietly awaiting her moment of flourishing.""

4134969584.m_KeyValue: "Is she going through a rebellious phase? I hope her recklessness doesn't affect our plans."

4138405325.m_KeyValue: "What?! How do you know of that!?"

4138405326.m_KeyValue: "No wonder I sense someone tailing us..."

4138405327.m_KeyValue: "Must be all those high-grade relics I so kindly sold him."

4138405328.m_KeyValue: ""Oh, don't mind me. I'm sure the he has plenty of nostalgic words to share.""

4139907417.m_KeyValue: "I will burn your remains to celebrate the new dawn of my homeland."

4139907418.m_KeyValue: "Has the endless war not yet worn out the night? So be it."

4139907419.m_KeyValue: ""I will return to that future, the future meant for us.""

4139907420.m_KeyValue: "The shield of the Aegis will never falter!"

4140627292.m_KeyValue: ""Someone once said this of me: 'He always has something concealed, but he never lies.'—I've always taken pride in that, even made it my life's motto.""

4140627293.m_KeyValue: "Who are you?! And what do you mean?"

4140627294.m_KeyValue: ""And this hot-tempered lady must be No. 66, who has a name but hasn't revealed it yet?""

4140627295.m_KeyValue: ""Unfortunately, I'm not an elder. I'm just an ordinary alchemist, and I suppose also the steward of this family.""

4140627297.m_KeyValue: ""Since you're so insistent, I'll give you the chance to reveal your own name, No. 66.""

4140627324.m_KeyValue: ""Damn it—66, don't just stand there, run!""

4140627327.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, 79, for deceiving you all this time...""

4140627358.m_KeyValue: ""Since you're already here, why not give it a try?""

4140627359.m_KeyValue: "I don't understand a word you're saying..."

4140627360.m_KeyValue: "D-don't say that... Didn't we... agree to escape together once all seven of us got here? We need to get along..."

4140627361.m_KeyValue: ""Let's go, Lamia. Let's return to our homeland together—carrying this hope and promise.""

4140627362.m_KeyValue: ""As expected of the perfect vessel, No. 79.""

4141226968.m_KeyValue: "Now I can't help but wonder… the next letter I receive…"

4141226969.m_KeyValue: "Only then would that letter appear on my desk."

4163796948.m_KeyValue: ""Everything's going to be alright. There are ways to suppress the Black Blood. I'm still me, aren't I?""

4163796953.m_KeyValue: "I just think we're being too hasty. This is our first encounter with a special type. The Church would surely be interested in this specimen. And the other one is only a child..."

4163796954.m_KeyValue: ""Hmph, I was just wondering why a little brat about to be corrupted by the Black Blood hasn't been dealt with yet!""

4163796976.m_KeyValue: ""As I said before, those with Black Blood are beyond saving. I've no interest in him, but...""

4163796979.m_KeyValue: "Aiona won't turn a blind eye to the suffering of others. She treats this world with her kindness. She's nothing like you!"

4163796980.m_KeyValue: "It's up to the people living here to decide where to draw the line. The Church that abandoned us has no right—"

4163797007.m_KeyValue: "Those werewolves... why are they talking like Clive?"

4163797012.m_KeyValue: ""The spores I gave you... you still have some, right?""

4163797013.m_KeyValue: ""Her actions are driven by emotion, overwhelmed by sentimentality. Perhaps this is why the Alita family has been reluctant to let her take over.""

4163797014.m_KeyValue: "Especially Friedrich... He's already mastered 'Covenant'. I feel like I'm falling further and further behind them."

4163797016.m_KeyValue: "It is the cage that seals the sources of the Black Blood—the Seeds of Calamity."

4163797017.m_KeyValue: ""Consuming it may make you feel better, just like the child earlier...""

4163797048.m_KeyValue: "Just how old are you?! I couldn't tell from your appearance at all!"

4163797077.m_KeyValue: "Something caused me to lose most of my memories. It has been a painful experience."

4164227917.m_KeyValue: ""I'm not sad... If you need any help in the future, you can always come to me.""

4189851120.m_KeyValue: "Now it all adds up—the Saint anticipated this."

4189851121.m_KeyValue: ""Now, let us begin this tragic prelude of mutual slaughter!""

4189851122.m_KeyValue: "The Silver Cross uncovered House Astolfo's betrayal long ago. Just like the Bathorys before them."

4189852143.m_KeyValue: ""Insolence! Who do you think you are, mumbling in the Hall of the Elders?""

4189852144.m_KeyValue: "Nothing has changed... I keep becoming someone else for nothing."

4189852145.m_KeyValue: ""We can take shelter inside if we get through the corridor. You guys go first, I'll cover you.""

4193062856.m_KeyValue: ""I'm sorry, but I can't make that promise.""

4193584417.m_KeyValue: ""Recently, many vassals have experienced digestive discomfort from consuming raw meat. Perhaps we should reduce the supply of raw meat in the dining hall. What are your thoughts on this matter?""

4193584514.m_KeyValue: "A Blood Servant has suggested purchasing a highly effective bloodstain cleaning agent developed by the Church. What are your thoughts on this matter?"

4198433453.m_KeyValue: ""Huh? Didn't you have that sparkling, firefly-like ability? Wait, you mean I can't make wishes to you?""

4198433454.m_KeyValue: ""Wake up, I'm not a wish-granting sprite.""

4198433461.m_KeyValue: ""Mr. Nevernight, I hope this letter finds you well. I wish you all the best in your days after leaving Sapphire Isle.""

4198433463.m_KeyValue: "Has anything interesting happened to you? Would you tell me about it in your letter?"

4198433464.m_KeyValue: "The doctor says I need plenty of rest and less physical activity. These days are just so dull."

4198433465.m_KeyValue: ""I just... lost the only friend I could confide in, and I feel a bit lost.""

4201795438.m_KeyValue: ""Don't worry, I'll pay what we agreed upon.""

4202321388.m_KeyValue: "Perhaps everyone's been mistaken from the start."

4202321389.m_KeyValue: ""...How disappointing. Still unwilling to show me your true form, Mass?""

4202321390.m_KeyValue: "Isn't that better? The Church won't be ready for a breach today."

4202321391.m_KeyValue: ""Sealed beneath the wings of the Divine Body… Limine Bathory, the Everlasting Night.""

4202321392.m_KeyValue: "Just like when you toppled the old Carrelle house eighty-eight years ago?"

4212263854.m_KeyValue: ""We'll make it out of here, Aiona.""

4212263855.m_KeyValue: ""This little thing was so scared a moment ago, but now it has completely let its guard down. You really are something.""

4212263858.m_KeyValue: ""It just came into this world. It's curious about everything around it, but also afraid...""

4218894216.m_KeyValue: "Let's try to shake them off. We don't have time to deal with them now."

4219357333.m_KeyValue: ""Patch, just stand by at the treasure chest.""

4221079461.m_KeyValue: ""We'll surely find it, won't we? A way to stop 'Death.'""

4221079465.m_KeyValue: "Jason! Have you lost your mind?! That's a Blood Beast!"

4221079726.m_KeyValue: "This coast feels oddly familiar... Is it just my imagination? I can't shake the feeling that I've been here before."

4221079757.m_KeyValue: "...We don't know if we'll run into them again here. We should find somewhere that's safe."

4221079758.m_KeyValue: "Ah... Th-Thank you for saving me. I've always been... scared of the dark... and wild animals."

4221079759.m_KeyValue: "Then... could this be that legendary place? Have I ended up here due to sheer coincidence?"

4221079760.m_KeyValue: "I shouldn't jump to conclusions. I've only explored this side of the island. Who knows what I'll find inland or on the other coast."

4221079789.m_KeyValue: ""Could this really be just a coincidence? After everything that happened on the El Dorado, I still ended up here—""

4221079790.m_KeyValue: "Earlier you mentioned you had something to ask me?"

4221079792.m_KeyValue: ""Wait, you weren't a passenger on the El Dorado?""

4221079795.m_KeyValue: ""Today... but maybe not. I really can't tell, because...""

4221079821.m_KeyValue: ""Your grandmother? Is she on this island? No, that can't be, a normal person can't just vanish...""

4221079824.m_KeyValue: "I don't think it's just the island welcoming us home."

4221079825.m_KeyValue: ""I've looked all over, but she's nowhere to be seen. With everything that's happening on the island right now...""

4221079827.m_KeyValue: ""You must live on. I'll be waiting for you here, always...""

4221079828.m_KeyValue: ""Maybe he really doesn't know... Remember, Dr. Ressa said that Noah was a 'person without memories.'""

4221079853.m_KeyValue: "Hold on... The transformed Gravekeepers from 66 years ago just materialized before us and vanished just the same"

4221079854.m_KeyValue: ""Everything you saw, and will see, are merely 'shades' formed from the lingering longings of those devoured by Death—nothing more.""

4221079858.m_KeyValue: ""Well, since I can't have any alone time, let's just go find our 'objective.'""

4221079859.m_KeyValue: "But he was kept in the central chamber..."

4221079887.m_KeyValue: "Your true identity... could it be that you're the..."

4221079889.m_KeyValue: "I won't be manipulated by your words. I'll uncover the truth about my past on my own terms."

4221079890.m_KeyValue: "Ressa is the island's best doctor. She's our only hope for survival..."

4221079892.m_KeyValue: ""That makes sense... If Empousa and the others ended up here too, they'd probably look for village first. Well, Aiona would, at least.""

4221079915.m_KeyValue: ""We can easily check that, for example...""

4221079917.m_KeyValue: ""Grandmother did tell me about the rules governing these phantoms, but she never mentioned if the ones we can't see could be harmful...""

4221079918.m_KeyValue: "This feeling of memories being excavated from deep within my mind... It's as if I've experienced it somewhere not long ago..."

4221079920.m_KeyValue: "And here I thought you weren't much of a talker."

4221079922.m_KeyValue: ""Then why, Noah... why do you still...""

4221079923.m_KeyValue: ""And you're obviously afraid of ghosts, yet you completely trust what 'they' have been telling you.""

4221079924.m_KeyValue: ""Noah... you've really been through a lot, haven't you...""

4221284899.m_KeyValue: ""And these two—Jones, from Van Helsing's squad, and William... the Captain's brother.""

4221284901.m_KeyValue: ""There are no eternal friends, only eternal profits. Cain is now our common enemy.""

4221284902.m_KeyValue: "I don't understand how you can wear another's face so easily... but the power you wield—it pales beside the original."

4221284904.m_KeyValue: "Sacrifice? You mean the _$$vessel_$$ for that vile ritual you so shamelessly glorify."

4222593432.m_KeyValue: ""You may look like Colossus Max, but you're nothing like him! You disgrace the form you wear.""

4233757347.m_KeyValue: "How curious... So many Brennholts have been thrown into the flames. And yet you're the first to answer."

4233757350.m_KeyValue: "So they hand the name out like candy."
